announcements.subject: Retirement
announcements.detail: Central Bank of India has informed the Exchange about Retirement
announcements.ai_summary: Central Bank of India has informed the stock exchanges about significant changes in its management due to retirements. Shri Mukul N. Dandige, Chief General Manager and Chief Financial Officer, retired on May 31, 2026, upon superannuation. Concurrently, Shri Suryanarayana Murty Saladi, General Manager of the MSME Department, also retired on May 31, 2026, due to superannuation. These changes are in accordance with Regulation 30 and 51 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The bank has requested that these updates be taken on record by the exchanges.

announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities
announcements.detail: Alkyl Amines Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Options to purchase securities
announcements.ai_summary: Alkyl Amines Chemicals Limited's Nomination and Remuneration Committee, in a meeting held on March 31, 2026, approved the grant of 28,300 stock options to eligible employees under the "AACL Employees Stock Option Plan 2018". Of these, 21,900 stock options are granted at an exercise price of Rs. 1,125 per option, and 6,400 stock options are granted at an exercise price of Rs. 875 per option. The stock options are convertible into equity shares of face value Rs. 2/- each. These options will vest over a period of 1 to 4 years and can be exercised within 5 years from the date of vesting. The scheme is in compliance with SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021.

announcements.subject: Sale or disposal
announcements.detail: Dev Information Technology Limited has informed the Exchange about Sale or disposal
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Dev Information Technology Limited has approved the sale and transfer of its products, ByteSIGNER and Talligence, along with their associated business as a going concern on a slump exchange basis. This decision was made by the Board of Directors on March 31, 2026, based on the recommendation of the Audit Committee. The sale is to M/s. Byte Technosys Private Limited, an associate company of DEVIT, and will be effective from March 31, 2026. The cash consideration for this transaction is Rs. 11.90 Crores. The valuation for the slump sale was determined by an independent registered valuer. The Board's approval aligns with Section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013, and Regulation 23 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities
announcements.detail: Fusion Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Options to purchase securities
announcements.ai_summary: Fusion Finance Limited's Nomination and Remuneration Committee, on March 31, 2026, approved the grant of 25,000 stock options to eligible employees under the Fusion Employee Stock Option Plan 2023. These options are granted at an exercise price of Rs. 138.24 per stock option, which was the closing price on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on March 30, 2026. The options will vest not before one year from the grant date and can be exercised within eight years from the vesting date. The company confirmed that the scheme complies with the SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Krishana Phoschem Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial production at Meghnagar, Distt.-Jhabua, Madhya Pradesh
announcements.ai_summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited has commenced commercial production of its Diammonium Phosphate & Nitrogen and Phosphorus (DAP/NPK Complex) fertilizer plant located in Meghnagar, District Jhabua, Madhya Pradesh, effective March 31, 2026. This expansion increases the installed production capacity of DAP/NPK to 4,95,000 Metric Tonnes Per Annum. The company has informed the exchange about this commencement of operations as per Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: D. P. Abhushan Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated March 31, 2026, titled "D. P. Abhushan Limited hereby submit Press Release titled "D. P. Abhushan Limited Inaugurates a New Showroom in Dhar, Madhya Pradesh, Further Strengthening its Central India Footprint."".
announcements.ai_summary: D. P. Abhushan Limited has inaugurated a new showroom in Dhar, Madhya Pradesh, on March 30, 2026, as part of its strategy to strengthen its presence in Central India. The new showroom, located in Happy Villa Colony, spans approximately 3,000 sq. ft. of retail area and is designed to cater to the region's preference for classic and bridal jewellery, offering a curated collection of gold, silver, diamond, Kundan, and Polki items. This expansion is a regular operational initiative aimed at making premium jewellery collections more accessible in Tier-II cities across India. The company's press release highlights the historical significance of Dhar as a jewellery market rooted in trust and family legacy.

announcements.subject: Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up
announcements.detail: Senco Gold Limited has informed the Exchange about Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up
announcements.ai_summary: Senco Gold Limited has extended its strategic and marketing tie-up with August Jewellery Private Limited (AJPL), which operates the omnichannel brand "Melorra." This arrangement, initially valid until March 31, 2026, has now been extended until June 30, 2026, on the same terms and conditions as previously agreed. The company had previously informed the exchange about this tie-up on April 24, 2025, September 27, 2025, and December 29, 2025. The extension covers operational transactions and does not involve any acquisition. The details of the agreement, including its domestic scope and business operations, remain the same as initially disclosed.

announcements.subject: Diversification/Disinvestment
announcements.detail: PDS Limited has informed the Exchange about Diversification/Disinvestment
announcements.ai_summary: PDS Limited has informed the Exchange that NexStyle Apparel Manufacturing Limited has ceased to be a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company effective March 31, 2026. This change is a consequence of the allotment of Employee Stock Options. The company has provided this update in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Aditya Vision Limited has informed the Exchange about- opening of showroom
announcements.ai_summary: Aditya Vision Limited has announced the opening of five new showrooms on March 31, 2026, as part of its business expansion. The new showrooms are located in Unnao (203rd showroom), Agra (204th showroom), Aligarh (205th showroom), Hardoi (206th showroom), and Agra (207th showroom), all in Uttar Pradesh. This expansion is in line with the company's strategy to increase its retail presence.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: TVS Srichakra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated March 31, 2026, titled "Launching of Exclusive Retail Outlet in Ludhiana which will be Company s 14th signature store in India".
announcements.ai_summary: TVS Srichakra Limited has announced the launch of its new exclusive retail outlet in Ludhiana on March 31, 2026. This marks the company's 14th signature store in India, aimed at strengthening its retail presence and providing customers with a complete tyre and 2-wheeler care experience. The new outlet will offer Eurogrip's entire range of tyres, along with services such as professional tyre fitment, tyre care, puncture repair, and air pressure checks. This expansion is part of TVS Srichakra Limited's strategy to enhance its branded retail footprint across key Indian markets and provide a consistent and trusted service environment.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: DOMS Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about update on Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: On March 31, 2026, DOMS Industries Limited announced the completion of the acquisition of an additional 6.5% stake in Pioneer Stationery Private Limited, a subsidiary. The company purchased 3,900 Equity Shares from existing shareholders for a total consideration of ₹5,53,80,000. This acquisition increases DOMS Industries Limited's shareholding in Pioneer to 64.0% from the previous 57.5% of its total paid-up Equity Share capital. This transaction follows the Board of Directors' approval for acquiring an additional 13.0% stake and is a continuation of their letter dated December 29, 2025. The update is in accordance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bluspring Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 31, 2026, titled "Bluspring records another robust quarter delivering strong YoY growth: Revenues up 20%, EBITDA up 48% and PAT up 47%".
announcements.ai_summary: Bluspring Enterprises Limited has reported robust financial results for the first quarter of FY 2026-27, ended June 30, 2026. The company's revenues increased by 20% year-on-year to ₹930 crore, while EBITDA saw a significant rise of 48% year-on-year to ₹35 crore, with EBITDA margin improving by 72 basis points to 3.8%. Profit After Tax (PAT) grew by 47% year-on-year to ₹16 crore, and diluted Earnings Per Share (EPS) stood at ₹1.1, a 45% increase year-on-year. These results exclude the foundit business, which had revenues of ₹19 crore and an EBITDA of ₹(14) crore in Q1 FY27. The company attributes its strong performance to the integration of STEAG India and the planned acquisition of LSG Sky Chefs India, which are enhancing its scale and capabilities.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: PCBL Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations )   Order issued by the Office of Assistant Excise And Taxation Officer, Sonipat, Haryana
announcements.ai_summary: PCBL Chemical Limited has disclosed an order issued by the Office of the Assistant Excise and Taxation Officer, Sonipat, Haryana. The order, dated July 31, 2026, confirms a penalty of ₹6,08,400 under section 129(3) of the GST Act, 2017. This penalty is in connection with the detention of a vehicle en route on March 23, 2026, due to incomplete documentation for the movement of goods. The company has evaluated the order and stated that there is no material impact on its financial, operational, or other activities.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: InterGlobe Aviation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a Press Release.
announcements.ai_summary: InterGlobe Aviation Limited, operating as IndiGo, has announced the conclusion of its wide-body damp lease operations with Norse Atlantic Airways, effective October 25, 2026. This decision is attributed to the challenging operating environment, including geopolitical tensions and significant cost escalations. IndiGo flights between Mumbai and Amsterdam will be transitioned to be operated using its Airbus A321XLR from October 25, 2026. The airline will temporarily discontinue services to London Heathrow until its Airbus A350-900 aircraft are delivered. The damp lease, initiated in early 2025 with six Boeing 787-9 aircraft, was intended to fast-track learning, develop capabilities, and establish brand presence for future widebody ambitions, enabling services to the UK and Europe.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about update on Technical Ammonium Nitrate Project
announcements.ai_summary: Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited has announced a significant update regarding its Technical Ammonium Nitrate Project. Production of Technical Ammonium Nitrate - Ammonium Nitrate Solution (ANS) has commenced effective July 31, 2026, at the company's existing site in Gadepan, District Kota, Rajasthan. The production of prilled High Density Ammonium Nitrate (HDAN) is expected to commence in due course. This development is a continuation of the project to set up a plant for the manufacture of Technical Ammonium Nitrate and Weak Nitric Acid.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Afcons Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about the press release with respect to new order of Rs. 900 cr secured by the Company. The order mentioned in the enclosed press release have been received in the normal course of business.
announcements.ai_summary: Afcons Infrastructure Limited has secured new orders totaling nearly ₹900 crore in July, as announced in a press release. These orders were received in the normal course of business and strengthen the company's presence in India's urban infrastructure sector. The company, a flagship of the Shapoorji Pallonji Group, has a legacy of over six decades and a strong track record in executing complex EPC projects both domestically and internationally, with a footprint in 31 countries. Afcons is recognized globally, ranking among the Top 140 international contractors, and specifically within the top 12 in Bridges and top 8 in Marine & Ports.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Astec LifeSciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 31, 2026, titled "ASTEC: Astec LifeSciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 31, 2026, titled "Press Release for the Quarter ended June 30, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Astec LifeSciences Limited announced its Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter ended June 30, 2026, as approved by the Board of Directors on July 31, 2026. For Q1 FY27, the company reported a consolidated total income of ₹84.3 crore, a decrease of 8.0% from ₹91.6 crore in Q1 FY26. Consolidated EBITDA improved to ₹0.1 crore in Q1 FY27, compared to a loss of ₹-10.5 crore in Q1 FY26. The company reported a consolidated Loss after tax of ₹-18.7 crore in Q1 FY27, an improvement from a loss of ₹-33.0 crore in Q1 FY26. Revenue from Enterprise Products grew 42% year-on-year to ₹51.8 crore in Q1 FY27, while revenue from CDMO Products stood at ₹31.8 crore in Q1 FY27.

announcements.subject: General Updates

announcements.company: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited
announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 31, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited announced its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 31, 2026. The company reported a significant increase in revenue from operations, which more than doubled year-on-year to INR 832 crore. Adjusted EBITDA grew by 74% year-on-year to INR 494 crore, while reported Profit After Tax (PAT) stood at INR 55 crore. The company's contracted Renewable Energy (RE) Power Sales capacity reached 6 GW as of June 30, 2026, with a total contracted portfolio, including the RE Services segment, standing at 6.8 GW. This represents a threefold increase in the total contracted portfolio over the past two years. During the quarter, CleanMax commissioned a record 0.5 GW of capacity across India, marking the highest quarterly commissioning in its history.

announcements.company: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited
announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger
announcements.detail: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Amalgamation/Merger
announcements.ai_summary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on 31 July 2026, approved a Composite Scheme of Amalgamation. This scheme involves the amalgamation of four wholly-owned subsidiaries: Clean Max Aditya Power Private Limited, Cleanmax IPP 1 Private Limited, CMES Power 1 Private Limited, and CMES Infinity Private Limited (collectively, "Amalgamating Companies") with Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited ("Amalgamated Company"). As a result, the Amalgamating Companies will be dissolved without winding up, and all their issued and outstanding equity shares will be cancelled. Since the Amalgamating Companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries, no new shares will be issued, nor will any cash or other payment be made by the Company as consideration under the Scheme. The amalgamation is being undertaken pursuant to Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013, and in compliance with the Income Tax Act, 2025. The Scheme is subject to necessary statutory and regulatory approvals, including sanction by the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench. The board meeting commenced at 03:00 p.m. and concluded at 06:00 p.m.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 31, 2026, titled "Press Release and Management Discussion & Analysis".
announcements.ai_summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited announced its financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, via a press release dated July 31, 2026. The Supreme Court reviewed its earlier order and altered it to ensure that Environmental Clearances (ECs) granted under the 2017 Notification and 2021 OM until now remain valid unless challenged on merits. All pending applications made under these notifications will be taken to their logical conclusion, and any application dismissed or delisted solely due to a stay order or the Vanashakti-I judgment may be reconsidered. However, no fresh applications under these instruments will be entertained. Consequently, the proposal for the grant of EC for OMDC's Belkundi Mines is ordered to be restored to its stage before delisting on May 31, 2025, for reconsideration. Notably, on July 28, 2026, the MoEF&CC had already favorably recommended the grant of EC for the Belkundi Iron and Mn. Mines, subject to the outcome of the Supreme Court's judgment and other conditions.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Bharat Gears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.:We refer to our letter dated April 16, 2026 made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (the "Regulations").Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Regulations  we hereby inform you that Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company, has intimated the Company that the appeal dated 15.04.2026 filed by him under Section 11 of the Passports Act, 1967, against the revocation of his passport, has been dismissed by an Order dated July 23, 2026 passed by the Joint Secretary (PSP) & Chief Passport Officer (CPO), Ministry of External Affairs, which was received by him on July 29, 2026. Mr. Kanwar has further informed the Company that the said appeal has been disposed of without providing him any opportunity of representing his case, which is contrary to the proviso to Section 11(5) of the Passports Act, 1967, which mandates that a reasonable opportunity has to be given before disposing of the appeal. Accordingly, he is in the process taking appropriate steps for filing a rectification/clarificatory/appropriate application viz. the said order.Mr. Kanwar has also assured that at every juncture, he remains fully mindful of his fiduciary duties and will continue to keep the Board promptly informed of any material developments and advised that the statutory authorities be informed accordingly in a fair and transparent manner.The Company will keep you informed of any material developments in this matter, as and when required, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.You are requested to kindly take the same on record.
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Gears Limited has been informed by Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director, that his appeal filed on April 15, 2026, against the revocation of his passport has been dismissed by an order dated July 23, 2026, passed by the Joint Secretary (PSP) & Chief Passport Officer (CPO), Ministry of External Affairs. Mr. Kanwar received this order on July 29, 2026. He has stated that the appeal was disposed of without an opportunity for him to represent his case, which he believes is contrary to Section 11(5) of the Passports Act, 1967. Mr. Kanwar is taking steps to file a rectification/clarificatory application regarding the order and has assured the Board of his continued fiduciary duties and commitment to keeping them informed of material developments.

The company received 25% of the issue price upfront, amounting to Rs. 41.25/- per warrant or Rs. 6,18,75,000/- in total. announcements.ai_summary: Aether Industries Limited and Dow Chemical International Private Limited have announced a collaborative research program aimed at advancing silicone manufacturing technology development in India. The company cited the commoditized nature of the MCD business, its low strategic relevance, and limited pricing power, which have negatively impacted its margins and profitability, as reasons for the closure. This decision follows a global agreement between BASF and funds managed by Carlyle regarding BASF's automotive coatings businesses.

These observations were procedural in nature, and none were repeat observations or related to data integrity. The company does not anticipate any impact on the supply of its commercial products and will work closely with the Agency to address the observations, responding to the U.S. FDA within the stipulated timeline. The company will keep the stock exchanges informed of any further updates regarding this matter.

This significant milestone is a major step towards the film's global release, validating its international potential and strengthening Digikore's transition into owned IP and global content creation. Chairman Mr. Rashesh Gogri stated that this milestone represents a major leap forward in expanding production capabilities and strengthening the company's ability to serve business partners.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 30, 2026, titled "IKS Health Delivers $12 Million in Annual Cash Impact for Coding Foundation at Axia Women s Health.".
announcements.ai_summary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited (IKS Health) issued a press release on June 30, 2026, titled "IKS Health Delivers $12 Million in Annual Cash Impact for Coding Foundation at Axia Women’s Health." The press release highlights IKS Health's partnership with Axia Women’s Health, a leading U.S. women's healthcare provider with over 450 clinicians. IKS Health delivered $12 million in annual cash upside for Axia Women’s Health, along with a 36% reduction in total denial rate to 5.5% and a 37% reduction in total coding-specific denials to 2.4%. Coding accuracy was maintained above 96%, and there was a 10% increase in charges and CPTs per visit due to identifying potentially missed billable services. Monthly collections increased by $1.6 million to $14.3 million, and accounts receivable status improved by 1.3 days to 38.7 days, as IKS Health scaled coding volume to 100% of Axia's sites, up from 60%.

announcements.ai_summary: The Ruby Mills Limited is experiencing a disruption of operations at its Dhamni Weaving Division due to a work stoppage by certain workmen, effective June 29, 2026, related to ongoing wage settlement discussions. While a draft settlement was circulated, some workmen subsequently abstained from reporting for duty. The matter is currently under conciliation with the Assistant Labour Officer, and the company has initiated legal and administrative proceedings. The work stoppage is confined to one department, and other manufacturing operations, including the Spinning and Processing Divisions, remain unaffected. The company is assessing the financial and operational impact, which is not expected to be material and is not covered by insurance. Steps are being taken to minimize disruption and continue servicing customers.

This collaboration, detailed in a press release dated June 30, 2026, involves Ajanta Group integrating Unicommerce's Order Management System (OMS) and Warehouse Management System (WMS) solutions. The objective is to streamline inventory management and order fulfilment across multiple online marketplaces and its D2C website, addressing the growing online demand and strengthening its digital presence. Unicommerce's platform will provide a unified dashboard for real-time inventory visibility and automated order processing, aiming to reduce stock mismatches and improve fulfilment accuracy.

announcements.ai_summary: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Limited has issued a press release on June 30, 2026, announcing the launch of its new centrifugal air compressor model, 'Tezcatlipoca' A800. This model is designed to deliver 600 to 980 CFM of Class 0 oil-free air and is positioned as India's first indigenously designed and manufactured centrifugal air compressor in this specific CFM range. The launch, which took place on June 26, 2026, aims to provide a more efficient and reliable alternative to conventional dry screw compressors for critical industrial applications, offering superior air quality and lower lifecycle costs. The company highlights the engineering efforts involved in refining impeller designs, bearing systems, and controls to achieve this performance in a smaller footprint.

MLMML plans to raise approximately Rs. 322 crore through the issuance of equity shares to Lightrock Cayman Holdings Ltd. and its affiliates, along with existing investors International Finance Corporation (IFC) and India-Japan Fund (IJF). announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Data Patterns (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition

The authorized share capital of STAC is Rs. 50,00,000, divided into 5,00,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 each. As of March 31, 2026, STAC's provisional turnover was Rs. 416.85 lakhs. This acquisition aims for vertical integration, as Data Patterns currently procures radomes and composite structures externally, leading to margin leakage and schedule dependency. Upon completion, STAC will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Data Patterns (India) Limited, subject to statutory and regulatory approvals.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: TVS Motor Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "TVS Motor Expands TVS Raider Super Squad Edition with New Marvel Doctor Doom-Inspired Variant".
announcements.ai_summary: TVS Motor Company announced on July 30, 2026, the expansion of its TVS Raider Super Squad Edition with a new Marvel Doctor Doom-inspired variant. This new variant features a striking spectral green colourway with a unique multi-tone travel finish that transitions from green to brown, designed to reflect Doctor Doom's powerful persona. The motorcycle is equipped with a Connected Reverse LCD Cluster, offering over 85 connected features, and iGO Assist technology for enhanced acceleration and effortless rideability. It retains the refined three-valve engine and offers wider tyres for improved confidence, with the top variant featuring dual disc brakes and single-channel ABS. The new variant was unveiled following the post-credit sequence of the newly released film, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, in select Indian theatres.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Opening of Keys Prima by Lemon Tree Hotels, Kempty Road, Mussoorie".
announcements.ai_summary: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited announced on July 30, 2026, the opening of Keys Prima by Lemon Tree Hotels, Kempty Road, Mussoorie. This new hotel features 47 well-appointed rooms and suites across Superior, Deluxe, Executive, and Studio Suite categories. Facilities include an all-day dining restaurant named Keys Café, Unlock Bar, a swimming pool, fitness centre, spa, kids' zone, and a banquet and conference venue called Grand Chamber. The hotel is managed by Carnation Hotels Private Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Lemon Tree Hotels Limited. This opening marks the group's second operational hotel in Mussoorie and expands its operational portfolio in Uttarakhand to 10 hotels, with an additional 11 properties currently in the pipeline across the state.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled 'Tata Steel reports Consolidated EBITDA of Rs 9,370 crores for the quarter ended June 30, 2026'
announcements.ai_summary: Consolidated Revenues for Tata Steel Limited for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, were Rs 60,794 crores, with an EBITDA of Rs 9,370 crores, marking a 25% year-on-year improvement despite a volatile operating environment. In India, revenues stood at Rs 36,989 crores and EBITDA was Rs 9,908 crores, achieving a 27% EBITDA margin, with India EBITDA per ton increasing by Rs 3,255 QoQ to Rs 19,162 per ton. India's crude steel production was 5.76 million tons and deliveries were 5.17 million tons, though affected by maintenance shutdowns. Netherlands revenues were €1,445 million with €4 million EBITDA, and UK revenues were £484 million with a narrowed EBITDA loss of £27 million. The company incurred Rs 3,579 crores in capital expenditure during the quarter, including progress on a 0.75 MTPA EAF at Ludhiana and a 0.7 MTPA Hot Rolled Pickling & Galvanising Line. Net debt was Rs 84,173 crores, with a Net debt to EBITDA ratio of 2.3x, and group liquidity remained strong at Rs 45,950 crores.

It has been successfully connected to the MSEDCL Grid through the commissioned infrastructure. The receipt of this certificate marks the successful completion of the project's commissioning, enabling commercial operations as per the regulatory framework. This update follows the company's earlier disclosure dated July 11, 2026, regarding the project's successful installation and commencement of power generation.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Alivus Life Sciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Press Release of the Company for the First Quarter ended June 30, 2026.".
announcements.ai_summary: Alivus Life Sciences Limited (formerly Glenmark Life Sciences Limited) released its financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 30, 2026. The company reported a revenue from operations of Rs. 6,404 Mn, marking a 6.4% year-on-year growth, primarily driven by a 26.5% growth in its non-GPL business. EBITDA for the quarter stood at Rs. 2,341 Mn, a 29.1% year-on-year increase, with margins reaching 36.6% due to a favorable product mix and new launches. Profit After Tax (PAT) surged by 31.8% year-on-year to Rs. 1,601 Mn, with PAT margins at 25.0%, an increase of 480 basis points. The company generated a strong free cash flow of Rs. 901 Mn during Q1FY27, resulting in cash and cash equivalents of Rs. 8,802 Mn as of June 30, 2026. Dr. Yasir Rawjee, MD & CEO, noted confidence in sustained momentum, despite the GPL business being expected to be flattish in FY27 and historically skewed towards H2.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Global Health Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Press release for the Results of First Quater ended June 30, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Global Health Limited has announced its unaudited consolidated financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a total income of INR 13,262 million, representing a 26.2% year-on-year growth. EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 3,153 million, up 23.5% year-on-year, with EBITDA margins at 23.8%. Profit before tax was INR 2,133 million, a 2.5% increase, while Profit after tax was INR 1,573 million, a slight decrease of 1.1% compared to the same quarter last year. The company also added 72 new beds across its network during the quarter, with 21 beds at Lucknow and 51 beds in Noida.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: The Karnataka Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about updated brief profile of Mr. Parthasarathi Periaswamy, Additional Director of the Bank
announcements.ai_summary: The Karnataka Bank Limited has provided an updated brief profile of Mr. Parthasarathi Periaswamy, who was appointed as an Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive, Independent Director on July 29, 2026, for a period of four years. Mr. Periaswamy is a seasoned technology and cybersecurity leader with over three decades of experience in India's financial sector. He previously served as Chief Information Security Officer and Chief General Manager (IT) at the Reserve Bank of India, and as Chief Technology Officer at the Institute for Development and Research in Banking Technology (IDRBT). He has also advised private sector banks on cybersecurity and was a Board Member of Indian Financial Technology and Allied Services (IFTAS), an RBI subsidiary, from 2019 to 2021.

announcements.ai_summary: Shalby Limited's Management Committee of Directors has approved availing working capital facilities totaling ₹129.70 crore from Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited. Of this amount, ₹119.70 crore will be utilized by Shalby Advanced Technologies, Inc., USA, an overseas step-down subsidiary, for its working capital needs. The remaining ₹10 crore will be availed by Shalby Limited itself through Working Capital Demand Loan (WCDL) or Cash Credit facilities. The meeting where this approval was granted commenced at 5:43 p.m. and concluded at 6:05 p.m. on July 30, 2026. This facility is considered to be in the overall interest of the company as it will assist the subsidiary in obtaining credit.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Navin Fluorine International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''.
announcements.ai_summary: Navin Fluorine International Limited has entered into an agreement with India's Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) – Ministry of Defence. This agreement pertains to the "Indigenous Manufacturing of Sodium Borohydride Chemical in Bulk" project, aimed at accelerating the indigenous process development for a critical defence material. DRDO has announced this collaboration, stating that the Technology Development Fund (TDF) Scheme will provide grant-in-aid and technological support to Navin Fluorine International Limited for developing this technology. This initiative is part of the "Make in India" program and is intended to strengthen India's defence R&D ecosystem. The company expressed pride in this collaboration and its contribution to indigenous defence capabilities.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: GAIL (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "GAIL (India) Limited enters prestigious FTSE4Good Index Series".
announcements.ai_summary: GAIL (India) Limited has been included in the prestigious FTSE4Good Index Series, as announced in a press release dated July 30, 2026. The company received the FTSE4Good Index Certificate of Membership following the June 2026 review by FTSE Russell. This recognition highlights GAIL's strong commitment to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance, emphasizing its focus on environmental stewardship, social responsibility, and robust corporate governance. The FTSE4Good Index Series identifies companies with strong ESG practices based on internationally recognized standards, and GAIL's inclusion underscores its alignment with global sustainability benchmarks.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Intimation of sale and transfer of project specific SPV/Subsidiary.
announcements.ai_summary: REC Limited has announced the sale and transfer of its project-specific Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV)/Subsidiary, Ryapte Power Transmission Limited. REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited (RECPDCL), a wholly-owned subsidiary of REC Limited, transferred its entire shareholding of 50,000 equity shares in Ryapte Power Transmission Limited to the successful bidder selected through a tariff-based competitive bidding process. This transfer, effective July 30, 2026, includes all assets and liabilities of the subsidiary. The consideration received for this sale and disposal is ₹8,86,62,034, which includes taxes, professional fees, and reimbursement. The Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) was executed between RECPDCL and the successful bidder on July 30, 2026. Consequently, Ryapte Power Transmission Limited is no longer a subsidiary of RECPDCL or REC Limited.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Rajratan Global Wire Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Rajratan Global Wire Limited's shareholders approved the re-appointment of Mr. Yashovardhan Chordia as CEO & Deputy Managing Director at the 38th Annual General Meeting. Mr. Chordia, representing the next generation of leadership, has been instrumental in the turnaround and expansion of the Thailand business, enhancing operational performance and market position. He has also driven global market development, expanding customer engagement in strategic markets like Japan, Europe, and the United States, and plays a key role in operational excellence and strategic alignment across manufacturing operations in India and Thailand. His leadership supports technology-driven processes and sustainability initiatives, aiming to build a more agile and resilient organization. The requisite details for his re-appointment are enclosed in Annexure A and B.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Tata Power Renewables Marks a Major milestone with Groundbreaking of 800 MW RE Project in Andhra Pradesh".
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Power Company Limited has issued a press release dated July 30, 2026, detailing a significant milestone for its subsidiary, Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (TPREL). TPREL has commenced a new 800 MW renewable energy project in Andhra Pradesh, comprising 400 MW of solar power capacity and 400 MW of wind power capacity. The project involves an investment of ₹5,750 crore and is expected to generate employment for 4,000 local people. Suzlon will be the EPC contractor for the wind component. This initiative aligns with the company's commitment to accelerating India's clean energy transition.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted with the Stock Exchange a disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted a disclosure regarding a penalty order received by its indirect wholly owned subsidiary, SMRC Automotive Interiors Spain S.L.U. The Department of Enterprise and Labour – Spain has imposed a penalty aggregating to Euro 65,000 (equivalent to INR 7.08 million) on SMRC Spain. The penalty relates to the company entering into temporary agency employment contracts for structural needs during 2025, rather than short-term requirements. SMRC Spain has filed an appeal with the Labour Department, and further appeals to the courts in Spain are intended if the initial appeal is dismissed. The company states there is no material impact on its financials or operations.

This new entity will be a step-down subsidiary of Clean Science and Technology Limited and will be engaged in the business of selling, distribution, trading, and job work of specialty chemicals and related products. The incorporation process will commence with an initial capital of EUR 50,000 (or its INR equivalent), to be infused in tranches.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Kabra Extrusion Technik Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Kabra Extrusion Technik Limited has announced its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a significant year-on-year revenue growth of 44.8%, reaching ₹ 1,245 Million. This growth was primarily driven by the Geon business, which saw its revenues surge by 133.1% year-on-year to ₹ 701 Million. The extrusion machinery segment contributed ₹ 544 Million to the revenue. The company achieved a positive EBITDA of ₹ 60 Million with an EBITDA margin of 5.0% for the quarter, a notable improvement from a negative EBITDA in the prior year's quarter.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Life Insurance Corporation Of India has informed the Exchange about demand order for GST, Interest and penalty for Jharkhand State.
announcements.ai_summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) has received a demand order from the Additional Commissioner Central GST & Central Excise, Jamshedpur, for Goods & Service Tax (GST), interest, and penalty for the Financial Year 2022-23. The demand includes GST of INR 99,09,87,896/-, applicable interest, and a penalty of INR 9,90,98,790/-. The alleged contravention pertains to the pre-mature availment of Input Tax Credit on Reverse Charge Mechanism. This order is appealable before the Commissioner (Appeals), Jamshedpur. LIC has stated that there is no material impact on its financials, operations, or other activities due to this demand.

These funds will be raised in tranches by issuing debt instruments via the Bank's Dubai and/or Sydney branches. The meeting commenced at 03:45 PM and concluded at 05:25 PM.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Power Company Limited has completed the acquisition of 100% equity stake in Ryapte Power Transmission Limited (RPTL) on July 30, 2026. RPTL is a special purpose vehicle (SPV) established on May 21, 2025, to provide transmission services on a Build-Own-Operate-Transfer basis. The acquisition involved a cash consideration of ₹ 10.87 crore. Approval for the share transfer of RPTL has been received from the Ministry of Power. This acquisition is in line with Tata Power's strategy to establish and operate transmission services.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: PVR INOX Limited has informed the Exchange about opening of 3-screen Multiplex at Mall 11, Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh.
announcements.ai_summary: PVR INOX Limited has announced the opening of a new 3-screen multiplex in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, on July 30, 2026. This expansion is part of the company's strategy to focus on India's growing Tier II markets. The new cinema, developed in partnership with Satya Prakash Group, spans approximately 19,430 sq. ft. and is located in the Madan Mahal area, within Mall 11. It features 659 luxury recliner seats across three auditoriums, equipped with 2K projection, Dolby 7.1 surround sound, and Next Generation 3D technology. This launch brings PVR INOX's total screen count to 1782 across 355 properties in 113 cities, with 10 cinemas and 55 screens now in Madhya Pradesh.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Sical Logistics Limited has informed the exchange regarding 'availing of lease facility from Tata Capital Limited'.
announcements.ai_summary: Sical Logistics Limited's board of directors, in a meeting held on July 30, 2026, approved availing a lease facility of up to Rs. 72 crore from Tata Capital Limited. This facility will be used to lease commercial equipment, including dumpers, excavators, dozers, graders, water tankers, and diesel tankers, for a period of 60 months. These options are exercisable into an equal number of equity shares of face value ₹10 each. The grant is in compliance with the SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021. The exercise price for these options is determined at a discount of not more than 20% on the latest available closing price of the company's equity shares on the National Stock Exchange. The meeting commenced at 10:30 AM and concluded at 11:45 AM.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bank Of India has informed the Exchange about change in MCLR & FRS w.e.f 01-08-2026
announcements.ai_summary: Bank of India has announced a revision in its Marginal Cost of Fund based Lending Rate (MCLR) and Fixed Rate Spread (FRS), effective from August 01, 2026. The bank's ALCO meeting decided to adjust the MCLR, with the 3-month MCLR increasing from 8.25% to 8.35% and the 1-year MCLR increasing from 8.75% to 8.80%. Other MCLR tenors, including Overnight, 1-Month, 6-Month, and 3-Year, will remain unchanged. The Repo Based Lending Rate (RBLR) will also see no change. Specific details on the revised Fixed Rate Spread (FRS) rates for various tenors are also being implemented from August 01, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Satin Creditcare Network Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Satin Creditcare Network Limited announced its un-audited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 30, 2026. The company reported a consolidated Profit After Tax (PAT) of ₹123 Crores, marking a significant 172% year-on-year increase from ₹45 Crores in Q1 FY26. This marks the 20th consecutive profitable quarter for the company. Consolidated Assets under Management (AUM) grew by 27.5% to ₹15,935 Crores, and disbursements increased by 55.9% to ₹3,495 Crores. The company also reported a strong improvement in asset quality, with PAR 1 improving to 3.0% on a standalone basis, and collection efficiency for the X bucket remaining at 99.9%. Credit cost reduced by over 177 bps to 3.06% (including a management overlay buffer of ₹36 Crores). The results are available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: General Updates

Shareholders can submit their feedback via email to investors@balpharma.com or the scrutinizer at parameshwar@vjkt.in. The remote e-voting facility will remain open until 5:00 PM on Saturday, August 08, 2026. The company has also made this intimation available on its website.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Maral Overseas Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Dhanuka Agritech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Clarification regarding determination of Appreciation Amount under the Proposed Dhanuka Stock Appreciation Rights Plan, 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: Dhanuka Agritech Limited has issued a clarification regarding the determination of the appreciation amount under its proposed Dhanuka Stock Appreciation Rights Plan, 2026 ("SAR 2026"). This clarification addresses queries from proxy advisory firms. The appreciation amount payable upon exercise of each SAR will be the cash equivalent of the appreciation in the underlying equity share's value. This amount is calculated as (Fair Market Value as on the date of Exercise of SAR – Exercise Price) × Number of SARs Exercised. The exercise price will be no less than the closing market price of the shares on the date of grant, especially if a higher number of shares traded on that date. This information is also available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Swiggy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Swiggy Limited has submitted a press release dated July 30, 2026, detailing its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported that its Food Delivery business achieved INR 292 Crore in Adjusted EBITDA, a year-on-year increase of INR 100 Crore, on a Gross Order Value (GOV) growth of 17.4% YoY to INR 9,490 Crore. Overall revenue for the quarter grew 34.0% YoY to INR 7,112 Crore, and platform Monthly Transacting Users (MTUs) increased by 27.4% YoY to 27.5 million.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Fischer Medical Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Press Release on Fischer Medical Ventures Secures CDSCO Import Approval for Spincare   India's First Regulatory Clearance for a Portable Electrospun Wound Care System".
announcements.ai_summary: Fischer Medical Ventures Limited has announced that its associate company, Nanomedic Technologies Ltd. (Lod, Israel), has received import approval from India's Central Licensing Authority (CDSCO) for the Spincare Portable Wound Care System. This approval, issued under Form MD-27 of the Medical Devices Rules, 2017, marks the first regulatory clearance in India for a portable electrospun wound care system. The Spincare system is a Class C medical device designed to apply a breathable, transparent nano-fiber film directly onto wounds, potentially replacing traditional dressings for various skin breaches including partial and full thickness wounds, burns, surgical incisions, and chronic ulcers. This development positions Fischer Medical Ventures to enter India's growing advanced wound care market.

The adoption includes Finacle Deposits Suite, Finacle Lending Suite, Finacle Virtual Accounts Management, and Finacle Liquidity Management Solution. This transformation is expected to enhance Investec's business agility, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance, enabling more intelligent banking experiences and accelerating innovation through an extensive API suite.

announcements.detail: Bhageria Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Bhageria Industries Limited has provided an update regarding a legal matter before the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT). The SAT had adjourned a case involving promoters, promoter groups, and directors challenging a Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) adjudication order dated March 31, 2023. The matter was listed for final disposal between July 28 and July 30, 2026. Following an adjournment on July 28, 2026, and after consultation with all parties, the next hearing date has been set for October 21, 2026, for final disposal. The SEBI order dated March 31, 2023, remains stayed until this date. The company received the formal order copy on July 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "OIL Signs MoU with MCD to Establish Compressed Bio-Gas Plants Based on Municipal Solid Waste in Delhi".
announcements.ai_summary: Oil India Limited (OIL), a Maharatna CPSE, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) to establish Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) plants utilizing segregated organic municipal solid waste in Delhi. The MoU, signed on July 30, 2026, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Delhi and the Hon’ble Mayor of Delhi, aims to foster collaboration for sustainable waste management and clean energy production. Initially, two CBG plants with capacities of 500 TPD and 300 TPD are planned, which will produce 30 to 32 TPD of Compressed Biogas. This initiative supports the conversion of biodegradable waste into renewable fuel, reducing landfill dependency, improving urban sanitation, and lowering greenhouse gas emissions, aligning with the Government of India’s energy transition and circular economy objectives.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: The Board of Directors of VAML have approved the execution of definitive agreements with Serentica Renewable India 9 Private Limited for integration of a Battery Energy Storage System( BESS )
announcements.ai_summary: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited (VAML) has approved the execution of definitive agreements with Serentica Renewable India 9 Private Limited (SRI9PL) to integrate a 150 MW Round-The-Clock Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). This integration, utilizing an existing 600 MW Solar Power Delivery Agreement, will convert the solar power arrangement into a reliable RTC renewable power solution, supporting VAML's decarbonization roadmap and regulatory compliance. VAML proposes to invest INR 165 Crore, representing a 26% stake, in the project, which will be developed on a Build-Own-Operate-Maintain (BOOM) basis for a 25-year term from commissioning. The Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) is expected to commence power delivery within 12 months of the PDA signing, with project funding structured at a 70:30 debt-to-equity ratio. The Board of Directors of VAML approved this on July 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: WESTLIFE FOODWORLD LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled " Submission of Press Release for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026.".
announcements.ai_summary: Westlife Foodworld Limited announced its financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 30, 2026, reporting its strongest growth momentum in recent quarters. The company's revenue for Q1 FY27 stood at ₹7.36 billion, a 12% year-on-year increase, driven by robust guest count growth and a value-led strategy. Same Store Sales Growth (SSSG) improved to 4.3%, with May and June showing particularly strong performance. Operating EBITDA was ₹946 million, up 11% year-on-year, with a margin of 12.9%. During the quarter, the company expanded its footprint by adding 5 new restaurants, bringing its total to 482 restaurants across 79 cities as of June 30, 2026. The company, which operates McDonald's restaurants in West and South India through its subsidiary Hardcastle Restaurants Pvt. Ltd., noted that on-premise sales contributed 59% of system sales, while off-premise channels, including McDelivery, also showed healthy growth.

announcements.subject: Press Release

The company reported a consolidated revenue from operations of INR 163.4 crore, an increase of 31.2% compared to INR 124.5 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. Profit after tax (PAT) also saw a significant rise of 32.0%, reaching INR 56.5 crore for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, up from INR 42.8 crore in the same period last year. The consolidated financial performance includes the impact of Fintellix, which was acquired in October 2025, meaning the current quarter's performance is not directly comparable to the previous year. Mr. Ramnath Krishnan, MD & Group CEO, highlighted strong growth in Ratings and sustained momentum in Risk & Analytics as key drivers of the quarterly performance.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Moneyboxx Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Moneyboxx Finance crosses INR 10 crore in Renewable Energy (Solar) Loan disbursement; Targets10% of AUM from Solar Loans in FY27".
announcements.ai_summary: Moneyboxx Finance Limited has announced a significant milestone, crossing INR 10 crore in Renewable Energy (Solar) Loan disbursements as of July 30, 2026. This achievement underscores the company's commitment to supporting India's clean energy transition and promoting inclusive economic growth by making clean energy accessible to underserved MSMEs and rural entrepreneurs. The company has achieved this through strategic partnerships with a leading solar OEM and a global climate foundation, which helps de-risk green lending. Moneyboxx Finance aims to scale its green finance portfolio substantially, targeting 10% of its Assets Under Management (AUM) from Solar Loans by the end of FY27. This initiative aligns with the company's vision to be a leading financier of distributed renewable energy for India's MSMEs and rural economy, supporting the nation's renewable energy and net-zero aspirations.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations

The company's total annual production capacity now stands at 2.9 million units, with the Hansalpur facility producing the e VITARA, FRONX, Baleno, and Swift. The cumulative investment at the Hansalpur facility is INR 252,887 million (INR 25,288.7 crore), with an estimated INR 39,000 million (INR 3,900 crore) invested in the new Plant D. This expansion also positions the Hansalpur facility as a major export hub, accounting for nearly 47% of the company's overall overseas shipments.

Specifically, OBCL Limited failed to make timely disclosures concerning an FIR filed on November 11, 2025, and a subsequent Family Settlement Agreement executed on December 16, 2025, which impacted promoter holdings. announcements.ai_summary: AVATAR Industries Limited has announced the incorporation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, AVATAR AI MindLab Private Limited, as of July 30, 2026. This new entity is conceptualized as a full-stack AI enterprise focused on driving Enterprise AI Adoption, Industry Skilling, Managed Dark Services, and a Talent-as-a-Service (TaaS) framework. AVATAR AI MindLab aims to create an operational structure that generates direct employment alongside enterprise AI implementation. Its integrated charter includes delivering end-to-end AI capabilities, acting as a managed "Dark Services" hub for white-labeled AI execution, and functioning as an employment-generating TaaS engine through a "Skill-to-Deploy" framework.

The order, obtained through the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) platform, is for the deployment of an integrated E-surveillance system across GAIL's NCR (Operations & Maintenance) network. The scope of work includes the Supply, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning (SITC) and maintenance of an advanced E-surveillance infrastructure, adhering to GAIL's technical specifications. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Coforge Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Coforge Launches Momentuum AI, a Specialized FDE Operating Unit Built to Turn Enterprise AI into Measurable Outcomes".
announcements.ai_summary: Coforge Limited has announced the launch of Momentuum AI, a new specialized operating unit designed to accelerate enterprise AI transformation and deliver measurable business outcomes. This unit is built around Coforge's Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) model, incorporating human + agent delivery pods and the Coforge Nuuron AI Operating System. Momentuum AI aims to help organizations move from ideas to execution and from experimentation to tangible business value by working closely with clients. The division enters the market with FDEs already deployed in multiple global enterprises and an outcome-based pricing model, supported by a dedicated academy for AI talent development.

These agreements are for the Click Hotel at Bengaluru Airport, which will have 54 guest rooms, a restaurant, and parking; the Click Hotel in Dhooma, Madhya Pradesh, featuring 60 guest rooms, two restaurants, banquet space, and a gymnasium; and the Comfort Inn in Shamshabad, Hyderabad. The company will operate, manage, and market these hotels under its established brand standards and systems.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Ramco Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled  Aurecon goes live on Ramco Payce  which is being released to the press from our end.".
announcements.ai_summary: Ramco Systems Limited has announced that its client, Aurecon, a leading global design, engineering, and advisory company, has gone live on Ramco Payce. This deployment signifies a digital transformation of Aurecon's payroll operations across seven Asian countries: Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, and Indonesia. Ramco's Payroll Managed Services, powered by its Payce platform, will now manage gross and net pay calculations, retroactive pay, increments, and statutory compliance for Aurecon in these markets. The solution integrates with Aurecon's existing ERP system, Workday, and third-party banking partners, providing a consolidated view of payroll operations through Ramco BInGO. This initiative aims to improve payroll accuracy, achieve cost efficiencies, and leverage modern payroll technology. The announcement was made via a press release on July 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Aurionpro Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Aurionpro secures additional MMRDA order, further expanding engagement for Automated Fare Collection Solution deployment on Mumbai Metro Line 5.".
announcements.ai_summary: Aurionpro Solutions Limited has secured an additional order from the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority (MMRDA) for its Automated Fare Collection (AFC) solution. This new mandate expands the company's engagement for the deployment of its AFC system to six additional stations on Mumbai Metro Line 5 – Phase I. The order is valued at approximately ₹50 crore and builds upon Aurionpro's existing work on Mumbai Metro Lines 4 and 4A. This win further solidifies Aurionpro's leadership in urban transit and mobility technology and enhances its footprint in metro networks across India. The company announced this significant order on July 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Press Release dated July 30th, 2026, announcing Indri's Historic Performance at the International Whisky Competition 2026. ".
announcements.ai_summary: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited has announced the historic performance of its whisky brand, Indri, at the International Whisky Competition (IWC) 2026. Indri secured the top three positions in both the "Best Indian Whisky" and "Best Single Malt Indian Whisky" categories. Specifically, Indri Diwali Collector's Edition 2025 won first place with 93.53 points, Indri Dru Cask Strength Single Malt Indian Whisky took second with 90.87 points, and Indri Agneya Single Malt Indian Whisky placed third with 89.70 points. This achievement makes Indri the only Indian whisky brand to score above 90 points at this prestigious competition, reinforcing India's position in the global luxury whisky market. The company released this information via a press release on July 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release (Revised)
announcements.detail: Mangal Electrical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Press release Under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015".
announcements.ai_summary: Mangal Electrical Industries Limited has announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a revenue from operations of ₹125.8 Crs, an increase of 40% year-on-year, with EBITDA at ₹11.1 Crs, up 12%. Profit After Tax (PAT) stood at ₹7.5 Crs, a significant increase of 101% year-on-year. The Earnings Per Share (EPS) for the quarter was ₹2.72. The company achieved approximately 32% volume growth in CRGO during Q1 FY27 compared to Q1 FY26, despite a 18% decline in CRGO realizations. Mangal Electrical Industries Limited also acquired industrial land adjacent to its manufacturing facility in Reengus, Rajasthan, to support future capacity expansion, with its transformer capacity expansion expected to be completed by the end of FY27.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited (L&T) has received a Limited Notice to Proceed (LNTP) from NTPC Ltd for the main plant package of the 2x800 MW Lara Stage-III thermal power plant in Chhattisgarh. This project involves the construction of two 800 MW ultra-supercritical generating units. L&T's scope includes the design, engineering, manufacturing, supply, erection, testing, and commissioning of boilers, steam turbines, generators, electrostatic precipitators (ESPs), air-cooled condensers (ACCs), and associated works on an EPC basis. The project will add 1,600 MW of baseload generation capacity to India's grid. The Notice to Proceed will be granted upon environmental clearance and completion of the LNTP period. This is L&T's third ultra-supercritical project from NTPC in the past two years.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 29, 2026, titled "PRESS RELEASE REGARDING COMPANY S WHOLLY-OWNED SUBSIDIARY VIZ. CARBOGEN AMCIS AG., COMMISSIONS A NEW GROUND-MOUNTED PHOTOVOLTAIC SYSTEM AT ITS NEULAND SITE."
announcements.ai_summary: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, CARBOGEN AMCIS AG., a Switzerland-based pharmaceutical process development and API manufacturing company, successfully commissioned a new ground-mounted photovoltaic system at its Neuland site in Switzerland on June 29, 2026. This new solar power plant has a capacity of 1,200 kWp and comprises 2,448 photovoltaic modules installed over an area of approximately 6,200 m² on the company's premises. The plant is considered one of the most efficient conventional ground-mounted systems in the Swiss Mittelland, bringing its efficiency close to that of vertical alpine installations. The solar power generated will primarily be used for on-site consumption, aiming to sustainably reduce the company's CO₂ emissions. The project was executed in collaboration with energy and infrastructure partners IWB (Industrielle Werke Basel) and its subsidiary Planeco, who handled the planning and implementation. This initiative underscores CARBOGEN AMCIS AG.'s long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

announcements.detail: BSE Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'BSE Media Release - Change in licensing requirements for market data products'.
announcements.ai_summary: BSE Ltd announced a significant change in its licensing requirements for market data products, effective January 1, 2027. From this date, BSE will directly manage the licensing of its market data products for all international clients, a responsibility previously undertaken by Deutsche Börse AG. This change stems from a market data service agreement established in October 2013, where Deutsche Börse AG handled international sales and marketing, while BSE served domestic clients. BSE and Deutsche Börse AG are collaborating to ensure a seamless transition, and international clients will experience no interruption in service. There will be no changes for clients based in India, who will continue to access market data products directly from BSE. International clients wishing to continue receiving BSE India Information Products after December 31, 2026, should contact datafeed.sales@bseindia.com.

This partnership aims to provide PMC services from concept to commissioning for the development and improvement of CONCOR's terminals and establishments. RITES will leverage its multidisciplinary engineering and project management expertise for services including feasibility studies, Detailed Project Reports, detailed engineering, and construction management. Both companies aim to utilize their respective strengths to facilitate the timely execution of logistics infrastructure projects and contribute to the development of efficient multimodal logistics facilities across the country.

announcements.ai_summary: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited (SWREL), in a 50-50 joint venture with Hassan Allam Construction, has secured a landmark project in Egypt. The joint venture received a Letter of Award (LOA) for a 1,000 MWac capacity Solar PV project integrated with a 600 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). announcements.detail: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 29, 2026, titled "Press Release in respect of the Company s strategic intent to expand Refrigerant capacity".
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited (GFL) has announced its strategic intent to expand its refrigerant capacity. This expansion will enable the company to fully utilize its refrigerant gas entitlement under the Montreal Protocol and the Kigali Amendment. GFL, a part of the INOXGFL Group, plans to add R134A capacity to its existing portfolio of R32, R22, R125, and R410A. This move is driven by the growing demand for refrigerants, particularly with the increasing adoption of air-conditioning in India and international markets. The expansion will allow GFL to offer a more comprehensive product basket, cater to diverse customer needs, optimize its product mix, and maximize its designated quota under the Kigali Amendment. GFL has confirmed that it possesses all necessary approvals, infrastructure, and compliance mechanisms for this expansion. The press release was dated June 29, 2026.

announcements.detail: Optiemus Infracom Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 29, 2026, titled "Optiemus Electronics to manufacture Quectel wireless modules in India".
announcements.ai_summary: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited, through its subsidiary Sojern, has released insights into global summer travel trends for 2026. The data indicates resilience in travel demand, with travelers making different choices due to pricing sensitivity, rising airfares, and geopolitical caution. US outbound travel shows a 44% year-on-year increase in flight bookings to Canada, while bookings to Mexico are down 12%. For the FIFA World Cup 2026, Japan and South Korea are significant international origin markets, with the UK leading. Intra-European flight bookings have increased by 37% year-on-year, suggesting a shift towards closer-to-home destinations. Sojern's AI-powered platform analyzes travel intent data to provide these insights.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: RPG Life Sciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Press release".
announcements.ai_summary: RPG Life Sciences Limited has issued a press release on July 29, 2026, titled "RPG Life Sciences Announces Strategic API Initiative to Accelerate Next Phase of Growth." The announcement details the transfer of the company's Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) business to its wholly-owned subsidiary, RPG Active Pharma Limited (RPGAP), on a slump sale basis. This strategic move aims to create a focused API business with dedicated capital and management. Additionally, RPG Active Pharma will receive an initial investment of up to Rs. 243 crore from funds managed by InvAscent, a healthcare-focused private equity investor, and will acquire 100% of Actis Generics Private Limited. The API business generated Rs. 95.06 crore in revenue and had a net worth of Rs. 70.92 crore in FY26.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Execution of Share Purchase Agreement
announcements.ai_summary: RPG Life Sciences Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting on July 29, 2026, approved the execution of a Share Purchase Agreement by its wholly-owned subsidiary, RPG Active Pharma Limited (RPGAP), to acquire the entire stake of Actis Generics Private Limited. This acquisition is part of a broader strategic initiative where RPGAP will also receive an investment of up to Rs. 243 crore from funds managed by InvAscent. The API business, which contributed Rs. 95.06 crores in revenue and Rs. 70.92 crores in net worth in FY26, is being transferred to RPGAP on a slump sale basis. The completion of the sale is anticipated by September 30, 2026, pending necessary approvals.

announcements.subject: Other Restructuring
announcements.detail: Execution of Business Transfer Agreement
announcements.ai_summary: RPG Life Sciences Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 29, 2026, approved the execution of a Business Transfer Agreement for the sale of its API business to its wholly-owned subsidiary, RPG Active Pharma Limited (RPGAP), on a slump sale basis. The API business generated Rs. 95.06 crores in revenue for FY26, representing 13.54% of the consolidated turnover, and had a net worth of Rs. 70.92 crores as of March 31, 2026, which is 11.72% of the company's total net worth. The sale is expected to be completed by September 30, 2026, subject to customary conditions and approvals. This move is part of a strategy to create a focused API business with dedicated capital and management attention.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Max Healthcare Institute Limited has informed the Exchange about disclosure under regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting held today July 29, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: At a board meeting held on July 29, 2026, RPG Life Sciences Limited approved the execution of a Business Transfer Agreement for the sale of its Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) business to its wholly-owned subsidiary, RPG Active Pharma Limited (RPGAP), on a slump sale basis. The board also approved an Investment and Shareholders' Agreement among RPG Life Sciences Limited, RPGAP, India Life Sciences Fund IV Domestic, and Vistaject Fund for the proposed share issuance by RPGAP. Additionally, RPGAP will execute a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire the entire stake of Actis Generics Private Limited. The API business contributed Rs. 95.06 crores in revenue for FY26, representing 13.54% of the consolidated turnover, and had a net worth of Rs. 70.92 crores as of March 31, 2026, which is 11.72% of the company's total net worth. The sale is expected to be completed on or before September 30, 2026, subject to customary conditions and approvals.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Welspun Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about the execution of Securities Subscription and Purchase Agreement ("SSPA") with BIIF Infrastructure II Private Limited to exit from operational NHAI Aunta Simaria Ganga River Bridge Highway Project
announcements.ai_summary: Welspun Enterprises Limited has executed a Securities Subscription and Purchase Agreement (SSPA) on July 29, 2026, with BIIF Infrastructure II Private Limited to exit its entire shareholding in Welspun Aunta-Simaria Project Private Limited (WASPPL). WASPPL is a subsidiary operating the NHAI Aunta Simaria Ganga River Bridge Highway Project in Bihar on a hybrid annuity model. The transaction's consummation is contingent upon approval from NHAI and lenders, along with the fulfillment of other conditions precedent stipulated in the SSPA. Upon completion, WASPPL will no longer be a subsidiary of Welspun Enterprises Limited. The company has stated that WASPPL is not a material subsidiary and the transaction value is below the materiality threshold, thus shareholder approval is not required.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: GMR AIRPORTS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Update on Tariff Matter
announcements.ai_summary: GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Limited, a subsidiary of GMR Airports Limited, has been issued a tariff order (No. 10/2026-27) by the Airports Economic Regulatory Authority (AERA). This order pertains to the determination of ad-hoc aeronautical charges/tariff for the Bhogapuram International Airport in Andhra Pradesh. The tariff will be effective from the commercial date of operation until the implementation of regular aeronautical charges for the 1st Control Period, which runs from April 01, 2027, to March 31, 2032. The detailed order is accessible via a provided web-link.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Rainbow Childrens Medicare Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: Rainbow Childrens Medicare Limited is undertaking a strategic initiative to establish and operate a women’s and children's hospital in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh. To facilitate this expansion, the company has executed a long-term lease deed for hospital premises in Guntur. The leased premises include a newly built hospital building with existing healthcare infrastructure, which is expected to enable a faster operational ramp-up and lower capital expenditure compared to a greenfield development. This expansion is anticipated to strengthen the company's presence in Andhra Pradesh, enhance access to specialized healthcare services, and support its long-term growth strategy. Details are available on the company's website.
