announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Sun Pharma receives approval to manufacture and market semaglutide in Brazil".
announcements.ai_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has received approval from the Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency (ANVISA) to manufacture and market semaglutide injection in Brazil. This approval is for the treatment of adults with inadequately controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus, to be used as an adjunct to diet and exercise. Sun Pharma plans to launch the product in partnership with Hypera Pharma within the next few days. The semaglutide injectable will be available in two strengths, 2 mg/1.5 mL and 4 mg/3 mL, in a pre-filled, multi-dose pen for once-weekly dosing. The semaglutide injectable market in Brazil is valued at approximately USD 413 million as of June 2026. This approval signifies Sun Pharma's commitment to expanding access to high-quality medicines globally.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "The Company has signed two License Agreements viz. Lemon Tree Hotel, Siddharthanagar in Nepal and Keys Select by Lemon Tree Hotels, Vijayawada".
announcements.ai_summary: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has signed two License Agreements for new properties: Lemon Tree Hotel, Siddharthanagar in Nepal, and Keys Select by Lemon Tree Hotels, Vijayawada in Andhra Pradesh. Both properties will be managed by Carnation Hotels Private Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Lemon Tree Hotels Limited. The Lemon Tree Hotel in Nepal will feature 120 rooms, a restaurant, banquet hall, meeting room, and recreational facilities. The Keys Select hotel in Vijayawada will offer 70 rooms, a restaurant, banquet hall, meeting room, spa, and fitness center. These signings expand the group's portfolio in India and Nepal.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: PRESTIGE: Prestige Estates Projects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled  Prestige Group Expands MMR Footprint with Rs. 6,000 Crore Thane Residential Development
announcements.ai_summary: Prestige Estates Projects Limited has announced a significant expansion of its presence in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) with a new residential development in Thane. The company has entered into a strategic partnership for a project with an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹6,000 crore. This development will span approximately 14.6 acres and has a developable potential exceeding 5 million square feet, positioning it as one of the largest residential projects in the Thane micro-market. The project will feature a mix of residences and retail spaces, offering a convenient live-work-shop environment. It is strategically located near Kolshet–Balkum Road, providing excellent connectivity. The press release, dated July 29, 2026, highlights the project's contemporary architecture, lifestyle amenities, and sustainable design principles.

announcements.ai_summary: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited has acquired Bhadla Ramgarh Power Transmission Limited on July 29, 2026. This acquisition was made under the Tariff Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) route, with Power Grid Corporation of India Limited emerging as the successful bidder. The acquired entity, Bhadla Ramgarh Power Transmission Limited, is a Project SPV established to build, own, operate, and transfer (BOOT) an Inter-State Transmission system. The project involves augmentation and bay extension works at Bhadla-III S/S (Rajasthan), Ramgarh S/S (Rajasthan), and Kanpur S/S (Uttar Pradesh). The acquisition was made from the Bid Process Coordinator, REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited (RECPDCL). This acquisition falls within the main line of business for Power Grid Corporation of India Limited, which is power transmission.

announcements.subject: General Updates

announcements.ai_summary: REC Limited, through its wholly-owned subsidiary REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited (RECPDCL), has divested its entire shareholding in two project-specific subsidiaries. On July 29, 2026, after receiving the necessary consideration, RECPDCL transferred 50,000 equity shares of each subsidiary, along with all their assets and liabilities, to the successful bidders selected through a tariff-based competitive bidding process. The subsidiaries transferred are Bhadla Ramgarh Power Transmission Limited to Power Grid Corporation of India Limited and Shongtong Power Transmission Limited to Terralight Solar Energy Private Limited. Consequently, these entities are no longer subsidiaries of RECPDCL or REC Limited.

announcements.subject: Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Astral Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on the Composite Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.ai_summary: Astral Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 29, 2026, from 04:00 P.M. to 04:30 P.M., decided to withdraw the Composite Scheme of Arrangement. This decision followed a comprehensive independent review, which included feedback from an appointed Independent Consultant. The consultant recommended against proceeding with the scheme in its current form, citing the present scale of the Chemical Business. After considering input from the consultant and various stakeholders, the Board concluded that the proposed scheme is not in the best interests of the Company and its shareholders at this stage. The company stated that a demerger of the Chemical Business might be considered in the future once it achieves sufficient scale and financial strength to fund its organic and inorganic growth. Consequently, no further steps will be taken regarding this proposed Composite Scheme of Arrangement.

announcements.ai_summary: Astral Limited announced on July 29, 2026, the outcome of its Board Meeting, where it decided to withdraw the proposed Composite Scheme of Arrangement. announcements.detail: GAIL (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "GAIL and RCF Sign MoU for Setting up Gas-Based Fertilizer Project in Maharashtra".
announcements.ai_summary: GAIL (India) Limited and Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on July 29, 2026, to jointly establish a gas-based fertilizer project in Maharashtra. The proposed urea production facility is planned to have a capacity of 1.27 Million Metric Tonnes Per Annum (MMTPA). This project is envisaged to be established in the Vidarbha region of Maharashtra, strategically located along GAIL's Mumbai–Nagpur–Jharsuguda Natural Gas Pipeline (MNJPL). The collaboration will be executed through a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV), combining GAIL’s natural gas value chain strengths with RCF’s fertilizer manufacturing expertise. The MoU was signed by Shri Sanjay Agarwal (ED, BD & Start-up, GAIL) and Ms. Jyoti Patil (Executive Director, Project, Corporate & Co-ordination, RCF), aligning with the Government of India’s National Investment Policy for Urea-2026 (NIPU-2026).

announcements.ai_summary: On July 29, 2026, Piramal Pharma Limited's Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved the grant of up to 56,36,436 stock options under the Piramal Pharma Limited - Employee Stock Option and Incentive Plan 2022. These options cover 56,36,436 equity shares and are granted at an exercise price of Rs. 10 per option. Vesting schedules vary for locations inside and outside the US, with options exercisable until March 2028 for US-based employees and until July 2034 for others, depending on the specific vesting tranche.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Vikran Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Intimation of Press Release - Vikran Engineering Commissions Strategic 132 kV Miao Namsai Transmission Line in Arunachal Pradesh".
announcements.ai_summary: On July 29, 2026, Vikran Engineering Limited announced the successful commissioning of its strategic 132 kV Miao–Namsai Transmission Line in Arunachal Pradesh. This project, spanning 40.630 kilometers and including 138 tower foundations, is crucial for strengthening the power transmission infrastructure in the North Eastern Region. The transmission line will enhance the reliability of the existing system, connect remote areas to the National Grid, and support the integration of upcoming hydropower projects. The commissioning is expected to improve energy accessibility and contribute to the region's economic growth. The project was closely monitored by the Ministry of Power, Government of India, throughout its execution.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Steelcast Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: Steelcast Limited's Board of Directors, in their meeting held on July 29, 2026, approved the establishment of a Greenfield Foundry with a capacity of 8,500 Tons. This addition will increase the company's existing installed capacity of 29,000 Tons, with an investment of Rs. 120 Crores. The expansion is planned to be completed within two years, by March 31, 2028, and will be financed through internal accruals. The rationale behind this expansion is to cater to increasing customer demand, with an expectation to reach 90% capacity utilization by March 31, 2029. The Board also declared a First Interim Dividend of Rs. 0.45 per equity share for FY 2026-27, with August 7, 2026, fixed as the record date.

(TEIL) and Sir Shadi Lal Enterprises Limited (SSEL) and Triveni Power Transmission Ltd (TPTL) and their respective shareholders under Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 ( Scheme )

(TEIL) has provided a material update regarding the Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving TEIL, Sir Shadi Lal Enterprises Limited (SSEL), and Triveni Power Transmission Ltd (TPTL). The update pertains to material events and updates concerning TPTL, as communicated by TPTL to TEIL on July 28, 2026. announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Prizor Viztech Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of New Assembly Line and Capacity Expansion.
announcements.ai_summary: Prizor Viztech Limited has successfully commenced operations of a new assembly line at its manufacturing facility, increasing its total annual production capacity. The new assembly line adds 8,00,000 units, bringing the total capacity from 16,00,000 units per annum to 24,00,000 units per annum. This expansion is aimed at meeting increasing customer demand, strengthening execution capabilities for current and future orders, and improving operational efficiencies. The additional capacity is expected to enhance manufacturing flexibility, reduce turnaround times, and support the company's long-term growth strategy.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Aequs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled " Aequs Delivers Another Record Quarter, Revenue Grows 55% YoY to ₹3,955 Million ".
announcements.ai_summary: Aequs Limited announced its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting a record quarter with revenue growing 55% year-on-year to ₹3,955 million. The company's aerospace order book has surpassed USD 1 billion, and consumer revenue has nearly tripled year-on-year. While EBITDA stood at ₹215 million with a 5% margin, the year-on-year comparison reflects consumer electronics operating costs being expensed. Underlying operating performance improved sequentially, with Operational EBITDA increasing to ₹148 million. Aerospace EBITDA grew 35% year-on-year to ₹731 million. The company reported a PAT loss of ₹532 million for the quarter.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: India Pesticides Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of the Fungicide Formulation
announcements.ai_summary: India Pesticides Limited has received approval for one of its fungicide formulations in Morocco. This registration marks a significant step in the company's international expansion and its entry into the Moroccan agrochemical market. The approval is expected to boost the company's export revenues and contribute to foreign exchange earnings. Further details regarding this regulatory approval are provided in Annexure – A, and the information is also available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Dabur India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Dabur Q1 Consol Net Profit Surges 15% at Rs 591 Crore".
announcements.ai_summary: Dabur India Limited has announced its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a 15% surge in consolidated net profit, reaching Rs 591 Crore, and a 10.6% increase in consolidated revenue to Rs 3,761 Crore. The India FMCG business saw a 9.5% growth with a 5% underlying volume growth. This marks the third consecutive quarter of double-digit profit growth for Dabur, achieved through disciplined cost management, operational efficiencies, and judicious price increases, despite inflationary pressures and geopolitical uncertainties. The company also reported an 11% growth in operating profit for the quarter.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Opening of Ethos Watch Boutiques at Amritsar'.
announcements.ai_summary: Ethos Limited has announced the opening of a new Ethos Watch Boutique in Amritsar, Punjab, located at GF 06, Nexus Amritsar Mall. This expansion marks a significant step in strengthening the company's luxury brand portfolio and its presence in prominent Indian luxury retail markets. The new boutique aims to make exclusive brands more accessible to discerning customers, aligning with the company's strategic vision. With this launch, Ethos Limited now operates a total of 103 boutiques across India.

announcements.detail: Yaap Digital Limited has informed the Exchange about update on issuance of Equity Shares for consideration other than cash on preferential basis
announcements.ai_summary: Yaap Digital Limited has provided an update regarding the proposed issuance of Equity Shares for consideration other than cash on a preferential basis, following clarifications from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE). SPA Valuation Advisors Private Limited, an Independent Registered Valuer, based on the audited financial statements for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, of both Yaap Digital and Gozoop Online Private Limited ("Gozoop"). The financials were approved by the respective Boards on May 29, 2026, for Yaap Digital and May 25, 2026, for Gozoop. The revised valuation report adjusted the fair value of Gozoop's equity share from INR 11,79,713/- to INR 11,79,711.80/- per equity share, resulting in a negligible difference of INR 1.20/- per share. This aggregate difference of INR 76.80/- in the Tranche 1 Swap Consideration does not impact the swap ratio or the terms of the transaction previously approved by shareholders. The company confirmed that this revision has not altered the total number of Gozoop equity shares acquired or the number of Yaap Digital equity shares to be issued under Tranche 1, with the INR 76.

announcements.ai_summary: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited (IRCTC) has announced that the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, issued an Order dated July 29, 2026, approving the entrustment of additional charge for the post of Chairman & Managing Director (CMD). Shri Rahul Himalian, who currently serves as Director (Tourism & Marketing) at IRCTC, has been appointed to this additional role. The appointment is effective from July 20, 2026, for a period of nine (09) months. This arrangement will continue until a regular incumbent assumes charge or until further orders, whichever occurs earliest. This disclosure follows earlier communications from IRCTC dated July 16, 2026, and July 20, 2026.

These shares will be allotted upon the conversion of Optionally Convertible / Redeemable Preference Shares (OCRPs) at a conversion price of Rs. 33.21/- per equity share, which includes a premium of Rs. 31.21/-. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Unihealth Hospitals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "UMC Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, Achieves Regional Milestone with First Bilateral Robotic Direct Anterior Total Hip Replacement in Navi Mumbai".
announcements.ai_summary: Unihealth Hospitals Limited has announced a significant medical milestone achieved by its UMC Hospitals in Navi Mumbai. On July 29, 2026, the hospital successfully performed Navi Mumbai's first Bilateral Robotic Direct Anterior Approach (DAA) Total Hip Replacement. This complex procedure was performed on a 67-year-old patient suffering from Stage IV Avascular Necrosis of both hip joints. The surgery combined the Direct Anterior Approach for minimally invasive access with Robotic-Assisted Technology for enhanced precision in implant positioning. The patient was able to walk with assistance on the same day of the surgery.

announcements.ai_summary: Borana Weaves Limited has provided an update regarding a fine levied by the NSE. The company has disclosed information related to this fine on July 29, 2026, with multiple entries indicating different times throughout the day.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Dabur India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Dabur Q1 Consol Net Profit Surges 15% at Rs 591 Crore".
announcements.ai_summary: Dabur India Limited has issued a press release on July 29, 2026, announcing its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a 15% surge in its consolidated net profit, reaching ₹591 Crore for the quarter. This announcement is in compliance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Shyam Metalics And Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited has successfully commissioned its new 1.5 MTPA Beneficiation Plant located in Sambalpur, Odisha, effective July 29, 2026. This plant has a capital investment of ₹150 Crore and is designed to process low-grade ore, delivering high-grade feedstock to the company's downstream operations. The commissioning of this plant is expected to enhance resource efficiency by upgrading lower-grade minerals, extend mine life, and optimize existing reserves. Furthermore, it aims to improve operating margins by reducing reliance on costly external feedstock and creating cost synergies. The plant utilizes eco-efficient technology to ensure uniform premium-grade input while optimizing water and energy consumption.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Cupid Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Cupid Limited Strengthens Strategic Partnership with GII Healthcare Investment Limited through Additional Follow-on Investment Of USD 5 Mn".
announcements.ai_summary: Cupid Limited has announced a strategic partnership enhancement with GII Healthcare Investment Limited through an additional follow-on investment of USD 5 million. This investment, funded entirely by internal accruals, signifies Cupid's sustained confidence in GII's healthcare investment strategy and reinforces a long-term strategic partnership. The company believes the GCC healthcare sector offers significant long-term growth opportunities, driven by increasing healthcare expenditure, population growth, rising insurance penetration, and sustained government investment. The investment was made at an attractive valuation, allowing Cupid to increase its participation in the platform's growth. The platform currently holds a substantial equity stake in a prominent healthcare provider in Saudi Arabia. GII is a leading investment firm with over USD 3.5 billion in assets under management, operating across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Europe, the USA, and India, with a strong track record in healthcare investments. The press release is available on Cupid Limited's website at https://www.cupidlimited.com/.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Capri Global Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Capri Loans Collaborates with OpenAI to Bring Enterprise-Grade AI to Lending Operations ".
announcements.ai_summary: Capri Global Capital Limited has issued a press release dated July 29, 2026, announcing a collaboration with OpenAI. This partnership aims to integrate enterprise-grade generative AI into Capri Loans' lending operations. The initiative is a key component of Capri Loans' technology-led growth strategy. Over the coming months, the company plans to deploy secure AI-powered tools to enhance customer service, knowledge management, and operational processes across its network of over 1,400 branches. These branches serve more than 7.6 lakh customers throughout India. The press release also highlights that the collaboration will help identify and deploy practical AI use cases within the lending value chain, while maintaining high standards of governance, security, and human oversight. The press release will be available on the company's website at www.capriloans.in.

announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger
announcements.detail: Transindia Real Estate Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation regarding issuance of Notice to Equity Shareholders pursuant to the Order passed by the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench in relation to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Madanahatti Logistics and Industrial Parks Private Limited, a Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company with Transindia Real Estate Limited, the Holding Company
announcements.ai_summary: Transindia Real Estate Limited has announced that the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, has directed the issuance of a notice to its equity shareholders regarding the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation. This scheme involves the amalgamation of Madanahatti Logistics and Industrial Parks Private Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary, with Transindia Real Estate Limited. The NCLT passed this order on July 15, 2026, in Company Scheme Application No. C.A. (CAA)/232/MB-III/2025. Following the NCLT's directive, Transindia Real Estate Limited issued a notice to its equity shareholders on July 28, 2026, providing details of the amalgamation scheme and making relevant documents available for inspection. These documents, including the Scheme of Amalgamation, NCLT Application, and the Tribunal's Order, can be accessed on the company's website under "Merger/Amalgamation - Transindia Real Estate."

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: TeamLease  - Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Divestment of entire stake in Joint Venture Company; Crystal HR and Securities Solutions Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: TeamLease Services Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 29, 2026, approved the divestment of its entire 30% equity stake in the joint venture company, Crystal HR and Securities Solutions Private Limited. This decision is in line with the terms of the Share Purchase Agreement dated January 06, 2025. Crystal HR has agreed to buy back TeamLease's stake in the joint venture. The transaction is subject to customary conditions precedent and any required regulatory or contractual approvals. Upon completion, Crystal HR will no longer be a joint venture of TeamLease, which is considered beneficial for portfolio rationalization and capital allocation.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 29, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited's Board of Directors met on July 29, 2026, and approved a significant fund-raising initiative. The company plans to raise up to ₹317,47,75,000 by issuing 2,18,95,000 equity shares at a price of ₹145 per share, which includes a premium of ₹143 per share. This preferential allotment is intended for non-promoter category investors and is subject to shareholder and other necessary approvals. The Board also approved amendments to the company's Memorandum of Association and fixed August 28, 2026, as the date for an Extra Ordinary General Meeting to seek member approval. A cut-off date of July 24, 2026, was set for dispatching the EGM notice.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Patanjali Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Patanjali Foods Limited has received an Order-in-Original in Form DRC-07 from the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, State Tax Department, Circle-H, Jaipur-1, Rajasthan, on July 28, 2026. This order pertains to the reversal of Input Tax Credit (ITC) and the imposition of a penalty, aggregating to ₹80,37,898. The company has stated that it does not expect any financial liability beyond this penalty amount, and it will not impact the company's financial, operational, or other activities. The company has provided detailed disclosures as required by SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.company: SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited
announcements.subject: Product launch
announcements.detail: Sbi Cards And Payment Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Product launch
announcements.ai_summary: SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited has launched a new product named "Google Pay Flex SBI Card" on July 29, 2026. This rewards-focused credit card is designed for the domestic market. The launch signifies an expansion of SBI Card's product offerings to cater to evolving customer needs. The company has uploaded the details of this new product on its website, www.sbicard.com, for public access. This initiative is part of the company's ongoing efforts to enhance its market presence and customer engagement.

announcements.company: SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited
announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Sbi Cards And Payment Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "SBI Card and Google Pay Launch Co-Branded Google Pay Flex SBI Card".
announcements.ai_summary: SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited, in partnership with Google, has launched the 'Google Pay Flex SBI Card' on July 29, 2026. This co-branded credit card is part of the 'Flex by Google Pay' offering and aims to simplify everyday transactions by providing a unified digital payments experience. The card allows customers to earn up to 18,000 Stars (reward points) annually on everyday spending, with instant redemption at the time of payment. Customers can earn up to 8 Stars for every cumulative ₹500 spent across various categories like groceries, bill payments, travel, and shopping. The card also offers financial flexibility by allowing customers to convert their latest outstanding balances.

announcements.company: B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited
announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited has secured a new order worth ₹ 91.57 Crores (excluding GST) from Embassy Development Ltd. The contract involves the execution of Civil and Structural works for Verde Phase II at Bengaluru. This is a domestic order for civil and structural works for a residential building, with an approximate execution period of 17 months. The Letter of Intent (LOI) was received and accepted on July 28, 2026. The company has confirmed that there is no interest from promoter or promoter group companies in the entity awarding the order, and it does not fall within related party transactions.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Hind Rectifiers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled - "Hirect Secures First Order from the United States for Traction Motor Assemblies".
announcements.ai_summary: Hind Rectifiers Limited (now Hirect Limited) has secured its first order from the United States for Traction Motor Assemblies, marking its entry into the U.S. market. This order is scheduled for delivery during Fiscal Year 2027. The company aims to leverage this development to expand customer relationships and pursue further opportunities in the U.S. market, aligning with its long-term strategy of international footprint expansion. Hirect Limited, established in 1958, has a workforce of 950 employees across two manufacturing plants in India and exports to over 30 countries. The company designs and manufactures power electronics equipment for sectors including Railways, Defence, Power, and Hydrogen.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Nintec Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "NINtec Delivers AI Platform for Europe's Leading Automotive Marketplace.".
announcements.ai_summary: NINtec Systems Limited has announced the successful delivery of an enterprise-scale AI transformation platform for a leading European automotive marketplace on July 29, 2026. This AI-first seller platform is designed to enhance the vehicle-listing journey, a critical point for customer acquisition. The platform unifies multiple AI-powered customer journeys, including conversational AI, VIN-based vehicle lookup, document processing (OCR), and guided workflows, into a single, scalable system. It features a cloud-native, event-driven architecture integrating seven AI components such as pricing intelligence, image moderation, and damage detection. The platform also includes built-in A/B testing for continuous experimentation and optimization of conversion rates and customer experience. NINtec Systems Limited will continue to provide regular business updates.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Ramco Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "CFS Aero Selects Ramco Aviation".
announcements.ai_summary: Ramco Systems Limited has announced that CFS Aero, a UK-based aerospace engineering company, has selected Ramco Aviation software. This selection, detailed in a press release dated July 29, 2026, aims to streamline CFS Aero's engine and APU maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) operations from contract to cash. Ramco's unified digital platform, including modules for Engineering, Planning, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Customer and Commercials Management, and Accounting, will provide CFS Aero with an integrated solution. The software will offer real-time visibility into costs and revenues, support configuration lifecycle management, and enable digital maintenance execution through mobile-enabled task cards.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: R Systems International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Press Release - R Systems Recognized as a Horizon 2 GCC Accelerator in HFS Horizons: GCC Services, 2026 Report".
announcements.ai_summary: R Systems International Limited has announced its recognition as a Horizon 2 GCC Accelerator in the HFS Horizons: GCC Services, 2026 Report, as detailed in a press release dated July 29, 2026. The report highlights R Systems' (RSI) AI-first GCC model, platform-led delivery capabilities, and strong execution in setting up, operating, and transforming Global Capability Centers (GCCs). HFS Research specifically noted RSI's proprietary accelerators, including GCC Copilot, OptimaAI, EXIQO, and C-Osmosis, which assist enterprises in accelerating GCC maturity and driving business outcomes. The report also emphasized RSI's focus on innovation, supported by over 120 AI-led case studies and more than 1,400 AI experts.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Vilin Bio Med Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Vilin Bio Med Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Ideal Pharma BV, based in the Netherlands, on July 29, 2026. This collaboration aims to distribute Generic and Branded Medicines across Europe, utilizing Ideal Pharma's established European Wholesale Distribution Infrastructure. The agreement is on a preferential and long-term basis, covering a full range of Pharmaceutical and Healthcare products. Vilin Bio Med Limited has stated that there is no shareholding in Ideal Pharma BV, and the MOU does not confer any special rights such as the right to appoint directors or pre-emptive rights. Definitive agreements will be executed between the parties to finalize the allocation of responsibilities.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''.
announcements.ai_summary: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF) and GAIL (India) Limited have entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on July 29, 2026, to jointly establish a gas-based fertilizer project in Maharashtra. This project will be executed through a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV). The planned facility will have a urea production capacity of 1.27 Million Metric Tonnes Per Annum (MMTPA). The project is intended to be located in the Vidarbha region of Maharashtra, leveraging GAIL's Mumbai-Nagpur-Jharsuguda Natural Gas Pipeline (MNJPL).

announcements.subject: Preferential issue
announcements.detail: 5paisa Capital Limited has informed the Exchange about Revision in the Disclosure regarding Acquisition of Giskard Datatech Private Limited approved at the Board Meeting held on July 28, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: 5paisa Capital Limited has issued a clarification regarding its proposed acquisition of Giskard Datatech Private Limited (GDPL). The company is correcting an inadvertent error in its previous disclosure from the Board Meeting held on July 28, 2026. The original disclosure incorrectly suggested that the promoters of 5paisa might acquire shares of GDPL directly from its existing shareholders to facilitate cash consideration. However, 5paisa Capital Limited clarifies that the acquisition of GDPL shares will be undertaken by the company itself. The consideration for this acquisition will be a combination of cash and share swap, as previously disclosed in the Postal Ballot Notice and other filings. There is no plan for the promoters to acquire GDPL shares from its current shareholders as part of this approved transaction.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: 5paisa Capital Limited has informed the Exchange about Revision in the Disclosure regarding Acquisition of Giskard Datatech Private Limited approved at the Board Meeting held on July 28, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: 5paisa Capital Limited has issued a revision to its previous disclosure regarding the acquisition of Giskard Datatech Private Limited (GDPL), following a Board Meeting held on July 28, 2026. The company has identified an inadvertent error in the initial outcome submission to the stock exchanges. The erroneous paragraph stated that promoters of 5paisa would acquire GDPL shares directly from existing shareholders for the cash component of the consideration. 5paisa Capital Limited clarifies that the acquisition of GDPL shares will be undertaken by the company itself, with the consideration comprising a mix of cash and share swap, as detailed in prior disclosures. There is no current proposal for the company's promoters to acquire GDPL shares from its existing shareholders as part of this approved transaction. A revised outcome of the Board Meeting dated July 28, 2026, has been enclosed as Annexure A, with all other disclosures remaining unchanged.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Trom Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Trom Industries Limited has clarified that it is not required to comply with certain corporate governance provisions as per SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. This exemption applies because the company has listed its specified securities on the SME Exchange. Specifically, regulations 17, 17A, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 24, 24A, 25, 26, 26A, 27, clauses (b) to (i) and (t) of sub-regulation (2) of regulation 46, and paragraphs C, D, and E of Schedule V are not applicable. This non-applicability is based on the company's paid-up equity share capital not exceeding Rs. 10 Crore and net worth not exceeding Rs. 25 Crore as of the last day of the previous financial year. Consequently, these corporate governance provisions are not applicable to Trom Industries Limited for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has received approval from the Ministry of Defence for an extension of the additional charge for the post of Director (Operations) to Shri Kota Ravi, Chairman & Managing Director. This extension is for a further period of three months, commencing from August 1, 2026, or until a regular incumbent assumes the charge, or until further orders, whichever is earliest. This update follows a previous letter dated May 11, 2026, regarding the entrustment of this additional charge.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Tata Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Chemicals Limited's Kenyan subsidiary, Tata Chemicals Magadi Limited (TCML), has received a directive from the Ministry of Mining, Blue Economy and Maritime Affairs, Kenya, dated July 28, 2026. The notice requires TCML to suspend its mining operations pending a compliance review and submission of evidence of compliance with all statutory documentation. Additionally, the Ministry has directed the suspension of exports of Soda Ash by TCML. The company states it is fully compliant with all regulations and is working with authorities to uphold compliance standards. Tata Chemicals Limited is evaluating future options to pursue the matter.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: MAS Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Press Release dated 29.07.2026".
announcements.ai_summary: MAS Financial Services Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. On a consolidated basis, the company reported Assets Under Management (AUM) of ₹16,122.75 Crores and Profit After Tax (PAT) of ₹110.15 Crores. This represents a growth of 21.24% in AUM and 27.21% in PAT compared to the corresponding quarter of the previous year. Consolidated disbursements for the quarter were ₹4,532.76 Crores. The company maintained a strong Capital Adequacy Ratio of 23.25% as of June 30, 2026, with Tier-I capital at 21.94%. Gross stage 3 assets were reported at 2.58% of AUM, and net stage 3 assets at 1.70% of AUM. A management overlay of ₹17.60 Crores was carried as of June 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: 5Paisa Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Revised Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 28, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: 5Paisa Capital Limited has issued a revised outcome of its Board Meeting held on July 28, 2026, on July 29, 2026, to clarify an inadvertent error in the previous submission. The company clarified that the proposed acquisition of GDPL shares will be undertaken by 5Paisa Capital Limited itself, with consideration through a combination of cash and share swap, as previously disclosed. The paragraph mistakenly included, stating promoters' willingness to acquire GDPL shares directly from existing shareholders for cash, does not form part of the Board's approved transaction. announcements.detail: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Avio Smart Market Stack Limited and ProClime Join Hands to Develop Biochar-Based Soil Solutions for Climate-Resilient Agriculture".
announcements.ai_summary: The company, Avio Smart Market Stack Limited (ASMS), formerly Bartronics India Ltd., has entered into a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with ProClime Services Private Limited. This collaboration aims to jointly develop and commercialize next-generation biochar-based soil enhancement solutions. The initiative is designed to improve agricultural productivity and contribute to India's climate action goals. ASMS will leverage its rural network and agricultural expertise, while ProClime will contribute its specialization in biochar production and carbon project development. The partnership will focus on research, laboratory analysis at IIT Roorkee, and field trials across various crop varieties and soil types. They will also evaluate biochar from sustainable feedstocks like bamboo and agricultural residues for optimal commercial deployment. Furthermore, the collaboration seeks to create pathways for generating verified carbon credits through biochar application, benefiting farmers and agricultural stakeholders.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Shyam Metalics And Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "SHYAM METALICS AND ENERGY LIMITED ANNOUNCES COMMISSIONING OF NEW 1.5 MTPA BENEFICIATION PLANT".
announcements.ai_summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited has announced the commissioning of its new 1.5 MTPA Beneficiation Plant in Sambalpur, Odisha, on July 29, 2026. This plant represents a capital investment of ₹150 Crore and is designed to upgrade low-grade ore into high-quality feedstock. The facility is now fully operational, aiming to optimize raw material usage, extend mine life, and minimize waste. By processing low-grade ore in-house, the company expects to reduce reliance on costly external feedstock, leading to significant cost synergies and margin expansion. The beneficiation technology employed ensures a uniform, premium-grade input, which is expected to improve yield and throughput across manufacturing lines. Mr. Brij Bhushan Agarwal, Chairman & Managing Director, stated that this ₹150 Crore facility is already contributing to maximizing raw material value, lowering production costs, and strengthening the company's bottom line.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Acme Solar Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "ACME Solar raises INR 3,404.57 crore project funding for ACME Urja One 250 MW FDRE Project from Power Finance Corporation Limited".
announcements.ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited has successfully secured INR 3,404.57 crore in long-term project funding from Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC) for its ACME Urja One Pvt Ltd (Phase – III) 250 MW FDRE project. PFC will be the sole financier for this project, with a repayment tenor of 19 years. This funding milestone brings the total project funding raised by the company in the current fiscal year to INR 6,051 crore. The project has a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with NHPC Limited for a duration of 25 years, with a tariff of INR 4.33 per unit.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Biocon Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Company Statement'.
announcements.ai_summary: Biocon Limited has announced that its Canadian subsidiary has received Notice of Compliance (NOC) approval from Health Canada for Yesintek® (ustekinumab) Autoinjector 45 mg/0.05 mL and 90 mg/mL. This approval follows Health Canada's earlier NOC for Yesintek® in prefilled syringe and vial formats in October 2025. The introduction of the autoinjector pen offers patients an alternative not available with the originator product in Canada, allowing for customized treatment approaches across different care settings and patient needs. Yesintek® is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, active psoriatic arthritis, Crohn's disease, and ulcerative colitis. This approval is expected to strengthen Biocon's immunology product portfolio in Canada and enhance patient access to affordable medicines.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Cartrade Tech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "CarTrade Tech and Spinny Partner to Transform Used Car Buying and Selling".
announcements.ai_summary: CarTrade Tech Limited has announced a strategic partnership with Spinny, a leading full-stack used-car platform, aimed at transforming the used car buying and selling experience in India. This collaboration will offer consumers selling their cars on CarWale and OLX India a differentiated selling experience. Spinny will offer quality-assured used cars on CarWale and OLX India, leveraging the combined strengths of CarTrade's automotive buyer and seller network, technology, and data with Spinny's operational capabilities. CarTrade's proprietary VAYA AI will be used to connect users instantly with relevant Spinny offerings, enhancing the customer journey and simplifying the buying and selling process for the over 23 million consumers who use OLX India and CarWale annually. This partnership aligns with CarTrade Tech's strategy to build an integrated automotive ecosystem.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 29, 2026, titled "Inox Wind secures a 200 MW turnkey order from NLC India Limited".
announcements.ai_summary: Inox Wind Limited has announced securing a significant 200 MW turnkey order from NLC India Limited, with an approximate contract value of ₹1,600 crore. This project will be executed on a turnkey basis, encompassing the supply of wind turbine generators, engineering, procurement, construction (EPC), and subsequent operations and maintenance services. The company highlights this as a validation of its integrated turnkey capabilities and execution expertise, reinforcing its leadership in India's renewable energy sector.

The NeoStar series includes a new 27HP narrow variant purpose-built for sugarcane and inter-row applications, featuring Power Steering and ECO PTO across all models for convenience and fuel efficiency. This launch builds on Kubota's legacy and the trust of over 80,000 compact and narrow tractor customers in India.

announcements.detail: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Media statement by the Company, titled  Waaree Energies' Clarifies U.S. Customs Determination. '.
announcements.ai_summary: Waaree Energies Limited has issued a media statement to clarify a determination by the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) in EAPA Consolidated Investigation No. 8163. Following an investigation and on-site verification, CBP confirmed that Waaree did not export solar modules manufactured using Chinese-origin solar cells to the United States. The CBP also noted Waaree's full cooperation and drew no adverse inference against the company, declining a request for an evasion finding covering all of Waaree's imports. The determination is limited to a narrow subset of historical import entries and is not a final adjudication. Waaree is evaluating its legal remedies, including de novo administrative and judicial review, and its U.S. business operations remain unaffected.

This permission, granted by the Director of Industrial Safety and Health, Chennai, via Order No. C3/18838/2026 dated July 27, 2026, allows recommencement in all areas except the specific shed affected by a fire incident on July 14, 2026. The original Prohibition Order was issued on July 15, 2026, under Section 40(2) of the Factories Act, 1948. announcements.ai_summary: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited received a demand notice from the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) on July 27, 2026, alleging overcharging under the Drugs (Prices Control) Order, 2013 (DPCO, 2013). NPPA claims the company sold Betaloc-50 (Metoprolol 50 mg tablets) at an MRP higher than the notified ceiling price and failed to implement revised ceiling prices from March 2, 2016, and June 2, 2016. The demand notice seeks recovery of ₹79,97,457/-, inclusive of interest calculated up to August 10, 2026, for alleged overcharging during June to July 2016. The company is currently reviewing the notice and plans to take appropriate steps in accordance with applicable law, with payment demanded within 30 days.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Euro Panel Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "EUROBOND Commissions 2.2 MW Solar Plant in Surat, Creating India's Largest Cumulative Captive Solar Infrastructure of 3.6 MW in the ACP Industry".
announcements.ai_summary: Euro Panel Products Limited's flagship brand, EUROBOND, has commissioned a new 2.2 MW grid-connected solar facility in Moti Falod, Surat, as announced in a press release dated 28th July 2026. This completes the third phase of the company's multi-year energy expansion, bringing its total operational captive solar capacity to 3.6 MW. The new infrastructure allows EUROBOND to offset 50% of its total factory power requirements, a significant increase from its previous 20% offset capability. The plant is designed to generate 30 lakh units of clean electricity annually, reducing reliance on conventional grids and eliminating associated carbon emissions. This energy capacity expansion complements the company's Zero Liquid Discharge operations, which reclaimed over 1,322,500 litres of treated water in the last six months.

This new Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) is established to handle preparatory activities for a transmission system at 400kV Benchigere in Tumakuru District. announcements.ai_summary: ICRA Limited has acquired the remaining 1.25% shareholding in Fintellix India Private Limited for a consideration of INR 3.17 crores on July 28, 2026. This transaction, following previous announcements on June 12, 2025, and October 17, 2025, results in Fintellix India Private Limited becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary of ICRA Limited. Fintellix, with a turnover of INR 93.3 crore for FY26, is a related party to ICRA Limited. The acquisition makes Fintellix and its subsidiaries step-down wholly-owned subsidiaries of ICRA Limited.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: The Grob Tea Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Completion of Acquisition of 100% Equity share of Bazaloni Group Limited, resulting in Bazaloni Group Limited becoming the Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: The Grob Tea Company Limited has successfully completed the acquisition of 100% of the equity share capital of Bazaloni Group Limited as of July 28, 2026. This acquisition follows the execution of Share Purchase Agreements previously disclosed on July 1, 2026. Consequently, Bazaloni Group Limited, primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of Tea with a turnover of Rs. 52.78 Crores and a Net Profit of Rs 6.88 Crores as of March 31, 2026, has now become a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of The Grob Tea Company Limited. The acquisition does not involve related party transactions, and the terms were conducted at arm's length.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Pace Digitek Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "Intimation of press release".
announcements.ai_summary: Lineage Power Private Limited (LPPL), a material subsidiary of Pace Digitek Limited, has achieved a significant manufacturing milestone by producing 300 utility-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) containers, totaling approximately 1.5 GWh of battery energy storage capacity. This achievement underscores Pace Digitek's ongoing expansion in manufacturing to meet the rising demand for battery energy storage solutions. The company is actively increasing its BESS manufacturing capacity by adding another 2.5 GWh to its existing 2.5 GWh capacity and is establishing a new 5 GWh BESS manufacturing facility along with an in-house container fabrication facility. These strategic moves are designed to enhance manufacturing scale, improve backward integration, boost cost efficiencies, and strengthen execution capabilities across the BESS value chain. Pace Digitek offers an integrated BESS platform encompassing manufacturing, engineering, system integration, EPC, and long-term Operations & Maintenance (O&M), enabling end-to-end solutions.

The acquisition is not considered a related party transaction.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Modi Rubber Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'postal ballot notice'.
announcements.ai_summary: Modi Rubber Limited has issued a postal ballot notice to its members regarding a proposed resolution. The resolution seeks to appoint Mr. Ajay Kumar Jain (DIN – 00097213) as an Independent Director. The appointment will be decided by the members through postal ballot, specifically via remote e-voting, in compliance with Section 110 of the Companies Act, 2013, and relevant rules and circulars. An explanatory statement detailing the material facts and rationale for the proposed appointment is included with the notice. The company has appointed M/s Avinash K & Co., Practicing Company Secretaries, as the scrutinizer for the e-voting process.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Deep Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "Achieved all-time high quarterly revenue and profitability, driven by strong operationalexecution and market demand".
announcements.ai_summary: Deep Industries Limited has announced its consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, via a press release dated July 28, 2026. The company achieved an all-time high quarterly revenue and profitability, driven by strong operational execution and market demand. Total income for the quarter increased by 42.11% year-on-year to Rs. 302.60 crore. EBITDA stood at Rs. 131.83 crore, up 38.73% year-on-year, and Profit After Tax (PAT) was Rs. 89.14 crore, a 44.48% increase year-on-year. The Earnings Per Share (EPS) as of June 30, 2026, was Rs. 13.34. The company also highlighted securing key contracts for HP Compression at Assam and charter hiring of natural gas compression services at Ahmedabad.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited receives USFDA Final Approval for Prucalopride Tablets, 1 mg and 2 mg.".
announcements.ai_summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has received final approval from the US Food & Drug Administration (USFDA) for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) for Prucalopride Tablets, 1 mg and 2 mg. These tablets are therapeutically equivalent to Takeda Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.'s Motegrity Tablets and are indicated for the treatment of chronic idiopathic constipation in adults. The estimated market size for Prucalopride Tablets, 1 mg and 2 mg, was US$ 100 million for the twelve months ending March 2026, according to IQVIA. This approval brings Alembic's total USFDA ANDA approvals to 245, comprising 225 final and 20 tentative approvals.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Supreme Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "Q1 Press Release ".
announcements.ai_summary: Supreme Industries Limited announced its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. On a standalone basis, total income was Rs. 2726.79 crores, a 3.83% increase from Rs. 2626.12 crores in Q1 FY26, with operating profit rising 24.73% to Rs. 398.04 crores and PAT (before OCI) increasing 17.14% to Rs. 207.76 crores. Consolidated total income also grew by 3.83% to Rs. 2726.79 crores, while consolidated operating profit surged 36.89% to Rs. 471.00 crores and consolidated PAT (before OCI) increased by 38.76% to Rs. 280.72 crores. The company reported a total cash surplus of Rs. 542 crores as of June 30, 2026, down from Rs. 648 crores on March 31, 2026. The Chairman & Managing Director noted that while Q1 FY27 volumes were impacted by polymer price volatility, the company expects improved momentum due to stabilizing prices, the removal of customs duty exemptions, and the implementation of Minimum Import Prices (MIP) for suspension grade PVC resin.

announcements.detail: Nucleus Software Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Nucleus Software Exports Limited has received an order from the GST Appellate Authority for the financial year 2018-19, raising a GST demand of INR 47,02,500, which includes INR 22,27,500 in interest and INR 2,25,000 in penalty. This demand is related to tax reversals for credit notes that were not reflected on the GST portal. The company believes the order is not maintainable and is in the process of filing an appeal. Nucleus Software Exports Limited has assessed that this order will not have a material impact on its financials, operations, or other activities. The order was received on July 27, 2026.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: UPL Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of Sustainable Tech Inc, USA.
announcements.ai_summary: UPL Limited has announced the acquisition of shares in Sustainable Tech Inc, USA, by its step-down subsidiary, UPL NA Inc., USA. Sustainable Tech Inc, incorporated on July 14, 2026, will focus on the Aquatics business, which involves water treatment and environmental solutions. This acquisition is not a related party transaction, and no regulatory approvals are required. The acquisition was completed on July 27, 2026. Sustainable Tech Inc operates in a distinct sector from UPL's main agrochemical business.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Varun Beverages Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Varun Beverages Limited announced its financial results for the second quarter and half year ended June 30, 2026. Revenue from operations grew by 20.4% year-on-year to Rs. 84,512.3 million in Q2 2026, with consolidated sales volume increasing by 19.8% to 466.7 million cases. This growth was driven by a 14.4% volume increase in India and a 38.4% increase in international territories, which included 11.8 million cases from the acquisition of Twizza in South Africa. EBITDA rose by 17.2% to Rs. 23,430.4 million in Q2 2026. For the half year ended June 30, 2026, revenue grew 19.4% year-on-year to Rs. 150,254.2 million, and EBITDA increased by 18.7% to Rs. 38,719.6 million. Profit After Tax (PAT) for Q2 2026 increased by 15.1% year-on-year to Rs. 15,253.6 million, and for H1 2026, PAT increased by 16.9% to Rs. 24,040.7 million.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has been empanelled by the Indian Air Force (IAF) as a Prime Development Agency for the Indigenous Precision Range Extension Kit (IPREK) programme, under the Make-II category of India's Defence Acquisition Procedure 2020. This marks the company's entry into the precision guided munition segment. The IPREK is designed to convert existing General Purpose 500 Kg unguided bombs into long-range precision glide weapons. The empanelment signifies the IAF's confidence in Apollo Micro Systems' capability to develop such systems domestically. No specific financial details or timelines for development were disclosed in this announcement.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has been shortlisted and awarded a Make-II Prototype Sanction Order (PSO) by the Indian Air Force for indigenous Guidance and Navigation Kits. This award involves the design, development, and prototype demonstration of a 500 Kg Smart Bomb capable of precision targeting from over 80-100 kilometers. The project utilizes India's indigenous NavIC satellite navigation system, making it one of the first weapon systems globally to use this constellation. This development marks Apollo Micro Systems' entry into India's precision-guided munition (PGM) segment as a Prime OEM. Under the Make-II category, there is no cost obligation on the Government during the prototype development phase, with procurement committed upon successful demonstration. The company views this as a significant milestone, highlighting its technological capabilities and strategic role in India's defense manufacturing.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: HEG Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: HEG Limited has been informed by the U.S. Department of Commerce about its preliminary affirmative determination in the Countervailing Duty (CVD) investigation concerning imports of large diameter graphite electrodes from India into the United States. The preliminary determination, received on July 27, 2026, has assigned a preliminary countervailing duty rate of 6.99% for HEG Limited. Cash deposits at this rate may be required on future imports into the United States, subject to U.S. laws and procedures. The preliminary determination is subject to verification and a final determination by the U.S. Department of Commerce. The company is currently evaluating the potential impact on its business and financial performance, which is not yet ascertainable. The final CVD determination is scheduled for December 8, 2026, unless postponed.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: MBL Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: MBL Infrastructure Limited has issued a press release dated July 28, 2026, regarding an update on an Arbitration Award. The Commercial Court in Dehradun has dismissed petitions filed by the Public Works Department, Government of Uttarakhand, against an arbitration award dated December 14, 2024, in favor of MBL Infrastructure. This award pertains to the 'Improvement and Strengthening of Roads in the District of Udham Singh Nagar (Package No. C-2)' project. The value of the arbitration award, including interest, was Rs 82.77 crores as of July 27, 2026, with further interest accruing at 12% per annum until payment. The company is actively pursuing its receivables through negotiations, arbitrations, and litigations, aiming for amicable dispute resolution.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Exim Routes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Submission of Investor Update under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.
announcements.ai_summary: Exim Routes Limited has submitted an Investor Update under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, which is available on the company's website. The update highlights that despite challenging macro trends, Exim Routes has scaled its trade volume by approximately 40% in Q1 FY27 compared to Q1 FY26, reaching up to 10,000 MT monthly. The company has onboarded two new mills and two new yards in Europe as part of its expansion strategy. Exim Routes has secured a ₹20 Crore debt facility with Axis Bank, with ₹15 Crore already disbursed. Furthermore, the company has onboarded Credlix as its first invoice financing partner, with an initial facility of up to ₹2.5 Crore, and has already disbursed an initial tranche of ₹50 Lakhs. An MoU has also been signed with Oxyzo for a working capital solution.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Transrail Lighting Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 28, 2026, the Board has approved the raising of funds by way of Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP), up to Rs. 600 Crore
announcements.ai_summary: Transrail Lighting Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 28, 2026, approved a proposal to raise funds up to Rs. 600 Crore through a Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP). This fundraising initiative involves the issuance of equity shares with a face value of ₹2 each, or other eligible securities, or a combination thereof. The company also declared an interim dividend of ₹3 per equity share, representing 150% of the face value, for the financial year 2026-27, with a record date of August 3, 2026. Additionally, the Board approved an alteration to the Main Object Clause of the Memorandum of Association, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. The QIP is subject to necessary approvals, permissions, and consents, including shareholder approval.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Dilip Buildcon Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Dilip Buildcon Limited has been declared the L-1 bidder for a significant project by the Water Resources Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. The project involves the "Construction of Sikasar to Kodar Reservoir Link Canal (Pipeline)" on a lump-sum basis, with an order value of Rs. 2,524.32 Crores (excluding GST). The scope of work includes construction, testing, trials, run, commissioning, and operation & maintenance of the complete system for five years post-completion. The project is to be executed within a period of 30 months. This award is in accordance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Greaves Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a Press Release issued by Greaves Electric Mobility Limited, subsidiary of the Company, with the heading  Ampere and Muthoot Capital forges partnership to accelerate EV adoption across Bharat .
announcements.ai_summary: Greaves Cotton Limited has announced a partnership forged by its subsidiary, Greaves Electric Mobility Limited (GEML), through its E2W brand Ampere, with Muthoot Capital Services Ltd. This collaboration aims to make electric two-wheeler (E2W) ownership more accessible and affordable across India, thereby accelerating EV adoption. The partnership will offer customers convenient, flexible, and customer-centric retail financing solutions for Ampere's complete range of electric two-wheelers. It is designed to bridge affordability barriers by providing financing solutions tailored to diverse income profiles and mobility needs, including flexible repayment options. This initiative seeks to empower EV buyers, including salaried professionals, self-employed individuals, gig workers, and small business owners, by removing financial barriers and promoting clean mobility.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tata Communications Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "Tata Communications, Tata Tele Business Services Join Forces to Bring Unified AI Infrastructure to India s SMB Economy".
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Communications Limited has announced a strategic collaboration with Tata Tele Business Services (TTBS) to accelerate AI adoption among India's Small and Medium Businesses (SMBs) by offering a unified AI platform stack. This partnership combines the complementary strengths of both companies to unlock a significant market opportunity and expand their total addressable market. TTBS, known for its business-ready digital solutions for SMBs, will integrate its robust go-to-market strategy and channel partner ecosystem with Tata Communications' Voice AI platform. This platform, powered by AgenTix AI, provides advanced speech-to-speech customer engagement capabilities with features like instant decision-making, multilingual fluency, and sub-500 milliseconds latency. The collaboration aims to simplify the deployment of advanced AI solutions for businesses, overcoming typical complexity, cost, and technical barriers, and will include the showcasing of an AI-powered Voice Agent for customer interactions.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "Tata Tele Business Services and Tata Communications Join Forces to Bring Unified AI Infrastructure to India s SMB Economy".
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited has announced a strategic collaboration between Tata Tele Business Services (TTBS) and Tata Communications to accelerate AI adoption among India's Small and Medium Businesses (SMBs). This partnership will deliver a unified AI platform stack specifically designed for the SMB segment, combining the strengths of both companies to expand their total addressable market. TTBS, a trusted technology partner for SMBs, will integrate its extensive reach and digital B2B exchange with Tata Communications' Voice AI platform, which offers advanced speech-to-speech customer engagement solutions with low latency. The collaboration aims to simplify the deployment of advanced AI solutions for businesses, making them more accessible and affordable, and will showcase an AI-powered Voice Agent capable of managing customer interactions, handling inquiries, scheduling appointments, and processing orders.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tembo Global Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "TEMBO GLOBAL INDUSTRIES FORMS STRATEGIC JOINT VENTURE WITH JR-UAV EUROPE AND JR PROPO JAPAN TO ADVANCE INDIGENOUS UAV MANUFACTURING IN INDIA".
announcements.ai_summary: Tembo Global Industries Limited has announced a strategic joint venture with JR-UAV Europe S.r.l. (Italy) and JR PROPO (Japan) to establish an advanced ecosystem for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) and autonomous systems manufacturing in India. This collaboration aims to transfer technology, localize production, and build mission-ready UAV platforms for defense, surveillance, logistics, and industrial applications, aligning with India's "Atmanirbhar Bharat" vision. The venture will industrialize and manufacture global technologies in India, including UAV platform design, autonomous flight systems, and propulsion systems, leveraging expertise from Japan, Europe, the United States, and the Netherlands. The initiative strengthens India's aerospace and defense manufacturing capabilities through technology transfer, local production, and skill creation, supporting Tembo Global Industries' diversification into the defense sector.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Sundaram Multi Pap Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 28, 2026, titled "Sundaram Multi Pap Limited Announces AI-Powered Upgrade to its Digital Education Platform to Transform Learning Across Maharashtra".

Ignitium Services is an energy solutions company specializing in fuel delivery and energy management services for industrial customers. This strategic acquisition aims to strengthen BikeWo's energy capabilities and expand its integrated mobility and logistics platform into the energy sector that powers commercial transportation and industrial operations. Ignitium's growth roadmap includes conventional fuels, green energy generation, clean energy distribution, and integrated energy solutions, which complement BikeWo's long-term strategy. The project's total installed capacity of 8.90 MWp is split between a 4.60 MWp portion executed under the CAPEX model and a 4.30 MWp portion under the OPEX model. announcements.ai_summary: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited provided a clarification to the National Stock Exchange on May 27, 2026, regarding a delay in disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The delay stemmed from a surprise visit by Bureau of Indian Standards ("BIS") officials to the Company's Greater Noida facility on March 24, 2026, during which product samples were taken and inventory was seized, with a formal notice expected. The Company initially had preliminary information and awaited official communication from BIS to assess the event's materiality and complete facts, consulting with legal advisors. In the absence of further communication from BIS within a reasonable timeframe, the Company proactively made the disclosure to ensure transparency. Fujiyama Power Systems Limited stated the delay was unintentional and due to the need for verification, reaffirming its commitment to timely and transparent disclosures.

announcements.ai_summary: IDFC First Bank Limited has received an amount of ₹514.82 crore towards a claim under the 'Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units' (CGFMU) Scheme. The bank had previously made provisions for these MFI defaults, and this amount is expected to be a write-back of those provisions. This update is being uploaded to the bank's website as per listing regulations.

The washery, which started operations on May 26, 2026, is a three-product medium coking coal washery built under a Build, Operate and Maintain (BOM) model. This facility will enable the production of washed coking coal for supply to the steel sector.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Datamatics Global Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release'.
announcements.ai_summary: Datamatics Global Services Limited announced on May 27, 2026, a collaboration with SBI Life Insurance to redefine its underwriting operations using Datamatics' Agentic AI-powered automation. SBI Life has implemented Datamatics' TruAI Underwriting solution, which is designed to assist underwriters in handling complex medical underwriting cases with greater speed, consistency, and insight. The platform ingests and analyzes documents such as medical reports and laboratory results, extracts key medical parameters, and highlights potential risk indicators. It generates a consolidated digital case summary and provides intelligent decision support, continuously enhancing risk evaluation through self-learning capabilities. Human underwriters retain final decision authority to ensure governance, accountability, and regulatory compliance. This partnership aims to enhance decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and elevate the overall customer experience for SBI Life.
