announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: PNC Infratech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated March 27, 2026, titled "Completion of their Sale of Equity Stake in PNC Challakere (Karnataka) Highways Private Limited, a BOT (Toll) Road Project, to Vertis Infrastructure Trust ( VIT ) ".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: PNC Infratech Limited has issued a press release on March 27, 2026, announcing the completion of the sale of its equity stake in PNC Challakere (Karnataka) Highways Private Limited to Vertis Infrastructure Trust (VIT). This transaction marks the final tranche of a divestment initiative that began in January 2024, involving a portfolio of 12 road assets. The total aggregate length of these projects is approximately 3,800 lane-km across four states. The transaction was concluded at an Enterprise Value of Rs. 683.84 crore, which includes Rs 80.48 crore received towards Equity and Rs 134.94 crore received towards Unsecured Loans on March 27, 2026.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: PNC Infratech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''.SALE OR DISPOSAL OF AN ASSET/UNDERTAKING OF THE COMPANY
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: PNC Infratech Limited, along with its Wholly Owned Subsidiary PNC Infra Holdings Limited, has transferred its entire stake in PNC Challakere (Karnataka) Highways Private Limited (SPV) to Vertis Infrastructure Trust (VIT) on March 27, 2026. This marks the completion of the transfer of all twelve identified Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) as per the Share Purchase Agreement dated January 15, 2024. For the financial year ended March 31, 2025, PNC Challakere (Karnataka) Highways Private Limited contributed Rs. 16402.72 Lakhs (1.30%) to the consolidated revenue and had a net worth of Rs. 7803.22 Lakhs (2.42%) of the consolidated net worth. This divestment is part of a strategic initiative announced in January 2024.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Aditya Birla Money Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Aditya Birla Money Limited has been informed by the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) that a penalty of ₹2,13,864.89 (exclusive of GST) has been imposed on the Company. This penalty is related to Client Code Modifications and pursuant to MCSGFC directives. The Company received this communication on March 27, 2026. While the penalty amount is specified, the Company states that there is no material impact on its financial, operational, or other activities apart from the penalty itself.

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: Mukand Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Mukand Limited has executed two Conveyance Deeds for the sale of land parcels at Dighe. The first deed involves the sale of a 50% undivided share in land admeasuring approximately 9,871 sq. mtrs (2.44 acres) for a consideration of Rs. 43,98,02,405. The second deed is for the sale of a portion of land admeasuring approximately 57,386 sq. mtrs (14.18 acres) for a consideration of Rs. 511,36,66,460. The total consideration for both transactions is Rs. 555,34,68,865. After adjusting Rs. 110,00,00,000 paid earlier, the Company has received the balance consideration of Rs. 445,34,68,865. This follows an earlier intimation dated July 23, 2025.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Aksh Optifibre Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''.
announcements.ai_summary: Aksh Optifibre Limited has received an order from the Hon’ble Debt Recovery Tribunal (DRT), Jaipur, dated March 24, 2026, which was received by the company on March 26, 2026. The DRT has set aside the Demand Notice issued under Section 13(2) and the Possession Notice issued under Section 13(4) of the Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest (SARFAESI) Act, 2002, by Union Bank of India. Consequently, the securitisation action initiated by the Bank has been quashed by the Hon’ble Tribunal.

announcements.subject: Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: K.M.Sugar Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.ai_summary: K.M. Sugar Mills Limited has filed a joint First Motion Application with the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Allahabad Bench, for sanction of a Scheme of Arrangement. The scheme involves the demerger of the 'Distillery Division' of K. M. Sugar Mills Limited (Demerged Company) into KM Spirits and Allied Industries Limited (Resulting Company). The NCLT has ordered K. M. Sugar Mills Limited to issue individual notices and convene meetings of its Equity Shareholders and Unsecured Creditors through Video Conference or Other Audio-Visual Means.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Kross Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Mrs Anita Rai, Promoter and Whole Time Director of the Company has acquired 89,027 equity shares on 27.03.2026 through Open market'.
announcements.ai_summary: Mrs. Anita Rai, a Promoter and Whole Time Director of Kross Limited, has acquired 89,027 equity shares on March 27, 2026, through the open market. This acquisition represents 0.13% of the total issued and paid-up share capital of the company. This transaction is disclosed under Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Dredging Corporation of India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated March 27, 2026, titled "Press release - DCIL Marks 50 Years with Ambitious Expansion Roadmap, Modernisation Push, and ₹3,000 Crore Growth Target.- Reg.".
announcements.ai_summary: Dredging Corporation of India Limited has issued a press release dated March 27, 2026, outlining an ambitious expansion roadmap and modernization push. The company targets a growth of ₹3,000 Crore as part of its 50th-anniversary celebrations. This announcement signals a strategic focus on expanding its operations and upgrading its infrastructure to achieve significant growth in the coming period.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Vraj Iron and Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial operations of Induction Furnace unit situated at Bilaspur Chhattisgarh.
announcements.ai_summary: Vraj Iron and Steel Limited has commenced commercial production from its Induction Furnace unit located in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, effective March 27, 2026. This unit has an installed capacity of 1,53,000 TPA and has received the Consent to Operate from the Chhattisgarh Environment Conservation Board. The company has stated that this milestone is a significant step in enhancing its production capacity and operational efficiency. The unit is equipped with advanced technology and is expected to positively contribute to the company's overall performance.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: RSWM Limited has announced two key personnel updates. Firstly, Shri Riju Jhunjhunwala (DIN: 00061060) has been re-appointed as the Managing Director of the Company for a period of three years, effective from May 1, 2026, to April 30, 2029. Shri Jhunjhunwala is not debarred from holding this office by any SEBI order or other authority. Secondly, there has been a revision in the remuneration payable to Shri Rajeev Gupta (DIN: 02049516), the Joint Managing Director of the Company. These decisions are in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Vraj Iron and Steel Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015, merger order receipt by the promoter group entities.'.
announcements.ai_summary: Vraj Iron and Steel Limited has been informed by its promoter companies that the Hon'ble Regional Director, South East Region, Hyderabad, has approved a scheme of merger by absorption. This scheme, effective from March 18, 2026, involves the merger of Kirti Ispat Private Limited ("KIPL"), Utkal Ispat Private Limited ("UIPL"), and V A Transport Private Limited ("VATPL") with Gopal Sponge and Power Private Limited (GSPPL). Consequently, KIPL, UIPL, and VATPL will cease to exist, and investments held in VATPL within Vraj Iron and Steel Limited will be consolidated under GSPPL. The aggregate holding of the promoters in Vraj Iron and Steel Limited will remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: Memorandum of Understanding/Agreements
announcements.detail: PC Jeweller Limited has informed the Exchange about Memorandum of Understanding with NSDC
announcements.ai_summary: PC Jeweller Limited has executed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) on March 26, 2026. Under this MoU, PC Jeweller Limited will partner as the Industry/Franchise Partner for the Gems & Jewellery Sector. The agreement aims to develop and onboard up to 2,00,000 micro-entrepreneurs in India over a 5-year period under the PC Jeweller Brand as part of NSDC's National Entrepreneurship Drive (NED) initiative. This partnership is expected to contribute to employment generation and local economic development, while also expanding PC Jeweller's retail footprint.

announcements.subject: Rumour Verification - Regulation 30(11)
announcements.detail: Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd. has informed the Exchange about Rumour Verification - Regulation 30(11)- Clarification on news articles published in mainstream media
announcements.ai_summary: Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd. has clarified news articles regarding its hospital operations in Katra. The company stated that its wholly owned subsidiary, Narayana Vaishno Devi Specialty Hospitals Private Limited (NVDSHPL), executed a Business Transfer Agreement (BTA) with Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Charitable Society on March 27, 2026. This BTA formalizes the transition of the hospital to the Society, effective April 1, 2026, with NVDSHPL retaining a supervisory oversight role until 2033. This arrangement was previously disclosed on March 28, 2025, and the current news pertains to its implementation.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sheetal Cool Products Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 for Launch of New Ice Cream Café
announcements.ai_summary: Sheetal Cool Products Limited has expanded its retail presence by launching a new Ice Cream Café in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, with operations commencing on March 26, 2026, at 6:30 PM. This new outlet, located at Magnifico Complex, Sindhu Bhavan, Ahmedabad, is part of the company's ongoing business expansion strategy to strengthen its brand presence and enhance customer reach. The café will offer the company's premium ice cream products and related items, aiming to provide an enhanced in-store customer experience. This is considered a general business update in the ordinary course of operations.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Outcome Of Board Meeting - Purchase Of Shares Of Empire Mall Private Limited, Omni Infrastructure Private Limited, Hagwood Commercial Developers Private Limited From Prozone Liberty International Limited, WOS Of Prozone Realty Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Prozone Realty Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on March 27, 2026, approved the purchase of equity shares of Empire Mall Private Limited, Omni Infrastructure Private Limited, and Hagwood Commercial Developers Private Limited. These shares will be acquired from Prozone Liberty International Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Prozone Realty Limited based in Singapore. Empire Mall Private Limited has a paid-up share capital of INR 1,36,02,25,320 and a turnover of INR 6,271.36 lakhs. The acquisition is considered an arm's length transaction.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'conclusion of further acquisition of 3,66,49,271 fully paid ordinary shares in Colombo Dockyard PLC (CDPLC), resulting in total acquisition of 51% stake as on date'.
announcements.ai_summary: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited has completed the further acquisition of 3,66,49,271 fully paid ordinary shares in Colombo Dockyard PLC (CDPLC). This acquisition, made through a mandatory offer under Sri Lankan regulations, brings Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited's total shareholding in CDPLC to 51% as of March 27, 2026. This transaction was part of a Tripartite Agreement with CDPLC and Onomichi Dockyard Co. Ltd. The company had previously disclosed an initial agreement on January 21, 2026.

announcements.subject: Amendment(s)
announcements.detail: Shriram Pistons & Rings Limited has informed the Exchange about Amendment to Agreement to Purchase Identified Assets
announcements.ai_summary: Shriram Pistons & Rings Limited (SPRL) has entered into an amendment agreement dated March 27, 2026, to its Asset Purchase Agreement (APA) with Sunbeam Lightweighting Solutions Limited. This amendment extends the long stop date for the purchase of identified plant and machinery and related assets from March 31, 2026, to June 30, 2026, and allows for the completion of the proposed transaction in multiple tranches. The closing formalities for the second tranche are now expected to be completed on or before June 30, 2026. This update is in continuation of earlier intimations dated December 19, 2025, and December 31, 2025.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 29(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011'.
announcements.ai_summary: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited has announced the allotment of equity shares to Tikani Exports Limited, a Promoter Group entity, under its recently concluded Rights Issue. This allotment is made pursuant to Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Tikani Exports Limited is exempt from making an open offer as all conditions under Regulation 10(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011, have been fulfilled. The exact shareholding percentages before and after the acquisition are not explicitly stated in the provided text, but the transaction is a result of the Rights Issue.

announcements.company: Deepak Fertilizers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited
announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Deepak Fertilizers And Petrochemicals Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Deepak Fertilizers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited has responded to a query from BSE regarding a significant increase in the trading volume of its securities. The company has stated that it has been strictly complying with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, by filing all relevant disclosures and announcements within the stipulated timeframes. Deepak Fertilizers confirmed that there are no pending information or announcements that could impact the price or volume behavior of its securities. The company also mentioned that the volume movement is market-driven and they have no further comment on it.

announcements.subject: Diversification/Disinvestment
announcements.detail: Info Edge (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Info Edge (India) Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on March 27, 2026, approved the transfer of the company's entire stake in Shopkirana E Trading Private Limited to Trustroot Internet Private Limited (TIPL). This action is a divestment of Info Edge's holding in Shopkirana, which was held through its subsidiary Startup Investments (Holding) Limited (SIHL). SIHL will transfer 60,673 shares, representing 26.14% on a fully converted and diluted basis, of Shopkirana to TIPL for USD 32,970,499.20. In consideration, TIPL will allot 1,04,868 preference shares to SIHL, representing 2.021% on a fully converted and diluted basis, valued at USD 314.40 per share. This transaction is a part of the company's ongoing strategic realignment.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Global Education Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on March 27, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Global Education Limited's Board of Directors, in their meeting held on March 27, 2026, approved the introduction of new student-centric service offerings. These services will include student enrollment assistance, admission facilitation, counseling, guidance, student support, and ancillary services like educational materials and uniforms. This initiative represents an expansion of the company's service portfolio within the education segment, aimed at enhancing value-added services and creating additional revenue streams. The Board also reviewed general business operations and approved a Policy on effective two-way communication between Statutory Auditors and Those Charged with Governance.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Poddar Pigments Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.ai_summary: Poddar Pigments Limited has commenced commercial production for an additional 6000 Metric Tons Per Annum (MTPA) of Colour Masterbatches at its Chaksu Plant in Jaipur, Rajasthan. This expansion, which increases the plant's capacity from the existing 8030 MTPA, was undertaken at a capital expenditure of Rs. 1090.01 lakhs. The commencement of operations took place on March 27, 2026, as part of the company's overall growth strategy. This development is expected to contribute to PPL’s expansion plans within the pigments sector.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: AYM Syntex Limited has informed the Exchange about Allotment of 33,000 Equity Shares under AYM Employee Stock Option Scheme 2021.
announcements.ai_summary: AYM Syntex Limited's Finance Committee of the Board of Directors has approved the allotment of 33,000 fully paid-up equity shares under the AYM Employee Stock Option Scheme 2021. These shares, with a face value of Rs. 10 per share, were allotted to eligible employees upon their exercise of stock options on March 27, 2026. These newly allotted equity shares will rank pari-passu with the existing equity shares of the company. Consequently, the company's paid-up share capital has increased from Rs. 58,58,10,910 (5,85,81,091 equity shares) to Rs. 58,61,40,910 (5,86,14,091 equity shares).

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: PCBL Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange about Commissioning of additional Brownfield capacity of 30,000 MT of Carbon Black by M/s PCBL (TN) Limited, Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: PCBL Chemical Limited announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, M/s PCBL (TN) Limited, has commissioned an additional brownfield capacity of 30,000 MT of Carbon Black at its plant in Tamil Nadu. Commercial production from this new capacity commenced effectively on March 27, 2026. This expansion is expected to enhance the company's production capabilities and contribute to its long-term growth plans by meeting market requirements. The existing capacity was 2,07,000 MTPA, with an 88% utilization rate.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the approval granted by the Board of Directors to raise funds during FY 2026-27 by issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures on a Private Placement Basis.
announcements.ai_summary: Sundaram Finance Limited's Board of Directors has approved a proposal to raise funds up to ₹17,000 crore during the financial year 2026-27. The fundraising will be conducted through the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures on a private placement basis, potentially in one or more tranches. This decision was made during the Board Meeting held on March 27, 2026, which commenced at 10:00 A.M. and concluded at 11:50 A.M. This move is intended to strengthen the company's financial resources for its operations in the upcoming fiscal year.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Trident Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has successfully commissioned the additional capacity of 5.40 MWp rooftop Solar Power Project at Budhni, Madhya Pradesh.
announcements.ai_summary: Trident Limited has successfully commissioned an additional capacity of 5.40 MWp for its rooftop Solar Power Project at Budhni, Madhya Pradesh. This commissioning, effective March 27, 2026, brings the total installed capacity of the Solar Power Plant at the Budhni facility to 57.32 MWp. The proposed capacity addition involved an investment of approximately INR 10 Crore, financed through internal accruals. The rationale behind this expansion is the adoption of renewable energy to reduce the company's carbon footprint. The existing capacity was 51.92 MWp, operating at 100% utilization.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Renaissance Global Limited has informed the Exchange about launched of  ISSHŌ , a new lab-grown diamond jewellery collection developed in collaboration with Shibani Akhtar.
announcements.ai_summary: Renaissance Global Limited announced that its luxury brand, Irasva Fine Jewellery, has launched "ISSHŌ," a new lab-grown diamond jewellery collection. This collection is developed in collaboration with Shibani Akhtar and marks Irasva's first dedicated exploration into lab-grown diamonds. The name "ISSHŌ" means "together" in Japanese, reflecting the creative synergy between Irasva's Founder and Creative Director, Leshna Shah, and Shibani Akhtar. The collection features pieces crafted in gold and set with certified lab-grown diamonds, characterized by sculptural forms, refined geometry, and versatile silhouettes designed for everyday wear. The launch positions lab-grown diamonds as a deliberate and forward-looking choice, aligning with evolving consumer values around transparency, responsibility, and accessible luxury.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Marine Electricals (India) Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
announcements.ai_summary: Marine Electricals (India) Limited has announced a proposal to convert M/s. Narhari Engineering Works, a partnership firm where the company holds a 99% stake, into a Private Limited Company. This conversion will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The company has proposed three potential names for the new entity: MEL Heavy Industries Private Limited, MEL Advanced Machines Private Limited, or MEL Heavy Machineries Private Limited, subject to regulatory approvals. Marine Electricals (India) Limited will maintain its existing 99% shareholding in the converted entity, reflecting its current partnership contribution. This disclosure is being made as part of the company's commitment to good corporate governance. The company is seeking to have this information recorded by the stock exchange.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: One Point One Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated March 27, 2026, titled Disclosure under Regulation 30- Managing Director Honored with Most Promising Business Leader of the Year  Award at ET Edge Asian Business Leaders Conclave 2026..
announcements.ai_summary: One Point One Solutions Limited has announced that its Managing Director and Chairman, Mr. Akshay Chhabra, has been honored with the 'Most Promising Business Leader of the Year' award at the ET Edge Asian Business Leaders Conclave 2026. This award recognizes Mr. Chhabra's leadership, long-term business building approach, and focus on results in a dynamic market. The company has experienced strengthened operations, improved service delivery, and scaled its multi-location model under his leadership. This recognition was announced via a press release on March 27, 2026.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: PTC Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 27, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: PTC Industries Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 27, 2026, from 7:00 PM to 8:30 PM, approved several key proposals. Firstly, the company is authorized to raise funds up to ₹1800 Crores through a Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) or a Preferential Issue, or by issuing share warrants convertible into equity shares. This fundraising is subject to necessary approvals, including shareholder approval and regulatory clearances. The specific terms, objects, utilization of proceeds, issue size, pricing, and timing will be presented to the Board and Audit Committee for final approval before the launch. Secondly, the Board approved proposals for loans, guarantees, securities, and investments up to INR 2000 Crores, or 60% of the company's paid-up share capital, free reserves, and securities premium account, or 100% of its free reserves and securities premium account, whichever is greater, as per Section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013. This is also subject to shareholder approval via a Special Resolution. Lastly, the Board approved an increase in the company's borrowing limits.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 27, 2026, titled "Amber Group Conducted Groundbreaking Ceremony of Two Advanced Manufacturing Facilities at YIEDA, Jewar, Uttar Pradesh which is self- explanatory.
announcements.ai_summary: Amber Group conducted a groundbreaking ceremony on June 27, 2026, for two advanced manufacturing facilities at YIEDA, near Noida International Airport (Jewar), Uttar Pradesh. The first facility is for Ascent-K Circuit, dedicated to advanced HDI PCBs manufacturing, spanning 16 acres, and approved under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) by

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Powerica Limited has informed about the incorporation of its wholly owned subsidiary - Whisperwind Renewable Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Powerica Limited announced the incorporation of its wholly owned subsidiary, Whisperwind Renewable Private Limited (WRPL), on June 27, 2026, following an earlier intimation on May 28, 2026. Incorporated in India, WRPL is a related party to Powerica Limited and operates in the Renewable Energy industry. Its main objects include setting up, developing, and constructing various renewable power projects, such as wind, solar, and wind-solar hybrid projects. WRPL will also focus on power generation from these renewable sources and all other allied activities related to establishing wind parks or power projects. The incorporation was completed via

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sapphire Foods India Limited has informed Exchange regarding ESG Report for the Financial Year 2025-26
announcements.ai_summary: Sapphire Foods India Limited has released its Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Report for the Financial Year 2025-26. This report aligns with the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) Standards and provides insights into the company's sustainability efforts. The ESG Report is accessible on the company's website at https://www.sapphirefoods.in/investors-relation/annual-reports. The company's CIN is L55204HR2009PLC145722.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
announcements.ai_summary: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited has informed the stock exchanges about the incorporation of its Wholly Owned Subsidiary, WindCrest Realty Private Limited, on June 26, 2026. The authorized share capital of WindCrest Realty Private Limited is Rs. 10,00,000, with a paid-up share capital of Rs. 5,00,000. This subsidiary will engage in real estate activities, including acting as contractors and builders, and purchasing, selling, leasing, and developing properties. As a wholly owned subsidiary, it is a related party to Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited, but the promoters and promoter group do not have any direct interest beyond this relationship.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate of Incorporation received for the Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company i.e. Solex BESS Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Solex Energy Limited has announced the incorporation of its Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Solex BESS Private Limited, with a Certificate of Incorporation received on June 27, 2026. The authorized capital for Solex BESS Private Limited is Rs. 10,00,000, divided into 1,00,000 shares. This new subsidiary will focus on the manufacturing, assembling, designing, developing, installing, commissioning, operating, maintaining, and dealing in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). This move aligns with Solex Energy Limited's strategic objective to expand its presence in the renewable energy sector, and the business of the subsidiary is considered ancillary to the company's existing activities.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: VMS TMT Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 27, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: VMS TMT Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 27, 2026, approved a Scheme of Amalgamation for the merger of Aditya Ultra Steel Limited (AUSL) into VMS TMT Limited. Aditya Ultra Steel Limited reported total assets of ₹19,297.46 lakhs, a turnover of ₹40,989.92 lakhs for the twelve months ended March 31, 2026, and a net worth of ₹9,239.25 lakhs as of March 31, 2026. VMS TMT Limited reported total assets of ₹51,941.16 lakhs, a turnover of ₹84,019.95 lakhs for the twelve months ended March 31, 2026, and a net worth of ₹22,813.28 lakhs as of March 31, 2026. This proposed transaction is subject to obtaining necessary approvals from SEBI, NCLT, BSE, NSE, other regulatory authorities, and the respective shareholders and creditors.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Best Agrolife Limited has informed the Exchange about non exercise of option for conversion of Warrants
announcements.ai_summary: Best Agrolife Limited announced on June 27, 2026, that certain warrant holders did not exercise their option to convert 23,43,750 convertible warrants into equity shares within the stipulated

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Best Agrolife Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 27, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Best Agrolife Limited's Board of Directors met on June 27, 2026, and noted the lapse of 23,43,750 convertible warrants that were allotted on December 27, 2024. These warrants expired on June 26, 2026, as the holders failed to exercise their conversion rights within the stipulated 18-month period. Consequently, the Board approved the forfeiture of the initial subscription amount received for these warrants, totaling ₹37,50,00,000, which represents 25% of the warrant issue price. This action was taken in accordance with the terms of the warrant issue and SEBI regulations. The meeting commenced at 4:00 PM and concluded at 4:30 PM.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Commercial Syn Bags Limited provided an update on its expansion projects. The company is in the final stages of commissioning the expanded manufacturing capacity of its Techtex unit, located at Plot No. A-12 & A-13, Indore Special Economic Zone, Pithampur Phase-II, Dhar, Madhya Pradesh. Trial runs for this expanded facility are expected to begin on or before July 15, 2026. Commercial production is anticipated to commence immediately after successful trial runs and stabilization of operations, which will lead to an increase in the manufacturing capacity of this unit. The company will continue to update the stock exchange on the progress of its remaining expansion projects.

announcements.subject: Sale or disposal
announcements.detail: Strides Partners with Ascent Capital to Unlock Value in Pivot Path
announcements.ai_summary: Strides Pharma Science Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 27, 2026, approved a strategic investment by a consortium led by Ascent Capital, along with co-investor Vintage Classic, in its wholly owned subsidiary, Pivot Path Private Limited. The transaction involves the sale of a majority stake by Strides to Ascent Capital and Vintage Classic for an aggregate consideration of approximately ₹1,000 million. Furthermore, Ascent Capital will make a primary infusion of approximately ₹500 million into Pivot Path to support its future growth. Upon completion, Pivot Path will be reclassified as an Associate Company. The Board meeting took place from 3:00 PM IST to 3:50 PM IST.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Strides Pharma Science Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 27, 2026, titled "Strides Partners with Ascent Capital to Unlock Value in Pivot Path".
announcements.ai_summary: Strides Pharma Science Limited has issued a press release on June 27, 2026, titled "Strides Partners with Ascent Capital to Unlock Value in Pivot Path." The company announced a strategic investment by a consortium led by Ascent Capital, with Vintage Classic as a co-investor, in its wholly owned subsidiary, Pivot Path Private Limited. This transaction values Pivot Path at approximately ₹2,300 million on a post-money basis. Strides will realize approximately ₹1,000 million from the sale of a majority stake while retaining a ~20% ownership. Additionally, Pivot Path will receive a primary capital infusion of ₹500 million to accelerate its growth and technology investments. The Board meeting to approve this transaction commenced at 3:00 PM IST and concluded at 3:50 PM IST.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: TVS Motor Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 27, 2026, titled "TVS MOTOR COMPANY LAUNCHES NEPAL S MOST POWERFUL TVS APACHE RTR 160 4V".
announcements.ai_summary: TVS Motor Company launched the all-new TVS Apache RTR 160 4V in Nepal on June 27, 2026, at Satungal, Kathmandu. This new model is positioned as Nepal’s most powerful TVS Apache RTR 160 4V, delivering a best-in-class 17.55PS power. The motorcycle introduces several segment-first features, including a projector headlamp, USD Suspension, and a 5-inch TFT Cluster. announcements.subject: Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.detail: Vikran Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding cancellation of Order received from Ellume Energy MH Solar One Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Vikran Engineering Limited has decided not to proceed with a previously accepted Letter of Award (LOA) from Ellume Energy MH Solar One Private Limited (SPV) for a Turnkey Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contract. The LOA, accepted on October 24, 2025, was for a 100 MW AC Solar Power Project in Maharashtra, with an approximate value of ₹354.21 crore. The cancellation is due to prolonged delays by the client in achieving project readiness milestones, including the inability to provide a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA), work commencement approvals, design clearances, scope finalization, and mobilization permissions. These delays made the project execution commercially unviable. The cancellation is by mutual understanding and is not expected to have a material adverse impact on the company's operations or financial performance.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Persistent Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 27, 2026, titled "Press Release titled  Persistent and Nagarro sign Business Combination Agreement to form the Persistent - Nagarro Group, a global leader in AI-led digital engineering ".
announcements.ai_summary: Persistent Systems Limited has announced a significant development through a press release dated June 27, 2026, detailing a Business Combination Agreement with Nagarro. This agreement aims to form the "Persistent - Nagarro Group," positioning it as a global leader in AI-led digital engineering. Persistent intends to launch a voluntary public takeover offer for all outstanding Nagarro shares at EUR 81 per share, representing a premium of approximately 140% to the undisturbed closing price on June 25, 2026. Nagarro's management and supervisory board support the transaction and plan to recommend acceptance. Persistent has already secured a ~21% stake in Nagarro, with its largest shareholder committed to tendering its entire stake. The combined entity is projected to be a ~USD 2.9 billion AI-led engineering powerhouse with over 46,000 employees across 40+ countries, integrating Persistent's AI leadership and North American scale with Nagarro's European presence, complementary verticals, and ERP/CX delivery capabilities. The offer is contingent on a minimum acceptance threshold of 50% plus one share of all outstanding Nagarro shares.

announcements.ai_summary: Navin Fluorine International Limited has entered into Amendment Agreements to enhance its captive power supply and secure additional investment. announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Pavna Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 27, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: In a Board Meeting held on July 27, 2026, Pavna Industries Limited approved the lapse and forfeiture of 24,00,000 convertible warrants. These warrants were part of a preferential issue approved on September 26, 2024, with an issue price of ₹505/- per warrant (face value ₹10/-). The total issue size for the warrants was ₹210.69 Crore. According to the terms, 25% of the issue price was paid upfront, and the remaining 75% was due by July 28, 2026. As the warrant holders were unable to pay the balance consideration, the warrants have lapsed. Consequently, the upfront subscription amount of ₹30,30,00,000/- (₹30.30 Crore), which is 25% of the issue price, has been forfeited as per Regulation 169(3) of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, effective July 29, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bank Of Baroda has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30
announcements.ai_summary: Bank of Baroda has disclosed a cyber-security incident where an anonymous source claimed access to certain data. The bank has initiated its cyber incident response protocols and engaged an independent CERT-In empanelled agency for a comprehensive assessment. Preliminary findings suggest a potential business email compromise, which is not expected to materially impact the bank's operations, financial performance, or business continuity, as core business functions remain uninterrupted. A detailed assessment is ongoing, and appropriate remedial and preventive measures are being implemented.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Aastha Spintex Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Aastha Spintex Delivers Record Financial Performance with Unmodified Audit Opinion".
announcements.ai_summary: Aastha Spintex Limited announced on July 27, 2026, its record audited financial performance for FY 2025-26, receiving an unmodified audit opinion from its statutory auditors, M/s. S. N Shah & Associates. The company reported Revenue from Operations of ₹352 Crore and a Net Profit of ₹23.8 Crore, representing a 2,200% growth over four years. The Board also approved a 1:1 bonus issue and a dividend, alongside a strategic forward integration into fabric manufacturing. Production capacity has expanded by 127% to 17,457 MT. The company aims to transform from a yarn manufacturer to an integrated textile player.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Investment in Rights Issue of CIL Rajasthan Akshay Urja Limited (CRAUL) a subsidiary of CIL
announcements.ai_summary: Coal India Limited's Board, in a meeting held on an undisclosed date, approved an investment in the Rights Issue of CIL Rajasthan Akshay Urja Limited (CRAUL), a subsidiary. CRAUL is a joint venture between Coal India Limited and Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Urja Nigam Limited, with a paid-up capital of Rs. 10,00,000, where CIL holds Rs. 7,40,000 and RVUNL holds Rs. 2,60,000. The entity operates in the Renewable Energy sector and its objective is to develop, construct, and operate solar, PSP, and wind power projects, selling power to RVUNL or other agreed entities. This investment is part of Coal India Limited's strategy to expand its renewable energy portfolio.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Craftsman Automation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015)   Investment in Sterling MH Wind Private Limited'.
announcements.ai_summary: Craftsman Automation Limited has entered into a Power Supply Agreement, Share Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement with Sterling MH Wind Private Limited and Sterling Agro Industries Limited. On July 27, 2026, Craftsman Automation will subscribe to 2,14,500 equity shares of Sterling MH Wind Private Limited for an aggregate consideration of Rs. 1,07,25,000. This investment will result in Craftsman Automation holding 26.66% of Sterling MH's paid-up equity share capital. The purpose of this investment is to procure renewable wind power for the company's manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra, including its Pune operations, from Sterling MH's wind power project located in Maharashtra.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: W S Industries (I) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of the meeting of the Board of Directors held on 27th July, 2026.'.
announcements.ai_summary: W.S. Industries (India) Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 27, 2026, approved a Binding Tripartite Term Sheet to develop a senior living/care residential project in Poonamalee, Chennai. The project will be developed on approximately 4.00 acres of land, with an indicative built-up area of 5,66,280 sq. ft. The company will act as the Developer, responsible for end-to-end execution, and will receive a fixed return of 7.5% of the topline realized from the project. Additionally, the Board approved seeking working capital facilities, potentially secured against the project land and other project assets. The Binding Tripartite Term Sheet will be executed with SIXP Realty Private Limited (Landowner) and a Marketing Co-Developer.

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited has informed the Exchange about Temporary Disruption of Operations at Sanand Plants, Gujarat
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited has reported a temporary disruption of operations at its Sanand Plants in Gujarat, effective July 27, 2026, due to severe flooding caused by heavy rainfall. The disruption also affects its suppliers' facilities in and around Gujarat. The company is actively working to reinstate production operations at both supplier and company facilities. While the exact quantum of loss or damage is still being assessed, the company has an adequate insurance policy to cover floods and other natural calamities. They are confident in restoring normalcy within the next few days.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: JK Paper Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: JK Paper Limited issued a press release on July 27, 2026, detailing its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a consolidated turnover of Rs. 1,998.67 Crore, marking a 13% increase. EBITDA rose by 18% to Rs. 320.90 Crore, and Profit After Tax (PAT) saw a significant increase of 63%, reaching Rs. 136.27 Crore. The company attributed the improved performance to higher volumes and an enhanced product mix, despite a challenging paper and board market. Additionally, JK Paper announced it has acquired an additional 15.40% stake in Borkar Packaging Private Limited during the quarter. The company also commenced production of its Hardwood Bleach Chemical Thermo-Mechanical Pulp (BCTMP) Plant at Unit CPM, Gujarat, on June 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Supreme Holdings & Hospitality (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'update on Progress of Ongoing Projects'.
announcements.ai_summary: Supreme Holdings & Hospitality (India) Limited provided an update on its ongoing project, 'Belmac Infinity', located in New Panvel, Navi Mumbai. On July 27, 2026, the company received an Amended Commencement Certificate from CIDCO, permitting the construction of an additional three floors. This revision changes the project configuration from Ground + 10 Floors (G+10) to Ground + 13 Floors (G+13). The company believes these additional development rights and enhanced amenities will improve the project's value proposition and revenue potential, aligning with its long-term growth strategy. Supreme Holdings & Hospitality will continue to inform the stock exchanges of any material developments.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Supreme Petrochem Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: Supreme Petrochem Limited announced on July 27, 2026, its plan to add a new line of Polystyrene with a production capacity of 80,000 Tonnes Per Annum (TPA) at its Amdoshi Complex. This expansion is estimated to cost Rs. 325 Crores and is expected to be completed by March 2029. Upon completion, the company's total Polystyrene capacity will increase to 3,80,000 TPA from the current 3,00,000 TPA. The financing for this expansion will be through internal accruals. The rationale behind this capacity addition is the increasing demand from the appliances sector in India and potential export markets. The company also submitted its Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Wheels India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Wheels India Limited announced its financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 27, 2026. The company reported a net profit of Rs. 37 Crore, an increase from Rs. 26 Crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. Revenue for the quarter grew by 16.8% to Rs. 1,386 Crore, up from Rs. 1,187 Crore in the prior year's first quarter. Exports also saw a significant rise of 17.3%, reaching Rs. 380 Crore compared to Rs. 324 Crore in the previous year's Q1. The company's CMD, Srivats Ram, attributed the sales growth to the continued momentum in the domestic market for cars, trucks, and agricultural tractors, as well as strong growth in construction equipment wheel exports. He also noted inflationary pressures on material costs due to the West Asia crisis. The company expects this growth momentum to continue into the second quarter.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Akme Fintrade (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 25, 2026, titled "AKME Fintrade Launches Green Finance Platform, AKME GreenX   Powered by Finayo".
announcements.ai_summary: Akme Fintrade (India) Limited has issued a press release dated July 25, 2026, announcing the launch of its new Green Finance platform, "AKME GreenX – Powered by Finayo." This platform is designed to support financing for Electric Mobility and Renewable Energy. The company, an RBI-regulated NBFC, has partnered with Finayo to leverage its AI-powered digital lending platform. Over the next two years, AKME GreenX aims to build a ₹200 Crore Green Asset Portfolio, with ₹100 Crore allocated for EV Financing and ₹100 Crore for Solar & Distributed Renewable Energy Financing. The long-term goal is to build a ₹1,000 Crore EV & Solar Financing Portfolio within five years.

The company has received 25% of the issue price as upfront consideration, with the remaining 75% payable by the warrant holders within 18 months. The pre-allotment paid-up equity share capital was 23,16,97,111 shares amounting to Rs. 231,69,71,110. Post-allotment, assuming full conversion, the paid-up share capital will be 25,16,97,111 shares amounting to Rs. 251,69,71,110.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: E2E Networks Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates in relation to proceedings before the Hon ble Delhi High Court regarding stamp duty matter
announcements.ai_summary: E2E Networks Limited has provided an update regarding proceedings before the Hon'ble Delhi High Court concerning a stamp duty matter. Following an earlier disclosure on May 19, 2026, the company initiated proceedings after an order from the Collector of Stamps. The Hon'ble High Court of Delhi has now passed an interim order, directing E2E Networks Limited to deposit ₹1.25 crore with the Court's Registry within one month. This deposit will stay the operation of the Collector of Stamps' order until the next hearing date. The deposited amount will be kept in an interest-bearing Fixed Deposit Receipt. The company is complying with these directions and will continue to pursue legal remedies, keeping the stock exchanges informed of material developments.

announcements.company: Home First Finance Company India Limited
announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Home First Finance Company India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Investor Press Release on the Financial and Operational Performance of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Home First Finance Company India Limited has released its investor press release for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 27, 2026. The company reported a significant increase in Assets Under Management (AUM) to ₹16,938 crore, marking a 25.7% year-on-year growth and 6.7% quarter-on-quarter growth. Disbursements reached a record ₹1,628 crore, up 31.0% year-on-year and 3.6% quarter-on-quarter. Profit After Tax (PAT) grew by 34.5% year-on-year to ₹160 crore, with a Return on Assets (ROA) of 4.2%. Asset quality remained stable, with Gross Stage 3 (GNPA) at 1.8%. The company noted a favourable operating environment for affordable housing finance, supported by resilient customer demand.

announcements.detail: Vardhman Special Steels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Media Release on the foundation stone laying ceremony of the Forging Unit of the Company".
announcements.ai_summary: Vardhman Special Steels Limited has announced the foundation stone laying ceremony for its new state-of-the-art forging unit located at Village Mangarh, Kohara, Chandigarh Road, Ludhiana. The ceremony was attended by the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Punjab, S. Bhagwant Singh Mann Ji, highlighting the state government's support for advanced manufacturing. This new facility represents a strategic forward integration into high-value precision-forged automotive components. The company is strengthening its partnership with Aichi Steel Corporation to manufacture these components in Punjab.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Non-applicability of Corporate Governance Provisions as per SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Walpar Nutritions Limited has informed the exchange that the corporate governance provisions as specified in Regulations 17 through 27 and other related clauses of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 are not applicable to the company. This exemption applies to companies with paid-up equity share capital not exceeding ₹10 Crores and net worth not exceeding ₹25 Crores as of the last day of the previous financial year, or companies listed on the SME Exchange. As Walpar Nutritions Limited has listed its specified securities on the SME Exchange, these corporate governance provisions are not applicable for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

Makati, Managing Director of the Company''.
announcements.ai_summary: Neochem Bio Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about a disclosure received under Regulation 7(2) of the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. Makati held 93,52,475 equity shares, representing 54.63% of the total voting capital. After the purchase of 7,200 shares, his holding increased to 93,59,675 equity shares, representing 54.67% of the total voting capital. The value of this transaction was ₹6,43,020.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Goodluck India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'a press release regarding successfully Secured Quality Assurance Certificate from Directorate General of Quality Assurance (DGQA), Dept. Of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence for Supply of 155mm M107 Ready-to-Fill Artillery Shells assembled with recovery Plug by Goodluck Defence and Aerospace Limited, subsidiary of the Company'.
announcements.ai_summary: Goodluck India Limited has announced that its subsidiary, Goodluck Defence and Aerospace Limited (GDAL), has successfully obtained a Quality Assurance Certificate from the Directorate General of Quality Assurance (DGQA), Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence. This certification is for the supply of 155mm M107 Ready-to-Fill Artillery Shells assembled with a recovery plug. GDAL met the prescribed technical, operational, and quality assurance requirements, including visual examination, gauging, dimensional inspection, and dynamic testing. This certification qualifies GDAL as an approved supplier for this critical defence product to the Government of India, subject to procurement processes and tender conditions. The achievement reinforces Goodluck India's position in India's defence manufacturing sector.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited (WRTL), a subsidiary of Waaree Energies Limited, has entered into an Early Contractor Involvement (ECI) Agreement on July 27, 2026. This agreement is with a Special Purpose Vehicle of a leading global Independent Power Producer (IPP) for the development of a utility-scale solar photovoltaic (PV) project integrated with a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) in New Zealand. WRTL is undertaking this project in consortium with two experienced local companies, marking its strategic entry into the Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) renewable energy market. This is an initial engagement for preliminary work, and the Principal may sign an EPC contract with the consortium upon its completion.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Release    Economist Enterprise research, supported by HCLTech, confirms confidence in AI is high for the Telecom, Media, Semiconductor and Technology (TMT) industry, but business impact is still limited '.
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Limited has announced the release of research conducted by Economist Enterprise, supported by HCLTech. The research indicates high confidence in Artificial Intelligence (AI) within the Telecom, Media, Semiconductor, and Technology (TMT) industry, with 91% of organizations believing their AI investments are delivering results. However, only one-third of these organizations can measure the business value created by AI. The report also highlights an execution gap, with only 20% of organizations having a strategy for AI upskilling or hiring, and just 17% reporting that governance actively shapes their AI systems.

This presentation is intended for informational purposes for members and investors and is considered confidential. Recipients are not permitted to copy, reproduce, disseminate, or redistribute the information. The presentation has been prepared by the Company and has not been independently verified.

announcements.detail: BCP Topco IX Pte. Ltd, BCP Asia (SG) Mirror Holding Pte. Ltd has submitted to  the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011

The disclosures were made in compliance with Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of the SAST Regulations and the SEBI Master Circular.

announcements.subject: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
announcements.detail: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited has submitted to  the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
announcements.ai_summary: Anand Rathi IT Private Limited has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Ltd. on May 18, 2026. This disclosure pertains to the invocation of a pledge on equity shares of Anand Rathi Wealth Limited. Specifically, on May 11, 2026, Anand Rathi IT Private Limited saw the invocation of a pledge on 38,63,000 shares, representing 4.65% of the total share capital, held by Anand Rathi Financial Services Limited (ARFSL). announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Heritage Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update on Acquisition of additional 20% equity share capital of M/s. Peanutbutter and Jelly Limited'.
announcements.ai_summary: Heritage Foods Limited has successfully completed the acquisition of an additional 20% equity share capital of M/s. Peanutbutter and Jelly Limited (PBJL). The equity shares were credited to Heritage Foods Limited's demat account on July 27, 2026, marking the completion of the transaction. Following this acquisition, PBJL has now become a 71% subsidiary of Heritage Foods Limited, effective from the same date. This follows a prior intimation on July 16, 2026, regarding the approval for this acquisition.
