These documents are intended for the public shareholders of Bliss GVS Pharma Limited and are in compliance with Regulation 18(7) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011. This filing indicates a regulatory process is underway, likely related to a substantial acquisition or takeover event.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Avenue Supermarts Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Store Opening'.
announcements.ai_summary: Avenue Supermarts Limited has announced the opening of a new store located in Pratapnagar, Udaipur, Rajasthan, effective July 27, 2026. This expansion brings the company's total store count to 505 as of the reporting date. The company has duly informed both the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. regarding this development. Investors can note this as a step in the company's ongoing retail network expansion.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Vision Infra Equipment Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Vision Infra Equipment Solutions Limited has secured a significant new order amounting to Rs. 9,04,88,300/- (inclusive of all taxes) for DBM/BC Laying work and CTB/WMM Laying from an undisclosed Indian company. This order is considered domestic in nature and its execution timeline is as per agreed terms. The company has confirmed that its promoters or group companies do not have any interest in the entity awarding this order, and it does not fall within related party transactions. Further details regarding the specific terms and conditions of the contract are available in Annexure-I of the announcement.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Remsons Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015   Update on temporary disruption of operations due to flooding
announcements.ai_summary: Remsons Industries Limited has provided an update on the temporary disruption of its operations due to flooding. The water levels at the company's manufacturing facilities located in Daman have receded, and power supply and essential utilities have been restored. Consequently, the company commenced the gradual resumption of production operations at these facilities effective July 27, 2026. However, at the manufacturing facility in Pardi, Gujarat, power supply has not yet been restored, and operations remain temporarily suspended. The company is closely monitoring the situation and will provide further updates on the resumption of operations at the Pardi plant as developments occur.

announcements.subject: Product launch
announcements.detail: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015- Launch of New Products.
announcements.ai_summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has expanded its product portfolio with the launch of three new Ayurvedic pain relief patches for external application. The newly introduced products include a Back Pain Relief Patch (200 cm²), a Knee Pain Relief Patch (220 cm²), and a Pain Relief Patch (50 cm² – Pack of 30), along with a Pain Relief Patch Large (75 cm² – Pack of 10). These launches further strengthen the company's healthcare and wellness offerings. The details of these products, as required by SEBI regulations, have been annexed to the filing and will also be uploaded on the company's website, www.jeenasikho.com. The launch date for these products was July 27, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Thinking Hats Entertainment Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled " Thinking Hats Entertainment Solutions Limited Announces Revised Theatrical Release Date of "OHH MY DOG" .".
announcements.ai_summary: Thinking Hats Entertainment Solutions Limited has announced a revised theatrical release date for its upcoming feature film, "OHH MY DOG." The film, originally slated for release on July 31, 2026, has been rescheduled to August 7, 2026. This strategic decision was made to secure optimal exhibition windows and achieve wider audience reach, as most screens were occupied by other major releases. The postponement is expected to facilitate improved screen availability and strengthen the film's overall theatrical prospects. The company appreciates the continued support of its stakeholders and looks forward to the new release date.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on Nidlegy
announcements.ai_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has received an update from its partner, Philogen, regarding Nidlegy. Philogen has resubmitted the Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) for Nidlegy to the European Medicines Agency (EMA). This updated application is for the neoadjuvant treatment of locally advanced, fully resectable melanoma in adult patients. The resubmission is based on clinical data from the Phase III PIVOTAL study, with a longer median patient follow-up of 33 months compared to the previous submission in June 2024. The updated dossier includes additional post-hoc analyses focused on event-free survival and Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) information to address previous queries. The clinical data supporting this resubmission have been accepted for publication in the Journal of Clinical Oncology.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding conclusion of internal review pertaining to Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation arrangement
announcements.ai_summary: HDFC Bank Limited has announced the conclusion of its internal review concerning the arrangement with Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation (MSRDC) for garnering deposits in 2017 and 2021. The Board, in its meeting on July 23, 2026, determined that the actions of the involved employees constituted business overreach rather than malicious intent or personal gain. As a consequence, three senior employees, including the Managing Director & CEO, Chief Financial Officer, and Group Head – Retail Assets, will receive warning letters and a monetary penalty of ₹1 lakh each. Other employees involved will also receive warning letters. The Board has directed that this matter be communicated to the Reserve Bank of India. This disclosure is made for good governance, even though it does not trigger mandatory disclosure obligations under SEBI regulations.

announcements.subject: Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.detail: Manglam Infra & Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.ai_summary: Manglam Infra & Engineering Limited has received a Letter of Award (LOA) from the Office of the Chief Engineer (PW(R&B) Department), Jammu Zone, for consultancy work on an Elevated Corridor (Flyover) from Amphalla Chowk to Roop Nagar T-Junction via Janipur. The consultancy fee for this domestic project is approximately Rs. 6.51 Crores. The work is to be executed within a period of 03 Months. The company has confirmed that there is no interest from the promoter/promoter group/group companies in the entity awarding the order, and the contract will not fall within related party transactions.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Wipro partners with Databricks to Enable Enterprises to Modernize Data and Deploy AI at Scale".
announcements.ai_summary: Wipro Limited announced on July 27, 2026, an enhanced partnership with Databricks to help enterprises modernize their data foundations and accelerate AI adoption. As part of this collaboration, Wipro has established a dedicated Databricks business practice focused on building industry-specific AI-led solutions and accelerators. This initiative aims to enable clients to move from fragmented data foundations and isolated AI pilots to governed, enterprise-scale AI implementations. The partnership will integrate Databricks' capabilities in agentic AI, data modernization, and analytics with Wipro Intelligence™, Wipro's suite of AI-powered platforms. The business practice is built on over 300 agentic AI and data use cases delivered across various industries and has been recognized by Databricks for its contributions.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Senores Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a Media Release dated July 27, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Senores Pharmaceuticals Limited announced its unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 27, 2026. The company reported a Total Revenue of ₹ 180.2 Crores for Q1 FY27, a significant 35.9% increase from ₹ 132.6 Crores in Q1 FY26. This growth was driven by strong performance in Regulated Markets, which grew by 41.9% to ₹ 127.8 Crores, and Emerging Markets, which grew by 29.6% to ₹ 37.6 Crores. Profitability saw a substantial improvement, with EBITDA growing by 87% to ₹ 54 Crores and PAT increasing by 56% to ₹ 31 Crores, accompanied by an EBITDA margin expansion of approximately 800 basis points. The company also expanded its product portfolio, with approved ANDAs in Regulated Markets nearly doubling from 30 in June 2025 to 58 in June 2026, of which 23 have been commercialized.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited has entered into an agreement with Daimler India Commercial Vehicles Private Limited (DICV) on July 27, 2026. Under this agreement, Zaggle will provide its Zaggle Zatix & Corporate Credit Card Program to DICV for their fleet partners. This is a domestic order with a tenure of 3 years. The commercial consideration is proportional to the number of fleet partners and drivers onboarded by Zaggle and the spends at Authorized DICV touchpoints during the agreement tenure, making it difficult to ascertain the exact value at this stage. There is no disclosed interest from promoters or group companies in DICV, and the transaction is not considered a related party transaction.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Nelcast Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Nelcast Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 27, 2026. The company reported Total Revenue of Rs. 345.4 Crores for Q1 FY27, a 2.8% increase compared to Rs. 336.0 Crores in Q1 FY26. However, EBITDA decreased by 37.9% to Rs. 20.1 Crores from Rs. 32.4 Crores in the prior year's quarter, with the EBITDA Margin declining to 5.8% from 9.6%. The company attributed the profitability impact to elevated raw material costs and labor availability constraints. Nelcast is initiating price revision discussions with customers and expects new product production to commence in Q2 FY27, contributing meaningfully to volumes and revenues in the second half of the year.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Nitco Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Nitco Limited has provided a clarification regarding a previous disclosure made on July 23, 2026, concerning an order from the Pollution Control Committee, Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. The company was directed to pay Environmental Compensation of ₹14,25,000/- for alleged non-compliance with environmental standards. Nitco Limited has confirmed that this compensation was duly paid on April 28, 2026. The company clarified that the initial delay in disclosure was due to its interpretation that such orders were not subject to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. However, after further review and consultation, it was determined that disclosure was indeed required for orders issued by the Pollution Control Committee.

announcements.subject: Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.detail: Arabian Petroleum Limited has informed the Exchange about Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.ai_summary: Arabian Petroleum Limited has been awarded a significant purchase order aggregating to approximately INR 5 Crore for the Supply of Additive at the HPCL Lube Plant by Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd. This domestic order signifies a key development for the company in securing business with a major public sector undertaking. The terms of the contract involve the supply of additives, and the broad consideration for this order is approximately INR 5 Crore. The company has confirmed that neither the promoter, promoter group, nor any group companies have any interest in Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd., and the transaction is conducted at arm's length.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Raj Oil Mills Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 27, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Raj Oil Mills Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on July 27, 2026. The Board approved a change in the company's name from "Raj Oil Mills Limited" to "Raj Industries Limited," subject to approval from the Central Registration Centre (CRC), Ministry of Corporate Affairs, and other relevant authorities, as well as shareholder approval in a General Meeting. Furthermore, the Board approved the allotment of 10,00,000 equity shares of face value Rs. 10/- each at an issue price of Rs. 46/- per share, including a premium of Rs. 36/-, for an aggregate amount of Rs. 4,60,00,000/-. Additionally, 10,00,000 Warrants, each convertible into one fully paid-up equity share of face value Rs. 10/-, were approved for allotment at a price of Rs. 46/- per Warrant, including a premium of Rs. 36/-. An upfront payment of Rs. 1,15,00,000/- has been received, representing 25% of the issue price per Warrant. These Warrants are convertible within 18 months from the allotment date.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, it is hereby informed that IndiaMART InterMESH Limited (hereinafter referred as  Company ) has entered into an agreement to subscribe to 4,630 Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) of Fleetx Technologies Private Limited (hereinafter referred as  Fleetx )
announcements.ai_summary: IndiaMART InterMESH Limited has entered into an agreement to subscribe to 4,630 Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) of Fleetx Technologies Private Limited, an AI-powered fleet and logistics optimization platform. This investment is part of IndiaMART's long-term objective to offer various Software as a Service (SAAS) based solutions for businesses. Fleetx reported a turnover of Rs. 77.80 Crores for the financial year ended March 31, 2025. The acquisition is considered a related party transaction as Fleetx is an Associate Company, but the promoter and promoter group have no interest in this investment. IndiaMART intends to invest up to Rs. 64,98,76,060 (Sixty-Four Crores Ninety-Eight Lakh Seventy-Six Thousand) in cash consideration. The acquisition is expected to be completed within 30 days, and no governmental or regulatory approvals are required.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Business Update for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 - Aimtron Electronics quarterly reportreflects strong and sustained Business Momentum
announcements.ai_summary: Aimtron Electronics Limited has reported a strong business update for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, showcasing significant year-on-year revenue growth of 94%, reaching INR 840.1 Mn compared to INR 433.0 Mn in the same quarter of the previous year. This robust performance was driven by increased customer demand across various high-growth sectors including Industrial Electronics, Power & Energy, and Medical Technology. The company also boasts a healthy consolidated unexecuted order book of approximately INR 6,040 Mn as of June 30, 2026, which is about 2.0 times its FY26 revenue. Additionally, AIC's unexecuted order book saw a year-on-year increase of approximately 36% to USD 9.81 Mn, indicating sustained demand in international markets. The company's strategic focus on high-value manufacturing and innovation continues to strengthen its position as a trusted ESDM partner.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Om Freight Forwarders Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.ai_summary: Om Freight Forwarders Limited has announced the commencement of commercial operations at its newly expanded warehouse facility located at Mauje Sarade, Taluka Uran, District Raigad, Maharashtra. This development follows their earlier communication on May 08, 2026, regarding capacity addition. The commencement of operations at this state-of-the-art warehouse is a significant milestone in the company's infrastructure expansion strategy, aiming to strengthen its integrated logistics and warehousing capabilities. The expanded facility will enable the company to offer comprehensive supply chain solutions, including Fourth Party Logistics (4PL) services in addition to its existing Third Party Logistics (3PL) services, catering to evolving market demands from domestic and international customers.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Opening of New Branch
announcements.ai_summary: The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about the opening of a new branch. The new branch is located at Gachibowli Road, Kondapur, Hyderabad, specifically on the ground floor, Plot Numbers 136 & 137, Prashant Nagar, 8th Battalion Road, Hyderabad - 500084. The branch commenced its commercial operations on 27th July 2026. This information is being hosted on the bank's website, www.southindianbank.bank.in, for public record.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited (L&T) has secured a "Major" order for its Residential, Commercial Buildings & Factories (RCF) business vertical. The order is for a large-scale housing redevelopment project in Mumbai from a reputed client. The scope of work involves the design and construction of 26 high-rise residential towers, each reaching 120 metres, on a turnkey basis. This includes structural works, architectural finishes, and electromechanical services. L&T will utilize its precast construction technology for enhanced quality, productivity, and speed. The company classifies this order as "Major," which typically falls within the value range of INR 5,000 Crore to INR 10,000 Crore, as per their internal classification system.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: TechD Cybersecurity Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: TechD Cybersecurity Limited has announced the receipt of multiple purchase orders, letters of intent, and email confirmations from direct customers and channel partners, aggregating to approximately INR 2.91 Crore (INR 2,91,28,300/- inclusive of GST). These orders were received on 27 July 2026. Key orders include consulting, implementation, and certification for an ISO/IEC 42001 AI Management System for a Leading Stock Exchange and its group company, valued at INR 41,30,000 and INR 29,50,000 respectively. Additionally, the company secured orders for Next-Gen SIEM Platform, EDR Platform & Managed SOC Services for a FoodTech SaaS Company (INR 24,19,000) and a Pharmaceutical/Lifesciences Company (INR 19,76,500). Other contracts include an MSSP engagement for an Engineering & Construction Company (INR 25,48,800), Privileged Access Management (PAM) Support Services for a Global Technology Services Company (INR 76,70,000), and Network Security Platform Support Services for a Customer Experience/IT-enabled Services Company (INR 74,34,000).

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: SBC Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts from Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology through (NICSI). for an amount of Rs. 52,19,862/-
announcements.ai_summary: SBC Exports Limited has been awarded a work order by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology through NICSI for providing Manpower supply. The total value of this work order is INR ₹ 52,19,862/-. The empanelment is for NICSI/NIC internal requirements and projects, with payments to be made on a monthly basis based on services rendered. The company is obligated to ensure timely payment of entitlements to deployed manpower, including salaries, EPF, ESI, and other benefits, and submit proof to NICSI. This is a domestic order with a six-month execution period, and it is not a related party transaction. The order was allotted on July 27, 2026.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: United Heat Transfer Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: United Heat Transfer Limited has received a purchase order from Ingersoll-Rand (India) Limited for the manufacturing and supply of a Separator and Cooler. The approximate value of this order is Rs. 50,47,568/-, excluding tax. The terms of the order include payment within Net 45 days, and the delivery is scheduled to be completed by October 20, 2026. This is a domestic order, and it does not constitute a related party transaction. The company's Chairman & Managing Director, Mr. Yogesh Vishwanath Patil, has confirmed the receipt of this order.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Mold-Tek Packaging Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Mold-Tek Packaging Limited has announced its financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a significant increase in Net Sales by 26.32% on a Q1-on-Q4 basis, reaching Rs. 300.45 crores, up from Rs. 240.56 crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. Net Profit (PAT) also surged by 23.89% Q1-on-Q4, and by 14.15% year-on-year to Rs. 25.57 crores, compared to Rs. 22.40 crores in Q1 FY 2025-26. EBITDA grew by 17.31% Q1-on-Q4 and by 19.10% year-on-year to Rs. 56.43 crores. Sales Volume increased by 5.82% Q1-on-Q4 and by 6.25% year-on-year, reaching 12,089 MT. Profit Before Tax (PBT) increased by 13.86% year-on-year to Rs. 34.17 crores.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Crizac Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Crizac Limited, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Crizac Ltd, has successfully acquired 100% of the equity share capital of Inova Consultancy Limited. Inova Consultancy Limited is a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 1985, and reported a turnover of £442,360 for the year ended March 31, 2026, and £386,514 for the year ended March 31, 2025. This acquisition does not fall under the purview of related party transactions, and the promoter, promoter group, or group companies of Crizac Limited have no interest in Inova Consultancy Limited. The transaction details are provided as per SEBI Listing Regulations and the relevant SEBI Master Circular.

announcements.subject: Adoption of new line(s) of business
announcements.detail: Epigral Limited has informed the Exchange about Adoption of new line(s) of business
announcements.ai_summary: Epigral Limited is undertaking a strategic expansion by establishing a new manufacturing facility at its existing Dahej, Gujarat site. This facility will focus on producing Epoxy Resin & Formulations and will also house a Multi-Purpose Plant (MPP). The company plans to achieve a capacity of 1,25,000 TPA for Epoxy Resin & Formulations. The investment required for this expansion is estimated at Rs. 600 Cr. This capital expenditure will be financed through a mix of debt and internal accruals. The rationale behind this expansion is to broaden the company's product portfolio and cater to the increasing market demand. The proposed capacity is expected to be added by the second half of FY2028.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Hind Rectifiers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Hirect secures maiden MEMU Trainset order, marking entry into next-generation Rail Systems".
announcements.ai_summary: Hind Rectifiers Limited (HIRECT) has announced securing its maiden order for Mainline Electric Multiple Unit (MEMU) trainsets from MCF. This development order, valued at approximately ₹60 crore, signifies HIRECT's strategic shift from a component manufacturer to a provider of integrated railway systems. The order entails the supply of complete Propulsion Systems for 4 MEMU trainsets, which includes Traction Transformers, Traction Motors, and the complete Propulsion System with TCMS (Train Control and Management System). The execution of this order is projected to span 24 months. HIRECT's entry into the MEMU trainset segment represents a key expansion into next-generation trainsets beyond its traditional locomotive applications. Successful completion of this project is anticipated to enhance HIRECT's credentials for future, larger system-level opportunities within the expanding trainset market.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Hind Rectifiers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Hirect Secures First Vande Metro Development Order, Expands Presence in Next Generation Trainset Applications. ".
announcements.ai_summary: Hind Rectifiers Limited (HIRECT) has secured a significant development order for the Vande Metro (Namo Bharat) trainset from Rail Coach Factory (RCF), Kapurthala. This order, valued at approximately ₹60 crores, marks HIRECT's expansion into next-generation trainset applications. The scope of work includes the Design, Development, Manufacture, Supply, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning of an IGBT-based 3-phase propulsion system, Traction Transformers, Traction Motors, TCMS, and other associated equipment. The order also includes a comprehensive annual maintenance contract for the entire system. Execution of this order is expected to take 21 months, allowing HIRECT to showcase its indigenously developed propulsion solutions on an advanced Indian Railways platform. This achievement underscores the company's growing R&D capabilities in delivering high-value propulsion solutions for modern rolling stock.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Incorporation of wholly owned Subsidiary of PFC Consulting Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of Power Finance Corporation Limited)- (i) KUSHTAGI TRANSMISSION LIMITED
announcements.ai_summary: Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC) has announced the incorporation of a new wholly-owned subsidiary, Kushtagi Transmission Limited. This Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) has been incorporated by PFC Consulting Limited (PFCCL), which is itself a wholly-owned subsidiary of PFC. Kushtagi Transmission Limited will be involved in the transmission system for 765kV Kushtagi-III Koppal District. PFCCL was nominated as the Bid Process Coordinator by the Ministry of Power for this project. The SPV will undertake preparatory activities such as surveys, land acquisition initiation, and forest clearance processes before being transferred to the successful bidder selected through competitive bidding. The incorporation aligns with approvals received from the State Empowered Committee on Transmission and the Energy Department.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Baheti Recycling Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Submission of Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Baheti Recycling Industries Limited has submitted a press release dated July 27, 2026, detailing its strong performance in the first quarter of FY27. The company reported a significant 88.90% year-on-year growth in net total revenue, reaching ₹253.94 crore compared to ₹134.43 crore in Q1 FY26. Key segments contributing to this growth include Alloy Ingots, which generated ₹149.27 crore in revenue, and De-Ox, with revenue of ₹63.87 crore. The company also recorded ₹4.72 crore in revenue from Copper Alloy Ingots, marking a new addition to its value-added product portfolio. Management expressed satisfaction with the healthy growth across core business segments and the efficient execution driving the results.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Canara Bank has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure of Security Cover Certificate for the Quarter Ended June 30, 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: Canara Bank has submitted the Security Cover Certificate for the Quarter Ended June 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges on July 27, 2026. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 54 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The certificate, submitted by M/s K Venkatachalam Aiyer & Co., one of the Statutory Central Auditors, confirms the security cover and covenants in respect of the bank's listed secured non-convertible debt securities. The document details various listed Non-Convertible Debt Securities issued by the bank, including their ISIN, facility, date of allotment, nature of charge, sanctioned amount, outstanding amount, and required cover assets, as of June 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Patel Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Press Release with respect to opening of Patel s R Mart Store no.53.".
announcements.ai_summary: Patel Retail Limited announced the opening of its 53rd retail store, "Patel's R Mart Store no.53," on July 27, 2026. The new store is located at Karanja Road, Uran, Raigad, further expanding the company's retail footprint in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. This expansion aligns with Patel Retail's strategy to increase its presence in suburban and emerging urban markets, providing customers with convenient access to groceries and daily essentials. The opening of this 53rd store underscores the company's commitment to expanding its retail network in key markets and strengthening its position as a trusted neighbourhood retail destination. Patel Retail Limited is a diversified retail and food processing company with operations across the MMRDA region.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Indian Phosphate Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Phosphate Limited has submitted a Business Update for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. on July 27, 2026. For Q1 FY27, the company reported a standalone revenue growth of 87% year-on-year and a consolidated revenue growth of 81% year-on-year. This growth was driven by strong performance across its Chemicals and Fertilizers business. The company operates integrated manufacturing facilities in Rajasthan and Tamil Nadu and has strengthened its value chain through captive Sulphuric Acid manufacturing. Indian Phosphate Limited maintains a diversified product portfolio and has expanded its distribution network across 14+ states in India. The update also mentions continued focus on backward integration initiatives, including rock phosphate mining and proposed specialty chemical expansion.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tata Elxsi Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "SCTIMST and Tata Elxsi Forge Strategic Partnership to Accelerate Healthcare Innovation and Medical Technology Development".
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Elxsi Limited has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST) on July 27, 2026. This strategic partnership aims to accelerate healthcare innovation and medical technology development by combining SCTIMST's clinical and research expertise with Tata Elxsi's advanced engineering and digital technology capabilities. The collaboration will focus on developing next-generation healthcare solutions for both India and global markets, addressing areas such as diagnostics, medical imaging, digital health, and biomedical engineering. This initiative creates an extended innovation and engineering environment, enabling MedTech companies to develop, validate, and scale new products more efficiently within a collaborative ecosystem. The disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Rhetan TMT Limited has informed the Exchange about Captive Solar Power Project Update
announcements.ai_summary: Rhetan TMT Limited has announced the completion of its 1 MW (AC) captive ground-mounted solar power project. The project has successfully cleared all key regulatory and execution milestones, including final registration from the Gujarat Energy Development Agency (GEDA) and permission from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for cable laying. The installation is complete, and testing and commissioning are underway. Power generation is expected to commence by the end of the first week of August 2026. This project positions Rhetan TMT at the intersection of India's clean energy transition and the steel industry's growth cycle, driven by infrastructure spending. By generating its own green energy, the company aims to convert a volatile input cost into a stable, self-owned asset, contributing to cost leadership in steel manufacturing. This update follows an earlier communication dated February 15, 2025, and was announced on July 27, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Rhetan TMT Limited has informed the Exchange about Higher Grade Products Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Rhetan TMT Limited has achieved a significant milestone by securing Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification for its premium, high-strength TMT grades: Fe500D, Fe550, and Fe550D. This certification makes the company eligible to supply its products to government and Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) infrastructure projects across India, opening up a new and substantial addressable market. Previously, the company was limited to manufacturing Fe500 grade TMT bars. With this development, Rhetan TMT now offers a complete portfolio of high-strength TMT products, catering to diverse construction needs from individual housing to heavy infrastructure. The BIS certification for higher grades involves stringent testing, distinguishing the company and enhancing its value-added product mix. This update was announced on July 27, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: RattanIndia Power Limited has informed the Exchange about release of Non Disposal Undertaking (NDU) on the shares of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: RattanIndia Power Limited has announced the release of a Non-Disposal Undertaking (NDU) on a significant portion of its promoter's shareholding. An aggregate of 209,75,98,310 equity shares, representing 88.65% of the promoters' holding, have been released from the NDU. These shares were initially placed under the NDU in favor of Vistra ITCL (India) Limited, acting as Security Trustee for Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited, to secure a working capital facility of Rs. 550 crore availed by the company. Following this release, the entire promoter shareholding of 236,61,03,603 equity shares, which constitutes 44.06% of the company's equity share capital, is now free from all encumbrances. This development was effective as of July 27, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Ashok Leyland Limited has informed the Exchange that Ashok Leyland John Deere Construction Equipment Company Private Limited (ALJD), an associate of the Company, has been voluntarily liquidated
announcements.ai_summary: Ashok Leyland Limited has announced the voluntary liquidation of its associate company, Ashok Leyland John Deere Construction Equipment Company Private Limited (ALJD). ALJD has been undergoing a liquidation process with the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) for several years. The company has now received the final dissolution order, marking the completion of its liquidation. Consequently, ALJD has ceased to be an associate of Ashok Leyland Limited. There are no disclosed benefits to the promoter, promoter group, or group companies from this liquidation, and there is no change in the shareholding pattern of any entities. The event occurred on July 26, 2026.

announcements.subject: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
announcements.detail: DCM Shriram International Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 10 (5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.ai_summary: Alok Bansidhar Shriram has submitted a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for the proposed acquisition of shares in DCM Shriram International Limited from Mr. Madhav Bansidhar Shriram, Mrs. Urvashi Tilakdhar, and Lala Bansi Dhar & Sons (HUF). The proposed acquisition date is July 31, 2026, and the transaction is an inter-family gift. Specifically, 8,941,864 equity shares (10.28%) will be acquired from Mr. Madhav Bansidhar Shriram, 8,942,142 equity shares (10.28%) from Mrs. Urvashi Tilakdhar, and 9,021,200 equity shares (10.37%) from Lala Bansi Dhar & Sons (HUF). This acquisition represents a total of 30.92% of the target company's share capital. The acquisition is exempted from making an open offer under Regulation 10(1)(a)(i) as it is a gift among immediate relatives. The shares are being acquired at a price of ₹67.62 per share, which is the volume-weighted average market price for the preceding 60 trading days.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Affle 3i Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment of equity shares under Affle (India) Limited Employee Stock Option Scheme, 2021'.
announcements.ai_summary: Affle 3i Limited has informed the stock exchanges about the allotment of 83,000 equity shares of face value Rs. 2 each on July 25, 2026. These shares were allotted to the Affle (India) Limited Employees’ Welfare Trust under the Affle (India) Limited Employee Stock Option Scheme – 2021. Following this allotment, the company's issued, subscribed, and paid-up share capital has increased to Rs. 281,758,768/-, comprising 140,879,384 equity shares of Rs. 2 each. The company is in the process of applying for the listing of these newly allotted shares on the NSE and BSE. Affle 3i Limited clarified that this allotment is not material in nature to the company.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Jamna Auto Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 24, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Jamna Auto Industries Limited announced on July 24, 2026, that its Board of Directors has approved the acquisition of the entire issued share capital of Owen Springs Limited, a company incorporated in England and Wales. The acquisition will be from OSL Group Holdings Limited, the existing shareholder. This transaction is subject to the fulfillment of certain conditions precedent and other completion formalities as outlined in the Share Purchase Agreement and applicable laws. Owen Springs Limited reported revenue of £2,761 thousands for the calendar year ended December 31, 2025, and operates in the manufacturing and trading of leaf/parabolic springs and allied products. The acquisition is not a related party transaction.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: LTM Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "LTM and Cognition Partner to Reduce Cyber Risk in Financial Services with Devin".
announcements.ai_summary: LTM Limited has issued a press release on July 27, 2026, announcing a strategic partnership with Cognition, the AI lab behind Devin. This collaboration aims to reduce cyber risk in the financial services sector by integrating Devin, Cognition's Autonomous AI Engineer, into LTM's BlueVerseTM RightLogic framework. BlueVerse RightLogic is designed to help enterprises identify, assess, and remediate cyber exposures as they accelerate AI adoption. The partnership will focus on the financial services sector, where Devin has demonstrated significant capabilities and LTM possesses deep expertise. The initiative seeks to address the growing gap between innovation and cyber risk visibility in financial institutions by autonomously identifying, prioritizing, and remediating vulnerabilities across banking infrastructure, applications, AI systems, and software supply chains. The service aims to increase Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) backlog coverage from approximately 60% to 80%, ensuring the uninterrupted operation of mission-critical financial services.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 25, 2026, titled "Press release for the declaration of result for the quarter ended on 30th June 2026.".
announcements.ai_summary: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited announced its financial results for the First Quarter of FY27, ending June 30, 2026, following its Board of Directors' meeting on July 24, 2026. The company reported a strong performance with revenue from operations growing by 18.9% year-on-year to ₹314.64 Crore and Profit After Tax (PAT) increasing by 22.0% year-on-year to ₹18.24 Crore. EBITDA also saw a significant rise of 31.7% year-on-year to ₹35.98 Crore, with an EBITDA margin of 11.43%. The company's Copper Clad Laminate (CCL) project is approximately 60% complete and is on track for commercial production in November 2026, which is expected to contribute significantly to future growth. Additionally, the company received in-principle approvals from NSE and BSE for a proposed Rights Issue of up to ₹330 Crore to support future expansion.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Energy in Motion partners with HPCL to set-up charging and battery swapping infrastructure at retail outlets across India for deployment of Electric Heavy Commercial Vehicles
announcements.ai_summary: Ravindra Energy Limited's associate company, Energy In Motion Limited (EIM), has entered into an agreement with Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) to establish and operate fast charging and battery swapping infrastructure for electric heavy commercial vehicles. This infrastructure will be deployed at select HPCL retail outlets across India, leveraging HPCL's extensive network of over 25,000 retail outlets. EIM will manage the battery inventory and swap-and-charge hardware, while HPCL will provide the necessary space and utilities. The initial phase will focus on establishing swap-cum-charge hubs on key freight corridors, including Mumbai–Pune, Delhi–Jaipur, and Chennai–Bangalore, over the next 18 to 24 months, with progressive expansion thereafter. This partnership aims to accelerate the rollout of charging capacity by combining EIM's electric vehicle expertise with HPCL's established retail network.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Welspun Corp Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Welspun Corp Limited has announced that its consolidated global order book has crossed Rs. 25,750 Crore, reaching its strongest point in the company's history. This milestone has been reinforced by a new order valued at approximately Rs. 960 Crore for the supply of Coated Line Pipes. This order will be fulfilled from the company's manufacturing facility located in Little Rock, USA. The entire order book, including this new contract, is scheduled for execution over FY27 and FY28, providing robust revenue visibility and ensuring high capacity utilization across its manufacturing assets in both India and the USA. This expansion underscores Welspun Corp's growing presence in the global pipeline infrastructure market.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 27, 2026, titled "Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015 - Press Release -  Sigma Advanced Systems Secures USD 104.9 Million (roughly INR 1,013 Cr.) Export Order for Next-generation Extended Range 155mm Base Bleed Artillery Shells".
announcements.ai_summary: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited has secured a significant export order valued at USD 104.9 million, which is approximately INR 1,013 Crore, from a North American customer. This order is for the manufacture and supply of 147,000 units of next-generation Extended Range 155mm Base Bleed Artillery Shells. The execution of this order is expected to take place over the next 6 to 12 months. This new contract strengthens Sigma's position in the global defense manufacturing supply chain and is anticipated to contribute to incremental revenue and EBITDA margins. The company is moving up the value chain by manufacturing technologically advanced shells that integrate aerodynamics, energetics, and propulsion-related technologies, enhancing the effective range of artillery systems.

The options were granted at a price of Rs. 425 per option. These options will have a vesting period of a minimum of one year from the grant date and can be exercised within two years from each vesting date.

This product launch occurred on April 27, 2026, at 5:00 P.M. and caters to the domestic market. The new models are Digitrac PP41i, Digitrac PP43i Plus, and Digitrac PP46i (4WD). announcements.detail: Jindal Saw Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: In a Board meeting held on April 27, 2026, Jindal Saw Limited approved the establishment of an additional plant in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) for LSAW (Longitudinal Submerged Arc Welded) pipe facilities. The launch took place on June 26, 2026, in Madhya Pradesh, marking the company's entry into this rapidly growing market segment. announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Bajaj Healthcare Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'The Company has received a recommendation from SEC-CDSCO to manufacture and market Cenobamate Tablets'.
announcements.ai_summary:
Bajaj Healthcare Limited announced on June 26, 2026, that it has received a recommendation from the Subject Expert Committee (SEC) of the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) to manufacture and market Cenobamate Tablets. The recommendation covers strengths of 12.5mg, 25mg, 50mg, 100mg, 150mg, and 200mg. This makes Bajaj Healthcare the first company in India to secure the SEC recommendation for Cenobamate Tablets, which is a next-generation antiseizure medication for partial-onset seizures in adults. Mr. Anil Jain, Managing Director, stated this approval is a significant regulatory milestone, reinforcing the company's commitment to expanding its portfolio of differentiated CNS therapies. The company will now work closely with regulatory authorities to obtain the necessary approvals for manufacturing and commercialization of the product.

announcements.detail: Neogen Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 26, 2026, titled "Neogen Chemicals reports strong financial performance   Revenue at INR 250 crore, higher by 34% Y-o-Y  PAT at INR 17 crore, an increase of 67% Y-o-Y".
announcements.ai_summary: Neogen Chemicals Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 26, 2026. The company reported a consolidated revenue of INR 250 crore, marking a 34% year-on-year increase, and a profit after tax (PAT) of INR 17 crore, which is a 67% increase year-on-year. This strong performance was achieved despite a temporary shutdown of its Dahej plant, driven by efficient management of toll manufacturing sites and higher volumes for key product lines, including its Organolithium Portfolio. Consolidated EBITDA stood at INR 48 crore, up 53% year-on-year, with cost pass-throughs implemented for raw material and input costs. The company's PAT trajectory was moderated by higher finance costs, up 64% year-on-year, due to increased debt drawdown for CAPEX and higher working capital intensity. The press release is available on the company's website and the stock exchanges.

announcements.subject: General Updates

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Sula Vineyards Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated March 25, 2026, titled "Sula Vineyards (NSE: SULA) Signs a Definitive Agreement to Acquire Chandon s World-Class Wine Estate Spanning 19 Acres in Nashik to Expand its Wine Tourism Footprint".
announcements.ai_summary: Sula Vineyards Limited has announced the signing of a definitive agreement to acquire Chandon's wine production estate, which spans 19 acres in Nashik. This acquisition is aimed at expanding Sula Vineyards' wine tourism footprint. The press release, dated March 25, 2026, details this strategic move by India's largest wine producer to enhance its presence in the wine tourism sector.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Dredging Corporation of India Limited has informed the Exchange about extension of charge of Dr. Madhaiyaan Angamuthu, IAS as Chairman (Additional Charge), Visakhapatnam Port Authority
announcements.ai_summary: Dredging Corporation of India Limited has been informed about the extension of the additional charge of Dr. Madhaiyaan Angamuthu, IAS, as Chairman of the Visakhapatnam Port Authority. This extension is in line with previous communications and follows a letter from the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways dated March 17, 2026. Dr. Angamuthu, who is also the Chairperson of Mumbai Port Authority, was initially entrusted with this additional charge from September 22, 2025, for six months or until a regular Chairperson is appointed.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Jet Freight Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation on the Participation of Jet Freight Logistics Limited (the  Company ) in India International Cargo Show 2026 ( IICS 2026 )
announcements.ai_summary: Jet Freight Logistics Limited announced its participation in the India International Cargo Show 2026 (IICS 2026), scheduled from June 03, 2026, to June 05, 2026, at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. This participation aims to showcase the company's logistics capabilities across air, ocean, road, and cold chain services. The event is expected to facilitate engagement with key stakeholders, exploration of strategic partnerships, and identification of new business opportunities, aligning with the company's growth objectives.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
announcements.ai_summary: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has informed the exchange about a significant legal development. The company had filed appeals before the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India against various show cause notices and orders related to the period from 1996 to 2005. On March 24, 2026, the Hon'ble Supreme Court set aside the impugned orders-in-original dated January 27, 2010, and February 04, 2010, as well as the order passed by the Customs Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal (CESTAT).

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: Sula Vineyards Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
announcements.ai_summary: Sula Vineyards Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, Artisan Spirits Private Limited (ASPL), approved the purchase of identified assets from Moët Hennessy India Private Limited (MHIP) on March 25, 2026. The assets include land, buildings, plant, and machinery forming the estate of Domaine Chandon India in Dindori, Nashik. The consideration for this asset purchase is Rs. 20 Crores, excluding inventory, taxes, and other statutory levies. ASPL has entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement (APA) with MHIP, which is subject to the satisfaction of closing conditions and completion of closing deliverables.

announcements.detail: Bartronics India Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited (formerly Bartronics India Limited) has received a Purchase Order from Indian Overseas Bank. The order is for empanelment as a Corporate Business Correspondent Service Provider, focusing on the engagement and management of Business Correspondent Agents (BCAs) under Financial Inclusion Technology. This disclosure is made pursuant to Schedule III (Part A) of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The significant terms and conditions of the order are provided in Annexure A.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Crown Lifters Limited has informed the Exchange about  Acquisition of 800 MT Crawler Crane
announcements.ai_summary: Crown Lifters Limited has successfully completed the acquisition of an 800 MT crawler crane in March 2026, which has since been deployed at a project site. This acquisition, valued at approximately ₹18 crore, contributes to the company's total capital expenditure of around ₹50 crore for the financial year 2025–26. The addition of this high-capacity crane significantly enhances Crown Lifters' capabilities in executing complex projects across sectors such as Renewable Energy, Refineries, Cement, Steel, and Infrastructure, including High-Speed Rail projects. This follows an earlier disclosure on February 12, 2026, regarding the proposed acquisition.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Power & Instrumentation (Gujarat) Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Power & Instrumentation (Gujarat) Limited has secured an additional work order worth Rs. 11,72,16,053/- from M/s Ajmer Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited. This order is for the supply, erection, installation, testing, and commissioning of materials and equipment for distribution infrastructure development. The project focuses on the on-grid electrification of unelectrified households and public institutions across nine circles in tribal villages of Ajmer Discom. These works are part of the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyana (DA-JGUA) under the RDSS scheme, to be executed on a turnkey basis. The company had previously intimated about orders on August 11, 2025.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: PG Electroplast Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: PG Electroplast Limited (PGEL) has addressed constraints faced due to geopolitical tensions impacting LPG gas supplies, which had affected Room AC production. The company, on March 25, 2026, informed stakeholders that it has successfully identified and installed alternative energy sources at its production facilities. This measure has largely normalized current Room AC production and mitigated LPG challenges for the time being. PGEL had previously communicated these constraints on March 09, 2025. The company continues to assess the situation and explore further solutions.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts

The contract is for the "Balance work of new bridge on Gandak river including approaches and rehabilitation of the existing Gandak Bridge and Mahi Bridge of Chappara -Hajipur section of NH-19 in the state of Bihar on EPC mode". This order is in the ordinary course of RKEC Projects Limited's business. The announcement was made on March 24, 2026.

The offer price is set at Rs. 285.00 per Equity Share, which represents a discount of Rs. 5.35 (1.84%) to the floor price of Rs. 290.35. The Equity Shares have a face value of Rs. 2 each, with a premium of Rs. 283.00 per share. The placement is being conducted under SEBI ICDR Regulations and relevant sections of the Companies Act, 2013. The Placement Document dated June 25, 2026, will be filed with the stock exchanges.

This redemption is in reference to the company's intimation dated June 23, 2023.

This transaction ensures the company's full control over its UAE-based subsidiary.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release being made for publication dated Jun 25, 2026, titled "Cholamandalam Investment recognised in 2025 Burgundy Private Hurun India 500 list".

The financial services arm of the Murugappa Group has a diversified portfolio including vehicle finance, loan against property, home loans, and investment advisory services.

Consequently, the Memorandum of Association will be altered, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.

This sale represents 27.89% of ORPL's paid-up equity share capital, and following this transaction, ORPL will no longer be an associate of CHL or CIE Automotive India Limited. The divestment was executed on June 25, 2026, for a total consideration of Rs. 1,62,00,000 (Rupees One Crore Sixty-Two Lakh Only) to CSE Development (India) Private Limited. announcements.subject: Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Astral Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.ai_summary: Astral Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on June 25, 2026, approved a Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving Astral Limited, Astral Chemie Limited (formerly Astral Coatings Private Limited), and Al-Aziz Plastics Private Limited. The Scheme entails two primary actions: first, the demerger and transfer of the Chemicals Business Undertaking, including all related assets and liabilities, from Astral Limited to Astral Chemie Limited on a going concern basis. Second, it provides for the amalgamation of Al-Aziz Plastics Private Limited into Astral Limited, leading to the subsequent dissolution of Al-Aziz Plastics Private Limited. This Composite Scheme is subject to obtaining necessary approvals from the National Company Law Tribunal (Ahmedabad Bench), SEBI, the National Stock Exchange of India Limited, BSE Limited, and the respective shareholders and creditors.

announcements.subject: Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: RPSG VENTURES LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.ai_summary: RPSG Ventures Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on June 25, 2026, approved a Composite Scheme of Arrangement under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. This scheme primarily involves two key components: first, the amalgamation of Woodlands Multispeciality Hospital Limited (WMHL) with RPSG Ventures Limited. Second, it includes the transfer and vesting of the Hospital & Nursing Undertaking from RPSG Ventures Limited into its wholly-owned subsidiary, Clarionix Healthcare Private Limited (RPSG WOS), on a slump sale basis. The implementation of this Scheme is contingent upon receiving requisite approvals from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), stock exchanges, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), and the respective shareholders and creditors.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: RPSG VENTURES LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 25, 2026 for approval of Acquisition and Composite Scheme of Arrangement.
announcements.ai_summary: RPSG Ventures Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on June 25, 2026, approved the acquisition of 100% of the equity shareholding of Clarionix Healthcare Private Limited (CIN: U86100WB2026PTC288277). Effective June 25, 2026, Clarionix Healthcare Private Limited has become a wholly-owned subsidiary of RPSG Ventures Limited. This acquisition was part of a broader agenda that also included the approval of a composite scheme of arrangement.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited announced on June 25, 2026, the completion of its initial investment of Rs. 52 lakhs to acquire a 26% equity share capital stake in Swarnaakshu Solar Power Private Limited (Swarnaakshu). Concurrently, the company also executed a power purchase agreement with Swarnaakshu to procure solar power for its captive consumption. This transaction is part of a previously disclosed plan to invest up to Rs. 10.40 crores for a 26% stake in Swarnaakshu, aimed at utilizing solar power under the Government of Telangana's captive power policy. The remaining investment will be disbursed over time, contingent on the solar project's advancement and Swarnaakshu's funding needs.

announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities
announcements.detail: Rainbow Childrens Medicare Limited has informed the Exchange about allotment of equity shares
announcements.ai_summary: Rainbow Childrens Medicare Limited's Nomination & Remuneration Committee, through a circular resolution passed on June 25, 2026, approved the allotment of 7,483 fully paid-up Equity Shares. These shares, each with a face value of Rs. 10/-, were allotted to one eligible employee following the exercise of vested stock units under the "Rainbow Children’s Medicare Limited – Employees Stock Unit Plan 2023". Consequently, the company's paid-up equity share capital increased from Rs. 1,01,55,91,560 (10,15,59,156 shares) to Rs. 1,01,56,66,390 (10,15,66,639 shares). The newly allotted shares will rank pari passu with the existing equity shares, and the company is currently undertaking the necessary formalities for their listing.

announcements.ai_summary: Indiabulls Limited's Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on June 25, 2026, approved the grant of 30,09,036 Stock Options. These options were granted under the "Indiabulls Limited Employee Stock Option Scheme – 2025". Each option represents one fully paid-up equity share with a face value of Rs. 2/-, at an exercise price of Rs. 26 per share. This exercise price is against the latest available closing market price on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited, which was Rs. 25.75 as of June 25, 2026. The granted Stock Options will vest within five years, commencing from the first vesting date of June 26, 2027, and can be exercised within five years from their respective vesting dates.

This agreement, originally dated November 5, 2019, was for the development and commercialization of multiple products, including XelprosTM, ElepsiaTM, TaclantisTM, PDP-716, and SDN-037, in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan. The company has stated that this termination will not have any material impact on its financial position, operations, or other activities. No parties involved are related to the promoter, promoter group, or group companies.

This decision, made on the recommendation of the Audit Committee, aims to simplify the overall Accelya group structure. ASUK is not considered a material subsidiary and reported Nil turnover or income during the financial year 2025-26. The procedural formalities for the voluntary winding up and striking off will be completed in due course, with the process expected to conclude by September 30, 2026. Any

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Tata Communications Limited has informed the Exchange about the update regarding Fire Incident
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Communications Limited provided an update on June 25, 2026, regarding a fire incident that occurred at a company leasing its premises at Next-Gen Tower, Greater Kailash-1, New Delhi 110048, as previously intimated on June 5, 2026. Following the incident, Tata Communications activated its business continuity protocols to maintain service continuity and minimize disruptions. A majority of the affected customer data has been successfully recovered, with only limited cases requiring further validation and rebuilding. While some customers faced temporary operational disruption, the overall business impact has not been material, and the Company’s operations continue unaffected. Tata Communications Limited maintains adequate insurance coverage to address any potential financial impact or liabilities arising from the incident.

announcements.subject: Sale or disposal
announcements.detail: Isgec Heavy Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange on update on sale of Equity Shares in Joint Venture Company - Transaction Completed
announcements.ai_summary: Isgec Heavy Engineering Limited announced on June 25, 2026, the completion of the sale of 5,00,000 equity shares in its Joint Venture Company, Isgec SFW Boilers Private Limited ("JV Company"). The shares, representing 25% of the JV Company's paid-up share capital, were sold to its joint venture partner, Sumitomo SHI FW Energia Oy. This transaction, which was previously intimated on May 08, 2026, has reduced Isgec Heavy Engineering Limited's shareholding in the JV Company from 51% to 26%. Consequently, Isgec SFW Boilers Private Limited has ceased to be a subsidiary of the Company and is now classified as an associate company. The JV Company will continue to operate as a joint venture between Isgec Heavy Engineering Limited and Sumitomo SHI FW Energia Oy.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Sanginita Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 31A (10)(ii) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 for Reclassification of promoter(s) pursuant to the Open Offer'.
announcements.ai_summary: Sanginita Chemicals Limited announced on June 25, 2026, the reclassification of Sanginita Industries LLP from the "Promoter/Promoter Group" category to the "Public" category, pursuant to an open offer. This reclassification follows the completion of a Share Swap and Share Purchase Agreement (SSSPA) dated March 20, 2026, on June 24, 2026, where equity shares were transferred from Sanginita Industries LLP to one of the acquirers. The intent for this reclassification was disclosed in the Draft Letter of Offer dated April 8, 2026, by acquirers BNG Investment LLC and Mr. Anubhav Agarwal. Following the transaction, Sanginita Industries LLP's shareholding is now such that they do not hold more than ten percent of the total voting rights. Mr. Anubhav Agrawal, one of the acquirers, is now classified as a 'Promoter' of the Company.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Rishabh Instruments Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''.Press Release & Intimation of Award to Lumel SA, Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Rishabh Instruments Limited announced on June 25, 2026, that its wholly owned subsidiary, Lumel SA, has received the prestigious Forbes Diamonds 2026 Award for the second consecutive year in Poland. Lumel SA was recognized in the medium category of companies in the Lubuskie region, specifically for those with PLN 50-250 million in annual revenue. This marks the fifth prestigious award Lumel SA has received over the past 18 months. The Forbes Diamonds Award acknowledges companies demonstrating exceptional growth, financial strength, and effective management practices over the past three years. This distinction reinforces Lumel SA’s position as a leading provider of industrial automation, measurement, and energy management solutions.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: GMR AIRPORTS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Commencement of Operations at Nagpur Airport

announcements.detail: Hindustan Zinc Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 25, 2026, titled "Hindustan Zinc Limited has deployed India s first 250 Metric Tonne capacity electric crane at Zinc Smelter Debari in Rajasthan".

This hybrid-powered crane, capable of operating on both diesel and electric power, represents a significant advancement in the company's strategy to reduce operational emissions and transition towards low-carbon industrial infrastructure. announcements.ai_summary: Oil & Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) and bp have signed a Technical Services Contract on June 25, 2026, appointing bp as the Technical Services Provider (TSP) for ONGC's fields in the Western Offshore Basin. This agreement expands the collaboration between ONGC and bp beyond the Mumbai High field, where a similar contract was signed in February 2025. Under this new contract, bp will work with ONGC to enhance production by deploying advanced technologies and global expertise. ONGC will retain full ownership and operational control of the assets. bp will receive a fixed fee for the initial two years, followed by a service fee linked to a percentage of revenue from net incremental hydrocarbon production. The objective is to moderate production decline, improve hydrocarbon recovery, and support sustained production growth.

This marks Suzlon's fourth order from TPREL and brings their cumulative partnership across Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh to over 1 GW. The project will be executed in the Anantapur district of Andhra Pradesh, increasing Suzlon's orderbook in the state to nearly 1 GW. This order is part of Suzlon's newly launched DevCo (Development Company) business model.

Profit After Tax (PAT) increased by 44.4% year-on-year to Rs 74.8 crore, while total revenue grew 18.3% year-on-year to Rs 347.6 crore. Operating profit rose by 32.4% year-on-year to Rs 89.1 crore, with an operating profit margin of 25.6%. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Oil & Natural Gas Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 25, 2026, titled "ONGC Spuds First Deepwater Well in Mahanadi Basin under Samudra Manthan Mission".
announcements.ai_summary: Oil & Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) has announced the spudding of its first deepwater exploratory well, MN-DW18-1-H-D, in the Mahanadi Offshore Basin on July 25, 2026. This event marks a significant milestone under the Government of India’s Samudra Manthan Campaign, aiming to explore India’s deep and ultra-deepwater energy resources. The initiative aligns with the Prime Minister's call to harness untapped offshore potential, with the government opening nearly one million square kilometres of previously restricted offshore areas. ONGC launched its Deepwater Exploration Mission Centre, DeepX, on January 5, 2026, to integrate expertise and advance exploration. The drilling of this well, located approximately 23 nautical miles from Konark, off the Odisha coast, is part of an ambitious campaign to enhance domestic production and reduce import dependence, thereby strengthening India's energy security.

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: Camlin Fine Sciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Disruption of Operations
announcements.ai_summary: Camlin Fine Sciences Limited has reported a disruption of operations at its Diphenol Plant located in Dahej SEZ, Gujarat, due to geopolitical issues and economic conditions impacting the availability and prices of key raw materials. The company had already reduced capacity utilization and initiated steps towards shutting down the plant. The shutdown is not expected to affect downstream products as Hydroquinone has been secured through imports, and adequate Catechol inventory is available for Aroma products. A fire incident occurred at the Diphenol Plant on the night of May 23, 2026, caused by a leakage of thermic fluid, which was extinguished within an hour. The fire resulted in the loss of approximately 30 MT of Catechol inventory and damage to a flaker machine and other equipment, with an estimated loss of INR 2 crore, which is adequately covered by insurance. As a precautionary measure, the Vanillin facility was also shut down. The company is analyzing re-purposing the Diphenol Plant, and its restart will be evaluated based on economic and geopolitical improvements.

announcements.ai_summary: Varroc Engineering Limited has been awarded the ET AutoTech Award 2026 for Innovation in In-Cabin Infotainment & Connected Technology on June 24, 2026. The award recognizes VarrocLink, an indigenous connectivity ecosystem designed for deep OEM-centric customization and seamless integration in vehicles. Unlike conventional mirroring solutions, VarrocLink utilizes an Asynchronous Architecture to offload critical tasks like navigation to the infotainment system's GPS, addressing challenges in low-connectivity environments and reducing mobile battery drain. The platform allows manufacturers to develop bespoke OEM-branded UI/UX without third-party licensing dependence. VarrocLink is currently being integrated into next-generation models of a major Indian OEM for its 4x4 lifestyle SUV and premium MPV portfolio, with potential scalability across various vehicle categories, including ICE and EVs.

This upgrade is expected to help Aye Finance diversify its funding sources and lower its cost of borrowing.
