announcements.ai_summary: Aakaar Medical Technologies Limited has provided an operational business update for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company is focused on strengthening its distribution network, expanding scientific engagement, accelerating innovation, improving digital execution, and building recurring revenue platforms. The operational momentum from the second half of FY26 has continued into the current financial year, reinforcing the company's long-term strategy. This update is based on internal management information systems and is subject to a limited review by the statutory auditors. The company will continue to inform the stock exchange of all material developments.

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about impact on Operations due to Flooding caused by Unprecedented Heavy Rains at the Company's Silvassa Plant.
announcements.ai_summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Limited has reported that its manufacturing plant located at Unit No. 2, Plot No. 2, Survey No. 678/1/3, Village Naroli, Silvassa (Dadra & Nagar Haveli), U.T. – 396230, has been affected by flood-like conditions. This disruption is due to unprecedented heavy rainfall in Silvassa over the last 48 hours, causing severe waterlogging. The company is currently assessing the exact quantum of loss/damage and the impact on its assets, operations, and production. Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Limited confirms it has adequate insurance coverage, and the incident has been formally intimated to the insurance company. Appropriate measures are being taken to restore normal operations at the earliest, and the company will keep stock exchanges informed of any material developments.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Aakaar Medical Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Board Comments on Notice dated 14.07.2026 from National Stock Exchange'.
announcements.ai_summary: Aakaar Medical Technologies Limited held a Board of Directors meeting on July 24, 2026, to address a notice received from the National Stock Exchange dated July 14, 2026. The notice alleged non-compliance with Regulation 44(3) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015. The Board acknowledged the non-compliance, stating it was inadvertent and procedural in nature. The company's management has since implemented necessary corrective and preventive measures to ensure strict and timely compliance with SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, and other applicable laws. This action aims to prevent future recurrences of such non-compliance.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Nitco Limited has informed the Exchange about Allotment of Equity Shares pursuant to exercise of share warrants
announcements.ai_summary: On July 24, 2026, Nitco Limited announced the allotment of 55,05,935 equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each at a premium of Rs. 82.25 per share to Mr. Vivek Prannath Talwar, a promoter of the company. This allotment is pursuant to the exercise and conversion of the balance convertible warrants, upon receipt of the remaining 75% of the issue price. The issue price per warrant was Rs. 92.25, with 25% paid initially. A total of 1,79,04,065 warrants had previously been converted into equity shares on March 23, 2026, and July 23, 2026. This action follows shareholder approval on November 15, 2024, and in-principle approvals from BSE and NSE in January 2025.

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: Indo Count Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Disruption of Operations
announcements.ai_summary: On July 24, 2026, Indo Count Industries Limited informed the exchange about a temporary disruption of operations at its manufacturing facility in Bhilad, Gujarat, which commenced on July 23, 2026, due to unprecedented rainfall and flooding. The company has implemented safety measures for its personnel, and all assets and materials at the facility are adequately insured. Indo Count Industries Limited is currently assessing the extent of any damages and the impact on operations, with further updates to be provided once operations resume. The disruption is attributed to heavy rainfall at the factory premises located at 191/192, Mahala Falia, Village, Bhilad, Gujarat- 396105.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 24, 2026, titled "Aurobindo Pharma signs non-exclusive voluntary license agreement with MSD".
announcements.ai_summary: On July 24, 2026, Aurobindo Pharma Limited announced that it has entered into a non-exclusive voluntary licensing agreement with MSD (a trade name of Merck & Co., Inc.). This royalty-free agreement will enable Aurobindo Pharma to supply generic alimatravir to 129 Low- & Middle-Income Countries (LMICs) that account for a significant portion of new HIV diagnoses globally, subject to regulatory approvals. This initiative is a first in HIV prevention, aiming to facilitate the scale-up of manufacturing and supply of generic alimatravir that meets international standards. The agreement underscores Aurobindo Pharma's commitment to expanding access to high-quality, affordable medicines and partnering with innovators for equitable access to potential new therapies.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Patanjali Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Patanjali Foods Limited has disclosed receipt of a recall order dated July 20, 2026, from the Office of The Assistant Commissioner of Food Safety, Kottayam. The order, received on July 24, 2026, pertains to the recall of sale of Wheat Flour from a specific batch due to the presence of pesticide residues (Chlorpyriphos) exceeding the maximum tolerance limit. The company has stated that there is no material impact on its financial or operational activities, except for the value of the affected batch of Wheat Flour. The details of this communication and its implications are provided in Annexures A and B.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Welspun Living Limited has informed the Exchange about transfer of stake of Welspun Captive Power Generation Limited (WCPGL) to Welspun Corp Limited (WCL)
announcements.ai_summary: Welspun Living Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 24, 2026, approved the transfer of its 51% stake in Welspun Captive Power Generation Limited (WCPGL) to Welspun Corp Limited (WCL), a promoter group company. This transfer involves 1,50,64,213 equity shares of face value Rs. 10/- each, for a consideration of Rs. 67.66 Crores. The transaction, intended to be completed by August 31, 2026, is part of a strategic initiative to increase the use of renewable energy. Upon completion, WCPGL will cease to be a subsidiary and will become an associate company of Welspun Living Limited. Additionally, the Board approved a capital expenditure of Rs. 121 Crore for a De-bottlenecking & Modernisation Project at its Anjar facility.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Orient Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Orient Technologies Limited has secured a significant Purchase Order from the National Payments Corporation of India for the supply of Servers. The estimated value of this contract is approximately ₹76,20,00,000/- (Rupees Seventy-Six Crores and Twenty Lakhs Only), exclusive of GST. The order includes supply of servers with End of Sale support and a 7-year warranty, with back-to-back OEM support. This domestic order is to be executed within 18 weeks and will further strengthen the company's position in delivering enterprise infrastructure solutions and large-scale technology projects.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the earnings and operational update for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has announced its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting a strong performance. The company has a healthy order book of approximately Rs. 10,000 Mn, driven by visibility in PM-KUSUM 2.0 and other state-led solar irrigation programs. Despite input cost pressures and lower realizations on some orders, EBITDA margins remained broadly stable sequentially. The export business continued to show strong momentum. Looking ahead, growth is expected from an improved execution pipeline and operational efficiencies, with the company also expanding its Solar Cash/Retail, Solar Rooftop, and EV businesses, and investing in capacity expansion for pumps, motors, VFDs, and solar structures.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Welspun Living Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 24, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Welspun Living Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting on July 24, 2026, approved two significant items. The Board sanctioned the transfer of its 51% stake in Welspun Captive Power Generation Limited (WCPGL) to Welspun Corp Limited (WCL), a promoter group company. This stake, comprising 1,50,64,213 equity shares of face value Rs. 10/- each, will be transferred for a consideration of Rs. 67.66 Crores, with completion targeted by August 31, 2026, subject to necessary approvals. Upon completion, WCPGL will transition from a subsidiary to an Associate Company. Additionally, the Board approved a capital expenditure of Rs. 121 Crore for a De-bottlenecking & Modernization Project at the Company's plant in Anjar, aimed at replacing old technology with new and advanced systems to meet market demands and improve plant utilization.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bank of Maharashtra has informed the Exchange about Revision in MCLR Rates
announcements.ai_summary: Bank of Maharashtra announced on July 24, 2026, a review and revision of its Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR), with the new rates effective from July 25, 2026. The Overnight MCLR has been revised downwards from 7.50% to 7.30% per annum. Conversely, the Six months MCLR has increased from 8.80% to 8.90% per annum, and the One Year MCLR has also risen from 8.95% to 9.00% per annum. The MCLR for One month remains unchanged at 8.30% per annum, and the Three months MCLR stays at 8.55% per annum.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Share India Securities Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 24, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Share India Securities Limited's Board of Directors met on July 24, 2026, and approved several key decisions. The Board approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Additionally, a 1st interim dividend for the Financial Year 2026-27 of Re. 0.50 (Fifty Paisa Only) per equity share, having a face value of Rs. 2/- (Rupees Two Only) each, was declared. Thursday, July 30, 2026, has been fixed as the Record Date for this dividend, with payment scheduled before Saturday, August 22, 2026. The Board also approved raising funds up to Rs. 200 Crores through debt securities, including Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) and Commercial Papers (CPs), on a Private Placement Basis, authorizing the Finance Committee to finalize the terms. Lastly, the Board approved the acquisition of 100% equity share capital of Enshrine Leasing and Infotech Private Limited.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bank Of Baroda has informed the Exchange about Disclosure  under Regulation 30
announcements.ai_summary: Bank of Baroda announced on July 24, 2026, that its subsidiary, Indiafirst Life Insurance Company Limited (IFLIC), has informed the Bank about a significant stake transfer. Caramel Point Investments India Private Limited has transferred its 25.96% stake in IFLIC to BNP Paribas Cardif. This transaction was executed via a Share Purchase Agreement dated July 24, 2026, and is subject to necessary regulatory approvals. Bank of Baroda explicitly stated that there are no changes in its own shareholding or controlling interest in Indiafirst Life Insurance Company Limited as a result of this transfer.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Please refer attachment.
announcements.ai_summary: Piramal Pharma Limited announced on July 24, 2026, the temporary suspension of operations at its manufacturing facilities located at Plot Nos. 18 and 19 – PHARMEZ - Pharmaceutical Special Economic Zone, Village Matoda, Sarkhej Bawla, NH 8A, Taluka Sanand, Ahmedabad - 382 213, Gujarat, India. This precautionary measure was taken due to exceptionally heavy rainfall and flooding across parts of Gujarat, resulting in waterlogging. The affected facilities collectively account for less than 3% of the Company's consolidated revenues, and all employees, including contract staff, are reported safe. Piramal Pharma Limited has initiated actions to assess the facilities' condition and facilitate a safe and orderly resumption of operations. Subject to improved weather conditions, operations are expected to gradually normalize over the next few days, and the assets at these facilities are adequately covered under the Company's insurance policies.

announcements.subject: Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.detail: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)- Extension of validity of Letter of Award received by Fleur Hotels Limited (Material Subsidiary) from Delhi Development Authority ("DDA") for Development and Operations of -Aurika, Nehru Place.
announcements.ai_summary: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited announced on July 24, 2026, the extension of the validity of a Letter of Award (LOA) received by its material subsidiary, Fleur Hotels Limited (FHL). The original LOA, received on August 15, 2025, from Delhi Development Authority (DDA), pertains to the development and operations of "Aurika, Nehru Place," a 5-star hotel on a prime land parcel in Nehru Place, New Delhi. The validity of this LOA, which was originally valid up to August 14, 2026, has been extended by mutual agreement for a further period of one year. Consequently, the LOA will now remain valid until August 14, 2027. FHL accepted the extension letter from DDA on July 23, 2026, subject to necessary compliances on the part of DDA as per the LOA and Tender Document. The significant terms and conditions of the LOA dated August 14, 2025, remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 24, 2026, titled "Maruti Suzuki Launches New Brezza Turbo Boosterjet with Powerpacked Performance".
announcements.ai_summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited announced on July 24, 2026, the launch of the New Brezza Turbo Boosterjet, designed to appeal to today’s dynamic and youthful customers. This new model features a bolder, more youthful exterior and is conceptualized with 'Spontaneous Play' in mind, offering power-packed performance. The New Brezza Turbo Boosterjet comes with a 6-speed manual transmission and Progressive Smart Hybrid Technology. Introductory prices for the New Brezza Turbo Boosterjet start at INR 7,39,900. Additionally, the New Brezza is available with the Proven & Refined K15C Dual Jet Dual VVT engine, featuring a new 6-speed manual transmission or a 6-speed automatic transmission with steering-mounted paddle shifters. New Brezza S-CNG customers can also benefit from a new underbody CNG tank configuration, ensuring uncompromised boot space.

The company has received an aggregate amount of INR 190.32 million for these shares. The Special Committee of Directors for Rights Issue has approved this conversion, and the shares will rank pari passu with existing fully paid-up equity shares. announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: NBCC (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of Work Orders received by NBCC (India) Limited in the ordinary course of business amounting to Rs. 108.85 Cr. approx.'.

The second order, valued at approximately Rs. 88.43 Crore (excluding GST), is from the Directorate of Technical Education and Training, Odisha, Cuttack, for the construction of Boys/Girls Hostels at various locations in Odisha. The announcement does not specify a delivery timeline for either of these domestic contracts.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: NTPC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 24, 2026- Raising of funds through issue of Non-Convertible Debentures
announcements.ai_summary: NTPC Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on Friday, July 24, 2026, approved a proposal to raise funds up to Rs. 12,000 Crore. The funds will be raised through the issuance of secured/unsecured, redeemable, taxable/tax-free, cumulative/non-cumulative, non-convertible debentures (NCDs Bonds). These NCDs will be issued in one or more tranches/series, not exceeding 12, via private placement in the domestic market. The issuance period will commence from the date of passing a special resolution until one year thereafter or the date of the next Annual General Meeting in the financial year 2027-28, whichever is earlier. This fund-raising initiative is subject to shareholder approval, with specific details like size, tenor, listing (BSE and/or NSE), coupon/interest rate, and security to be determined at the time of each tranche issue.

announcements.subject: Granting/withdrawal/surrender/cancellation/suspension of key licenses/ regulatory approvals
announcements.detail: AvenuesAI Limited has informed the Exchange about Authorisation for setting up a payment system for Issuance and Operation of Prepaid Payment Instruments by Reserve Bank of India
announcements.ai_summary: AvenuesAI Limited (formerly Infibeam Avenues Limited) has received authorization from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to set up a payment system for the Issuance and Operation of Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPIs). This authorization, granted via RBI Letter No. CO.DPSS.AUTH.No.S332/02.27.004/2026-27 dated July 24, 2026, falls under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007. The approval permits the company, operating as GoWallet, to issue and operate PPIs across India. This development is significant as it expands AvenuesAI Limited's offerings in the digital payments sector. No further approvals or specific next steps are disclosed in the intimation.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: KFINTECH: KFin Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 24, 2026, titled "Steady Performance, Led by International Growth and Robust Deal Momentum".
announcements.ai_summary: KFin Technologies Limited has issued a press release dated July 24, 2026, titled "Steady Performance, Led by International Growth and Robust Deal Momentum," detailing its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of ₹ 3,565.4 million, a 30.1% year-on-year increase, with core revenue growth at 30.6%. International and other investor solutions core revenue saw a significant rise of 192.1% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at ₹ 1,219.8 million, up 7.1% year-on-year, while Profit After Tax (PAT) was ₹ 752.1 million, down 2.6% year-on-year. Diluted EPS was ₹ 4.34, also down 2.6% year-on-year. The company highlighted growth in its international client base, with overall AUM growing 89.9% year-on-year to US$49.6 billion, and secured new RTA and datalake platform deals.

announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities
announcements.detail: DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Options to purchase securities
announcements.ai_summary: The Nomination and Remuneration Committee of DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited, on July 24, 2026, approved the grant of 300,000 stock options under the DTL Employees Stock Option Plan – 2018. These options carry the right to apply for an equal number of equity shares of face value Rs. 3 each. The pricing formula is based on Rs. 18.93, which is the market price of the share one day before the grant date. The vesting period is spread over four years, with 25% vesting at the end of each year from the grant date. The consolidated EBITDA for Q1 FY27 stood at ₹7.41 crores with an EBITDA margin of 9.5%, a recovery from the negative EBITDA of ₹5.27 crores in Q1 FY26. announcements.ai_summary: Cyient Limited has issued a press release dated July 24, 2026, announcing the elevation of Andrew Smith to the position of Chief Operating Officer (COO). This appointment is intended to drive global delivery excellence and accelerate the company's growth strategy. In his new role, Andrew Smith will be responsible for scaling next-generation delivery models, developing future-ready talent, and enhancing customer experience. He brings over two decades of experience in engineering, operations, and business leadership from organizations such as Airbus, Rolls-Royce, and Bombardier Transportation. He has also held various leadership positions within Cyient over the past nine years, successfully driving strategy and operational performance in the Transportation and Semiconductor businesses.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Jamna Auto Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Jamna Auto Industries Limited has announced a proposed acquisition of Owen Springs Limited, a company incorporated in England and Wales. This strategic entry into the UK leaf spring aftermarket is a step towards achieving 40% of turnover from new markets, aligning with JAI's Lakshya RISE 5000 growth ambition. This marks JAI's first-ever acquisition, establishing a wholly-owned platform in the UK aftermarket for leaf and parabolic springs. Owen Springs Limited, established in 2004, is a leading leaf spring brand in Britain with over 350 SKUs and a network of approximately 250 distributors, retailers, and garages, supported by local warehousing. The acquisition will provide JAI with a ready-made platform, a local team, and a trusted British brand, enabling faster delivery of JAI products and cross-selling opportunities for JAI's suspension and allied products.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Almondz Global Securities Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment of equity shares on a preferential basis by way of conversion of the existingunsecured loan into equity shares'.
announcements.ai_summary: Almondz Global Securities Limited has approved the allotment of equity shares on a preferential basis through the conversion of an existing unsecured loan into equity shares. The Committee For Further Issue of Shares, in its meeting held on July 24, 2026, sanctioned the allotment of up to 16,318,538 equity shares to Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited, a promoter. Each equity share has a face value of Rs. 1/- and an issue price of Rs. 15.32/-, including a premium of Rs. 14.32/- per share. The total consideration for this allotment is Rs. 25,00,00,000/-, which will be settled through the conversion of the unsecured loan. These allotted equity shares will be subject to a lock-in period as per SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018, and will rank pari passu with existing equity shares.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Indo Tech Transformers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''Expansion of Product Portfolio to 400 kV Transformer Segment"
announcements.ai_summary: Indo Tech Transformers Limited has announced a significant expansion of its product portfolio into the 400 kV transformer segment. The company has received approval from NTPC Limited to manufacture transformers in the 400 kV voltage class for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. Furthermore, Indo Tech Transformers has secured an order for the supply of two 90 MVA 400 kV transformers through a reputed EPC contractor. This development marks a crucial milestone, enhancing the company's technological capabilities and enabling it to participate in larger utility, renewable energy, transmission, and BESS projects. The company anticipates this expansion will provide access to higher-value business opportunities in the medium to long term.

announcements.detail: HandsOn Global Management (HGM) Limited has informed regarding receipt of No Objection Letter from the Exchanges approving the Company's application for Promoters Re-classification.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Responsive Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: On July 24, 2026, Responsive Industries Limited's Board of Directors held a meeting where they approved and reconstituted several committees. The Audit Committee will be chaired by Mr. Sanjiv Swarup, with Mr. Ajay Pratapray Shanghavi and Mr. Bajrang Lal Bajaj as members. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee will have Mr. Sanjiv Virendra Swarup as Chairperson, and Mr. Aayush Agarwal, Mr. Ajay Pratapray Shanghavi, and Mr. Bajrang Lal Bajaj as members. Mr. Aayush Agarwal will chair the Stakeholders Relationship Committee, with Ms. Jeny Vinod Kumar Gowadia, Mr. Ajay Pratapray Shanghavi, and Mr. Sadanand Raghavendra Morab as members. Additionally, Mr. Aayush Agarwal will chair the Risk Management Committee and the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee, with Mr. Sanjiv Virendra Swarup, Ms. Jeny Vinod Kumar Gowadia, and Mr. Mehul Vala as members for the CSR committee, and Ms. Jeny Vinod Kumar Gowadia, Mr. Bajrang Lal Bajaj, and Mr. Mehul Vala as members for the Risk Management Committee. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Sumeet Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 24, 2026, titled "Sumeet Industries Limited Completes ₹199.75 Cr Rights Issue to Drive Capacity Expansion and Long-Term Growth".
announcements.ai_summary: Sumeet Industries Limited has successfully completed its Rights Issue, raising ₹199.75 Cr. The Board of Directors approved the allotment of 16,84,24,217 Equity Shares, with a face value of ₹2 each, at an issue price of ₹11.86 per share. This Rights Issue was offered to eligible shareholders in a ratio of 8 Rights Equity Shares for every 25 fully paid-up Equity Shares held and was open from June 22, 2026, to July 20, 2026. The company's paid-up equity share capital has increased from ₹105.27 Cr (52,63,25,680 Equity Shares) to ₹138.95 Cr (69,47,49,897 Equity Shares). The proceeds will be utilized for strengthening working capital (₹100.00 Cr), general corporate purposes including the integration of the CP Plant acquired from Nakoda Limited (₹49.90 Cr), and prepayment of borrowings (₹23.00 Cr). This capital infusion is intended to drive capacity expansion, operational efficiency, and long-term growth.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bank Of Baroda has informed the Exchange about Outcome of Board Meeting- Fund Raising
announcements.ai_summary: Bank of Baroda's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 24, 2026, has approved the enhancement of resource raising limits for its overseas operations. The Medium Term Note (MTN) programme size will be retained at USD 4.00 billion, with a new sub-limit of USD 1.00 billion specifically for Green and ESG Bonds. Additionally, the limit for borrowings through various loan facilities, including syndicated and bilateral loans, has been increased from USD 5.00 billion to USD 10.00 billion. These decisions were made to support the bank's overseas operations and IFSCBU.

announcements.detail: Capital Nxt LLP has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 29(1) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.ai_summary: Capital NxT LLP has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 29(1) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, for the acquisition of shares in 3i Infotech Limited. Prior to this acquisition, Capital NxT LLP and its Persons Acting in Concert (PACs) held 10,310,229 shares, representing 4.97% of the total share capital and 4.85% of the diluted share capital. The recent acquisition involves an additional 100,000 shares, representing 0.048% of the total share capital and 0.047% of the diluted share capital. The PACs include Lakshmi Kaushik, Aishwarya Arvind, Mythili Srinivasan, and Venkatraman Srinivasan. Investors should track further disclosures to understand the complete implications of this acquisition.

announcements.subject: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
announcements.detail: Vedanta Resources Ltd has submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31 of the SEBI ( SAST) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.ai_summary: Vedanta Resources Limited has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31 of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, concerning Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited (VAML). This disclosure pertains to the creation of an encumbrance over the equity shares of VAML, held by its direct and indirect subsidiaries, namely Twin Star Holdings Ltd., Welter Trading Limited, Vedanta Holdings Mauritius Limited, Vedanta Holdings Mauritius II Limited, and Vedanta Netherlands Investments B.V. This encumbrance arises from a facility agreement dated July 20, 2026, with a total maximum commitment of US$ 2,250,000,000. The agreement mandates that no Obligor, including TSHL, VRL, VHMLII, and Welter, shall create or permit any security or quasi-security over the shares of VAML. Furthermore, the VRL group is required to retain control over VAML. Investors should note these developments as they may impact the company's governance and financial structure.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: DCB Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 24, 2026, titled "DCB Bank announces First Quarter FY 2027 Results".
announcements.ai_summary: DCB Bank Limited has announced its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1 FY 2027). The bank reported a Profit After Tax (PAT) of INR 213 Cr. for Q1 FY 2027, marking a significant 36% increase compared to INR 157 Cr. in Q1 FY 2026. Advances grew by 17% year-on-year, while Deposits saw a 20% year-on-year increase. The Gross NPA stood at 2.43% and Net NPA at 0.84% as of June 30, 2026. The Capital Adequacy Ratio remained strong at 17.03% as of the same date. The Managing Director & CEO highlighted the strong growth momentum in deposits and advances, improved profitability levers, and a historic low cost to average assets, contributing to the bank registering its highest ever quarterly PAT for the fourth consecutive quarter.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Saregama India Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Presentation.
announcements.ai_summary: Saregama India Limited has released a corporate presentation for investors, detailing its business performance and strategic outlook. The presentation highlights the company's evolution from a 1902 gramophone label to a digital IP powerhouse, owning over 1,80,000 songs in perpetuity and a global audience of over 650 million. For FY26, Saregama India Limited reported an Adjusted EBITDA of INR 4,047 million with a 41% margin, showing a 13% year-on-year growth. The company's investment case is supported by a 26% IRR on new music, with steady-state margins rising to approximately 90%. Key financial metrics show a consistent upward trend in Revenue from Operations and Adjusted EBITDA over the past few fiscal years. The presentation also outlines the company's historical milestones and its strategic expansion into new music, film music, and live events.

announcements.subject: Closure of Buy Back

Following the extinguishment, the company's issued, subscribed, and fully paid-up share capital has reduced from 27,94,97,838 equity shares to 27,48,03,838 equity shares. This extinguishment is effective from July 24, 2026.

announcements.subject: Strikes/Lockouts/Disturbances
announcements.detail: Hindustan Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about strikes/lockouts/disturbances
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about a temporary disruption of operations at its subsidiary, M/s Aero Care Personal Products LLP ('Aero Care'), due to flooding. The manufacturing facilities located at Survey No. 284/2, Village Naroli, Silvassa, have been temporarily suspended with immediate effect due to incessant rainfall and severe waterlogging. The extent of damage to plant and machinery, inventory, and other assets is currently being assessed. As access to certain areas remains restricted, the financial impact cannot be ascertained at this stage. Aero Care is taking necessary measures to safeguard assets and expedite restoration. The assets are comprehensively covered under insurance. The disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

announcements.detail: The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on today i.e. 24th July 2026, inter alia considered and approved the acquisition of a 26% of stake of Amplus Andhra Private Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of ACC Limited, in its meeting held on July 24, 2026, approved the acquisition of a 26% equity stake in Amplus Andhra Power Private Limited. Amplus Andhra Power Private Limited, incorporated on October 24, 2016, operates in the infrastructure and renewable energy sector, with a turnover of Rs 85.40 Million as of March 31, 2025. The acquisition does not involve related parties, and the transaction is not with a promoter or group company. The Board meeting commenced at 11:50 a.m. and concluded at 02:45 p.m. The details of the acquisition are disclosed as per SEBI Listing Regulations and a SEBI Circular dated January 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: ACC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 24, 2026, titled "ACC begins FY 27 with resilient Q1 Performance .".
announcements.ai_summary: The company announced its Q1 FY'27 financial results, reporting a quarterly sales volume of 10 million tonnes (MnT). Trade share increased by 5 percentage points year-on-year (YoY) to 81%, and the share of premium products in trade sales rose by 3 pp YoY to 44%. Quarterly revenue stood at Rs 5,808 crore, with Operating EBITDA at Rs 457 crore, benefiting from higher volumes with Ambuja. Despite headwinds from the West Asia conflict, the company achieved marginal sequential cost reductions through focused optimization. Capacity expansion is underway with a trial run for a 2.4 MTPA grinding unit at Salai Banwa (UP) and Kalamboli (MH) expansions to add 1 MTPA in the September 2027 quarter. The amalgamation of ACC with Ambuja received SEBI NOC on June 4, 2026, with an NCLT application filed on June 29, 2026, and the transaction is expected to complete during FY'27, subject to regulatory approvals. Green power share increased from 26% to 31% YoY. ACC also received CII's GreenPro certification for its blended cement portfolio and GRIHA certification for its entire B2B & B2C blended cement portfolio.

announcements.ai_summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited has received a letter of intent of resignation from its Statutory Auditors, M/s. S R B C & CO LLP (“SRBC”). announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Atul Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: Atul Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 24, 2026, approved a capital expenditure proposal for a new manufacturing facility. The facility will produce Mecoprop-p (MCPP-p) at a capacity of 1,000 tonnes per annum (tpa) and 2-methyl-4-chlorophenoxyacetic acid (MCPA) at a capacity of 750 tpa. This represents a proposed capacity addition, as the company currently has nil existing capacity for these products. The investment required is ₹167 crore, excluding working capital and goods and service tax, and will be financed through internal accruals. The rationale for this expansion is to broaden the company's portfolio and strengthen its position in Phenoxy herbicides, as well as to produce value-added downstream products of o-Cresol and MCA. The capacity is expected to be added within 67 weeks. The Board meeting took place from 10:15 am to 02:15 pm.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Adani Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 24, 2026, titled "AESL wins Rs 8,500 crore Transmission project in Andhra Pradesh".
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL) has announced its win of a significant transmission project in Andhra Pradesh valued at approximately Rs. 8,500 crore. This project, titled "Transmission System for Proposed Green Hydrogen / Green Ammonia Projects in Vizag Area, Andhra Pradesh (Phase- I)," was secured through the Tariff-Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) framework. The transmission system is designed to support the integration and supply of power for proposed Green Hydrogen and Green Ammonia projects in the Vizag area, catering to an estimated demand of 4,500 MW. It will also address the growing load requirements in the Pendurthi–Vizag region, driven by investments in data centers and digital infrastructure. The project involves establishing a 4×1500 MVA, 765/400 kV GIS substation at Pendurthi and a 3×1500 MVA, 765/400 kV Khammam-II substation. This win will add 1,582 ckm of transmission lines and 10,500 MVA of transformation capacity to AESL's portfolio, bringing its total transmission network to 29,531 ckm and 1,33,675 MVA of transformation capacity.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 24, 2026, titled "Veranda RACE partners with Dr. Rajkumar Academy to strengthen govt exam coaching across Karnataka".
announcements.ai_summary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has issued a press release dated July 24, 2026, announcing a strategic partnership between Veranda RACE, an enterprise of Veranda Learning, and Dr. Rajkumar Academy for Civil Services (DRACS). This Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) aims to enhance government exam coaching across Karnataka. The collaboration will integrate academic operations, brand stewardship, and institutional partnerships, continuing DRACS' social impact initiatives under the Veranda RACE umbrella. DRACS, established over nine years, is recognized for coaching UPSC, KAS, KPSC, and other State Public Service Commission examinations. Veranda RACE will contribute its academic expertise, technology-enabled learning, and operational scale, while maintaining DRACS' existing relationships with government departments, UNDP, UNICEF, and NGOs. Members of the Dr. Rajkumar family will serve as Goodwill Ambassadors, and initiatives like the Prithvi Scholarship Test will continue.

announcements.detail: Ambika Cotton Mills Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'General Business Update '.
announcements.ai_summary: Ambika Cotton Mills Limited has provided a general business update, indicating significant progress in its expansion and modernization plans. The company has successfully brought into operation an expansion of 6048 spindles, with an additional 6480 spindles nearing completion. The total cost for these expansions, amounting to Rs. 50 Crores, has been entirely funded through internal accruals. Furthermore, Ambika Cotton Mills Limited is planning a modernization of its existing 43000 spindles in Unit IV to 45000 spindles, utilizing state-of-the-art machinery at an estimated cost of Rs. 135 Crores, which will also be financed through internal accruals. These initiatives are expected to enhance production capacity, improve productivity, and elevate product quality. The modernization project is slated to commence in November 2026 and is anticipated to be completed by March 2027.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: 'Release:  HCLTech to establish Global Technology Center in Bhubaneswar '.
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of Odisha to establish a Global Technology Center in Bhubaneswar. This new facility is intended to house 5,000 employees and will focus on innovating and delivering AI-led digital solutions to global enterprises. The Technology Center will complement HCLTech's proposed AI Data Center within the Odisha Sovereign AI Park. Operations for the center are expected to commence by 2028. This expansion is part of HCLTech's "New Vistas" initiative to broaden its presence across India and bring opportunities closer to talent pools. The company plans to collaborate with local educational institutions and the government to enhance the local talent ecosystem with next-generation skills.

announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Limited has announced plans to establish its first AI Data Center in the upcoming Odisha Sovereign AI Park. This initiative is a partnership with Sarvam and the Government of Odisha. The planned capital outlay for this project is Rs. 14,257 crores, which includes financial assistance from the Government of Odisha. The AI Data Center aims to accelerate India's sovereign AI capabilities and foster the local developer ecosystem by combining HCLTech's full-stack AI expertise with Sarvam's foundation models. This will enable the offering of sector-specific AI applications to both private and public sector enterprises, addressing government sovereignty needs and delivering multi-lingual AI-based services. A Memorandum of Understanding was signed on July 24, 2026, between HCLTech, the Government of Odisha, and Sarvam.

announcements.subject: Offer for sale
announcements.detail: The President of India, acting through and represented by the Ministry of Railways, Government of India has informed the Exchange about an announcement with respect to offer for sale through Stock Exchange Mechanism for sale upto 13,06,85,060 Equity shares of face value of INR 10/- each of Indian Railway Finance Corporation Limited. Date and time of the opening of the offer for Non-Retail Investors: June 24, 2026 at 9:15 a.m.; Date and time of the closing of the offer for Non-Retail Investors: June 24, 2026 at 3:30 p.m.; Date and time of the opening of the offer for Retail Investors: June 25, 2026 at 9:15 a.m.; Date and time of the closing of the offer for Retail Investors: June 25, 2026 at 3:30 p.m. The Sale shall continue to take place on a separate window of the Stock Exchanges commencing at 9:15 a.m. and shall close at 3:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time) on the same date. The Floor Price for the Offer shall be INR 91/- (Rupees Ninety One only).
announcements.ai_summary: The President of India, through the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, is conducting an Offer for Sale (OFS) of up to 13,06,85,060 equity shares of Indian Railway Finance Corporation Limited, each with a face value of INR 10. The floor price for this Offer for Sale has been set at INR 91 per share.

announcements.subject: Press Release (Revised)

announcements.ai_summary: Rashi Peripherals Limited, a leading ICT distributor in India, is set to acquire a strategic stake in VDA Infosolutions Private Limited for an equity valuation of INR 5.5 Billion. VDA Infosolutions, a Mumbai-based IT solutions and services company with a FY26 revenue of approximately INR 8.5 Billion, specializes in enterprise technology and digital infrastructure solutions, including Cloud Technology, Cybersecurity, Data Protection, Virtualization, and Storage. This acquisition is intended to expand Rashi Peripherals' offerings into the value chain, transforming it from a distribution partner to a fully integrated technology solutions and services enterprise, aligning with growing digital infrastructure investment.

PIHS's paid-up share capital before this conversion was Rs. 4,40,99,99,460/-, comprising 4,40,99,99,46 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each.

The company subscribed to 75 Equity Shares, each with a face value of Saudi Arabia Riyal (SAR) 20,000, paying a total of SAR 15,00,000. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Honasa Consumer Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 23, 2026, titled "Honasa Consumer Limited Enters Nutraceuticals with Majority Stake Acquisition in Fluence Pharma".
announcements.ai_summary: Honasa Consumer Limited has announced its strategic entry into the nutraceuticals sector through the acquisition of a majority stake of 58% in Fluence Pharma, a science-backed nutraceuticals company. This acquisition, announced on June 23, 2026, marks Honasa's expansion into the high-growth nutraceuticals market, valued at over INR 16,000 Crore+. The company will establish a dedicated subsidiary, Honasa Health Private Limited, to scale a differentiated B2C nutrition portfolio by combining Fluence Pharma's patented clinical science and practitioner trust with Honasa's brand building and digital-first distribution expertise. This move is driven by the increasing consumer demand for holistic, "beauty-from-inside" solutions.

The second scheme involves the merger of 25 West Realty Private Limited (25 West), which is developing the '25 West' super-luxury residential project in Bandra (West), with Hubtown Limited. announcements.subject: Updates

This marks the company's 102nd boutique across India, strengthening its luxury brand portfolio and presence in prominent luxury retail markets. The expansion aligns with the company's strategic vision to make exclusive brands more accessible to discerning customers in India and deliver unparalleled luxury experiences.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015  Acquisition of Cable Television Business of various companies belonging to ACT Group.
announcements.ai_summary: GTPL Hathway Limited announced on June 23, 2026, that it has entered into a Business Transfer Agreement (BTA) to acquire the Cable Television Business of seven companies belonging to the ACT Group. The aggregate cash consideration for this acquisition, by way of slump sale on a going concern basis, is Rs. 36.23 crore. The acquired businesses operate across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Orissa, and Karnataka, serving approximately 6.00 lakh Cable Television subscribers. This acquisition is part of GTPL Hathway's strategy to expand its Cable Television Business. No governmental or regulatory approvals are required, and the acquisition is expected to be completed by September 15, 2026.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Delhivery Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release - Delhivery and Bajaj Auto Partner to Electrify Last-Mile Fleet, Boosting Rider Earnings and Safety'.
announcements.ai_summary: Delhivery Limited announced on June 23, 2026, a partnership with Bajaj Auto to electrify its last-mile delivery fleet. The initial phase involves deploying 200 Bajaj RIKI eCarts across Delhivery's network, extending electrification to Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities. A second phase is planned for 2026-2027, aiming for a total of approximately 1500 Bajaj electric three-wheelers (L3 & L5). This collaboration combines Bajaj Auto's electric mobility expertise with Delhivery's operational scale. The Bajaj RIKI eCart is designed for reliability and low maintenance, aiming to reduce operating costs per kilometer. This initiative is expected to increase daily earnings for delivery partners and contribute to a cleaner supply chain, supporting ESG commitments.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Ircon International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Additional charge arrangement for the post of Chairman & Managing Director (CMD), IRCON'.
announcements.ai_summary: Ircon International Limited informed the Exchange on June 23, 2026, regarding an additional charge arrangement for the post of Chairman & Managing Director (CMD). Following the superannuation of Shri Hari Mohan Gupta on June 30, 2026, the Ministry of Railways has decided to entrust the additional charge of CMD, IRCON to Shri Saleem Ahmad, CMD of Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd. (RVNL). This charge will be for a period of one year, effective from July 1, 2026, or until a regular incumbent assumes charge, whichever is earlier. The company is undertaking necessary actions for Shri Saleem Ahmad's appointment in compliance with relevant regulations. Further disclosures will be made upon his assumption of charge.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 23, 2026, titled "Ola Electric Receives BIS Certification for its Indigenous 46100 LFP Cell, Strengthening India's Battery Manufacturing Capabilities".
announcements.ai_summary: Ola Electric Mobility Limited announced on June 23, 2026, that its wholly owned subsidiary, Ola Cell Technologies (OCT), has received Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification for its indigenously developed 46100 LFP cylindrical cell. This makes Ola Electric the first Indian company to achieve BIS certification for a cell in this format, strengthening India's advanced battery manufacturing capabilities. The LFP 46100 cell has also successfully passed IS 16893 Parts 2 and 3, and UN 38.3 standards, confirming its safety and performance. The development involved significant localization of materials, components, engineering, and manufacturing processes. This achievement underscores Ola Electric's growing capacity to develop, qualify, and industrialize advanced cell technologies within India.

This approval signifies the successful completion of the QIP and the subsequent listing of these new shares.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Quess Corp Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 23, 2026, titled "Quess Partners with IGS and IPA to Open Indo Japan GCC Corridor".
announcements.ai_summary: Quess Corp Limited announced on June 23, 2026, that its wholly owned subsidiary, Quess International Services Private Limited (QISPL), has entered into a strategic collaboration with Institution for a Global Society (IGS) and Indo-Pacific Advisory (IPA). This partnership aims to establish a robust Indo-Japan Global Capability Center (GCC) corridor, facilitating opportunities for Japanese companies to set up GCCs in India across sectors like AI, engineering, cybersecurity, BFSI, and digital transformation. The initiative aligns with the deepening Special Strategic and Global Partnership between India and Japan, supported by significant investment commitments from Japan to India. QISPL is not a material subsidiary of Quess Corp Limited.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015   Acquisition of Oriflame India s Manufacturing business
announcements.ai_summary: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Pure and Cure Healthcare Private Limited, has approved the acquisition of Oriflame India Private Limited's manufacturing business for a total consideration of INR 56 Crore. This acquisition, approved on July 23, 2026, includes two manufacturing plants located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, and Noida, Uttar Pradesh, along with a leased warehouse in Noida. This move marks Akums' entry into the color cosmetics market and will expand its presence in skincare and wellness products, capitalizing on the fast-growing cosmetics opportunity in India. The trademark and marketing of Oriflame's products in India are not part of this transaction.

As a result, Suri Overseas Private Limited and Pangram Brands Global Private Limited, indirect step-down subsidiaries through DBS Lifestyle, have also ceased to be subsidiaries. Additionally, Pangram Celebrity Brands Private Limited is now classified as an associate, with PDS Limited retaining a 28.7% direct equity holding. The company stated that this transaction is not expected to have a material impact on its financial position, business operations, or performance.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Acme Solar Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 23, 2026, titled "ACME Solar operationalizes 3.62 GWh Battery Energy Storage System projects in Rajasthan".
announcements.ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited has issued a press release on July 23, 2026, announcing the operationalization of its 3.62 GWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects in Rajasthan. This brings the company's overall operational BESS capacity to approximately 3.62 GWh across three project sites. The company also provided an update on a technical root cause analysis closure for the ACME Suryodaya BESS facility in Pokhran, Rajasthan. The analysis confirmed an electrical short circuit in AC cables between the Transformer and PCS caused a localized fire, leading to equipment shutdown. Restoration activities have been successfully completed, and other on-site equipment were not damaged.

The acquisition involves Apitoria holding 80% in A1 Biochem Labs (India) Private Limited, which will then acquire 100% of A1 Biochem Labs LLC, USA, and the business of A1 Biochem Research (India) Private Limited. The existing promoter of A1 Biochem Group will retain the remaining 20% ownership.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 23, 2026, titled "CPCL S FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED 30.06.2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) has released its financial performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company achieved a crude throughput of 2.85 million metric tonnes (MMT), representing a capacity utilisation of 108%. Revenue from Operations for the quarter stood at ₹ 29,359 crore, a significant increase from ₹ 18,683 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. CPCL reported a Profit Before Tax (PBT) of ₹ 1366 crore and a Profit After Tax (PAT) of ₹1017 crore, a substantial improvement from a Loss Before Tax of ₹ 80 crore and Loss After Tax of ₹ 57 crore in the prior year's quarter. An additional revenue of ₹385.21 crore from supplies in March 2026 was recognised, impacting the Gross Refining Margin (GRM) to US$ 8.78 per barrel for April–June 2026, compared to US$ 3.22 per barrel in the same period last year. On a consolidated basis, the company reported a PBT of ₹ 1380 Cr and PAT of ₹ 1031 crore for the quarter.

announcements.subject: Frauds/Default by employees
announcements.detail: Servotech Renewable Power System Limited has informed the Exchange about Frauds/Default by employees
announcements.ai_summary: Servotech Renewable Power System Ltd. has detected an internal fraud involving two employees and an external party, M/s Shri Shyam Industries. The fraud is alleged to have been carried out over a period of time through the unauthorized removal of the Company's inventory and forgery of tax invoices. The estimated impact of this fraud is approximately Rs 2-2.5 crores, and the company is in the process of appointing a forensic auditor to determine the final quantum. The involved employees are Mr. Gagandeep Rajora (Head – Supply Chain Management) and Mr. Vijay Kumar (Manager – Production Planning & Control). An FIR No - 429/2026 has been registered with Police Station Kundli, District Sonipat, Haryana, regarding this matter.

announcements.detail: Excel Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Product launch
announcements.ai_summary: Excel Industries Limited announced on July 23, 2026, its plan to commission a project for manufacturing a new specialty chemical. The proposed capacity is expected to be added by February 2027, with the product launch also anticipated in February 2027, following the commissioning of the production capacity. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Disclosure Of Information Under Regulation 30(3) Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - In Principle Approval For Putting Up One More HCL Synthesis Unit At Dahej.
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited's Board of Directors granted in-principle approval on July 23, 2026, for establishing one more HCL synthesis unit at its Dahej complex. The approximate project cost for this new unit is Rs. 55 Crores. This expansion aims to enhance chlorine utilization, thereby optimizing the production of Caustic Soda at the Dahej facility. The additional HCL generated from this new synthesis unit will be specifically utilized in the Phosphoric Acid plant, which the Board had already approved to establish at Dahej.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Krsnaa Diagnostics Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Krsnaa Diagnostics Limited has entered into a Public Private Partnership (PPP) Agreement with the Director Health Services, Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Himachal Pradesh. Under this agreement, the company will set up, operate, manage, maintain, and report CT Scan Diagnostic Facilities at 34 Government Health Institutions across Himachal Pradesh. This project significantly expands the company's previous scope, which covered 12 Government Health Institutions in the state. The agreement is on a PPP and majority cash basis for an initial period of seven (7) years, extendable by a further three (3) years on mutually agreed terms. This expansion reinforces Krsnaa Diagnostics' position as a preferred service provider and represents one of its largest government partnerships for CT Scan diagnostic services.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition

announcements.ai_summary: Excel Industries Limited is undertaking a significant business expansion by commissioning a new project to produce a specialty chemical at its Lote site. This new facility will have a proposed capacity addition of 1265 Metric Tonnes Per Annum (MTPA). The company plans to complete this capacity addition by February 2027, with an estimated investment of Rs. 5.05 crores. The project will be financed through internal accruals, and the product launch is also expected in February 2027, post commissioning. The rationale behind this expansion is to diversify the company's product portfolio, catering to both domestic and international markets across a wide range of geographies.

On July 23, 2026, the Company filed an application under Sections 497 and 503 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, before the Court of the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 11, Ahmedabad City, seeking the release of these frozen funds. announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: Precision Wires India Limited has informed the Exchange about Disruption of Operations
announcements.ai_summary: Precision Wires India Limited has informed the exchange about a partial impact on its operations at its Silvassa plants due to flooding caused by unprecedented heavy rains. Between July 22, 2026, and July 23, 2026, approximately 740 mm of rain was recorded in Silvassa, following 333 mm of rain between July 21 and July 22, 2026. The company is currently assessing the extent of damages and the effect on operations. They anticipate that the situation may start normalizing gradually in the next few days, barring unforeseen developments. Precision Wires India Limited is taking measures to ensure the safety of equipment, materials, and personnel. The company will provide further updates on significant developments.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Ptc Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: PTC Industries Limited has secured a significant design and development order from the Armament Research & Development Establishment (ARDE), a laboratory under the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO). This order is for the development of a Titanium Cradle intended for the 105mm Indian Light Weight Tank. This marks a crucial milestone for PTC Industries as it represents their first order where they will be responsible for both the design and development of a component, moving beyond their traditional build-to-print manufacturing. The Titanium Cradle is a mission-critical defense component designed to support the main gun barrel and breech, facilitate recoil mechanism attachment, and safely transfer firing and recoil forces to the turret structure. This order enhances PTC ONE™, the company's integrated manufacturing system, by adding design-led development capabilities for mission-critical defense components.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: PTC Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 23, 2026, titled "PTC Industries Secures Landmark Order from PTC Industries Receives Design and Development Order from ARDE, DRDO for Titanium Cradle for Indian Light Weight Tank".
announcements.ai_summary: PTC Industries Limited has received a significant design and development order from the Armament Research & Development Establishment (ARDE), a laboratory of the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO). The order is for a Titanium Cradle for the 105mm Indian Light Weight Tank. This marks a crucial milestone for PTC Industries as it is their first order where they will be responsible for both designing and developing a mission-critical defense component, moving beyond traditional build-to-print manufacturing. The Titanium Cradle is a vital component that supports the main gun barrel and breech, facilitates recoil mechanisms, and safely transfers firing and recoil forces. This order strengthens PTC's integrated manufacturing system, PTC ONE™, extending its capabilities into design-led development of defense components.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Intellect Design Arena Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 23, 2026, titled "Press Release   Deal Win - Leading UAE Bank Partners with Intellect to Revolutionise Corporate Banking Landscape with Composable eMACH.ai Architecture".
announcements.ai_summary: Intellect Design Arena Limited has announced a strategic partnership with a leading Sharjah-based financial institution in the UAE. This collaboration aims to revolutionize the bank's corporate banking value proposition by modernizing its operations with Intellect's composable eMACH.ai architecture. The transformation will replace legacy, product-centric systems with a unified, digital-first transaction banking experience designed to scale corporate operations. The bank will deploy Intellect’s comprehensive front-to-back transactional banking framework, including end-to-end Digital Onboarding, advanced Cash Management (CBX), Virtual Account Management (VAM), Collections, and Liquidity Management. This implementation is expected to enable the bank to capture sustainable liabilities and accelerate its corporate portfolio growth.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Suzlon Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Suzlon Energy Limited has secured a significant new order for a 201.6 MW wind project from Waaree Group's Independent Power Producer (IPP) arm, Waaree Forever Energies Private Limited (WFEPL). This order will be executed in Andhra Pradesh and marks Waaree Group's maiden wind project. Suzlon will supply 64 of its flagship S144 wind turbine generators (WTGs), each with a rated capacity of 3.15 MW. The project will be executed under the Suzlon DevCo model, which encompasses land acquisition, turbine supply, Balance of Plant (BoP), commissioning, and lifetime operations and maintenance services. This is the second consecutive DevCo-led EPC order for Suzlon within a week, indicating a growing industry trend towards this model for faster execution and de-risking of projects.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 23, 2026, titled "Zydus receives approval for Phase III trial of Desidustat in patients with Sickle Cell Disease, to be conducted in collaboration with ICMR".
announcements.ai_summary: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has announced a significant development in its collaboration with the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). The company has received approval to conduct a Phase III clinical trial for Desidustat, an oral tablet, in patients with Sickle Cell Disease. This trial will evaluate the efficacy and safety of Desidustat in treating anemia associated with the disease. The Phase III study will be a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, parallel, multicentre study and will enroll 164 patients. This follows the successful completion of a Phase II Proof-of-Concept (PoC) trial by Zydus and ICMR, which demonstrated positive outcomes. The US FDA has also granted Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) to Desidustat for both Sickle Cell Disease and beta-thalassemia.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue

announcements.ai_summary: N. B. I. Industrial Finance Company Limited has announced a material update regarding amendments to its Memorandum of Association (MOA), approved by the Board of Directors on May 22, 2026. Specifically, the alterations will modify a sub-clause to permit the company to carry on the business of an investment company and to invest in, acquire, underwrite, subscribe for, hold, sell, dispose of, transfer, transmit, or otherwise deal with all kinds and types of securities. Industrial Finance Company Limited convened on May 22, 2026, and approved proposed alterations to the company's Memorandum of Association (MOA). The newly inaugurated auditorium will serve as a venue for academic, cultural, and extracurricular activities, fostering student confidence and skill development. The project involves the construction of a 4-lane highway from Barabanki to Mustafabad on NH-927 in Uttar Pradesh on a Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) basis. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Aavas Financiers Limited has informed the Exchange about Clarification Letter on Market Rumour
announcements.ai_summary: Aavas Financiers Limited has issued a clarification regarding market rumors concerning alleged discrepancies in loan classifications, purported reversal of refinancing facilities by the National Housing Bank (NHB), and management changes. The company strongly refutes these assertions, stating that the report's contents are misleading, malicious, and speculative, and do not accurately characterize its engagement with NHB. Aavas Financiers Limited clarified that NHB conducts periodic audits and reviews as part of its regulatory oversight, and an ongoing inspection is routine and has not concluded with any adverse findings or directions to reverse refinancing facilities. The company remains committed to robust governance, prudent underwriting standards, and responsible lending practices.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Flair Writing Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Flair Writing Industries Limited has secured fresh orders totaling INR 200 million for its Creative and Steel Bottles & Houseware division from large format stores. These orders are scheduled for execution within the next 90 days. The company expects these orders to support margin-accretive growth, with the Creative and Steel Bottles & Houseware divisions, which grew by 78% in FY26 and contributed approximately 31% of total revenue, projected to increase their combined contribution to 38%-40% of overall revenue in FY27. In FY26, Flair Writing Industries Limited sold 145 million mechanical pencils and has also commenced manufacturing wooden pencils at its Surat facility.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 22, 2026, titled "Aurobindo Pharma USA Receives FTC Approval to Acquire Lannett Company".
announcements.ai_summary: Aurobindo Pharma USA, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Aurobindo Pharma Limited, has received approval from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) to acquire Lannett Company LLC for $250 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis, inclusive of normalized working capital. This acquisition is expected to close before the end of June 2026 and will significantly expand Aurobindo USA's product offerings in complex, non-opioid controlled substances, while also adding a U.S.-based manufacturing facility in Seymour, Indiana, with a capacity to scale production to approximately 4 billion doses annually. The acquisition is anticipated to be immediately accretive to Aurobindo Group’s earnings per share, aligning with U.S. policy priorities to enhance supply chain resilience and increase domestic pharmaceutical production.

announcements.detail: United Spirits Limited has informed the Exchange about Share Subscription and Shareholder Agreement in relation to acquisition in Nuvola Spirits Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: United Spirits Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 22, 2026, approved an investment in Nuvola Spirits Private Limited (NSPL) through a Share Subscription and Shareholder Agreement. The company will subscribe to 17,350 Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) and 10 equity shares of NSPL, representing an aggregate of 10.08% of its issued and paid-up share capital on a fully diluted basis. The total consideration for this acquisition amounts to INR 2.69 crore. NSPL operates as an alcohol and non-alcohol beverage company, focusing on developing, producing, marketing, and selling alcohol beverages under the brands "Mikiamo" and "Seoulmate." This strategic investment aligns with United Spirits' objective to support innovative founders and leverage emerging consumer preferences in the premium craft beverage sector. For the year ended March 31, 2025, NSPL reported a turnover of INR 0.38 crore and a negative net worth of INR 0.15 crore. The acquisition is not classified as a related party transaction.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Release:  TIM Brasil partners with HCLTech to transform customer experience with South America s first cross-platform eSIM transfer capability '.
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Limited (HCLTech) announced on July 22, 2026, a strategic partnership with TIM Brasil, the leading 5G operator in Brazil. HCLTech has been selected to enable South America's first cross-platform eSIM transfer capability, aiming to transform customer experience for millions of users. This digital innovation will allow TIM Brasil customers to securely and seamlessly transfer their eSIM profiles across various devices and operating systems, leveraging HCLTech’s Device Entitlement Gateway (DEG). The solution eliminates the need for physical SIM cards, store visits, or complex migration processes, simplifying device upgrades and SIM transfers. Anil Ganjoo, Executive Sponsor of Brazil and Chief Growth Officer and Global Head of Telecom, Media and Technology at HCLTech, stated that this collaboration utilizes HCLTech’s engineering-led, AI-intrinsic platforms to foster agile, AI-driven, and device-agnostic telecom operations.

announcements.ai_summary: Neochem Bio Solutions Limited has reported a cyber fraud incident where unauthorized payments were made to third parties due to fraudulent instructions. The company assures that its core systems and operations remain unaffected. A specialized cybersecurity team and management have initiated investigations to mitigate the impact. Neochem Bio Solutions Limited has lodged a cybercrime complaint, reported the incident to CERT-In, and instructed its bankers to seek recall and freezing of beneficiary accounts. Vendor payment and bank-mandate verification protocols have been strengthened, and IT assets are being investigated for malware. Legal action is being initiated to recover the remitted amount, part of which has reportedly been tracked and frozen.
