announcements.ai_summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited is proposing to establish a new Ayurvedic, Naturopathy, and Panchkarma Hospital facility in Kalyani, District Nadia, West Bengal. This expansion is part of the company's strategic growth objectives to broaden its healthcare network and cater to a larger population with quality panchakarma services. The proposed hospital will have an estimated area of 13,000 sq. ft. and a capacity of over 60 beds. Operations are expected to commence around October 2026. The investment required for this new facility is approximately ₹1.30 Crores, which will be financed through the company's internal funds.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Sona Blw Precision Forgings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 22, 2026, titled "SONA Comstar  partners with DENSO Corporation Japan".
announcements.ai_summary: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Limited has announced a strategic partnership with DENSO Corporation, Japan, through a press release dated July 22, 2026. The companies have signed definitive agreements to establish two joint ventures in India focused on developing, designing, manufacturing, and marketing advanced electric and hybrid powertrain systems. One joint venture will concentrate on high-voltage liquid-cooled traction inverters, traction motors, and generators for four-wheelers and larger vehicle applications. The second joint venture will focus on air-cooled traction inverters, traction motors, generators, and e-Axles for electric and hybrid two-wheelers. This collaboration aims to leverage DENSO's technological leadership in electrification and Sona Comstar's manufacturing and engineering expertise to create scalable and cost-efficient powertrain solutions for the evolving electric mobility landscape.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Happy Square Outsourcing Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Happy Square Outsourcing Services Limited has secured a new work order from GOVT POLYTECHNIC DHAMTARI C. G. (Technical Education Department Chhattisgarh). The order is for services to be provided from August 1, 2026, to July 31, 2027, with an approximate value of Rs. 16.44 Lakhs, inclusive of all taxes. This work order is in the ordinary course of the company's business and is awarded by a domestic entity. The company expects this new contract to generate revenue of approximately Rs. 16.44 Lakhs over the contract period and contribute to strengthening its order book. The contract was bagged on July 21, 2026, at 11:55 PM.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Sona Blw Precision Forgings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 22, 2026 and Intimation under Reg 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations
announcements.ai_summary: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 22, 2026, approved the carve-out and transfer of its Electric Vehicle (EV) Business to its wholly-owned subsidiary, Sona Comstar eDrive Private Limited, via a slump sale. This transfer is part of a joint venture formation with DENSO Corporation of Japan. The EV Business, encompassing the development, design, manufacture, sale, and marketing of components for electric and hybrid systems in 2 and 3-wheelers, will be transferred for an aggregate consideration of INR 8,932 million. This consideration comprises INR 8,575 million in cash, subject to closing adjustments, and the balance in equity shares of Sona eDrive to be issued to Sona BLW Precision Forgings Limited. Concurrently, Sona BLW Precision Forgings Limited has entered into a Share Subscription Agreement with Sona eDrive and DENSO, through which DENSO will acquire a 49% equity stake in Sona eDrive.

announcements.subject: Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Siyaram Silk Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of Scheme of Arrangement between Siyaram Silk Mills Limited and its shareholders, by NCLT Mumbai, in relation to issue of Preference Shares by way of bonus
announcements.ai_summary: Siyaram Silk Mills Limited has received approval from the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, for its Scheme of Arrangement with its shareholders. This scheme, sanctioned on July 21, 2026, under Section 230 of the Companies Act, 2013, pertains to the issuance of Preference Shares by way of bonus. The NCLT order has been pronounced, and the company will proceed with further steps to implement the scheme upon receiving the certified copy of the order.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Sejal Glass Limited has informed the Exchange about Receipt of Order
announcements.ai_summary: Sejal Glass Limited's subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates, Sejal and Glass Manufacturing Products LLC, has secured five significant Architectural Glass orders totaling approximately AED 27.6 Million, equivalent to INR 71 Crores. These orders are for prestigious hospitality, residential, and healthcare projects in the UAE, reinforcing the company's presence in the GCC region. Additionally, the company has also secured Architectural Glass projects in India valued at approximately Rs. 50 Crore for various commercial, residential, and institutional projects. These new orders, which involve the supply of high-performance Architectural Glass Solutions like insulated glass units (IGUs), solar-control glazing, and laminated safety glass, are expected to be executed between 2026 and 2027.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: IIFL Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding re-purchase and cancellation of Senior Secured Fixed Rate Notes under the Global Medium Term Note Programme by IIFL Finance Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: IIFL Finance Limited has announced the repurchase and cancellation of USD 1,369,526.04 (including accrued interest) of its Senior Secured Fixed Rate Notes due 2028. These notes were originally issued under Regulation S and Rule 144A of the U.S. Securities Act 1933. The repurchase was conducted at a premium and is within the limits approved by the Authorized Dealer bank. This action is in compliance with applicable laws, including the Foreign Exchange Management (Borrowing and Lending) Regulations, 2018, and the Reserve Bank of India's Master Direction on External Commercial Borrowings. The total principal outstanding amount of these notes was USD 413,325,000 prior to this repurchase.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Inox Green Energy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 22, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Inox Green Energy Services Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 22, 2026, approved raising funds aggregating up to Rs. 600 Crore. This includes a base issue size of up to Rs. 400 Crore and a green shoe option of up to Rs. 200 Crore. The funds will be raised by issuing various instruments or securities, including equity shares, preference shares, or debentures, through methods like preferential allotment or qualified institutions placement. The Board also approved the notice for an Extra-Ordinary General Meeting (EGM) to seek shareholder approval for the proposed fund raise. The IGESL Committee of the Board of Directors for Operations has been authorized to decide the terms and conditions of the fund raise.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Deepak Builders & Engineers India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation regarding successful completion and inauguration readiness of  Jalandhar Cantt. Railway Station Redevelopment Project '.
announcements.ai_summary: Deepak Builders & Engineers India Limited has announced the successful completion and inauguration readiness of the Jalandhar Cantt. Railway Station Redevelopment Project on July 22, 2026. This project, executed for Indian Railways, signifies a major achievement in the company's infrastructure portfolio. The redeveloped station includes modern passenger amenities, improved circulation, upgraded platforms, and enhanced accessibility. The company believes this project strengthens its credentials in the railway and transportation infrastructure sector and enhances its competitiveness for future projects.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about allotment of Employee Stock Options
announcements.ai_summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited has approved the grant of 15,933 stock options to an eligible employee under the Dr. Reddy’s Employees Stock Option Scheme, 2018, on July 22, 2026. These options have an exercise price of Rs. 1,206/- per share. The options are subject to 100% vesting at the end of 3 years from the grant date. The total number of shares covered by these options is 15,933. The grant is in terms of the SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: TVS Motor Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 22, 2026, titled "TVS MOTOR LAUNCHES TVS RAIDER IN EGYPT, SET TO REDEFINE THE PREMIUM COMMUTER SEGMENT FOR YOUNG AND URBAN RIDERS".
announcements.ai_summary: TVS Motor Company Limited has announced the launch of its TVS Raider motorcycle in Egypt on July 22, 2026. This launch is part of the company's strategy to expand its presence in North Africa and its premium commuter motorcycle portfolio in Egypt. The TVS Raider, powered by a 124.76cc engine, is designed for young, urban riders and features advanced technology and rider-friendly features. The company aims to redefine the premium commuter segment in Egypt with this new offering. The launch event was attended by distributors, dealers, media, and other stakeholders. This expansion into Egypt is a significant step in TVS Motor's international growth strategy.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR 2015 - Issue of Bonus Shares by Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Sun TV Network Limited has disclosed that its wholly-owned subsidiary, SunRisers Leeds Limited (formerly Northern Superchargers Limited), approved a bonus issue of 99,999 Equity Shares on July 21, 2026. Each share has a face value of 1 GBP. Following this bonus issue, Sun TV Network Limited will hold a total of 1,00,000 Equity Shares in SunRisers Leeds Limited, maintaining its 100% ownership. There will be no change in the percentage of shareholding of Sun TV Network Limited in its subsidiary, which will continue to be wholly owned.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release - TCS study reveals Physical AI is now mainstream as manufacturers scale AI implementation'.
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has issued a press release on July 22, 2026, detailing the findings of its "Future-Ready Manufacturing: TCS Physical AI Readiness Report 2026." The study indicates that Physical AI is becoming mainstream in manufacturing, with a significant shift from isolated automation to comprehensive AI ecosystems. Key findings reveal that 77% of manufacturers expect substantial transformation in warehouse operations, and 75% anticipate similar changes in assembly and manufacturing operations. The report highlights that manufacturers are committing to long-term investments in physical AI, viewing it as a people-first transformation that enhances employee safety, efficiency, and productivity, rather than a replacement for the workforce. The study surveyed CXOs and vice presidents from 300 manufacturing companies across North America and Europe between March and April 2026. This research builds on TCS's partnership with Google Cloud and the recent launch of the TCS Physical AI Gemini Experience Center.

announcements.subject: Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.detail: Innovision Limited has informed the Exchange about Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.ai_summary: Innovision Limited has been awarded a Letter of Award (LoA) / Work Order by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) on July 21, 2026. This contract involves engaging Innovision Limited as a user fee collection agency for the Biratiya Kalan Fee Plaza on the Bar-Bilara-Jodhpur Section of NH-112 under NHDP Phase-IV in Rajasthan. The contract is on an EPC mode and also includes the upkeep and maintenance of adjacent toilet blocks, along with the recouping of consumable items. The order was granted under tender ID NHAI/13013/547/CO/26-27/CB/Biratiya Kalan & Binawas FP/E99375/R-1787. The broad commercial consideration for this order is ₹97,52,79,635 (Ninety-Seven Crore Fifty-Two Lakh Seventy-Nine Thousand Six Hundred and Thirty-Five). The execution period for this contract is one year.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Service Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 22, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Service Care Limited held a Board Meeting on July 22, 2026, from 03:30 P.M. to 04:00 P.M. During this meeting, the Board of Directors considered a proposal for the acquisition of certain intellectual property assets. This proposed acquisition aligns with the company's strategic business objectives and its long-term growth plans. The outcome of this board meeting has been communicated to the stock exchanges in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Electrotherm (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update - NCLT Order - Issuance and allotment of Preference Shares under Section 55(3) of the Companies Act, 2013'.
announcements.ai_summary: Electrotherm (India) Limited has received an order from the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Ahmedabad Bench, dated July 21, 2026, permitting the issuance and allotment of Non-Cumulative Redeemable Preference Shares (NCRPS). This follows a previous board meeting approval on February 11, 2025, for the issuance of 1,20,00,000 NCRPS of Rs. 10 each, equivalent to Rs. 12,00,00,000/- in unredeemed preference shares. The NCLT order allows the company to issue and allot 1,09,50,000 NCRPS of Rs. 10 each to five existing preference shareholders, excluding Ahmedabad Aviation and Aeronautics Limited, on the same terms as the original issue. These shares will be redeemable between 2 and 20 years from allotment. Upon this issuance, the corresponding existing unredeemed preference shares will be deemed redeemed. For Ahmedabad Aviation and Aeronautics Limited, the company is required to redeem 10,50,000 preference shares of Rs. 10 each at par forthwith.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 - We wish to inform that Azad delivered its First Expendable Indigenous Turbo Jet Engine to DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation) and the Ministry of Defence, Government of India after Manufacturing and Assembly of Engine Components, this is in continuation of our earlier communication vide letter CS/CA-Q1(2024-25) to the Stock Exchanges.
announcements.ai_summary: Azad Engineering Limited has made a significant disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company has successfully delivered its first Expendable Indigenous Turbo Jet Engine to DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation) and the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. This delivery follows the manufacturing and assembly of engine components and marks a crucial milestone in India's pursuit of self-reliance in propulsion technology. The achievement underscores Azad Engineering's expertise in precision manufacturing and complex aero-engine systems, contributing to India's indigenous defence and aerospace programs.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Euro India Fresh Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'clarification sought by NSE in connection with the Company's in-principle application for preferential issue of equity shares'.
announcements.ai_summary: Euro India Fresh Foods Limited has provided a clarification regarding its in-principle application for a preferential issue of equity shares. The company's shareholders approved the issuance of equity shares to the Non-Promoter Category on a preferential basis during an Extraordinary General Meeting held on July 17, 2026. Following observations from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited, it has come to light that certain proposed allottees acquired shares from the secondary market between June 19, 2026, and July 17, 2026. These acquisitions were not reflected in the pre-issue and consequential post-issue shareholding disclosed in the EGM Notice. The company is now disclosing the revised pre-issue and post-issue equity shareholding for proposed allottees Purvi Ricky Shah, Upendra Babubhai Kanani, and Darshan Hiteshkumar Rupapara.

announcements.subject: Closure of Buy Back
announcements.detail: Completion of extinguishment of 21,50,000 (Twenty-One Lacs Fifty Thousand) Equity Shares of Re. 1/- each of Kajaria Ceramics Limited ( Company ) and reconciliation of the Share Capital of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Kajaria Ceramics Limited has completed its buyback program by extinguishing 21,50,000 equity shares of Re. 1/- each. The tendering period for the buyback offer was from July 3, 2026, to July 9, 2026. Following the extinguishment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has reduced from 15,92,93,050 shares to 15,71,43,050 shares. This extinguishment has been carried out in compliance with Regulation 11 of the SEBI (Buy-Back of Securities) Regulations, 2018. The company has enclosed a certificate confirming compliance and has also provided the pre and post buyback shareholding patterns.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Rubicon Research Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 22, 2026, titled "Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations ) -Acquisition of a manufacturing facility in USA ".
announcements.ai_summary: Rubicon Research Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary AdvaGen Holdings Inc., has acquired a manufacturing facility located in East Brunswick, New Jersey, USA, from InvaTech Pharma Solutions, LLC. The acquisition was completed on July 21, 2026, at an enterprise value of USD 2.9 million. This transaction includes the lease, equipment, records, and permits associated with the site, providing Rubicon with a US manufacturing footprint comparable in size to its Satara facility. The facility manufactures oral solid and oral liquid formulations and has a history of successful USFDA inspections, including one in May 2026 which resulted in a Form 483 with six procedural observations unrelated to data integrity. AdvaGen Holdings Inc. was the successful bidder in a court-supervised competitive bid process under Section 363 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code and has entered into a long-term lease for the site.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: TSC India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Receipt of Air Canada "Circle of Excellence   Gold 2026" Award'.
announcements.ai_summary: TSC India Limited has been honored with the "Circle of Excellence — Gold 2026" Award by Air Canada. This award recognizes the company's outstanding performance, commitment, and continued support. The award signifies the dedication, teamwork, and relentless efforts of the entire TSC India family. This recognition underscores the strong partnership between TSC India Limited and Air Canada.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Wanbury Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Wanbury Limited has reported the completion of a routine current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) inspection by the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) at its facility in Tanuku, West Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh. The inspection took place from July 13, 2026, to July 17, 2026. Upon conclusion, the USFDA issued a Form 483 with six observations. The company has stated that it will respond to these observations within the stipulated timeframe. Wanbury Limited will provide further updates to the stock exchanges as the matter progresses.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Eternal Limited has filed with exchange copy of shareholders letter dated July 22, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Eternal Limited has filed a copy of its shareholders' letter dated July 22, 2026, with the Exchange. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company has also ensured that the information contained in the shareholders' letter is hosted on its website, www.eternal.com, for public access.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: SRF Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 22, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: SRF Limited announced its consolidated financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 22, 2026. The company reported a significant increase in consolidated revenue, which grew by 32% from ₹3,819 crore to ₹5,033 crore compared to the corresponding period last year. Operational Earnings Before Interest and Tax (EBIT) increased by 61% from ₹694 crore to ₹1,116 crore. Profit After Tax (PAT) saw a substantial rise of 76%, from ₹432 crore to ₹759 crore. The Chemicals Business also performed well, with revenue increasing by 26% to ₹2,315 crore and operating profit rising by 27% to ₹638 crore. The Chairman and Managing Director highlighted this as the company's best-ever quarterly performance, driven by strong momentum across its diversified businesses.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015- Shareholders  letter dated July 22, 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited has informed the Exchange about a disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. This disclosure pertains to a shareholders' letter dated July 22, 2026. The company has made this letter available on its website at https://www.smartworksoffice.com/investors/. This announcement is for the information and record of the exchange.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: SRF Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: SRF Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 22, 2026, approved a capital expenditure proposal to set up a BOPET Thick Film Line. This new line will add a capacity of 25,000 MTPA and is projected to cost ₹250 Crores. The financing for this expansion will be a mix of debt and internal accruals. The company expects the proposed capacity to be added within 24 months from the date of Board approval. This BOPET thick film is a specialized product with applications in industrial and electronic end-use segments, and its addition is intended to help manage cyclicality better due to its different cycle compared to commodity thin films.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bajel Projects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 22, 2026, titled "Press Release - Bajel Projects Limited Formalises Landmark 500 kV Transmission Line Agreement with EETC in Cairo, Egypt.".
announcements.ai_summary: Bajel Projects Limited has formalized a significant agreement with the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company (EETC) in Cairo, Egypt, for the construction of two contiguous sections, Lot 1 and Lot 5, of a 500 kV Overhead Transmission Line (OHTL). This combined order, valued at over ₹400 crore, is part of a national grid reinforcement program aimed at strengthening Egypt's high-voltage transmission backbone. The agreement was signed on July 22, 2026, by Mr. Rajesh Ganesh, Managing Director & CEO of Bajel Projects Limited, and Eng. Mona Rezk, Chairman of EETC. This development reinforces Bajel Projects' position as an international EPC partner in high-voltage power transmission and expands its footprint in the MENA region.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Thejo Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of demise of Mr. K.J. Joseph, Chairman Emeritus of the Company'.
announcements.ai_summary: Thejo Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about the sad demise of Mr. K.J. Joseph, who was one of the Founder Promoters and served as the Chairman Emeritus of the Company. Mr. K.J. Joseph passed away on July 22, 2026. He had previously served as the Chairman of the Company before being designated as Chairman Emeritus on June 22, 2021. The company has expressed its deep condolences and acknowledged his invaluable guidance, visionary leadership, and significant contributions to the company's growth and development since its inception.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Tembo Global Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of the circular resolution passed by the board of Directors '.
announcements.ai_summary: Tembo Global Industries Limited has approved, via a circular resolution passed on July 22, 2026, the allotment of 75,000 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each upon the conversion of an equal number of warrants. This conversion is from a preferential issue of 8,10,000 convertible warrants announced on January 28, 2025, at an issue price of Rs. 285/- per warrant. The warrant holder, Ms. Fatema Kachwala, a promoter, paid the balance 75% of the warrant exercise price, amounting to Rs. 213.75 per warrant, for the 75,000 warrants converted, totaling Rs. 1,60,31,250/-. Consequently, the company's issued and paid-up capital has increased from Rs. 19,28,01,980/- to Rs. 19,35,51,980/-, with the number of equity shares rising from 1,92,80,198 to 1,93,55,198.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Liberty Shoes Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Liberty Shoes Limited has received a communication dated July 21, 2026, from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) regarding the reclassification requests of two promoter shareholders from "Promoter and Promoter Group" to "Public" category. SEBI has provided observations on the actions taken by the company concerning these requests and advised corrective actions as per Regulation 31A(8)(b) of the SEBI LODR Regulations. The company has stated that it has submitted all relevant facts and explanations to SEBI and is currently examining the communication with legal advisors to take appropriate actions. This communication is in the nature of regulatory observations and does not impose any monetary penalty or enforcement action.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Jainik Power Cables Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 21, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Jainik Power Cables Limited has announced a preferential issue of up to 30,00,000 (Thirty Lakhs) Convertible Warrants, each convertible into one Equity Share. The issue price per warrant is Rs. 151.50, for a total potential amount of Rs. 45,45,00,000/- (Forty-Five Crores Forty-Five Lakhs Only). The conversion period for these warrants is 18 months from the date of allotment. A payment of 25% of the warrant price is due on allotment, with the remaining 75% payable upon exercise of the conversion option. The relevant date for this issuance was July 15, 2026. The company has corrected typographical errors in the name of a proposed allottee and the pre and post-issue shareholding percentage of another allottee, as disclosed in their board meeting outcome dated July 21, 2026.

announcements.subject: Buyback
announcements.detail: Tips Music Limited has informed the Exchange about Deferred the proposal for the Buyback of fully paid-up equity shares of the Company. The said proposal will be considered and approved at the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company which is scheduled to be held on Wednesday, August 5, 2026.

This buyback proposal will now be considered and approved at a subsequent Board Meeting scheduled for Wednesday, August 5, 2026. The company also approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, along with the limited review report. Additionally, Grant Thornton Bharat LLP has been re-appointed as the Internal Auditor for the financial year 2026-27. The trading window for dealing in the company's securities will remain closed for designated persons until 48 hours after the conclusion of the August 5, 2026 Board Meeting.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Aye Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 22, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Aye Finance Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 22, 2026, approved a proposal to raise funds up to INR 4,000 Crore through the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures. These debentures will be issued in one or more tranches on a private placement basis and the fundraising activity is planned to occur within one year from the date of shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting (AGM). The company also announced that its 33rd AGM is scheduled for Tuesday, September 1, 2026, and will be conducted via Video Conferencing (VC) / Other Audio-Visual Means (OAVM). The notice for the AGM will be circulated to shareholders within the statutory timeline.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about actions initiated or orders passed concerning the company. Further details regarding the nature of these actions or orders were not provided in the announcement.

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements - Update on Joint Venture
announcements.ai_summary: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited has announced an update regarding its joint venture. Mahindra World City Developers Limited (MWCDL), a material subsidiary, along with Sumitomo Corporation, Japan, and Mahindra Industrial Park Chennai Limited (MIPCL), a step-down subsidiary of MWCDL, executed a Second Supplemental Agreement on July 22, 2026. This agreement aims to further expand the existing Industrial Park in Tamil Nadu by developing Phase 2B in Chennai. This initiative is an extension of the original Joint Venture Agreement dated May 28, 2015, and a previous supplemental agreement dated November 24, 2024. The Company holds an 89% stake in MWCDL, which in turn holds 60% of MIPCL, with Sumitomo Corporation holding the remaining 40% of MIPCL.

announcements.company: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited
announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Paras Defence And Space Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 22, 2026, titled "Government of Madhya Pradesh and Paras Semiconductors Sign MoU for ₹6,200 Crore Semiconductor Facility".
announcements.ai_summary: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited, through its semiconductor business Paras Semiconductors, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of Madhya Pradesh. This agreement is for the establishment of an advanced semiconductor packaging OSAT facility in Madhya Pradesh, with a proposed investment of ₹6,200 crore. The Government of Madhya Pradesh has allocated fifty acres of land on the Ujjain–Indore Corridor for this facility. The project aims to bolster India's semiconductor manufacturing capabilities, particularly for strategic applications, and is expected to create significant employment opportunities. Paras Semiconductors intends to leverage advanced manufacturing and packaging technologies to develop semiconductor devices for sensor technologies, optical and optronic systems, and potentially expand into AI chips in the future.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 22, 2026, titled "Smartworks Revenue Jumps 44% in First Year as a Listed Company; Normalised PAT Nearly Triples; Continues to gain market share, Full-year guidance reiterated".
announcements.ai_summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited announced its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, marking its first full year as a listed company. The company reported a significant increase in revenue, which grew by 44% to ₹546 crore, and a near tripling of normalised Profit After Tax (PAT) to ₹39 crore, with reported PAT at ₹13 crore. A substantial ₹5,400 crore of revenue is already contracted, covering 87.2% of the full-year guidance. The company also highlighted that its expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are fully booked, with work commencing on FY29, indicating strong demand and advance bookings for its facilities. Additionally, Smartworks has doubled its capacity in Singapore to approximately 1,500 seats.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Hon ble Prime Minister of India Shri Narendra Modi Inaugurates Advanced Mother and Child Centre at PGIMER, Chandigarh, Supported by Infosys Foundation'.
announcements.ai_summary: Infosys Foundation has supported the inauguration of an Advanced Mother and Child Centre (AMCC) at the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh, by the Hon'ble Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi. Infosys Foundation committed over INR 147 crore towards critical medical equipment for this centre, which is expected to benefit over 25,000 pregnant women and newborns annually. The AMCC is equipped with comprehensive facilities including triage, labor and delivery units, intensive care units for both mothers and newborns, operation theatres, and a human milk bank. This initiative aims to strengthen maternal and neonatal healthcare and provide access to high-quality, affordable healthcare for low-income families.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 22, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has issued a press release announcing that it has been awarded a Make-II Prototype Sanction Order (PSO) by the Indian Navy for the development of the SAVIOR-ASW, a Semi-Submersible Autonomous Vessel for Intelligence, Operations and Reconnaissance. This award signifies the company's entry into the autonomous maritime and underwater warfare systems domain and is considered a significant indigenous defence technology milestone. The Make-II category under the Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) allows Indian companies to develop indigenous prototypes, with the Government committing to procure successful ones. The PSO is a formal endorsement of Apollo Micro Systems' capability to deliver an autonomous maritime surveillance system.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'business updates'.
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has been awarded a Make-II Prototype Sanction Order (PSO) by the Indian Navy for the design, development, and prototype demonstration of the Semi-Submersible Autonomous Vessel for Intelligence, Operations and Reconnaissance (SAVIOR-ASW). This project marks the company's formal entry into the domain of autonomous maritime and underwater warfare systems. Under the Make-II category, there is no cost obligation on the Government during the prototype development phase, with a commitment to procurement upon successful demonstration. The company's Board of Directors and Management view this award as a defining milestone, underscoring their technological capabilities and expanding strategic role in India's defence technology ecosystem.

announcements.subject: Issue of Securities
announcements.detail: Varroc Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about issue of Securities
announcements.ai_summary: In terms of Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015, Varroc Engineering Limited has issued and allotted Commercial Paper aggregating to Rs. 50 crores. The Commercial Paper has an issue size of Rs. 50 Crores, with an issue price of Rs. 4,97,058.5/- per unit and a face value of Rs. 5,00,000/-. A total of 1000 units were issued. The instrument has a tenure of 30 days, with allotment on July 22, 2026, and maturity on August 21, 2026. The coupon/interest offered is at a discount rate of 7.20%, with the principal payment due on maturity. The Commercial Paper is unsecured and issued in favor of Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited, with ICICI Bank Limited as the IPA. Varroc Engineering Limited is in the process of listing these Commercial Papers on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and is awaiting listing approval.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bharat Forge Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 22, 2026, titled "Bharat Forge And FLYING WHALES Sign Strategic MoU To Develop And Manufacture Heavy-Lift Airships For Sovereign Applications In India ".
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Forge Limited has signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with FLYING WHALES, a pioneer in heavy-lift airship technology, to jointly develop and manufacture advanced airships for India's defence and strategic operational requirements. The MoU, signed on July 22, 2026, at the Farnborough International Airshow 2026, aims to establish an indigenous airship ecosystem in India, aligning with the 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' and 'Make in India' initiatives. The partnership will focus on the LCA60T platform, a heavy-lift airship capable of transporting up to 60 tonnes of cargo with vertical take-off and landing capabilities. This collaboration seeks to create sovereign capabilities in a strategically important aerospace segment, exploring defence applications such as logistics support to forward operating bases and transport.

The trading approval letters were received on July 21, 2026, from NSE and BSE. The details required under SEBI Listing Regulations are enclosed as Annexure A and will be hosted on the company's website.

announcements.detail: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited has informed the Exchange about Grant of Stock Options under Jubilant Ingrevia Employees Stock Option Scheme 2021
announcements.ai_summary: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited's Nomination, Remuneration & Compensation Committee, in its meeting held on July 22, 2026, approved the grant of 42,298 stock options to eligible employees under the Jubilant Ingrevia Employees Stock Option Scheme 2021. This grant comprises 34,808 Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and 7,490 Performance Linked Stock Units (PSUs). The exercise price for these options is Re. 1 per equity share, which is the face value of the company's shares. RSUs will vest at the end of three years from the grant date, while PSUs will vest at the end of one year, subject to pre-vesting conditions and performance parameters, respectively. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted with the Stock Exchange regarding final closing of the acquisition through indirect wholly owned subsidiary.
announcements.ai_summary: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited, through its indirect wholly owned subsidiary Motherson Global Investments B.V. (“MGI BV”), has completed the acquisition of 81% stakes with voting rights in Yutaka Giken Co., Ltd. (“YGCL”). This transaction, initially disclosed on August 29, 2025, and with a completion timeline extended to the second quarter of FY 2026-2027, saw YGCL complete a buyback of shares held by Honda Motor Co., Ltd. As a result, MGI BV now holds 81% of YGCL, with Honda Motor holding the remaining 19%. The final closing of this acquisition was achieved on July 21, 2026. This acquisition also impacts YGCL's subsidiary, Shinnichi Kogyo Co., Ltd., in which YGCL holds a 62% stake.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Manba Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 22, 2026, titled "Press Release on Company's expansion on product portfolio".
announcements.ai_summary: Manba Finance Limited has announced the launch of a new product focused on financing lithium-ion battery replacements for electric three-wheelers (e-rickshaws and e-carts). This initiative aims to support the livelihoods of owner-operators by providing affordable, small-ticket, short-tenure loans for battery replacements. The batteries will be sourced from empaneled, quality-certified OEMs, ensuring warranty and service support. The company will utilize a technology-led process, including digital onboarding and IoT-enabled batteries. The rollout will begin with Manba's existing e-three-wheeler customer base and will expand to the wider market subsequently. This expansion into EV battery financing is part of Manba Finance's strategy to deepen customer relationships and increase its presence in the electric vehicle ecosystem.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Grand Continent Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Grand Continent Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Company Update at the end of Quarter 1(Q1) of Financial Year 2026-27'.
announcements.ai_summary: Grand Continent Hotels Limited has provided a company update for the quarter ending June 2026, which is the first quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27. During this period, the company commenced operations of two new hotels: Grand Continent, Gurugram (Sector 45) with 38 keys, and Grand Continent, Rameshwaram, Tamil Nadu, with 48 keys. The company reported an occupancy rate of 69% for its India operations and 70% for its USA operations in June 2026. There were no new hotel signings during Q1 FY 2026-27. The company remains focused on disciplined expansion and operational excellence.

announcements.company: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited
announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015   Signing of Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with MP State Electronics Development Corporation (MPSeDC).
announcements.ai_summary: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited, through its subsidiary Paras Semiconductors Private Limited, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Department of Science and Technology, acting through MP State Electronics Development Corporation (MPSeDC). The agreement aims to collaboratively establish a greenfield advanced IC packaging OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) facility in Madhya Pradesh. Paras Semiconductors plans to invest approximately Rs. 6,200 Crores in this facility, which will be located in Indore-Ujjain. The facility will focus on advanced packaging operations, including 3D heterogeneous integration, 2.5D/3D advanced packaging, hybrid bonding, and chiplet integration.

announcements.ai_summary: Viviana Power Tech Limited has secured multiple turnkey contracts from its existing client, M/s. Paschim Gujarat Vij Company Limited (PGVCL). announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Hexaware Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release'.
announcements.ai_summary: Hexaware Technologies Limited has issued a press release regarding the "Hexaware Dream Runners Half Marathon 2026" held in Chennai on July 19, 2026. The fifteenth edition of the event saw participation from 7,339 runners and raised INR 50 Lakhs for prosthetic support, survivor services, and disability programs. Hexaware served as the title sponsor for the seventh consecutive year. The funds raised will be distributed among three non-profit organizations: Freedom Trust, which provides prosthetics, and Vijay Human Services, which supports children and young adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities. The company's website will also host this information.

announcements.subject: Updates

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: De Neers Tools Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, effecting the reclassification from Promoter/Promoter Group category to Public category shareholders'.
announcements.ai_summary: De Neers Tools Limited has received shareholder approval for the reclassification of certain individuals from the 'Promoter/Promoter Group' category to the 'Public' category. This change, effective upon receipt of necessary approvals, will alter the company's shareholding structure. Prior to this reclassification, the Promoter and Promoter Group held 46.25% of the total voting capital, which will reduce to 37.83% post-reclassification. Conversely, the 'Public' category's shareholding will increase from 53.75% to 62.17%. Specifically, Mr. Kanav Gupta, who held 7,45,200 equity shares representing 8.42% of the company's voting rights, is among those reclassified. This intimation is made in compliance with Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Rescission/termination(s)
announcements.detail: RKEC Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Rescission/termination(s)
announcements.ai_summary: RKEC Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about the termination of an EPC contract for the "Passenger Jetty and Terminal Facilities at Radio Jetty near Gateway of India, Mumbai." RKEC Projects Limited intends to pursue recovery of all costs, losses, and consequential damages through arbitration.

The Board approved the incorporation of a Wholly Owned Subsidiary in Italy, Europe, with an authorized capital of up to EUR 1,000,000. This decision supersedes the previous plan to incorporate a subsidiary in Spain. The new subsidiary will be a related party to Studds Accessories Limited upon its incorporation. Its principal business activity will involve the importation, distribution, marketing, and sales of the Company's products in Europe. Further updates will be provided once the subsidiary is officially incorporated.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Beta Drugs Limited has informed the Exchange about Beta Drugs Expands International Market Access with Key Regulatory Milestones in Azerbaijan and Philippines.
announcements.ai_summary: Beta Drugs Limited has achieved significant regulatory milestones in Azerbaijan and the Philippines, expanding its international market access. The company's manufacturing facility in Azerbaijan underwent inspection from April 13 to April 17, 2026, and GMP approval is expected within one to two months, facilitating market entry into Azerbaijan and the CIS region. In the Philippines, Beta Drugs received Certificates of Product Registration (CPR) for two brands, marking its first generic approvals in the market and enabling early market presence. Further approvals are anticipated in the Philippines over the next six months, supporting expansion into other Southeast Asian markets like Vietnam and Thailand.

This follows the admission of the Second Motion Petition by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Allahabad Bench at Prayagraj, as previously intimated on April 10, 2026. The matter was listed before the NCLT on May 21, 2026, for further proceedings. However, due to a paucity of time, the matter could not be taken up for hearing on this date. The next date of hearing for this Scheme of Arrangement is yet to be notified by the NCLT. The company will intimate any further updates as and when received.

This new entity will operate in the AlcoBev industry and will be a wholly-owned subsidiary of Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited.

announcements.ai_summary: The Nomination and Remuneration Committee of Veranda Learning Solutions Limited, in a meeting held on May 21, 2026, approved the grant of 12,000 Employee Stock Options under the Veranda Learning Solutions Limited Employees Stock Option Plan, 2022. announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Godawari Power And Ispat limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Updates on disposal of stake in Ardent Steel Private Limited'.
announcements.ai_summary: Godawari Power And Ispat Limited (GPIL) has provided an update on the disposal of its stake in Ardent Steel Private Limited (ASPL). On May 21, 2026, GPIL transferred 7,30,400 equity shares of ASPL, representing 9.22% of the equity, for a consideration of Rs 22.18 Crores. Following this transfer, GPIL's stake in ASPL has reduced from 9.22% to 0.00%. This is in continuation of the earlier announcement made on February 06, 2026, regarding the disposal of its entire 37.85% stake for a total consideration of Rs 90.87 Crores.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Eicher Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition - Investment in Volvo Financial Services (India) Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Eicher Motors Limited (EML), at its meeting held on May 21, 2026, approved an investment of up to Rs. 750 Crore. This investment will be made as cash consideration for the subscription of 50% of the equity share capital of Volvo Financial Services (India) Private Limited ("VFS India"). VFS India, incorporated on January 13, 2015, is a Middle Layer Non-Deposit taking Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India, currently engaged in providing financing, leasing, and other financial services. The transaction also includes the formation of a joint venture for undertaking financial services business in India. This investment and joint venture formation are subject to the approval of the Reserve Bank of India. The board meeting commenced at 3:45 p.m. and concluded at 4:50 p.m.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: IIFL Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding additional information required under Industry Standards Note on Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
announcements.ai_summary: IIFL Finance Limited has provided additional information as required under the Industry Standards Note on Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. This follows an email communication from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited dated May 20, 2026. The enclosed annexure details that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), by an order dated May 11, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹3,10,000/- on IIFL Finance Limited for non-compliance with certain provisions of the ‘Master Direction- Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Company – Scale Ba’. The company has declared that the information provided is true, correct, and complete to the best of its knowledge.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Man Industries (India) Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Man Industries (India) Limited, at their meeting held on Thursday, May 21, 2026, noted the completion of a significant acquisition. Man International Steel Industries Company (“MISIC”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the company incorporated in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, acquired 100% equity stake in National Pipe Company Limited (“NPC”), Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The total cost of this acquisition was approximately USD 102 Million, which is equivalent to approximately INR 1,000 Crores. NPC is an established API manufacturer of HSAW and LSAW pipes, serving major clients like Saudi Aramco and Qatar Petroleum. This acquisition aligns with Man Industries' international expansion strategy, aiming to strengthen its global presence and access infrastructure and energy opportunities in Saudi Arabia. NPC has an installed manufacturing capacity of approximately 430,000 MT per annum and plans to add a Coating Mill with External & Internal Coating Plant.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Magellanic Cloud Limited has informed the Exchange about Incorporation of Subsidiary
announcements.ai_summary: Magellanic Cloud Limited, formerly South India Projects Limited, has incorporated a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) named MCRAY XTEND INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED ("MCRAY") in collaboration with Rayonix Tech Private Limited. This SPV is established to pursue activities related to unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) technology, defence technology solutions, manufacturing, and deployment. Magellanic Cloud Limited will acquire a 60% shareholding in MCRAY, making it a subsidiary. This move aligns with the company's strategic expansion into the UAV and defence technology sectors and aims to bolster its involvement in indigenous technology development. The incorporation and proposed investment were approved by the board, and no promoters or promoter group companies have direct interest in MCRAY, other than their shareholding in Magellanic Cloud Limited.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: PAKKA LIMITED has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Pakka Limited has provided an update on its Jagriti Project and clarified resolutions from its EGM held on May 05, 2026. The estimated project cost for the Jagriti Project has been revised to INR 744.00 Crores, with INR 583.45 Crores already incurred as of March 31, 2026. The remaining funding will be met through the proceeds of a preferential issue and internal accruals. The company also clarified post-issue shareholding percentages for proposed allottees Neo Special Credit Opportunities Fund II A at 0.35% and Neo Credit Opportunities Fund I at 0.13%. The company is seeking in-principle approval for the preferential issue of 27,20,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- each and 90,90,000 fully convertible warrants.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sakar Healthcare Limited has informed the Exchange about Sakar enters it s 40th agreement signed with Zydus Lifesciences to cater oncology products to GCC and other emerging markets, in parallel to building momentum on strong execution and expanding Business Opportunities
announcements.ai_summary: Sakar Healthcare Limited has announced a significant business development with the signing of its 40th agreement with Zydus Lifesciences. This new agreement will focus on supplying oncology products to the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council) and other emerging markets. This strategic move aligns with the company's ongoing efforts to strengthen its execution capabilities and expand its business opportunities. In parallel, Sakar Healthcare has made substantial progress in its regulatory filings, with 23 Marketing Authorization (MA) filings in the European Union (EU), securing 5 MAs and applying for 13 own MAs. The company has also progressed in regulatory filings with 33 site variations submitted across the EU, with 5 site variation approvals already obtained. On the API front, Sakar has developed 21 APIs in-house, with 16 having Written Confirmation and 2 CEP approvals secured, indicating a growing integration strategy. These developments signal a transition towards a more integrated, regulatory-led business model, enhancing supply chain control and margin visibility.

announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger
announcements.detail: Receipt of Corrigendum Order in relation to the First Motion order passed by Hon'ble NCLT, Kolkata Bench on 09th April, 2026 in the matter of Scheme of Amalgamation
announcements.ai_summary: Somany Ceramics Limited announced on May 21, 2026, the receipt of a corrigendum Order dated April 24, 2026, on May 20, 2026. This corrigendum relates to the First Motion order passed by the Hon'ble NCLT, Kolkata Bench, on April 09, 2026. The order pertains to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Somany Bathware Limited (SBL), Somany Excel Vitrified Private Limited (SEVPL), and SR Continental Limited (SRCL) (collectively, the Transferor Companies) with Somany Ceramics Limited (the Transferee Company). The scheme is being implemented under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013, and the corrigendum order was uploaded on the NCLT website on May 20, 2026.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: XTGlobal Secures Its First Finance & Accounting Outsourcing Engagement in Ireland
announcements.ai_summary: XTGlobal Infotech Limited has announced a significant business expansion by securing its first Finance & Accounting Outsourcing engagement in Ireland. This marks the company's entry into the Irish market and is a key step in its strategy to broaden its IT Consulting and Finance & Accounting services across Europe. The engagement involves establishing and managing an offshore finance support function from XTGlobal's delivery centers in India, covering areas such as management accounts, accounts payable, employee onboarding, HR administration, and ongoing finance support. This new contract is valued at €11,600 and demonstrates XTGlobal's increasing capability to provide high-quality Finance & Accounting outsourcing services to international clients, reinforcing its global delivery model. The company views this as an important step in expanding its European presence and building long-term client relationships.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Dalmia Bharat Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.ai_summary: Dalmia Bharat Limited has announced the commencement of commercial production at its recently acquired plant in Chunar, Uttar Pradesh. This plant, a wholly owned material subsidiary of Dalmia Cement (Bharat) Limited (DCBL), has a Cement Grinding Capacity of 2.5 MTPA. Commercial production officially began on June 20, 2026. This development follows earlier communications regarding the acquisition on May 22, 2026, and May 29, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Patanjali Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Patanjali Foods Limited has received an e-mail communication dated June 20, 2026, from the Office of the Designated Officer (Food Safety) in Kannur District. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tata Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 21, 2026, titled "Tata Motors Limited (formerly TML Commercial Vehicles Limited) Strengthens eCV Leadership with over 3,400 Vehicle Orders Across Freight, Logistics and Passenger Mobility Segments".
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Motors Limited has announced securing over 3,400 electric commercial vehicle (eCV) orders across freight, logistics, and passenger mobility segments. This significant order book includes approximately 2,000 SCVs and pick-ups, 900 trucks, and 500 buses. These orders span diverse applications, from e-commerce and logistics to sectors like cement, steel, and mining, as well as inter- and intra-city passenger transport. This development signifies a shift towards scaled operational integration of EVs in India and strengthens Tata Motors' leadership in the zero-emission commercial mobility sector. The company is focused on delivering customized, end-to-end solutions to facilitate customer transition to zero-emission mobility.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Voltas Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Press Release -Voltas Crosses 1 Million AC Sales Milestone In FY 26-27.
announcements.ai_summary: Voltas Limited has announced a significant achievement, crossing the milestone of 1 million air conditioner sales in the financial year 2026-27. This landmark was reached in record time, reinforcing Voltas' position as India's No. 1 AC brand. The company attributes this success to strong consumer demand, customer trust, and its continuous focus on innovation, execution excellence, and market expansion. Voltas has recently refreshed its product portfolio with a clear segmentation strategy, offering differentiated products across premium, mid, and value segments to cater to a wider range of consumer needs. Enhanced consumer engagement through a high-impact communication strategy, including campaigns featuring AI-enabled products and celebrity endorsements, along with an extensive distribution and service network, have contributed to this growth. To celebrate this achievement, Voltas has launched a nationwide campaign titled “India’s First. Keeping India First.”, acknowledging the trust of over one million families who have chosen Voltas this season. Mr. Mukundan Menon, Managing Director of Voltas Limited, highlighted that achieving this milestone within the first three months of the financial year is a testament to consumer trust and the execution capabilities of their teams and channel partners.

announcements.ai_summary: CRISIL Limited has approved the amalgamation of its wholly-owned step-down subsidiaries, Crisil Canada Inc. and Crisil PriceMetrix Inc. Following the amalgamation, both entities will cease to exist and will form a single entity named "Crisil PriceMetrix Inc." Crisil PriceMetrix Inc., based in Toronto, is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) and data analytics provider specializing in wealth management, benchmarking, and pricing intelligence. Crisil Canada Inc. operates in the Research and Benchmarking business segment. The total income for Crisil PriceMetrix Inc. from November 7, 2025, to December 31, 2025, was USD 1,431,352, while Crisil Canada Inc.'s total income for the year ended December 31, 2025, was USD 51,215. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Anant Raj Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 21, 2026, titled "Anant Raj Board Approves Strategic Demerger to Create Two Focused Independent Listed Companies".
announcements.ai_summary: Anant Raj Limited's Board of Directors has approved a Composite Scheme of Arrangement on July 21, 2026, for a strategic demerger to create two focused independent listed companies. The restructuring aims to separate the rapidly growing Data Centre & Cloud Services business from its core real estate and infrastructure business. Under the proposed scheme, Anant Raj Limited will focus on real estate and infrastructure development, while Ashok Cloud Private Limited will be a dedicated, independently listed company for next-generation data centre and cloud services, including AI workload. The process involves consolidating all data centre and cloud operations under one entity before carving them out into Ashok Cloud Pvt Limited. The Composite Scheme requires approval by the Hon’ble NCLT under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Intimation of receipt of ANVISA Approval for Biosimilars Manufacturing Facility of CuraTeQ Biologics Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, CuraTeQ Biologics Private Limited, has received approval from ANVISA (Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária), the National Health Surveillance Agency of Brazil, for its biosimilars manufacturing facility in Hyderabad. This approval follows a GMP inspection conducted by ANVISA from May 11 to May 15, 2026, which the facility successfully completed for biological API and sterile products. The scope of the inspection covered four biosimilar products and assessed the mammalian and microbial drug substance manufacturing facility, prefillable syringe and vial filling facility, packaging and labelling facility, and QC testing and release laboratories. CuraTeQ's facility is already EMA and WHO certified, and this ANVISA approval enhances the company's capability to supply biosimilar products to the Brazilian and broader Latin American markets.

announcements.detail: Virtual Galaxy Infotech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 21, 2026, titled "Virtual Galaxy Infotech Secures Cyber Security Services Order from BDCC Bank: Long-standing Banking Relationship Expands with AI-Powered Cyber Security Operations Centre (C-SOC - SaaS) Platform".
announcements.ai_summary: Virtual Galaxy Infotech Limited has secured a significant cyber security services order from The Buldana District Central Co-operative Bank Ltd. (BDCC Bank). This new contract involves the implementation and managed services for a Cyber Security Operations Centre (C-SOC) Platform-as-a-Service (SaaS). The scope of work includes Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR), IT Service Management (ITSM), and 24x7 Security Operations Centre monitoring. announcements.ai_summary: Viviana Power Tech Limited announced the successful commissioning of its 400 kV Double-Circuit (D/C) LILO transmission line, serving a 323.4 MW wind park in Kachchh, Gujarat. The line was energised on July 10, 2026, completing a technically demanding scope within a compressed execution window. The project involved safely executing three major high-voltage intersections, including a 765 kV under-crossing and a ±500 kV HVDC under-crossing, along with live-line stringing, all achieved without a grid shutdown. This milestone underscores the company's speed, agility, and engineering depth in power transmission, distribution, and industrial EPC projects. The company also provided a QR code to view an on-site video of the commissioned line.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Release:  HCLTech report exposes widening AI divide with only 18% of enterprises seeing revenue impact despite near-universal adoption .
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Limited has released a report titled "The Blueprint for AI Leadership," which highlights a significant gap between AI adoption and the realization of business value. The study, conducted among 500 enterprise decision-makers, indicates that while 90% of organizations report AI transforming workflows and 91% cite improved data access, only 18% are experiencing substantial revenue impact from AI. The report identifies "AI Leaders" as those who systematically convert AI adoption into growth and innovation, often by integrating AI into business strategy, ensuring data readiness, and implementing workforce upskilling programs. In contrast, "AI Followers" are described as being trapped in incremental gains, focusing primarily on efficiency and cost reduction.

announcements.detail: NHPC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a advance copy of press release dated July 21, 2026, titled "Press Release- Incident at Teesta VI HE Project (500 MW), Sikkim".
announcements.ai_summary: NHPC Limited has issued a press release dated July 21, 2026, detailing an incident at its under-construction Teesta VI Hydroelectric Project (500 MW) in Sikkim. An unfortunate incident occurred at 1:04 PM on July 20, 2026, inside the Head Race Tunnel (HRT) due to a suspected explosion from trapped methane gas, generating dense fumes and toxic gases. The company's emergency response protocols were activated, and they are coordinating with district administration, NDRF, SDRF, and other agencies for rescue operations. A special rescue team from DG Mines-Safety has also arrived. As of the latest information, 25 personnel were trapped, with 10 casualties reported. NHPC's top management is on-site, coordinating efforts to stabilize the tunnel and evacuate trapped personnel. A detailed investigation will be conducted to determine the cause of the incident.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 21, 2026, titled "Glenmark Receives U.S. FDA Approval to Expand the Use of RYALTRIS® Nasal Spray for Children Aged 6 to Less Than 12 Years".
announcements.ai_summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited, through its subsidiary Glenmark Specialty S.A., announced on July 21, 2026, that the U.S. FDA has approved the expanded use of RYALTRIS® (olopatadine hydrochloride and mometasone furoate) Nasal Spray. The approval extends the use of the 665 mcg/25 mcg per spray product for the treatment of symptoms of Seasonal Allergic Rhinitis (SAR) in pediatric patients aged 6 to less than 12 years. This expands RYALTRIS®'s approval in the United States to include adults and pediatric patients aged 6 years and older. The approval was supported by a Phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study involving 446 children aged 6 to 11 years, which demonstrated improved nasal symptoms and good tolerability over a 14-day treatment period.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Shyam Metalics And Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 21, 2026, titled "Shyam Metalics Expands Pakuria Operations with Addition of Two Annealing Furnaces (25 MT & 30 MT) and Commissioning of 2300 mm Vertical Foil Separator (LGSS)".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited has expanded its Pakuria operations by commissioning two new Annealing Furnaces with capacities of 25 MT per annum and 30 MT per annum, respectively. These furnaces are expected to streamline the annealing process, improve production efficiency, and enhance overall product quality. Additionally, the company has commissioned a 2300 mm Vertical Foil Separator (LGSS), which enables accurate separation of Ultra-Light Gauge (ULG) and Light Gauge (LG) foil, catering to specialized customer requirements with thicknesses ranging from 6 to 15 microns. These upgrades, announced on April 21, 2026, aim to strengthen manufacturing capabilities and expand the company's value-added product offerings.

announcements.subject: Product launch
announcements.detail: Shadowfax Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Launch of Shadowfax 360
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Shadowfax Technologies Limited is launching "Shadowfax 360," a proprietary unified digital shipping portal aimed at Small and Medium Enterprises (SME) and Direct to Consumer (D2C) brands. This platform will allow businesses to register and commence shipping within minutes, providing access to a network covering over 15,000 pincodes across 2,500 cities. Key features include a transparent flat-rate billing model, one-click integrations with platforms like Shopify and WooCommerce, and an AI-driven RTO Predictor. The platform also offers fast Cash on Delivery (COD) remittance cycles to support SME liquidity. Shadowfax 360 imposes no minimum order requirements, making enterprise-grade logistics accessible to smaller businesses. The launch was announced on April 21, 2026.

The partnership aims to build a technology-led, asset-light Small Finance Bank by leveraging AI-driven automation and intelligent decision-making for lending capabilities. This initiative supports the bank's objective of expanding credit access across India through a digital operating model. The disclosure will also be available on the bank's website.

The transaction covers over 700 seats and signifies a substantial enterprise mandate for IndiQube. This deal reflects a growing trend where consulting and knowledge-led enterprises are seeking workspaces that offer faster team deployment, business continuity, operational flexibility, and an enhanced employee experience. North Bengaluru is emerging as a key office destination due to improving infrastructure and expanding commercial activity. The company highlighted that this transaction reinforces their view that managed workspaces are becoming a strategic outsourcing solution for enterprises.

announcements.subject: Moil Ltd - 533286 - Fixation Of Price Of Different Grades Of Manganese Ore

For the month of June 2026, prices of all Ferro grades of manganese ore with Manganese content of 44% and above have been decreased by 6% compared to prices prevailing since May 1, 2026. Similarly, prices of all other Ferro grades with Manganese content below 44%, Chemical grades, SMGR grades, and Fines have been decreased by 5%. Specific ore codes for Fines (BGF534, KDF393, UKF532) have been continued for June 2026, while the price of Ferro grade BG4584 has been decreased by 10%. The basic price of EMD remains Rs. 1,80,000/- PMT, and the basic price of EMD flakes is Rs. 1,71,000/- for June 2026.

announcements.subject: Karnataka Bank Ltd - 532652 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Karnataka Bank Conducts Annual Conference of Concurrent Auditors and Internal Auditors
announcements.ai_summary: Karnataka Bank successfully organized its Annual Conference of Concurrent Auditors and Internal Auditors for the Financial Year 2026-27 on May 20, 2026, in Mangaluru. The conference, held in a hybrid mode with the theme "Anticipate, Strengthen, Prevent," facilitated discussions on enhancing audit practices, risk management, regulatory compliance, and internal control. Shri K. Gururaj Acharya, Chairman of the Audit Committee, presided over the event. Special Guest Shri M. R. Venkatesh shared insights on the audit and regulatory landscape, while Managing Director & CEO Shri Raghavendra S. Bhat emphasized the auditors' role in promoting transparency and sustainable growth. Guest Speaker Shri Nandan Rao Iddya discussed evolving audit practices and governance standards.

announcements.subject: Mach Conferences And Events Ltd - 544248 - Newsletter For The Month Of June 2026
announcements.detail: Enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Mach Conferences And Events Ltd has released its monthly newsletter for June 2026, titled "The Montage." The newsletter provides updates on various developments within the travel and tourism sector. Key highlights include the clearance of a new cruise terminal at Samne Ghat in Varanasi, aimed at transforming the local tourism landscape. It also notes the resilience of Indian travelers, with 77% remaining confident about taking trips in the next three months. The newsletter reports a strong recovery in tourism in Kashmir, with a 20% increase in conversions and a 35% drop in cancellations. announcements.subject: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd - 500570 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release (Revised)
announcements.detail: We are enclosing herewith the revised Press Release titled ''Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited (formerly Tata Motors Limited) Monthly Sales - May 2026''.
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd (formerly Tata Motors Limited) has announced its monthly sales figures for May 2026. The company registered total sales of 59,790 units in May 2026, a significant increase of 42% compared to 42,040 units sold in May 2025. Domestic sales for Passenger Vehicles (PV) stood at 59,090 units, up 42% year-on-year, while PV International Business (IB) sales were 700 units, up 45%. The company's electric vehicle (EV) sales, including those of its subsidiary Tata Passenger Electric Mobility Limited, reached a new high of 10,517 units, an 85% increase from May 2025. Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd. attributes this strong performance to continued sales momentum and a surge in VAHAN registrations, which increased by over 50% year-on-year. The company has also strengthened its position as the second-largest player in the PV market based on VAHAN registrations.

announcements.subject: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd - 544225 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

announcements.subject: H.G. Infra Engineering Ltd - 541019 - Declaration Of Appointed Date By National Highways Authorities Of India

announcements.subject: Hyundai Motor India Ltd - 544274 - Disclosure Under SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("Listing Regulations")

announcements.subject: Puravankara Ltd - 532891 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

announcements.company: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd
announcements.subject: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd - 534091 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release is attached.
announcements.ai_summary: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd (MCX) has launched a new futures contract, ‘Silver 100’, to expand its existing portfolio of bullion contracts. This launch aims to provide hedging and investment opportunities for jewelers, SMEs, and retail investors in India's silver industry, allowing them to manage price volatility and hedge or take delivery in quantities aligned with their inventory needs. The ‘Silver 100’ futures contract offers flexibility through liquidity and smaller denominations, with ease of delivery, transparent making charges, and assured quality if delivery is taken at expiry. MCX is also inviting eligible domestic silver refiners to be empanelled as per MCX Good Delivery Norms to reduce dependence on imports and increase domestic silver recycling.

announcements.subject: Atishay Ltd - 538713 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: The Company as prime bidder in consortium with M/s. Gundal Business Private Limited has been awarded Rate contract work order by the State Election Commission , Karnataka ("Authority") for Printing of State Voter Identity Cards (SVIC) and other enclosures for the State Election commision, Karnataka.
announcements.ai_summary: Atishay Limited, as the Prime Bidder in a consortium with M/s Gundal Business Private Limited, has been awarded a Rate Contract Work Order by the State Election Commission, Karnataka. The contract is for the "Printing of State Voter Identity Cards (SVIC) and Other Enclosures for the State Election Commission, Karnataka." This Rate Contract is valid for one year from the issuance date, extending up to May 2027, with a potential extension of up to six months.
