announcements.subject: Deccan Gold Mines Ltd - 512068 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release titled "Deccan Gold Reports Major Expansion of Bhalukona Critical Minerals Discovery Amid Global Race for Resource Security".
announcements.ai_summary: Deccan Gold Mines Limited has announced a significant expansion of its Bhalukona Critical Minerals Discovery in Chhattisgarh. Drilling results confirm extensive nickel-copper-PGE (Platinum Group Elements) mineralization across a target zone extending up to 1.3 kilometers. Key intersections include 15 metres grading 0.31% Nickel Equivalent (NiEq) in Hole BJD-02 and 36 metres grading 0.23% Nickel Equivalent (NiEq) in Hole BJD-03. The company has completed approximately 1,500 metres of diamond drilling across nine holes, with assay results from additional holes pending. This discovery reinforces India's efforts to enhance domestic critical minerals capacity and resource security, with the company aiming to define a mineable resource and advance India's first Nickel-Copper-PGE mine.

This includes a differential duty demand of ₹3,76,00,969, a penalty of ₹3,76,00,969 under Section 114A, and a penalty of ₹50,00,000 under Section 114AA of the Customs Act. announcements.subject: Timken India Ltd - 522113 - CIVIL SUIT BEFORE HIGH COURT OF CALCUTTA
announcements.detail:
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we write to inform you about civil suit filed by Artech International Private Limited against the Company before High Court of Calcutta.  
Artech International Private Limited was appointed as Distributor of the Company through execution of Distributor Agreement(s). The Company vide notice dated 8 May, 2026 terminated Distributor Agreement(s) w.e.f. ....
announcements.ai_summary: Timken India Limited is facing a civil suit filed by Artech International Private Limited before the High Court of Calcutta. Artech International Private Limited was previously a distributor for Timken India Limited, whose distributor agreements were terminated by the company effective July 7, 2026, with a 60-day notice provided on May 8, 2026. At this stage, the company does not anticipate any financial implications from this legal action.

announcements.subject: Unified Data Tech Solutions Ltd - 544406 - Clarification Regarding Alteration In Object Clause Of Memorandum Of Association

This alteration is subject to shareholder approval. The company clarifies that its principal business remains in the IT data centre sector. The proposed amendment aims to include supporting activities related to disaster management, rescue, and safety equipment, such as AI-based surveillance systems and cameras, to explore business opportunities where these items are bundled with IT data centre solutions. The company also intends to offer training, consultancy, installation, maintenance, and technical support services for safety and disaster management equipment, as well as IT products. The Board believes this amendment will enhance flexibility and allow participation in emerging business opportunities in the disaster management and allied safety sectors. The amendment will proceed subject to shareholder approval via Postal Ballot and other necessary regulatory approvals.

announcements.subject: S.A.L. Steel Ltd - 532604 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulation 2015 Inter  Alia Availing Term Loan From Axis Finance Limited
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulation 2015 inter alia availing Term Loan from Axis Finance Bank Limited
announcements.ai_summary: S.A.L. Steel Ltd. disclosed on May 29, 2026, that it has availed a Term Loan from Axis Finance Limited, as per the sanction letter dated May 26, 2026. The funds from this loan will be utilized specifically for the re-payment of an Inter Corporate Deposit (ICD) owed to AIA Engineering Limited. The borrowing is secured by a mortgage on the company's entire immovable fixed assets and current assets, along with the hypothecation of all movable fixed assets located at Survey No. 245, Village Bharapar, Kutch Dist., Gujarat-382721. Additionally, the loan is backed by unconditional and irrevocable personal guarantees from Mahesh Kumar Agarwal and Kaustubh Agarwal, and an unconditional and irrevocable corporate guarantee from Sree Metaliks Limited, all remaining valid for the tenor of the facility.

announcements.subject: Kabra Drugs Ltd - 524322 - Undertaking For Non- Applicability Of Regulation 32 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 For The Quarter Ended On 31St March 2026.
announcements.detail: Non-Applicability of Regulations 32 of SEBI (LODR)
announcements.ai_summary: Kabra Drugs Ltd. submitted an undertaking on May 29, 2026, confirming the non-applicability of Regulation 32 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. Regulation 32 mandates listed entities to provide statements indicating deviations in the use of proceeds from public, rights, or preferential issues. Mr. Nanjappan Aravind, the Managing Director of Kabra Drugs Limited, certified that this regulation is not applicable to the company. The reason cited is that the company did not issue any shares through a public issue, rights issue, or preferential issue during the quarter ended March 31, 2026.

announcements.subject: Arihant Capital Markets Ltd - 511605 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure Under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Arihant Capital Markets Ltd. disclosed on May 28, 2026, that both BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited have levied monetary penalties against the company. BSE imposed a total monetary levy of ₹1,20,000/-, which includes a financial disincentive of ₹1,00,000/- and a monetary penalty of ₹20,000/-. NSE levied a monetary penalty of ₹24,83,506/- specifically for reversal trades conducted by a group of clients. The company has acknowledged the observations from the exchanges and has already implemented the necessary corrective and compliance measures. Arihant Capital Markets Ltd. further stated that these penalties do not have any material impact on its financial position, operations, or other business activities.

announcements.subject: CreditAccess Grameen Ltd - 541770 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR
announcements.detail: Announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR
announcements.ai_summary: CreditAccess Grameen Limited announced that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) imposed a penalty of ₹3.10 Lakh (Rupees Three Lakh Ten Thousand only) on the company. The RBI order was dated May 25, 2026, and received by the company via e-mail on May 29, 2026. The penalty was levied due to the absence of robust software capable of generating alerts for transactions inconsistent with the risk categorization and updated profiles of customers, which is essential for effective identification and reporting of suspicious transactions. The financial impact on the company is limited to the penalty amount of ₹3.10 Lakh.

announcements.subject: Kinetic Engineering Ltd - 500240 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release- Kinetic Engineering Limited accelerates Kinetic EV Growth with National Expansion and Industry Recognition.
announcements.ai_summary: Kinetic Engineering Limited (KEL) announced on May 29, 2026, significant growth in its electric vehicle arm, Kinetic Watts & Volts Ltd. (KWV), reporting an increase in revenue to ₹158 crores, up from ₹142 crores last year. The company's Kinetic DX EV scooter received the prestigious ‘Viewer’s Choice – EV Scooter of the Year’ award, presented by Hon’ble Union Minister Shri Nitin Gadkari, signifying strong market acceptance. Kinetic EV has expanded its dealership network to 20 outlets across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Haryana, Delhi, and Odisha. Furthermore, the company plans to establish 24 more dealerships by June-end, reinforcing its commitment to making trusted electric mobility accessible nationwide. This expansion reflects positive customer engagement and recognition from industry experts for the Kinetic DX EV's design and technology.

announcements.subject: Dalmia Bharat Ltd - 542216 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations') - Update On Capacity Addition
announcements.detail: Update on Capacity Addition
announcements.ai_summary: Dalmia Cement (Bharat) Limited (DCBL), a wholly-owned material subsidiary of Dalmia Bharat Limited, completed the acquisition of a cement undertaking on May 29, 2026. This acquisition includes plants located at Rewa (Madhya Pradesh), Churk, Chunar, and Sadwa (Uttar Pradesh), with a combined capacity of 5.2 MnTPA cement and 3.3 MnTPA clinker. The assets were acquired from Jaiprakash Associates Limited (JAL) and Adani Infra (India) Ltd., following a Business Transfer Agreement executed on May 21, 2026, with JAL having been acquired by the Adani Group under the Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code. With the consummation of this transaction, Dalmia Bharat's total cement capacity now stands at 54.7 MnTPA.

announcements.subject: Gamco Ltd - 540097 - Update Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Update in continuation of the disclosure made on 26th March, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: GAMCO Limited, formerly Visco Trade Associates Limited, provided an update on the sale of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Visco Advisory Private Limited (VAPL), on May 29, 2026. The Board of Directors approved an extension for the closure date of the Securities Subscription and Purchase Agreement for the transfer of 100% equity stake in VAPL. The revised closure date is now on or before July 15, 2026, extended from the previous deadline of on or before May 31, 2026, subject to customary conditions precedent. The buyer is BREP Asia III India Holding Co II Pte. Ltd., an entity owned by funds managed and/or advised by affiliates of Blackstone Inc. While the consideration has been agreed, it will be disclosed upon transaction completion due to pending conditions. For FY 2024-25, VAPL contributed Nil turnover and had a net worth of INR 9.17 Lakhs, representing approximately 0.09% of GAMCO's consolidated net worth.

announcements.subject: Suraj Ltd-$ - 531638 - Suraj Limited Launching A New Business In The Field Of Copper/Aluminium Recycling.
announcements.detail: Suraj Limited launching a new business in the field of Copper/Aluminium Recycling.
announcements.ai_summary: Suraj Limited announced on May 29, 2026, its decision to launch a new business venture. The company will be expanding its operations into the field of Copper/Aluminium Recycling. This intimation was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. No specific details regarding the investment, project timelines, or expected capacity of this new recycling business were disclosed in the announcement.

announcements.company: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd
announcements.subject: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd - 532898 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition
announcements.detail: Acquisition of Tumkur II RE Transmission Limited by POWERGRID under TBCB Route.
announcements.ai_summary: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID) announced on May 29, 2026, the acquisition of Tumkur II RE Transmission Limited (TRETL). POWERGRID was selected as the successful bidder under the Tariff Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) route, facilitated by Bid Process Coordinator PFC Consulting Limited (PFCCL). TRETL, incorporated on September 24, 2025, is the Project SPV established to develop the "Transmission System Strengthening at Tumkur-II for Integration of Additional RE Potential (2.7 GW)". The project will be executed on a build, own, operate and transfer (BOOT) basis

announcements.company: Shree Tirupati Balajee Agro Trading Company Ltd
announcements.subject: Shree Tirupati Balajee Agro Trading Company Ltd - 544249 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, As Amended ('SEBI Listing Regulations')- Issuance Of Corporate Guarantee
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding Issuance of Corporate Guarantee
announcements.ai_summary: Shree Tirupati Balajee Agro Trading Company Ltd's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 29, 2026, approved the issuance of a corporate guarantee. This guarantee, for an amount of Rs. 4.09 Crores, will be provided to Bank of Baroda, AB Road Branch, Indore. The purpose of the guarantee is to secure an Additional Working Capital Term Loan facility availed by Jagannath Plastics Private Limited, which is a Material Subsidiary of the Company. Mr. Binod Kumar Agrawal, a promoter of the listed entity, is considered interested in this transaction due to his directorship and shareholding in Jagannath Plastics Private Limited, although the corporate guarantee was provided on an arm’s length basis.

announcements.subject: Sampre Nutritions Ltd - 530617 - Voluntary Disclosure Regarding Acknowledgement Of A Long-Standing Business Association
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we are enclosing a commemorative communication issued by the Company acknowledging approximately thirty (30) years of business association with a long standing commercial counterparty. This announcement is being made voluntarily for information purposes only and does not relate to any new agreement, partnership, joint venture, strategic alliance, or any other material event.
announcements.ai_summary: Sampre Nutritions Ltd has voluntarily disclosed the acknowledgment of a long-standing business association with a customer entity, marking approximately thirty (30) years of partnership. This announcement is made for transparency and investor information purposes only. The company explicitly clarified that this disclosure does not pertain to any new agreements, partnerships, joint ventures, strategic alliances, or any other material events requiring disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. There are no changes to existing business arrangements, financial commitments, or revenue assurances resulting from this acknowledgment.

announcements.subject: Vardhman Textiles Ltd - 502986 - Update On Investment In Renew Green (MPR Four) Private Limited.
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed herewith intimation regarding investment in Renew Green (MPR Four) Private Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Vardhman Textiles Limited has made an investment of Rs. 24.46 crore in Renew Green (MPR Four) Private Limited on May 29, 2026. This investment involved subscribing to 4,64,926 Equity Shares, each with a face value of Rs. 10. Following this allotment, Vardhman Textiles Limited's shareholding in Renew Green (MPR Four) Private Limited will be 31.2%. This is in continuation of previous intimations regarding the execution of a Share Subscription and Shareholder’s Agreement and a Captive Power Purchase Agreement, and the approval of acquiring a 31.2% equity stake in Renew Green (MPR Four) Private Limited for a 19 MW AC Wind Solar Hybrid Power Plant.

announcements.subject: Rubicon Research Ltd - 544578 - Formulation And Adoption Of New Employee Benefit Plan
announcements.detail: The Board of Directors at its Meeting held on 29 May 2026, approved and recommended the formulation and adoption of New Employee Benefit Plan
announcements.ai_summary: Rubicon Research Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 29, 2026, approved the formulation, adoption, and implementation of the "Rubicon Research Limited - Employees Stock Option Scheme 2026". This new scheme is designed for granting Employee Stock Options to Eligible Employees of the Company and its subsidiaries. The Board authorized the grant of Stock Options aggregating 24,84,415, corresponding to 24,84,415 Equity Shares of INR 1/- each, which includes 6,72,162 balance options from the existing Scheme 2022. The options will be granted in one or more tranches, subject to approval from the Company's Members and other necessary regulatory/statutory approvals. The Board meeting commenced at 02:30 PM (IST) and concluded at 4:10 PM (IST).

announcements.subject: Paisalo Digital Ltd - 532900 - Intimation of Repayment of Commercial Paper (CP)
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding redemption of Commercial Paper
announcements.ai_summary: Paisalo Digital Ltd has fully redeemed and repaid Commercial Papers with a total maturity amount of Rs. 30,00,00,000 on May 29, 2026. The specific Commercial Papers redeemed are identified by Scrip Codes 731221 and ISIN No. INE420C14243, with a maturity date of May 29, 2026. This action is in accordance with SEBI Operational Circular no. SEBI/HO/DDHS/P/CIR/2021/613 dated August 10, 2021, as updated on April 13, 2022. The company has requested that this information be taken on record.

announcements.subject: State Bank of India - 500112 - Raising Of Senior/ Unsecured/ Fixed Rate / Reg S Bond
announcements.detail: Raising of USD 200 Mio Senior Unsecured Reg-S Fixed Rate Notes
announcements.ai_summary: State Bank of India (SBI) has priced USD 200 million Senior Unsecured Reg-S, Fixed Rate Notes. This issuance is a tap of its existing outstanding fixed rate bond, which is due on September 9, 2030 (ISIN XS3176783986). The original bond had a maturity of 5 years and carries a coupon of 4.50% payable semi-annually. The new bonds will be issued through SBI's London branch as of June 5, 2026. These notes are scheduled for listing on both the Singapore Stock Exchange and the NSE-IX Exchange, located in GIFT City.

announcements.subject: Mercury Ev-Tech Ltd - 531357 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015: Listing Of Equity Shares Of Re. 1/- Each On The National Stock Exchange Of India Limited ('NSE')
announcements.detail: Intimation under Reg 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015 regarding listing of equity shares on the NAtional Stock Exchange of India Limited(NSE)
announcements.ai_summary: Mercury Ev-Tech Ltd announced that its equity shares of Re. 1/- each will be listed and admitted to dealing on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) with effect from June 02, 2026, under the NSE Symbol “MERCURYEV”. A total of 189,973,058 equity shares, representing the entire issued, subscribed, and fully paid-up equity share capital, will be listed. The company received a reference letter from NSE dated May 29, 2026, confirming the listing. The shares will be available for trading in Series ‘BE’ and will remain in the Trade-for-Trade segment until further notice.

announcements.subject: HOMRE Ltd - 523387 - Intimation For Commencement Of Biomass Briquettes And Pellets Manufacturing Operations At Bharatpur, Rajasthan
announcements.detail: Intimation for Commencement of Biomass Briquettes and Pellets Manufacturing Operations at Bharatpur, Rajasthan
announcements.ai_summary: HOMRE Ltd has commenced manufacturing operations at its Biomass Briquettes and Pellets Manufacturing Facility located in Village Tehra Lodha, Tehsil and District Bharatpur, Rajasthan, effective May 28, 2026. This facility is strategically situated in an agriculturally rich region, providing cost-competitive access to raw materials like mustard husks and wheat straw. The company expects to ramp up plant utilization, build its order book, and develop a biomass fuel supply chain, targeting industrial and commercial customers transitioning to renewable fuel alternatives. HOMRE Limited will closely monitor operational ramp-up, feedstock procurement, plant utilization, and overall commercial performance.

announcements.subject: DCW Ltd - 500117 - Report Of Audit Committee And Independent Directors Of The Company Certifying Distribution Of Proceeds To Eligible Shareholders Of Fractional Shares Pursuant To Scheme Of Amalgamation
announcements.detail: Report of Audit Committee and Independent Directors
announcements.ai_summary: DCW Ltd has submitted the Reports of its Audit Committee and Independent Directors, certifying the distribution of proceeds to eligible shareholders of fractional shares pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation. This amalgamation involves Dhrangadhara Trading Company Private Limited and Sahu Brothers Private Limited with and into DCW Limited. The requisite payment to the shareholders for their fractional entitlements was made on May 25, 2026. The National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench, had sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation via an order pronounced on January 22, 2026. The information has been made available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: JSW Steel Ltd - 500228 - Updates Of Resolution Plan Of Colour Roof India Limited
announcements.detail: Updates of Resolution Plan of Colour Roof India Limited
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Steel Ltd has provided an update on the resolution plan of Colour Roof India Limited, where its wholly-owned subsidiary, JSW Steel Coated Products Limited (JSWSCPL), is involved. Following directions from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), JSWSCPL submitted a revised financial plan on May 13, 2026. On May 28, 2026, JSWSCPL received a letter of intent from the resolution professional, indicating that the Committee of Creditors has approved JSWSCPL's resolution plan. JSWSCPL remains the successful resolution applicant, and the implementation of the plan is subject to NCLT approval.

announcements.subject: Aries Agro Ltd - 532935 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Aries Agro Limited Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Aries Agro Ltd has released a press release detailing its strong performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The company reported a gross revenue from operations of ₹956.88 crores, an increase of 18.93% from ₹804.59 crores in FY 2025. Profit Before Tax (PBT) grew by 35.82% to ₹60.29 crores from ₹44.39 crores in FY 2025, and Profit After Tax (PAT) increased by 26.50% to ₹42.37 crores from ₹33.49 crores. EBITDA rose by 22.93% to ₹88.86 crores, with an improved EBITDA margin of 9.29% in FY 2026 from 8.98% in FY 2025. The company also enhanced operational discipline, reducing inventory holding days to 55 and trade receivable days to 35.

announcements.subject: Eveready Industries India Ltd - 531508 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 - Commencement Of Commercial Production Of Alkaline Battery Manufacturing Facility At Jammu
announcements.detail: Commencement of Commercial Production of Alkaline Battery manufacturing at Jammu
announcements.ai_summary: Eveready Industries India Ltd has announced the commencement of commercial production at its alkaline battery manufacturing facility located in Jammu. The facility began operations with effect from May 29, 2026. This development is in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The information regarding the commencement of production has also been made available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Life Insurance Corporation of India - 543526 - Update On Investor Meet
announcements.detail: This is to inform that the Corporation has informed about the update on Investor Meet held on May 29, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) provided an update on an Investor Meet held on May 29, 2026. Representatives of LIC attended group and one-on-one meetings with investors. The company has confirmed that no unpublished price-sensitive information was shared or discussed during these meetings. A corporate presentation shared at the meet is available on LIC's website at https://licindia.in/fy-2026-271. This information has been recorded and disseminated, and is also available on the company's website at www.licindia.in.

announcements.subject: Hindustan Copper Ltd - 513599 - General Update Regarding Significant Proposals Approved / Deliberated By The Board Of Directors Of Hindustan Copper Ltd In Its Meeting Held Today I.E. 29.05.2026
announcements.detail: General Update regarding significant proposals approved / deliberated by the Board of Directors of Hindustan Copper Ltd in its meeting held today i.e. 29.05.2026 is submitted.
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Copper Ltd (HCL) announced significant proposals approved by its Board of Directors in a meeting held on May 29, 2026. The Board approved awarding a contract to Lohum Materials Pvt. Ltd. for restarting the Gujarat Copper Plant on a revenue-sharing model for 20 years, extendable by 5 years. Additionally, MoUs were approved with Central University of South Bihar for collaborative industry-academia cooperation and with Engineers India Limited for various services. An agreement for Research & Development projects with CSIR -NML Jamshedpur was also approved. The Board also discussed exploring copper blocks in several states. The meeting commenced at 10:30 AM and concluded at 02:30 PM.

announcements.subject: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd - 590003 - Karur Vysya Bank Elevates Premium Banking Experience with Visa Credit Card Portfolio
announcements.detail: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd has submitted to BSE a copy of Press Release dated May 29, 2026 titled "Karur Vysya Bank Elevates Premium Banking Experience with Visa Credit Card Portfolio".
announcements.ai_summary: Karur Vysya Bank (KVB) announced on May 29, 2026, the launch of its new premium credit card portfolio on the Visa platform. This initiative aims to strengthen the bank's affluent banking proposition and deepen engagement with lifestyle-oriented customers. The portfolio includes four distinct card variants: Aura (Visa Platinum), Samara (Visa Signature), Altura (Visa Infinite), and Eternis (Visa Infinite). These cards are designed to offer curated travel, dining, and premium lifestyle benefits specifically to emerging affluent and affluent customers, including salaried professionals, self-employed individuals, and business owners. Shri Ramesh Babu,

announcements.subject: Ironwood Education Ltd - 508918 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: The Company has been appointed as the Development Manager for the development of project situated at Kalyan
announcements.ai_summary: Ironwood Education Ltd has been appointed as the Development Manager for a project named "Patel Colossus" located in Kalyan West, Thane, Maharashtra. The appointment is by M/s. Patel Group & Company, a Partnership Firm. Under this arrangement, Ironwood Education will provide development management services, including monitoring, development, marketing, construction, and sale of unsold inventory, excluding hotel blocks. The project involves the construction of approximately 5,70,000 sq. ft. of RERA carpet area, comprising commercial spaces and residential units. In consideration for these services, Ironwood Education will receive a Development Management Fee equivalent to 8% of the revenue generated from the sale of unsold commercial and residential inventory. This appointment aligns with the company's strategy to enhance its presence in development management and project execution within the real estate sector.

announcements.subject: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd - 532540 - Rumour verification - Regulation 30(11)
announcements.detail: Clarification on the article published by Moneycontrol.com
announcements.ai_summary: This announcement from Tata Consultancy Services Ltd (TCS) serves as a clarification regarding an article published by Moneycontrol.com on May 29, 2026. The article, titled “TCS loses part of RBC Canada technology mandate, 150 members to be ‘rebadged’,” contained claims that TCS has stated are "completely false and inaccurate." TCS explicitly informed the publication that the story was based on unverified and speculative sources and that there was "absolutely no truth" to the attributed claims. The company emphasized its long-standing and cherished partnership with Royal Bank of Canada. This clarification is for the information and record of the stock exchanges.

announcements.subject: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Ltd - 530001 - Putting Up 5000 TPA (100%) High Purity Grade Hydrogen Peroxide Plant At Dahej
announcements.detail: Putting up 5000 TPA (100%) Gigh Purity Grade Hydrogen Peroxide Plant at Dahej. For more details kindly refer attached file.
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 29, 2026, approved the establishment of a 5000 TPA (100%) High Purity Grade Hydrogen Peroxide Plant at Dahej, Gujarat. The estimated investment for this project is Rs. 67 Crores. This plant will enable the company to produce high-purity hydrogen peroxide for niche applications in semiconductor fabrication, solar cell manufacturing, and other advanced electronics. The project is planned to go on stream within 18 months from the zero date. The plant is expected to contribute approximately Rs. 42 crores to annual sales revenue. Funding will be from surplus internal operations, with borrowings to meet any potential gap.

announcements.subject: Indo Rama Synthetics (India) Ltd - 500207 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Demise
announcements.detail: Intimation of sad demise of Mr. Dhanendra Kumar, Independent Director of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Indo Rama Synthetics (India) Ltd regrets to inform about the sad demise of Mr. Dhanendra Kumar, an Independent Director of the Company, on Thursday, May 28, 2026. Consequently, he has ceased to be a Director on the Board and its committees from that date. The company states that his demise will be an irreparable loss and expresses condolences to his family. The requisite disclosures as per Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, and SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/1/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, are enclosed.

announcements.subject: IIFL Finance Ltd - 532636 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment
announcements.detail: IIFL Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of Perpertual Debt Instruments on Private Placement basis
announcements.ai_summary: IIFL Finance Limited has announced the allotment of Perpetual Debt Instruments on a private placement basis. The Finance Committee of the Board of Directors, through a resolution dated May 29, 2026, approved the allotment of 100 Perpetual, Unsecured, Listed, Rated, Debentures in the nature of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs). Each NCD has a face value of INR 1,00,00,000 (Indian Rupees One Crore Only), aggregating to a total issue size of INR 100,00,00,000 (Indian Rupees One Hundred Crores Only). These NCDs are in dematerialised form and carry an interest rate of 9.90% per annum. The NCDs are proposed to be listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The instruments are perpetual in nature, subject to the company's call option after at least 10 years from the allotment date, with prior RBI approval. The interest payment schedule includes annual payments starting from May 29, 2027.

announcements.subject: B-Right Realestate Ltd - 543543 - Revision In Lot Size Of Equity Shares
announcements.detail: Lot size of the Company has been reduced from 400 Equity Shares to 200 Equity Shares
announcements.ai_summary: The lot size for B-Right Realestate Ltd's equity shares has been reduced from 400 shares to 200 shares. This revision, effective from May 29, 2026, is intended to improve market liquidity and encourage greater participation from retail investors. The company has informed the exchange about this change as per SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. This adjustment is a procedural update by the exchange and does not involve any new issuance or transaction of shares by the company itself.

announcements.subject: Bank of Maharashtra - 532525 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Interest Rates Updates
announcements.detail: Revision in MCLR Rates
announcements.ai_summary: Bank of Maharashtra has announced a revision in its Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR). Effective May 30, 2026, the MCLR for the overnight tenor will be revised to 7.50% from the existing 7.65%. The MCLR for the one-month tenor will be increased to 8.30% from 8.20%. The MCLR rates for three months, six months, and one year will remain unchanged at 8.55%, 8.70%, and 8.85% respectively. This update is being provided pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: STL Networks Ltd - 544395 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI Listing Regulation
announcements.detail: Announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulation
announcements.ai_summary: STL Networks Ltd has provided clarifications to the Stock Exchanges regarding its Preferential Issue, as requested, in continuation of their communication dated May 14, 2026. The company will utilize 25% of the total issue proceeds for General Corporate Purposes, not exceeding 25% of the Issue Size. Until the complete utilization of funds as per the objects specified in the Postal Ballot Notice dated April 18, 2026, the company will invest the issue proceeds in permitted instruments, including mutual funds and fixed deposits with Scheduled Commercial Banks. This update will also be available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Shalibhadra Finance Ltd - 511754 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Shalibhadra Finance Ltd Strong FY26 Performance, Poised for Next Phase of Growth
announcements.ai_summary: Shalibhadra Finance Ltd has released a press release detailing its strong performance for the Financial Year 2026 and its strategic plans for future growth. The company reported a Total Assets Under Management (AUM) of ₹219.66 Crores, a 24.81% year-on-year increase, and Profit After Tax (PAT) of ₹19.48 Crores, up 21.67% year-on-year. Net Interest Income (NII) grew by 15.03% YoY to ₹35.95 Crores. The company plans to expand its AUM by focusing on secured lending products, technology, and distribution, including venturing into Micro LAP of under ₹5 lakh and other segments like Home Loans and Property Loans. Shalibhadra Finance aims to achieve an AUM of ₹1000 crores without further equity dilution, by raising debt through Term Loans or NCDs, leveraging its net worth of ₹172 crores.

announcements.subject: NTPC Ltd - 532555 - Declaration Of Commercial Operation Of Second Part Capacity Of 34.4 MW Out Of 176 MW Capacity Of NTPC'S Solar PV Project At Ramagundam
announcements.detail: Disclosure attached.
announcements.ai_summary: NTPC Ltd has announced the declaration of commercial operation for the second part capacity of 34.4 MW out of its 176 MW Solar PV Project at Ramagundam, Telangana. This capacity is declared on Commercial Operation effective from 00:00 Hrs. of May 29, 2026. Following this declaration, NTPC group's total installed capacity has reached 90,807 MW, and its commercial capacity stands at 88,927 MW. This update is in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: RateGain Travel Technologies Ltd - 543417 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: RateGain Travel Technologies Ltd has released "The APMEA Direct Booking Friction Report 2026," highlighting critical issues impacting direct bookings for hotels in the Asia-Pacific, Middle East, and Africa (APMEA) region. The report, issued on May 29, 2026, reveals that a significant number of hotels (42%) are not appearing on the first page for unbranded search queries, making them invisible to potential travelers. Furthermore, 63% of properties list higher rates on their own websites than on Online Travel Agencies (OTAs), actively driving customers to third-party platforms. The report also points out that 72% of hotel websites fail the 3-second load benchmark, with average mobile load times reaching 4.1 seconds, and guests often require an average of 4 clicks to confirm a reservation, exceeding the global benchmark of 3.

announcements.subject: Eco Recycling Ltd - 530643 - Business Updates
announcements.detail: Ecoreco is pleased to share that Company has been shortlisted/empaneled for certain interaction s and industry Participation initiatives with the Ministry of Mines and Jawaharlal Nehru Aluminum Research Development and Design Centre (JNARDDC) relating to critical Minerals and recycling ecosystem development.
announcements.ai_summary: Eco Recycling Ltd (Ecoreco) has been shortlisted and empanelled for interactions and industry participation initiatives with the Ministry of Mines and Jawaharlal Nehru Aluminium Research Development and Design Centre (JNARDDC). These initiatives are related to critical minerals and the development of a recycling ecosystem. This development aligns with the QUAD Critical Minerals Initiative and India's focus on critical mineral security, presenting long-term opportunities for the organized recycling sector. Ecoreco, with over two decades of experience in e-waste and lithium-ion battery recycling, believes urban mining will be crucial for India's strategic materials security. The company is evaluating opportunities in the critical minerals recovery value chain. However, Ecoreco clarifies that no definitive commercial contract, financial commitment, or material order has been finalized under these initiatives as of the reporting date.

The Subarnrekha Canal Division, Water Resource Department Ghatshila, Jharkhand, has reassessed its earlier demand of Rs. 216 crore. Based on data provided by the company, the department has now estimated the total outstanding amount from 2000-01 to October 2025 at Rs. 92.166 crore, as conveyed in a letter dated May 19, 2026, and received on May 27, 2026. announcements.subject:
Tata Consultancy Services Ltd - 532540 - Press Release - TCS Partners With Mistral; Becomes The First Global Systems Integrator (GSI) To Bring Mistral Forge To

announcements.detail: Press Release - TCS Partners with Mistral; becomes the first Global Systems Integrator (GSI) to bring Mistral Forge to enterprises worldwide
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has announced a strategic partnership with Mistral, a leading AI company, on May 28, 2026. Under this agreement, TCS becomes the first Global Systems Integrator (GSI) to offer Mistral Forge, an advanced system for enterprises to build AI models using their proprietary data. This collaboration aims to help global enterprises and governments design, fine-tune, and deploy domain-specific AI systems with enhanced customer control. The abstract, titled "A phase 1 study to evaluate safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of LNP8701 (SOS1 inhibitor) in subjects with metastatic solid tumors," has been published and details findings from an ongoing first-in-human study. announcements.subject: Wockhardt Ltd - 532300 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of Listing Regulations, please find enclosed Press Release - "Indian drug regulator grants marketing authorization to Wockhardt''s breakthrough antibiotic , ZAYNICH (Zidebactum/ Cefepime), for treatment of complicated urinary tract infections including pyelonephritis with concurrent Gram- negative bacteremia"
announcements.ai_summary: Wockhardt Ltd has received marketing authorization from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) for its indigenously developed antibiotic, ZAYNICH® (Zidebactam/Cefepime). This approval is for the treatment of adult patients (≥18 years) with complicated urinary tract infections (cUTI), including pyelonephritis, and concurrent Gram-negative bacteremia. The authorization is based on the pivotal ENHANCE-1 Phase 3 clinical trial, which demonstrated that ZAYNICH® was statistically superior to meropenem. In the trial, 89% (250/281) of patients treated with ZAYNICH® achieved the primary composite endpoint of clinical cure and microbiological eradication at the test-of-cure visit, compared to 68.4% (93/136) in the meropenem arm, representing a treatment difference of 20.6% in favor of ZAYNICH®. Notably, among patients with concomitant bacteremia at baseline, composite response rates at test-of-cure were 89% (16/18) for ZAYNICH® versus 44% (4/9) for meropenem.

announcements.detail: Disclosure of Deemed Material event under Regulation 31A(8)(b) of SEBI(LODR) Regulations 2015 for approval of Reclassification application received from the 4 Promoter and promoter group members.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Jupiter Infomedia Ltd, in a meeting held on May 27, 2026, approved a preferential issue of warrants to raise up to Rs. 50 crores. The company also plans to alter its Memorandum of Association to add new business objects related to IT solutions, AI, machine learning, IoT, and data analytics, among others. Additionally, the authorized share capital will be increased to Rs. 20,00,00,000, divided into 2,00,00,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 each. The registered office will be shifted from Maharashtra to Gujarat, and a branch office will be opened in Ahmedabad. The board also approved the reclassification request from promoter and promoter group members, including Mr. Umesh Vasantlal Modi and Mrs. Manisha Umesh Modi. Ms. Payal Dhamecha and Mr. Ankit Dave were appointed as Independent Director and Professional Executive Director, respectively, subject to shareholder approval.

announcements.subject: Bajaj Steel Industries Ltd - 507944 - Closure Of Wholly Owned Subsidiary In Uganda
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015, this is to inform you that the Board of Directros of the Company at its board meeting held on 27 May, 2026 has approved the Proposal for closure of its wholly owned subsidiary namely Bajaj Steel Industries(U) Limited incorporated in Uganda subject to compliance witb applicable laws and regulatory  requirements. The detailed disclosure is enclosed herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Bajaj Steel Industries Limited, in their meeting on May 27, 2026, approved the proposal to wind up its wholly-owned subsidiary, Bajaj Steel Industries (U) Limited, incorporated in Uganda. This decision is subject to compliance with all applicable laws and regulatory requirements in Uganda. The subsidiary's contribution to the company's turnover and net worth was deemed not material. The closure is due to continuous losses incurred by the subsidiary over the past few years, making its operations no longer financially feasible or commercially viable. The winding up is not expected to have any material adverse impact on the listed entity's operations or financials.

announcements.subject: Emkay Global Financial Services Ltd - 532737 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment
announcements.detail: Intimation of Allotment of 1,00,000 Equity Shares pursuant to exercise of warrants at its Management Committee meeting held on 27th May, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited's Management Committee, at its meeting held on May 27, 2026, approved the allotment of 1,00,000 equity shares of face value Rs 10/- each. These shares were allotted to Mr. Prakash Kacholia, a promoter, upon the exercise of 1,00,000 convertible warrants. This follows a previous exercise by Mr. Prakash Kacholia in April 2026, where he converted 1,00,000 warrants into 1,00,000 equity shares. The company had initially allotted a total of 95,00,000 convertible warrants on October 24, 2025, via a preferential allotment, at an issue price of Rs 239.50/- per warrant, with an initial subscription of Rs 59.875/- per warrant.

announcements.subject: Monte Carlo Fashions Ltd - 538836 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Regarding Investment In MCFL Energy Projects Private Limited, Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company
announcements.detail: Investment in MCFL Energy Projects private Limited- wholly owned subsidary company
announcements.ai_summary: Monte Carlo Fashions Limited announced on May 27, 2026, a further investment of Rs 40,00,000 (Rupees Forty Lacs Only) in MCFL Energy Projects Private Limited, its wholly-owned subsidiary. This investment involved the allotment of 4,00,000 equity shares, each with a face value of Rs 10/-. MCFL Energy Projects Private Limited was incorporated on January 19, 2026, and its authorized and paid-up share capital is Rs 50,00,000. With this additional investment, the total amount invested by Monte Carlo Fashions Limited in the subsidiary now stands at Rs 50,00,000 (Rupees Fifty Lacs Only). The subsidiary operates in the Renewable Energy – Solar Power Generation industry, and the promoter/promoter group does not have any interest in it.

announcements.subject: Gail (India) Ltd - 532155 - Extension Of Additional Charge Of The Post Of Director (Projects),                        GAIL (India) Limited
announcements.detail: This is to inform that Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MoP&NG) vide Letter No. CA-31022/1/2026-CA-PNG (55479) dated¬¬¬ 27.05.2026 has approved the extension of additional charge of the post of Director (Projects) GAIL (India) Limited assigned to Shri Deepak Gupta, Chairman & Managing Director (CMD), GAIL (India) Limited for a further period of six months w.e.f. 01.06.2026, or till assumption of charge of the post by the regular incumbent, ....
announcements.ai_summary: GAIL (India) Limited announced on May 27, 2026, that the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MoP&NG) has approved the extension of an additional charge to Shri Deepak Gupta, the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of GAIL (India) Limited. Shri Gupta will continue to hold the additional charge of the post of Director (Projects) for a further period of six months. This extension is effective from June 01, 2026, or until a regular incumbent assumes charge of the post, or until further orders, whichever is the earliest. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: RACL Geartech Ltd - 520073 - Intimation Of Achievement Of Historic Consolidated Revenue Milestone
announcements.detail: Intimation of Achievement of Historic Consolidated Revenue Milestone
announcements.ai_summary: RACL Geartech Limited announced on May 27, 2026, the achievement of a historic business milestone by recording its highest-ever consolidated revenue. For the financial year ended March 31, 2026, the company achieved a consolidated revenue of ₹512.42 Crores. This accomplishment reflects the company's sustained focus on precision engineering, operational excellence, technological advancement, and strong relationships with leading global automotive customers. Having started with a modest revenue base, the company has evolved into a globally recognized supplier of high-precision automotive components. This milestone is considered an important step in its growth trajectory, reinforcing its commitment to higher standards of performance, innovation, and value creation.

announcements.subject: Vadilal Industries Ltd-$ - 519156 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Update on disclosure dated February 21, 2026, on Company''s assessment of its Compliance with Certain Statutory Provisions
announcements.ai_summary: Vadilal Industries Ltd provided an update on May 27, 2026, regarding its assessment of compliance with the Minimum Wages Act, 1948, and the Code on Wages, 2019 ("Wage Codes"). The Board had constituted a sub-committee and commissioned an independent "Big 6" accounting firm to conduct a comprehensive assessment. The firm reviewed the company's payment of minimum wages to its contract workmen from April 2025 to March 2026 across all plant locations: Bareilly, Dharampur, and Pundhra. Based on this assessment, the Independent Firm observed no material non-compliance with the Wage Codes and no wage shortfalls at the individual employee level. The company also reviewed its direct (on-roll) employees and found no non-compliance, and the Board has directed the implementation of enhanced operational best practices, including digitalization.

announcements.company: State Trading Corporation of India Ltd
announcements.subject: State Trading Corporation of India Ltd - 512531 - Disclosure Of Event Or Information Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI(LODR) Regulations,2015.
announcements.detail: Please find intimation of levy of fine by BSE vide their email dated 27.05.2026 for  Rs 11,91,800/- for non compliance of provisions of Regulation 17,18,19 and 20 of SEBI(LODR), Regulation2015 for the period ended March 31,2026.
announcements.ai_summary: The State Trading Corporation of India Ltd received an email from BSE Limited on May 27, 2026, intimating the levy of a fine of Rs 11,91,800/-. This fine was imposed for non-compliance with provisions of Regulation 17(1), 17(1A), 17(2), 17(2A), 18(1), 19(1)/19(2), and 20(2)/20(2A) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The non-compliance specifically relates to not having the requisite number of Independent Directors on the Board of STC for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The company secretary is CS Ritu Bhatia.

announcements.subject: Prime Focus Ltd - 532748 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, As Amended ('LODR Regulations')
announcements.detail: Update on Supreme Court order dated May 25, 2026 in Civil Appeal No. 7946 of 2026 and NCLAT proceedings in relation to Comp. App. (AT) (Ins.) No. 850 of 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Prime Focus Ltd. provided an update on May 27, 2026, regarding ongoing legal proceedings. The Hon’ble Supreme Court of India, on May 25, 2026 (order made available May 26, 2026), dismissed Civil Appeal No. 7946 of 2026 filed by Raspalfa Services Private Limited, which challenged an interim order by the NCLAT. The Supreme Court observed that interference with the NCLAT's interim order, which stayed an NCLT order and directed the Interim Resolution Professional not to take further steps, was not required at this stage. Subsequently, on May 27, 2026, the NCLAT dismissed I.A. No. 3835 of 2026, filed by Raspalfa Services Private Limited to vacate the NCLAT’s interim order, as it was not pressed in light of the Supreme Court's decision. The Hon’ble NCLAT has scheduled the main appeal for further hearing on July 9, 2026.

announcements.subject: Zydus Lifesciences Ltd - 532321 - Update
announcements.detail: Update
announcements.ai_summary: Zydus Lifesciences Ltd. announced on May 27, 2026, that its wholly owned subsidiary, Zydus Therapeutics, received Priority Review status from the US Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) for the New Drug Application (NDA) of saroglitazar. The proposed indication for saroglitazar is the treatment of Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) in adults, either in combination with ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) for those with inadequate response, or as monotherapy for UDCA-intolerant patients. The US FDA has set a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of November 27, 2026, for a decision on the NDA. This marks a crucial step towards potential market entry in the US for this therapy.

announcements.subject: Bhagyanagar India Ltd - 512296 - Intimation Pursuant To Regulation 30 Read With Schedule III Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) 2015
announcements.detail: To inform that company has received show cause notice.
announcements.ai_summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited has received a Show Cause Notice from the Directorate General of Goods and Service Tax Intelligence (DGGI) on May 26, 2026. The notice alleges "Irregular Availment of ITC" and proposes a tax liability of Rs. 17.50 Crores on the company, along with interest for its Managing Director, Shri Devendra Surana. The company has paid Rs. 17.50 Crores under protest towards the alleged tax liability. The company will be filing a reply to the Show Cause Notice within the prescribed time.

announcements.subject: Swiggy Ltd - 544285 - Clarification Regarding The Proposed Amendments To The Articles Of Association
announcements.detail: Clarification regarding the proposed amendments to the Articles of Association
announcements.ai_summary: Swiggy Limited has issued a clarification on May 27, 2026, regarding proposed amendments to its Articles of Association. This follows previous intimations on May 13 and May 21, 2026, and the filing of voting results on May 21, 2026. The special resolution for the amendments received 72.36% shareholder approval, falling short of the required 75% threshold by 2.64%. The company emphasizes its commitment to governance and is working with shareholders to address concerns. The proposed amendments were intended to facilitate Swiggy's objective of qualifying as an Indian Owned and Controlled Company (IOCC) under Indian foreign exchange laws, which requires resident Indian shareholding to exceed 50% along with regulatory and shareholder approvals.

announcements.subject: Emmbi Industries Ltd - 533161 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release attached
announcements.ai_summary: Emmbi Industries Ltd reported a record financial year for FY26, with consolidated revenue growing by 12.4% year-over-year to ₹1,532.40 crore. Standalone export sales showed significant growth of 27.25% year-over-year, reaching ₹341.60 crore, despite industry-wide export contractions. Consolidated Profit After Tax (PAT) for the full year grew by 26.6% year-over-year to ₹17.89 crore, with Q4 PAT surging by 65.4% year-over-year to ₹12.43 crore. Consolidated Profit Before Tax (PBT) before exceptional items increased by 45.0% year-over-year. Earnings Per Share (EPS) rose to ₹4.22 from ₹3.67, a 15.0% increase. The company also highlighted its commitment to sustainability, with approximately 20% of raw material consumed sourced from post-consumer and post-industrial polymer waste, marketed under the brand Reclaim 30.

announcements.subject: Choksi Asia Ltd - 530427 - General Update - Intimation Of Change Of Domain Of Email ID Of The Company.
announcements.detail: General Update - Intimation of change of domain of email ID of the Company to @choksi-asia.com.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Choksi Asia Ltd (formerly Choksi Imaging Limited) has announced a change in its official email ID domain. Effective May 27, 2026, all company communications will be sent from the new domain @choksi-asia.com. This follows a previous communication on May 7, 2026, regarding a change in the company's website. The old email domain will be discontinued, and emails sent to it may not be accessible after this change. The company has provided the new email domain for all future correspondence.

announcements.subject: RITES Ltd - 541556 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release titled "RITES & Crisil sign MoU to offer data driver solutions" dated 27.05.2026
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: RITES Ltd has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Crisil Limited on May 27, 2026, to offer data-driven solutions. This partnership aims to combine RITES' expertise in transport infrastructure and engineering consultancy with Crisil's strengths in data intelligence, analytics, and market insights. The collaboration will explore consultancy assignments and infrastructure opportunities across various sectors, including railways, metro rail, highways, airports, and energy, both in India and internationally. The focus will be on enhancing analytical and advisory support for infrastructure projects through market intelligence, data validation, financial due diligence, valuation support, and the development of analytical models.

announcements.subject: Godfrey Phillips India Ltd - 500163 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 - Contract Manufacturing Agreement
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 - Contract Manufacturing Agreement
announcements.ai_summary: On May 27, 2026, Godfrey Phillips India Ltd announced a significant development in its manufacturing operations by entering into a Contract Manufacturing Agreement with Polisetty Somasundaram Tobacco Products (India) Pvt. Ltd. This agreement, effective from today, will see Polisetty manufacture and deliver cigarettes and other tobacco products for Godfrey Phillips India Ltd at its own facility. The domestic agreement outlines that Polisetty will exclusively produce these products according to Godfrey Phillips India Ltd's specifications, using materials provided by the latter. In consideration for these services, Godfrey Phillips India Ltd will pay Polisetty a 'Manufacturing Fee' composed of fixed and variable components. Polisetty is obligated to establish the manufacturing facility and secure necessary licenses within twelve months. The agreement has an initial term of nine years and includes standard warranties and indemnities.

announcements.subject: Linc Ltd-$ - 531241 - Strategy Presentation For Half Year Ended 31St March, 2026
announcements.detail: Strategy Presentation for half year ended 31st March, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Linc Limited has released a Strategy Presentation for the half-year ended March 31, 2026. The presentation covers various aspects of the company's strategy, including industry outlook, about Linc, recent launches, participation in expos, and a financial snapshot. The document also includes a safe harbor statement, cautioning investors about forward-looking statements and the inherent risks and uncertainties associated with them. The company undertakes no obligation to publicly update or revise these statements.

announcements.subject: Linde India Ltd - 523457 - Commencement Of Commercial Production At 1450 Tonnes Per Day Air Separation Unit At Jindal Stainless Ltd. Works At Kalinganagar
announcements.detail:
Please find enclosed our letter no. Sect/42 dated 27 May 2026 in connection with commencement of commercial production at the Company''s new Air Separation Unit at Jindal Stainless Ltd. at Kalinganagar (JSL).

You are requested to please take the above on record.
announcements.ai_summary: Linde India Limited has announced the commencement of commercial production at its new Air Separation Unit (ASU) located at Jindal Stainless Ltd. (JSL) works in Kalinganagar. This facility is designed to supply 1,450 tonnes per day of Oxygen, 1,800 tonnes per day of Nitrogen, and 64 tonnes per day of Argon to JSL. The ASU also has additional capacity to serve the merchant market. This development signifies an expansion of the company's operational capabilities and its commitment to serving key industrial clients. This announcement is made in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Grovy India Ltd - 539522 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Acquisition of a New Premium Luxury Residential Project
announcements.ai_summary: Grovy India Limited has announced the acquisition of a new premium luxury residential project located in Defence Colony, New Delhi. This acquisition strengthens the company's footprint in a prestigious and highly sought-after South Delhi neighbourhood. The newly acquired project has an estimated development area of approximately 15,000 sq. ft. This aligns with Grovy India Limited's objective of developing high-quality, premium residential spaces that embody modern design, luxury, and refined urban aesthetics. The company expects this development to enhance its project portfolio and contribute positively to its long-term growth and standing in the premium real estate segment.

announcements.subject: Jyoti Structures Ltd - 513250 - Intimation On Direction From Hon'Ble National Company Law Appellate Tribunal, New Delhi Bench
announcements.detail: Intimation on Direction from Hon''ble National Company Law Tribunal, New Delhi Bench
announcements.ai_summary: Jyoti Structures Limited has received a direction from the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT), New Delhi Bench, dated May 26, 2026. The NCLAT has allowed the company's appeal against an earlier order from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) dated February 16, 2026, concerning a contempt matter related to the release of non-fund-based limits. The NCLAT has directed that the company can request the release of these limits from appellant banks, and the banks must respond within one month of receiving such a request. If the company is aggrieved by the banks' response, it has liberty to revive its contempt application before the NCLT.

announcements.subject: JSW Steel Ltd - 500228 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: JSW Steel commences project development of 13.2 MTPA integrated Steel Plant at Paradeep, Odisha
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Steel has commenced the project development of a new 13.2 MTPA integrated steel plant at Paradeep, Odisha. This project represents one of the company's largest investments, with an estimated outlay of approximately ₹65,000 crore to be invested in phases. The plant, spread across nearly 2,950 acres, is strategically located with strong port connectivity and robust logistics infrastructure. This expansion reinforces JSW Steel's commitment to strengthening India's manufacturing capabilities and contributing to Odisha's industrial growth. The project has been master-planned for future capacity expansion based on market demand.

announcements.subject: Trident Ltd - 521064 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Trident Limited has informed the exchange regarding a press release dated May 27, 2026, titled " TEXPROCIL HONOURS TRIDENT - GOLD TROPHY IN THE CATEGORY OF HIGHEST GLOBAL EXPORTS."
announcements.ai_summary: Trident Limited has been honored with the Gold Trophy in the "Highest Global Exports" category by The Cotton Textiles Export Promotion Council (TEXPROCIL) at the TEXPROCIL Export Awards 2023–24, held on May 25, 2026. This recognition highlights the company's significant export performance and its established position in the global textile industry. The award ceremony was attended by the Hon’ble Union Minister of Finance & Corporate Affairs, Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman. Trident Limited is a vertically integrated manufacturer of textiles, paper, and chemicals.

announcements.subject: Goodluck India Ltd - 530655 - Order Bags
announcements.detail: Goodluck Defence and Aerospace Limited subsidiary of Goodluck India Limited has received a Order to supply empty shells
announcements.ai_summary: Goodluck India Limited's subsidiary, Goodluck Defence and Aerospace Limited, has received an order to supply 20,000 empty 155mm shells in Ready to Fill Conditions. The order is for a domestic entity and is valued at approximately Rs. 52.20 Crore. The company is expected to manufacture and deliver these shells within 3 months, subject to requisite approvals from the competent authority. This order falls under the 'Deliverable Base' nature.

announcements.subject: NHC Foods Ltd - 517554 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting For Approval Of Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds ("Fccbs") And Other Related Matters
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting for approval of Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds ("FCCBs") and other related matters
announcements.ai_summary: NHC Foods Limited's Board of Directors has approved the issuance of Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds (FCCBs) with an aggregate amount not exceeding US$ 27 million. The bonds will carry a coupon rate of 1.5% and will be issued at a 10% discount. The issuance is an international offering, and the bonds are expected to be credited to subscribers on or about May 29, 2026, subject to receipt of funds and satisfaction of conditions precedent. The company has already obtained consent from its members through a postal ballot on March 19, 2026, and in-principle approval from BSE Limited on April 28, 2026. The issue of FCCBs opened on May 27, 2026, with the same date designated as the 'Relevant Date' for determining the regulatory floor price in accordance with the FCCBs Guidelines.

announcements.subject: Mphasis Ltd - 526299 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Mphasis Limited has issued a press release announcing the launch of Mphasis Tria, a first-of-its-kind Enterprise Agency Platform. This platform is designed to enable enterprises to move beyond AI experimentation and achieve coordinated decision-making and measurable business outcomes across their operations, technology, and commercial functions. Mphasis Tria unifies enterprise insight, foresight, and execution, powered by its Governed Front2BackTM approach, accelerating Mphasis' evolution into a platform-led AI enterprise. The platform connects enterprise knowledge, causal reasoning, and agentic execution to deliver Agency AppliedTM, transforming enterprise intelligence into governed, accountable, and outcome-oriented actions at scale. Alongside Mphasis Tria, the company also unveiled two market-facing product lines: Mphasis ModernizeTM and Mphasis OptimizeTM, which will be used for enterprise transformation engagements.

announcements.subject: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Ltd - 544447 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Capacity Addition
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Capacity Addition
announcements.ai_summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited has announced a significant capacity addition, expanding its operational footprint by 4,92,661 Square Feet in Bengaluru. This expansion is planned to be completed within May 2026 and requires an estimated investment of INR 70.00 Crores. The funding for this expansion will be sourced from internal accruals or issue proceeds. The rationale behind this move is to support business growth and increase the company's market presence. As of March 31, 2026, Smartworks had an existing leased capacity of 13.7 Million Sq. Ft. and an operational capacity of 10.1 Million Sq. Ft., with a utilization rate of 82% for its operational capacity.

announcements.subject: Subam Papers Ltd - 544267 - Revised Cost Of Project For Preferential Issue Due To Under Subscription Of Equity Shares
announcements.detail: Revised cost of Project for preferential issue due to Under Subacribtion of Equity Shares
announcements.ai_summary: Subam Papers Ltd's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 26, 2026, revised the project cost/utilization for its preferential issue due to an under-subscription of equity shares. The company had initially planned to raise Rs. 107.04 Crores through a preferential issue comprising Convertible Warrants and Equity Shares. However, the company received Rs. 74.36 Crores in total, with Rs. 64.36 Crores from the equity share issue, resulting in a shortfall of Rs. 2.66 Crores. Consequently, the allocation towards General Corporate Purposes has been reduced from Rs. 4.03 Crores to Rs. 1.36 Crores, revising the overall project cost/fund utilization from Rs. 107.04 Crores to Rs. 104.37 Crores.

announcements.subject: Ramco Industries Ltd - 532369 - Board Meeting Updates
announcements.detail: Board Meeting Update
announcements.ai_summary: Ramco Industries Ltd's Board of Directors met on May 27, 2026, and approved an increase in the project cost for setting up a new Fibre Cement Boards plant at Maksi, Madhya Pradesh. The estimated project cost has been revised upwards from Rs. 180 Crores (Gross value) to Rs. 250 Crores (Gross value). This increase in cost does not alter the previously provided details regarding the project, which was initially approved on November 5, 2025, with an installed capacity of 58,000 M.T. per annum. The board meeting commenced at 11:30 a.m. and concluded at 2:00 p.m.

announcements.subject: Hyundai Motor India Ltd - 544274 - Advance Intimation Regarding Price Increase
announcements.detail: Advance Intimation regarding Price Increase
announcements.ai_summary: Hyundai Motor India Ltd has announced an advance intimation regarding a price increase on its vehicles, effective from June 01, 2026. This price adjustment, which will be up to a maximum of Rs. 12,800 per vehicle, is attributed to rising input costs, increased commodity prices, and higher operational expenses. The company stated that the extent of the increase will vary depending on the specific model and variant. Hyundai Motor India Ltd aims to balance customer interests while passing on some of these increased costs.

announcements.subject: Goldiam International Ltd - 526729 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release 27-5-2026
announcements.ai_summary: Goldiam International Ltd. has reported its highest ever Revenue, EBITDA, and PAT for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. Despite challenges such as US tariffs and volatile gold prices, the company achieved a consolidated revenue of ₹10,212.3 million for FY2026, a 27.5% increase year-on-year. Consolidated PAT for FY2026 surged by 45.7% to ₹1,705.9 million. For the fourth quarter of FY2026, consolidated revenue was ₹2,433 million, up 21% year-on-year, and consolidated PAT was ₹372 million, up 61%. The company has pivoted to US-based casting and dual manufacturing, making it tariff-agnostic and unaffected by recent gold duty increases. Additionally, the company has doubled its ORIGEM stores to 24 operational stores and the Board has proposed a bonus share issuance in the ratio of 1:3.

announcements.subject: Jaysynth Orgochem Ltd - 524592 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition
announcements.detail: Proposed Incorporation of a Wholly owned subsidiary (WOS)
announcements.ai_summary: Jaysynth Orgochem Limited's Board of Directors, in their meeting held on May 27, 2026, approved the incorporation of a Wholly Owned Subsidiary (WOS) in Hong Kong. This new entity will primarily support the company's trading activities, including procurement functions and exploring export opportunities for its products. The WOS will be a subsidiary of Jaysynth Orgochem Limited and will operate in the Chemicals and Inkjet Printers & Accessories industry. The incorporation is subject to approvals from the Hong Kong Companies Registry and the Hong Kong Inland Revenue Department for a Business Registration Certificate, as well as compliance with the Foreign Exchange Management Act.

announcements.company: Deepak Builders and Engineers India Ltd
announcements.subject: Deepak Builders and Engineers India Ltd - 544276 - Emerged As The L1 Bidder For The Project
announcements.detail: Emerged as the L1 bidder for the project
announcements.ai_summary: Deepak Builders and Engineers India Ltd has emerged as the L1 bidder for a project involving the Planning, Design, Engineering, Procurement, and Construction of various building infrastructure facilities and allied estate services for Shri Krishna AYUSH University in Kurukshetra, Haryana. The project is to be executed on an EPC basis. The total bid project cost is approximately Rs. 559.50 Crores, inclusive of GST. This project falls under the purview of the Department of Haryana State Industrial & Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited (HSIIDC). The company will provide further updates on any developments related to this project.

announcements.subject: Simplex Castings Ltd - 513472 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find the press release .
announcements.ai_summary: Simplex Castings Limited has received approval from the Research Designs & Standards Organisation (RDSO), Ministry of Indian Railways, for prototype testing of Cast Steel CASNUB Bogie and its critical components for railway wagon applications. This approval, granted under RDSO’s fresh registration process, covers components such as Cast Steel Side Frames, Cast Steel Bolsters, Centre Pivot Assemblies, and CASNUB 22HS/22HS(M) & 22RFT Bogies. The company will conduct prototype testing according to RDSO specifications. This marks a return to the company's core railway business and positions Simplex Castings to capitalize on opportunities in the expanding domestic railway market, driven by train modernization and freight corridor expansion. The company historically held a 60-70% market share in cast bogies and aims to leverage this experience to bid for railway tenders.

announcements.subject: Bajaj Housing Finance Ltd - 544252 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Issue of Securities
announcements.detail: Allotment of Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures on Private Placement basis
announcements.ai_summary: Bajaj Housing Finance Ltd, through its Debenture Allotment Committee meeting held on May 27, 2026, has allotted 2,00,000 Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) on a private placement basis. The NCDs have a face value of Rs. 1,00,000 each, aggregating to Rs. 2,000.6723 crore. These debentures are proposed to be listed on the Wholesale Debt Market Segment of BSE Limited. announcements.subject: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd - 524715 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd has announced that it will present pivotal long-term follow-up data on UNLOXCYT™ (cosibelimab-ipdl) at the ASCO® 2026 Annual Meeting on May 31, 2026. The press release details that in the investigator-reviewed data from the locally advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (laCSCC) expansion cohort of the pivotal CK-301-101 trial, 64 patients received UNLOXCYT. The median age of these patients was 77 years, with 66% being male. Patients received a median of 29 doses over a median treatment duration of 60 weeks. The objective response rate was 50%, comprising 17 (27%) complete responses and 15 (23%) partial responses. With a median follow-up of 31 months, responses were durable, and the median duration of response had not yet been reached. Importantly, only one patient experienced a Grade >3 immune-related adverse event.

announcements.subject: Astal Laboratories Ltd - 512600 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR)- Lapse Of Convertible Warrants.
announcements.detail: Intimation of Lapse and forfeiture of Convertible Warrants allotted on 27th November, 2024.
announcements.ai_summary: Astal Laboratories Ltd announced on May 26, 2026, the lapse and forfeiture of 1,86,700 Convertible Warrants that were allotted to non-promoters on November 27, 2024, on a preferential basis. These warrants had a face value of Rs. 10/- each and were issued at a premium of Rs. 30/- each. As per Regulation 162 of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, 25% of the issue price was received upfront at the time of allotment, with the balance 75% due within 18 months from the allotment date, which was on or before May 26, 2026. Since the company did not receive the balance 75% consideration for these 1,86,700 warrants by the stipulated deadline, they lapsed upon expiry of the exercise period on May 26, 2026. Consequently, the upfront subscription amount of Rs. 18,67,000/- (18.67 Lakhs) stands forfeited, effective May 27, 2026, in line with Regulation 169(3) of the SEBI ICDR Regulations. This lapse will not result in any change to the company's paid-up share capital, and the forfeited amount will be retained by the company and accounted for as per applicable accounting standards; this matter will be taken up at a forthcoming Board Meeting.

announcements.subject:
La Tim Metal & Industries Ltd - 505693 - Under Regulation 30 Of Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, As Amended Read With Applicable
Circulars Issued Thereto, ("SEBI LODR Regulations") - Withdrawal Of In-Principle Application Filed For Proposed Preferential Issue
announcements.detail: Under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing obligation and disclosure requirements) regulation 2015, as amended read with applicable circular issued thereto,("SEBI LODR Regulations")- withdrawal of in-Principal application filed for proposed preferential issue
announcements.ai_summary: La Tim Metal & Industries Ltd announced on May 26, 2026, the withdrawal of its In-Principle Application for a proposed Preferential Issue, which was originally filed with the Exchange on October 24, 2025. The proposed issue included 3,50,00,000 Convertible Warrants of Rs. 10/- each and 1,58,60,000 equity shares of face value Re. 1/- each, to be issued for cash consideration at a price of Rs. 10/- per share. The withdrawal occurred because many proposed investors expressed unwillingness to participate, primarily due to the substantial time taken to obtain In-Principle approval. Consequently, the company will not proceed with the issue and allotment of these equity shares and convertible warrants as initially planned. The company assures stakeholders that this withdrawal will not materially impact its business operations or financial stability. La Tim Metal & Industries Ltd may explore alternative avenues for capital raising, including a fresh preferential issue of shares, and will keep stakeholders informed of future developments.

announcements.subject: Thomas Cook (India) Ltd - 500413 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: We are enclosing herewith the Press Release dated May 26, 2026 titled, "Thomas Cook India and Atlys, a Leading Visa Processing Platform Announce Partnership to Integrate Forex into the Visa Application Journey".
announcements.ai_summary: Thomas Cook (India) Ltd announced on May 26, 2026, a partnership with Atlys, a leading visa processing platform. This exclusive long-term partnership aims to integrate Thomas Cook India's foreign exchange services into the visa application journey on Atlys. The collaboration will enable customers applying for international visas to seamlessly opt for forex solutions, including Visa backed Forex Cards or foreign currency, directly through Atlys. The service will be supported by Thomas Cook India's digital and assisted onboarding, video KYC, and secure doorstep delivery across India. This initiative seeks to enhance ease, speed, and trust for travellers by offering a digital-first, hassle-free booking experience. Thomas Cook's offerings will include Prepaid Travel Cards, currency notes, and overseas remittance services.
