announcements.subject: Union Bank of India - 532477 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Meeting Of Board Of Directors Held On May 26, 2026.

announcements.subject: Elin Electronics Ltd - 543725 - Intimation Of Fire Accident At Ghaziabad Plant Of Elin Electronics Limited

announcements.subject: Quadrant Future Tek Ltd - 544336 - Update Regarding Approval Process W.R.T Kavach System (Version 4.0)
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding update on approval process w.r.t. KAVACH System (Ver 4.0)
announcements.ai_summary: Quadrant Future Tek Limited has provided an update on the approval process for its KAVACH System (Version 4.0), also known as the Indian Railways Automatic Train Protection (IR-ATP) System. The commencement of passenger trials demonstrates the company's technological capabilities and commitment to enhancing railway safety. This progress is expected to create substantial long-term opportunities in the railway signalling and safety systems sector.

announcements.subject: Shekhawati Industries Ltd - 533301 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of LODR
announcements.detail: Please find the Disclosure under Regulation 30 of LODR, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Shekhawati Industries Ltd. has acquired an additional parcel of land in Karjat, Maharashtra, for business expansion. This strategic acquisition aims to strengthen the company's presence in the Karjat growth corridor, which is part of the "Mumbai 3.0" development vision. The region is experiencing infrastructure development, including improved connectivity through the Panvel–Karjat suburban railway corridor and proximity to the Navi Mumbai International Airport. Karjat is anticipated to become a significant hub for residential, wellness, tourism, and second-home development within the extended Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR). The acquisition aligns with the company's long-term vision to develop high-quality, future-ready real estate projects.

announcements.subject: Yash Highvoltage Ltd - 544310 - Intimation Of "Vastu Pujan" Performed At The Company New Expansion Site At Suncity Industrial Park, Vadodara- Gujarat
announcements.detail: Intimation of "Vastu Pujan" performed at the Company new expansion site at Suncity Industrial Park, Vadodara- Gujarat.
announcements.ai_summary: Yash Highvoltage Ltd. has performed a "Vastu Pujan" ceremony at its new expansion site located at Plot No. 32-A, Suncity Industrial Park, Vadodara, Gujarat, on May 25, 2026. This ceremony marks a significant milestone in the expansion project, following earlier Bhoomi Pujan and commencement activities. The new facility is being developed for the trial production of Resin Impregnated Paper (RIP) / Resin Impregnated Synthetic (RIS) transformer condenser graded bushings, funded by IPO proceeds. The company has completed the office building construction, procured and is installing plant and machinery, and has acquired major production and testing equipment. Peripheral infrastructure work is in its final stages. Trial production is expected to commence in the second quarter of FY 2026-27, with commissioning and installation activities to be completed by the end of the first quarter of FY 2026-27.

announcements.subject: Tata Chemicals Ltd - 500770 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Chemicals Ltd. has received an order from the Hon’ble High Court of Gujarat concerning a writ petition challenging a Collector’s Order dated April 10, 2006. The petition related to the company's pre-existing rights over land used for legacy open wastewater channels at Mithapur, Gujarat. The High Court, in its order dated May 25, 2026, rejected the company's claim of pre-existing rights over these channels, which were established before 1987. The Court has directed the Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) to engage experts to assess the environmental impact and determine appropriate remediation and compensation within three months. Tata Chemicals is currently examining the order and evaluating its next steps, while reaffirming its commitment to environmental standards.

announcements.subject: Arrow Greentech Ltd - 516064 - Presentation On Business Performance Of The Company

announcements.subject: Larsen & Toubro Ltd - 500510 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order

announcements.ai_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited (L&T) announced on May 26, 2026, that its wholly-owned subsidiary, L&T GeoStructure, has secured multiple significant orders in India for its GeoStructure Business. These include its largest-ever piling order from JSW Utkal Steel Ltd, a subsidiary of JSW Steel, for a 10 MTPA Integrated Steel Plant at Paradeep, Odisha, involving approximately 30 lakh running metres of piling work. Additionally, L&T GeoStructure has secured two orders from the Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) for the construction of Ship Repair Facilities (SRF) at Patna and Varanasi, which will feature advanced Ship Lift and Transfer Systems. The company has also been awarded a contract by the Mumbai Port Authority for the construction of India's first yacht marina at Mumbai Harbour.

announcements.subject: Regaal Resources Ltd - 544485 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR)- Capacity Addition And Product Launch
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 for Capacity Addition and Product Launch
announcements.ai_summary: Regaal Resources Ltd has announced significant capacity additions and a new product launch. The company has successfully doubled its crushing capacity from 825 TPD to 1,650 TPD, with the expansion commencing on May 26, 2026. This expansion required an investment of approximately Rs 389 Crores, financed through debt and internal accruals, to cater to increased demand. Additionally, Regaal Resources has commissioned a new Liquid Glucose (LG) manufacturing facility with a capacity of 180 MT per day and a Maltodextrin Powder (MDP) manufacturing facility with a capacity of 50 MT per day, both launched on May 26, 2026. The company has also expanded its captive co-generation power plant capacity from 7.1 MW to 15.8 MW. These new products are value-added maize specialty products and derivatives for both domestic and international markets.

announcements.subject: Adani Green Energy Ltd - 541450 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Media Release
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Green Energy Ltd (AGEL) has released a media statement announcing the commissioning of the world's largest single-location battery energy storage system (BESS) with a capacity of 3.37 GWh at Khavda, Gujarat. This deployment is the largest outside China and one of the fastest utility-scale battery storage projects globally, completed within ten months of construction commencement. The total operational BESS capacity at Khavda now stands at 3.37 GWh, including 1.37 GWh commissioned in March 2026. AGEL plans to add over 10 GWh of battery storage capacity in FY27 and aims for 50 GWh over the next five years. This BESS can power nearly one million homes for a day and supports grid stability and reliable clean power delivery.

announcements.subject: UTI Asset Management Company Ltd - 543238 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: UTI Mutual Fund has launched 'Wealth 360', a new digital feature available on the UTI MF App and website, designed to simplify wealth tracking for users. This feature allows investors to view and track their investments across various financial products, including bank deposits, mutual funds, stocks, ETFs, and NPS, through a single, unified dashboard. Wealth 360 is built on the RBI-regulated Account Aggregator framework, ensuring secure, consent-based, and encrypted data sharing. The service is offered free of cost and provides daily refreshed portfolio insights. It has been developed in collaboration with Finarkein through the Sahamati-led Account Aggregator ecosystem and currently supports linking with banks, depositories, RTAs, NPS, and insurance providers.

announcements.subject: HCL Technologies Ltd - 532281 - Release: "Hcltech And Pegasystems Deepen Collaboration To Accelerate AI Powered Enterprise System Modernization"
announcements.detail: Enclosed please find a release on the captioned subject being issued by the Company today.
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Ltd. has announced an expanded collaboration with Pegasystems Inc. to accelerate AI-powered enterprise system modernization. This deepened partnership combines HCLTech AI Force and Pega Blueprint™ to enable enterprises to rapidly transform legacy systems into agile, cloud-native, and AI-powered Pega applications. The solution aims to enhance business agility, operational efficiency, and innovation by addressing the challenges of outdated, siloed legacy systems. Key features include AI-infused, agentic automation for discovery and transformation, end-to-end modernization to retire legacy estates, industry best practices, and seamless cloud adoption for modern applications on the Pega Platform.

The company also provided vehicle type-wise revenue breakdowns and India vs. International revenue figures. These KPIs are also available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: LTM Ltd - 540005 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Intimation attached

Through this AI-powered collaboration, LTM will provide modernized, end-to-end IT infrastructure support and enhanced application maintenance services to SSP Group. LTM will leverage its advanced AI capabilities, including its BlueVerse ecosystem, to help SSP manage operational risks, simplify IT complexities, and drive business efficiency. announcements.subject: Persistent Systems Ltd - 533179 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: The Press Release titled ''Persistent and Kong Announce Strategic Partnership to Help Enterprises Securely Move AI into Production'' is as enclosed.
announcements.ai_summary: Persistent Systems Ltd has announced a strategic partnership with Kong, a leader in API and AI connectivity. This collaboration aims to help enterprises securely move AI into production by establishing a new enterprise architecture for governing APIs, data, and AI systems across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Persistent will act as Kong's global systems integration partner, combining its engineering expertise with Kong's platform to simplify integration, enhance governance, and accelerate AI adoption. announcements.subject: Hindustan Zinc Ltd - 500188 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please refer the enclosed file.
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Zinc Limited (HZL) announced on May 25, 2026, that its Rampura Agucha Mine has become India's first Zinc Mark certified mine. This certification validates responsible zinc production against internationally benchmarked Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) standards, responsible sourcing practices, and value chain transparency. This achievement strengthens HZL's position in ESG-focused and traceable supply chain markets. Following the recent Zinc Mark certification for its Chanderiya Smelting Complex, HZL is now the first company in India to offer responsibly sourced zinc across its entire production chain, from mining to smelting.

announcements.subject: Jupiter Wagons Ltd - 533272 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release (Revised)

These agreements add 110 MWh of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) business to JEM Energy's orderbook for FY 2026-27, comprising both Utility-scale and Commercial and Industrial (C&I) deployments. With these additions, JEM Energy's current BESS orderbook stands at over INR 150 Crore. The company is targeting a combined orderbook of INR 200 Crore in the Battery and BESS segment within FY 2026-27. Looking ahead to FY 2027-28, JEM Energy aims for over INR 500 Crore revenue in this vertical.

announcements.subject: Kalpataru Ltd - 544423 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

announcements.ai_summary: Kalpataru Limited announced on May 25, 2026, the signing of a cluster redevelopment project in Kandivali East, Mumbai, named "Ashokgram Cluster." This project involves five adjacent societies and spans approximately 2.8 acres of land, with a free sale potential of about 0.37 million square feet of carpet area. The estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) for this project is around ₹ 1,250 crore. The redevelopment is envisioned as a future-ready residential development with high-street retail, offering excellent connectivity and proximity to social infrastructure. This initiative aims to set a new benchmark for high-quality, sustainable urban living while preserving local heritage.

announcements.subject: Indian Railway Finance Corporation Ltd - 543257 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release- IRFC signs Rs 13,527 cr refinancing deal for Hyderabad Metro in major push to  urabn rail financing
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Railway Finance Corporation Ltd (IRFC) has signed a Rs 13,527 crore term loan agreement with L&T Metro Rail (Hyderabad) Limited (L&TMRHL) on May 25, 2026. This agreement is for refinancing the debt obligations of the Hyderabad Metro Rail project, marking a significant transaction in India's urban transit financing sector. The deal was signed in the presence of IRFC CMD & CEO Manoj Kumar Dubey and Telangana Chief Secretary K. Ramakrishna Rao. This move aligns with the Government of India’s Viksit Bharat vision and showcases IRFC's evolving role as a diversified infrastructure financing institution. The company aims to channel Indian savings into Indian infrastructure and supports sustainable urban mobility through efficient capital.

announcements.subject: Nahar Industrial Enterprises Ltd-$ - 519136 - INTIMATION OF FIRE INCIDENT  UNDER REGULATION 30 OF SEBI LODR,2015
announcements.detail: INTIMATION OF FIRE INCIDENT
announcements.ai_summary: A fire incident occurred on the intervening night of May 23rd/24th, 2026, at Nahar Industrial Enterprises Ltd.'s unit in Lalru, Mohali, Punjab. The fire affected a godown storing raw cotton bales, which are essential raw materials for the company's manufacturing process. The cause of the fire is still under investigation. The fire was successfully brought under control through the combined efforts of the local Fire Department, the company's internal emergency response team, and its firefighting systems. Importantly, there were no reported casualties or personal injuries. The affected godown and its stock are adequately insured, and the insurance company has been notified, with an insurance survey expected to commence shortly. The company is currently assessing the full extent of the loss and damage incurred.

announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Pudumjee Paper Products Ltd announced its financial performance for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026. The company maintained its revenue at Rs. 807.88 crores, a slight decrease from Rs. 809.08 crores in the previous year, by increasing paper tonnage by 1675 MT and reducing the average net sales realization per MT to pass on cost benefits to customers. The EBITDA margin remained steady at 18% for both periods. Pudumjee Paper Products Ltd has successfully completed a capex program exceeding Rs. 110 crores, which includes the operationalization of a 15.4 MW Solar Power Plant in December 2025 at Bhalwani, near Solapur. This solar plant is expected to meet approximately 35% of the company's annual power requirements, reducing costs and carbon footprint by about 27,000 MT. The company is also pursuing environmental clearance for a project in Mahad due to regulatory changes and continues to focus on biodegradable and compostable specialty papers for sustainable packaging solutions.

This unit will focus on the production of Plywood and Particle Board. The proposed capacity addition includes Phase-1 of 60,000 CBM per year for Plywood and 240,000 CBM per year for Particle Board, with Phase-2 adding another 60,000 CBM per year for Plywood. The investment for Phase-1 is approximately Rs. 230 Crores, Phase-2 is approximately Rs. 140 Crores, and the Particle Board unit requires approximately Rs. 500 Crores. The financing for the project will be through a mix of debt and equity. The rationale behind this expansion includes increasing demand, proximity to raw material sources, availability of manpower, and closeness to a large customer base.

announcements.subject: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd - 500108 - COMPLIANCE WITH REGULATION 30 & 51 OF SEBI (LODR) REGULATIONS, 2015 - NON-FUNDING OF 07TH SEMI ANNUAL INTEREST IN ESCROW ACCOUNT MAINTAINED IN BANK OF INDIA WRT MTNL BOND SERIES VIIB (INE153A08113)
announcements.detail: LETTER ATTACHED
announcements.ai_summary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited (MTNL) has informed the stock exchanges regarding its non-funding of the 7th semi-annual interest payment for its 7.87% MTNL Bond Series VII-B (ISIN: INE153A08113), which is due on June 1, 2026. Despite the bonds being Sovereign Guaranteed by the Government of India, MTNL could not fund the required amount into the escrow account maintained with Bank of India due to insufficient funds. This non-funding is in compliance with Regulation 30 & 51 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The Tri-Partite Agreement (TPA) outlines that in case of MTNL's default, the Sovereign Guarantee will be invoked, and the Government of India will be obliged to make the payment.

announcements.subject: Venus Remedies Ltd - 526953 - Venus Remedies Receives Saudi FDA Approval For Plerixafor - Its First Maketing Authorization For The Specialty Oncology Therapy Globally
announcements.detail: As per the pdf enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Venus Remedies Limited has received Marketing Authorization from the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) for its specialty oncology therapy, Plerixafor. This marks the first global marketing authorization for Plerixafor for Venus Remedies and signifies a strategic shift towards higher-value specialty injectables in regulated markets. Plerixafor is a stem cell mobilization therapy used in autologous transplantation for patients with multiple myeloma and non-Hodgkin lymphoma. The company aims to replace reliance on commodity injectables with differentiated therapies.

announcements.subject: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 533573 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited receives USFDA Final Approval for Levothyroxine Sodium Tablets USP.
announcements.ai_summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has received final approval from the US Food & Drug Administration (USFDA) for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) for Levothyroxine Sodium Tablets USP. The approved strengths include 25 mcg, 50 mcg, 75 mcg, 88 mcg, 100 mcg, 112 mcg, 125 mcg, 137 mcg, 150 mcg, 175 mcg, 200 mcg, and 300 mcg. These tablets are therapeutically equivalent to Synthroid Tablets, the reference listed drug product from AbbVie, Inc. Levothyroxine sodium tablets are indicated for hypothyroidism and as an adjunct in managing certain thyroid cancers. The estimated market size for these tablets was US$ 1,869 million for the twelve months ending March 2026. This approval adds to Alembic's portfolio of 239 ANDA approvals from the USFDA.

announcements.subject: Suzlon Energy Ltd - 532667 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Suzlon 3 MW platform sales reach nearly 9 GW with a new order from Sunsure Energy
announcements.ai_summary: Suzlon Energy Ltd has secured a repeat order of 195 MW from Sunsure Energy for its 3 MW platform. This new order brings the total sales of Suzlon's 3 MW platform to nearly 9 GW, indicating strong market demand. The project will be executed in the Bijapur district of Karnataka and involves the supply of 65 S144 wind turbine generators (WTGs), each with a rated capacity of 3.0 MW. Suzlon will also be responsible for the project execution, including erection and commissioning, as well as operations and maintenance services post-commissioning. This order contributes to Suzlon's orderbook in Karnataka, which now exceeds 2 GW, making it a key market for the company. The announcement was made on May 22, 2026.

Further details regarding the floor price and other terms of the offer will be announced.

announcements.subject: Kesar India Ltd - 543542 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Bagging of Order for Residential EPC Project in Central Mumbai
announcements.ai_summary: Kesar Infraventures Private Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Kesar India Limited, has secured an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contract valued at approximately ₹ 78 Crore. This contract, awarded by M/s Zee Enterprises, is for a large-scale residential development project located at Siddharth Nagar, Byculla in Central Mumbai. The project involves the construction of residential towers along with allied infrastructure and amenities, including RCC construction, internal and external development works, electrical systems, plumbing, firefighting systems, roads, drainage, and landscaping. The estimated execution timeline for this project is 24 months. This order marks a significant expansion for Kesar Group's infrastructure and EPC vertical.

announcements.subject: Fino Payments Bank Ltd - 543386 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting And Intimation Under Regulation 30 Read With Schedule III Of SEBI LODR
announcements.detail: Outcome of the meeting of Board of Directors held on May 21, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Fino Payments Bank Limited, in their meeting held on May 21, 2026, reviewed legal opinions and reports concerning an investigation by the Directorate General GST Intelligence against Mr. Rishi Gupta, the MD & CEO. The Board concluded that no prima facie case was made out against Mr. Gupta and deemed him 'fit and proper' to continue in his role. However, Mr. Gupta submitted a voluntary early retirement request, effective May 21, 2026, which the Board accepted. Consequently, Mr. Rishi Gupta will cease to be the MD & CEO of the Bank from May 21, 2026, after the end of the business day. The Board expressed gratitude for his contributions.

announcements.subject: Covidh Technologies Ltd - 534920 - We Hereby Submit The Declaration W.R.T. Non Applicability Of Regulation 23(9) Of SEBI LODR
announcements.detail: We hereby submit the declaration w.r.t. non applicability of regulation 23(9) of SEBI LODR
announcements.ai_summary: iSERA Lifesciences Limited (formerly Covidh Technologies Limited) has submitted a declaration regarding the non-applicability of Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. This exemption is due to the company's Paid-up Equity Share Capital and Net Worth as of March 31, 2026, being less than ₹10 Crore and ₹25 Crore, respectively. Consequently, the company falls under the exemption criteria provided in Regulation 15(2) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, and is therefore not required to comply with Regulation 23(9).

announcements.subject: Welspun Corp Ltd - 532144 - Update On Intra-Group Transaction: Transfer Of 100% Equity Stake Of Welspun Pipes Company, KSA From Welspun Mauritius Holdings Limited To Welspun Global Holdings Limited Both Wholly-Owned Subsidiaries Of The Company.
announcements.detail: Update on intra group transaction- Transfer of 100% equity stake of Welspun Pipes Company, KSA from Welspun Mauritius Holdings Limited to Welspun Global Holdings Limited both wholly owned subsidiaries of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Welspun Corp Limited has announced the successful completion of an intra-group transaction involving the transfer of 100% equity stake of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Welspun Pipes Company, KSA. announcements.ai_summary: RPSG Ventures Limited has announced the sale of its entire investment in M/s. Incnut Digital Private Limited. This transaction is in accordance with a Share Purchase Agreement dated May 7, 2026, entered into with M/s. Veerendra Shivhare, M/s. Sangram Simha Datla, and M/s. Chaitanya Chakravartin Nallan. The company sold its Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) in Incnut Digital Private Limited, which were converted into Equity Shares in a 1:1 ratio before the sale. The total consideration for the sale of 5810 CCPS in Incnut Digital Private Limited was Rs11.76 Crores, with Rs3.92 Crores from each of the three buyers. This announcement is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Ltd - 543965 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited has been allotted equity shares by the Board of FIT 3PL Warehousing Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited (TVS SCS) has announced an update on its acquisition activities. The Board of FIT 3PL Warehousing Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of TVS SCS, has allotted equity shares to TVS SCS. This follows the Board's approval on December 09, 2025, for additional funding in its wholly owned subsidiaries for business expansion. FIT 3PL Warehousing Private Limited is engaged in the logistics industry, and its turnover as of March 31, 2025, was Rs133.18 Crores. TVS SCS acquired 2,20,609 equity shares at a price of Rs2700 each, representing 100% of the shareholding, for a cash consideration of Rs59.56 Crores. The acquisition is intended to facilitate business growth and is expected to lead to revenue and profit growth. FIT 3PL will continue to be a wholly owned subsidiary of TVS SCS. The completion of this acquisition is anticipated by September 2027.

announcements.subject: Jio Financial Services Ltd - 543940 - Update On Institutional Investors'' Meeting
announcements.detail: This is further to the disclosure dated May 13, 2026 made by the Company. We wish to inform you that the Company executives participated in the Institutional Investors Meeting
announcements.ai_summary: Jio Financial Services Limited executives participated in an Institutional Investors' Meeting, specifically a Non-Deal Roadshow, held in-person in Hong Kong on May 20-21, 2026. This meeting, organized by a third party, involved One-on-One and Group sessions with institutional investors. The company explicitly stated that no unpublished price sensitive information was shared or discussed during these interactions. Only information already available in the public domain was presented and reviewed. This update is a follow-up to the company's previous disclosure regarding investor meetings dated May 13, 2026.

announcements.subject: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd - 532500 - Advance Intimation Regarding Price Increase
announcements.detail: Advance intimation regarding price increase
announcements.ai_summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited announced an advance intimation regarding a price increase across its model portfolio, effective from June 2026. The company stated that this decision is a direct result of sustained increases in input costs and elevated inflationary pressures. Prices will be increased by up to Rs. 30,000/- per model. Maruti Suzuki has been implementing cost reduction measures to mitigate the impact, but the adverse cost environment necessitates passing on a portion of these increased costs to the market. The exact quantum of the price change will vary for each specific model.

announcements.subject: Ganesha Ecosphere Ltd - 514167 - Capacity Addition In Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of The Company
announcements.detail: Capacity addition in wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Ganesha Ecosphere Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, Ganesha Eco Pet Private Limited (Ganesha Ecopet), has decided to drop its previously announced greenfield project in Odisha, which aimed for a 67,500 TPA capacity for rPET Chips/Granules, as intimated on February 3, 2025. Instead, the Board of Directors of Ganesha Ecopet, at its meeting held on May 20, 2026, approved an expansion of its existing rPET granules capacity at the Warangal unit by an additional 22,500 TPA. This expansion will increase the total installed capacity at the Warangal unit to 87,000 TPA, up from the current 64,500 TPA (which includes 22,500 TPA already commissioned but not yet in commercial production). The proposed capacity addition is estimated to require an investment of Rs. 125 Crore and is expected to be completed by March 2027, financed through a mix of debt, equity, and internal accruals.

announcements.subject: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd - 500655 - Incorporation Of Wholly Owned Subsidiary
announcements.detail: Incorporation of Wholly Owned Subsidiary
announcements.ai_summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited announced the incorporation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, "Garware Hi Tech Global Trading FZCO" (GHGT), in the Dubai Airport Free Zone Authority, Dubai, UAE. The company received the Certificate of Formation/Incorporation and Trading license via email on May 21, 2026, with both documents dated April 27, 2026. GHGT is a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited and operates in the Films, Ceramic Coatings, and PPF industry. This incorporation follows a previous intimation made by the company on January 22, 2026.

announcements.subject: RailTel Corporation of India Ltd - 543265 - Cancellation Of Work Order
announcements.detail: Cancellation of Work Order
announcements.ai_summary: RailTel Corporation of India Ltd has informed about the cancellation of a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) awarded by South East Central Railway for the supply, transportation, and laying of OFC, among other related works. The estimated order value was ₹26,72,60,140/-. The cancellation is due to the prevailing war situation, which has led to a steep increase in the prices of OFC, HDPE pipes, and other materials, making the project unviable. Consequently, RailTel has decided not to execute the work, and the customer has terminated the contract awarded to RailTel. This cancellation follows RailTel's earlier intimation on March 7, 2026, regarding securing this major order.

announcements.subject: IVP Ltd - 507580 - Update W.R.T. Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015 -  Fraud By Employee Of The Company
announcements.detail: Please find update as per the attached disclosure
announcements.ai_summary: IVP Limited provided an update on May 21, 2026, regarding a fraud by an employee, following initial intimations on January 13, 2026, January 22, 2026, and January 29, 2026. A detailed investigation has determined the total amount involved in the matter to be Rs. 613 lakhs, which is also the actual financial impact on the company. An FIR has been filed before the Byculla Police Station (Mumbai 400027, Maharashtra) against Mr. Ravi Ranjan Jha, the employee involved in the fraud. As a corrective measure, the company has made its customer onboarding process more robust. IVP Limited will timely intimate the Exchange of any further material developments in this matter.

announcements.subject: Goodricke Group Ltd - 500166 - Execution Of Agreement For Sale
announcements.detail: Execution of Agreement for Sale
announcements.ai_summary: Goodricke Group Ltd has executed an Agreement for Sale with M/s Chalouni Plantation Pvt. Ltd. on May 21, 2026, for the transfer of Estates, Bearer Plants, and Specified Assets comprising in Chalouni Tea Estate. This follows a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding intimated on April 6, 2026, and a completed due diligence process by the buyer. Upon execution of this agreement, possession of the aforesaid assets has been duly transferred to M/s Chalouni Plantation Pvt. Ltd., which is represented by Mr. Ashok Kumar Goyal, Director. The buyer's registered office is at H/19/1 SEVOKE ROAD, ANAND VIHAR COMPLEX, Sevoke Road, Darjiling, Siliguri, West Bengal, India, 734001. The transfer of leasehold rights over the land remains subject to the approval of the Competent Authority of the Government of West Bengal. Detailed information regarding the transaction was previously intimated to the Exchange on April 6, 2026.

announcements.subject: Kirloskar Electric Company Ltd - 533193 - Certified True Copy Of The Merger Order Passed.
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed certified true copy of the merger order passed by Hon''ble National Company Law Tribunal, Bengaluru Bench.
announcements.ai_summary: Kirloskar Electric Company Ltd has received the Certified True Copy of the merger order from the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Bengaluru Bench, on May 21, 2026. The NCLT order, dated April 30, 2026, approves the merger by absorption of four wholly owned subsidiary companies – KELBUZZ Trading Private Limited, Luxquisite Parkland Private Limited, SLPKG Estate Holdings Private Limited, and SKG Terra Promenade Private Limited – with the holding company, Kirloskar Electric Company Limited. This follows the company's earlier intimation on May 15, 2026, regarding the proposed merger.

announcements.subject: Laurus Labs Ltd - 540222 - Inclusion Of Laurus Labs In Dow Jones Best-In-Class (DJ BIC) Indices
announcements.detail: Please see annexed enclosure.
announcements.ai_summary: Laurus Labs Ltd has been featured for the first time in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class (DJ BIC) Indices, specifically included in the DJBIC World Index. This inclusion recognizes the company's strong commitment to sustainable and ethical corporate governance practices and its high ESG performance. Previously, Laurus Labs was recognized in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook 2026, achieving an S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA) score of 81 out of 100 in the pharmaceutical category. The DJ BIC Indices identify companies with exceptional ESG performance based on leading S&P Global CSA scores, reinforcing Laurus Labs' credibility with global investors.

announcements.subject: Suraj Industries Ltd - 526211 - Intimation Pursuant To Regulation 30 Read With Regulation 31A Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Receipt Of Request For Reclassification From 'Promoter Group' Category To 'Public' Category.
announcements.detail: Receipt of request for reclassification from "Promoter Group " Category to "Public Category".
announcements.ai_summary: Suraj Industries Ltd received a request letter dated May 21, 2026, from Mr. Rajesh Gupta, seeking reclassification from the 'Promoter Group' category to the 'Public' category. Mr. Gupta currently holds 10 Equity shares of Rs. 10/- each in Suraj Industries Ltd. In his request, Mr. Gupta stated that he is no longer connected to the company's business, does not participate in day-to-day activities, and lacks the ability to appoint directors or control management/policy decisions. The company will present this reclassification request to its Board of Directors in the upcoming Board Meeting for consideration and approval. The reclassification is subject to compliance with Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and obtaining requisite approvals.

announcements.subject: Cranex Ltd - 522001 - Intimation Of Loan Agreement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Please find the attached Intimation of the Loan Agreement entered with M/s. Kalyan Capitals Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Cranex Limited has entered into a Loan Agreement with M/s. Kalyan Capitals Limited, acting as the borrower, as intimated on May 21, 2026. Under this agreement, Cranex Limited, as the lender, is granting an inter-corporate loan up to a maximum amount of Rs. 3,00,00,000 (Rupees Three Crore Only). The loan is structured as a demand loan and carries an interest rate of 9% per annum. While the loan amount is repayable on demand, Kalyan Capitals Limited retains the discretion to repay the loan in full or in parts at intervals of its choosing. This transaction was disclosed under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd - 544044 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 - Updates
announcements.detail: Receipt of NOC for promoter and promoter group re-classification from Stock exchanges
announcements.ai_summary: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd has received approval from both NSE and BSE for the reclassification of certain members from the 'Promoter & Promoter Group' to the 'Public' category, as per Regulation 31A of the Listing Regulations. This approval follows the company's application submitted on February 10, 2026. The reclassified entities include Mr. Anil Mehta, who held 1.44% shareholding as of March 31, 2026, and several other promoter group members and entities, whose post-reclassification category is now 'Public' with NIL shareholding. The stock exchanges communicated their approval via letters dated May 21, 2026.

announcements.subject: NIIT Ltd - 500304 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed Press Release on "NIIT launches six GenAI Programs to build AI -first skills"
announcements.ai_summary: NIIT Limited announced the launch of six new programs under its GenAI & Artificial Intelligence (AI) portfolio on May 21, 2026. This initiative is in response to the increasing demand for AI-led skills, with enrolments in NIIT’s Agentic AI program growing by 88% over the past four months and overall AI program enrolments increasing by 40% year-on-year. The new programs cater to diverse learner segments, including students, educators, and professionals. The offerings include the GenAI Spark Program for Students, GenAI Spark Program for Educators, GenAI Spark Essentials, GenAI Spark Program on Marketing, GenAI Applied Program for No-Code Apps, and the advanced GenAI Applied Program for Practitioners. These programs emphasize structured, hands-on learning and real-world application to equip learners with practical AI skills.

announcements.subject: Le Travenues Technology Ltd - 544192 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Grant Of Options Under Employees Stock Option Schemes Of The Company
announcements.detail: Outcome of Nomination and Remuneration Committee meeting held on May 21, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Le Travenues Technology Ltd announced that its Nomination and Remuneration Committee, in a meeting held on May 21, 2026, approved the grant of 32,708 stock options under its Employees Stock Option Schemes 2016 and 2021. These options are exercisable at ₹93 per option. The granted options will vest over four years in equal annual installments of 25% each. The exercise period for these options is five years from the respective vesting date, after which they would lapse. The company has provided these disclosures in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Juniper Hotels Ltd - 544129 - Board Comments On Fine Levied By The Exchange
announcements.detail: Please find attached letter
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Juniper Hotels Ltd has commented on a fine of ₹4,60,200 (including GST) levied by both NSE and BSE for non-compliance with Regulation 17 of SEBI Listing Regulations concerning the Board's composition between October 01, 2025, and December 17, 2025. The Board noted the delay in compliance but highlighted that their composition includes a balanced mix of experienced Executive and Non-Executive Directors, with a higher representation of Non-Executive Directors, benefiting from diverse guidance. Mr. Mayur Chokshi was appointed as an Independent Director effective December 18, 2025, bringing the company into compliance. Juniper Hotels Ltd has paid the levied fines within the prescribed timeline and emphasized the importance of adhering to regulatory timelines to prevent future non-compliance.

announcements.subject: GEE Ltd - 504028 - Clarification / Continuation To Our Outcome Of Board Meeting Letter Dated 15Th May, 2026 - Inadvertent Omission Of Certificate From Statutory Auditor

announcements.subject: Onward Technologies Ltd - 517536 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

This penalty is in connection with procedural delays in filing 270 SOFTEX Forms related to export transactions. The authority has condoned the delay and closed the issue, confirming that export proceeds have been duly realized and there are no allegations of fund diversion or loss of foreign exchange. The order was received by the company on May 20, 2026.

announcements.subject: Ultramarine & Pigments Ltd-$ - 506685 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR)- Project
announcements.detail: The Board of Directors at its meeting held on 20th May, 2026 has approved the greenfield project for manufacture of inorganic pigments at SIPCOT industrial park, Manapparai, TN.
announcements.ai_summary: Ultramarine & Pigments Ltd's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 20, 2026, approved a greenfield project for manufacturing inorganic pigments. The new facility will be located at SIPCOT Industrial Park, Manapparai, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, and is designed to add a proposed capacity of 2500 MT. The total investment required for this expansion is ₹250 Crores, which will be financed through a combination of internal accruals and a term loan. The company plans to add this capacity in a phased manner over the course of FY 202

announcements.subject: Adani Power Ltd - 533096 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Updated Disclosure For Acquisition Of Certain Power Assets And Investments Of Jaiprakash Associates Limited
announcements.detail: Adani Power Limited has informed the Exchange about updated disclosure for acquisition of certain power assets and investments of Jaiprakash Associates Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Power Limited has provided an updated disclosure regarding its acquisition of certain power assets and investments from Jaiprakash Associates Limited (JAL). Following their earlier intimation of in-principle interest, Adani Power has entered into definitive agreements with JAL. These agreements include a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 24% of Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited's shares held by JAL, and a Business Transfer Agreement to acquire JAL's 180 MW thermal power plant in Churk and related assets, including 11.49% of Prayagraj Power Generation Company Limited. These acquisitions are part of the NCLT-approved resolution plan for JAL and are expected to be consummated on the 'Effective Date' of the plan.

announcements.subject: Tata Capital Ltd - 544574 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment
announcements.detail: Tata Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of Non - Convertible Debentures
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Capital Limited has successfully allotted Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) on a private placement basis on May 21, 2026. A total of 2,95,000 NCDs were issued with an issue size of Rs. 2,950 crore. The NCDs carry a floating coupon rate, which is benchmarked against the 3-month Treasury Bill Rate plus a fixed spread of 210 bps per annum. The initial coupon rate was set at 7.42% p.a. (5.32% + 210 bps). The coupon rate will be reset quarterly, with the spread remaining fixed at 210 bps throughout the tenor of the instrument.

announcements.subject: Platinum Industries Ltd - 544134 - Announcement Under Reg 30 Of SEBI (LODR) For The Commencement Of Commercial Production
announcements.detail: Announcement under Reg 30 of SEBI (LODR) for the Commencement of Commercial Production for the manufacturing facility located at Palghar.
announcements.ai_summary: Platinum Industries Ltd has announced the commencement of commercial production for the remaining manufacturing facility located at Palghar, Maharashtra, effective May 21, 2026. This facility is a key objective of the company's Initial Public Offer. Partial commercial production at this site had already begun on August 8, 2025. With the full operationalization of these remaining facilities, the manufacturing unit is now fully functional. This development is a significant step in the company's expansion strategy, and they anticipate continued growth from this new capacity. The company will make this information available on their website.

announcements.subject: HCL Technologies Ltd - 532281 - Release - 'Hcltech Named Citrix GSI Of The Year'
announcements.detail: Enclosed please find a release on the captioned subject being issued by the Company today.
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Ltd announced on May 21, 2026, that it has been named Citrix GSI (Global System Integrator) of the Year. This award recognizes HCLTech's close collaboration with Citrix in supporting enterprise digital workplace transformation and cloud adoption utilizing Citrix technologies. The partnership spans early-stage product co-development, solution validation, and enterprise-wide transformation programs. HCLTech's unified virtual workspace solution, combined with Citrix virtualization technologies, enables enterprises to modernize end-user environments, enhance employee experience, and support hybrid and cloud-first operating models. Ravi Yeddanapudi, EVP, Digital Foundation Services, HCLTech, highlighted the deep strategic alignment and shared vision for the modern digital workplace with Citrix.

announcements.subject: Shanti Educational Initiatives Ltd - 539921 - Letter Of Comfort

announcements.subject: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Ltd - 533033 - Intimation Of Imposition Of Penalty
announcements.detail: Intimation of Imposition of Penalty
announcements.ai_summary: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Ltd has received an intimation regarding the imposition of a penalty and demand for customs duty from the Office of the Commissioner of Customs (NS-V), Maharashtra, INDIA. The company received this order on May 20, 2026, at 15:51 HRS. The penalty imposed is Rs. 2,76,66,845/-, and the demand for Custom Duty is Rs. 2,76,66,845/-, along with applicable interest. This action stems from an HSN Classification Issue, where the Customs Department alleged that goods assessed under HSN 86012000 were assessable under HSN 87049012. The total financial impact on the company is the sum of the demanded customs duty and the penalty. ISGEC Heavy Engineering Ltd plans to file an appeal under the Customs Act against this order.

announcements.subject: Dee Development Engineers Ltd - 544198 - DEE Piping System (Thailand) Co. Limited, A Material Subsidiary Of The Company, Entered Into Reservation Agreement With An International EPC Company
announcements.detail: Announcement under Reg 30
announcements.ai_summary: DEE Piping System (Thailand) Co. Limited, a material subsidiary of Dee Development Engineers Ltd, has entered into a Reservation Agreement with an International EPC Company, securing a significant order. The agreement, effective from June 1, 2027, through December 31, 2029, involves booking 60% of the subsidiary's total capacity for HRSG pipe spool fabrication, including shop detailing, procurement, and manufacturing. The order is valued at a minimum of US$ 15.27 million per annum. This development signifies a major contract for the subsidiary and is expected to contribute substantially to the company's revenue over the specified term.

announcements.subject: Aurum PropTech Ltd - 539289 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Media Release - Aurum PropTech Becomes Debt-Free, Doubles Down on Building India''s First AI- Native PropTech Ecosystem
announcements.ai_summary: Aurum PropTech Limited has successfully completed the sale of Buildings Q5 and Q6 located at MIDC, MBP-1, Plot Nos. P-136 & 136/1, TTC Industrial Area, Mahape, Navi Mumbai, for a total consideration of ₹112 Crores on May 21, 2026. This transaction, which was for a consideration approximately 15% above independent valuation, has enabled the company to fully prepay its Lease Rental Discounting (LRD) facility. Consequently, Aurum PropTech Limited is now debt-free, significantly strengthening its balance sheet and financial position. The company intends to utilize the surplus capital to build advanced AI capabilities, aiming to become India's leading AI-first PropTech company by integrating artificial intelligence across its rental, distribution, and capital segments.

announcements.subject: Tejas Networks Ltd - 540595 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Tejas Networks Ltd. has announced a significant partnership with Maharashtra Information Technology Corporation Limited (MahaIT) through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed on May 21, 2026. This collaboration aims to provide world-class training and certification in emerging telecom technologies to engineering students across Maharashtra, with a particular focus on underserved regions. The MoU was signed in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Maharashtra and the Hon’ble Minister of IT, Government of Maharashtra. MahaIT, a key agency for the state's ICT initiatives, will work with Tejas Networks to skill and certify students in advanced telecom and digital technologies via online and instructor-led programs. This initiative is expected to foster industry-academia engagement and technology-led capacity building, aligning with the vision of a "Digital Maharashtra" and supporting the state's economic growth.

announcements.ai_summary: Aurum PropTech Limited has successfully completed the sale of Buildings Q5 and Q6 located at MIDC, MBP-1, Mahape, Navi Mumbai for a total consideration of ₹112 Crores. announcements.subject: Coforge Ltd - 532541 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release Intimation
announcements.ai_summary: Coforge Limited has issued a press release announcing the launch of Aeronova.AI, a new framework designed to assist airlines in transitioning from legacy PNR-based operations to order-led retailing. This AI-enabled solution aims to facilitate a safe and predictable shift to Offer, Order, Settlement, and Delivery (OOSD) operations without disrupting revenue or day-to-day performance. Aeronova.AI is built to help airlines modernize their retailing capabilities while ensuring revenue continuity, operational stability, and a positive customer experience throughout the transformation process. The framework draws on Coforge's extensive airline and travel-technology expertise to help carriers manage the coexistence of legacy PNR environments with emerging order-native platforms at an enterprise scale.

announcements.ai_summary: Bosch Limited, along with Brakes India Private Limited and Wheels India Limited (collectively referred to as "TSF Companies"), has announced a joint venture to drive growth in the commercial vehicle segment, specifically focusing on e-enabled air systems. This partnership aims to leverage shared capabilities to deliver enhanced value to customers. The joint venture will be a 50:50 partnership between Bosch and the TSF Group companies. Operations are expected to commence by the end of 2026, subject to the receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals. The venture will concentrate on the engineering, manufacturing, and sales of electronically controlled and software-driven modules for air compression, air processing, air suspension, and air parking brakes.

announcements.subject: L&T Technology Services Ltd - 540115 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release titled "L&T Technology Services Limited Unveils Europe''s First EI Center; Ushers in New Era of Engineering Intelligence for Products, Platforms & Manufacturing" is attached.
announcements.ai_summary: L&T Technology Services Limited (LTTS) has announced the inauguration of its first Engineering Intelligence Center of Excellence (EI CoE) in Europe, located in Munich, Germany, on May 20, 2026. This new center aims to accelerate the adoption of applied AI and foster innovation in Engineering Intelligence for products, platforms, and manufacturing. By integrating deep-tech expertise with technologies such as GenAI, Agentic AI, and Physical AI, LTTS intends to help global enterprises transition from AI experimentation to scalable industrial transformation. The company highlighted its leadership in AI patent filings, with over 237 patents filed in AI & GenAI in FY26. The EI CoE will serve LTTS' clients in the mobility, industrial products, and sustainability segments, acting as a collaborative innovation hub within a key European industrial and technology ecosystem.

announcements.subject: Qualitek Labs Ltd - 544091 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: The enclosed Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) provides an overview of the company''s consolidated and standalone financial and key operational highlights,  and the future outlook following the Integration of Intersteller Testing Centre Private Limited and expension of Multi Location TIC Capabilities.
announcements.ai_summary: The Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) for H2 FY26 and the full year FY26 has been submitted by Qualitek Labs Ltd. For FY26, the company achieved consolidated revenue of ₹124.52 Crore, a significant fourfold increase from ₹29.18 Crore in FY24 and a 77% rise from ₹70.23 Crore in FY25. This performance was driven by the integration of Interstellar Testing Centre Private Limited and the expansion of multi-location TIC capabilities, including new labs in Mumbai and Bengaluru, and capacity expansion in Bhubaneshwar, Panchkula, and Chennai. Consolidated revenue from operations in H2 FY26 was ₹70.27 Crore, a 56% year-on-year increase. EBITDA for H2 FY26 was ₹18.05 Crore, more than double the ₹8.90 Crore in H2 FY25, and full-year EBITDA grew 80% to ₹29.28 Crore. The company aims to double its revenue every two years. The MD&A will be available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: HCL Technologies Ltd - 532281 - Release - 'Hcltech Report Warns 43% Of Enterprise AI Initiatives May Fail As Leaders Face Shrinking Timelines For Impact'
announcements.detail: Enclosed please find a release on the captioned subject being issued by the Company today.
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies has released findings from its Enterprise AI Market Report, "The AI Impact Imperatives, 2026," indicating that 43% of enterprise AI initiatives may fail. This risk stems from shrinking timelines for delivering impact, with nearly half of leaders expecting measurable value within 18 months. The report surveyed 467 senior executives from enterprises with over $1 billion in annual revenue. It highlights that AI adoption is widespread, but translating ambition into consistent, enterprise-wide outcomes is a significant challenge. The study also points to hidden constraints in application estates, data environments, and operating models that are not designed for autonomous AI systems. The findings underscore the growing execution gap as organizations balance rapid AI deployment with necessary structural changes.

This product is a generic version of Semaglutide injection, launched in Canada by Shaily's strategic partner Orbicular Pharmaceutical Technologies in partnership with its Customer. The combination product has already been commercially available in India since March 2026 and has received USFDA Tentative Approval, Health Canada Notice of Compliance, and Indian Regulatory Approval (CDSCO). Shaily's role involved the full design, development, manufacturing, and supply of the device components for this approved product. The ShailyPen Neo™ is a spring-driven, variable and fixed dose pen injector platform, compatible with ISO-standard 3 mL cartridges (3 mL and 1.5 mL fill), positioning it among a rare class of commercially available spring-driven pen injectors globally.

announcements.subject: KFin Technologies Ltd - 543720 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find attached Press Release titled "KFin Technologies Launches AEGIX, India''s First AI-native Integrated Investor Relations Intelligence Platform"
announcements.ai_summary: KFin Technologies Limited has launched AEGIX, an AI-native integrated investor relations intelligence platform designed for listed companies in India and globally. This platform aims to help investor relations teams gain deeper ownership visibility, market insights, and structured stakeholder engagement capabilities. AEGIX combines ownership intelligence, AI-powered workflows, market intelligence tools, and integrated investor relations functions to enable faster decision-making. The platform is currently available for companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited, as well as those preparing to go public. The launch is intended to strengthen the position of Indian listed companies in their market interactions.

announcements.ai_summary: Unicommerce eSolutions Limited has announced a strategic partnership with The Bear House, a contemporary menswear brand. announcements.subject: HFCL Ltd - 500183 - Issuance Of Corporate Guarantee On Behalf Of HTL Limited, A Subsidiary Of The Company     ("HTL") To The Extent Of ?265 Crores In Substitution Of Earlier Corporate Guarantee Of Rs.295 Crores
announcements.detail: The Company has extended a Corporate Guarantee by execution of a Second Amended & Restated Deed of Corporate Guarantee in favour of SBICAP Trustee Company Limited [acting for the benefits of the Working Capital Lenders of HTL Limited, a subsidiary of the Company  ('HTL')], a 'Security Trustee', to secure the various fund based and non-fund based facilities availed/to be availed by HTL, to the extent of Rs.265 Crores in substitution  of earlier Corporate ....
announcements.ai_summary: HFCL Ltd. announced on May 19, 2026, that it has extended a Corporate Guarantee of ₹265 Crores on behalf of its subsidiary, HTL Limited. This new guarantee, executed via a Second Amended & Restated Deed of Corporate Guarantee, substitutes an earlier corporate guarantee of ₹295 Crores. The guarantee is provided in favour of SBICAP Trustee Company Limited, acting as Security Trustee for the Working Capital Lenders of HTL Limited, to secure various fund-based and non-fund-based facilities availed or to be availed by HTL. HFCL holds 74% of HTL's paid-up share capital, with the remaining 26% held by the Government of India. HTL is engaged in manufacturing Optical Fiber Cables (OFC), providing passive connectivity solutions, and producing key OFC raw materials like Aramid Rods, Fiber Reinforced Plastic Rods, and Impregnated Glass Fiber Reinforcement, alongside electrical wiring interconnect solutions for Aerospace & Defence and Automotive & Industrial sectors.

announcements.subject: Zim Laboratories Ltd - 541400 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find attached a press release dated 19th May 2026 titled "ZIM Laboratories Limited announces grant of Marketing Authorization (MA) for Dabigatran Etexilate (75 mg, 110 mg &150 mg) Capsules in Italy, Europe
announcements.ai_summary: Zim Laboratories Ltd has announced the grant of Marketing Authorization (MA) for its Dabigatran Etexilate (75 mg, 110 mg & 150 mg) Capsules in Italy, Europe. The Italian Medicines Agency (AIFA) granted this authorization via DCP to SIA ZIM Laboratories Limited, Latvia, the company's wholly owned European subsidiary. This MA is for an anticoagulant product indicated for the prevention and treatment of thromboembolic disorders. The product was developed using Zim Laboratories' proprietary non-tartaric acid-based formulation and has demonstrated bioequivalence with the innovator product. This authorization is expected to facilitate faster approvals in other European Union countries, the UK, and global markets, leading to enhanced commercialization opportunities.

announcements.subject: Godfrey Phillips India Ltd - 500163 - Update On Fire Incident

announcements.subject:
Apollo Ingredients Ltd - 503639 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Appeal Dismissed As Withdrawn By Securities Appellate Tribunal.

Pursuant To Regulation 30 Read With Para A Of Part A Of Schedule III Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI LODR Regulations'), We Hereby Inform That The Hon'Ble Securities Appellate Tribunal, Mumbai ('SAT'), Vide Its Order Dated May 07, 2026 In Appeal No. 39 Of 2026 (Along With Miscellaneous Application Nos. 152 & 153 Of 2026), Has Passed A Final Order In The Matter Of Apollo Ingredients Limited (Formerly Known As Indsoya Limited) Versus BSE Limited.
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, We hereby inform that the Hon''ble Securities Appellate Tribunal, Mumbai (SAT), vide its order date May 7, 2026 in Appeal No. 39 of 2026 (along with Miscellaneous Application Nos. 152 & 153 of 2026), has passed a final order in the matter of Apollo Ingredients Limited (formerly known as Indsoya Ltd) Verses BSE Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Ingredients Ltd (formerly Indsoya Limited) has informed the exchange about a final order passed by the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT), Mumbai, on May 07, 2026, in Appeal No. 39 of 2026. The appeal was filed by the company challenging a communication from BSE Limited dated November 01, 2025, regarding the rejection of a waiver application for fines imposed by the exchange. The SAT permitted the withdrawal of the appeal, dismissing it as withdrawn. BSE Limited is allowed to collect Rs. 2,06,000 along with accrued interest, which had been deposited in an interest-bearing account. The company has no objection to BSE Limited collecting this amount. This order is not expected to have a material impact on the company's financial position or operations, other than the deposit amount.

announcements.subject: Surana Telecom and Power Ltd - 517530 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Restructuring

The buyer is Lakhanlal Anand Kumar Trade Private Limited, and they do not belong to the promoter or promoter group of Surana Telecom and Power Ltd. Bhagyanagar Solar Private Limited has not yet commenced operations, thus contributing no turnover, revenue, income, or net worth to the listed entity in the last financial year.

announcements.subject: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd - 543530 - Update On Material Litigation
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed the disclosure under Reg 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Paradeep Phosphates Limited has received an unfavorable order from the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) on May 18, 2026, which was published on May 18, 2026. The NCLAT rejected the company's appeal concerning exemption from Entry Tax in Odisha under a BIFR-sanctioned rehabilitation scheme. The litigation pertains to the company's claim for exemption from 2007 to 2014. Paradeep Phosphates Limited had previously provided for the liability and deposited ₹26 crore against a total demand of ₹76 crore. The company maintains its eligibility for remission for the period 2007-2011, as it was classified as a sick industrial company. While the company expects no material financial impact currently, any additional impact from interest on the unpaid amount is also not anticipated to be material.

announcements.subject: Emrock Corporation Ltd - 531676 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of  SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of  SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Emrock Energy Private Limited, a subsidiary of Emrock Corporation Limited where the company holds a 50.49% stake, has approved the installation of a new Bio-CNG project. This project, approved by the subsidiary's Board of Directors on May 19, 2026, aims for a yearly production capacity of 1600 Tons of Bio-CNG, 8652.80 Tons of Fermented Organic Manure (FOM), and 14732.80 Tons of Liquid Fermented Organic Manure (LFOM). The initial estimated cost for this project is between ₹30 Crores and ₹33 Crores, which will be funded through new capital infusion and financial assistance from banks or financial institutions. The project is targeted for completion by June 30, 2026, subject to necessary approvals. This initiative signifies Emrock Corporation's strategic move into the renewable energy sector.

announcements.subject: JSW Energy Ltd - 533148 - Acquisition Of Additional Equity Shares Of Toshiba JSW Power Systems Private Limited From Toshiba Corporation

announcements.ai_summary: JSW Energy Limited has entered into definitive agreements to acquire an additional equity stake in Toshiba JSW Power Systems Private Limited (TJPS) from Toshiba Corporation, Japan. This secondary purchase will increase JSW Energy's shareholding in TJPS to 20.7% on a non-diluted basis and 10.7% on a fully diluted basis. TJPS, incorporated in 2008, is involved in the engineering, manufacturing, marketing, and maintenance of supercritical steam turbines and generators for thermal power generation. For FY 2025-26, TJPS reported revenue from operations of Rs. 339.3 crores. The acquisition is part of JSW Energy's strategy to enhance its position in the power sector.

announcements.subject: Advait Energy Transitions Ltd - 543230 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail: MoU signed by the Company with TECO Fuel Cell Technology AS, during 3rd India-Nordic Sumit held in Oslo, Norway on May 18, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Advait Energy Transitions Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with TECO Fuel Cell Technology AS, Norway. The MoU was signed on May 18, 2026, during the 3rd India-Nordic Summit held in Oslo, Norway. The agreement aims to enable domestic manufacturing capabilities in hydrogen fuel cell technology through knowledge transfer and joint engineering, aligning with India's "Atmanirbhar Bharat" initiative and the National Green Hydrogen Mission. The collaboration is intended to cater to stationary power applications, heavy-duty transport and mobility, and maritime and shipping applications, with targeted production for stationary power from Q1 CY2027 and for heavy-duty transport from Q1 CY2028. Further disclosures will be made upon the execution of specific agreements.

announcements.subject: Computer Age Management Services Ltd - 543232 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release titled: CAMS unveils "Going beyond the Box 2026" Report: Women Investors'' participation surges with rising focus on Long Term Wealth Creation
announcements.ai_summary: Computer Age Management Services Limited (CAMS) released its 5th edition "Going Beyond the Box - Report on Women Investors 2026" on May 19, 2026. The report highlights that women investors now manage ₹11.3 Trillion in mutual fund assets under management (AuM) within CAMS-serviced funds. They contributed ₹3.0 Trillion in gross inflows during the financial year 2026, underscoring their growing role in India's investment landscape. The total number of women investors has reached 13.2 Million, with 2.2 Million new investors joining in FY'26. announcements.subject: Deccan Gold Mines Ltd - 512068 - Discovery Of Nickel - Copper - PGE Mineralization Through Drilling In Bhalukona, Chhattisgarh
announcements.detail: Please refer the attached letter.
announcements.ai_summary: Deccan Gold Mines Ltd has announced the discovery of Nickel-Copper-PGE mineralization through drilling in Bhalukona, Chhattisgarh. The drilling program has confirmed a layered mafic complex with wide zones of disseminated sulphides and occasional heavy-massive sulphide lenses. The first drill hole intersected three mineralized layers of gabbro with a combined width of over 60m, and potentially economic sulphide mineralization averaging 0.4% Ni_Eq. The highest-grade intersection was 2.6m at 1.01% Ni, 0.29% Cu, 0.2g/t Pd, and 1.25% Ni_Eq. The company is accelerating its drilling program to define a mineable resource and is hopeful Bhalukona can become India's first nickel-copper-PGE mine.

announcements.subject: United Spirits Ltd - 532432 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulation, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: United Spirits Limited (USL) has provided a disclosure regarding ongoing litigation with various entities of the Government of Maharashtra, including the State of Maharashtra, Maharashtra Water Resources Regulatory Authority (MWRRA), and the Water Resources Department (WRD). This matter pertains to a demand of INR 441.95 crore towards water charges for the period November 2018 to February 2026, which was issued by WRD on 20th March 2026, following directions from the Bombay High Court. USL has challenged this demand before the Bombay High Court, arguing that it was made without adhering to the principles of natural justice and without considering the material provided by the company. The Bombay High Court issued notices to the respondents on 5th May 2026, but no interim protection was granted. Subsequently, USL filed a Special Leave Petition (SLP) before the Supreme Court of India. By an order dated 12th May 2026, the Supreme Court has directed USL to deposit INR 50 Crores with the Court within four weeks as an interim measure, during which WRD is restrained from taking any coercive action against USL. The writ petition remains pending adjudication.

announcements.ai_summary: Infinity Infoway Ltd has announced the media coverage of its proprietary AI-enabled platform, ZeroTouch DaaS, which was launched on May 15, 2026, in Jaipur. This platform is designed as an integrated secure examination paper distribution system, enabling digital upload, controlled access, automated printing, and tamper-resistant dissemination of confidential examination papers. The launch and product introduction have been reported by various national and regional print and digital media outlets, highlighting the company's technological advancements in secure examination management systems. Representative media links have been provided for shareholder and stakeholder reference.

announcements.subject: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 544210 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - US FDA Inspection At Our Formulations Facility Located At Sanand, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - US FDA inspection of our formulations facility located at Sanand, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
announcements.ai_summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd is informing stakeholders about a US FDA inspection conducted at its formulations facility in Sanand, Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The inspection, which took place from May 06, 2026, to May 15, 2026, was for current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP). Following the inspection, the company received a Form 483 with 7 observations, which are described as procedural in nature. Emcure Pharmaceuticals is comprehensively addressing these observations and will submit its response to the US FDA within the stipulated timeframe.

announcements.subject: IDBI Bank Ltd - 500116 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting
announcements.detail:
In continuation to Bank's intimation dated May 13, 2026, it is hereby informed that the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on Saturday, May 16, 2026, has approved issuance of Long Term Rupee denominated Bonds for financing of Infrastructure and Affordable Housing of up to Rs. 10,000 crore in tranche/s up to March 31, 2027 through private
placement route in the domestic market.
You are requested to kindly take the above intimation on record ....
announcements.ai_summary: IDBI Bank Ltd's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on Saturday, May 16, 2026, approved the issuance of Long Term Rupee denominated Bonds. These bonds will be for financing Infrastructure and Affordable Housing and can be issued in tranches up to March 31, 2027, with a total value of up to Rs. 10,000 crore. The issuance will be conducted through a private placement route in the domestic market. This approval follows the bank's previous intimation on May 13, 2026.

announcements.subject: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 544222 - Update On Disruption In Operations At Some Of The Manufacturing Sites At Haridwar
announcements.detail: Update on Disruption in Operations at some of the manufacturing sites at Haridwar
announcements.ai_summary: The company, Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd, is providing an update on the disruption of operations at some of its manufacturing sites in Haridwar. This disruption was an industry-wide issue, primarily caused by a review of minimum wages by state authorities, affecting various sectors in Uttarakhand. Manufacturing operations at the affected sites have now resumed at over 70% capacity as of May 16, 2026, with expectations of progressive improvement in productivity. Local authorities are actively collaborating with industries to restore normalcy. The company has confirmed no damage to its property, and the loss of production due to labor unrest is covered under an industrial insurance policy. The exact amount of insurance claim and realized amount will be ascertained and claimed in due course.

announcements.subject: Bhageria Industries Ltd - 530803 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR)_ Update
announcements.detail: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR) -Update
announcements.ai_summary: The Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT) has adjourned a matter concerning an adjudication order dated March 31, 2023, passed by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). This case involves promoters, promoter groups, and directors challenging the SEBI order. The SAT has now scheduled the matter for final disposal from July 28, 2026, to July 30, 2026. Until this date, the SEBI order dated March 31, 2023, remains stayed. Further details required under SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD–PoD–1/P/CIR/2023/123 dated July 13, 2023, have been provided.

announcements.subject: PH Capital Ltd - 500143 - Updates on Open Offer
announcements.detail: Choice Capital Advisors Pvt Ltd ("Manager to the Offer") has submitted to BSE a copy of Pre-Offer Advertisement in accordance with Regulation 18(7) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquistion of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011 and Corrigenudm to the Detailed Public Statement and Letter of Offer for the attention of the public shareholders of PH Capital Ltd ("Target Company")
announcements.ai_summary: PH Capital Ltd, through its Manager to the Offer, Choice Capital Advisors Pvt Ltd, has issued a Pre-Offer Advertisement and a Corrigendum to the Detailed Public Statement and Letter of Offer. This is in accordance with Regulation 18(7) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011. The open offer is for the acquisition of up to 7,80,026 equity shares, representing 26% of the total voting share capital, at a price of Rs. 206.66 per share. The Committee of Independent Directors has opined that the offer price is justified and in compliance with regulations. There has been no competitive bid for this offer.

announcements.subject: Kirloskar Industries Ltd - 500243 - Update Of Material Subsidiary
announcements.detail:
Dear Sir/Madam,
