KFIL, which is also a listed entity, has informed the stock exchanges about an intimation filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. A copy of KFIL's intimation, which is self-explanatory, is enclosed for the records of Kirloskar Industries Ltd. This update is in line with regulatory requirements for material subsidiaries.

announcements.subject: Windsor Machines Ltd - 522029 - Intimation Under Regulation 31A Of The SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed the intimation under Regulation 31A of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015 regarding the approval received from NSE and BSE for Reclassification Application of the Erstwhile Promoter.
announcements.ai_summary: Windsor Machines Ltd has received approval from NSE and BSE for the reclassification of Castle Equipments Private Limited and Ghodbunder Developers Private Limited from Promoter to Public category under Regulation 31A of SEBI LODR Regulations. This follows an application made on April 05, 2026. The company has also received warning letters from NSE and BSE regarding this matter and has assured strict compliance with SEBI regulations. The approval letters from NSE and BSE are enclosed as Annexure-A, and details related to the warning letters are in Annexure-B.

announcements.subject: Onesource Specialty Pharma Ltd - 544292 - General-Update
announcements.detail: We wish to inform that the Government of Karnataka has accorded in-principle approval for the application submitted by the Company for Unit-II expansion project under the Karnataka Industrial Policy (KIP) 2025-30, towards incentives and concessions.
announcements.ai_summary: The Government of Karnataka has granted in-principle approval for the Unit-II expansion project of Onesource Specialty Pharma Ltd. This approval is under the Karnataka Industrial Policy (KIP) 2025-30 and pertains to incentives and concessions. The approval follows the company's proposal for investment in expanding its Unit II facility located at Obadenahalli, Doddaballapur Taluk, Bengaluru Rural District. This proposal was considered in the 67th State High Level Clearance Committee (SHLCC) meeting held on April 13, 2026. The company received the official Government Order on May 15, 2026. This expansion is a key part of the company's growth strategy to increase manufacturing capacities for global partners.

announcements.subject: Allcargo Terminals Ltd - 543954 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: Monthly Operational Update for the month ended April 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Allcargo Terminals Limited has provided its monthly operational update for the month ended April 2026. The company reported total volumes of 59.2 thousand TEUs in April 2026. This volume represents a 7% increase compared to April 2025 and a 1% increase compared to March 2026. The company also noted that its ICD (Inland Container Depot) operations are a joint venture with CONCOR. This update is in compliance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and will be available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd - 539876 - Clarification On News Items Appearing In Media Reports
announcements.detail: Clarification on News items appearing in Media Reports
announcements.ai_summary: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Limited has issued a clarification regarding recent media reports suggesting that the company is involved in discussions to acquire a majority stake. The company explicitly states that it is not engaged in any such discussions as reported. This clarification is made to address potential investor concerns arising from these media speculations.

announcements.subject: Windlas Biotech Ltd - 543329 - Submission Of Post Buyback Public Announcement
announcements.detail: Post Buyback Public Advertisement pursuant to and in compliance with Buyback Regulations. The Post Buyback Public Advertisement dated May 15, 2026 has been published in the newspapers on Saturday, May 16, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Windlas Biotech Limited has completed its buyback of 4,70,000 equity shares, each with a face value of INR 5, at a price of INR 1,000 per share. The buyback was conducted on a proportionate basis and in compliance with SEBI (Buy-back of Securities) Regulations 2018. A Post Buyback Public Advertisement was published on May 16, 2026, in the Financial Express, Jansatta, and Dainik Bhaskar (Dehradun Edition). This announcement confirms the closure of the tendering period for the buyback. The advertisement will also be available on the company's website, www.windlas.com.

announcements.subject: Lloyds Enterprises Ltd - 512463 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Intimation of receipt of Observation Letter with No Adverse Observation Letter from BSE Limited and Observation Letter conveying No Objection from National Stock Exchange of India Limited in relation to Composite Scheme of Arrangement.
announcements.ai_summary: Lloyds Enterprises Ltd has received an Observation Letter with "No Adverse Observations" from BSE Limited and an Observation Letter conveying "No Objection" from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on May 15, 2026. These letters are in relation to the Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving Lloyds Realty Developers Limited, Indrajit Properties Private Limited, Lloyds Enterprises Limited (as the Transferee Company), and Lloyds Realty Limited (as the Resulting Company). The Scheme is subject to further statutory and regulatory approvals, including those from the respective shareholders and creditors of the involved companies, and the National Company Law Tribunal.

announcements.subject: RDB Infrastructure And Power Ltd - 533285 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail: This is to inform you that the Company has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding dated 16 May 2026 with Mecpower Solutions Private Limited in relation to execution of EPC works for development of Solar Power Project at Bikaner, Rajasthan.
announcements.ai_summary: RDB Infrastructure and Power Ltd has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on May 16, 2026, with Mecpower Solutions Private Limited. This agreement is for the execution of Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) works for a Solar Power Project located in Bikaner, Rajasthan. The project will have a capacity of 70 MW (AC) / 95 MW (DC) and will include a 25 MWh Battery Energy Storage System. Under this MOU, both companies will jointly participate in the project on a 50:50 basis for profit sharing. RDB Infrastructure and Power Ltd will be responsible for the procurement and execution of the EPC scope. The EPC contract value is approximately Rs. 348.64 Crores.

announcements.subject: India Cements Ltd - 530005 - Disclosure W.R.T. Compounding Order Passed By Reserve Bank Of India
announcements.detail: Disclosure w.r.t. Compounding Order passed by Foreign Exchange Department, Reserve Bank of India, Chennai
announcements.ai_summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Foreign Exchange Department in Chennai has issued a Compounding Order against India Cements Ltd on May 15, 2026. This order pertains to a delay in filing Form FC-TRS, a regulation under the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999. The company has been directed to pay a compounding amount of Rs. 18,250/-. India Cements Ltd has stated that this order does not have any material financial impact on the company. The company has informed the stock exchanges about this order as required by SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Craftsman Automation Ltd - 543276 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On 16Th May, 2026
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting held on Saturday, the 16th May, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015, as amended ('SEBI Listing Regulations')
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Craftsman Automation Limited, in its meeting held on May 16, 2026, approved the raising of funds up to an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 2000 Crores. These funds can be raised through various methods including equity shares, debt, preferential allotment, rights issue, depository receipts, or private placement, in one or more tranches. The proceeds are intended for repayment or pre-payment of certain outstanding borrowings. The Board has authorized the Fund Raising Committee to make all necessary decisions regarding this fundraising, subject to regulatory approvals, including shareholder approval via postal ballot.

announcements.subject: Insecticides (India) Ltd - 532851 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Product Launch
announcements.ai_summary: Insecticides (India) Limited (IIL) has announced the launch of GRANUVIATM, a new insecticide for paddy crops, on May 16, 2026. This product is designed to offer long-duration control of brown plant hopper (BPH) for up to 60 days and protection against stem borer for up to two weeks. The launch addresses significant pest challenges in India's rice cultivation, where BPH can cause yield losses of 20% to 60% and stem borer can lead to 10% to 30% crop damage. GRANUVIATM is positioned as a future-ready solution for consistent and long-term pest control, aiming to improve crop health and productivity. The press release detailing the product launch will be available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd - 524804 - Curateq Biologics Receives CDSCO Marketing Authorisation (Form CT 23) For Bevqolva® (Bevacizumab Biosimilar)
announcements.detail: Curateq Biologics Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company receives CDSCO Marketing Autorisation (Form CT 23) for Bevqolva (Bevacizumab Biosimilar).
announcements.ai_summary: CuraTeQ Biologics Private Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Aurobindo Pharma Limited, has received Marketing Authorisation (Form CT 23) from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) for its bevacizumab biosimilar, Bevqolva®. This authorization permits the manufacture of Bevqolva® at CuraTeQ's Hyderabad facility and its marketing in 100 mg/4mL and 400 mg/16 mL vial presentations. Bevqolva® is indicated for metastatic carcinoma of the colon or rectum.

announcements.subject: IRB InvIT Fund - 540526 - Reg 21: Disclosure of valuation report received by the manager
announcements.detail: IRB Invit Fund has informed the Exchange regarding Annual Full Valuation report for assets for FY ended 2025-26
announcements.ai_summary: IRB InvIT Fund has disclosed its annual full valuation report for its assets as of March 31, 2026. The report, issued by KPMG Valuation Services LLP, indicates total assets valued at INR 1,92,811.58 million and liabilities of INR 88,668.57 million. This results in net assets of INR 1,04,143.00 million. With 1,281.60 million outstanding units, the Net Asset Value (NAV) per unit at fair value is INR 81.26. The fund has also enclosed traffic reports from GMD Consultants for its Project SPVs. This valuation is a key disclosure for investors to assess the fund's underlying asset value.

announcements.subject: Mindspace Business Parks REIT - 543217 - Unitholding pattern post capital restructuring
announcements.detail: Mindspace Business Parks REIT has informed the Exchange regarding Unitholding pattern post capital restructuring
announcements.ai_summary: Mindspace Business Parks REIT has submitted its Unitholding Pattern following a capital restructuring and the allotment of 1,36,50,506 units on a preferential basis on May 07, 2026. The filing, made on May 15, 2026, details the unit holding post-allotment as per SEBI Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/DDHS-PoD-2/P/CIR/2025/99. The unitholding pattern shows that as of the reporting date, the Sponsor(s)/Manager and their associate/related parties hold 44,54,23,863 units, representing 67.29% of the total outstanding units. Within this category, bodies corporates hold 32,42,31,024 units (48.98% of total outstanding units), with 13,63,94,182 units (42.07% of their total holding) being pledged or otherwise encumbered.

announcements.subject: Infosys Ltd - 500209 -  Investor Conference
announcements.detail: Enclosed

Mr. Sandeep Mahindroo, Financial Controller and Head – Investor Relations, will be attending. The information regarding these meetings will also be hosted on the company's website, www.infosys.com.

announcements.subject: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd - 500247 - Grant Of Employee Stock Options
announcements.detail: Intimation attached
announcements.ai_summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd's Nomination and Remuneration Committee has granted an aggregate of 20,15,350 Employee Stock Options on May 15, 2026, under the Kotak Mahindra Equity Option Scheme, 2023. These options are granted to eligible employees of the Bank and its subsidiary companies. Each option entitles the grantee to one Equity Share of the face value of Rs. 1/-. The options are structured with vesting occurring in tranches of 25% on May 18, 2027, May 18, 2028, May 18, 2029, and May 18, 2030. The exercise period for these options is one year from their respective vesting dates.

announcements.subject: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd - 532898 - Investment Approval By 'Committee Of Directors On Investment On Projects' Of POWERGRID
announcements.detail: Investment approval by ''Committee of Directors on Investment on Projects'' of POWERGRID
announcements.ai_summary: The 'Committee of Directors on Investment on Projects' of Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd (POWERGRID) convened on May 15, 2026, and granted investment approval for three key proposals. The first project involves the augmentation of 1x500MVA, 400/230kV ICT (7th) at Tuticorin-II GIS Sub Station, estimated at ₹132.06 crore, with commissioning scheduled by February 17, 2028. Secondly, the committee approved the installation of OPGW and associated communication systems on existing ISTS lines in the WR Region, at an estimated cost of ₹308.49 Crore, to be commissioned within 30 months by September 18, 2028. Lastly, a similar scheme for OPGW and communication systems on existing ISTS lines in the ER Region was approved, costing ₹143.58 Crore, also slated for commissioning within 30 months by September 18, 2028.

announcements.subject: General Insurance Corporation of India - 540755 - In Principle Approval For Infusion Of Funds Into The Corporation'S Labuan (Malaysia) Branch
announcements.detail: Intimation is enclosed.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of General Insurance Corporation of India, in its meeting held on May 15, 2026, from 5:15 p.m. to 6:17 p.m. (IST), has granted in-principle approval for a significant fund infusion. This approval is for infusing USD 49 million, approximately equivalent to Rs 469 crore, into the Corporation's Labuan (Malaysia) Branch. The purpose of this capital injection is for solvency restoration, aligning with the guidelines on Insurance Capital Adequacy Framework issued by the Labuan Financial Services Authority (LFSA). This infusion is contingent upon receiving all necessary regulatory approvals and completing the required formalities.

announcements.subject: Hindustan Copper Ltd - 513599 - Progress W.R.T. Agreement For Cooperation And Exchange Of Information With CODELCO And Hindustan Copper Limited
announcements.detail: Progress w.r.t Agreement for cooperation and exchange of information with CODELCO and Hindustan Copper Limited is submitted
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) provided an update on its progress regarding the Agreement for Cooperation and Exchange of Information with Corporación Nacional Del Cobre De Chile (CODELCO). In a Board meeting held on May 15, 2026, it was informed that HCL has executed a Non-Disclosure and Confidentiality Agreement (NDA) with CODELCO and has engaged a Transaction Advisor for potential entry into the Chilean mining sector and further acquisition. Furthermore, a team from HCL, along with its MOU partners, visited exploration sites in Chile from April 20th to April 30th, 2026, for site studies of Copper Blocks. The work in this regard is currently in progress.

announcements.subject: Primo Chemicals Ltd - 506852 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: Attached.
announcements.ai_summary: Primo Chemicals Limited has formally executed transaction documents for its investment in TPCS Private Limited, a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) established to own and operate a 49.998 MW AC Solar Power Plant. This follows previous disclosures where the company announced its intention to subscribe to 26% of TPCS Private Limited's equity capital. The executed documents include a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with TPCS Private Limited and a Share Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement (SSSHA) with TPCS Private Limited, along with its promoters, Arpa Infrastructure Developers Private Limited and Sun Photonics Private Limited. The purpose of these agreements is to develop, own, operate, and maintain the solar power plant under a captive mode on an OPEX model.

announcements.subject: Essex Marine Ltd - 544475 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release on Operational and financial performance for the half and year ended March 31, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Essex Marine Ltd has announced its operational and financial performance for the half-year and year ended March 31, 2026. The company successfully expanded its peeling capacity from 10.8 tons per day to 21.6 tons per day and installed advanced blanching and cooking machinery for Ready-to-Cook segments with a capacity of 4.8 MT per day. Furthermore, Essex Marine Ltd has diversified into integrated cold chain logistics services, deploying its own refrigerated truck fleet to ensure reliable temperature-controlled logistics. Total revenue from operations increased by 61.72% to Rs. 6,470.90 Lakhs in FY2026 from Rs. 4,001.19 Lakhs in FY2025. Total quantity exported also rose from 550MT in FY2025 to 972MT in FY2026. Profit After Tax (PAT) saw a significant increase of 59.23% to Rs. 637.34 Lakhs in FY2026 from Rs. 400.26 Lakhs in FY2025.

announcements.subject: SRF Ltd - 503806 - Commissioning And Capitalisation Of Capital Expenditure Proposal Approved By The Board
announcements.detail: Commissioning and Capitalisation of Capital Expenditure proposal approved by the Board
announcements.ai_summary: SRF Limited has commissioned and capitalized the first phase of its manufacturing facility for Capacitor Grade BOPP Film line at Indore, at an aggregate cost of INR 277 Crores (approximately). This commissioning is a continuation of the capital expenditure proposal approved by the Board on October 27, 2023. The second phase of this project is expected to be capitalized in September 2026 at an approximate cost of INR 6 Crores.

announcements.subject: CIE Automotive India Ltd - 532756 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of schedule III the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015- Update on acquisition of shares
announcements.ai_summary: CIE Automotive India Limited announced on May 15, 2026, that Suryadeep GJ3 Project Private Limited ("Suryadeep") allotted 4,80,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 each to the company. The aggregate consideration for this acquisition was Rs. 48,00,000. This transaction resulted in CIE Automotive India Limited holding 26.09% of the Paid-up Share Capital of Suryadeep. Consequently, Suryadeep has become an Associate of CIE Automotive India Limited, effective from May 15, 2026. This investment follows a previous disclosure dated March 04, 2025, where the company had informed about its agreement to invest and subscribe up to 26% of Suryadeep's equity share capital, amounting to Rs. 48,00,000.

announcements.subject: Wim Plast Ltd-$ - 526586 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Enclosed h/w is the copy of Order received from Hon''ble NCLT, sanctioning the Composite Scheme of Arrangement.
announcements.ai_summary: Wim Plast Limited announced that the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Ahmedabad Bench, has sanctioned the Composite Scheme of Arrangement. The NCLT uploaded its Order dated May 14, 2026, on its website, approving the scheme. This arrangement involves Wim Plast Limited ("WPL"), Cello Consumer Products Private Limited ("CCPPL"), and Cello World Limited ("CWL"), along with their respective shareholders and creditors. The scheme was sanctioned under Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013. Wim Plast Limited will provide further updates on developments regarding this scheme.

announcements.subject: Pokarna Ltd - 532486 - The Company Has Received Demand Notice From Department Of Mines And Geology Government Of Andhra Pradesh.
announcements.detail: The Company has received Demand Notice from Department of Mines and Geology Government of Andhra Pradesh.
announcements.ai_summary: On May 15, 2026, Pokarna Ltd received a Demand Notice from the Department of Mines and Geology, Government of Andhra Pradesh. The notice alleges misuse of dispatch permits and unlawful excavation/transportation of colour granite under the APMMC Rules, 1966. The authorities have raised a demand aggregating to Rs. 33,39,58,289, which includes normal seigniorage fee of Rs. 4,66,56,900, penalty of Rs. 27,96,03,000, DMF of Rs. 58,32,113, Merit of Rs. 9,33,138, and IT at 2% of Rs. 9,33,138. The company is seeking legal advice regarding the impact of this demand on its financial, operational, or other activities.

announcements.subject: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd - 539876 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation of order passed
announcements.ai_summary: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd received an interim injunction order from the Hon’ble High Court of Delhi on May 14, 2026, at 7:05 pm. The order pertains to "one model grace fan" and alleges similarity in overall visual appearance and essential design features. Despite the interim injunction, the company has stated that there is no material impact on its financials, operations, or other activities. This disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Race Eco Chain Ltd - 537785 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition
announcements.detail: Intimation for acquisition of 51% stake by Subsidiary company in LLP
announcements.ai_summary: Race Eco Chain Ltd announced that its material subsidiary, M/s. Ganesha Recycling Chain Pvt Ltd, has acquired a 51% stake in M/s. Shubhlaxmi Ecoplast LLP through an Admission cum Reconstitute deed executed on May 15, 2026. This acquisition, with a fixed capital contribution of Rs. 2,30,00,000 (Rupees Two Crore Thirty Lac Only), makes M/s. Shubhlaxmi Ecoplast LLP a subsidiary of M/s. Ganesha Recycling Chain Pvt Ltd and a step-down subsidiary of Race Eco Chain Ltd. The target entity, M/s. Shubhlaxmi Ecoplast LLP, operates in the recycling industry and had a turnover of Rs. 80.24 Lac in 2025. This acquisition is part of the company's overall corporate objectives to expand its business.

announcements.subject: Ethos Ltd - 543532 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange regarding press release dated May 15, 2026, titled ''Ethos Limited Marks a Golden Milestone as it Opens 100th Boutique in India.''
announcements.ai_summary: Ethos Limited issued a press release on May 15, 2026, announcing the opening of its 100th boutique in India, located in Indore. This milestone reinforces the company's commitment to providing luxury timepieces and service excellence across the country. The new boutique features a range of prestigious international watch brands. The opening signifies Ethos' continued expansion and its dedication to catering to watch enthusiasts and collectors nationwide. The company has grown from a single boutique to a pan-India network over two decades, enhancing its retail experience through various formats, including mono boutiques, Summits, and Haute Horology boutiques.

announcements.subject: RBL Bank Ltd - 540065 - Update On Disclosures Dated October 18, 2025 And April 11, 2026 Under Relevant Provisions Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015
announcements.detail: RBL Bank Limited informs the exchange about update under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: RBL Bank Limited provided an update on its disclosures dated October 18, 2025, and April 11, 2026, as per SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. On May 15, 2026, the bank was informed by Emirates NBD Bank (P.J.S.C) that it received approval from the Government of India, Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services) on May 14, 2026. This approval allows Emirates NBD Bank to acquire between 49% and 74% of RBL Bank's total paid-up equity share capital, subject to the completion of customary conditions precedent outlined in the Investment Agreement dated October 18, 2025. The proposed investment also includes the amalgamation of Emirates NBD Bank's existing Indian operations into RBL Bank.

announcements.subject: Ugro Capital Ltd - 511742 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment

The Company has initiated a detailed investigation with the support of internal IT teams and external ....

announcements.detail: AM approval for listing of MCL
announcements.ai_summary: Coal India Limited (CIL) has received Alternative Mechanism (AM) approval for the listing of its subsidiary, Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL), and the disinvestment of CIL's equity in MCL. CIL is authorized to disinvest its stake in MCL through an Offer for Sale (OFS) of existing shares as part of MCL's Initial Public Offering (IPO), and subsequently in one or more tranches. MCL is also approved to raise capital through a fresh issue of equity shares as part of its IPO, and/or through subsequent FPOs, QIPs, or other SEBI-approved methods. The disinvestment and capital raising can be undertaken simultaneously or separately, in one or more tranches, with the overall extent of disinvestment/capital raising limited to reducing CIL’s shareholding in MCL by up to 25%. The proposed listing remains subject to prevailing market conditions and completion of all necessary statutory and regulatory formalities.

announcements.subject: GMR Airports Ltd - 532754 - Monthly Traffic Updates
announcements.detail: Monthly Traffic Updates
announcements.ai_summary: GMR Airports Limited released its monthly traffic data for April 2026 on May 15, 2026, reporting approximately 10 million passengers served across its portfolio airports, a decrease of 0.5 million or 5.0% year-over-year. Domestic traffic stood at 7.6 million (down 0.3 million or 3.7% YoY), while international traffic was 2.3 million (down 0.2 million or 8.9% YoY), though monthly traffic has remained sustainably around 10.0 million passengers since October 2025. For the full FY26, the company achieved a record 121.6 million passengers, including 92 million domestic (up 0.6% YoY) and 30 million international (up 1.7% YoY). Operational performance records were set in FY26 at Delhi (highest ATMs, cargo volumes over 1 million metric tonnes), Hyderabad (highest Pax, ATMs, cargo volumes), and Goa (highest Pax, ATMs). The April 2026 decline and muted FY26 growth were attributed to temporary disruptions from changed airspace conditions due to geopolitical events and the Runway 10/28 upgradation at Delhi Airport, which re-opened on September 16, 2025.

announcements.subject: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd - 533326 - Clarification To Institutional Investor Advisory Services (Iias) Voting Recommendation - Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd. - Postal Ballot
announcements.detail: Clarification to IiAS Voting Recommendation - Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd. - Postal Ballot
announcements.ai_summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd. issued a clarification on May 15, 2026, in response to voting recommendations from Institutional Investor Advisory Services (IiAS) concerning a postal ballot dated March 31, 2026. The resolution in question pertains to the approval of the Texmaco Rail Long Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) Scheme, 2026. The company clarified that its LTI framework is firmly anchored in performance-based vesting, aligning leadership incentives with long-term shareholder value creation. Performance metrics for vesting include EBITDA margin (30%), EPS (25%), ROCE (30%), and Operating Cash Flow (15%) annually, with final vesting after 3 years based on average performance. No vesting will occur if 85% of the stated targets are not achieved, and while actual target thresholds are not disclosed to avoid revealing commercially sensitive information, they are defined, measurable, and approved by the Nomination & Remuneration Committee.

announcements.subject: JSW Energy Ltd - 533148 - JSW Energy Commissions ~250 MW RE Capacity Since April'26
announcements.detail: JSW Energy Commissions ~250 MW RE Capacity since April'26
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Energy Limited announced on May 15, 2026, that it has successfully commissioned approximately 250 MW of renewable energy capacity since April 2026. This includes 130 MW of Wind, 69.4 MW of Solar, and the 50 MW Tidong Hydro Plant Unit-I, which was acquired in January 2026 and commissioned in a record turnaround time. The company's total installed capacity now stands at 13.7 GW, with renewables comprising 59% of this. The remaining two units of the Tidong Hydro Plant are expected to be commissioned by June 2026. JSW Energy has a total locked-in generation capacity of 32.1 GW, with 13.7 GW operational and 13.8 GW under construction. The company plans to add approximately 3 GW of renewable capacity in FY27 and expects to incur a total capital expenditure of approximately ₹20,000 crores in FY27. Furthermore, JSW Energy has 29.6 GWh of locked-in energy storage capacity and aims to reach 30 GW of generation capacity and 40 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2030, with a goal of achieving carbon neutrality by 2050.

announcements.subject: Bharat Dynamics Ltd - 541143 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Media Release Manufacturing facility at T. Sirasapalli, A.P
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) announced that the foundation stone for its new Naval Systems Manufacturing Facility has been laid by the Hon'ble Raksha Mantri at T. Sirasapalli, Andhra Pradesh. This facility, spread across nearly 160 acres, is designed to meet the growing requirements of the Indian Navy for advanced underwater and naval combat systems. It will feature advanced manufacturing and assembly infrastructure, integration buildings, explosive handling and storage, and testing facilities, including an acoustic tank. The establishment of this facility is a significant step towards strengthening India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and advancing the 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' vision in the strategic defence sector. The new complex is expected to substantially increase BDL's production capacity and enable the execution of multiple concurrent projects.

announcements.subject: Honasa Consumer Ltd - 544014 - Disclosure Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Honasa Consumer Limited provided an update on its dispute with RSM M General Trading LLC regarding the termination of an Authorised Distributor Agreement dated 30th July 2020, amended on 27th May 2021. Initially, on 17th May 2024, the Court of First Instance, Dubai, ordered Honasa to pay RSM AED 25,071,991 as compensation, plus 5% annual interest. The Delhi High Court, on 20th August 2024, granted an anti-enforcement order against Dubai proceedings, directing RSM to deposit INR 57,17,65,947 (equivalent to the decree value) with its registry. On 15th October 2024, the Court of Appeal, Dubai, upheld the initial judgment, which Honasa subsequently challenged before the Cassation Court. The Supreme Court of India, on 17th February 2025, appointed Justice (Retd.) Hrishikesh Roy as Sole Arbitrator, commencing arbitration proceedings. Subsequently, on 26th March 2025, the Cassation Court, Dubai, overturned the Court of Appeal judgment as flawed and remanded the matter for a fresh rehearing, rendering the Court of First Instance judgment inoperative. Most recently, on 11th February 2026, the Court of Appeal, Dubai, significantly reduced the compensation payable by Honasa from approximately AED 25 million to AED 1.7 million.

1.  To raise funds by issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs), and Compulsorily Convertible Debentures (CCDs) aggregating upto an amount of Rs.660.00 Crores (Rupees Six Hundred and Sixty Crores only) to repay the outstanding term loans and related liabilities.

announcements.ai_summary: Deccan Cements Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 14, 2026, approved a plan to raise funds aggregating up to Rs. 660.00 Crores through the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) and Compulsorily Convertible Debentures (CCDs). These funds are intended to repay outstanding term loans and related liabilities. The company will seek shareholder consent via a Special Resolution through Postal Ballot for the issuance of CCDs up to Rs. 103.00 Crores. For the CCD issuance, Rs. 103.00 Crores will be raised via private placement from five identified investors, with each CCD having a face value of Rs. 715/-, convertible into one equity share of Rs. 5/- at a premium of Rs. 710/-, within 18 months of allotment.

Institutional investors had raised queries about the board nomination framework and its role in the company's ambition to become an Indian Owned and Controlled Company (IOCC). Swiggy clarified that the Proposed Amendment aims to rationalize legacy nomination rights and ensure management continuity and board-level representation. Furthermore, these amendments are part of a broader effort to achieve IOCC status under Indian foreign exchange laws, which requires resident shareholding to exceed 50% and control to be vested in resident Indian citizens or entities. Given the absence of an identifiable promoter group, the company emphasizes the need for a governance architecture supporting domestic control. The Proposed Amendments alone do not confer IOCC status and will necessitate shareholder approval and additional corporate actions.

announcements.subject: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd - 544232 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI(LODR) Regulations ,2015  for entering  MOU with ER Steel Inc., British Columbia , Canada, for exploration and development of open web steel joists(OWSJ) business for North America and Canada.
announcements.ai_summary: Interarch Building Solutions Limited announced on May 13, 2026, that its Board of Directors approved entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with ER Steel Inc., British Columbia, Canada. This collaboration aims to jointly explore and develop the Open Web Steel Joists (OWSJ) business specifically for the North American market, encompassing both Canada and North America. The proposed arrangement seeks to establish a structured framework for evaluating the design, engineering, manufacturing, and supply of OWSJ products via a scalable and cost-efficient platform based in India. Conversely, ER Steel Inc. will primarily focus on supporting market development, customer relationships, sales, and marketing efforts within Canada and the broader North American region.

announcements.subject: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Ltd - 544408 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

The dispute stems from circulars issued in 2025 by the Additional District Magistrate, Collector of Stamps, Revenue Department, Delhi, challenging the applicable stamp duty rate for dematerialized shares under the Indian Stamp Act, 1899, as amended. announcements.detail:

For more details, please refer the attachment
announcements.ai_summary: Embassy Developments Ltd has announced a favorable outcome from the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka on May 12, 2026. The court allowed a writ petition filed by Embassy East Business Park Limited (EEBPL), a subsidiary of the company, and set aside a previous order from the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board (KIADB) dated March 16, 2026. This KIADB order had directed the resumption of approximately 78 acres of land in the Kadugodi Industrial Area, Bengaluru, held by EEBPL. Consequently, EEBPL will continue to hold and retain possession of this land, and the KIADB order is now quashed and ineffective. This development is considered material and favorable for the company and its stakeholders. The formal signed copy of the court order is still awaited.

announcements.subject: Le Travenues Technology Ltd - 544192 - Media Release - Ixigo Reimagines Travel With A Fully AI-Native App; Reinvents TARA As A Multimodal AI Assistant And Introduces Agentic Travel Flows
announcements.detail: Media Release titled ''ixigo Reimagines Travel With a Fully AI-Native App; Reinvents TARA as a Multimodal AI Assistant and Introduces Agentic Travel Flows''
announcements.ai_summary: Le Travenues Technology Ltd has announced the launch of its fully AI-native app, which reimagines travel experiences. The app introduces TARA, a multimodal AI assistant that will plan, book, and act on behalf of users, moving beyond traditional booking functionalities. Key features include "Trip Mode" for consolidated post-booking information and real-time alerts, and "Agentic Travel Flows" where AI agents proactively assist travelers. This redesign integrates AI from the ground up, aiming to make travel planning more conversational, intuitive, and personalized for users seeking flights and hotels. The company unveiled these advancements at its flagship tech launch event, ixigo NEXT.

announcements.subject: Atul Ltd - 500027 - Product Launch
announcements.detail: Letter attached
announcements.ai_summary: Atul Ltd has launched three new proprietary crop protection products for the Indian domestic market: Mylonis, Salix Gold, and Tikadis. Mylonis is a patented fungicide designed to combat challenging diseases in rice, such as sheath blight and blast, while also strengthening plant health and improving grain quality. Salix Gold is a 2,4-D sodium salt-based water-dispersible granule formulation offering post-emergence weed control for broadleaf weeds and sedges in rice cultivation. Tikadis is a premium technical-grade herbicide for rice. These launches aim to enhance crop productivity and promote sustainable farming practices by addressing critical needs in disease, pest, and weed management for key crops. The company is focused on the domestic market for these products, with a launch date of May 13, 2026.

announcements.subject: Ceigall India Ltd - 544223 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order

announcements.ai_summary: Ceigall India Limited (CIL) has been selected to set up 50 MW Standalone Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) in Punjab. The selection was made through a Tariff-Based Global Competitive Bidding process via E-Reverse Auction by Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL). The contract includes a 12-year Battery Energy Storage Purchase Agreement (BESPA) with a tariff of Rs. 2.99/KWh. The project cost is estimated at Rs. 125 Cr, and the execution period for setting up the plant is 18 months, followed by 12 years of operation and maintenance.

announcements.subject: Desco Infratech Ltd - 544387 - Announcement Under Reg 30 Of SEBI LODR - Intimation Regarding L1 Bidder For ONGC Pipeline Replacement Project
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding emergence as L1 Bidder for ONGC Pipeline Replacement Project
announcements.ai_summary: Desco Infratech Limited has emerged as the L1 (Lowest Bidder) for the ONGC Pipeline Replacement Project. This project involves the replacement and strengthening of critical 24-inch crude oil transfer pipelines from the ONGC Trombay Terminal to BPCL and HPCL Refineries at Uran Plant. The project is strategically important for ensuring safe and efficient crude oil transportation within India's energy infrastructure. The company's selection as L1 bidder highlights its technical and execution capabilities in the oil & gas and hydrocarbon infrastructure sector. This development is expected to further strengthen Desco Infratech Limited's order pipeline.

announcements.subject: Archean Chemical Industries Ltd - 543657 - Execution Of Fiscal Support Agreement By Sicsem Private Limited (Subsidiary Of Archean Chemical Industries Limited) With The India Semiconductor Mission ("ISM")

announcements.ai_summary: Archean Chemical Industries Limited's step-down subsidiary, SiCSem Private Limited, along with wholly-owned subsidiary Neun Infra Private Limited, executed a Fiscal Support Agreement (FSA) with the India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) on May 11, 2026. This FSA, following ISM approval on August 12, 2025, formalises the fiscal incentive framework under the Semicon India Programme. The agreement supports the establishment of India's first approved Silicon Carbide (SiC) based Compound Semiconductor Fab and ATMP facility at Info Valley, Bhubaneswar, Odisha. The project involves an investment of approximately Rs. 2,067 crore, aiming for an annual capacity of ~60,000 SiC wafers and ~96 million SiC MOSFETs and diodes. This facility will cater to critical sectors such as Electric Vehicles (EVs), Renewable Energy, and 5G. The company had previously extended inter-corporate funding to Neun Infra to advance procurement of long-lead machinery pending FSA execution.

announcements.detail: Kindly find attached herewith disclosure under SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 for your reference and record.
announcements.ai_summary: Pakka Limited has provided a detailed bifurcation of the project cost for its 'Jagriti Project', an ongoing capital expenditure program at its existing manufacturing facility aimed at capacity expansion, facility upgradation, and integrated operations. The total revised cost of the Jagriti Project is INR 744.00 Crore. This project includes the installation of a new paper machine (PM-4), upgrading existing paper machines (including PM-3), expanding and modernizing the pulp mill, installing captive power generation facilities, developing chemical recovery systems, and upgrading the effluent treatment plant. The cost is bifurcated across Phase I (INR 95.65 Crore), Phase II (INR 644.53 Crore), and Phase III (INR 3.83 Crore), including components like project land, civil work, plant & machinery, contingency, pre-operative expenses, and interest during construction. This bifurcation is based on a revised Techno-Economic Viability assessment, reflecting cost escalations due to design changes, time overruns, and foreign exchange fluctuations.

announcements.subject: Active Clothing Co Ltd - 541144 - Opening Of Retail Outlets Under The Brand Name 'NUEMO'. It Is A Company'S Strategic Entry Into The Multi-Brand Retail Segment.
announcements.detail: opening of retail outlets under the brand name "NUEMO". it is a Company Strategic entry into the multi-brandretail segment.
announcements.ai_summary: Active Clothing Co Ltd announced its strategic entry into the multi-brand retail segment with the approval to open retail outlets under the brand name "NUEMO". This initiative will operate as a multi-brand retail platform targeting growth opportunities in India's Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns. NUEMO will feature flexible retail models offering men's, women's, and kids' apparel under one roof, alongside category-specific stores based on market demand, aiming to create a curated and scalable retail ecosystem. The company expects NUEMO to strengthen its retail presence in underserved markets, leverage existing manufacturing and brand-building capabilities, and establish a scalable, technology-driven retail model. The projected topline for NUEMO is approximately ₹200–250 crore within four years, subject to market conditions and execution.

announcements.subject: KELTECH Energies Ltd - 506528 - Update Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Order Received From CESTAT.
announcements.detail: Update under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 Order received from CESTAT
announcements.ai_summary: Keltech Energies Ltd has received a favorable order from the Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal (CESTAT). This update pertains to an earlier disclosure on February 12, 2025, where the company had received a notice from the Commissioner of Customs imposing a penalty of Rs. 13,75,43,257/- for the import of Ammonium Nitrate. Keltech Energies Ltd had filed an appeal before CESTAT. The Hon’ble CESTAT has now allowed the appeal and set aside the order passed by the lower authority. Consequently, there is no further liability arising on account of this matter for the company.

announcements.subject: Piccadily Agro Industries Ltd - 530305 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release dated 12.05.2026
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Piccadily Agro Industries Ltd. has announced significant achievements by its subsidiary, Piccadily Distillery, at the London Spirits Competition 2026 and the Asian Spirits Masters 2026. Indri Agneya was awarded 'Single Malt Whisky of the Year' with 95 points at the London Spirits Competition, while Cashmir Vodka achieved a Double Gold with 96 points, highlighting its excellence beyond whisky. At the Asian Spirits Masters 2026, Piccadily Distillery secured Master Awards for Indri Trini, Indri Dru, and Camikara Rum 8-Year-Old. Further, Camikara Rum 3-Year-Old also received accolades. These awards reinforce the company's position in India's premium spirits market and its ability to compete globally.

announcements.subject: Fedbank Financial Services Ltd - 544027 - Update On Shareholding
announcements.detail: Update on Shareholding
announcements.ai_summary: Fedbank Financial Services Limited has been informed by True North Fund VI LLP, a significant shareholder, that they have disposed of their entire stake in the company. True North Fund VI LLP previously held 2,56,95,139 equity shares, representing approximately 6.8644% of the paid-up equity share capital. The stake was sold through a block deal on the stock exchange mechanism to Nomura India Equity Fund, which is managed by Nomura Asset Management - FPI. Consequently, True North Fund VI LLP's shareholding in Fedbank Financial Services Limited is now Nil.

announcements.subject: Seamec Ltd - 526807 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail: Intimation of Execution of Charter Party with M/s. Lamprell Energy Limited for Charter Hire of Vessel "SEAMEC PRINCESS"

announcements.subject: Dreamfolks Services Ltd - 543591 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR)-Updates On Second Phase Of Acquisition
announcements.detail: Announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) - Update on Second phase of acquisition is attached herewith
announcements.ai_summary: Dreamfolks Services Limited has provided an update on the second phase of its acquisition of ETT Solutions DMCC. The first phase, involving the secondary purchase of shares, has been completed and registered with the Dubai Multi Commodities Centre Authority, resulting in Dreamfolks Services Limited holding a 34% stake in ETT. The subsequent phase, which involves a primary subscription to freshly issued shares, is currently underway and is expected to be completed after remaining procedural and regulatory formalities. announcements.subject: Veefin Solutions Ltd - 543931 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press release - NEDFi Partners with Veefin Solutions to Revolutionize Digital Lending Operations in Northeast India.
announcements.ai_summary: Veefin Solutions Limited has entered into a multi-year contract with North Eastern Development Finance Corporation Ltd. (NEDFi) to implement a comprehensive digital lending ecosystem. This partnership aims to enhance credit access across the North Eastern Region of India by deploying Veefin's cloud-hosted solutions, including a Loan Origination System (LOS), Loan Management System (LMS), and Loan Collection System (LCS). The deployment will also feature dedicated mobile applications for sales and collection, along with a customer portal for borrowers. The solution will integrate with credit bureaus and banking APIs to create a unified financial ecosystem. NEDFi expects the new software, to be fully implemented within the next few months, to help reach entrepreneurs in remote areas and benefit small borrowers in unserved and underserved regions. Veefin Solutions was selected through an extensive RFP process, and their solutions were found to meet NEDFi's digital transformation requirements.

announcements.subject: Coal India Ltd - 533278 - Striking Off And Dissolution Of CIL Solar PV Limited (A Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of Coal India Ltd.) Under Section 248(2) Of The Companies Act, 2013.

announcements.subject: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd - 500645 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd has received an order from the Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, Nodal-3, Pune, dated March 31, 2026. The order imposes a total demand of Rs. 74,89,20,261, comprising Rs. 31,04,33,269 in tax, Rs. 36,08,78,675 in interest, and Rs. 7,76,08,317 in penalty. The company collected this order on May 11, 2026. The department erred in levying a 13.5% MVAT rate on the sale of Natural Gas to a subsidiary instead of the applicable 3% rate for captive consumption. Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd believes the demand is not tenable and plans to challenge the order at an appropriate forum. The company has stated there is no material impact on its financials, operations, or other activities. This information is also available on the company's website at www.dfpcl.com.

announcements.subject: L&T Technology Services Ltd - 540115 - Press Release Titled 'L&T Technology Services And Emerson Announce A Global Cooperation And Strategic Engagement To Drive Innovation In Engineering Excellence'
announcements.detail: Press Release attached.
announcements.ai_summary: L&T Technology Services (LTTS) and Emerson have announced a global cooperation and strategic engagement to drive innovation in engineering excellence. This partnership, focused on LTTS's sustainability segment, will combine LTTS's engineering capabilities with Emerson's NI test platform to accelerate system integration and product development across various industries. LTTS will act as a global System Integrator and technology development partner, supporting the design, deployment, and lifecycle enablement of advanced systems engineering platforms. The collaboration will also involve joint engagement approaches for customer projects, positioning LTTS as a key system integration partner for the NI test platform. The focus sectors include Industrial, Transportation, Semiconductors, and Aerospace & Defense. As part of this agreement, LTTS will establish a dedicated Centre of Excellence (CoE) at its Mysuru campus, based on the NI test and measurement platform, to serve as a global hub for joint development.

announcements.subject: United Spirits Ltd - 532432 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements

announcements.ai_summary: United Spirits Ltd (USL) has amended and restated its share purchase agreement (A&R SPA) dated May 11, 2026, concerning the sale of Royal Challengers Sports Private Limited (RCSPL). The original purchasers, Aelius Investments Pte Ltd and Metropolitan Media Company Limited, will no longer be parties to the A&R SPA, with their rights assumed by the continuing and additional purchasers. The underlying consortium, the sale of 14,690 equity shares of RCSPL, and the aggregate consideration of INR 166.6 billion remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: Voltas Ltd - 500575 - Intimation - Update On A Pending Material Litigation As Required Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation- Update on a pending material litigation as required under Regulation 30 of the SEBI(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Voltas Limited has provided an update on a pending material litigation as required by Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The Court of Appeal in Qatar issued a judgment on May 4, 2026 (English translation received on May 9, 2026) in a matter involving Voltas and a Joint Venture of OHL International, Spain, and Contrack (Cyprus) Limited. The judgment mandates OHL International, Spain, and Contrack (Cyprus) Limited to pay QAR 163.62 million (approximately ₹425.58 crores) to Kentz Voltas Consortium (KVC) for outstanding subcontract payments and an additional QAR 40 million (approximately ₹104.04 crores) as compensation. Furthermore, bank guarantees totaling QAR 166.72 million (approximately ₹433.64 crores) are to be returned to Voltas within 10 days of the judgment. The counterclaims filed by OHL International, Spain, and Contrack (Cyprus) Limited have been dismissed. Voltas Limited has filed an application for the execution of this order and will monitor further developments.

announcements.subject: Infosys Ltd - 500209 - Receipt Of No-Objection Letter For Re-Classification Of Certain Members Of The Promoter And Promoter Group Under Regulation 31A Read With Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

announcements.subject: Thomas Cook (India) Ltd - 500413 - Disclosure Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 As Amended

announcements.subject:
Canara Bank - 532483 - Revision In Marginal Cost Of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR)
W.E.F. 12.05.2026

announcements.ai_summary: Canara Bank has announced a revision in its Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR) effective from May 12, 2026. The overnight MCLR will increase from 7.85% to 7.90%. Similarly, the one-month MCLR will be revised from 7.90% to 7.95%, and the three-month MCLR from 8.15% to 8.20%. The two-year MCLR will be revised from 8.95% to 9.00%, and the three-year MCLR from 9.00% to 9.05%. This update is for the information and records of the exchange.

announcements.subject: Nisus Finance Services Co Ltd - 544296 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release - Nemetschek and NCCCL Partner to Lead India''s AI-Driven Construction Revolution, Pilot Projects Launch with Runwal and L&T Realty.
announcements.ai_summary: Nisus Finance Services Co Limited has issued a press release announcing a strategic partnership between Nemetschek Group India and New Consolidated Construction Company Ltd. (NCCCL). This three-year partnership aims to integrate Building Information Modeling (BIM) and structured digital workflows into India's construction projects. Pilot projects will be launched with Runwal and L&T Realty to demonstrate improvements in design validation, project transparency, and operational control. This collaboration is expected to redefine India's infrastructure sector by leveraging Nemetschek's technology and NCCCL's construction expertise.

announcements.subject: Shanti Gold International Ltd - 544459 - Change In Accounting Policy - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Read With Schedule III Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Change in Accounting Policy - Disclosure under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Shanti Gold International Limited's Board of Directors, at a meeting held on May 11, 2026, approved a voluntary change in its accounting policy for inventory valuation. The policy has been changed from the First-In-First-Out (FIFO) method to the Weighted Average Cost (WAC) method, effective retrospectively from April 01, 2024, and applicable for financial reporting from FY 2025-26 onwards. This change, made in accordance with Ind AS 8, is intended to provide more reliable and relevant financial information by better reflecting the blended cost of inventories, improving cost-revenue matching, and aligning with industry practices. The company has conducted a detailed analysis to quantify the financial impact of this change on key financial parameters.

announcements.subject: Vodafone Idea Ltd - 532822 - Rumour verification - Regulation 30(11)

The news article may be referencing this earlier disclosure.

announcements.subject: Sai Life Sciences Ltd - 544306 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Intimation for Achievement of 100% renewal Power at Bidar Campus of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Sai Life Sciences Limited has announced a significant sustainability milestone: its Bidar campus, which includes Unit IV (flagship API manufacturing facility) and Unit VI (animal health API manufacturing facility), now operates entirely on renewable power. This achievement makes the Bidar site the first facility within an Indian CRDMO to be powered by 100% renewable electricity. The transition was a multi-year effort, with renewable sources accounting for 21% of the site's energy consumption prior to this full transition. This initiative reflects the company's long-term view on sustainability, resilience, and resource efficiency in its infrastructure.
