announcements.subject: Prism Johnson Ltd - 500338 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligation And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: The Company informed about the conclusion of  Arbitration proceeding between the Company and M/s Doosan Power Systems India Pvt Ltd in a commercial dispute.
announcements.ai_summary: Prism Johnson Ltd has announced the conclusion of arbitration proceedings with M/s Doosan Power Systems India Pvt Ltd concerning a commercial dispute. An oral Arbitral Award was pronounced on April 16, 2026, in New Delhi, favoring Prism Johnson Ltd. As per the award, M/s Doosan Power Systems India Pvt Ltd is obligated to pay the company an amount of Rs. 8,86,52,116/- by May 27, 2026, to settle all claims, counterclaims, interest, and costs. The company had previously written off this claim amount in earlier years. The written and signed Arbitral Award was received by Prism Johnson Ltd on April 23, 2026.

announcements.subject: DHP India Ltd - 531306 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Todays Board Meeting Dated 24/04/2026 And Todays All Four Committees Meetings Of Annual Meet Of Statutory Requirement Related To Year Ended 31/03/2026
announcements.detail: Outcome of Todays Board Meeting dated 24/04/2026 and Todays all Four Committees Meetings of Annual Meet of Statutory requirement related to Year ended 31/03/2026
announcements.ai_summary: DHP India Ltd held its Board of Directors meeting on April 24, 2026, following meetings of its four committees: Stakeholders Committee, Nomination & Remuneration Committee, Corporate & Social Responsibility (CSR) Committee, and Audit Committee. The Nomination & Remuneration Committee recommended an increase in employee remuneration for FY2026-27, which was approved by the Board. The Board also approved the commencement of Statutory Audit, Tax Audit, Cost Audit, and Secretarial Audit for FY2025-26. These outcomes are related to the annual general affairs for the year ended March 31, 2026.

announcements.subject: Alkyl Amines Chemicals Ltd-$ - 506767 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: The company, Alkyl Amines Chemicals Ltd, has issued an update regarding its production of Ammonia-based products. This announcement follows a previous disclosure on March 16, 2026, concerning disruptions caused by the geopolitical conflict in the Middle East, which had impacted logistics and the global supply chain for crude oil and petrochemicals. While the overall ammonia supply situation remains uncertain and dynamic, it has improved sufficiently to allow for a gradual restart of production for ammonia-based products. This information is provided for the record and is in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Patel Retail Ltd - 544487 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Patel Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Press Release dated Friday, April 24,2026 with respect to opening of Patel''s R MART Store No. 51.
announcements.ai_summary: Patel Retail Limited has announced the opening of its 51st Patel’s R Mart store, located at Ganesh Nagar, Rasayani, Khalapur, Raigad. This opening, effective April 24, 2026, strengthens the company's presence in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) and aims to increase accessibility to quality groceries and daily essentials in suburban and emerging urban markets. The company highlights its integrated sourcing, packaging, processing, and logistics capabilities, which enable efficient scaling of operations and ensure product quality, affordability, and customer convenience. This expansion aligns with Patel Retail Limited's cluster-based growth strategy and its commitment to expanding organized retail accessibility in high-potential residential and semi-urban clusters.

announcements.subject: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd - 524715 - Incorporation Of A Subsidiary Company
announcements.detail: Incorporation of a Subsidiary Company
announcements.ai_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has announced the incorporation of a new subsidiary company, Sun Pharma America, Inc., in the United States of America on April 23, 2026. This incorporation is part of the company's internal group structuring. The subsidiary operates within the pharmaceutical industry. The initial capital consideration for this newly set-up company was in cash. No specific governmental or regulatory approvals are required for this intimation, and there is no applicable indicative time period for completion as it pertains to the establishment of the subsidiary.

announcements.subject: Apcotex Industries Ltd - 523694 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: Revised Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Acquisition of shares of M/s. Opera Vayu (Narmada) Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Apcotex Industries Limited has completed the acquisition of 33,75,000 equity shares, representing 5.12% of the total voting capital, in Opera Vayu (Narmada) Private Limited for a total value of INR 3,37,50,000. This acquisition was finalized on April 23, 2026. The objective of acquiring shares in this Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) is to facilitate the captive consumption of hybrid power generated by Opera Vayu (Narmada) Private Limited. The company has requested that this revised intimation supersede any previous submissions regarding this matter. No further approvals are indicated as pending for this transaction.

announcements.subject: Ashoka Buildcon Ltd - 533271 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail:
Ashoka Buildcon Limited (the Company) informs that the Company had submitted bid to the Ministry of Energy and Water, the Republic of Angola, (the Authority) for the Project viz. Electricity Sector Improvemenet and Access Project (the Project).

Further to update that the Company has received Letter of Contract Acceptance for the said Project.
announcements.ai_summary: Ashoka Buildcon Ltd has received a Letter of Contract Acceptance from the Ministry of Energy and Water, the Republic of Angola, for the 'Electricity Sector Improvement and Access Project'. The project involves the Design, Supply, Installation, and Commissioning of the Rehabilitation of Distribution Networks for Lot 5 Luanda City 2. The accepted bid cost for this international contract is USD 72,359,639.46. The execution of this contract is expected to be completed within 24 months. This announcement is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Patel Retail Ltd - 544487 - Patel Retail Limited Has Informed The Exchange About Opening Of 51 Patel''s R Mart Store.
announcements.detail: Patel Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Opening of 51 Patel''s R Mart Store.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Patel Retail Limited has opened its 51st Patel's R Mart store, located at Survey No 34 B/6 Ganesh Nagar Rees Mohopada Khalapur, Khalapur, Raigad, Maharashtra 410206. This expansion brings the total number of stores operated by the company to fifty-one as of April 24, 2026.

announcements.subject: Greaves Cotton Ltd - 501455 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail:
Please find enclosed herewith Press Release issued by Greaves Electric Mobility Limited, subsidiary of the Company , with the heading, "Greaves Electric Mobility strengthens Ampere Magnus portfolio with the New Magnus Neo"

Kindly take the same on record.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Greaves Electric Mobility Limited, a subsidiary of Greaves Cotton Ltd, has launched the all-new Magnus Neo under its Ampere electric two-wheeler brand. This new variant is designed to offer a lighter, smoother, and more comfortable riding experience, with a focus on seat ergonomics and rider comfort for everyday use. The vehicle features a lightweight construction for easier maneuverability and a 10-inch rear tire for improved control in city conditions. The new Magnus Neo aims to make electric mobility more practical and accessible for a wider range of riders by addressing practical riding needs and enhancing rideability through ergonomic design and a new wheel and motor configuration for smoother acceleration and stability.

announcements.subject: Tamboli Industries Ltd - 533170 - Admission & Trading Permission On National Stock Exchange (NSE). Regulation 30 Of LODR, 2015.
announcements.detail: Admission & Trading permission on National Stock Exchange (NSE). Regulation 30 of LODR, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Tamboli Industries Ltd has received admission and trading permission on the National Stock Exchange (NSE). This approval is effective from April 20, 2026, as per NSE's Listing Department Circular Ref. No. NSE/CML/73797 dated April 17, 2026. The company's securities will now be permitted to trade on the NSE portal. The trading symbol for Tamboli Industries Ltd on the NSE will be 'TAMBOLIIN'. This development is in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Brightcom Group Ltd - 532368 - OMS Operational Updates
announcements.detail: OMS Operational Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Brightcom Group Ltd has announced a significant operational milestone achieved by its subsidiary, OMS. OMS has successfully completed a large-scale programmatic infrastructure deployment in partnership with Azerion, a global digital entertainment and media platform. This project involved scaling Azerion's publisher network from approximately 11 domains to over 100+ domains within a six-month period. OMS utilized its proprietary infrastructure, including independently managed data centers and AI-driven systems, to handle high-volume traffic expansion without performance degradation. The deployment enabled high-throughput query handling, seamless onboarding of multiple domains, and stable performance. By operating its own infrastructure, OMS optimized cost structures and improved operational margins. The company also deployed AI-powered monitoring systems for continuous performance tracking and optimization. This achievement reinforces Brightcom Group's focus on infrastructure-led competitive advantages and AI-driven programmatic capabilities.

announcements.subject: Reliance Industries Ltd - 500325 - Media Release - "TIME To Bring 'TIME100 Next' To India For The First Time In Partnership With Reliance.'
announcements.detail: Please find attached a media release by the Company, titled "TIME to bring ''TIME100 Next'' to India for the First Time in Partnership with Reliance."
announcements.ai_summary: Reliance Industries Ltd has entered into a partnership with TIME to launch "TIME100 Next India" for the first time. This initiative will recognize 100 emerging Indian leaders across various sectors, including arts, science, business, sports, and advocacy. The list will be curated by TIME editors and will be published online, culminating in a gala event at the Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre in Mumbai in December 2026. This collaboration signifies Reliance's commitment to empowering the next generation of talent and leadership in India, aligning with their vision of bringing global best practices to India and showcasing Indian talent to the world.

announcements.subject: JTL Industries Ltd - 534600 - Receipt Of Trading Approval By Subsidiary Company_JTL Defence Limited
announcements.detail: JTL Defence Limited (Erstwhile RCI Industries & Technologies Limited) a subsidiary of the Company has received Trading Approval from the BSE Limited for 1,05,26,315 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each and same shall be availbable for trading from 27.04.2026
announcements.ai_summary: JTL Industries Ltd has announced that its subsidiary, JTL Defence Limited (formerly RCI Industries & Technologies Limited), has received trading approval from BSE Limited. The approval is for 1,05,26,315 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each. These shares will be available for trading on the exchange starting from Monday, April 27, 2026. The trading approval covers new equity shares issued on account of capital reduction (5,26,315 shares) and on a preferential basis (1,00,00,000 shares). JTL Defence Limited will be listed and admitted to dealings on the BSE under the XT Group and will continue to trade in the Trade-to-Trade segment.

announcements.subject: Aayush Wellness Ltd - 539528 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Aayush Wellness Limited launches "Liver Detox Tablets" to capture growing demand in Preventive Wellness and Lifestyle Disease Management.
announcements.ai_summary: Aayush Wellness Limited has launched "Liver Detox Tablets," a herbal formulation aimed at supporting liver health and addressing the growing prevalence of lifestyle-related liver disorders. This launch represents a strategic expansion of the company's preventive healthcare portfolio and aligns with its focus on condition-led wellness categories. The new product is designed to naturally detoxify, protect, and regenerate liver cells, catering to increasing health awareness and demand for daily preventive solutions. The company believes this move positions it to capitalize on the large and growing wellness opportunity driven by lifestyle disorders and consumer preference for daily health supplements.

announcements.subject: Indian Oil Corporation Ltd - 530965 - Disclosure Under Chapter XIV - Centralized Database For Corporate Bonds/ Debentures Of SEBI Operational Circular Dated August 10, 2021 (Updated As On April 13, 2022)
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Chapter XIV- Centralized Database for Corporate Bonds/Debentures of SEBI Operational Circular dated August 10, 2021 (Updated as on April 13, 2022) for the year ended March 31, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Oil Corporation Limited has submitted a disclosure under Chapter XIV-B of the SEBI Operational Circular dated August 10, 2021, for its debt securities issued through private placement for the year ended March 31, 2026. The disclosure includes listing details for seven series of debt securities with ISINs INE242A08437, INE242A08502, INE242A08528, INE242A08536, INE242A08544, INE242A08551, and INE242A08569. announcements.subject: Hindustan Construction Company Ltd - 500185 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: We are enclosing a copy of the Press Release being issued by the Company today in this regard. We request you to take the same on record.
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Construction Company Ltd (HCC) has won a contract valued at approximately ₹2,917 crore from the City and Industrial Development Corporation of Maharashtra Limited (CIDCO). The contract is for the construction of a 22.21 km raw water tunnel and a 250 MLD water treatment plant in Raigad. This project has been awarded to the LCESPL-HCC Joint Venture, with HCC responsible for executing works estimated at approximately ₹1,100 crore. The scope includes tunnel construction using Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) technology and the design, build, supply, erection, testing, and commissioning of the water treatment plant, along with 15 years of operation and maintenance under a Design, Build and Operate (DBO) model. This project is crucial for CIDCO's strategy to enhance water supply infrastructure for Navi Mumbai and surrounding areas.

announcements.subject: Atul Auto Ltd-$ - 531795 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Atul Auto and Exponent Signed Contract/ MOU for the manufacture and supply of 15000 electric three-wheelers in a period of 3 years from state approval to vehicles.
announcements.ai_summary: Atul Auto Ltd has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Exponent Energy Private Limited for the manufacturing and supply of 15,000 electric three-wheelers. Under this agreement, Atul Auto will act as the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and will integrate Exponent's battery system and powertrain into the vehicles. The collaboration covers manufacturing, supply, sales, servicing, and customer support. The volume commitment of 15,000 electric three-wheelers is for a period of three years, extendable by an additional six months, from the date of state transport authority approvals. This MOU is expected to accelerate Atul Auto's presence in the electric vehicle segment.

announcements.subject: Edelweiss Financial Services Ltd - 532922 - Disclosure Under The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 regarding IPO of EAAA India Alternatives Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Edelweiss Financial Services Ltd has received an observation letter from the Securities & Exchange Board of India (SEBI) on April 23, 2026, for the proposed Initial Public Offering (IPO) of its wholly-owned subsidiary, EAAA India Alternatives Limited. The IPO will include an Offer for Sale (OFS) by Edelweiss Securities & Investments Private Limited (ESIPL), not exceeding ₹15,000 million. The receipt of SEBI's observations allows EAAA India Alternatives Limited to proceed with the IPO within the next 12 months, subject to market conditions, necessary approvals, and other regulatory compliances. This disclosure is made in continuation of the company's letter dated January 20, 2026.

announcements.subject: Hari Govind International Ltd - 531971 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change of Company Name
announcements.detail: Submission of new Certificate of Incorporation pursuant to the Name change of the Company from "Hari Govind International Limited" to "Popees Baby Care India Limited".
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Ltd has announced a significant change in its corporate identity. The Ministry of Corporate Affairs has officially approved the company's name change from "Hari Govind International Limited" to "Popees Baby Care India Limited". This change is effective from April 22, 2026, as evidenced by the fresh Certificate of Incorporation received on the same date. The company is now operating under its new name, Popees Baby Care India Limited. As per regulations, the company must display its old name, Hari Govind International Limited, alongside its new name for a period of two years. Investors should note this name change for all future correspondence and record-keeping.

announcements.subject: Sheela Foam Ltd - 540203 - Sale Of Fraction Share In Open Market In Pursuant Of Merger
announcements.detail: Sale of 575 fraction shares in open market in pursuant of merger of KEL into SFL
announcements.ai_summary: Sheela Foam Ltd announced on April 23, 2026, the sale of 575 fractional shares in the open market. This sale is a consequence of the composite scheme of arrangement involving the amalgamation of Kurlon Enterprise Limited (KEL) into Sheela Foam Limited (SFL). The fractional entitlements arising from the share exchange ratio have been consolidated and allotted to a Trust appointed by the Board. This Trust sold the consolidated shares on April 22, 2026. The net proceeds from this sale, after deducting charges and taxes, will be distributed to the eligible shareholders of Kurlon Enterprise Limited based on their respective fractional entitlements.

announcements.company: Anzen India Energy Yield Plus Trust
announcements.subject: Anzen India Energy Yield Plus Trust - 543655 - Reg 21: Disclosure of valuation report received by the manager
announcements.detail: Anzen India Energy Yield Plus Trust has informed the Exchange regarding Full Valuation report subsequent to material development FY ended 2025-26

This report is in connection with the proposed acquisition of SEPL Energy Private Limited. The valuation report was received on April 15, 2026, and is enclosed with the announcement. This submission is in accordance with Regulation 21(6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Infrastructure Investment Trusts) Regulations, 2014.

announcements.subject: Lux Industries Ltd - 539542 - Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On April 23, 2026
announcements.detail: Outcome of the Board Meeting held on April 23, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: On April 23, 2026, the Board of Directors of Lux Industries Ltd held a meeting where it was informed that the members of the promoter and promoter group from the Todi Family have entered into a Family Settlement Agreement (FSA). The company is not a party to this FSA. The Board has accorded its in-principle approval for a scheme of demerger, subject to regulatory and stakeholder approvals. This demerger contemplates separating the company's businesses into three verticals. Verticals A and C will be demerged into two new listed companies, led by the AKT Family and KKT Family, respectively. Vertical B will remain with Lux Industries Ltd, managed by the PKT Family. Following this, the AKT and KKT families will cease to hold management or control rights in Lux Industries Ltd, while the PKT family will continue to manage and control the company.

announcements.subject: Krystal Integrated Services Ltd - 544149 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: On April 23, 2026, Advait Krystal Solar Energy SPV Private Limited, an associate company of Krystal Integrated Services Ltd, entered into a Power Purchase Agreement with the Directorate of Medical Education & Research, Mumbai, and the Directorate of Ayush (M.S) Medical Education & Drug Department, Mumbai. This agreement is for the supply of power. The details of the agreement, including the counterparties and the date of execution, have been disclosed as per SEBI Listing Regulations. This development is for the information and records of the exchange.

announcements.subject: Gujarat Gas Ltd - 539336 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release - titled Gujarat Gas Limited Supports Revival of Morbi Ceramic Industry with Assured Gas Supply and Pricing.
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Gas Limited (GGL) has issued a press release on April 23, 2026, reaffirming its commitment to supporting the revival of the Morbi ceramic industry. Amidst recent geopolitical disruptions that led to increased raw material costs and restrictions on industrial propane usage, GGL ensured uninterrupted natural gas supply and price stability. The company proactively sourced gas from non-Middle East markets to maintain supply as per government directives. GGL's efforts, including engaging with the Morbi Ceramic Association, have facilitated the gradual resumption of industrial activity in Morbi. Gas consumption has increased significantly from approximately 0.36 mmscmd serving 83 units on March 31, 2026, to approximately 2.70 mmscmd serving 290 units on April 22, 2026.

announcements.subject: Havells India Ltd - 517354 - Intimation Of Grant And Vesting
announcements.detail: Intimation of Grant and Vesting of Shares under employees stock purchase schemes of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: On April 23, 2026, Havells India Limited announced the vesting of shares to eligible employees under its employee stock purchase plans for the financial year 2025-26. This action was taken based on the Nomination and Remuneration Committee Meeting held on April 21, 2026. Under the Havells Employees Long Term Incentive Plan 2014, 1,14,191 shares of Re. 1/- each were vested. Additionally, 1,50,000 shares of Re. 1/- each were vested under the Havells Employees Stock Purchase Scheme 2015, and 40,619 shares of Re. 1/- each were vested under the Havells Employees Stock Purchase Scheme 2016. The exercise period for these vested shares is 30 days from the date of vesting.

announcements.subject: Birla Corporation Ltd - 500335 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Commencement Of Coal Mining Operations - Corrigendum
announcements.detail: In continuation of our earlier intimation of even date, please find enclosed the corrigendum issued by the Company in the above subject matter.
announcements.ai_summary: Birla Corporation Limited has issued a corrigendum on April 23, 2026, regarding its earlier intimation about the commencement of coal mining operations. The company clarified that the figure of 9.44 Million Tonnes, previously stated as the Annual Production Capacity of the Bikram Coal Mine at Burhar, Shahdol, Madhya Pradesh, actually represents the Extractable Reserves of the mine. The Peak Rated Capacity of the mine is 0.36 Million Tonnes Per Annum (MTPA). This correction is to ensure accurate information is available to stakeholders and has been uploaded to the company's website.

announcements.subject: Bharat Wire Ropes Ltd - 539799 - Intimation Of Acquisition Of Shares By Shareholder(S)
announcements.detail: Intimation of acquisition of shares by shareholder(s)
announcements.ai_summary: On April 23, 2026, Bharat Wire Ropes Limited announced that Lloyds Metals and Energy Limited and Lloyds Enterprises Limited have acquired shares in the company. Lloyds Metals and Energy Limited acquired 20,00,000 shares, representing 2.91% of the total voting capital, increasing their total shareholding to 23,00,000 shares, or 3.35%. Lloyds Enterprises Limited acquired 16,46,875 shares, representing 2.40% of the total voting capital, bringing their total shareholding to 16,46,875 shares, or 2.40%. These acquisitions were made through market purchases. Prior to this, Lloyds Metals and Energy Limited held 3,00,000 shares (0.44%) and 14,569 warrants (0.02%). The disclosures were made under Regulation 29(1) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.

announcements.subject: Digispice Technologies Ltd-$ - 517214 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Order dated April 22, 2026 passed by Hon''ble NCLT for convening meeting of equity shareholders of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: DigiSpice Technologies Limited has received an order dated April 22, 2026, from the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Principal Bench, New Delhi. The order directs DigiSpice Technologies Limited to convene a meeting of its equity shareholders, through Video Conferencing/Other Audio Visual Means, as part of the Scheme of Amalgamation by way of merger. This merger involves DigiSpice Technologies Limited, Spice Money Limited, E-Arth Travel Solutions Private Limited, and Vikasni Fintech Private Limited. The NCLT's order is a step towards the approval of this amalgamation scheme.

announcements.subject: Prime Fresh Ltd - 540404 - Intimation Regarding Receipt Of Approval Letter Received From The Stock Exchange For Listing Of 1,18,849 Equity Shares Of Rs. 10/- Each At A Premium Of Rs. 154/- Issued To Promoter On A Preferential Basis Pursuant To Conversion Of Warrants.
announcements.detail: Intimation Regarding Receipt of Approval Letter Received From The Stock Exchange for Listing of 1,18,849 Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- each at a premium of Rs. 154/- Issued to promoter on a Preferential Basis Pursuant to Conversion of Warrants.
announcements.ai_summary: Prime Fresh Ltd has received approval from the stock exchange for the listing of 1,18,849 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, issued at a premium of Rs. 154/- per share. These shares were issued to the promoter on a preferential basis pursuant to the conversion of warrants. The total issue price per share is Rs. 164/- (Rs. 10/- face value + Rs. 154/- premium). The company has been advised by the exchange to ensure compliance with SEBI (ICDR) Regulations and to file the shareholding pattern in XBRL mode if there is a change exceeding two percent of the total paid-up share capital.

announcements.subject: Eraaya Lifespaces Ltd - 531035 - Outcome Of Fund-Raising Committee Meeting Held Today, I.E. April 23, 2026.
announcements.detail: Conversion of Warrants into equity shares as per letter attached
announcements.ai_summary: Eraaya Lifespaces Ltd's Fund-Raising Committee, in a meeting held on April 23, 2026, approved the allotment of 31,25,000 Equity Shares of face value Re. 1/- each at an issue price of Rs. 81/- each (including a premium of Rs. 80/- each). The company's issued and paid-up capital has increased to Rs. 20,98,19,160/-, comprising 20,98,19,160 equity shares.

announcements.subject: Sarla Performance Fibers Ltd-$ - 526885 - Chairman & Managing Director Note
announcements.detail: Mr. Krishna Jhunjhunwala, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company (DIN: 00097175) - communication to the Shareholders of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Sarla Performance Fibers Ltd has divested its investment in preference shares of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Sarlaflex Inc., located in the United States. The subsidiary, incorporated to expand global manufacturing, suspended operations in December 2017 due to unforeseen business and market circumstances, resulting in a negative net worth as of March 31, 2026. This divestment has led to a recognized loss of ₹7,713.26 lakhs, of which ₹111.59 lakhs was received as sale consideration. The company expects this to improve its Return on Capital Employed (ROCE) by removing non-productive capital and strengthening the balance sheet. The transaction is largely a non-cash accounting adjustment and does not impact operational liquidity or current cash flows.

announcements.subject: Star Cement Ltd - 540575 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition
announcements.detail: We hereby inform you that M/s Star Cement North East Limited (SCNEL), subsidiary of the Company has acquired 100% shareholding of M/s Jaitaran Renewable Power Private Limited (JRPPL) from its shareholders. Consequently, JRPPL has became a wholly-owned subsidiary of SCNEL and a step down subsidiary of Star Cement Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Star Cement Limited's subsidiary, Star Cement North East Limited (SCNEL), has acquired 100% of the shareholding in Jaitaran Renewable Power Private Limited (JRPPL) from its shareholders. This acquisition makes JRPPL a wholly-owned subsidiary of SCNEL and a step-down subsidiary of Star Cement Limited. JRPPL has an authorized share capital of Rs. 10.00 Lakhs (1,00,000 shares of Rs.10/- each) and a paid-up share capital of Rs. 0.20 Lakhs. The company's turnover for 2025 was Nil. This acquisition is intended to diversify Star Cement's business into the renewable energy sector. No governmental or regulatory approvals are required for this acquisition.

announcements.subject: Power Finance Corporation Ltd - 532810 - Assumption Of Charge By Shri Rajesh Kumar Agarwal (DIN: 09699001) As Director (Finance) On The Board Of Power Finance Corporation Limited
announcements.detail: Intimation
announcements.ai_summary: Power Finance Corporation Ltd has announced that Shri Rajesh Kumar Agarwal (DIN: 09699001) has assumed charge as Director (Finance) on the Board of the company on April 23, 2026. This appointment is pursuant to an order from the Ministry of Power, Government of India, and he will serve for a period of five years or until further orders. Shri Agarwal brings over 31 years of experience in the Power and Financial sectors, holding a Bachelor's degree in Commerce (Honours) and is a Member of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

announcements.subject: United Breweries Ltd-$ - 532478 - Media Release - India Operations
announcements.detail: Media Release by Heineken N.V. (Promoter Group) on India Operations
announcements.ai_summary: United Breweries Ltd announced a media release by its promoter group, Heineken N.V., regarding India operations for the Q4-January-March 2026 trading update. The release, published on April 23, 2026, states that net revenue in India grew by a low-single-digit, and total volume grew by a mid-single-digit. announcements.detail: Update under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations

The Hon’ble Court has dismissed the claim filed by Comex with no order as to costs. Comex had filed a claim for £543,501.07 for breach of contract on June 3, 2024, allegedly in retaliation to Clearcomm's £195,000.00 adjudication award. The dismissal follows an out-of-court settlement for an amount of £25,000 (excluding taxes). This settlement has no significant financial impact on STL Networks Ltd. The company had previously attempted to strike out Comex's claim, and an agreement was reached to sample 110 claims. Comex had faced delays in providing required documentation and evidence for these samples.

announcements.ai_summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited (ABREL) announced strong financial performance for FY2026 through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Birla Estates Private Limited. The company achieved a booking value of ₹8,136 crores, driven by robust demand in key markets such as NCR, Bengaluru, and MMR. Collections saw a significant increase of 23.5% year-on-year, indicating strong customer engagement and sales momentum. Birla Estates launched 8 new projects spread across four regions during FY2026, catering to the growing demand for integrated community ecosystems and premium residential offerings. The company attributes its success to a focus on design differentiation, execution excellence, and the assurance of a trusted legacy brand, supported by stable macroeconomic fundamentals and sustained end-user demand in India's residential real estate sector.

announcements.subject: Cipla Ltd - 500087 - Cipla Receives U.S. FDA Approval For First AB Rated Generic Of Ventolin® HFA
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed intimation
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Cipla Limited announced on April 23, 2026, that its wholly owned subsidiary, Cipla USA Inc., has received final approval from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA). This approval is for Albuterol Sulfate Inhalation Aerosol, 90 mcg per actuation, which is the first AB-rated generic therapeutic equivalent of Ventolin® HFA, marketed by GlaxoSmithKline. The product is indicated for the treatment or prevention of bronchospasm in adult and pediatric patients aged four years and older with reversible obstructive airway disease, as well as for preventing exercise-induced bronchospasm. Cipla USA Inc. expects to launch this product in the United States in the first half of FY 2026-27.

announcements.subject: K.P. Energy Ltd - 539686 - Press Release - KP Energy Limited Receives Inter-State Electricity Trading Licence From CERC, Expanding Access To Nationwide Power Markets
announcements.detail: K.P. Energy Limited informed the Exchange regarding press release titled KP Energy Limited Receives Inter-State Electricity Trading Licence from CERC, Expanding Access to Nationwide Power Markets. The Disclosure is attached herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: K.P. Energy Limited has been granted an Inter-State Electricity Trading Licence (Category V) by the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) as announced on April 23, 2026. This license allows the company to trade electricity across state boundaries and participate in nationwide power markets, thereby expanding its market reach and trading capabilities. This development is a significant milestone for K.P. Energy Limited, enhancing its flexibility in power sales, enabling better market-linked realizations, and supporting its strategy of building an integrated renewable energy platform. The company will now be able to access demand centers across multiple states, optimize power sales based on market conditions, engage with a broader customer base, and participate in exchange-led and short-term markets.

announcements.subject: Dynamatic Technologies Ltd-$ - 505242 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: The company, Dynamatic Technologies Limited, through its division Dynauton Systems, has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Aerodata AG, a German aviation solutions provider. This MoU establishes a strategic partnership to develop a new unmanned, airborne surveillance and reconnaissance solution specifically for the Indian region. The collaboration will focus on further developing Aerodata's AeroForce® X platform, a Male UAS with high payload capacity and up to 40 hours of endurance, suitable for ISR missions. Dynauton Systems will contribute its engineering and manufacturing expertise in unmanned systems, while Aerodata will bring its experience in integrating complex airborne surveillance systems. This partnership aims to tailor the AeroForce® X platform to meet the requirements of the Indian market for ISR missions, particularly in challenging terrains like the Himalayas and the Indian Ocean Region.

announcements.subject: Infosys Ltd - 500209 - Infosys Announces Strategic Collaboration With Openai To Accelerate Enterprise AI Transformation And Unlock AI Value At Scale
announcements.detail: Enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Infosys Limited has announced a strategic collaboration with OpenAI, aiming to accelerate enterprise AI transformation and unlock AI value at scale. This partnership will leverage OpenAI's frontier AI models, including Codex, and combine them with Infosys Topaz Fabric, an agentic services suite. announcements.subject: HCL Technologies Ltd - 532281 - Release - 'Hcltech Launches Gemini Enterprise Business Unit To Accelerate Agentic AI Adoption'
announcements.detail: Enclosed please find a release on the captioned subject being issued by the Company today.
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Ltd has announced the launch of a dedicated Gemini Enterprise Business Unit to accelerate the adoption of agentic AI solutions. This new unit, the first of its kind from a global system integrator, will focus on developing industry-specific solutions built on Google Gemini Enterprise. announcements.detail: Enclosed herewith Announcement pertaining to update on USFDA.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Supriya Lifescience Limited has provided an update on an inspection conducted by the United States Food & Drug Administration (USFDA) at its manufacturing facility in Lote, Maharashtra. The inspection took place from February 2, 2026, to February 6, 2026, and resulted in the issuance of a Form 483 with one minor observation. The company has addressed this observation and has received the Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) with a "Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI)" status, confirming the successful completion of the inspection. Supriya Lifescience Limited remains committed to maintaining full compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) requirements across all its facilities.

announcements.subject: Escorts Kubota Ltd - 500495 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Copy of press release issued by company titled "Escorts Kubota expands Digitrac into a full series, launches three new tractor models"
announcements.ai_summary: Escorts Kubota Ltd has issued a press release announcing the expansion of its Digitrac tractor series and the launch of three new tractor models. This expansion broadens the Digitrac range to a comprehensive series of five models, covering the 45–55 HP category, including a 4-Wheel Drive option. This marks the company's fourth major tractor launch since February 2025 across its three brands: Kubota, Farmtrac, and Powertrac. The Digitrac series, part of the Powertrac brand, is designed for advanced agricultural and heavy haulage applications and will be launched pan-India. The new models are the Digitrac PP 46i 4WD, Digitrac PP 43i Plus, and Digitrac PP 41i, all featuring enhanced specifications like bigger engines and a 12 forward and 3 reverse constant mesh gearbox.

announcements.subject: Dalmia Bharat Ltd - 542216 - Release Of Attached Properties Of The Dalmia Cement (Bharat) Limited, Material Subsidiary Of The Company
announcements.detail: ED has vide its order dated April 21, 2026 ordered release of entire attached land parcels.
announcements.ai_summary: Dalmia Bharat Ltd announced on April 22, 2026, that the Enforcement Directorate (ED) has ordered the release of entire attached land parcels belonging to its material subsidiary, Dalmia Cement (Bharat) Limited (DCBL). This follows an earlier Provisional Attachment Order (PAO) dated March 31, 2025, which had provisionally attached land parcels of DCBL. The PMLA Tribunal had previously reduced the Proceeds of Crime (PoC) to Rs. 92.52 crs. DCBL had made an application to the ED along with a bank guarantee of Rs. 92.52 crs, leading to the ED's order on April 21, 2026, to release the attached land parcels. The alleged POC has been reduced from Rs. 793.34 cr to Rs. 92.52 crs. DCBL is in the process of filing an appeal against the impugned order regarding the alleged POC of Rs. 92.52 Cr.

announcements.subject: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Ltd - 543895 - Signing Of Term Sheet - Exhibition & Convention Centre At MMLP Indore
announcements.detail: Intimation is enclosed herewith
announcements.ai_summary: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Limited has signed a Term Sheet for a strategic Design & Construction along with Operations & Maintenance (O&M) partnership for an Exhibition & Convention Centre at MMLP Indore, Madhya Pradesh. Under an asset-light model, the entire project CAPEX will be funded by the Developer, with Exhicon Global Development Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, awarded the design and construction, converting project CAPEX into execution revenue. The company will also act as the Operator with zero capital deployment, generating dual revenue streams from execution and annuity operations. The O&M phase includes a 35% revenue share for Years 1-3 and 30% from Year 4 onwards, applicable across various event types and ancillary revenues. This 10-year O&M agreement with a lock-in period provides long-term revenue visibility and a stable, growing revenue stream with built-in escalation. The project is strategically located at MMLP Indore, spanning approximately 4 acres within a 255-acre Multimodal Logistics Park, and is part of a larger commercial ecosystem. This marks Exhicon's 5th multipurpose venue signed in the last 2 years, reinforcing its position as a fast-growing integrated event venue company.

announcements.subject: Aeroflex Enterprises Ltd-$ - 511076 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: The Company has successfully acquired an additional stake of 4% in M.R. Organisation Limited, subsidiary company
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited has successfully acquired an additional 1,03,350 equity shares in its subsidiary, M.R. Organisation Limited ("MRO"), at a price of Rs. 539.50 per share, aggregating to Rs. 5,57,57,325. This acquisition represents a 4% increase in the issued and paid-up share capital of MRO. This transaction is the third tranche of the acquisition envisaged under the Share Purchase Agreement dated July 27, 2024, and the Deed of Amendment (DOA) dated April 21, 2026. announcements.subject: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd - 500104 - Intimation To The Stock Exchanges Regarding Fire Incident At HRRL Refinery
announcements.detail: Intimation to the stock exchanges regarding fire incident at HRRL Refinery
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) has informed about a fire incident that occurred on April 20, 2026, at the Crude Distillation Unit (CDU) section of the HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (HRRL) refinery, a joint venture company. The fire is believed to have been caused by a leakage of hydrocarbons from a valve or flange in the heat exchanger circuit and was localized to the heat exchangers stack. The CDU, Vacuum Distillation Unit (VDU), and other associated units were promptly isolated and are structurally safe. There were no loss of life or injuries. As a precautionary measure, the scheduled dedication of the refinery by the Hon’ble Prime Minister on April 21, 2026, has been postponed, with a new date to be announced later. An investigation is underway to determine the cause and necessary remedial actions, and the financial and operational impact is being assessed but is not expected to be material.

announcements.detail: Press Release titled "Prestige Estates Sees Strong Response to ''Prestige Golden Grove'' in Hyderabad, Clocks Rs. 2,500 Crore in Early Sales".
announcements.ai_summary: Prestige Estates Projects Limited has reported a strong response to its residential project, 'Prestige Golden Grove', in Hyderabad, achieving early sales of over ₹2,500 crore. The project, located in Tellapur, has witnessed over 4,000 customer footfalls and sold more than 1,700 units within two weeks of its launch. 'Prestige Golden Grove' is a large-scale development spread across approximately 29 acres, comprising around 5,120 units across 10 towers. The total estimated gross development value (GDV) for the project is approximately ₹9,500 crore. The company highlighted the sustained homebuyer demand and the project's strategic location, modern living blend, quality construction, and lifestyle amenities as key drivers for its success.

announcements.subject: Parsvnath Developers Ltd - 532780 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find attached Press Release- Received completion of 20.67 Acres Project in Indore
announcements.ai_summary: Parsvnath Developers Limited has announced the completion of its project 'Saatvik Green NX' located in Raukhedi, Indore, Madhya Pradesh. The project is situated on a land parcel measuring 83,670 Sqm or 20.67 Acres. This development, undertaken in collaboration with RRHL Realty Limited, offers residential plots across three categories: Silver, Gold, and Platinum, with a total of 473 plots. The project commenced in April 2024, and all development work has now been finalized. The company has received the Completion Certificate from the Office of the Collector, District Indore. The project is strategically located on the AB Bypass Road, offering good connectivity to city landmarks and amenities.

announcements.subject: Embassy Developments Ltd - 532832 - Voluntary Strike-Off Of Non-Operational Step-Down Subsidiaries Of The Company
announcements.detail:
Voluntary strike-off of non-operational step-down subsidiaries of the Company.

For further information, please refer attachment.
announcements.ai_summary: Embassy Developments Ltd. has completed the voluntary strike-off of two non-operational step-down subsidiaries, Varali Real Estate Limited (VREL) and Devona Infrastructure Limited (DIL), from the register of companies. This action, taken on April 20, 2026, is part of the company's initiative to simplify its corporate structure and reduce administrative and compliance costs. As a result, VREL and DIL have been dissolved and are no longer subsidiaries of Embassy Developments Ltd. The company has stated that this event does not involve the sale of any undertaking or subsidiary and therefore does not contribute to turnover, revenue, income, or net worth.

announcements.subject: GRM Overseas Ltd - 531449 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: GRM Launches 10X Basmati Rice for Diabetics
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: GRM Overseas Ltd has announced the launch of its "10X Basmati Rice Suitable for Diabetics." This product launch is a strategic initiative to expand the company's health-focused product portfolio in both domestic and international markets. The 10X Basmati Rice is designed to offer the aroma, elongation, and taste of premium basmati rice while supporting better glycaemic management with low GI and high fibre content, without compromising on quality or taste. This launch aligns with GRM's vision to evolve into a diversified, consumer-centric food company addressing modern lifestyle needs. The product will be rolled out across key markets to cater to the rising demand for healthier dietary choices.

announcements.subject: PNGS Gargi Fashion Jewellery Ltd - 543709 - Akshay Tritiya Sales Update
announcements.detail: Akshay Tritiya Sales Update for FY 2026-27.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: PNGS Gargi Fashion Jewellery Ltd has provided an update on its sales performance for Akshay Tritiya for the financial year 2026-27. The company recorded strong counter sales, including those at Shop-in-Shop (SIS) stores operating on a FOFO (Franchise Owned Franchise Operated) model. Akshay Tritiya revenue for FY 2026-27 reached ₹236.82 Lakhs, representing a Year-on-Year (YoY) growth of 77.41% compared to ₹133.49 Lakhs in FY 2025-26. The revenue channel mix for FY 2026-27 shows that counter sales contributed 76.44% from SIS stores and 23.56% from Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs). As of the reporting date, the company has a retail footprint of 127 stores across 65 cities and 21 states.

announcements.subject: JSW Steel Ltd - 500228 - 5.95% Fixed Rate Senior Unsecured Notes Issued By Periama Holdings LLC ('Issuer') Have Matured In The Normal Course As Per The Terms Of Their Issuance, And Have Been Fully Redeemed On April 20, 2026 By The Issuer.

announcements.subject: Mobavenue AI Tech Ltd - 539682 - Mobavenue Delivers AI-Powered Campaigns For Sebamed, Goibibo And Snabbit, Securing Two Gold And One Silver At DIGIXX 2026.
announcements.detail: Mobavenue Media Private Limited, a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of Mobavenue AI Tech Limited, has been recognized for two Gold awards and one Silver across AI/ML-Powered marketing, programmatic campaign execution and location based targeting categories at the DIGIXX Awards 2026 by Adgully. Theses recognisitions reflect MMPL''s capabilities in delivering data-driven and technology-enabled marketing solutions across diverese campaign objectives.
announcements.ai_summary: Mobavenue Media Private Limited (MMPL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Mobavenue AI Tech Limited (MATL), has received significant recognition at the DIGIXX Awards 2026 by Adgully. MMPL secured two Gold awards for Best AI/ML-Powered Marketing Solution for Sebamed and Best Programmatic Marketing Campaign for Goibibo. Additionally, it won a Silver award for Location-Based Targeting Campaign for Snabbit. These accolades highlight MMPL's proficiency in delivering data-driven and technology-enabled marketing solutions, including AI/ML-powered marketing, programmatic campaign execution, and location-based targeting. The company's success is attributed to its ability to integrate data, automation, and audience intelligence to achieve outcome-oriented objectives and drive measurable growth for its clients.

announcements.subject: Biocon Ltd - 532523 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Biocon Limited announced on April 21, 2026, that Health Canada has granted a Notice of Compliance (NOC) for its biosimilars Bosaya™ (denosumab) and Vevzuo™ (denosumab). Bosaya™ is a biosimilar to Prolia®, approved for treating postmenopausal women with osteoporosis at high risk for fracture, increasing bone mass in men with osteoporosis at high risk for fracture, and increasing bone mass in men with nonmetastatic prostate cancer receiving androgen deprivation therapy. Vevzuo™ is a biosimilar to Xgeva®, approved for treating bone complications associated with cancer. Both products are denosumab injections for subcutaneous use, with Bosaya™ in a 60 mg/mL prefilled syringe and Vevzuo™ in a 120 mg/1.7 mL single-dose vial. This approval signifies Biocon's expanding access to high-quality biosimilars in key global markets and strengthens its portfolio of affordable biologic therapies.

announcements.subject: GOCL Corporation Ltd-$ - 506480 - Update On Leased Land Situated At Kukatpally, Hyderabad.
announcements.detail: Update on leased land situated at Kukatpally, Hyderabad.
announcements.ai_summary: GOCL Corporation Limited has provided an update regarding leased land situated at Kukatpally, Hyderabad. The company has become aware of ongoing proceedings concerning an order from the Endowment Tribunal, Telangana, which directs GOCL not to alienate its land or provide adequate security. The company is currently reviewing the order and seeking legal advice. Based on their current assessment, this development is not expected to have a material adverse impact on the company's operations or financial position. GOCL Corporation Limited will continue to monitor the situation and make further disclosures as required.

announcements.subject: Vishal Mega Mart Ltd - 544307 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Vishal Mega Mart Limited has informed the stock exchange that its subsidiary, Airplaza Retail Holdings Private Limited, has received an order from the Court of the Adjudicating Officer, Food Safety -cum- Additional District Magistrate (Revenue), Rayagada. On April 20, 2026, a penalty of Rs. 4,00,000/- was imposed on the subsidiary. This penalty stems from a violation of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, identified during an inspection of the subsidiary's store in Rayagada on May 19, 2025. announcements.subject: PDS Ltd - 538730 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR)
announcements.detail: PDS Limited has informed the stock exchange about the intimation.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: PDS Limited has disclosed an incident involving alleged professional misconduct by a former employee of Poeticgem International Limited, a step-down subsidiary in Hong Kong. Poeticgem has initiated legal actions in Bangladesh, and the matter is sub judice. PDS Limited filed a complaint with the Economic Offences Wing (EOW), Mumbai, on January 10, 2026, which led to an FIR being registered on April 18, 2026, under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. The preliminary internal review suggests historical transactions over four years, starting from August 2021, with an estimated value of approximately ₹20.15 Cr. This is a broad estimate and not a confirmed accounting loss, with no identified incremental financial exposure or future liability at this stage. The investigation is ongoing.

announcements.subject: Gayatri Projects Ltd - 532767 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment

announcements.subject: AVG Logistics Ltd - 543910 - Incorporation Of Joint Venture Company

announcements.subject: Ravindra Energy Ltd - 504341 - General Business Updates Of Electrical Vehicle Business
announcements.detail: Ravindra Energy Limited has informed the exchange regarding General Business update of electrical vehicle business.
announcements.ai_summary: Ravindra Energy Ltd has provided a business update regarding its electrical vehicle (EV) business. Its associate entity, Energy in Motion Limited (EIM), and Drivn have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to deploy approximately 1,000 electric heavy-duty commercial vehicles over the next two years. This partnership will combine EIM's vehicle and energy solutions with Drivn's EV leasing and financing platform, focusing on large-scale electric fleet deployment across India. The collaboration aims to improve access and reduce entry barriers for fleet operators by providing support across vehicle supply, financing, deployment planning, lifecycle management, and energy solutions, including charging and battery-swapping.

announcements.subject: 360 ONE WAM LTD - 542772 - Receipt Of In-Principle Approval From International Financial Services Centres Authority ('IFSCA')
announcements.detail: We would like to inform you that 360 ONE Global Asset Management (IFSC) Limited ("GAM"), a wholly owned subsidiary of 360 ONE Asset Management Limited ("AMC") and a step-down wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, has received in-principle approval from IFSCA to act as a Fund Management Entity (Retail).
announcements.ai_summary: 360 ONE Global Asset Management (IFSC) Limited (“GAM”), a wholly owned subsidiary of 360 ONE Asset Management Limited and a step-down wholly owned subsidiary of 360 ONE WAM LTD, has received in-principle approval from the International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA). The company plans to infuse necessary capital into GAM and obtain the final registration certificate from IFSCA to commence its asset and fund management business at GIFT City. This development was communicated to the exchanges on April 20, 2026.

announcements.subject: Dhampur Bio Organics Ltd - 543593 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Monday, April 20, 2026
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting held on Monday, April 20, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Dhampur Bio Organics Ltd's Board of Directors met on April 20, 2026, and approved several key decisions. The Board approved the transfer of the company's sugar factory located at Meerganj, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, on a slump sale basis to Forever Global Enterprises Limited. announcements.subject: IIFL Capital Services Ltd - 542773 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

announcements.subject: TVS Motor Company Ltd - 532343 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail: Signing of Joint Development Agreement with Hyundai Motor Company
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: TVS Motor Company Ltd has entered into a Joint Development Agreement (JDA) with Hyundai Motor Company on April 20, 2026. This agreement, signed internationally with Hyundai Motor Company of the Republic of Korea, is for the development, manufacturing, and commercialisation of electric micromobility 3-wheelers. The JDA outlines the terms for joint development, with Hyundai Motor Company leading the concept design and both parties collaborating on product development. The agreement also covers manufacturing, marketing, sales, and distribution of these products. TVS Motor Company will pay royalties for sales in India and other territories, while Hyundai Motor Company will provide compensation and royalties for sales in Korea and other designated regions.

This regulatory update signifies increased accessibility for investors to trade the company's shares on a major stock exchange.

announcements.subject: Muthoot Microfin Ltd - 544055 - Regulation 30- Key Business Update For The Quarter And Fiscal Year Ended 31 March 2026
announcements.detail: Regulation 30-Key business update for the quarter and fiscal year ended 31 March 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Muthoot Microfin Limited has provided a key business update for the quarter and fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The company reported a return to normalized business momentum, with Assets Under Management (AUM) growing by 13% year-over-year to Rs. 14,006 crore as of March 31, 2026, compared to Rs. 12,357 crore in the previous year. Disbursements increased by 6% YoY to Rs. 9,418 crore in FY26. The company's diversification into Individual Loans, Micro-Lap, and Gold Loans is progressing, with the non-JLG portfolio increasing to 17% of the total AUM. Asset quality improved, with GNPA trending lower and collection efficiencies rising. The total branch count stood at 1,670, with 91 branches consolidated during the year.

announcements.subject: Real Touch Finance Ltd - 538611 - Revised Announcement Under Regulation 30  Of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015.

announcements.subject: Andrew Yule & Company Ltd - 526173 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30

announcements.subject: JSW Steel Ltd - 500228 - Update On Joint Venture Agreement Between JSW Steel Limited And POSCO Group.
announcements.detail: Update on Joint Venture Agreement between JSW Steel Limited and POSCO Group.
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Steel Limited, along with POSCO Group (POSCO Co., Ltd and POSCO-India Private Limited), has executed a Share Subscription and Joint Venture Agreement. This marks a significant step in the strategic collaboration between JSW Steel and POSCO.

announcements.subject: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Ltd - 544111 - Press Release On Signing Of Two Hotel Management Agreements
announcements.detail: Press Release on signing of two hotel management agreements
announcements.ai_summary: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited (ASPHL) has announced the signing of two hotel management agreements for the development of Zone Connect by The Park in Ayodhya and Zone Connect by The Park in Ujjain. This strategic expansion aims to strengthen the company's presence in prominent spiritual destinations known for religious significance and growing tourism. Zone Connect by The Park, Ayodhya will feature 56 rooms and is located near Ram Janmabhoomi and Maharishi Valmiki International Airport. Zone Connect by The Park, Ujjain will have 64 rooms and is situated near Ujjain Railway Station and the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga Temple. These agreements align with ASPHL's growth strategy to cater to modern travellers seeking hospitality in culturally significant locations.

announcements.subject: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Ltd - 542759 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Meeting Of The Management Committee Of The Board Of Directors Held On April 20, 2026.

announcements.subject: Aeroflex Industries Ltd - 543972 - Intimation Of Participation In International Exhibition - Data Center World 2026
announcements.detail: Intimation of participation in International Exhibition- Data Center World 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Aeroflex Industries Limited will be participating in the Data Center World Exhibition, which is scheduled to take place in Washington, USA, from April 20 to April 23, 2026. The company will be showcasing its advanced flexible flow solutions specifically designed for liquid cooling systems. This participation highlights Aeroflex Industries' strategic focus on the high-growth data center infrastructure market and its commitment to developing next-generation thermal management technologies for the global market. Investors can note this as an initiative to expand market presence and showcase technological capabilities.

announcements.subject: Stanley Lifestyles Ltd - 544202 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Opening Of New Stores In Bengaluru.
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Opening of New Stores in Bengaluru.

The new stores include "Sofas & More by Stanley" on Mysore Road (10,000 sq. ft.) and in Gunjur (12,000 sq. ft.), as well as "Hilker India" on Hosur Road (6,000 sq. ft.). This expansion aims to enhance the company's retail presence and reach in the Bengaluru market. The company has provided this intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Jayant Infratech Ltd - 543544 - Compliances-Reg.24(A)-Annual Secretarial Compliance

announcements.subject: P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd - 544256 - Akshaya Tritiya Revenue Update - FY 2026-27
announcements.detail: Akshaya Tritiya Revenue Update - FY 2026-27
announcements.ai_summary: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited announced a strong revenue performance for Akshaya Tritiya in FY 2026-27, recording Rs. 251 Crores. This represents a significant year-on-year growth of 80.3% compared to Rs. 140 Crores in the previous year, marking the company's second-highest single-day revenue. The growth was driven by strong volume, healthy footfall, and traction across product categories. The gold segment contributed Rs. 220 Crores (79.6% YoY growth), silver Rs. 10 Crores (98.0% YoY growth), and diamond & other products Rs. 21 Crores (79.9% YoY growth). The gold segment also saw a 12.8% year-on-year volume growth.

announcements.company: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd
announcements.subject: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd - 542760 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed a copy of the press release with respect to  New Domestic Orders received by SWREL worth approx INR 3550 Crore
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited (SWREL) has announced receiving new domestic orders worth approximately INR 3,550 Crore. The company has been declared the L1 bidder for a turn-key EPC package of 875 MW AC in Bikaner, Rajasthan, from Coal India, with a total contract value including O&M and taxes of approximately INR 3,490 Crore. Additionally, SWREL secured an order for a 50 MW AC project in Maharashtra from a private IPP. These new orders bring the total EPC order inflow for FY26 to over INR 10,062 Crore, exceeding the company's initial target. Mr. Chandra Kishore Thakur, Global CEO, highlighted the significance of the first project from Coal India and expressed confidence in sustaining the growth momentum in India's renewable development sector. SWREL is a global pure-play EPC solutions provider with a total portfolio of over 26.1 GWp.

announcements.subject: Krishival Foods Ltd - 544416 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Krishival Foods Crosses 15,000 Deep Freezers, Strengthening Cold Chain Infrastructure and Retail reach Across India for its ice cream brand ''Melt N Mellow''
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Krishival Foods Limited has announced a significant expansion of its cold chain infrastructure for its ice cream brand 'Melt N Mellow'. The company has deployed over 15,000 deep freezers across its retail network, a substantial increase from 3,732 units at the beginning of the year to 15,490 units as of March 31, 2026. This expansion strengthens its last-mile distribution capabilities and aims to enhance product availability in urban and Tier II/III markets. The expanded freezer network is expected to improve product visibility and consistency. Krishival Foods' distribution footprint already covers over 30,000 retail touch points across Maharashtra, Karnataka, Goa, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh. This initiative aligns with the company's growth outlook and its strategy to capture the increasing demand for its ice cream portfolio.

announcements.subject: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd - 524000 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Intimation w.r.t Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd has announced the launch of its next-generation conversational AI platform for omnichannel customer service, a key step in its AI-first transformation. This unified platform aims to serve as a single customer service interface across all channels, ensuring a seamless and consistent customer experience. The platform is designed to autonomously resolve up to 80% of voice and chat interactions, which is expected to reduce service costs while simultaneously enhancing customer experience. More complex or high-empathy cases will be routed to human agents, allowing them to focus on value-added tasks. The AI platform incorporates an industry-first contextual interface with real-time insights, including customer history, loan risk flags, and sentiment analysis, to facilitate faster resolutions and improve first-contact closure rates. This initiative underscores Poonawalla Fincorp's strategy to leverage AI as a core driver for growth, sharper decision-making, and operational excellence across customer engagement, credit underwriting, risk management, and internal productivity.

announcements.subject: Titagarh Rail Systems Ltd - 532966 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed herewith Press Relese issued by Titagarh Naval Systems Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Titagarh Naval Systems Limited (TNSL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Titagarh Rail Systems Limited, launched its fourth Diving Support Craft A23 (YARD 328) for the Indian Navy on April 19, 2026. This vessel is part of a series of five DSCs being built under the Government of India’s Make in India initiative. The craft, designed as a catamaran, is equipped with advanced, indigenously sourced systems to support the Indian Navy’s Command Clearance Diving Teams (CCDTs) in underwater operations such as inspection, repair, maintenance, and salvage. The launch ceremony, attended by approximately 150 employees, took place on the Hooghly River at 1455 Hrs. The press release regarding this milestone is available on the company's website, www.titagarh.in.

announcements.subject: 360 ONE WAM LTD - 542772 - Disclosure Of Material Events With Respect To Subsidiaries Of The Company

announcements.ai_summary: The board of directors of 360 ONE Portfolio Managers Limited and 360 ONE Asset Management Limited, both wholly owned subsidiaries of 360 ONE WAM LTD, have approved the transfer of the Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) business and the Portfolio Management Services (PMS) business from the former to the latter. This business transfer will be on a going concern and slump sale basis for a consideration not less than the net book value of the undertaking, subject to adjustments for working capital. This transaction does not require shareholder approval as it is an internal restructuring between wholly owned subsidiaries and is not prejudicial to investors, creditors, or shareholders. The effective date of the transfer will be determined by the subsidiaries.

announcements.subject: ASI Industries Ltd - 502015 - Company Update
announcements.detail: Update under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR), 2015
announcements.ai_summary: ASI Industries Limited has sold its entire shareholding in Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd on April 17, 2026, through open market transactions. The company sold 75,000 equity shares, which represented approximately 0.014% of the paid-up share capital of Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd. Following this sale, ASI Industries Limited's holding in Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd is now NIL. The company has stated that this divestment of investment has no material impact on its financials, operations, or other activities. This update is provided under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

V. Investment and Dealers Limited, a promoter group entity. A total of 4,95,000 NCRPS, each with a face value of Rs. 1,000/-, have been allotted on a private placement basis. announcements.subject: Balaji Telefilms Ltd - 532382 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please refer attached file.
announcements.ai_summary: Balaji Telefilms Ltd announced that their film "Bhooth Bangla" has achieved a remarkable box office collection of ₹21.60 crore on its opening day in India. The horror-comedy film, presented by Balaji Motion Pictures in association with Cape of Good Films, has surpassed expectations and is performing strongly. Starring Akshay Kumar, Wamiqa Gabbi, Paresh Rawal, Tabu, and Rajpal Yadav, and directed by Priyadarshan, the film is a joint production by Akshay Kumar, Shobha Kapoor, and Ektaa R Kapoor. The impressive opening day collection indicates a positive reception from audiences and suggests a strong performance in the coming days.

announcements.subject: Lupin Ltd - 500257 - U.S. FDA Has Concluded An Inspection At The Company''s  Manufacturing Facility Located In Somerset, New Jersey, U.S.A.
announcements.detail: U.S. FDA has concluded an inspection at the Company''s manufacturing facility located in Somerset, New Jersey, U.S.A.
announcements.ai_summary: Lupin Ltd has informed that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has concluded an inspection at its manufacturing facility located in Somerset, New Jersey, U.S.A. The inspection, which took place from April 13, 2026, to April 17, 2026, resulted in the issuance of a Form-483 with three observations. Lupin Ltd has stated its commitment to addressing these observations and will provide a response to the U.S. FDA within the stipulated timeframe. The company emphasizes its dedication to maintaining CGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practice) standards across all its facilities. This disclosure is made in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Hardwyn India Ltd - 541276 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosures Requirement) Regulations, 2015. ('Listing Regulations') We hereby inform you that the company has received purchase order from the following projects as we mentioned in attachment.
announcements.ai_summary: Hardwyn India Ltd has announced the receipt of multiple purchase orders for its ISI-Certified floor springs from various prestigious projects. These include orders for CM House in Chhattisgarh (New Raipur) for 600 Floor Springs, Baba Raghav Das Medical College in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, for 240 Floor Springs, UP Medical College in Gajipur, Uttar Pradesh, for 310 Floor Springs, UP Medical College in Sidharth Nagar, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, for 460 Floor Springs, UP Medical College in Pilibhit, Near Lakhimpur, Uttar Pradesh, for 180 Floor Springs, and Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University (CSJMU) in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, for 255 Floor Springs. The company's floor springs are designed for reliable glass door control and are manufactured to meet safety standards and durability requirements for commercial and high-traffic applications.

announcements.subject: Hindustan Copper Ltd - 513599 - Incident At Process Plant Of Khetri Copper Complex (A Unit Of Hindustan Copper Ltd) At District Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan
announcements.detail: This is to report an incident at Process Plant of Khetri Copper Complex (a unit of Hindustan Copper Ltd) at District Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan on 17.04.2026 in which one contractual employee engaged by a civil contractor met with fatality.
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Copper Ltd has reported an unfortunate incident at the Process Plant of its Khetri Copper Complex in District Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan, on April 17, 2026. A contractual employee engaged by a civil contractor met with a fatality during the incident. The company has expressed its deep sorrow over the event. Importantly, the incident did not cause any disruption to the ongoing operations of the plant. This disclosure is made in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Tega Industries Ltd - 543413 - Announcement Pursuant To Reg. 30 Of The SEBI LODR Regulation - Incorporation Of Wholly Owned Subsidiary
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed herewith intimation with respect to incorporation of wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
