The Certificate of Incorporation was received from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs on April 17, 2026. TSL has an Authorised Share Capital of Rs. 100,00,00,000/- and a Paid-up Share Capital of Rs. 99,00,00,000/-. The object of incorporation is to carry on the business of providing management consultancy services and manufacturing grinding media for the mining industry and related products. TSL is a related party to Tega Industries Limited and its other subsidiaries, and the incorporation is part of the company's strategic objectives, as previously disclosed on November 29, 2025.

announcements.subject: NTPC Ltd - 532555 - Declaration Of COD Of Capacity Of 87.50 MW Solar Out Of The Total Installed Capacity Of 150 MW Solar Project Located In Rajasthan, By A Group Company Of NGEL.
announcements.detail: Disclosure attached.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: NTPC Ltd has announced that its subsidiary, NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL), has declared the Commercial Operation Date (COD) for a capacity of 87.50 MW of solar power. This capacity is part of a larger 150 MW solar project located in Rajasthan, undertaken by a group company of NGEL. The COD is effective from April 19, 2026. Following this declaration, the total installed capacity of the NTPC group has reached 89,615 MW, with a commercial capacity of 88,535 MW. This update was disclosed on April 17, 2026.

announcements.subject: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd - 500104 - HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (HRRL) Project
announcements.detail: HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (HRRL) Project
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd (HPCL) has received approval from the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas on April 17, 2026, for a revision in the project cost of the HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (HRRL) Project. The project cost has been revised from Rs. 43,129 Crore to Rs. 79,459 Crore. HPCL's equity investment will remain Rs. 19,600 Crore to maintain its 74% equity stake in the project. HRRL is a greenfield integrated refinery cum petrochemical complex with a high Nelson Complexity Index of 17 and petrochemical intensity of 26%. The project is in an advanced stage of commissioning, with trial runs of the CDU and other units currently in progress.

announcements.subject: Rathi Steel & Power Ltd-$ - 504903 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release- Grant of GreenPro Ecolable Certification by CII for TMT Rebars manufactured by the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Rathi Steel and Power Limited (RSPL) has been awarded the prestigious GreenPro ecolabel certification by the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) for its Rathi Powertech brand of TMT rebars, manufactured at its Ghaziabad Unit. This certification, effective April 17, 2026, specifically covers the Fe 550 Grade of TMT Rebars and signifies RSPL's commitment to sustainable manufacturing and environmental stewardship. The GreenPro certification provides essential credits for green building certifications like LEED or IGBC, ensures a toxic-free environment for end-users, and guarantees high-quality, durable steel for structural designers, streamlining due diligence and accelerating construction. This achievement aligns RSPL with global sustainability standards and the industry's shift towards "Green Steel" and reduced carbon footprints.

announcements.subject: AXIS Bank Ltd - 532215 - General Updates
announcements.detail: General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Axis Bank Ltd has received speaking orders from the Employees Provident Fund Organization (EPFO) levying damages and interest for delays in remittance of provident fund and allied dues. The damages amount to Rs. 91,50,641 and the interest amounts to Rs. 47,34,743. These levies are under Section 7Q (interest) and Section 14B (damages) of the Employees Provident Fund Act & Miscellaneous Provisions Act 1952, for the period from April 1, 2022, to June 13, 2024. The bank has reviewed the matter and submitted the requisite information. Axis Bank Ltd anticipates no significant impact on its financial, operational, or other business activities as a result of these orders. The orders were dated March 27, 2026.

announcements.subject: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd - 500040 - Reply To The Clarification Sought With Reference To The Media Report Appearing On Https://Economictimes.Indiatimes.Com Dated April 16, 2026
announcements.detail: Reply to the clarification sought with reference to the media report appearing on https://economictimes.indiatimes.com dated 16th April, 2026 which is an old news of which disclosures had been already submitted to stock exchanges.

Additionally, the company submitted an intimation on April 14, 2026, regarding a press release titled "Birla Estates records robust bookings of Rs.650 crores at Birla Trimaya phase 4 in Bengaluru" as a continuous disclosure.

announcements.subject: Gujarat State Petronet Ltd - 532702 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Receipt of final order today from Hon''ble Ministry of Corporate Affairs, New Delhi sanctioning the Composite Scheme of Arrangement

announcements.subject: Niyogin Fintech Ltd - 538772 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed the disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Niyogin Fintech Limited (NFL) announced that its Board, in a meeting held on April 17, 2026, approved the dilution or reduction of the company's shareholding (on a percentage basis without reducing the number of shares held) in its material subsidiary, Iserveu Technology Private Limited. This approval is in anticipation of a proposed fund-raise by Iserveu, which could involve up to a 10% dilution or a change in control of Iserveu. The Board also approved a draft Postal Ballot Notice to seek shareholder consent via a Special Resolution under Section 110 of the Companies Act, 2013, for this dilution or change in control. The purpose is to induct potential investors into Iserveu.

announcements.subject: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd - 532540 - Statement By Chief Executive Officer And Managing Director
announcements.detail: Statement by Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has provided an update regarding a recent matter in Nashik. The company has engaged expert teams from Deloitte and the law firm Trilegal to conduct an internal investigation led by Ms. Aarthi Subramanian, President and COO. An Oversight Committee, chaired by Independent Director Mr. Keki Mistry, has been constituted to review the investigation findings. TCS clarified that Ms. Nida Khan, mentioned in the press, is not an HR manager or responsible for recruitment, having served as a process associate. The company also stated that its Nashik unit remains operational and reports of its shutdown are untrue. Preliminary reviews indicate no complaints were received through ethics or POSH channels, and TCS reiterated its zero-tolerance policy for misconduct, emphasizing its commitment to employee safety and a respectful workplace. TCS is cooperating with law enforcement agencies for a thorough investigation.

announcements.subject: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd - 544283 - Receipt Of Certificate Of Commissioning Of 16 MW Capacity Of Wind Power Project In Gujarat.
announcements.detail: Receipt of Certificate of Commissioning of 16 MW Capacity of Wind Power Project in Gujarat.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited, through its subsidiary ACME Eco Clean Energy Private Limited, has received a Certificate of Commissioning dated April 16, 2026, from the Gujarat Energy Development Agency (GEDA). This certificate pertains to the commissioning of a 16 MW wind power project located in Gujarat, specifically at Village: Nana Morsal, Mota Kandhasan, Dhinkvali and Dhakaniya, Taluka: Chotila, Sayla, Dist: Surendranagar. This update follows previous intimations made on March 17, March 19, and March 26, 2026, and is in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: eMudhra Ltd - 543533 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release (Revised)
announcements.detail: "eMudhra launches emSigner for SMEs to accelerate digital workflows across India".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: eMudhra Limited has announced the launch of "emSigner for SMEs," a new offering designed to accelerate digital workflows for small and medium enterprises across India. This solution, priced affordably starting from INR 1000, aims to digitize document workflows in HR, Legal, Finance, and other functions, addressing operational inefficiencies and compliance risks associated with manual processes. emSigner for SMEs enables legally compliant digital signatures under the Indian IT Act, offering rapid deployment, intuitive usage, and cost-effectiveness. The platform combines enterprise-grade reliability and security with the simplicity required for SME adoption, supporting eMudhra's "SME Digitalization for India" initiative. The company has also submitted a revised press release to the stock exchanges due to inadvertent errors in the initial submission.

announcements.subject: 3i Infotech Ltd - 532628 - 3I Infotech Joins SAP Partner Ecosystem To Strengthen Enterprise Transformation Capabilities
announcements.detail: Please find attached press release issue by the Company titled 3i Infotech Joins SAP Partner Ecosystem to Strengthen Enterprises Transformation Capabilities.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: 3i Infotech Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary 3i Infotech Inc., USA, has joined the SAP Partner Ecosystem under the PE Service Partnership model. This partnership focuses on SAP Cloud ERP and enterprise transformation services, aligning with 3i Infotech's cloud-led SAP strategy. The company will now support enterprises with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, RISE with SAP, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). Through this engagement, 3i Infotech will offer implementation, application management services (AMS), managed services, and industry-led solutions. The partnership aims to leverage SAP's technology framework to enhance service delivery and accelerate outcomes in enterprise resource planning, data-driven decision-making, and business process transformation. This move is expected to drive faster deployments and measurable business impact for clients, particularly in North America.

announcements.subject: Onesource Specialty Pharma Ltd - 544292 - Intimation Of "Renewal Of EU -GMP Certification For Onesource : Flagship Unit II Facility
announcements.detail: Intimation of the renewal of EU -GMP Certification for OneSource: Flagship Unit II Facility located in Bengaluru.
announcements.ai_summary: Onesource Specialty Pharma Limited has announced the renewal of its European Union Good Manufacturing Practices (EU-GMP) certification for its flagship Unit II manufacturing facility located in Bengaluru. This renewal follows an inspection by a European regulatory authority. Unit II is an integrated biologics drug-substance and drug-product manufacturing site with capabilities in drug-device combinations and sterile injectable products. This certification is crucial for the company's operations and compliance with international pharmaceutical standards.

announcements.subject: Nandan Denim Ltd - 532641 - Board Meeting Outcome for Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015. - Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: On April 17, 2026, Nandan Denim Limited's Board of Directors approved entering into a Share Transfer cum Shareholders’ Agreement. This agreement is with M/s. Opera Vayu (Narmada) Private Limited (SPV) and Shivman Wind Energy Private Limited. The company will acquire a 6.1% equity shareholding in the SPV. This acquisition is for the purchase of wind and solar power under the applicable captive power route. The SPV was incorporated on August 1, 2022, and for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, it had a turnover of Nil, an authorized capital of ₹25.00 Crores, and a paid-up capital of ₹20.17 Crores. Currently, the authorized capital is ₹66.00 Crores and paid-up capital is ₹65.93 Crores.

announcements.subject: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Ltd - 544355 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: The Company has received today on April 17, 2026 "No objection - Observation Letter" from NSE and BSE pursuant to Scheme of Arrangement for Demerger under Regulation 37. Please refer attachment for complete details.
announcements.ai_summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Ltd has received "No objection - Observation Letters" from both NSE and BSE on April 17, 2026, concerning the Scheme of Arrangement for Demerger. This follows the company's earlier intimation on November 04, 2025, regarding the approval of the Scheme. The Scheme involves the demerger between Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited (Demerged Company) and Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited (Resulting Company). The Observation Letters from NSE (Ref: NSE/LIST/52055) and BSE (Ref: DCS/AMAL/RD/R37/024/2026-27) are available on the respective stock exchange websites and the company's website, https://www.jacpl.co.in/. announcements.subject: UltraTech Cement Ltd - 532538 - Company Update: Commissioning Of Cement Capacity
announcements.detail: Commissioning of cement capacity
announcements.ai_summary: UltraTech Cement Limited has announced the commissioning of an additional 8.7 million tonnes per annum (mtpa) of cement capacity. This expansion includes a 2.7 mtpa cement grinding unit in Shahjahanpur, Uttar Pradesh, a 3.0 mtpa cement grinding unit in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, and a 3.0 mtpa cement grinding unit in Patratu, Jharkhand. Following this commissioning on April 17, 2026, the company's total domestic grey cement manufacturing capacity has increased to 200.1 mtpa. Including its overseas capacity of 5.4 mtpa, UltraTech Cement's global capacity now stands at 205.5 mtpa. This makes the company the world's largest cement company by sales volume and the largest single-country cement manufacturer globally (excluding China).

announcements.subject: Petronet LNG Ltd - 532522 - Incorporation Of A Section 8, Limited By Guarantee, A Wholly-Owned Subsidiary Company Of Petronet LNG Limited
announcements.detail: Disclosure regarding incorporation of MC2 Foundation, a wholly-owned subsidiary of PLL is enclosed herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: Petronet LNG Limited (PLL) has incorporated a new wholly-owned subsidiary named 'MC2 Foundation' on April 3, 2026, with the Certificate of Incorporation received on April 17, 2026. This Section 8, limited by guarantee company, is established to foster innovation and sustainable entrepreneurship within the energy sector. MC2 Foundation aims to support startups through incubation, mentorship, acceleration, and promotion, aligning with India's national development and energy transition goals. It will focus on innovation infrastructure, industry-led mentorship, research translation, capital mobilization, and ecosystem integration. The first directors of MC2 Foundation include Dr. Neeraj Mittal (Chairman, PLL), Shri Akshay Kumar Singh (MD & CEO, PLL), Shri Sanjay Khanna (CMD, Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited), and Shri Vikas Kaushal (CMD, Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited).

announcements.subject: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd - 500103 - Withdrawal Of BHEL''s  Acceptance To Letter Of Intent From MB Power (Madhya Pradesh) Limited
announcements.detail: Withdrawal of BHEL''s acceptance of Letter of Intent from MB Power (Madhya Pradesh) Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) has withdrawn its acceptance of a Letter of Intent (LOI) from MB Power (Madhya Pradesh) Limited. The LOI was for the supply of equipment, specifically Boiler, Turbine, and Generator, for the 1x800 MW Anuppur Thermal Power Project. BHEL had initially accepted this LOI on September 3, 2025. However, the LOI was contingent on the execution of a formal contract within an agreed timeline. Despite multiple discussions and extensions, the contract could not be finalized as per the terms of the LOI. Consequently, BHEL formally informed the customer of the withdrawal of its acceptance to the LOI on April 17, 2026, at 1636 hrs.

announcements.subject:
Standard Capital Markets Ltd - 511700 - Corrigendum To Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing
Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Redemption Of Non-Convertible Debentures (Ncds)
announcements.detail: We wish to inform you that certain inadvertent errors were noted in the aforesaid disclosure. Accordingly the Revised  details are to be filled
announcements.ai_summary: The company, Standard Capital Markets Ltd, has issued a corrigendum to its earlier intimation regarding the redemption of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs). The original disclosure on March 30, 2026, stated the redemption of 123 NCDs with a face value of ₹10,00,000 each, totaling ₹12,30,00,000. However, it is now clarified that this figure inadvertently included 98 NCDs that were already redeemed on February 23, 2026, amounting to ₹9,80,00,000. Therefore, the actual redemption on March 30, 2026, was for 25 NCDs, each with a face value of ₹10,00,000, aggregating to ₹2,50,00,000. Following this correction, the reported balance of NCDs post-redemption has been revised from 881 to 979. All other details from the previous intimation remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: PC Jeweller Ltd - 534809 - Update On Debt Reduction
announcements.detail: Update on debt reduction
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: PC Jeweller Limited has provided an update on its debt reduction efforts, reporting a further approximately 10% reduction in its outstanding bank debt as per the Joint Settlement Agreement with its Consortium Lenders. With this latest reduction, the company has now repaid over 90% of its outstanding bank debt since the agreement was executed. This progress reaffirms the company's commitment to achieving a debt-free status in the near future. The company has informed the stock exchanges of this development for their records.

announcements.subject: Jash Engineering Ltd - 544402 - TV Interview

The interview, titled "Know your Company (KYC)," is scheduled for Monday, April 20, 2026, at approximately 11:40 AM. announcements.subject: Mirc Electronics Ltd - 500279 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, April 17, 2026
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith Outcome of the Board Meeting held on Friday, April 17, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Mirc Electronics Limited held a Board Meeting on April 17, 2026, where two significant property-related decisions were approved. The Board discussed and approved the redevelopment and/or sale or transfer of the company's property, "Onida House," in Mumbai, which measures approximately 2,143 square meters. Additionally, the Board discussed and approved a proposal for the monetization of the company's property located in Lote, District Ratnagiri, measuring approximately 20,004 square meters. Further disclosures will be made at appropriate times as per SEBI Master Circular dated January 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: TTK Prestige Ltd - 517506 - Award Of CII Greenco Certification
announcements.detail: Award of GreenCo Certification
announcements.ai_summary: TTK Prestige Limited has been awarded the CII GreenCo Certification for all its manufacturing plants, recognizing its commitment to environmental stewardship and sustainable operations. The certification, awarded by the CII–Sohrabji Godrej Green Business Centre, is valid for three years for each plant. The Karjan plant in Gujarat received a SILVER rating (Feb 2024-Feb 2027), Hosur in Tamil Nadu also received SILVER (Jan 2025-Jan 2028), Coimbatore in Tamil Nadu achieved PLATINUM (Nov 2025-Nov 2028), Roorkee in Uttarakhand received GOLD (Feb 2026-Feb 2029), and Khardi in Maharashtra was awarded GOLD (Apr 2026-Apr 2029). The certification follows a comprehensive assessment of parameters like energy efficiency, water conservation, renewable energy usage, and waste management, reinforcing the company's ESG objectives and stakeholder confidence. This disclosure was made voluntarily under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Cipla Ltd - 500087 - USFDA Inspection At Company'S Manufacturing Facility In Goa, India
announcements.detail: USFDA inspection at Company''s manufacturing facility in Goa, India
announcements.ai_summary: Cipla Ltd has informed that the US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) conducted a routine current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI) at its manufacturing facility in Verna, Goa, India, from April 6 to April 17, 2026. Upon conclusion of the inspection, the company received two observations in Form 483. Cipla has stated its commitment to working closely with the USFDA and addressing these observations comprehensively within the stipulated time.

announcements.subject: Premier Explosives Ltd - 526247 - Submission Of The Disclosure Received From AKS Family Trust As Per The SEBI Exemption Order Dated January 08, 2026.

announcements.subject: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd - 540879 - General Update
announcements.detail: General Update
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd (AMS) has been granted a License by the Government of India, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), for the manufacture of ammunitions. This Lifetime License, issued on April 10, 2026, authorizes AMS to manufacture, assemble, integrate, and proof-test high-value strategic weapon systems and munitions. The license covers the manufacturing of Missiles, Anti-Tank Guided Missiles (ATGMs), Torpedoes, Underwater Mines, Aerial Bombs, Rockets, and Loitering Munition. The company will utilize its owned facilities in Hyderabad for commercial manufacture and proof-testing. This grant significantly transforms AMS's revenue architecture and strategic positioning in defence manufacturing.

During his employment, he held the position of Group Managing Director of the Reliance Group and served as Vice Chairman and Director of Reliance Capital Limited. Furthermore, Mr. Amit Bapna left the Reliance Group in December 2019 and has had no association with Reliance Infrastructure Limited and Reliance Power Limited since then. This consideration comprises ₹148.52 crores in cash and ₹96.97 crores through the issuance of 50,50,686 equity shares of Moschip Technologies, with a face value of ₹2 each, at an issue price of ₹192 per share. The issuance and allotment of these 'Swap Shares' are on a preferential basis and are subject to shareholder and requisite regulatory approvals. announcements.subject: Sasken Technologies Ltd - 532663 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed a Press Release bearing the title 'Sasken Announces Hyderabad Center of Excellence to Scale Product Engineering and Digital Innovation' being released today.
announcements.ai_summary: Sasken Technologies Ltd has announced the launch of its new Center of Excellence (CoE) in Hyderabad, aimed at scaling product engineering and digital innovation. This new facility will enhance Sasken's regional delivery capabilities and strengthen its collaboration with key chipset customers like Qualcomm and their OEMs. The Hyderabad CoE will focus on next-generation engineering for connected devices, 5G platforms, IoT solutions, and embedded systems. As part of this expansion, Sasken has appointed Nirmala Datla as the Site Leader for the Hyderabad CoE and plans to hire over 100 specialized engineering professionals in the coming months. The hiring will focus on high-skill roles in semiconductors, ODM, automotive, and Data Science & Engineering.

announcements.subject: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd - 543299 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Read With Schedule III Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015-Commencement Of Commercial Production Of Phase II Of Colour Coated Sheets Facilitity
announcements.detail: We are enclosing disclosure Under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd, through its step-down subsidiary Shyam Sel and Power Limited (SSPL), has successfully commenced commercial production for Phase II of its Colour Coated Sheets facility at its Jamuria plant. This expansion adds an incremental capacity of 0.15 Million Tonnes Per Annum (MTPA) for Colour Coated Sheets. The total installed capacity for this facility now stands at 0.40 MTPA, combining the existing 0.25 MTPA from Phase I and the new 0.15 MTPA from Phase II. This development is a significant step in the company's phased capacity expansion strategy, aiming to strengthen SSPL's production capabilities and product offerings in the value-added steel segment. The company anticipates this enhancement will improve its manufacturing competitiveness and market presence in the Colour Coated Sheets sector.

announcements.subject: Gail (India) Ltd - 532155 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed a copy of Press Release on "GAIL to set up 600 MW Solar Power Project in UP"
announcements.ai_summary: GAIL (India) Limited is set to establish a 600 MW solar power project in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, at TUSCO's Solar Park. The company has signed contract agreements with M/s TUSCO Limited for this project, which will also include a 550 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). This initiative is primarily aimed at meeting the captive energy requirements of GAIL's Petrochemical Plant in Pata, Auraiya district, Uttar Pradesh. Additionally, it will cater to the increased demand from electrification of gas-based equipment and CBG plants being set up in the state. This project signifies GAIL's diversification into low-carbon and sustainable energy solutions and its commitment to expanding its business footprint in Uttar Pradesh.

announcements.subject: Birlasoft Ltd - 532400 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release - Birlasoft Recognized as a Leader in ISG''s Manufacturing Industry Services and Solutions Report
announcements.ai_summary: Birlasoft Ltd, a part of the CK Birla Group, has been recognized as a Leader in ISG's Manufacturing Industry Services and Solutions report. The company achieved leadership positions in two key quadrants: Supply Chain & Aftermarket Services and Technology, Transformation & Consulting Services. This recognition highlights Birlasoft's expertise in AI-led digital manufacturing transformation, its strong domain knowledge, ecosystem partnerships, and proprietary solutions like IntelliBridge and IntelliAsset. In the Supply Chain & Aftermarket Services quadrant, Birlasoft was acknowledged for its ability to modernize and optimize operations using technologies such as AI, IoT, and GenAI. For the Technology, Transformation & Consulting Services quadrant, ISG noted Birlasoft's integrated transformation framework and its capabilities in digital engineering and smart factory solutions.

announcements.subject: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Ltd - 544309 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Enclosed is the Press Release titled "IKS Health Debuts First-of-Its-Kind Agentic AI Platform that Automates and Personalizes Patient Engagement at the 2026 American Medical Group Association Annual Conference."
announcements.ai_summary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Ltd announced the debut of its innovative Agentic AI platform, MyCareHubTM, at the 2026 American Medical Group Association Annual Conference on April 15, 2026. This platform is designed to automate and personalize patient engagement throughout their healthcare journey, before, during, and after care. MyCareHubTM is integrated with Epic and available in the Epic Connection Hub, utilizing a multi-agent behavioral algorithm for an adaptive and autonomous patient experience. The company highlights that prioritizing patients through this platform leads to improvements in total collections, patient payments, and net payments. IKS Health has already implemented MyCareHubTM at OrthoNY, a leading orthopedic and pain management practice.

announcements.subject: Syschem India Ltd - 531173 - Announcement Under Regulation 30

This incident occurred on April 15, 2026, and was detected on the same day, stemming from cyber fraud through WhatsApp impersonation. Syschem India Ltd has promptly lodged a formal complaint with cybercrime authorities and is reviewing its internal controls to prevent recurrence. The company is also exploring recovery options and legal remedies. While the financial impact is estimated at Rs. 1.96 Cr, the management believes this incident will not materially impact the company's operations. Further updates will be provided to the stock exchange as developments occur.

announcements.subject: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd - 517334 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015.
announcements.detail: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted with the Stock Exchange a disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has disclosed a penalty imposed by the State of California Franchise Tax Board (SCFTB) on its indirect wholly owned subsidiary, Motherson SAS Automotive Services USA Inc. The penalty of $28,518 USD, equivalent to approximately INR 26,62,742, relates to the income and tax computation return for the year ended March 31, 2025. This arose from the classification of certain sales as foreign, impacting the calculation of eligible tax for Motherson SAS. The company states there is no material impact on the financial or operational activities of either Motherson SAS or Samvardhana Motherson International Limited. The disclosure was made on April 15, 2026.

announcements.subject: Radiant Cash Management Services Ltd - 543732 - Announcement Regarding Frauds In Subsidiary By A Former Employee Of Subsidiary Company
announcements.detail: Announcement regarding fraud in subsidiary by a former employee of subsidiary company
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Radiant Cash Management Services Ltd has disclosed an incident of fraud within its subsidiary, Aceware Fintech Services Private Limited (RadiantAcemoney), perpetrated by a former employee. The fraud involved unauthorized and fraudulent activities through the misuse of residual system access credentials, leading to an estimated financial exposure of approximately ₹3.13 crore at the subsidiary level. The incident, which occurred between July 2025 and February 2026, was confined to a limited number of Business Correspondent (BC) Agent accounts. The investigation, including a forensic audit, confirmed no involvement of existing employees. RadiantAcemoney has taken immediate containment measures, including suspending affected functionalities and filing complaints with law enforcement. The Audit Committee of RadiantAcemoney and the Company reviewed the investigation reports on April 15, 2026. The consolidated financial impact on Radiant Cash Management Services Ltd is not considered material.

announcements.subject: Allcargo Terminals Ltd - 543954 - Allca

announcements.ai_summary: Allcargo Terminals Ltd released its monthly business update for March 2026 on April 15, 2026. The company reported total volumes of 58.6 '000 TEUs for March 2026, which represents a 2% increase compared to February 2026 and a 4% increase compared to March 2025. This information is provided in accordance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and has undergone a limited review by the management. The update also notes that the ICD is a joint venture with CONCOR. The information will be available on the company's website at www.allcargoterminals.com.

announcements.subject: Omega Interactive Technologies Ltd - 511644 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

This allotment will increase the company's paid-up equity share capital from INR 2,59,12,490 to INR 7,90,41,890, with the total number of equity shares increasing from 2,59,12,490 to 7,90,41,890, each with a face value of INR 1.

announcements.subject: UFO Moviez India Ltd - 539141 - Press Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed herewith Press Release titled ''UFO MOVIEZ TIES UP WITH CHINA FILM GROUP PROMOTED "CINITY" A HOLLYWOOD APPROVED PREMIUM LARGE SCREEN FORMAT TO PROVIDE A LARGER-THAN-LIFE EXPERIENCE TO CINEGOERS IN INDIA''
announcements.ai_summary: UFO Moviez India Limited has announced an exclusive tie-up with China Film Group for their Hollywood-approved Premium Large Screen Format (PLF) called "CINITY," for the Indian market. This collaboration aims to provide a larger-than-life cinematic experience to cinegoers in India. CINITY integrates advanced cinema technologies such as 4K resolution, 3D, high brightness, high frame rate (HFR), high dynamic range (HDR), wide color gamut, and immersive sound. UFO Moviez believes this partnership will offer Indian exhibitors a platform to deliver premium large screen experiences that align with global industry standards, enhancing the quality of cinema viewing and drawing more audiences to theaters.

announcements.subject: Mold-Tek Technologies Ltd - 526263 - Utilization Of Proceeds Of Preferential Issue Of Equity Shares.
announcements.detail: Utilization of proceeds of Preferential Issue of Equity Shares.
announcements.ai_summary: Mold-Tek Technologies Limited has provided details on the utilization of proceeds from its preferential issue of equity shares, which aggregated to ₹4,75,60,000. The entire amount, representing 100% of the proceeds, will be utilized for capital expenditure towards the construction of the company's new branch office building at its Nashik location. The land for this project was acquired in 2023, and the construction is intended to establish a dedicated facility to support current business operations and future growth, as the Nashik branch currently operates from rented premises. The utilization of these funds for the construction project is expected to be completed within an estimated timeline of 15 to 18 months from the date of allotment.

announcements.subject: Vikram Kamats Hospitality Ltd - 539659 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015-Lapse Of 45,270 Fully Convertible Warrants Held By Non-Promoter Entity.
announcements.detail: Lapse of 45,270 fully convertible Warrants held by Non-Promoter entity
announcements.ai_summary: Vikram Kamats Hospitality Limited has announced the lapse of 45,270 fully convertible warrants held by a non-promoter entity, Nabs Vriddhii LLP. These warrants were part of an allotment of 19,12,163 warrants on October 16, 2024, at a price of ₹74 per warrant. The allottee failed to exercise the option to convert the warrants within the stipulated 18-month period. Consequently, the 45,270 warrants have lapsed, and the upfront subscription amount of ₹10,04,994, representing 30% of the issue price, has been forfeited. There is no change in the company's paid-up equity share capital as a result of this lapse.

announcements.subject: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd - 530007 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition
announcements.detail: The Directors at their meeting approved an Investment up to Rs. 1.31 Crore for acquiring 26% equity shares of Roofsol Renewables Five Pvt. Ltd.

Ltd. This acquisition is intended to comply with regulatory requirements for captive power consumption under Indian Electricity laws, necessitating the acquisition and maintenance of a minimum 26% stake in Roofsol Renewables Five Pvt. Ltd throughout the term of the Power Purchase Agreement. The acquisition involves a cash consideration and is expected to be completed within 180 days, with no governmental or regulatory approvals required.

announcements.subject: Orient Tradelink Ltd - 531512 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail:
Please find enclosed herewith the disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India
(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI Listing Regulations') regarding acquisition of Film Rights
announcements.ai_summary: Orient Tradelink Limited has entered into an agreement on January 14, 2026, to acquire the exclusive rights for the spiritual feature film titled “Children of God,” produced by Aum Sportainment Private Limited. The total consideration for this acquisition is ₹4 Crores, plus additional publicity and promotional expenditure to be incurred by Orient Tradelink Limited. The scope includes global marketing, distribution, promotion, and merchandising across theatrical, OTT, and digital platforms, with an expected release timeline in June 2026. This acquisition is expected to strengthen the company's presence in the spiritual and entertainment segment, generate increased revenue streams over the next 12-18 months, and positively impact profitability and shareholder value.

announcements.subject: Tarc Ltd - 543249 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Tarc Ltd has announced significant delivery milestones and expansion of its luxury real estate pipeline for FY2026. The company has commenced customer handovers for TARCTripundra, a development with a gross development value of ₹1,000 crore, and is now recognizing revenue from this project. Additionally, Tarc Kailasa has introduced its most premium tower inventory, with its total gross development value now standing at ₹4,400 crore, and has launched a new Experience Gallery and Sample Residence to drive sales. These achievements are underpinned by strong cash flows, supporting long-term value creation. The company is focused on expanding its luxury offerings and delivering on its development commitments.

announcements.detail: refer enclosed

announcements.subject: Godawari Power and Ispat Ltd - 532734 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition

announcements.subject: John Cockerill India Ltd-$ - 500147 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order

announcements.subject: Brigade Enterprises Ltd - 532929 - Material Information - 'Brigade Group Signs JDA For 8.63 Acres, Unlocking A 39 Acre Development In East Bengaluru
announcements.detail: Material Information - "Brigade Group Signs JDA for 8.63 Acres, Unlocking a 39 Acre Development in East Bengaluru
announcements.ai_summary: Brigade Enterprises Ltd has signed a Joint Development Agreement (JDA) for an 8.63-acre parcel of land in Gunjur, East Bengaluru. This agreement is a crucial step that enables the development of a larger, integrated 39-acre residential township in the Whitefield–Sarjapur corridor. The entire 39-acre development is projected to have an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of approximately ₹7,200 crore. This development is being undertaken through a combination of outright purchases and joint development agreements. The company is making this disclosure as per Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and has also released a press release detailing this material information.

announcements.subject: Starlog Enterprises Ltd - 520155 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, As Amended ('Listing Regulations') - Update
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended ('Listing Regulations') - Update
announcements.ai_summary: Starlog Enterprises Ltd has received a significant update regarding an arbitration award concerning its material subsidiary, Starlift Services Private Limited. An arbitration award dated April 18, 2011, had initially granted Starlift approximately ₹9.02 crore plus interest against Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata (KPT). Although KPT challenged this award, leading to its setting aside by the Hon'ble High Court at Calcutta on December 24, 2020, Starlift appealed this decision. On April 9, 2026, the Division Bench of the Hon'ble High Court at Calcutta set aside the earlier order, deeming it without jurisdiction, and has thereby restored the original arbitration award in favor of Starlift. The company is continuing to evaluate the matter and will take appropriate legal steps.

announcements.subject: Aelea Commodities Ltd - 544213 - Achievement Of The Fairdeal Filaments Award For Outstanding Entrepreneurship In The MSME Segment For 2024-2025
announcements.detail: Intimation under Reg.30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Achievement of Fairdeal Filament Award for Outstanding Entrepreneurship in the MSME Segment for 2024-2025.

This recognition was bestowed by The Southern Gujarat Chamber of Commerce & Industry (SGCCI). The company is formally informing the stock exchange about this achievement as per Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. This award highlights the company's significant contributions and entrepreneurial spirit within the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises sector.

announcements.subject: Rubicon Research Ltd - 544578 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Rubicon Research Ltd has announced the acquisition of an 85% equity ownership in Arinna Lifesciences Limited from its current shareholders. This acquisition marks Rubicon's entry into the Indian Central Nervous System (CNS) formulations market. Arinna Lifesciences possesses a portfolio of over 60 brands in chronic therapies and an established distribution network across India. This move aligns with Rubicon's strategy to leverage its intellectual property and chronic products to drive growth in key markets, particularly in the CNS therapeutic category. The acquisition is expected to provide Rubicon with access to patients and prescribers in India for its specialized offerings.

announcements.subject: Vega Jewellers Ltd - 512026 - Receipt Of BSE In-Principle Approval For Bonus Issue
announcements.detail: BSE In principle Approval for Bonus Issue
announcements.ai_summary: Vega Jewellers Ltd has received in-principle approval from BSE Limited for its proposed Bonus Issue. The approval, dated April 15, 2026, grants permission for the issue and allotment of 4,07,05,192 equity shares of Re.10/- each as bonus shares. This will be in the ratio of 4:1, meaning shareholders will receive four new equity shares for every one existing equity share held. This follows the company's earlier intimation on March 5, 2026, regarding the bonus issue proposal.

announcements.subject: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd - 533047 - Update
announcements.detail: As per corporate announcement attached
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd (IMFA) has provided an update on its ongoing projects. The 100,000 tpa (2 x 33 MVA) Greenfield Ferro Chrome Project in Kalinganagar is in its final construction stages, with pre-commissioning for the first furnace scheduled for June 2026 and the second furnace in September 2026. The strategic acquisition in Kalinganagar is complete, and all four furnaces are now operational. The Ethanol Project in Therubali is experiencing a delay in commissioning, now expected in July 2026, due to equipment delivery slippage and geopolitical impacts, though this is not expected to materially affect the company's financials.

announcements.subject: Samhi Hotels Ltd - 543984 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: A copy of Press Release on signing of Agreement with INGKA Centres for leasing ~162 rooms upscale hotel in Noida, Uttar Pradesh is enclosed for your kind information.
announcements.ai_summary: Samhi Hotels Ltd, through its wholly owned subsidiary SAMHI Skyline Private Limited, has signed an agreement with INGKA Centres India Private Limited, part of the Ingka Group, for leasing an upscale ~162-room hotel. This hotel will be part of Ingka Centres’ upcoming ~2.5 million sq. ft. mixed-use development in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The agreement was signed on April 15, 2026. The project will be executed under Samhi Hotels' long-term variable lease model, with Ingka Centres leasing the building and Samhi Hotels investing in interior fit-outs. This partnership aims to create a modern retail-led destination combining shopping, leisure, and community experiences.

announcements.subject: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Ltd - 544476 - Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited Has Informed The Exchange About Receipt Of NABH Accreditation For Noida Hospital.
announcements.detail: Receipt of NABH Accreditation for Noida Hospital.

The accreditation, specifically for Panchakarma services, has the certification number AH-2026-0451 and is valid until March 09, 2029. This accreditation signifies the hospital's adherence to national standards for quality healthcare, patient safety, and operational excellence. The company stated that this development is in the ordinary course of business and does not constitute business expansion, capacity enhancement, or acquisition.

announcements.subject: Triveni Turbine Ltd - 533655 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

The merger was executed as per a merger agreement between the two entities.

announcements.subject: City Union Bank Ltd - 532210 - Opening Of 3 New Branches
announcements.detail: Our Bank has opened 3 new Branches on April 15,2026 and as on date the Bank has 959 Branches in total.
announcements.ai_summary: City Union Bank Ltd has opened 3 new branches on April 15, 2026. This expansion brings the bank's total branch count to 959. announcements.subject: Varun Beverages Ltd - 540180 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligation And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Update

announcements.subject: Samhi Hotels Ltd - 543984 - Signing Of An Agreement To Lease/ Sub-Lease For A Proposed ~162 Rooms Up-Scale Hotel To Be Constructed As Part Of A Mixed-Use Development In Noida, Uttar Pradesh
announcements.detail: SAMHI Skyline Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company has on 15th April 2026 executed an agreement with INGKA Centres India Private Limited ("Lessor") for a long term lease in respect of ~162 rooms Upscale hotel to be developed as a part of mixed use development in Noida, Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh. The required information as per SEBI Listing Regulations is provided in enclosed disclosure.
announcements.ai_summary: SAMHI Skyline Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of SAMHI Hotels Limited, has executed a long-term lease/sub-lease agreement with INGKA Centres India Private Limited on April 15, 2026. The agreement is for a proposed upscale hotel with approximately 162 rooms, to be constructed as part of a mixed-use development in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The estimated built-up area for the hotel is 15,022 square meters. SAMHI Skyline will take possession for hotel fit-outs and branding after the Lessor completes their scope of work. The hotel will operate under an international brand to be determined later. This agreement is part of SAMHI's capital-efficient growth strategy and aims to expand its presence in key markets.

announcements.detail: Intimation for allotment of equity shares pursuant to Composite Scheme of Amalgamation

announcements.subject: Infosys Ltd - 500209 - 7-Time Grand Slam Champion Carlos Alcaraz Is Infosys Global Brand Ambassador
announcements.detail: Enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Infosys Limited has announced a multi-year partnership with Carlos Alcaraz, the youngest athlete to achieve the World No. 1 ranking in men's tennis, appointing him as its Global Brand Ambassador. This collaboration aims to leverage Alcaraz's champion mindset, relentless drive, and pursuit of excellence, aligning with Infosys' values of responsible leadership and innovation. Infosys will work with Alcaraz and his coaching team to develop an AI-powered match analytics and personalized performance application using Infosys Topaz. The partnership also includes joint initiatives with the Carlos Alcaraz Foundation to drive social impact through tech-for-good initiatives.

announcements.subject: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd - 524804 - Expanding Existing CMO Operations With Merck Sharpe & Dohme Singapore Trading Pte. Ltd  By Theranym Biologics Private Limited, A Subsidiary Of The Company .
announcements.detail: Intimation of addition of  additional  product schedule  to the existing CMO agreement entered in to with  Merck Sharpe & Dohme Singapore Trading Pte (MSD) by TheraNym Biologics Private Limited

announcements.subject: Goodyear India Ltd - 500168 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015

announcements.subject: Baazar Style Retail Ltd - 544243 - Intimation Regarding Settlement Of Insurance Claim
announcements.detail: Pursuant to the Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the insurance claim in respect of inventory loss has been settled, the details of which is enclosed herewith.

announcements.subject: A-1 Ltd - 542012 - Clarification W.R.T Regulation 30 Of The SEBI(LODR) Regulations,2015 -A-1 Limited_BSE Email Dated 13.04.2024
announcements.detail: Clarification w.r.t Regulation 30 of the SEBI(LODR) Regulations, 2015- A-1 Limited_BSE email dated 13.04.2024
announcements.ai_summary: A-1 Ltd has issued a clarification regarding a false rumor circulating on the Telegram channel 'Chase Alpha-SEBI REG' that the company acquired a 20% stake in Yashvi Lifesciences. A-1 Ltd categorically states that this information is false, baseless, and fabricated. The company has not acquired any stake in Yashvi Lifesciences, nor is there any such proposal under consideration by its Board of Directors. This development signifies a strategic expansion for Shraddha Prime Projects Ltd in the Mumbai real estate market, focusing on residential and redevelopment opportunities. The company aims to strengthen its presence in key suburban areas.

announcements.subject: AVI Polymers Ltd - 539288 - Revised Intimation Under Requlation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Requlations, 2015 - Launch Of 'Krishibuddy' Agritech Platform By Wholly-Owned Subsidiary, AVI Eco Spark Private Limited.
announcements.detail: Revised Intimation under regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) regulations, 2015- Launch of ''"KrishiBuddy"'' Agritech Platform by Wholly-Owned Subsidiary, AVI Eco Spark Private Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: AVI Polymers Ltd has submitted a revised intimation regarding the launch of the 'KrishiBuddy' Agritech Platform by its wholly-owned subsidiary, AVI Eco Spark Private Limited. The platform is now live and accessible to the public at https://krishibuddy.tech/. This launch signifies AVI Polymers Ltd's strategic move into high-growth technological sectors, particularly in artificial intelligence and IoT for Indian agriculture. KrishiBuddy is an AI-powered smart farming assistant designed for Indian smallholder farmers, aiming to capture a significant share of the $9 billion agritech market. The platform features a multimodal, multilingual AI with a conversational interface that supports voice, text, and image inputs in regional languages.

announcements.subject: Globe Civil Projects Ltd - 544424 - Business Update
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) 2015, please find attached the business update for FY 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Globe Civil Projects Ltd has provided a Business Update for FY 2026, highlighting a strong order book of ₹730 Crore as of March 2026. The company operates in 11+ states with over 37 completed projects and 13-15 ongoing projects. Approximately 55% of its pending order book is from government exposure. Key order wins in FY26 include projects for Central University of Punjab (₹173 Crore), an International Cricket Stadium (₹222 Crore), IIT Kanpur (₹71 Crore), and NIT Delhi (₹13 Crore). The company expects continued growth driven by the execution of its existing order book and participation in government infrastructure projects, with margins expected to remain stable due to disciplined bidding and efficient execution.

announcements.subject: Umiya Mobile Ltd - 544464 - Announcement For Opened A New Retail Stores.

announcements.subject: Aster DM Healthcare Ltd - 540975 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Strikes /Lockouts / Disturbances
announcements.detail: Update in relation to Nurse  Strike at Hospital in Kerala
announcements.ai_summary: Aster DM Healthcare Ltd has provided an update regarding the nurse strike at its hospitals in Kerala. The company has been actively engaging with the United Nurses Association to resolve wage structure demands. While the Hon’ble High Court has extended the deferral of the strike until May 31, 2026, proceedings are ongoing for a final settlement. Importantly, the entire nursing staff across Aster hospitals in Kerala has resumed work, and operations have returned to full capacity. The company incurred an additional revenue loss of INR 5,77,60,948 due to the strike, but no further losses are expected if the current status quo is maintained until settlement terms are agreed upon.

announcements.subject: Techknowgreen Solutions Ltd - 543991 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail:
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that Techknowgreen Solutions Limited ('TSL') has entered into a Teaming Up Agreement (TUA) dated April 14, 2026, with Sri Sri Naisargik LLP ('SSNL').

The agreement establishes a strategic collaboration between TSL and SSNL for the deployment, promotion, and execution of Yuka Yantra - Ambient Air Purification System ....
announcements.ai_summary: On April 15, 2026, Techknowgreen Solutions Limited (TSL) announced the execution of a Teaming Up Agreement (TUA) with Sri Sri Naisargik LLP (SSNL) on April 14, 2026. This agreement establishes a strategic collaboration for the deployment, promotion, and execution of the Yuka Yantra - Ambient Air Purification System and other environmental technologies. SSNL will serve as the Promotional Partner, focusing on stakeholder engagement and market outreach, while TSL will act as the Technology Partner, responsible for design, engineering, deployment, and monitoring. The agreement outlines a revenue-sharing mechanism and aims to enhance TSL's reach through SSNL's network for air pollution mitigation projects.

announcements.subject: Datamatics Global Services Ltd - 532528 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please refer attached  PDF File
announcements.ai_summary: Datamatics Global Services Ltd announced that its Automatic Fare Collection (AFC) and mobile ticketing systems have gone live for Phase 1 of Mumbai Metro Lines 2B and 9. This system facilitates faster entry-exit and auto fare deduction using QR coded tickets or common mobility cards. The inauguration of Phase 1 for these lines took place on April 8, 2026. Datamatics has previously implemented AFC solutions for Mumbai Metro Lines 2A and 7, and has a global track record of over 30 AFC projects in cities like London, New York, and Dubai, as well as in India for projects such as Delhi-Meerut RRTS and Pune Metro. The company's Vice Chairman and CEO, Rahul Kanodia, expressed pride in their continued association with Mumbai Metro, highlighting the positive impact on millions of Mumbaikars.

announcements.subject: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Ltd - 543895 - Business Update For The Half Year Ended March 31, 2026
announcements.detail: Business update is enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Ltd has provided a business update for the half-year ended March 31, 2026. The company reported strong performance in aviation, infrastructure development, and marquee events, maintaining leadership in India and eight international markets. Despite market volatility, Exhicon maintained a high-growth trajectory and strong cash flows with a lean balance sheet. The company is strategically pivoting towards large-scale infrastructure ownership and high-margin service diversification for its FY27 outlook. A significant development is the board meeting convened to consider migration to the Main Board of BSE & NSE, subject to approvals. Exhicon also emerged as the winning bidder for the Mohali Convention & Exhibition Centre project under a PPP model and completed Phase I of Exhibition Hall expansion at Expo Centre Greater Noida. Additionally, the company secured a helicopter shuttle contract for the Mandakini Valley to Shri Kedarnath Ji route.

announcements.subject: Ramco Systems Ltd - 532370 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

announcements.ai_summary: Ramco Systems Limited has announced that Korean Air, South Korea's flag carrier, has successfully gone live with Ramco Aviation Suite. This implementation digitally transforms Korean Air's Engine Maintenance Center and establishes the technology foundation for its upcoming Maintenance Cluster, which is set to be Asia's Largest Engine MRO Hub. The Ramco Aviation Suite will streamline complex operations, enhance productivity, and support the expansion of Korean Air's engine maintenance capabilities. It facilitates seamless collaboration across Engine Maintenance, Finance, Customer Support, and Billing, and integrates with internal and external platforms, including Korean Air’s Automated Storage Retrieval System. Over 400 mechanics and engineers will now utilize Ramco’s mobile application for paperless performance maintenance execution.

announcements.subject: Hitachi Energy India Ltd - 543187 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please refer the attached document
announcements.ai_summary: Hitachi Energy India Limited, in collaboration with Adani Energy Solutions Ltd. (AESL), has successfully commissioned a high-voltage direct current (HVDC) city center infeed in Mumbai. This new HVDC link increases the city's power supply from external sources by 50%, injecting up to 1,000 megawatts (MW) of clean power. The project, which includes a space-saving converter station and 50 km of underground HVDC cables, strengthens Mumbai's transmission infrastructure to support over 20 million people. The technology enhances grid resilience, facilitates renewable energy integration, and aligns with the city's Climate Action Plan and decarbonization goals. This development sets a global benchmark for urban transmission.

announcements.subject: Vedanta Ltd - 500295 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI Listing Regulations')
announcements.detail: Please refer the enclosed file.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Vedanta Ltd is reporting an unfortunate incident that occurred at Unit-1 boiler of its Athena Power plant in Singhita rai, Chhattisgarh, on April 14, 2026. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Power Finance Corporation Ltd - 532810 - Incorporation Of Four Wholly Owned Subsidiaries Of PFC Consulting Limited (A Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of Power Finance Corporation Limited)- (I) BABAI TRANSMISSION LIMITED (Ii) BIKANER TRANSMISSION LIMITED (Iii) HUMNABAD POWER TRANSMISSION LIMITED (Iv) HEBBANI POWER TRANSMISSION LIMITED
announcements.detail: INTIMATION
announcements.ai_summary: Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC) has announced the incorporation of four new wholly owned subsidiaries through its wholly owned subsidiary, PFC Consulting Limited (PFCCL). These new entities are BABAI TRANSMISSION LIMITED, BIKANER TRANSMISSION LIMITED, HUMNABAD POWER TRANSMISSION LIMITED, and HEBBANI POWER TRANSMISSION LIMITED. These Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) companies have been incorporated to undertake transmission system projects. Babai Transmission Limited and Bikaner Transmission Limited are related to transmission systems for 765kV GSS in Rajasthan, with PFCCL nominated as the Bid Process Coordinator (BPC) by Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Prasaran Nigam Ltd. announcements.subject: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd - 539254 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Adani Energy Commissions 1,000 MW Power Link to bring More Clean Energy into Mumbai
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL), through its subsidiary Adani Electricity Mumbai Infrastructure Limited (AEMIL), has successfully commissioned a 1,000 megawatt (MW) high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission link. This new link connects Kudus and Aarey, comprising a 30-kilometer overhead line and a 50-kilometer underground corridor, designed for dense urban environments. The project includes the world's first compact HVDC substation and aims to improve grid reliability and energy security across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR). This initiative, conceived after the October 2020 Mumbai blackout, will enable greater flow of renewable energy into Mumbai, reducing dependence on in-city generation and lowering outage risks. The HVDC link enhances connectivity by allowing more controlled, efficient, and higher-capacity power flows, particularly for renewable energy integration.

announcements.subject: Supreme Petrochem Ltd - 500405 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of LODR - Capacity Addition
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed herewith, disclosure with respect to capacity addition.
announcements.ai_summary: Supreme Petrochem Ltd has commissioned its EPS-Phase II expansion project at the Amdoshi Plant in Nagothane, Maharashtra. This expansion increases the company's total production capacity for EPS from the existing 85,000 TPA to 115,000 TPA, adding 30,000 MT per year. The project was commissioned on April 14, 2026. The investment for this expansion was Rs. 54 crores, financed through internal accruals. The rationale behind this capacity addition is to meet the projected demand growth in the packaging, construction, and cold supply chain sectors. The company's existing capacity utilization was 75%.

announcements.subject: LE Lavoir Ltd - 539814 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Tie-up with Hotel Tunga Regency Private Limited For Providing Laundry Services
announcements.ai_summary: LE Lavoir Ltd has entered into a 3-year agreement with Hotel Tunga Regency Private Limited to provide laundry services, including wet cleaning, washing, and dry-cleaning. This tie-up, effective from the date of execution, aims to expand LE Lavoir's footprint among institutional clients and explore broader commercial opportunities under the "Le Lavoir" brand. The agreement covers room linen, staff uniforms, and guest laundry services. This partnership signifies a strategic shift towards providing linen rental-based solutions to customers and is expected to enhance operational synergies and broaden the customer base. The company views this as a significant milestone in strengthening its presence in the hospitality sector.

announcements.subject: Zelio E Mobility Ltd - 544563 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015, we are enclosing herewith the Press Release titled "Zelio Electric Scooters joins hands with Punjab Kings as Official EV Partner for 2026 Season".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Zelio Electric Scooters has announced a significant partnership with Punjab Kings, becoming their Official EV Partner for the 2026 season. This collaboration aims to leverage the popularity of cricket to enhance Zelio's brand presence across India, particularly in Tier 2 markets and beyond. The partnership includes branding rights, digital media integration, and in-stadia activations. Two of Zelio's popular models, the XMen+ and X Men 2.0, will be featured. This strategic move is intended to accelerate brand awareness and consumer consideration for Zelio's electric two-wheeler lineup. The company's Managing Director, Kunal Arya, highlighted cricket's power in connecting with Indian audiences and aligning visibility with growth momentum. Punjab Kings' Chief Commercial Officer, Saurabh Arora, expressed enthusiasm for partnering with a forward-looking brand in sustainable innovation.

announcements.subject: Nexxus Petro Industries Ltd - 544265 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Nexxus Petro Industries Limited has intimated to the Stock Exchange regarding Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR) Regulations, 2015 for Press Release titled "Nexxus Petro Indutries Limited Positioned at the Forefront of India''s Bio-Bitument Revolution"
announcements.ai_summary: Nexxus Petro Industries Limited has issued a press release titled "Nexxus Petro Industries Limited Positioned at the Forefront of India's Bio-Bitumen Revolution." The company is leveraging its CSIR-CRRI & CSIR-IIP certified license for proprietary Bio-Bitumen Technology (KrishiBind™) as India aims to reduce its bitumen import costs, which have surged by approximately 40% due to the West Asia conflict. Domestic bitumen prices have risen from around ₹40,000 per tonne to ₹54,000–₹76,000 per tonne. India currently imports about 54% of its bitumen requirement, totaling nearly 6 million tonnes annually. Nexxus Petro Industries Limited is among only 15 companies nationwide holding this crucial technology license, positioning it to benefit from government policies promoting indigenous bitumen supply and the acceleration of India's road construction programs.

announcements.ai_summary: Time Technoplast Limited has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the promoters of Systoverse Private Limited (SPL) to acquire a 76% stake in SPL. The MOU establishes a transparent framework for the acquisition, ensuring regulatory compliance. The acquisition of SPL is expected to create strong synergies and unlock new growth opportunities, aligning with Maharashtra's infrastructure growth policy.

announcements.subject: Valencia Nutrition Ltd - 542910 - Press Release- Resistance To 2026 Strait Of Hormuz Crisis
announcements.detail: We hereby provide comprehensive update on the operations and strategic resilience of Valencia Beverages and Superwater Private Limited (VBSW) Unit I & Unit II in Cherlaplly, Hyderabad.
announcements.ai_summary: Valencia Nutrition Ltd has provided an update on the operational resilience of its Valencia Beverages and Superwater Private Limited (VBSW) Unit I & Unit II in Cherlapally, Hyderabad, in the face of the 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis. The company secured a three-month supply of packaging materials before the crisis began on February 28, 2026, and purchased fruit pulp at low prices due to export chokes, securing its entire year's requirement. VBSW also converted its boilers from LPG to Diesel, creating a dual-fuel system, and is managing supply and demand using its in-house ERP and FIFO methodology. The company has seen growth in its own brand sales, is awaiting final orders from GCC clients for juice samples, and has signed an agreement with Virchow Laboratories Ltd to manufacture eight juice SKUs, securing 15% of Unit II's capacity. Despite a labor challenge on April 06, 2026, operations remained uninterrupted due to engineering executives from Valencia Engineering Group stepping in.

announcements.subject: Jyoti CNC Automation Ltd - 544081 - Litigation Involving A Wholly Owned Subsidiary - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.detail: Litigation Involving Wholly Owned Subsidiary  - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Jyoti CNC Automation Limited has disclosed a litigation involving its material wholly-owned subsidiary, Huron Graffenstaden SAS. French authorities have initiated an investigation against Huron Graffenstaden SAS and certain employees concerning export controls and documentation of dual-use machinery. As interim measures, the director general of Huron Graffenstaden SAS has been temporarily restricted from duties, and certain bank accounts totaling approximately EUR 4.0 million, along with two residential properties owned by Jyoti SAS, have been seized. A formal judicial investigation has been launched. Huron Graffenstaden SAS refutes the allegations and is seeking clarity and legal advice to contest these actions. The company believes that while seized assets and involved employees may be temporarily unavailable, the current business and operations of Huron Graffenstaden SAS remain unaffected. Furthermore, these actions are not expected to adversely impact Jyoti CNC Automation Limited's standalone business and operations, which contribute over 85% of the Group's revenue.

announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Action Initiated or Order passed
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Ltd has received an order dated April 10, 2026, from the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI). The order imposes a financial disincentive of Rs. 64,000 for the quarter ending June 2024. The violation pertains to the company's alleged failure to curb Unsolicited Commercial Communications (UCC) sent through its network, as required by the Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulations, 2018. The company is currently reviewing the order and evaluating its next steps. The financial impact is limited to the penalty amount.

announcements.subject: SJ Corporation Ltd - 504398 - Intimation Of Approval Received For Listing 3,50,00,000 Equity Shares On A Preferential Basis.
announcements.detail: Intimation of Approval received for Listing 3,50,00,000 Equity Shares on a Preferential Basis.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: SJ Corporation Ltd has received approval from BSE Limited for the listing of 3,50,00,000 equity shares on a preferential basis. These shares, with a face value of Re. 1/- each, are being issued at an issue price of Rs. 12/- each, including a premium of Rs. 11/- per share. The shares are to be allotted to proposed promoters and non-promoters. The company has been informed by BSE that trading approval will be granted only after the company files the listing approval from the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd (if applicable) and confirmation letters from NSDL/CDSL regarding the crediting of shares to beneficiary accounts. SJ Corporation Ltd must also ensure compliance with SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, including Regulation 167.

announcements.subject: NTPC Ltd - 532555 - Declaration Of COD Of 4Th Unit (250) MW Of Tehri PSP (4X250 MW) Of THDC India Limited.
announcements.detail: Disclosure attached.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: THDC India Limited, a subsidiary of NTPC Ltd, has declared the Commercial Operation Date (COD) for the 4th Unit of its Tehri Pumped Storage Project (PSP). This unit has a capacity of 250 MW, and the project comprises four such units totaling 1000 MW. The COD is effective from 00:00 Hrs on April 12, 2026. Following this declaration, the total installed capacity of the NTPC group has reached 89,378 MW, with a commercial capacity of 88,298 MW. This development signifies an increase in NTPC's overall operational capacity.

announcements.subject: Rudra Ecovation Ltd - 514010 - Admission Of Second Motion Petition Pertaining To Merger Between Rudra Ecovation Limited And Shiva Texfabs Limited
announcements.detail: We are pleased to inform you that the Hon''ble National Company Law Tribunal, Chandigarh Bench-I,  Chandigarh has admitted the 2nd motion petition
announcements.ai_summary: Rudra Ecovation Limited has announced that on April 10, 2026, the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Chandigarh Bench-I, Chandigarh, admitted the second motion petition pertaining to the proposed merger between Rudra Ecovation Limited and Shiva Texfabs Limited. This admission is a significant step in the merger process. The company has provided this update as a general disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Kamdhenu Ventures Ltd - 543747 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: Allotment of 3,614 Equity Shares by Kamdhenu Colour and Coatings Limited on right issue basis.

The total investment made by Kamdhenu Ventures Limited was Rs. 13,01,04,000. This follows earlier intimations on April 10, 2026, regarding the investment approval and payment. The company has submitted the complete details as required under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

announcements.subject: Vikas Lifecare Ltd - 542655 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Saturday, April 11, 2026
announcements.detail: As per letter attached
announcements.ai_summary: Vikas Lifecare Ltd announced that its Board of Directors, in a meeting held on April 11, 2026, approved a fund-raising plan not exceeding Rs. 200 Crores. This fund raising will be conducted in one or more tranches through the issuance of warrants and/or equity shares on a preferential basis, in accordance with Chapter V of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018. The Board also approved an increase in the Authorized Share Capital to Rs. 300 Crores, consisting of equity shares with a face value of Re.1/- each, and a consequent amendment to the Memorandum of Association. Additionally, the Articles of Association will be altered to include a clause for "Further Issue of Capital" to align with the company's fund-raising proposals. The 'Fund Raising Committee' has been authorized to finalize details, including proposed allottees and issue price, which must adhere to SEBI pricing formulas. The company's scrip code is 542655.

announcements.subject: Advance Agrolife Ltd - 544562 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30, The Company has informed regarding Bagging/Receiving of order/contract

This is a domestic order, and the company's promoter or promoter group has no interest in NFL. The announcement was made on April 11, 2026.

announcements.subject: AAA Technologies Ltd - 543671 - Disclosure under Regulation 30A of LODR
