announcements.subject: PC Jeweller Ltd - 534809 - Update On The Conversion Of Fully Convertible Warrants Allotted On September 30, 2024 And October 11, 2024
announcements.detail: Update on conversion of Fully Convertible Warrants allotted on September 30, 2024 and October 11, 2024
announcements.ai_summary: PC Jeweller Ltd has successfully completed the conversion of 43,58,82,572 Fully Convertible Warrants into equity shares, benefiting 111 allottees, including promoter group entities. This conversion was done at a price of ₹ 42.15 per warrant, representing 75% of the issue price. The company had initially allotted 48,08,02,500 warrants on September 30, 2024, and October 11, 2024. Out of the total allotted warrants, 43,58,82,572 were converted, while 4,49,19,928 warrants lapsed upon expiry. The total amount raised through the allotment and conversion of these warrants is ₹ 2512,77,25,534.80. The upfront amount received for the lapsed warrants has been forfeited. The update was provided on April 11, 2026.

announcements.subject: Sundaram Brake Linings Ltd - 590072 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) With-Regarding To Fire Incident.
announcements.detail:
Dear Sir/Madam,
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the listing Regulation , it is hereby informed that on Friday, 10th April 2026, at around 09.55 PM a fire incident occurred at the factory of Plant -1 situted at Kariapatti, Virundhunagar, Tamil nadu.

This is for your information and records.

Thanking You,
Hari S.
CFO
announcements.ai_summary: Sundaram Brake Linings Ltd has reported a fire incident at its Plant-1 located in Kariapatti, Virudhunagar, Tamil Nadu, which occurred on Friday, April 10, 2026, at approximately 09:55 PM IST. The fire was controlled, and fortunately, there were no casualties or injuries. However, the affected operations will be temporarily shut down. The extent of damage to assets and equipment is currently being evaluated, and a detailed estimate will be provided in due course. The assets at the affected plant are adequately insured, and the company has already informed the insurance company, with an insurance survey expected shortly. The company has provided this disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Craftsman Automation Ltd - 543276 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, (SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015)
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, and in continuation of our earlier intimations dated 24th May, 2025 and 27th March, 2026, with respect to Equity investment in RC Green Powers Private Limited ("RCGPPL"), under the Group Captive Scheme, we wish to inform you that the Company has completely exited its investment in RCGPPL.
announcements.ai_summary: Craftsman Automation Limited has announced a complete exit from its investment in RC Green Powers Private Limited (RCGPPL). This divestment follows earlier intimations regarding equity investment in RCGPPL under the Group Captive Scheme. As of April 11, 2026, Craftsman Automation Limited no longer holds any equity shares or other interests in RC Green Powers Private Limited. The company has stated that this exit will not have any material impact on its operations or financial position.

announcements.subject: Seamec Ltd - 526807 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR), Regulations, 2015 - "Updates"

This update follows a previous communication dated February 18, 2026, regarding the vessel's off-hire status. The information was received on April 10, 2026, at 22:20 hours.

announcements.subject: Dabur India Ltd - 500096 - Submission Of Information Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015- Imposition Of Penalty
announcements.detail: Submission of information under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015- Imposition of Penalty
announcements.ai_summary: Dabur India Ltd has been notified of a penalty imposed by the Additional District Magistrate, Almora. The penalty amounts to INR 4,00,000/- and is related to alleged contraventions of Section 26 and Section 27 of The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, concerning the labelling of one of the company's products. Dabur India Ltd received this order on April 10, 2026. The company believes the demand is not maintainable and intends to file an appeal before the 1st Appellate Authority. Dabur India Ltd states that this order will not have any impact on its financial, operational, or other activities, and it is confident of a favorable outcome in higher forums. The company will also make this information available on its website.

announcements.subject: Jindal Poly Films Ltd - 500227 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Order Passed By The Hon'Ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Dated 09.04.2026
announcements.detail: Update
announcements.ai_summary: The Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Principal Bench, New Delhi, has issued an order dated April 9, 2026, in response to a petition filed by minority shareholders of Jindal Poly Films Limited. The NCLT has issued notice in an intervention application filed by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and directed parties to file their replies. Jindal Poly Films Limited has received the SEBI intervention application but is awaiting the NCLT order. The company reiterates its commitment to legal and regulatory compliance and states that all transactions were conducted according to due process and necessary approvals. Further disclosures as required by SEBI regulations are provided in Annexure A. The company expresses full trust in the judicial system.

announcements.subject: PC Jeweller Ltd - 534809 - Update On Reduction Of Outstanding Debt Payable To Banks
announcements.detail: Update on reduction of outstanding debt payable to banks
announcements.ai_summary: PC Jeweller Ltd has announced a further reduction of approximately 14% in its outstanding debt payable to banks under the Joint Settlement Agreement with its Consortium Lenders. This reduction brings the company closer to its objective of achieving a debt-free status. The repayment was facilitated by the balance consideration received from the conversion of Fully Convertible Warrants into equity shares by both the Promoter Group and Non-Promoter, Public entities. This marks significant progress towards the company's financial goal of becoming debt-free in the near future.

announcements.subject: Tata Motors Ltd - 544569 - Compliances-Half Yearly Communication - Debt Instruments

These include two tranches of E-28B Series, each issued for Rs. 250 crore and maturing in December 2026 and January 2027 respectively, with an 8.00% coupon rate. announcements.subject: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd - 522275 - Intimation Of Update In Litigation Filed By The Company
announcements.detail: Intimation of update in litigation filed by the Company
announcements.ai_summary: The company, GE Vernova T&D India Ltd, is providing an update on its ongoing litigation concerning the exemption from Basic Customs Duty on imported parts used in the manufacture of relays between 2002 and 2014. The Hon'ble Madras High Court had previously dismissed the company's writ petition against an Order-in-Original dated March 25, 2015, directing them to the appellate authority. Subsequently, on November 13, 2025, the company filed a Special Leave Petition before the Hon'ble Supreme Court. The Supreme Court, in its order dated April 8, 2026, received on April 10, 2026, dismissed the Special Leave Petition but permitted the company to file an appeal before the Commissioner (Appeals). GE Vernova T&D India Ltd will now proceed to file an appeal on merits against the Order-in-Original dated March 25, 2015.

announcements.subject: Vakrangee Ltd-$ - 511431 - VAKRANGEE EXPANDS INSURANCE PORTFOLIO THROUGH TIE-UP WITH INDIAFIRST LIFE INSURANCE
announcements.detail: Please refer the attachment for futher details
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Vakrangee Limited has entered into a strategic corporate partnership with IndiaFirst Life Insurance Company Limited, as announced on April 10, 2026. This tie-up will enable Vakrangee Kendras to offer a wide range of life insurance products, including term protection plans, to individuals and businesses. The partnership aims to significantly strengthen the availability of insurance services, particularly in underserved rural and semi-urban regions where Vakrangee Kendras are predominantly located. This initiative is part of Vakrangee's mission to expand access to essential financial services and promote inclusive growth by making insurance solutions more accessible and convenient. The Managing Director, Vedant Nandwana, highlighted the company's commitment to expanding financial services reach and driving deeper insurance penetration, especially in Tier 4 to Tier 6 markets.

announcements.subject: Filatex Fashions Ltd - 532022 - Receipt Of No-Objection Certificate From BSE And NSE For Reclassification Under Regulation 31A Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Filatex Fashions Ltd has received a No-Objection Certificate (NOC) from both BSE and NSE on April 10, 2026, for the reclassification of promoters Prashant Kumar Sethia and Rajkumar Sethia from the promoter category to the public category. This reclassification is in accordance with Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company had applied for this reclassification on November 15, 2025. The reclassification is subject to the approval of the company's members in a general meeting. Following this, the company will need to ensure compliance with subsequent disclosure requirements related to this material event.

announcements.ai_summary: TGV Sraac Ltd announced on April 10, 2026, a significant capacity addition for several of its products, effective from the same date. The company has increased its production capacity for Potassium Hydroxide by 27150 TPA to a total declared capacity of 76650 TPA. Other products with increased capacities include Liquid Chlorine (17160 TPA addition), Methylene Chloride (17817 TPA addition), Chloroform (12450 TPA addition), Carbon Tetra Chloride (1534 TPA addition), and HCL (100%) from CMS (1606 TPA addition). These details have been declared to the concerned authorities.

announcements.subject: Swiggy Ltd - 544285 - Board Meeting Outcome for Alteration Of The Articles Of Association
announcements.detail: Alteration of the Articles of Association of the company
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Swiggy Limited, at its meeting held on April 10, 2026, approved the alteration of the company's Articles of Association and the grant of special rights to identified shareholders. The Board also approved a Postal Ballot Notice to seek shareholders' approval for these alterations and special rights. The notice will be published and communicated in due course. announcements.subject: Kopran Ltd - 524280 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement

announcements.ai_summary: Kopran Limited has announced an update regarding its Scheme of Amalgamation, where Kopran Laboratories Limited will be merged by absorption into Kopran Limited. The Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, issued an order on April 09, 2026, directing the respective companies to convene meetings of their Equity Shareholders, Secured Creditors, and Unsecured Creditors. The order copy is available on the company's website. This disclosure is made in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations. The amalgamation is subject to the receipt of applicable regulatory and other approvals.

announcements.subject: Panacea Biotec Ltd - 531349 - Receipt Of Awards From The Presiding Officer Of Industrial Tribunal, Mohali
announcements.detail:
We would like to inform you that the Company has received four Awards from the Presiding Officer (in the rank of Additional District Judge) of Industrial Tribunal, S.A.S. Nagar, Mohali.

A detailed disclosure as required under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations read with SEBI Master Circular dated 30.01.2026 and Industry Standards on Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations is attached herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Panacea Biotec Limited has received four Awards from the Presiding Officer of the Industrial Tribunal, S.A.S. Nagar, Mohali, on April 9, 2026. These awards include setting aside the transfer of 23 workmen and granting them full back wages from the date of transfer, awarding reasonable wage revision for the workmen, and ordering the reinstatement of workers (excluding those who have settled) with 50% back wages from their termination date. Further details are provided in Annexure A, as required by SEBI LODR Regulations.

announcements.subject: Mcleod Russel India Ltd - 532654 -  Company Update
announcements.detail: Company Update
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: McLeod Russel India Ltd has accepted a Sanction Letter from National Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd (NARCL) on April 9, 2026, for debt restructuring. NARCL represents approximately 75.02% of the total lenders as of December 31, 2025, and discussions are ongoing with the remaining 24.98% of lenders. The company is required to pay a sustainable debt of Rs. 1,050 crores to NARCL by February 15, 2029. As part of the restructuring, NARCL will receive 10% of the company's new equity shares on a fully diluted basis through the conversion of unsustainable debt, and promoter shareholding will be pledged, subject to necessary approvals.

announcements.subject: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd - 524715 - Rumour verification - Regulation 30(11)

announcements.ai_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd has responded to a news item published on www.moneycontrol.com on April 10, 2026, which speculated about a $12 billion Organon deal entering its final stages. The company clarifies that the information presented in the article is speculative and that there is no material event or information requiring disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations. Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd reaffirms its commitment to adhering to high standards of corporate governance and disclosures. The company will continue to inform the stock exchanges of any material events as mandated by Regulation 30. This clarification is for the information and dissemination by the stock exchanges.

announcements.subject: Heranba Industries Ltd - 543266 -  Intimation About New Products Launch
announcements.detail: The Company has launched a new products 'Fentaamine' and 'MycoHil' on April 10, 2026, Press Release regarding the same is enclosed herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Heranba Industries Limited has announced the launch of two new products, 'Fentaamine' and 'MycoHil', on April 10, 2026. These products are categorized as Innovative Crop Nutrition Solutions and cater to the domestic market. 'Fentaamine' is a next-generation bio stimulant designed to enhance plant metabolism, improve stress tolerance, and boost crop yield. 'MycoHil' is an advanced biofertilizer aimed at improving nutrient absorption, strengthening soil microbiology, and promoting sustainable agriculture practices. The company has developed these products in collaboration with a leading American multinational company. Heranba Industries aims to leverage these new offerings to target ₹2,500 Crore revenue this fiscal year from its Crop Protection and Crop Nutrition segments.

announcements.subject: Texel Industries Ltd - 526638 - Outcome Of Finance And Investment Commitee Meeting Held On 10/04/2026.
announcements.detail: Outcome of the Finance and Invetsment commitee meeting held on 10/04/2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Texel Industries Ltd announced the outcome of its Finance and Investment Committee meeting held on April 10, 2026. The committee approved the allotment of 1,96,078 equity shares to Bhupendra Ramniklal Mehta, a promoter, upon conversion of an equal number of fully convertible equity warrants. The issue price for each share was ₹38.25, including a premium of ₹28.25 per share. The company received ₹56,24,987.63, representing 75% of the total consideration for the conversion. These warrants were initially issued on a preferential basis on October 5, 2024, at an issue price of ₹38.25 per warrant, with 25% of the consideration paid at the time of allotment. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased from ₹13,37,23,500 (1,33,72,350 equity shares) to ₹13,56,84,280 (1,35,68,428 equity shares), each with a face value of ₹10. The newly allotted shares will rank pari-passu with the existing equity shares.

announcements.subject: UCO Bank - 532505 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Interest Rates Updates
announcements.detail: Update on Benchmark Rates of the Bank
announcements.ai_summary: UCO Bank has announced updates to its benchmark interest rates, effective from April 10, 2026. The Asset Liability Management Committee (ALCO) reviewed and decided on revisions for certain rates. While the Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR) for all tenors (Overnight, One month, Three month, Six month, and One year) remains unchanged at 7.90%, 8.15%, 8.40%, 8.65%, and 8.75% respectively, there are changes in other benchmark rates. The Treasury Bill Linked Rate (TBLR) for a 3-month tenor has increased from 5.30% to 5.35%. The UCO G-Sec Rate for a 1-year tenor has been revised from 5.58% to 5.72%, and the 10-year G-Sec Rate YTM has increased from 6.83% to 7.24%. Rates for TBLR (6 month), TBLR (12 month), Repo Linked Rate – UCO Float, Repo Linked Rate – UCO Prime, Base Rate, and BPLR remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: Jain Resource Recycling Ltd - 544537 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: Corrigendum to Intimation dated March 30, 2026 under Regulation 30 - Acquisition of Equity Shares in Captive Generating Plant Companies for Captives Use of Electricity.
announcements.ai_summary: Jain Resource Recycling Ltd has issued a corrigendum to its earlier intimation dated March 30, 2026, regarding the acquisition of equity shares in Captive Generating Plant (CGP) companies for captive electricity use. The correction pertains to the acquisition price for Sea Sindu Green Energy Private Limited. The company will acquire 26% shareholding in Sea Sindu Green Energy Private Limited for Rs. 26,000, 26% in Sri Kamakshi Wind Power Private Limited for Rs. 13,00,000, and 26% in OM Sakthi Wind Power Private Limited for Rs. 60,83,000. The total consideration for these acquisitions is Rs. 74,09,000. This corrigendum, dated April 10, 2026, clarifies the pricing details for the acquisition of shares in these CGP companies, which are established for the company's captive use of electricity.

announcements.subject: Dev Information Technology Ltd - 543462 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Intimation Regarding Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Dev Information Technology Limited (DEV IT) has secured a significant mandate worth ₹26 crore from the National Informatics Centre Services Incorporated (NICSI) for the National Pharmacists Registration Tracking System (NPRTS). This project, under the Pharmacy Council of India, involves the design, development, system integration, and maintenance of a centralized, web-based platform for national pharmacist registration and tracking. The contract is on a fixed-cost basis with an execution timeline of approximately three years, providing medium-term revenue visibility. DEV IT's Chairman, Pranav Pandya, highlighted the company's capability in delivering large-scale digital solutions, reinforcing its position in government and enterprise digital transformation programs. The announcement was made on April 10, 2026.

announcements.subject: International Conveyors Ltd - 509709 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition

announcements.subject: Airfloa Rail Technology Ltd - 544516 - Corporate Growth & Prformance
announcements.detail: Corporate growth and performance of the Company During the FY - 2025-26
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Airfloa Rail Technology Limited has provided an update on its operational performance for the financial year 2025-26, projecting a topline of over ₹315.00 crore, indicating a significant YoY growth of approximately 64%. This growth is attributed to strong order inflows and execution across railway, defense, renewable energy, and emerging segments. The company has an unexecuted order book of approximately ₹500 crore and an active order pipeline of approximately ₹236 crore, with tenders worth ₹1,350 crore participated in. Key strategic developments include a planned Joint Venture with Big Bang Boom Solutions (BBBS) for entry into electronic warfare, AI-led defense systems, and advanced materials, and an MoU with Janatics Industrial Automation for automatic door systems. The company is also enhancing its participation in integrated and system-level railway projects.

announcements.subject: VA Tech Wabag Ltd - 533269 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements

This agreement formalizes the terms governing the relationship between the parties, including the management and control of the SPV, which was previously incorporated on February 16, 2026. The SPV is established to execute a Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) project on a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) basis in Dundaheda, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh. This announcement is made in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: WSFx Global Pay Ltd - 511147 - Intimation Of New Product Launch
announcements.detail: Intimation of launch of UNI-Z Digital Forex Card
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: WSFx Global Pay Ltd has launched a new product, the UNI-Z Digital Forex Card, on April 8, 2026. This 100% digital payment solution is designed for international markets, specifically to facilitate instant pre-admission education payments for students through the GlobalPay App. The card offers features such as instant digital issuance after KYC and funding, multi-currency support in 12 major currencies, and real-time app management for transactions and reloads. It aims to replace traditional payment methods like demand drafts and international bank transfers, providing faster processing, reduced costs, and enhanced convenience. The company has informed the BSE about this product launch as per Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.ai_summary: Network People Services Technologies Limited (NPST) has secured an order from a public sector bank to deploy its AI-Powered Risk Intelligence and Decision Platform (RIDP). This platform is a cloud-native solution designed for merchant underwriting and lifecycle risk monitoring across online and Point of Sale (POS) channels. The RIDP offers automated risk assessment, monitoring, and compliance functionalities and is provided under a managed SaaS model, which is expected to generate recurring revenue. The solution includes automated website crawling to detect prohibited content and payment scheme violations, and it triggers re-underwriting when a merchant's business details change materially. The risk scoring is based on identity, behavioral, and website risk signals.

This appointment is effective from the date of assumption of charge and will continue until further orders, pending approval from the Competent Authority. CONCOR is undertaking the necessary procedures as per the Companies Act 2013 and SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and will file the required disclosures with the stock exchanges within the stipulated time.

announcements.subject: NTPC Ltd - 532555 - Uprating Of Dadri Thermal Power Station Unit No. 5 And 6 (From 2×490 MW To 2×500 MW) Of NTPC Limited
announcements.detail: Disclosure attached.
announcements.ai_summary: NTPC Limited has announced an uprating of its Dadri Thermal Power Station Units 5 and 6 from 490 MW each to 500 MW each, effective April 7, 2026, as confirmed by the Central Electricity Authority (CEA). This enhancement increases NTPC group's total installed capacity to 89,128 MW and its commercial capacity to 88,048 MW. The company has filed this disclosure as per Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. No further immediate actions or approvals are mentioned as pending for this capacity enhancement.

announcements.subject: India Tourism Development Corporation Ltd - 532189 - Comments Of The Board Of Directors Regarding Non-Compliance Observed In IGR For The Quarter Ended On 31.12.2025
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed comments made by the Board in its meeting held on 24.03.2026 w.r.t. non compliance observed in IGR for the Quarter ended on 31.12.2025 under SEBI(LODR) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: India Tourism Development Corporation Ltd (ITDC) has submitted comments from its Board of Directors regarding non-compliance observed in its Integrated Governance Report (IGR) for the quarter ended December 31, 2025. The non-compliance pertains to not having the minimum number of directors and the requisite number of Independent Directors, including a woman Independent Director, on the ITDC Board. The Board noted that directors are appointed by the Government of India through the Administrative Ministry and therefore ITDC is not at fault. ITDC plans to seek a waiver of penalties and is following up with the concerned appointing authority for compliance. Once compliance is achieved, a request for waiver of the imposed fine will be submitted to the exchange. This matter was discussed in the Board meeting held on March 24, 2026.

announcements.subject: NHPC Ltd - 533098 - Investment Approval For Kamala Hydro Electric Project (1720 MW)
announcements.detail: In compliance to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR, Investment approval for 1720 MW Kamala Hydro Electronic Project by CCEA is submitted. The details given in the attached letter.
announcements.ai_summary: NHPC Ltd has received investment approval from the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) for the construction of the 1720 MW Kamala Hydro Electric Project (HEP) in Arunachal Pradesh. The total investment approved is ₹26,069.50 Crore, with an estimated completion period of 96 months. The project, which will have an installed capacity of 1720 MW, is expected to generate 6870 MUs of energy annually. This project will be implemented through a Joint Venture Company between NHPC Limited and the Government of Arunachal Pradesh. The Government of India will provide budgetary support of ₹4,743.98 crore for flood moderation and ₹1,340 crore for enabling infrastructure, along with Central Financial Assistance of ₹750 crore towards the State's equity share.

announcements.company: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd
announcements.subject: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd - 540767 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed the intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Nippon Life India Asset Management Limited has received an order dated April 7, 2026, from the Regional PF Commissioner-II, Employee’s Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO). The order, issued under Section 7A of the Employees Provident Funds & Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952, mandates the payment of balance E.P.F. and allied dues amounting to Rs. 36,54,699/- (Rupees Thirty Six Lakhs Fifty-Four Thousand Six Hundred and Ninety-Nine Only). announcements.subject: Jet Airways (India) Ltd - 532617 - Intimation Regarding Auction Outcome For Sale Of Aircraft Assets
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding Auction Outcome for Sale of Aircraft Assets
announcements.ai_summary: Jet Airways (India) Limited (Under Liquidation) has completed the e-auction for the sale of two Boeing 777 aircraft. The first aircraft, MSN 35157 (VT-JET), was sold to Ace Aviation XIV Limited for Rs. 3,09,24,90,000, exceeding the reserve price of Rs. 1,71,80,50,000. The second aircraft, MSN 35160 (VT-JEU), was sold to Ace Aviation XV Limited for Rs. 2,58,93,00,000, surpassing its reserve price of Rs. 1,84,95,00,000. The total consideration for both aircraft amounts to Rs. 5,68,17,90,000. This outcome is in consultation with the Stakeholders’ Consultation Committee and follows the IBBI (Liquidation Process) Regulations, 2016.

announcements.subject: Mkventures Capital Ltd - 514238 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Wholly Owned Subsidiary Likely To Become A Material Subsidiary
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Wholly Owned Subsidiary Likely to become a Material Subsidiary
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: MKVentures Capital Limited informed on April 8, 2026, that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Destination Properties Private Limited, is likely to become a material subsidiary. This is due to a Supplementary Agreement dated April 7, 2026, entered into with Anant Raj Limited for the development of a residential group housing project in Gurugram, Haryana. The revised commercial arrangement and expected scale-up in operations and revenue potential, where the subsidiary is entitled to approximately 17.69% of total project revenue, are the key factors. The subsidiary has contributed approximately 2.25 acres to the project's total land parcel of 5.0875 acres. Anant Raj Limited will have exclusive development, marketing, and sales rights.

announcements.subject: Redtape Ltd - 543957 - Intimation Pursuant To Acquisition Of Brand Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation pursuant to Acquisition of Brand under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Redtape Limited has acquired the international sports footwear brand SPRANDI for the markets of India, Nepal, Bhutan, and Sri Lanka, as announced on April 8, 2026. SPRANDI is a globally recognized brand with established sales in markets like China, Russia, and the Middle East. Redtape Limited plans to launch the brand in the Indian market soon through online and retail stores, aiming for significant sales volumes. This acquisition is intended to expand Redtape's brand portfolio and market presence. No specific financial details of the acquisition were disclosed in this announcement.

announcements.subject: Confidence Petroleum India Ltd - 526829 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition
announcements.detail: attaching herewith disclosure under regulation 30 (LODR) for acquisition made
announcements.ai_summary: Confidence Petroleum India Ltd announced on April 8, 2026, that it has acquired 25,00,000 equity shares, representing 50% of the paid-up share capital of BW Confidence Enterprise Private Limited, from BW LPG Infrastructure DMCC. announcements.subject: Dhruva Capital Services Ltd - 531237 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: :Launch of NeoMoney App"
announcements.ai_summary: Dhruva Capital Services Limited announced the launch of its new digital lending platform, "NeoMoney," on April 8, 2026, with a planned launch date of April 15, 2026. NeoMoney is designed to offer instant, compliant, and scalable credit solutions across India, powered by AI-driven infrastructure for intelligent underwriting and automated decision-making. The platform will facilitate loan sizes from INR 500 to INR 5,000 with tenures of 30, 60, or 90 days, plus a 90-day extension, and offers a credit limit of up to INR 50,000. Disbursements will be powered by RazorpayX and its payment gateway, with IDFC First Bank as the banking partner for real-time disbursals. The target segment includes students aged 18-30 years and salaried professionals aged 18-50 years, offering benefits such as 24x7 access, zero processing fees, and fast disbursements.

announcements.subject: Scoda Tubes Ltd - 544411 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 For Setting Up Of Ground Mounted Solar Project Under Gujarat Integrated Renewable Energy Policy-2025 For Captive Generating Plant
announcements.detail: This is to inform you that Gujarat Energy Development Agency (GEDA) has approved an application of the company for setting up of 3 MW (AC)/3.8 MW (DC) Ground Mounted Solar Project, at Survey No. 295, Village - Mundana, Tal. Sidhpur, Dist. Patan.
announcements.ai_summary: Scoda Tubes Limited has received approval from the Gujarat Energy Development Agency (GEDA) to establish a 3 MW (AC)/3.8 MW (DC) Ground Mounted Solar Project for captive power generation. The project will be located at Survey No. 295, Village - Mundana, Tal. Sidhpur, Dist. Patan, under the Gujarat Integrated Renewable Energy Policy-2025. The estimated total cost of the project is Rs. 13,69,74,420. The project is expected to generate an average of 16,340 KWH of electricity daily, leading to an estimated annual saving in electricity bills of Rs. 3,75,73,830. The Managing Director of Scoda Tubes Limited is Jagrutkumar Rameshbhai Patel. This intimation was made on April 8, 2026.

announcements.subject: Kkalpana Industries (India) Ltd - 526409 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Strikes /Lockouts / Disturbances
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Update on Impact of Operations due to Force Majeure
announcements.ai_summary: Kkalpana Industries (India) Ltd has announced a disruption in its manufacturing operations due to force majeure, as per Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The company cites current geopolitical tensions and ongoing conflict in the Middle East as the cause for significant supply chain disruptions and a critical shortage of essential raw materials. These force majeure conditions have adversely affected operations at the company's unit. Kkalpana Industries is closely monitoring the situation and taking steps to mitigate the impact and resume operations. Further updates will be provided regarding the restoration of normalcy.

announcements.subject: Shriram Finance Ltd - 511218 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release - MUFG subscribes to 47,11,21,055 Equity Shares of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Shriram Finance Limited has announced the successful completion of a significant investment by MUFG Bank, Ltd., a subsidiary of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. MUFG Bank has subscribed to 471,121,055 equity shares of Shriram Finance Limited at an issue price of INR 840.93 per share, totaling approximately INR 396.18 billion. This preferential issue was approved by Shriram Finance's Board of Directors on April 8, 2026, and has received all necessary regulatory and statutory approvals, including from the Competition Commission of India. Upon allotment, MUFG Bank will hold a 20.0% equity stake in Shriram Finance on a fully diluted basis, marking the largest cross-border investment in India's financial services sector. This transaction aims to strengthen MUFG's presence in India and enable Shriram Finance to leverage MUFG's global expertise for its growth strategy.

announcements.subject: Adani Green Energy Ltd - 541450 - Further Update On USA Matter
announcements.detail: Further update on USA matter
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Green Energy Limited has provided a further update regarding a civil matter initiated by the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of New York (EDNY). This update is in furtherance of previous intimations filed with the stock exchanges. The update states that the Defendants, Mr. Gautam Adani and Mr. Sagar Adani, who are directors of Adani Green Energy Limited, intend to move to dismiss the SEC's complaint by April 30, 2026. They have submitted a pre-motion conference letter to the EDNY judge, outlining their grounds for dismissal. These grounds include the court lacking personal jurisdiction over the Defendants, the claims being impermissibly extraterritorial, the alleged misstatements being non-actionable, and the Defendants' lack of involvement in the Offering barring the SEC's claims. The company, Adani Green Energy Limited, is not a party to these proceedings, and no charges have been brought against it.

announcements.subject: Colgate Palmolive (India) Ltd - 500830 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find herewith attached Media Release.
announcements.ai_summary: Colgate-Palmolive (India) Limited has issued a media release on April 8, 2026, titled "Colgate Makes Preventive Dental Care Accessible to All with FREE Dental Check-Ups." This initiative aims to enhance the accessibility of preventive dental care across India by offering free dental check-ups. The program builds upon its success in 2024-25, having facilitated over 4.5 million dental screenings. To address the issue of dentist availability in rural areas, where the dentist: patient ratio is 1:250,000, Colgate has partnered with Bajaj Health to integrate a Virtual Consultation option. Consumers can also access personalized Dental Screening Reports and find participating dentists by scanning a QR code on Colgate Toothpaste packs.

announcements.subject: Trishakti Industries Ltd - 531279 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Intimation of Order Received - Larsen & Toubro Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Trishakti Industries Limited has secured a significant work order from Larsen & Toubro Limited for the deployment of advanced machinery and skilled manpower. This domestic order involves the hiring of machines with manpower and is for an initial contract period of 06 months. The total contract value is expected to be upwards of ₹75 Lacs, inclusive of taxes. The execution of this order is scheduled to be completed by the end of April. This award reinforces the trust of top-tier corporates in Trishakti Industries' execution capabilities and asset strength, which is anticipated to lead to stronger revenue visibility and profitability in the upcoming quarters.

announcements.subject: Easy Trip Planners Ltd - 543272 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

announcements.subject: Indian Hotels Company Ltd - 500850 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed copy of press release titled "IHCL accelerates portfolio expansion; reaches 628 hotels marks a year of inorganic & sustained organic growth with 373 in operations and a pipeline of 255 hotels"
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) has announced a significant expansion of its hotel portfolio, reaching a total of 628 hotels, with a pipeline of 255 properties. This growth was driven by both inorganic and organic strategies, with 373 hotels currently in operation. The company added over 100 operating hotels through acquisitions this year, bringing the total operating hotels to 373 with over 33,000 rooms. IHCL aims to achieve its goal of a 700-hotel portfolio under its "Accelerate 2030" strategy. Key expansions include the onboarding of Claridges Collection, acquisition of a controlling stake in Atmantan, and majority stake acquisitions in ANK and Pride hospitality, bolstering the midscale segment. The company also saw organic growth across its brands, including 19 signings in Taj, with a new hotel in Cairo and a 500-key hotel in Patna.

This approval, under Section 31(1) of the Competition Act, 2002, also covers the internal restructuring of the Lemon Tree group through amalgamation and demerger. This development follows the company's prior intimation dated January 9, 2026, and is a significant step towards the consummation of the proposed transactions. The company is awaiting the detailed order from the CCI and will proceed with the transactions in accordance with applicable laws.

The company has implemented containment and remediation protocols to mitigate the impact and ensure the integrity of its systems, infrastructure, and data. As a containment measure, the company proactively isolated its network. Data related to affected accounts and Structured Digital Database (SDD) data that was lost has been re-entered. announcements.subject: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd - 524804 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Submission of Press Release on receipt of USFDA approval for Dapagliflozin and Metformin Hydrochloride Extended-Release tablets.
announcements.ai_summary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has received final approval from the US Food & Drug Administration (USFDA) for its Dapagliflozin and Metformin Hydrochloride Extended-Release Tablets. These tablets are available in strengths of 5 mg/ 500 mg, 5 mg/1000 mg, 10 mg/500 mg, and 10 mg/1000 mg, and are bioequivalent to AstraZeneca AB's Xigduo XR Tablets. The product will be manufactured at Unit-IV of APL Healthcare Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, and will be launched immediately. The estimated market size for these products is US$ 514 Million for the twelve months ending February 2026. Aurobindo Pharma has a total of 579 ANDA approvals from the USFDA as of March 31, 2026. As one of the first ANDA applicants with a paragraph IV certification, the company is eligible for 180 days of shared generic drug exclusivity.

announcements.subject: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd - 522275 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding imposition of penalty
announcements.ai_summary: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd has been informed of a penalty imposed by the Joint Commissioner of Customs. The company imported certain goods and assessed them at concessional rates of Basic Customs Duty. However, the authority determined that the imported goods did not qualify for these concessional rates, leading to a demand for short-levied differential duty. The order dated April 4, 2026, received on April 6, 2026, includes a short-levied differential duty of INR 15,14,900/-, a penalty of INR 15,14,900/-, and a redemption fine of Rs. 200,000/-. The company states there is no material impact on its financial or operational activities, with the financial impact limited to the order amount.

announcements.subject: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd - 544410 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Of Prostarm Info Systems Limited Held On Tuesday, April 07, 2026

announcements.ai_summary: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd held a Board Meeting on April 07, 2026, where several key decisions were approved. The company resolved to strategically realign its business operations by shifting its UPS-related business from the Pisoli Unit to the Bakrol Unit in Gujarat, impacting its wholly owned subsidiary, Prostarm Energy Systems Private Limited. Furthermore, Prostarm Info Systems Ltd signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Shenzhen Topband Co. Ltd (TOPBAND) of China. This MOU aims to explore a strategic alliance for Exclusive Cooperation in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), where TOPBAND will provide SKD kits and technology, and Prostarm will handle local assembly and commercialization in India, aligning with the "Make in India" initiative.

announcements.subject: The Phoenix Mills Ltd - 503100 - Business Update - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Please refer the attached letter.
announcements.ai_summary: The Phoenix Mills Limited has provided an operational business update for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. For the fiscal year 2026, the company achieved an all-time high retail consumption of approximately Rs. 16,578 crore, representing a 21% year-on-year increase, solely from its existing mall portfolio without any new additions. The fourth quarter of FY26 saw even stronger growth, with consumption reaching approximately Rs. 4,251 crore, up 31% year-on-year. The company's office portfolio also expanded significantly, with gross leasing of over 2.2 million square feet, leading to improved occupancy. Residential sales more than doubled year-on-year, and the hospitality segment remained resilient. The company has also uploaded this information on its website.

announcements.subject: Laurus Labs Ltd - 540222 - Update On Meetings Of Unsecured Creditors In Relation To The Composite Scheme Of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Please see annexed enclosure.
announcements.ai_summary: Laurus Labs Limited has announced a significant development regarding its Composite Scheme of Arrangement. The meetings of the unsecured creditors for both the Transferor Company (Laurus Synthesis Private Limited) and the Resulting Company (Sriam Labs Private Limited), which are wholly-owned subsidiaries, were held on April 06, 2026. These meetings were convened as per the directions of the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Amravati Special Branch (NCLT). The company confirms that the requisite quorum was present, and the meetings were conducted fairly and transparently. Crucially, the unsecured creditors of both entities have approved the Composite Scheme of Arrangement. This approval is a key milestone, though the scheme remains subject to further approval from the Hon’ble NCLT and other applicable statutory/regulatory authorities.

announcements.subject: Aegis Logistics Ltd - 500003 - Disclosure Pursuant To Regulation 30 Read With Schedule III Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Aegis Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about providing Corporate Guarantee and intimation for the same is attached.
announcements.ai_summary: Aegis Logistics Limited has provided a Corporate Guarantee to Itochu Corporation for the full and faithful performance of obligations by its subsidiary, Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited (AVTL), as per a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) dated March 27, 2026. This guarantee is related to Itochu Corporation becoming a shareholder of Aegis Terminal (Pipavav) Limited (ATPL), a subsidiary of AVTL, prior to the transfer of an Ammonia Terminal. The Corporate Guarantee amounts to INR 80,32,00,000/- and is for a limited period. The company has confirmed that this guarantee is at arm's length and no promoters or group companies have an interest in this transaction.

announcements.subject: Dhabriya Polywood Ltd - 538715 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (The "Listing Regulation') - Purchase Of Industrial Property.
announcements.detail: Intimation of Purchase of Industrial Land & Building.
announcements.ai_summary: Dhabriya Polywood Ltd has purchased an industrial property, including land and a building, for a total consideration of ₹22.46 crore. The property, measuring 2436 sq. meters, is located at Plot No. B-10(A,D,D1)A, Malviya Nagar Industrial Area, Jaipur - 302017, and is situated opposite the company's existing factory premises and registered office. This acquisition is intended to support the company's future expansion plans, including capacity enhancement for new and existing product lines. The purchase has been funded through internal accruals and partial bank funding. This intimation is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Shubham Polyspin Ltd - 542019 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulation 2015 For Capacity Expansion
announcements.detail: Disclosure for Capacity Expansion
announcements.ai_summary: Shubham Polyspin Ltd announced a capacity expansion of 200 MT per month at its existing unit in Borisana, Gujarat. The company's current capacity is 225 MT per month, with an approximate utilization of 90%. The proposed expansion is expected to be completed by March 2027 and requires an investment of approximately Rs. 1650 Lacs. This expansion will be funded by Rs. 415 Lacs from promoters' unsecured loans and Rs. 1235 Lacs from additional bank finance. The rationale behind this expansion is the increasing demand for PP yarn in domestic and international markets, aiming to improve operational efficiency, reduce per-unit costs, and strengthen competitiveness through economies of scale. The expanded capacity will also enable the adoption of modern, energy-efficient machinery, leading to improved yarn quality and reduced waste.

announcements.subject: Infosys Ltd - 500209 - Infosys And Harness Announce Strategic Collaboration To Unlock AI Value For Enterprise Transformation And Modernization Programs
announcements.detail: Enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Infosys Ltd has announced a strategic collaboration with Harness, an AI Software Delivery Platform company, effective April 7, 2026. This partnership aims to accelerate agentic AI-led software delivery transformation for global enterprises. The combined capabilities of Infosys Topaz Fabric, Infosys Cobalt, and the Harness Software Delivery Platform will focus on enhancing productivity, software engineering, AI governance, and scaling AI adoption. The collaboration seeks to automate the end-to-end software delivery lifecycle by applying AI to downstream activities such as testing, deployment, security, and governance. This initiative is designed to support large-scale modernization programs, particularly in complex and regulated environments, and will be hosted on Infosys' website.

announcements.subject: Rajshree Sugars & Chemicals Ltd - 500354 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: Operational data of our sugar factories for the month of March 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Rajshree Sugars & Chemicals Ltd has provided its monthly business update for March 2026, detailing the operational data for its sugar factories. For the month of March 2026, the company crushed a total of 67,261 MTs of cane across its Coimbatore Unit I and Unit II, producing 6,875 MTs of sugar and selling 4,336 MTs. In the same period, molasses production was 4,305 MTs, with own consumption and sales at 4,454 MTs. Cogeneration operations produced 92.33 Lakh Units of power, with 27.37 Lakh Units for captive consumption and 64.96 Lakh Units exported to the grid. The report also includes cumulative figures up to March 2026 for cane crushed, sugar produced and sold, molasses production, and power generation.

announcements.subject: Praxis Home Retail Ltd - 540901 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of LODR - Grant Of Stock Options
announcements.detail: Grant of Stock Options.
announcements.ai_summary: The Nomination and Remuneration Committee of Praxis Home Retail Ltd, in its meeting held on April 07, 2026, approved the grant of 5,00,000 stock options to eligible employees under the 'Praxis Employee Stock Option Plan 2024'. Each option will have an exercise price of Rs. 5/-. These options cover 5,00,000 equity shares of Rs. 5/- face value each. The options will vest in tranches: 40% after one year, 30% after two years, and 30% after three years from the grant date. Grantees can exercise these options within three years of their respective vesting dates. The meeting of the committee commenced at 4:05 p.m. and concluded at 4:16 p.m.

announcements.subject: Prince Pipes and Fittings Ltd - 542907 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Completion of Acquisition of Manufacturing facility at Bhuj, Gujarat
announcements.ai_summary: Prince Pipes and Fittings Limited has successfully completed the second phase of its acquisition of a manufacturing facility in Bhuj, Gujarat. This follows the company's earlier disclosure on March 20, 2024, regarding an Asset Purchase Agreement (APA) with Klaus Waren Fixtures Private Limited and Mr. Narshi Mulji Shah for the Aquel bathware business. The second phase involved the acquisition of the land parcel, buildings, machinery, manufacturing equipment, and office furniture and fixtures. This acquisition is a strategic move to strengthen Prince Pipes' diversification into the bathware segment and will serve as a manufacturing base for its bathware operations, supporting the scaling of the "Aquel by Prince" product portfolio.

announcements.subject: Alkem Laboratories Ltd - 539523 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith Press release- Alkem Launches A to Z Daily, an everyday multivitamin supplement for body and mind.
announcements.ai_summary: Alkem Laboratories Ltd. has announced the launch of "A to Z Daily," a new everyday multivitamin supplement designed for adults to provide holistic nutritional support for both body and mind. The supplement is formulated with 26 essential vitamins, minerals, and select botanicals, including Vitamin B complex, Vitamin D3, Vitamin C, Zinc, Iron, Ashwagandha, Bacopa monnieri, Panax ginseng, and L-theanine. These ingredients are intended to help manage stress, improve energy levels, and strengthen immunity. Alkem Laboratories positions "A to Z Daily" as a consistent, long-term approach for individuals seeking to maintain physical energy and mental composure amidst daily pressures. The launch was announced on April 7, 2026.

announcements.subject: CarTrade Tech Ltd - 543333 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Attached
announcements.ai_summary: CarTrade Tech Limited announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Sobek Auto India Private Limited (OLX India), has appointed Mr. Varun Sanghi as its Non-Executive Chairman. Mr. Sanghi, who has been with CarTrade Tech for over a decade and currently serves as Chief Strategy Officer, was instrumental in the acquisition of OLX India in 2023 and has led post-integration initiatives. He also heads CarTrade Labs, the company's innovation hub. As Chairman of OLX India, Mr. Sanghi will provide strategic guidance to support the company's next phase of growth, focusing on innovation, trust, and customer-centricity. This appointment is effective from April 7, 2026.

announcements.subject: Regency Ceramics Ltd - 515018 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2025
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2025, we here by inform that the Hon''ble  Principal District Court, puducherry has passed judgement in favour of the Company in the matter  of National Insurance company Limited vs Regency Ceramics Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: On April 7, 2026, Regency Ceramics Limited announced that the Hon'ble Principal District Court, Puducherry, passed a judgment in favor of the company on April 6, 2026. The case involved National Insurance Company Limited vs. Regency Ceramics Limited (OP No. 33 of 2022). The court partly allowed the petition, modifying an arbitral award to Rs. 133,30,60,000 (Rupees One Hundred Thirty-Three Crores Thirty Lakhs Sixty Thousand Only) and confirming the remaining portion along with proportionate costs. This outcome is expected to have a positive impact on the company's financial position.

announcements.subject: Sayaji Hotels Ltd - 523710 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 Of Entering Into Hotel Management Agreement.
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 of entering into Hotel Management Agreement
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Sayaji Hotels Limited has entered into a Hotel Management Agreement for a property located in Bengaluru, Karnataka. This agreement is for providing operational and management services for a hotel that will comprise 59 rooms and be developed as a 4-star property under the brand name "Enrise" by Sayaji. This initiative aligns with the company's strategic expansion plans in key Indian markets and aims to strengthen its presence in the southern region. The company has informed the BSE Limited about this development under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd - 532811 - Clarification On Dated 09-07-2024 Reply To NSE On 12-07-2024 But Missed With BSE

announcements.ai_summary: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd has submitted a clarification to BSE Limited regarding a non-compliance with Regulation 21(3C) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The company inadvertently missed intimating BSE about a warning letter received from NSE on July 9, 2024. The Risk Management Committee meetings were held on February 13, 2023, and November 10, 2023, with a gap of 270 days, which exceeded the 180-day limit stipulated by the regulation. The company acknowledges the unintentional delay in intimation to BSE and assures future compliance.

announcements.subject: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd - 543300 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release on achievement of significant production milestones by the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd announced on April 7, 2026, that it has achieved significant production milestones, manufacturing 500 million differential gears and 10 million differential assemblies since its inception. This achievement reinforces its position as a key global driveline solutions provider. The company, a leading global provider of mobility technology solutions, designs and manufactures components for Battery Electric Vehicles (BEV), Passenger Vehicles, Commercial Vehicles, and Off-highway Vehicles. Sona Comstar held an estimated 8.7% global market share in differential gears in CY25, an increase from 4.5% in 2019. Production began in 1999 at its Gurugram plant, followed by its Pune facility in 2005, with accelerated production in recent years.

announcements.subject: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd - 532143 - Updates
announcements.detail: Updates
announcements.ai_summary: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd has issued an update confirming the absence of bird flu incidents in its poultry farms, particularly in Tamil Nadu, where all its operations are located. The company clarified that it has no operations in Kerala, where avian influenza cases were previously reported. Their farms are recognized by the Government of India as avian influenza-free compartment farms, with continuous and rigorous surveillance for diseases like avian influenza, Newcastle disease, and salmonella. Enhanced biosecurity measures, including securing bird waste areas and restricting external visitors, are in place. The company assures stakeholders that the health of its layer birds remains stable, and egg production continues uninterrupted.

announcements.subject: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd - 538446 - Business Updates On Collection Efficiency
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith the intimation w.r.t. business updates.
announcements.ai_summary: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd has provided business updates on its collection efficiency for the period ending March 2026. The company's collection efficiency for the 'POS resolution %' in the 61-90 bucket showed an upward trend, reaching 62.8% in March 2026, up from 42.9% in October 2025. The number of bounce cases in the 'X Bucket' increased from 40,600 in September 2025 to 66,200 in March 2026. These updates are made pursuant to SEBI regulations and are available on the company's website, www.moneyboxxfinance.com. The update is subject to a quarterly limited review by the statutory auditors.

announcements.company: Swan Defence And Heavy Industries Ltd
announcements.subject: Swan Defence And Heavy Industries Ltd - 533107 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 7, 2026 titled "SDHI secures India''s First Ammonia Dual-Fuel Bulk Carrier Order".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited (SDHI) has secured a shipbuilding contract with Energy ONE Limited for the construction of four (4) 92,500 DWT dual-fuel ammonia bulk carriers. This marks India's first order for such vessels and represents one of the largest commercial vessels ever to be built at an Indian shipyard. Each vessel will be 229.5m in length with a beam of 37m and will feature an ammonia-fuelled propulsion system. The vessels will be designed by KMS-EMEC, South Korea, and classed by Det Norske Veritas (DNV). The first vessel is scheduled for delivery in October 2029, with subsequent deliveries at four-month intervals.

announcements.detail: Outcome of the Meeting of Right Issue Committee held on 06th April, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: The Right Issue Committee of Lexora Global Limited (formerly Yash Trading & Finance Limited) met on April 06, 2026, from 09:00 PM to 09:50 PM. During this meeting, the Committee considered, approved, and took on record the Draft Letter of Offer (DLOF) for the proposed Right Issue of equity shares. The Committee also authorized the filing of this DLOF with BSE Limited. Furthermore, designated officials of the Company have been authorized to make necessary modifications, finalize the document, and undertake all other required actions related to the Right Issue.

announcements.subject: Cambridge Technology Enterprises Ltd - 532801 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of Securities Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI Listing Regulations')
announcements.detail: We wish to inform that Divestment of 100% shareholding in R.P. Web Apps Pvt. Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of the company as approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on March 30, 2026 has been completed.
announcements.ai_summary: Cambridge Technology Enterprises Limited has completed the divestment of its entire 100% shareholding in its wholly-owned subsidiary, R.P. Web Apps Private Limited. This divestment, previously approved by the Board of Directors on March 30, 2026, involved the transfer of 60,880 equity shares of face value Rs. 10/- each to AKIT IT Consulting Private Limited. The transaction was completed on April 06, 2026, resulting in R.P. Web Apps Private Limited ceasing to be a subsidiary of Cambridge Technology Enterprises Limited.

announcements.subject: Tube Investments of India Ltd - 540762 - Update On Acquisition Of Orange Koi Private Limited
announcements.detail: Update on Acquisition of Orange Koi Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Tube Investments of India Limited ("TII") has acquired 8,94,072 equity shares of Orange Koi Private Limited, each with a face value of Rs.10, representing 76.24% of the paid-up equity share capital. This acquisition, which took place on April 6, 2026, makes Orange Koi a subsidiary of TII under Section 2(87) of the Companies Act, 2013. This update follows TII's previous letter dated February 6, 2026, regarding the acquisition.

announcements.subject: Damodar Industries Ltd-$ - 521220 - General - Updates
announcements.detail:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Enclosed herewith is the disclosure under regulation 10(6) of SAST Regulations.
announcements.ai_summary: Arunkumar Biyani, a promoter of Damodar Industries Limited, has made a disclosure under Regulation 10(6) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure pertains to the inter-se transfer of equity shares in the nature of a gift. announcements.subject: C.E. Info Systems Ltd - 543425 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of C.E. Info Systems Limited held a meeting on April 06, 2026, from 4:30 PM to 6:30 PM. During this meeting, several key personnel changes and role assignments were approved, effective from April 06, 2026. Mrs. Rashmi Verma will take on the additional role of Chief Human Resources Officer, in addition to her current position as CTO. Mr. Shishir Kumar Verma will oversee the role of Chief Operating Officer (COO) at Gtropy Systems Private Limited and will also manage Human Resources functions as CHRO for Gtropy Systems Private Limited and Mappls DT Private Limited, both subsidiaries of the company. Furthermore, Mr. Rishin Kalra will transition to the role of Chief Technical Officer (CTO) at Gtropy Systems Private Limited. These changes are intended to strengthen leadership at the subsidiary level, enhance operational efficiency, and support the group's growth strategy.

announcements.subject: Brightcom Group Ltd - 532368 - Monthly Updates
announcements.detail: Monthly updates
announcements.ai_summary: Brightcom Group Limited has submitted its monthly update presentation for February and March 2026, detailing operational progress, governance initiatives, and business developments. The company focused on structured execution across operations, partnerships, and governance during this period, rather than expansion. Key highlights include improving revenue quality, strengthening internal processes and control frameworks, and aligning global operations. The presentation emphasizes a strategic shift towards improving yield per unit of supply and deepening partner integration, with a focus on increasing direct publisher integrations and demand efficiency. Growth continues in video, CTV, and in-app ecosystems, with heightened performance expectations.

announcements.subject: TechNVision Ventures Ltd - 501421 - Emagia Unveils Gia Order Management Super Agent On Its Autonomous Finance Platform To Accelerate Order-To-Cash For Global Enterprises
announcements.detail: Please find the attached information for dissemination at the Corporate Announcement section of BSE website.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Emagia, an AI-powered Autonomous Finance platform provider, has announced the launch of its Gia Order Management Super Agent. This new solution is designed to autonomously capture, validate, and process customer purchase orders, aiming to accelerate order-to-cash cycles for global enterprises. Key highlights include 80-95% touchless order processing across omni-channels and multi-languages, up to 10x faster order entry cycles, and 50-70% cost reduction in processing with improved data accuracy. The platform also offers over 120 enterprise integrations. TechNVision Ventures Ltd is disseminating this news for corporate announcement purposes.

announcements.subject: Purple Finance Ltd - 544191 - Intimation Of Allotment Of Subordinated, Unsecured, Rated, Listed, Redeemable, Transferable, INR Denominated,  Non- Convertible Debentures
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed announcement pertaining to allotment of Subordinated, Unsecured, Rated, Listed, Redeemable, Transferable, INR Denominated Non-Convertible Debenture.

These debentures have been allotted on April 06, 2026, on a private placement basis to Mr. Sanjeev Prithviraj Kumar. This allotment follows the company's earlier intimation dated March 31, 2026.

announcements.subject: Kisan Mouldings Ltd-$ - 530145 - Intimation Of Receipt Of No-Objection Letter For Reclassification From 'Promoter And Promoter Group' Category To 'Public' Category
announcements.detail: In accordance with Regulation 30 read with Regulation 31A(8) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 as amended, we wish to inform you that the company has received a No Objection Certificate letter dated April 06, 2026 along with an Advisory letter from BSE Limited in connection with the proposed reclassification of Mrs. Bindiya Aggarwal from the Promoter Category to Public Category
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Kisan Mouldings Ltd has received a No-Objection Letter and an Advisory Letter from BSE Limited on April 06, 2026, regarding the proposed reclassification of Mrs. Bindiya Aggarwal. The reclassification is from the 'Promoter and Promoter Group' category to the 'Public' category. These letters were issued after BSE Limited's due examination of the company's application and confirmation of compliance with Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company will proceed with the necessary steps to effect this reclassification and will keep the stock exchange informed of further developments.

announcements.subject: Manali Petrochemicals Ltd - 500268 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail: Agreement with Media Company
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Manali Petrochemicals Limited has executed an agreement on April 6, 2026, to further extend its engagement with Fortuna Public Relations Private Limited (FPRPL) for an additional two-year period. This extension, commencing from April 1, 2026, to March 31, 2028, will see FPRPL continue to provide public relations consultancy services. These services include promoting media and investor relations, corporate image building, and other related matters. FPRPL is not a related party to the promoter or group companies, and the company holds no shareholding in FPRPL. No special rights like director appointment or pre-emptive subscription rights have been granted to FPRPL.

announcements.subject: Route Mobile Ltd - 543228 - Shareholders Satisfaction Survey
announcements.detail: Shareholders Satisfaction Survey
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Route Mobile Ltd has initiated a Shareholders' Satisfaction Survey to gather feedback from its shareholders regarding their experience with the company. The survey communication was sent via email on April 6, 2026, to shareholders with registered email IDs. The company encourages participation to help improve investor relations and meet shareholder expectations. Feedback can be submitted through a provided link until April 20, 2026. The survey also covers feedback on services offered by the company and its Registrar and Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies Limited. This initiative is part of Route Mobile Ltd's commitment to enhancing shareholder value.

announcements.subject: Standard Capital Markets Ltd - 511700 - Partial Redemption Of 10% Secured Non- Convertible Debentures (NCD-3 Series I)
announcements.detail: The Company has redeemed its Secured, Unlisted, Unrated, Redeemable Non Convertiable 15000 NCD 3 Series I having face value 100000 aggregating to 1500000000 within 5 working day

The company has redeemed 15,000 NCDs, each with a face value of Rs. 100,000, aggregating to Rs. 1,50,00,00,000 (Rupees One Hundred Fifty Crore). Previously, these debentures aggregating to Rs. 250 Crore were issued on April 30th, 2025, and allotted between May 2nd, 2025, and May 6th, 2025. Following this partial redemption, the entire Rs. 250 Crore of NCD-3 Series I, including accrued interest, stands fully redeemed.

announcements.subject: Pune E - Stock Broking Ltd - 544141 - Receipt Of In Principle Approval For Issue And Allotment Of 16,00,000 Convertible Warrants

The company has been advised to obtain undertakings from allottees regarding no intra-day trading and to strengthen internal controls before allotment to ensure compliance with SEBI (ICDR) Regulations.

announcements.subject: Vipul Ltd - 511726 - Vipul Limited Has Informed The Exchange About The Reason Of Delay In Providing Material Information Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Vipul Limited has informed the Exchange about the reason of delay in providing material information under Regulation 30 of SEBI(LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Vipul Limited has informed the exchange regarding a delay in disclosing material information. The delay was primarily due to the non-availability of requisite details with the management within the prescribed timeline. Furthermore, the process of obtaining necessary confirmations was impacted by extended weekly offs and a company holiday observed for Holi. Vipul Limited remains committed to ensuring timely and accurate disclosures in compliance with regulatory requirements. The company will submit the relevant information to the stock exchanges promptly upon receipt and confirmation by the management.

announcements.subject: PDS Ltd - 538730 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: PDS Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding press release.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: PDS Limited has secured a strategic sourcing mandate from a leading US value retailer, a contract expected to drive sourcing volumes of approximately ₹450 crore. This engagement will be executed through PDS subsidiary, GSCL, under the leadership of Michael Yee, who is spearheading PDS's efforts to scale its US business. The contract signifies a crucial step in strengthening PDS's presence in key markets through on-ground leadership and execution capabilities. The company highlighted that this partnership reflects the resilience of the PDS platform and the strength of its global ecosystem, with its widespread sourcing network and ability to deliver agile solutions positioning it as a partner of choice for leading global retailers. Continued investments in cost transformation, digital capabilities, and AI-led initiatives have enhanced PDS's sourcing platform and value proposition, as evidenced by this new partnership.

announcements.subject: Valencia Nutrition Ltd - 542910 - Press Release-Strategic Manufacturing Agreement Between Valencia Beverages And Superwaters P Ltd And Virchow Laboratories Ltd
announcements.detail: Valencia Beverages and Superwaters Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Valencia Nutrition Limited has entered into a definitive business agreement with Virchow Laboratories Limited for manufacturing of its juice product profile.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Valencia Nutrition Ltd, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Valencia Beverages and Superwaters Private Limited, has entered into a strategic manufacturing agreement with Virchow Laboratories Limited. This agreement covers the manufacturing of Valencia's juice product portfolio, including 8 SKUs such as Mango, Guava, and Apple variants. A committed monthly production volume has been secured, representing approximately 15% of Valencia Beverages Unit II's installed capacity in Hyderabad. This partnership aims to enhance Valencia's manufacturing capabilities and leverage Virchow Laboratories' expertise to improve production efficiency and meet growing demand. The collaboration is expected to contribute to optimal capacity utilization at Valencia's Hyderabad facility.

announcements.subject: Greenlam Industries Ltd - 538979 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR), 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Greenlam Industries Ltd announced that its wholly owned subsidiaries, Greenlam Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) and Greenlam Industries SDN. BHD. (Malaysia), have jointly acquired the entire 33% local shareholding of PT. Greenlam Indo Pacific in Indonesia. Previously, the Singapore subsidiary held 67% of PT. Greenlam Indo Pacific. Following this acquisition, the Indonesian entity has become a wholly owned step-down subsidiary of Greenlam Industries Limited, with the collective shareholding of the Singapore and Malaysia subsidiaries now at 100%. The turnover of PT. Greenlam Indo Pacific for FY 2024-25 was IDR 13,169,408,093, with a comprehensive income of IDR (7,318,172,587). This transaction aims to rationalize the group's holding structure and minimize compliance requirements. The announcement was made on April 6, 2026.

announcements.subject: Tulive Developers Ltd - 505285 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Update On Voluntary Delisting - Formation Of Independent Director Committee
announcements.detail: In relation to voluntary delisting of equity shares of the Company from BSE Limited, pursuant to regulation 28(1) of SEBI (Delisting of Equity Shares) Regulations, 2021 and Detailed Public Announcement published in newspapers on April 06, 2026, the Board of Directors of the Company has constituted a Committee of Independent Directors to provide reasoned recommendations on the delisting offer
announcements.ai_summary: Tulive Developers Ltd has announced the formation of a Committee of Independent Directors to provide recommendations on its voluntary delisting offer from BSE Limited. This action is in accordance with Regulation 28(1) of the SEBI (Delisting of Equity Shares) Regulations, 2021. The committee members are Mr. Jacob George Kandathil (Chairman), Mr. Pradeep Bhandari, and Mrs. Bhumika Jignesh Shah. The company will publish the committee's reasoned recommendations and voting pattern details at least two working days before the bidding period commences, in the same newspapers where the Detailed Public Announcement (DPA) was published on April 06, 2026. Saffron Capital Advisors Private Limited is the Manager to the Delisting Offer.

announcements.subject: Visa Steel Ltd - 532721 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Conversion of Securities
