announcements.subject: Globus Spirits Ltd - 533104 - Press Release - Launch Of TERAI Tequila
announcements.detail: Press Release - Launch of TERAI Tequila
announcements.ai_summary: Globus Spirits Limited has announced the launch of TERAI Tequila, marking its entry into the premium tequila market. This new product is positioned as India's first authentic, CRT-certified tequila to be bottled domestically. TERAI Tequila is crafted in Jalisco, Mexico, at the La Huaracha Distillery using 100% Blue Weber Agave and traditional methods. The spirit is then imported to India and bottled under the strict supervision of the Consejo Regulador del Tequila (CRT). The initial offering is a Blanco expression, highlighting the purity of the agave. This launch signifies Globus Spirits' strategy to cater to evolving Indian consumer preferences for global, authentic, and luxury spirits.

announcements.subject: Banaras Beads Ltd - 526849 - Annual Discloser Pursuant To Regulation 30 (1) And 30 (2) Of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition Of Shares And Takeovers Regulation 2011 For Year Ended 31.03.2026.
announcements.detail: Annual Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30(1) and 30(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of shares and Takeovers Regulation 2011.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: This announcement is an annual disclosure for the year ended March 31, 2026, made by the promoters and their groups of Banaras Beads Ltd, pursuant to Regulation 30(1) and 30(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure details the shareholding of various promoters, including Ashok Kumar Gupta holding 886,185 shares (13.43%), Rekha Gupta holding 739,830 shares (11.21%), Ashok Kumar Gupta (HUF) holding 544,920 shares (8.26%), Prashant Gupta & Ashok Kumar Gupta jointly holding 472,540 shares (7.16%), Shivani Gupta holding 513,900 shares (7.79%), and Siddharth Gupta holding 701,000 shares (10.63%). Collectively, these promoters hold 3,858,375 shares, representing 58.48% of the total share/voting capital. The disclosure confirms that no single shareholder holds more than 25% of the company's shares or voting capital.

announcements.subject: Tata Motors Ltd - 544569 - SIAM Report - January To March 2026

announcements.subject: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Ltd - 512608 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Meeting Of Board Of Directors Of Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited (The Company) - Revision In The Utilisation Of Funds Raised In Rights Issue Concluded In March 2026
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting for modification in utilisation of funds raised through rights issue due to under subscription.
announcements.ai_summary: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited's Board of Directors met on April 6, 2026, to revise the utilization of funds raised from a rights issue concluded in March 2026, due to under-subscription. The rights issue was only 48.44% subscribed. As of March 31, 2026, Rs. 678 Lakhs were utilized for repayment of MSME and pressing creditors, suppliers, and rights issue expenses. The remaining funds, totaling Rs. 2378.41 Lakhs, will be utilized by June 30, 2026, primarily for long-term working capital and rights issue expenses. The company has deferred the object of payment of long-term loans and will limit the use of funds for general corporate purposes.

announcements.subject: Midwest Gold Ltd - 526570 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Regulations) 2015.
announcements.detail: Midwest Energy Devices Private Limited, Step-down subsidiary company has commenced trial production at its Lithium Battery Assembly Line and Certification - Led BESS Platform.
announcements.ai_summary: Midwest Gold Ltd announced that its step-down subsidiary, Midwest Energy Devices Private Limited, has commenced trial production at its Lithium Battery Assembly Line and Certification-Led BESS Platform. This facility, located in Bengaluru, has a semi-automated, process-driven manufacturing platform with an initial annual capacity of 1 GWh, which has a roadmap to scale up to 3 GWh. The production line is designed for traceability, process control, validation rigor, and certification readiness, verifying each battery cell before production and testing finished units. The platform offers flexibility to handle different cell types, pack capacities, and configurations, supporting Midwest's branded BESS products, contract manufacturing, and customized battery pack requirements. The company is currently advancing two flagship BESS platforms under certification-led development, including a 418 kWh Outdoor BESS Unit.

announcements.subject: Jindal Steel Ltd - 532286 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Jindal Steel has announced a significant advancement in India's energy sector by pioneering the use of swadeshi coal through advanced coal gasification. The company achieved a global first by establishing India's first coal gasification-based Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) plant, utilizing syngas for iron-making. In response to fuel shortages, Jindal Steel has successfully deployed syngas in galvanizing and color coating line furnaces, a first for the steel industry, to mitigate supply disruptions. Furthermore, the company has pioneered syngas injection into its blast furnace, reducing reliance on imported coking coal and lowering carbon emissions per tonne of steel. This integrated approach across the steelmaking value chain aims to enhance efficiency, sustainability, and energy self-reliance, supported by government policies like the National Coal Gasification Mission.

announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Copper Ltd (HCL) has announced strong operational performance for the financial year 2025-26, reporting a Metal in Concentrate (MIC) production of 27,421 tonnes, a 9% increase from FY 2024-25 and the highest in seven years. Ore production reached 3.67 million tonnes, a 6% increase year-on-year. Sales of Copper MIC for the fiscal year were 27,367 tonnes, marking the best in the last five years. These achievements were driven by coordinated efforts across functional domains and HCL's resilience in a challenging operating environment. The company is progressing towards its strategic goal of achieving 12.2 MTPA mining capacity by 2030. Key milestones include the resumption of operations at Kendadih, Kolihan, and Surda mines, progress in securing statutory clearances, and advancements in greenfield projects in India and overseas. The paste fill plant at Malanjkhand Copper Project is a notable implementation of paste backfill technology.

Borosil has successfully secured LPG supplies from Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs), leading to the full restoration of production at its Borosilicate Glass Furnace for Pressware Products and Opal Glass Furnaces in Jaipur, Rajasthan. The company acknowledges the support from OMCs and government authorities in facilitating the resumption of operations, which remains contingent on continued LPG availability.

announcements.subject: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd - 543237 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 03, 2026, titled "Strengthening Maritime Prowess: INS Taragiri Commissioned into the Indian Navy".
announcements.ai_summary: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd (MDL) has announced the commissioning of INS Taragiri, an indigenously built stealth frigate, into the Indian Navy on April 3, 2026, at Visakhapatnam. This marks a significant advancement in India's warship design and construction capabilities, as INS Taragiri is the third vessel in the Project 17A series. The ship, measuring 149.02 meters in length and 17.8 meters in width, has a displacement of 6400 tons and is powered by a CODOG propulsion system, enabling a speed of over 28 knots. Equipped with advanced stealth features, weapon systems, sensors, and automation, INS Taragiri is expected to substantially enhance India's maritime security and operational reach in the Indian Ocean Region. The commissioning ceremony was presided over by the Hon’ble Raksha Mantri, Shri Rajnath Singh.

In March 2026 alone, APSEZ achieved its highest-ever monthly cargo volume of 46 MMT, up 11% year-on-year, primarily driven by a 14% increase in container handling. The company's CWIT terminal surpassed the 1 million TEU milestone in FY26, handling 1.06 million TEUs, and recorded its highest monthly volume of 134,960 TEUs in March 2026. The Haifa port also showed operational progress, handling 0.77 MMT in March 2026. While logistics rail volume saw a slight decrease of 7% year-on-year in March 2026 to 55,237 TEUs, it increased by 8% year-on-year for FY26, reaching 695,517 TEUs.

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: SoftTech Engineers Limited has been appointed as the technology partner for the e-TDR platform, India's first unified digital platform for Transfer of Development Rights (TDR) transactions. This initiative is launched by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) under the direction of the UDD, Government of Maharashtra. The platform is designed to serve over 18,000 registered developers and TDR owners within BMC. Key features include online payments, real-time bidding, digital contracts with IGR integration, AI-enabled analytics, and blockchain-anchored TDR certificate issuance. The e-TDR platform aims to eliminate opaque pricing, reduce transaction cycle times, and prevent fraud by replacing manual processes with automated, auditable workflows. announcements.subject: Indian Bank - 532814 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Interest Rates Updates
announcements.detail: Revision in Benchmark Rates
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Bank announced on April 2nd, 2026, a revision in its benchmark rates as decided by the Asset Liability Management Committee (ALCO). The Treasury Bills Linked Lending Rate (TBLR) for tenors of up to 3 months has been revised downwards from 5.35% to 5.30%. Rates for tenors greater than 3 months and up to 1 year, as well as for tenors greater than 1 year and up to 3 years, remain unchanged at 5.50% and 5.60% respectively. The revised TBLR is effective from April 3rd, 2026. The Marginal Cost of Funds based Lending Rate (MCLR), Base Rate, Benchmark Prime Lending Rate (BPLR), Policy Repo Rate, and Repo Linked Benchmark Lending Rates (RBLR) remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 544210 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release Titled "Emcure Pharma Reduces Poviztra Starting Dose Price by 55% to Expand Patient Access."
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd. has announced a significant price reduction for its weight management drug, Poviztra® (semaglutide injection), effective April 3, 2026. The starting dose price will now be Rs. 999/- per week or Rs. 3,999/- per month, representing a 55% reduction in the starting dose price and an average reduction of 47% across all doses. The company aims to expand patient access to this therapy, which is a second brand of Novo Nordisk’s semaglutide injection for obesity. The price revision brings the innovator molecule, backed by extensive clinical and real-world evidence, within reach of a larger patient base in India, addressing the growing public health challenge of obesity.

announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited (EIEL) has announced securing five major project wins in March 2026, with a combined value of INR 1,481 Crores. These new projects include a significant INR 1070 Cr order in the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) segment, with a combined capacity of 930 MWH across these projects. The company is expanding its geographical footprint into Bihar, Assam, and Telangana. These wins mark a strong closure to the financial year and strengthen EIEL's position in the renewable energy and BESS segments, aligning with India's growing demand for energy storage solutions. Under the terms, Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited is entitled to receive a management fee linked to pre-agreed milestones and has the option to use its Intellectual Property (IP) at the water park. announcements.subject: Dhanlaxmi Bank Ltd - 532180 - Business Updates For The Year Ended March 31,2026
announcements.detail: Business updates for the Year ended March 31,2026
announcements.ai_summary: Dhanlaxmi Bank Ltd has provided business updates for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The bank reported a Total Business of INR 33,773 Crore for the provisional period ending March 31, 2026, representing a Year-on-Year growth of 19.68% compared to INR 28,219 Crore in the previous year. Total Deposits stood at INR 18,643 Crore, up 16.42% from INR 16,013 Crore. Gross Advances increased by 23.96% to INR 15,130 Crore from INR 12,206 Crore. Notably, Gold Loans saw a significant increase of 71.41% to INR 6,512 Crore, and MSME advances grew by 30.90% to INR 2,135 Crore. This data is provisional and subject to audit.

announcements.subject: Vedanta Ltd - 500295 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, As Amended ('SEBI Listing Regulations')
announcements.detail: Please refer the enclosed file.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Vedanta Limited's subsidiary, Talwandi Sabo Power Limited (TSPL), has received a direction from the Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (CAQM) to deposit an Environmental Compensation of Rs. 33,02,56,800. This penalty is allegedly for not achieving the mandatory five percent blend of crop residue pellets or briquettes with coal for FY 2024-25, as per Rule 3 of the Environment (Utilization of Crop Residue by Thermal Power Plant) Rules, 2023. TSPL received this direction via email on April 01, 2026, and intends to file an appeal before the appropriate forum within the prescribed timeline. The company expects a favourable outcome and does not anticipate any material financial impact on TSPL or Vedanta Limited.

announcements.subject: Sanathan Textiles Ltd - 544314 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 - Completion Of Phase I Ramp-Up At Punjab Facility.
announcements.detail: Please find attached the press release pertaining to completion of Phase I at Punjab Facility.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Sanathan Textiles Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary Sanathan Polycot Private Limited, has successfully completed the Phase I ramp-up at its Punjab facility. The facility, which commissioned its Continuous Polymerisation line with an initial capacity of 350 tonnes per day on August 27, 2025, is now operating at approximately 96% of its installed capacity. This achievement reflects strong execution capabilities and robust demand absorption, particularly from North India's textile ecosystem. The company is now focused on advancing its expansion roadmap, including the planned progression towards Phase II, to further enhance its position as an integrated and diversified polyester yarn manufacturer. The Executive Director, Mr. Sammir Dattani, highlighted the operational discipline and market positioning that enabled this successful ramp-up despite geopolitical challenges.

announcements.subject: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd - 544225 - Disclosure Of Shareholders' Communication Dated April 1, 2026, Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.detail: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has informed the exchange regarding the Shareholders communication dated April 1, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd has reported a significant surge in its business performance for March 2026. Daily orders for electric vehicles exceeded 1,000 units in the last week of March, indicating strong demand momentum. Vehicle registrations in March 2026 reached 10,117 units, a substantial increase of over 150% compared to 3,973 units in February 2026. This performance signifies a sharp market share recovery, driven by structural improvements in service operations, with over 80% of vehicles now serviced on the same day. The company has implemented operational changes to improve turnaround times and customer experience, thereby strengthening customer trust and boosting demand. Ola Electric has communicated these positive developments to shareholders on April 1, 2026, and the information will be hosted on their website.

announcements.subject: InterGlobe Aviation Ltd - 539448 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: InterGlobe Aviation Limited, operating as IndiGo, has announced a revision in fuel charges for all new domestic and international bookings made after 0001 hrs on April 2, 2026, due to a significant increase in Air Turbine Fuel (ATF) costs. The Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas and Ministry of Civil Aviation have allowed a partial and staggered increase of 25% for domestic operations. Revised fuel charges per sector for domestic routes will range from ₹ 275 for distances up to 500 kms to ₹ 950 for routes above 2,000 kms. For international operations, revised fuel charges will vary by region, with charges for the Indian Subcontinent up to 500 kms at ₹ 900 and for UK & Europe at ₹ 10,000. These revisions are intended to mitigate the impact of rising fuel prices on the airline's operating costs.

announcements.detail: Pursuant to provisions of Regulation 30 of LODR Regulations, the subsidiaries of Prime Focus Limited have proposed to undertake certain steps for internal restructuring within the group to streamline the business operations and details of key restructuring steps.
announcements.ai_summary: Prime Focus Limited (PFL) is undertaking an internal restructuring of its subsidiaries to streamline business operations. This involves the transfer of 100% equity shareholding of Prime Focus Technologies Inc. (PFT US) from Brahma AI Services India Limited (Brahma India) to DNEG S.a.r.l. (DNEG). This transfer is contingent upon the conversion of optionally convertible redeemable preference shares and loans previously extended by Brahma India to PFT US into equity shares, which does not involve any fresh capital infusion. Additionally, DNEG will transfer its entire 100% equity shareholding in Brahma AI Services India Limited to Brahma AI Holdings Limited. Following these transactions, PFT US and Brahma India will remain step-down subsidiaries of PFL. The Audit Committee has approved these restructuring steps, which were finalized by the Board of Directors on April 1, 2026.

As of March 31, 2026, 3,23,388 warrants were allotted to promoters and 3,13,600 to non-promoters that have now lapsed. This disclosure is made in accordance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations.

announcements.subject: Nestle India Ltd - 500790 - Regulation 30 And Schedule III Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations'): Intimation Regarding The Addition Of A New Maggi Noodles Production Line At The Sanand Factory, Gujarat

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: On April 01, 2026, Nestlé India Ltd informed the stock exchanges about the addition of a new Maggi Noodles production line at its Sanand Factory in Gujarat. announcements.subject: Zuari Industries Ltd - 500780 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed herewith the Press release on "Zuari Industries'' SPE Division Records Highest-Ever Sugarcane Crushing in FY26".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Zuari Industries Limited's SPE Division has achieved a record sugarcane crushing of 159.7 lakh quintals in FY26, exceeding the previous FY25 record of 157.2 lakh quintals. This improvement is attributed to enhanced operational efficiency, higher capacity utilization, increased cane availability, and an earlier commencement of the crushing season. The company plans to extend crushing operations into April to gain a head start for FY27. This milestone underscores Zuari Industries' ongoing commitment to operational discipline within its Sugar, Power & Ethanol division.

announcements.subject: Yatra Online Ltd - 543992 - Disclosure Regarding Outcome Of Appeal Before CESTAT, Chandigarh
announcements.detail: Disclosure regarding Outcome of Appeal before CESTAT, Chandigarh
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Yatra Online Ltd has disclosed the outcome of an appeal before the Customs, Excise & Service Tax Appellate Tribunal (CESTAT), Chandigarh, which ruled in favor of the company and its subsidiary, TSI Yatra Pvt. Ltd. The CESTAT has set aside significant tax and penalty demands previously raised by the Revenue Department. For Yatra Online Limited, a total duty demand of approximately Rs.111.25 Crore (Rs.1,11,25,81,653/-) and penalties of approximately Rs.39.47 Crore (Rs.39,47,89,549/-) have been dropped. For TSI Yatra Pvt. Ltd., duty demands of approximately Rs.1.99 Crore (Rs.1,99,42,636/-) and penalties of approximately Rs.1.99 Crore (Rs.1,99,52,636/-) have also been set aside. The Tribunal held that incentives received from Computer Reservation System (CRS) companies are not subject to service tax. This order provides significant relief to the company regarding long-standing tax litigations.

announcements.subject: Advik Capital Ltd - 539773 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: SEBI Interim Findings in Elitecon and Update on Ongoing Judicial Proceedings New Delhi
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Advik Capital Limited has issued a media release regarding interim findings by SEBI in the Elitecon matter and an update on ongoing judicial proceedings. SEBI, through an Ex-Parte Interim Order dated March 30, 2026, has issued directions against Elitecon International Limited, its promoter, and connected persons for alleged regulatory violations. The order notes SEBI's prima facie observations regarding financial statement irregularities, misleading disclosures, changes in share capital and promoter shareholding, and abnormal price movements in Elitecon's scrip. Notably, SEBI has recorded the receipt of ₹64 crore by Advik Capital Limited through banking channels from Elitecon during August 2024, in line with Advik Capital's claim regarding a loan advanced to Elitecon. The legal nature and accounting treatment of this transaction remain sub-judice before the Hon’ble High Court of Delhi.

announcements.subject: Rushil Decor Ltd - 533470 - Intimation About Temporary Shutdown Due To Technological Upgradation At Manufacturing Unit, Mansa, Gujarat.
announcements.detail: Intimation about temporary shutdown due to Technological Upgradation at Manufacturing Unit, Mansa, Gujarat.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Rushil Decor Limited is undertaking a technological upgradation at its laminate sheet manufacturing unit in Mansa, Gujarat. The company will replace its existing steam boiler system with a Thermic Fluid Heater system, which is expected to improve fuel efficiency, reduce water consumption, enhance plant efficiency, and improve product quality and productivity. This upgrade will also enable automation and reduce manpower dependency. The plant will be temporarily shut down until approximately April 20, 2026, with an estimated loss of sale of Rs. 4 Crores during this period. The other two manufacturing units of the company will continue operations without interruption.

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Rain Industries Limited, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Rain Carbon Canada Inc., in collaboration with Green Graphite Technologies Inc., has successfully completed a project to advance the production of coated spherical purified graphite. This critical material is used in lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles, micromobility, and energy storage systems. The project received CA$682,000 in support from the Government of Ontario through the Ontario Vehicle Innovation Network (OVIN), out of a total project value of CA$2.05 million. This initiative aims to address the domestic supply gap for battery materials, as over 90% of battery-grade graphite is currently sourced from China. The collaboration leverages Green Graphite Technologies' purification technology and Rain Carbon Canada's expertise in carbon precursors and processing. This press release was issued on April 1, 2026.

announcements.subject:
NTPC Ltd - 532555 - Declaration Of COD Of Ayana Renewable Power Four Private
Limited, A Group Company Of NTPC Green Energy Limited
announcements.detail: Disclosure attached.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: NTPC Ltd. announced the declaration of the Commercial Operation Date (COD) for a portion of its group company's renewable energy projects. Specifically, the fourth part capacity of 37.5 MW Solar power from a 150 MW Solar Project in Gujarat achieved COD effective April 2nd, 2026. Additionally, the seventh part capacity of 13.2 MW Wind power from a 100 MW Hybrid Project (comprising 92.4 MW Wind and 37.5 MW Solar) in Gujarat also achieved COD effective April 2nd, 2026. announcements.subject: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd - 543530 - Disclosure Of Information Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Paradeep Phosphates Limited has successfully commissioned its 300 TPD Sulphuric Acid Plant at its Mangalore unit, effective March 31, 2026. The total expenditure incurred for this project is approximately Rs. 240 Crores, financed through internal accruals and term loans. This commissioning will enhance the company's captive sulphuric acid production, reducing import dependence and improving operational efficiency. The new capacity addition will increase the overall sulphuric acid capacity to 400 TPD. The project is expected to generate around 1,05,000 tonnes of high-pressure steam annually from waste heat, reducing CO2 emissions by 19,000 tonnes.

announcements.subject:
Ganesha Ecosphere Ltd - 514167 - Ministry Of Environment, Forest And Climate Change

announcements.subject: Dee Development Engineers Ltd - 544198 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: DEE Development Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange about the Outcome of the Order of Hon''ble PSERC revising the tariff for supply of electricity by its Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company M/s Malwa Power Private Limited from Rs. 3.50 per kWh to Rs. 5.227 per kWh with an annual escalation of 5% on variable tariff
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Dee Development Engineers Limited has received a final order from the Punjab State Electricity Regulatory Commission (PSERC) regarding the tariff determination for its wholly-owned subsidiary, M/s Malwa Power Private Limited (MPPL). The PSERC has determined the tariff for MPPL's 6 MW biomass-based power plant for an extended period of 10 years, following the expiry of its initial 20-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL). The new tariff is set at ₹5.224 per kWh for FY 2025-26, comprising a fixed tariff of ₹0.97/kWh and a variable tariff of ₹4.254/kWh with a 5% annual escalation. This revised tariff represents an enhancement of approximately ₹1.724 per kWh compared to the interim tariff of ₹3.50 per kWh previously received. Based on this revised tariff, the company estimates an additional revenue recovery of approximately ₹5.80 Crores to date. The order was dated March 27, 2026, and received by the company on June 1, 2026.

announcements.subject: Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd - 533155 - Renewal Of Master Franchise Agreement With Domino'S Pizza International Franchising Inc.
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed the intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR

The renewal was formalized on March 31, 2026, and the event occurred at 00:03 hours IST on April 1, 2026.

announcements.subject: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd - 543985 - Intimation Of Investor Release - Revenue Guidance For Financial Year 2026-27 (FY27)
announcements.detail: Revenue Guidance for FInancial year 2026-27 (FY27)
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited has provided its revenue guidance for the financial year 2026-27 (FY27). announcements.subject: IRB Infrastructure Developers Ltd - 532947 - Update In Relation To TOT-18 Project

announcements.subject: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Ltd - 541195 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: In terms of Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ,please find below press release titled "MIDHANI achieves highest ever sales amid supply chain disruptions.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Ltd (MIDHANI) has announced a record-breaking performance for the financial year 2025-2026, achieving its highest-ever sales of ₹1,206 Crores (provisional and unaudited). This represents a 12% year-on-year growth from the previous year's sales of ₹1,074 Crores, including export orders worth ₹85 Crores. Despite supply chain disruptions, strategic planning mitigated production impacts. Key growth drivers included supplies for indigenous aero-engine programs, the Indian Navy, and Indian space sectors. Notable achievements include CEMILAC and NADCAP certifications, a ~40% YoY increase in Titanium production, and the supply of Titanium alloy windows for Shri Ram Mandir, Ayodhya. MIDHANI also obtained technology transfer for manufacturing ABHED bullet proof jackets.

announcements.subject: Hemant Surgical Industries Ltd - 543916 - Execution Of Semi Knocked Down (SKD) Manufacturing Agreement With Sonomed Escalon, USA
announcements.detail: The Company has entered into Strategic Semi Knocked Down (SKD) Manufacturing Agreement with Sonomed Escalon, USA
announcements.ai_summary: Hemant Surgical Industries Ltd has entered into a strategic Semi Knocked Down (SKD) Manufacturing Agreement with Sonomed Escalon, USA, a global leader in ophthalmic diagnostic imaging. The purpose of this agreement is to undertake SKD manufacturing and further localize the production of ophthalmic ultrasound diagnostic devices in India for 100% manufacturing. Sonomed Escalon will supply components in SKD form at a preferential "Transfer Price," exclusive of taxes, duties, customs, statutory levies, and shipping unless otherwise agreed. The promoter was previously an authorized distributor for Sonomed Escalon.

announcements.subject: EID Parry India Ltd - 500125 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR), 2015
announcements.detail: Agreement entered into with the Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: EID Parry (India) Limited has announced the closure of operations of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Parry Sugars Refinery India Private Limited (PSRIPL), effective from the close of working hours on March 31, 2026. The decision was approved by the Boards of Directors of both companies. The refinery, established in 2006 as an export-oriented unit, faced challenges including non-availability of natural gas, increased operating costs due to coal boilers, a sharp decline in white premiums, reduced power export revenue, factory accidents, demurrage charges, inventory write-offs, hedge losses, and high finance costs. As of March 31, 2025, PSRIPL had accumulated losses of approximately Rs. 1,406 Crores, and the business is deemed unable to overcome current and potential challenges.

announcements.subject: Carborundum Universal Ltd - 513375 - Initiation Of Voluntary Winding Down Of The Step-Down Subsidiary Of The Company
announcements.detail: Enclosed intimation pertaining to initiation of voluntary winding down of step-down subsidiary of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Carborundum Universal Ltd has announced the initiation of the voluntary winding down of its step-down subsidiary, CUMI AWUKO Abrasives GmbH, Germany (CAAG). The decision was made by the Board of CUMI International Limited, Cyprus (CIL), the holding company of CAAG, on March 30, 2026, due to continued underperformance, mounting losses, and inability to turn around in prevailing market conditions. CAAG is engaged in manufacturing coated abrasives for wood and leather applications. The estimated financial impact arising from this winding down is between Rs. 110 crores to Rs. 130 crores, subject to change based on asset realization and obligations. CAAG is not considered a material subsidiary, and its winding down is not expected to adversely affect the Company’s business. All requisite legal steps under German law will be followed before the entity is wound down.

announcements.subject: Yash Highvoltage Ltd - 544310 - Reporting Of Cyber Fraud
announcements.detail: On the subject matter, a Intimation / Disclosure is sent herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Yash Highvoltage Ltd is reporting a cyber fraud incident involving orders for raw materials from a vendor in China. The company received an email purportedly from the exporter requesting a change in bank account details, which was confirmed through documentation. Subsequently, the company processed a payment to the revised account, and a partial shipment of materials was received. The fraud was discovered when the supplier reported non-receipt of funds. The estimated financial impact is Rs. 1.36 crore for the material received and Rs. 73.90 lacs for the non-receipt of material, totaling Rs. 2.10 crore. The company has initiated an internal investigation, is filing a formal complaint with regulatory authorities, and is evaluating solutions with its bankers for fund recovery. Yash Highvoltage Ltd has also stated that the partial shipment of material was successfully received on March 31, 2026, and the incident has no material impact on the company's operations. Corrective measures are being reviewed to strengthen internal processes.

announcements.subject: HCL Technologies Ltd - 532281 - Release - "Hcltech And Crowdstrike Expand Strategic Partnership With Aipowered Continuous Threat Exposure Management Services"
announcements.detail: Enclosed please find a release on the captioned subject being issued by the Company today.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: HCL Technologies Ltd. and CrowdStrike have expanded their strategic partnership by launching AI-powered Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) services. This joint offering aims to provide enterprises with continuous, intelligence-led identification, prioritization, and remediation of exposures across endpoints, cloud, identity, applications, and data. announcements.detail: Receipt of work order from Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation (APSSDC), Government of Andhra Pradesh.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: RNIT AI Solutions Limited has been awarded a Work Order by the Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation (APSSDC), Government of Andhra Pradesh. The order is for additional scope of work related to the design, development, integration, and deployment of an AI-Enabled Skill & Employment Enhancement Platform. This platform will be integrated into the existing "Naipunyam" Unified Skill Development Portal. The scope includes developing AI-powered modules for automated resume generation, conversational discovery for skill trainings, personalized assessment recommendations, automated job scraping, conversational job discovery, and a suitability index for career fitment analysis. The engagement also covers platform integration, quality testing, deployment, and ongoing support.

announcements.subject: IB Infotech Enterprises Ltd - 519463 - Intimation Pursuant To The Requirements Of Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("Listing Regulations").
announcements.detail:
Pursuant to the requirements of Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform you that Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held today i.e 31st March, 2026, have transacted the following business:
1) Approval for proposal for sub-division of shares.
2) Considered and recommended amendment to capital clause of Memorandum of Association.
3) Consider and recommended adoption of new set of Articles of Association.
announcements.ai_summary: IB Infotech Enterprises Ltd announced that its Board of Directors, in a meeting held on March 31, 2026, approved a proposal for the sub-division of shares. The company plans to sub-divide each equity share of face value Rs. 10/- into 10 equity shares of face value Re. 1/- each. This sub-division is subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot. announcements.subject: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd - 500103 - Rumour verification - Regulation 30(11)
announcements.detail: Rumour Verification regarding news item in https://economictimes.indiatimes.com
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd (BHEL) has clarified news regarding relaxations in land border norms for its tenders. The company confirms receipt of an Office Memorandum (OM) dated March 27, 2026, from the Department of Expenditure (DoE), Ministry of Finance, which grants BHEL a five-year relaxation under Rule 144(xi) of GFR for procuring 21 items from entities representing countries sharing land borders with India. BHEL states that no negotiations were taking place; however, a communication from DoE on December 31, 2025, sought details on items procured from non-land border sharing countries due to GFR rule 144(XI), to which BHEL provided inputs on January 6, 2026. The company is not aware of any other unannounced information that could explain trading movements and confirms there are no ongoing regulatory or legal proceedings.

announcements.detail:
The Company is pleased to announce the commissioning of additional new grinding capacity of 1.20 mtpa at its Aligarh Unit in Uttar Pradesh. With this commissioning, the total cement capacity of the Aligarh unit now stands at 1.95 mtpa.

Consequent to the above, the Company''s total grey cement manufacturing capacity stands at 5.60 mtpa.
announcements.ai_summary: Mangalam Cement Ltd has announced the commissioning of an additional new grinding capacity of 1.20 mtpa at its Aligarh Unit in Uttar Pradesh, effective March 31, 2026. Investors can anticipate potential benefits from increased production and improved operational efficiencies.

announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Patent Office, Government of India has granted the Patent for an invention to Insecticides (India) Limited entitled A SYNERGISTIC INSECTICIDAL COMBINATION OF DIAFENTHIURON AND ACETAMIPRID IN WETTABLE POWDER FORM AND A PROCESS OF PREPARING THE SAME for the term of 20 years from 23rd day of July 2013 (Date of Filing of Main Patent).

announcements.subject: PTC Industries Ltd - 539006 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: As enclosed.
announcements.ai_summary: PTC Industries Ltd, through its wholly owned subsidiary Aerolloy Technologies Limited, has completed the installation and successful trials of an advanced 4500/5100 Tonne Intelligent Open Die Forging System. This new system is located at the Strategic Materials Technology Complex in Lucknow and is capable of forging aerospace-grade materials such as Titanium and Superalloys. This acquisition significantly enhances Aerolloy's manufacturing capabilities, enabling the production of critical components for next-generation aeroengines, defence platforms, space systems, and industrial gas turbines. This development integrates melting (VIM), casting (VAR), and forging processes, creating a comprehensive aerospace manufacturing ecosystem. The company aims to capitalize on the multi-billion dollar global market for aerospace-grade forged components and promote import substitution, strengthening India's self-reliance.

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Sammaan Capital Limited announced on March 31, 2026, that International Holding Company PJSC (IHC), through its affiliate Avenir Investment RSC Ltd., will become the Promoter, acquiring a 41.5% stake via preferential allotment of equity shares and warrants. Sammaan Capital has received an initial tranche of INR 5,652 crores (USD ~600 million) for this allotment. announcements.subject: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Ltd - 543942 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (SEBI Listing Regulations)

announcements.ai_summary: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Ltd has completed the sale of its portfolio of unsecured stressed Microfinance Institution (MFI) loans. This transaction, which includes both Non-Performing Assets (NPAs) and written-off accounts, was finalized on March 31, 2026. The sale was conducted using the Swiss Challenge Method. Pool 1, comprising 2,92,030 accounts with an aggregate principal outstanding of ₹1,016.24 crore, was sold to Asset Reconstruction Company India Limited (ARCIL) for ₹133.10 crore. Pool 2, consisting of 1,36,832 accounts with an aggregate principal outstanding of ₹474.75 crore, was sold to Shriram Asset Reconstruction Private Limited (SARC) for ₹62.19 crore. This disclosure is in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

announcements.subject: Tata Communications Ltd - 500483 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Tata Communications Maintains A leader Position for 13th Straight Year in Gartner Magic Quadrant
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Communications has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global WAN Services for the 13th consecutive year. This recognition highlights their Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. The company has enhanced its network fabric with AI and analytics, offering composable, high-speed, and on-demand connectivity for global enterprises. Key advancements include expanding the network-on-demand portfolio with IZOTM DC Dynamic Connectivity and multi-cloud on-demand options, investing in 800G wavelength services for AI cloud infrastructure, and extending global coverage through strategic partner PoPs. They have also strengthened Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) capabilities and plan to offer quantum-safe encryption services leveraging Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithms.

announcements.subject:
NTPC Ltd - 532555 - Declaration Of COD Of NTPC Renewable Energy Limited, A
Stepdown Subsidiary Of NTPC Limited Through Its Subsidiary NTPC Green Energy Limited.
announcements.detail: Disclosure attached.
announcements.ai_summary: NTPC Ltd has announced the declaration of Commercial Operations Date (COD) for NTPC Renewable Energy Limited, a stepdown subsidiary. This declaration is made through its subsidiary, NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL). Specifically, the twelfth and final part capacity of 78.02 MW out of the 1255 MW Khavda-I Solar PV Project in Gujarat has achieved COD effective March 31, 2026. Additionally, the sixth part capacity of 90 MW out of the 1200 MW Khavda-II Solar PV Project in Gujarat also achieved COD on March 31, 2026. With these additions, the total installed capacity of the NTPC group now stands at 89,057 MW, and the commercial capacity is 87,977 MW.

announcements.subject: Max India Ltd - 543223 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release-Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)
announcements.ai_summary: Max India Ltd has announced a press release from its wholly owned subsidiary, Antara Assisted Care Services Limited (AACSL). The press release details the launch of AGEasy's new adult diaper pants featuring proprietary Smart Liquid Distribution™ technology. This in-house developed technology, currently awaiting patent grant, aims to address challenges such as sagging, leakage, and uneven absorption, offering up to 12 hours of protection with an anti-bacterial core. The product is designed specifically for seniors to enhance independence and dignity by addressing incontinence issues. AGEasy conducted extensive research to re-engineer existing adult hygiene products, which have historically fallen short in areas like leakage protection and fit. This innovation represents a significant step in improving the quality of life for seniors.

announcements.subject: Tata Chemicals Ltd - 500770 - Intimation Regarding Simplification Of The Holding Structure Of The UK Operations Of Tata Chemicals Limited
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed intimation regarding simplification of the holding structure of the UK operations of Tata Chemicals Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Tata Chemicals Limited announced on March 31, 2026, a simplification of its UK operations' holding structure. Effective March 30, 2026, Gusiute Holdings (UK) Limited (GHUL) transferred all its assets and investments to Homefield Pvt. UK Limited (HFUK). Consequently, GHUL has ceased to be a material subsidiary, and HFUK is now considered the material subsidiary. This restructuring aims to rationalize intermediate entities and simplify the group's holding structure without altering the ultimate ownership of the company over its UK subsidiaries.

announcements.subject: NTPC Green Energy Ltd - 544289 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: NTPC Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release titled "NTPC Renewable Energy Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL) Signed Green Ammonia Purchase Agreement (GAPA) with Solar Energy Corporation Limited (SECI) for supply of Green Ammonia."
announcements.ai_summary: NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL) announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, NTPC Renewable Energy Limited (NTPC REL), has signed a Green Ammonia Purchase Agreement (GAPA) with Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI). This agreement, executed on March 30, 2026, is for the supply of Green Ammonia under the SIGHT Scheme of the National Green Hydrogen Mission. Under the terms of the GAPA, NTPC REL will supply 70,000 MTPA of Green Ammonia to M/s Krishna Phoschem Limited, situated in Meghnagar, Madhya Pradesh. SECI will act as the intermediary procurer in this transaction. This development is a significant step for NGEL's Green Hydrogen and Green Ammonia portfolio, underscoring its dedication to India's decarbonization objectives.

announcements.subject: Bank of Baroda - 532134 - Clarification On News Item Appearing In Media/Publication

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Bank of Baroda has provided a clarification regarding a news item that appeared in the media. The bank's branch received an email on March 26, 2026, for a fund transfer from an MP Government savings account, but there was a mismatch in the available balance. A revised email was received later that day. On March 27, 2026, an email with an attached letter from the State Government Department was received for fund transfer on the same day, which was a holiday. After necessary arrangements and approvals, funds were remitted on March 27, 2026. The exercise price for each option is Rs. 790/-, with a vesting schedule starting after one year and vesting over the next four years in ratios of 20%, 20%, 25%, and 35%. The options can be exercised within a maximum period of four years from the vesting date, up to March 30, 2030.

announcements.subject: Simran Farms Ltd - 519566 - Board Meeting Outcome for Board Meeting Held On 30.03.2026

announcements.subject: Prime Focus Ltd - 532748 - Issuance Of Corporate Guarantee On Behalf Of Unlisted Material Subsidiary Of Company

announcements.subject: Cineline India Ltd - 532807 - Opening Of 2 - Screen Multiplex In Chennai, Tamil Nadu
announcements.detail: Opening of 2 - Screen Multiplex in Chennai, Tamil Nadu
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Cineline India Ltd has opened a new 2-screen multiplex under the brand name "MovieMax" in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. This is the company's first cinema in the state and expands its portfolio to 85 operational screens across 22 properties and 16 cities. The multiplex is located in Prince Ratnapuri Garden Residency, Walltax Road, Kondithope, Chennai, and features 452 seats, 4K laser projection systems, next-generation 3D capabilities, and Dolby sound systems. It also offers an enhanced F&B experience with a pure vegetarian menu and a live kitchen concept. The CEO, Ashish Kanakia, stated that this launch strengthens their pan-India presence and caters to evolving cinema audience preferences.

announcements.subject: Black Box Ltd - 500463 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed herewith Press Release on completion of Preferential Issue.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Black Box Limited has successfully completed a preferential issue, receiving ₹386.36 crore through the conversion of warrants. These 92,65,215 warrants were converted into equity shares at a price of ₹417 per share. All warrant holders fully exercised their rights, indicating strong investor confidence. The promoters contributed ₹200 crore, representing 51.76% of the total funds raised, and their shareholding now stands at 69.99%. This infusion of capital will strengthen the company's balance sheet and support its growth strategy.

announcements.subject: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Ltd - 543895 - Award Of Contract For Helicopter Shuttle Services By Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority
announcements.detail: Intimation is enclosed herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: United Helicharters Private Limited (UHPL), a subsidiary of Exhicon Events Media Solutions Limited, has been awarded a contract for operating helicopter shuttle services in Uttarakhand by the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority. This award is based on a Letter of Award dated March 28, 2026, for the Mandakini Valley to Shri Kedarnath Ji Route. UHPL emerged as the L1 (Lowest) bidder after successfully qualifying at the technical evaluation stage, competing against established operators like Pawan Hans Limited and others. This contract is expected to enhance the company's presence in the aviation and pilgrimage logistics sector and contribute positively to its operational and financial performance.

announcements.subject: Aries Agro Ltd - 532935 - Aries Agro Limited Has Appointed Mr. Sourav Ganguly As Brand Ambassador Of The Company For A Period Of 3 (Three) Years.

announcements.subject: JSW Steel Ltd - 500228 - Update On 50:50 Joint Venture Between JSW Steel Limited And JFE Steel Corporation, Japan For The Steel Business Of Bhushan Power And Steel Limited
announcements.detail: Update on 50:50 Joint Venture between JSW Steel Limited and JFE Steel Corporation, Japan for the Steel Business of BPSL.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: JSW Steel Limited and JFE Steel Corporation of Japan have provided an update on their 50:50 joint venture for the steel business of Bhushan Power and Steel Limited. JFE Steel Corporation has invested Rs 7,875 crores as the first tranche, resulting in the allotment of 2,26,94,524 equity shares of JSW Kalinga Steel Limited to JFE, giving them a 25% shareholding on a fully diluted basis. Consequently, JSW Steel and JFE have established joint control over JSW Kalinga and its subsidiary, JSW Sambalpur Steel Limited, as of March 30, 2026. The acquisition of an additional 25% stake by JFE for Rs 7,875 crores is expected to be completed as per the Joint Venture Agreement.

announcements.company: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd
announcements.subject: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd - 500312 - Monetisation Of DUDP Project
announcements.detail: Monetisation of DUDP Project
announcements.ai_summary: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd (ONGC) has announced the successful monetization of its Daman Upside Development Project (DUDP) in the western offshore. The project achieved a significant milestone on March 29, 2026, with the commencement of gas flow from Platform B-12-24P to the Hazira Plant. This project, with a capital expenditure of approximately USD 1 billion, was executed in less than two years from its award date, highlighting strong project execution and innovative practices. Production from all wells will be progressively ramped up. This update marks the beginning of gas monetization from the DUDP.

announcements.subject: Signatureglobal (India) Ltd - 543990 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting

This transaction is being executed through a Business Transfer Agreement, Joint Development Agreement, and other related documents. Concurrently, the Board also approved the sale of 35,69,731 equity shares of GCL, held by Signatureglobal (India) Ltd, to Millennia Realtors Private Limited (RMZ) at Rs. 158.84 per share, aggregating to approximately Rs. 56.70 crores. Upon this share transfer, GCL will no longer be a wholly-owned subsidiary of Signatureglobal (India) Ltd. This follows a previous disclosure on February 14, 2026, regarding RMZ's potential acquisition of 50% of GCL's share capital.

announcements.subject: P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd - 544256 - Intimation Of Store Opening
announcements.detail: Intimation of store opening
announcements.ai_summary: Deepak Builders & Engineers India Limited has emerged as the L1 bidder for a significant construction project. The company will be responsible for building 12 high-rise residential buildings, each with G+13 floors, utilizing monolithic construction technology. This project also includes the development of associated parking facilities, a sewerage treatment plant, utility infrastructure, and roadworks, all adjacent to the existing Panipat Refinery & Petrochemical Complex Township of IOCL in Haryana. The total project value for this package is Rs.474.25 crores. Upon the formal award of this project, Deepak Builders & Engineers India Limited's total value of projects in hand will increase to approximately Rs. 2,000 Crores.

announcements.subject: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Ltd - 543989 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations
announcements.ai_summary: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Ltd's Audit Committee and Board of Directors, in their meetings on March 29, 2026, approved an extension for the utilization of balance IPO proceeds. The company raised ₹566.23 Crore (net of expenses) through its IPO, with an original utilization timeline up to March 31, 2026. The extension is primarily due to optimization in capital utilization and savings. As of March 28, 2026, ₹39.86 Crore remained unutilized, with ₹19.19 Crore for new stores and ₹20.67 Crore for warehouse expansion. The company has already exceeded its targeted retail footprint and is in discussions for a strategic warehouse location in Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu.

announcements.company: Deepak Builders and Engineers India Ltd
announcements.subject: Deepak Builders and Engineers India Ltd - 544276 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

announcements.ai_summary: Deepak Builders & Engineers India Limited has emerged as the lowest (L1) bidder for a residential project valued at ₹474.25 crore at the Indian Oil Panipat Refinery Township in Haryana. The project involves constructing 12 high-rise residential buildings with advanced monolithic construction technology, including parking, sewerage treatment plant, and internal roads. Upon formal award, the company's total order book is expected to reach approximately ₹32,000 crore, enhancing its revenue visibility. This L1 status highlights the company's capabilities in executing large-scale infrastructure projects for marquee clients.

announcements.subject: Setco Automotive Ltd - 505075 - Board Meeting Outcome for Intimation Under Regulation 30 Read With Schedule III Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations') And Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On March 28, 2026
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations') and Outcome of the Board Meeting held on March 28, 2026

announcements.subject: EPL Ltd - 500135 - Board Meeting Outcome for Scheme Of Amalgamation Of Indovida India Private Limited With EPL Limited And Their Respective Shareholders
announcements.detail: We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company has, at its meeting held today i.e. on March 29, 2026, inter alia considered and approved the Scheme of amalgamation (by way of merger by absorption) of Indovida India Private Limited with EPL Limited and their respective shareholders ('Scheme'), along with the execution of requisite agreements in relation to the Scheme, details of which are enclosed as a part of the intimation.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: EPL Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on March 29, 2026, has approved a Scheme of Amalgamation by way of merger by absorption of Indovida India Private Limited with EPL Limited and their respective shareholders. This merger will be executed on a going concern basis under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The consideration for the merger will be the issuance and allotment of equity shares of EPL Limited to the shareholders of Indovida India, based on a stipulated share exchange ratio. The merger is subject to various statutory and regulatory approvals, including from the Stock Exchanges, SEBI, shareholders and creditors of both companies, the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), and the Competition Commission of India (CCI).

announcements.subject: Midwest Gold Ltd - 526570 - Board Meeting Outcome for Allotment Of Equity Shares On Preferential Basis
announcements.detail: Allotment of equity shares on Preferential basis
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Midwest Gold Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on March 29, 2026, approved the allotment of 4,50,750 equity shares at a price of Rs. 2,000 per share on a preferential basis. announcements.subject: NLC India Ltd - 513683 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 And 51 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Please refer attachment.
announcements.ai_summary: NLC India Limited has announced the commencement of coal production from the Pachwara South Open Cast Project on March 29, 2026. This coal block, located in Dumka District, Jharkhand, was allotted to the company by the Ministry of Coal on October 3, 2016, and has an estimated extractable coal reserve of 264.84 million tonnes with a normative mining capacity of 9 million tonnes per annum. Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Limited, where NLC India Limited holds a 51% equity stake. Overburden removal for the project had commenced on December 19, 2025.

announcements.subject: HealthCare Global Enterprises Ltd - 539787 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements

announcements.subject: Coal India Ltd - 533278 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order

announcements.subject: Som Distilleries & Breweries Ltd - 507514 - Update On License Suspension - Disclosure / Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015
announcements.detail: Update on License Suspension - Disclosure/intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulation
announcements.ai_summary: Som Distilleries & Breweries Limited provided an update on its license suspension, stating that there has been no change in the status since their press release on February 5, 2026. The company's petition seeking validation of the license was not favorably considered by the Single Bench of the Hon’ble Madhya Pradesh High Court on March 23, 2026. Subsequently, on March 24, 2026, the company approached the Double Bench, which granted relief by permitting their associate company to participate in the country liquor tender process. The final order in this matter is still awaited. The company is making all necessary efforts to resolve the deadlock and will promptly communicate any material developments.

announcements.subject: Ram Ratna Wires Ltd-$ - 522281 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations') - Capacity Addition

announcements.subject: Oberoi Realty Ltd - 533273 - Execution Of Development Agreement In Respect Of Lands Situated At Peddar Road, Mumbai
announcements.detail: Execution of Development Agreement in respect of lands situated at Peddar Road, Mumbai

The agreement is with two adjacent housing societies located on M.L. Dahanukar Marg and Dr. G. Deshmukh Marg. The total land area involved in this redevelopment project is approximately 4,800 square meters, subject to set-back areas. The company's estimated entitlement of free sale component from this project is up to 1.40 lakh square feet (RERA Carpet area). This entitlement is subject to the provisions of the Development Control & Promotion Regulations for Greater Mumbai, 2034, and other applicable laws. This development agreement signifies a strategic expansion of the company's real estate portfolio in a prime Mumbai location.

announcements.subject: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd - 544232 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI(LODR) Regulations,2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI(LODR) Regulations,2015
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd announced that its shareholders approved key resolutions via postal ballot on March 27, 2026. The company is now proceeding with the necessary steps to implement these shareholder-approved decisions.

announcements.detail: Intimation under regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015

announcements.subject: Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd - 533155 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations') - Business Update
announcements.detail: Please find attached Intimation regarding Business Update
announcements.ai_summary: Jubilant FoodWorks Limited has issued a business update regarding supply constraints on commercial LPG distribution across India due to the ongoing geopolitical situation in the Middle East. This has led to a constrained supply of LPG cylinders to certain parts of the company's store network, although the operational impact is currently limited and being actively managed. The company is implementing measures to conserve LPG and is transitioning to alternative energy sources such as electricity and piped natural gas (PNG). Jubilant FoodWorks is in continuous dialogue with oil marketing companies to stay informed about the evolving situation and to adapt its operational strategies accordingly. The company emphasizes its resilient systems and processes to manage short-term operational challenges.

announcements.subject: NTPC Green Energy Ltd - 544289 - NTPC Green Energy Limited Has Informed The Exchange About Declaration Of Commercial Operation Of Third And Last Part Capacity Of 75 MW Out Of 500 MW Bhadla Solar PV Project Located In Phalodi, Rajasthan Of NTPC Renewable Energy Limited, A Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of NTPC Green Energy Limited, Is Declared On Commercial Operation W.E.F. 25.03.2026.

This project is undertaken by NTPC Renewable Energy Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of NTPC Green Energy Limited. The commercial operation is effective from March 25, 2026. announcements.subject: Adf Foods Ltd-$ - 519183 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR - Commencement Of Commercial Production.
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 w.r.t. Commencement of Commercial Production at the Company''s new Green Field manufacturing facility at Surat.
announcements.ai_summary: ADF Foods Limited has commenced commercial production at its new Greenfield manufacturing facility located at Gujarat Agro Infrastructure Mega Food Park, Mangrol, Surat. This commencement of production took place on March 28, 2026. The new facility has a potential installed capacity of 10,000 MT per annum and involved an investment of approximately Rs. 90 crore in Phase 1. This expansion is intended to cater to both international and domestic markets, aiming to strengthen the company's production capabilities, improve operational efficiencies, and support future growth plans. The information has been made available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd - 544209 - Announcemnt Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Bansal Wire Industries Limited has informed the exchange regarding temporary disruption in supply of natural gas to our manufacturing facilities due to prevaling geopolitical situation
announcements.ai_summary: Bansal Wire Industries Limited has informed the stock exchanges about a temporary disruption in the supply of natural gas to its manufacturing facilities. This disruption is a consequence of ongoing geopolitical tensions in the West Asian region, leading to restrictions from Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) due to a force majeure situation. As a result, the company's production capacity has been impacted by 35% since mid-March. Bansal Wire Industries Limited is implementing measures such as enhancing the operationalization of electric furnaces and using alternative heating systems to mitigate the impact and ensure operational continuity. The company is coordinating with natural gas distribution partners and relevant authorities to restore affected production capacity and minimize adverse financial effects.

announcements.subject: Urban Company Ltd - 544515 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release titled- Urban Company''s ''Instahelp'' Crosses 1 Million Monthly Delivered Bookings; Becomes Fastest-Growing Vertical in Company History"
announcements.ai_summary: Urban Company Limited announced that its quick-service housekeeping vertical, InstaHelp, has achieved over 1 million monthly delivered bookings as of March 28, 2026, making it the fastest-growing vertical in the company's history. This milestone follows the reporting of over 50,000 daily orders in February 2026. InstaHelp is currently operational in Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, and Pune, offering services like cleaning, dishwashing, laundry, and meal preparation within 10-15 minutes of booking. The company's CEO & Co-founder, Abhiraj Singh Bhal, highlighted the strong consumer trust in the platform for immediate, everyday needs. Urban Company Limited is a technology-driven platform connecting customers with professionals for home and beauty services.

announcements.subject: Bharti Hexacom Ltd - 544162 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

announcements.subject: Crizac Ltd - 544439 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

announcements.subject: Thermax Ltd - 500411 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

Through this agreement, Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited will sell 10% of the equity stake in ATPL, representing 5,000 equity shares of INR 10 each, to Itochu Corporation for an aggregate consideration of INR 80,32,00,000 (Indian Rupees Eighty Crores Thirty Two lakhs Only). announcements.subject: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd - 524715 - Updates On Fibromun And Nidlegy
announcements.detail: Updates on Fibromun and Nidlegy
announcements.ai_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has provided clinical updates on its drug candidates, Fibromun and Nidlegy, from its partner Philogen. The Phase II FLASH study for Fibromun in soft tissue sarcoma did not meet its primary endpoint for Progression Free Survival (PFS). Similarly, the Phase II GLIOSTAR trial for glioblastoma also did not meet its primary endpoint, although an improvement in survival was observed in a subgroup of patients with limited exposure to alkylating agents. The company remains committed to the GLIOSUN trial for treatment-naïve glioblastoma patients, which is initiating its dose expansion phase, and the GLIOSTELLA study, which is expected to report survival data in September 2026. Following encouraging signals from the FIBROSARC study, a request for Parallel Scientific Advice with the FDA and EMA has been submitted to define the design of a new Phase III registrational study, FIBROSARC-2, planned to start in the second quarter of 2026.

The allotment was made to eligible shareholders and/or renouncee(s) at a price of Rs. 512 per Equity Share, which includes a premium of Rs. 502 per Equity Share. This decision was made by the Rights Issue Committee at its meeting held on March 27, 2026. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased from Rs. 141,00,76,370 (14,10,07,637 shares) to Rs. 149,30,22,030 (14,93,02,203 shares).

announcements.subject:
Reliance Communications Ltd - 532712 - Intimation In Accordance With Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of
India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation in accordance with Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations 2015 related to Central Bureau of Investigation visit on 26th March 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Reliance Communications Limited has informed the exchanges that officials from the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) conducted a search and seizure operation at the office premises of Reliance Telecom Limited (RTL), a wholly owned subsidiary of the company. The operation took place on March 26, 2026, at RTL's office located in Navi Mumbai. The company and RTL are continuing to operate their businesses as usual. This disclosure is made in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Titagarh Rail Systems Ltd - 532966 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting held today i.e. 27th March, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: The Board of Directors of Titagarh Rail Systems Limited (TRSL) met on March 27, 2026, and approved the sale of its entire 100% shareholding in Titagarh Singapore Pte. Limited (TSPL), a wholly owned subsidiary. This sale is subject to necessary approvals and is governed by the terms of a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) dated March 27, 2026, executed with Worldvmc Singapore Pte. Limited (WSPL). TSPL, incorporated in 2008 for overseas business expansion, has remained dormant and is not part of TRSL's current strategic vision. Upon completion, TSPL will cease to be a subsidiary of TRSL.

announcements.subject: Markolines Pavement Technologies Ltd - 543364 - General Updates As To Scheme Of Amalgamation Documents Filed By The Company.
announcements.detail: General updates as to Scheme of Amalgamation documents filed by the Company with BSE and NSE
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has provided an update regarding its Scheme of Amalgamation with Markolines Infra Limited. The company has filed the necessary documents with both the BSE and NSE. In a clarification, the company corrected an inadvertent clerical error in its previous board meeting outcome dated March 6, 2026. Sobhagya Capital Options Private Limited, a SEBI registered Category I Merchant Banker, has issued a fairness opinion stating that the Share Exchange Ratio is financially fair. The name Aftertrade Broking Private Limited was mistakenly mentioned instead of Sobhagya Capital Options Private Limited.

announcements.subject: Suditi Industries Ltd - 521113 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation30 of SEBI(LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to update that the Company has successfully completed the acquisition of 50% equity shareholding in SAA & Suditi Retail Private Limited. Consequent to this acquisition,  SAA & Suditi Retail Private Limited has become wholly owned subsidiary of Suditi Industries Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Suditi Industries Limited has successfully completed the acquisition of 50% equity shareholding in SAA & Suditi Retail Private Limited. This acquisition was made from Project Anushka Sharma Lifestyles Private Limited on an arm's length basis, based on an independent valuation report. As a result of this transaction, SAA & Suditi Retail Private Limited has now become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Suditi Industries Limited. The acquired entity is involved in the manufacturing of all types of textile garments and clothing accessories.

announcements.subject: Swan Corp Ltd - 503310 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of LODR Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Issuance of Corporate Guarantee
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Swan Corp Limited has issued a Corporate Guarantee amounting to Rs. 72.57 Crores (Rupees Seventy Two Crores and Fifty Seven Lakhs). This guarantee is provided to secure the repayment obligation of Swan LNG Private Limited, a subsidiary company. The issuance of this guarantee does not have an immediate pecuniary impact on Swan Corp Limited. The transaction is being conducted at arm's length, with Swan LNG Private Limited being a subsidiary of Swan Corp Limited.

announcements.subject: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd - 543596 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - "Opening Of New Branches"
announcements.detail: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding "Opening of New Branches"
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Limited has announced the opening of three new branches. The branches will be located in Ballari, Karnataka; Anand, Gujarat; and Pandalkudi, Tamil Nadu. The Ballari branch is scheduled to open on March 30, 2026. The opening dates for the Anand and Pandalkudi branches are not explicitly stated but are implied to be around the same period. This expansion aims to increase the bank's reach and customer service points.

announcements.subject: Saatvik Green Energy Ltd - 544526 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Receipt of Order
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Saatvik Green Energy Limited's material subsidiary, Saatvik Solar Industries Private Limited, has secured a new order valued at INR 14.48 Crores. This order is from a renowned Independent Power producer/EPC Player for the supply of Solar PV Modules. The order is for a domestic entity and is commercial in nature. The execution of this order is expected to be completed by March 2026. This development signifies a new business opportunity for the company in the solar energy sector.

announcements.subject: P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd - 544256 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Intimation of Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited has announced the launch of its new store in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, on March 27, 2026. This marks the 76th overall store for the brand and its 4th store in Uttar Pradesh. The new store, located in a prime retail area, is 6000 sq ft and features a wide range of gold, diamond, and bridal jewellery, including collections like Saptam, Katha, Pratha, Eiina, and Polmi. This expansion is aimed at intensifying the company's retail strength in Central India.

announcements.subject: G R Infraprojects Ltd - 543317 - G R Infraprojects Limited Has Emerged As L-1 Bidder For A Project.
announcements.detail: G R Infraprojects Limited has emerged as L-1 Bidder for a project.
