announcements.detail: Technocraft Industries (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about closure of fabric division located at Murbad
announcements.ai_summary: Technocraft Industries (India) Limited has decided to discontinue the manufacturing operations of its Fabric Division located at Murbad, District Thane, Maharashtra, effective July 20, 2026. This decision stems from adverse market conditions and prolonged losses incurred by the division, with turnover figures of ₹125.83 crore in 2025-26, ₹172.84 crore in 2024-25, and ₹161.65 crore in 2023-24, and losses after depreciation before tax of ₹2.86 crore, ₹6.23 crore, and ₹10.73 crore respectively for the same periods. Consequently, the Fabric Segment will no longer be present in the standalone financial statements. However, the Garment business will continue through its subsidiary, Technocraft Fashions Limited, and the Yarn Division will also continue its operations.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Salasar Exteriors And Contour Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 20, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Salasar Exteriors and Contour Limited held a Board of Directors meeting on July 20, 2026, where it was decided to discontinue the company's Corporate Office located at Unit No 503, 6th Avenue Mithakali Six Road, Above SBI Bank, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, effective from July 20, 2026. This administrative decision was made to enhance operational efficiency and optimize resources, and it will not interrupt business operations. All statutory records, including books of account, will be transferred to and maintained at the Registered Office of the Company. The board meeting commenced at 03:00 P.M. and concluded at 03:40 P.M.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Krishca Strapping Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 20, 2026, titled "Krishca's Strategic Investment by acquiring 50.05% Stake in Manda Stainless Private Limited".
announcements.ai_summary: Krishca Strapping Solutions Limited announced on July 20, 2026, that its Board of Directors has approved the acquisition of a 50.05% controlling stake in Manda Stainless Private Limited for a cash consideration of ₹7,36,02,950. This acquisition involves purchasing 73,60,295 equity shares and is a strategic move to expand the company's presence in value-added specialty steel products. Through Manda Stainless, Krishca Strapping Solutions Limited will establish a 36,000 TPA stainless steel cold rolling facility near Vapi, Gujarat, with commercial production targeted from February 2027, subject to project implementation. The transaction is expected to be completed on or before July 31, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. This investment aligns with Krishca's long-term strategy for growth in the specialty steel sector.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Sammaan Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Further to our intimation dated July 15, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, we wish to inform you that the Securities Issuance and Investment Committee (the  Committee ) of Sammaan Capital Limited (the  Company ), in its meeting held on July 20, 2026, has approved the (i) offer to purchase for cash, upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Tender Offer Memorandum, in an aggregate principal amount up to U.S.$ 18,000,000 of the amount outstanding in relation to the U.S.$ 350,000,000 9.70% Senior Secured Social Bonds due 2027 issued by the Company (the  Bonds  and such offer, the  Tender Offer );  (ii) tender offer memorandum to be issued to the bondholders of the Bonds ( Tender Offer Memorandum ) expected to be dated on or around the date of this announcement; (iii) the dealer manager agreement dated July 20, 2026 ( Dealer Manager Agreement ) to be entered into between the Company and the dealer manager; (iv) engagement letter with the Information and Tender agent dated July 20, 2026, (v) the commencement of the Tender Offer subject to the conditions set forth in the Tender Offer Memorandum, issued by the Company; and (vi) any other documents that may be required to be executed, in relation to the Tender Offer". For details refer attached PDF.
announcements.ai_summary: Sammaan Capital Limited's Securities Issuance and Investment Committee, in a meeting held on July 20, 2026, approved a tender offer to purchase for cash up to U.S.$18,000,000 of its outstanding U.S.$350,000,000 9.70% Senior Secured Social Bonds due 2027. This tender offer is part of the company's liability management program aimed at rebalancing obligations, aligning maturities, and reducing the cost of funds. The company will issue a tender offer memorandum, expected around the announcement date, and has entered into a dealer manager agreement and an engagement letter with the information and tender agent, both dated July 20, 2026. The commencement of the tender offer is subject to the conditions outlined in the tender offer memorandum. Sammaan Capital Limited intends to continue evaluating and undertaking buybacks of its USD-denominated bonds to optimize its overall cost of funds, supported by its improving credit ratings.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Intellect Design Arena Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 20, 2026, titled "Press Release - Intellect Design Arena launches Credit Union Solution Suite, purpose-built for credit unions and mutuals globally".
announcements.ai_summary: Intellect Design Arena Limited has announced the global launch of its Credit Union Solution Suite on July 20, 2026. This comprehensive, AI-first suite is specifically designed for the unique technology requirements of credit unions and mutuals worldwide. It unifies core banking, AI-powered lending, and digital engagement on a single, composable platform built on the eMACH.ai architecture. The suite is engineered for member-centric institutions focused on sustainable growth. Intellect Design Arena's domain knowledge, serving over 90 credit unions, is embedded within this solution, allowing institutions to modernize at their own pace without disruptive "big-bang" migrations.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Fortis Healthcare Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 20, 2026, titled "Agilus Diagnostics Limited(Subsidiary of the Company) Appoints Vijender Singh as Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer".
announcements.ai_summary: Fortis Healthcare Limited has announced a press release dated July 20, 2026, regarding its subsidiary, Agilus Diagnostics Limited. Agilus Diagnostics has appointed Mr. Vijender Singh as its new Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer, effective July 20, 2026. This appointment follows the resignation of Dr. Anand K. Mr. Singh brings over three decades of leadership experience in the diagnostics, healthcare, consumer healthcare, and FMCG sectors, with a proven track record in business scaling and operational excellence. He has previously held leadership positions at Diagnum Healthcare, Metropolis Healthcare, Healthians, and Dr. Lal PathLabs.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Tata Elxsi Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015'.
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Elxsi Limited has received an order under Section 250 of the Income Tax Act, 1961, from the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) on July 20, 2026. This order pertains to the company's appeal against a penalty levied under Section 271(1) of the Income Tax Act, amounting to Rs. 67,29,774/-. The total order amount is Rs. 67,29,774/-. The company is currently reviewing the order and will take appropriate action as required. Based on a preliminary assessment, this order is not expected to have any material financial impact on the company.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Anant Raj Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Anant Raj Limited's Finance and Investment Committee, in a meeting held on July 20, 2026, approved an additional investment in its wholly-owned subsidiary, Ashok Cloud Private Limited (ACPL). The company will acquire an additional 37,43,22,553 fully paid-up equity shares of ACPL at a face value of Rs. 2/- per share, aggregating to Rs. 74,86,45,106. This investment is part of a right issue by ACPL. Following this transaction, ACPL's paid-up equity share capital will increase to Rs. 74,91,45,106, comprising 37,45,72,553 equity shares. Anant Raj Limited's shareholding in ACPL will increase to 37,45,72,553 equity shares, maintaining its 100% ownership and voting rights.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Blue Jet Healthcare Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release  Blue Jet Healthcare Limited has been awarded with Silver Medal by  EcoVadis'.
announcements.ai_summary: Blue Jet Healthcare Limited has been awarded a Silver Medal by EcoVadis for its outstanding sustainability management practices. This recognition covers areas such as Environment, Labor and Human Rights, Ethics, and Sustainable Procurement. The Silver Medal places Blue Jet Healthcare amongst the top 15% of companies globally, achieving a 90th percentile ranking in sustainability performance. The company achieved an EcoVadis Sustainability Score of 77 out of 100. This award signifies significant progress in strengthening their environmental, social, ethical, and governance (ESG) practices across operations, building upon their previous EcoVadis Committed Badge.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Chemplast Sanmar Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: Chemplast Sanmar Limited has received a Prohibition Order from the Chief Inspector of Factories, Puducherry, dated 19th July, 2026. This order prohibits further usage and operation of the Ethylene-Di-Chloride (EDC) manufacturing plant at their Karaikal facility, following a fire incident on July 17, 2026. The company is required to obtain a Revoke order after complying with all directives issued under the prohibition order. Chemplast Sanmar is undertaking necessary corrective actions and is in the process of submitting a compliance report with an action plan for the revocation of the order. The company is currently ascertaining the financial and operational impact of this incident.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Indian Overseas Bank has informed the Exchange regarding 'Security Cover Certificate' for the quarter ended 30.06.2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Overseas Bank has submitted its Security Cover Certificate for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026, as per Regulation 54(2)/(3) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The bank has provided a NIL Security Cover Certificate, indicating that all its outstanding listed non-convertible debt securities are of an unsecured nature. This disclosure is in compliance with SEBI regulations and the relevant circulars. The certificate has been issued by R. DEVENDRA & ASSOCIATES, Chartered Accountants, and is intended for dissemination to the stock exchanges and debenture trustees.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited emerges as the Lowest Bidder (L1) from East Central Railway - Normal course of business of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) has emerged as the Lowest Bidder (L1) from East Central Railway for a significant project. The contract involves the construction of doubling work, including earthwork, blanketing, minor and major bridges, station and other buildings, platform work, LC work, and other miscellaneous works for 25T Indian Railway Standard Loading. This project spans from Kundawa Chainpur (excl.) to Raxaul (excl.), covering a total of 41.04 km, in connection with the doubling of the Sitamarhi-Raxaul section in Samastipur Division of East Central Railway. The execution period for this Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) tender is 1095 Days. This award is considered a normal course of business for the company.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Swastik Pipe Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: Swastik Pipe Limited has received a formal legal notice on July 16, 2026, from the Debt Recovery Tribunal (DRT), Chandigarh, initiated by Canara Bank, a consortium member. This notice is part of the company's ongoing negotiations with lenders regarding its Non-Performing Asset (NPA) status. The company clarified that the notice is procedural and that active settlement dialogues are underway with the Lead Bank, State Bank of India (SBI), and other consortium partners. Swastik Pipe Limited is seeking legal counsel to respond to the DRT notice within the stipulated timeframe while prioritizing an amicable debt resolution.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Mahindra Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 20, 2026, titled "Mahindra Logistics Ltd. Q1 F27 Revenue up by 23% YoY at Rs. 2,003 cr, PAT at Rs 25.4 cr".
announcements.ai_summary: Mahindra Logistics Limited announced its unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, in a press release dated July 20, 2026. The company reported a revenue of Rs. 2,003 crore, a 23% year-on-year (YoY) increase and a 12% quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) increase. EBITDA stood at Rs. 115 crore, up 51% YoY and 3% QoQ. Profit After Tax (PAT) was Rs. 25.4 crore, showing improvement for the fourth consecutive quarter, compared to Rs. (10.8) crore in Q1 F26 and Rs. 20.2 crore in Q4 F26. Diluted Earnings Per Share (EPS) was Rs. 2.55, up from Rs. (1.44) in Q1 F26. The Contract Logistics Business grew 26% YoY with a 31% EBITDA growth, and the Express Business grew 58% YoY. These results were approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on July 20, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Womancart Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 20, 2026, titled "Launch of Technology-Enabled Quick Delivery Platform with Real-Time Order Tracking".
announcements.ai_summary: Womancart Limited has launched a technology-enabled Quick Delivery Platform with real-time order tracking, aiming to enhance customer experience through faster deliveries and complete order visibility. This platform integrates a real-time GPS tracking system, allowing customers to monitor their orders live on a map from dispatch to delivery. The system provides live status updates and dynamic Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) based on the delivery partner's location. Initially launched in Delhi and Jaipur, Womancart Limited intends to progressively expand this service based on customer response and operational readiness. This initiative aims to offer customers a seamless shopping experience with increased transparency, convenience, and reliability.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Release:  HCLTech named a Customers  Choice in 2026 Gartner® Peer Insights  Voice of the Customer for Outsourced Digital Workplace Services .
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Limited has been recognized as a Customers’ Choice in the 2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer report for Outsourced Digital Workplace Services. This marks the third consecutive year HCL Tech has received this accolade for its services. The company achieved a 97% willingness-to-recommend score, based on 42 verified customer reviews as of February 28, 2026. Customers rated HCL Tech highly across key engagement stages, with Service Capabilities, Sales Experience, and Execution Experience each receiving a score of 4.8 out of 5, and Transition Experience rated at 4.7 out of 5. HCL Tech was also named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Outsourced Digital Workplace Services for the fifth consecutive time since 2022.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: D. P. Abhushan Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Opening of Jewellery Showroom at Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh under Franchisee Owned Company Operated (FOCO) Model'.
announcements.ai_summary: D. P. Abhushan Limited's Board of Directors has approved the opening of a jewellery showroom in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, operating under the Franchisee Owned Company Operated (FOCO) model. This initiative represents the company's first expansion using the FOCO model, a significant step in its retail growth strategy. The proposed showroom will have an approximate retail area of 3,750 square feet. The company believes this franchisee model will facilitate expansion into new markets with an asset-light approach, strengthen its brand presence, and improve customer outreach. The expected date for the commencement of operations is under finalization.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has informed the Exchange about Publication of Case Studies.
announcements.ai_summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has announced the publication of case studies authored by its research professionals, including the Managing Director and senior consultants. These case studies, focusing on Ayurvedic research and evidence-based clinical practice, have been published in the "International Journal of Advanced Research (IJAR)". Two specific case studies are highlighted: "Ayurvedic Management of Chronic Kidney Disease (Vrikka Vikara) with Reference to Mutravah Sroto Dushti: A Case Study" and "Role of Ayurveda in The Management of Vrikka Vikar (Kidney Disorders): A Case Study". Links to these publications are available on the company's website, www.jeenasikho.com.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: D. P. Abhushan Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''Opening of Company owned Showroom in Dahod, Gujarat"
announcements.ai_summary: D. P. Abhushan Limited's Board of Directors has approved the opening of a new company-owned jewellery showroom in Dahod, Gujarat. This expansion is part of the company's retail strategy and will be its first showroom in Gujarat, marking a strategic entry into the state's retail market. The showroom, located in Ambika Society, will have an approximate retail area of 3,200 square feet. It will be owned and operated by the company, aiming to enhance its retail presence, customer accessibility, and brand recognition in the region. The expected date for the commencement of operations is currently under finalization.

announcements.subject: Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: Akiko Global Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Update on Estimated Consolidated Turnover of Akiko Global Services Limited for June 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Akiko Global Services Limited has announced its estimated consolidated turnover for June 2026, reporting a significant year-on-year growth. The turnover for June 2026 stood at ₹24.37 crore, a substantial increase from ₹9.38 crore in June 2025, representing a 160% YoY growth. For the period of April to June 2026, the consolidated turnover reached ₹68.12 crore, compared to ₹20.71 crore in the same period of the previous year, marking a 229% YoY growth. These figures reflect the company's strong performance in the reported periods.

announcements.subject: Public Announcement-Open Offer
announcements.detail: SBI Capital Markets Limited has informed to the Exchange about Addendum to Public Announcement and Detailed Public Statement for the Open Offer made by Anupam Rasayan Limited, the acquirer for the addition of PAC
announcements.ai_summary: SBI Capital Markets Limited has informed the Exchange about an Addendum to the Public Announcement and Detailed Public Statement concerning an Open Offer. This Open Offer is being made by Anupam Rasayan Limited, the acquirer, for the addition of a Promoter and Acquirer (PAC). Further details regarding this addendum and the open offer are expected to be provided.

announcements.subject: Post Buyback Public Announcement
announcements.detail: Post-Buyback public announcement regarding Buyback of Equity Shares of Kajaria Ceramics Limited by way of tender offer from existing shareholders pursuant to the provisions of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Buy-back of Securities) Regulations, 2018 and the Companies Act, 2013
announcements.ai_summary: Kajaria Ceramics Limited has published a post-Buyback public announcement on July 20, 2026, in the Financial Express and Jansatta newspapers. This announcement is in compliance with Regulation 24(vi) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Buy-back of Securities) Regulations, 2018, and the Companies Act, 2013, regarding the buyback of equity shares through a tender offer from existing shareholders. Copies of this post-Buyback Public Announcement have been submitted to the stock exchanges for their records.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Godrej Agrovet Limited has informed the Exchange about Inauguration of New Oil Palm Complex in Telangana
announcements.ai_summary: Godrej Agrovet Limited (GAVL) has inaugurated India's first Integrated Oil Palm Complex in Khammam, Telangana, on July 20, 2026. This comprehensive facility integrates all stages of the oil palm value chain, including seed and genetics, nursery, R&D center, mill, and an upcoming refinery. The company's cumulative investment in this complex is expected to reach INR 300 Crore once fully operational. The inauguration was attended by several dignitaries from the Government of Telangana, including the Hon'ble Deputy Chief Minister and Ministers for Revenue, Agriculture, and Industries. This development is a significant step in supporting GAVL's expansion plans in the oil palm sector.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Arihant Academy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Opening of New Branch at Dombivli, Mumbai'.
announcements.ai_summary: Arihant Academy Limited has announced the opening of a new study centre in Dombivli, Mumbai, on July 20, 2026, as part of its expansion strategy. Located at 2nd Floor, A Wing - 201, Shree Complex, Manpada Road, Dombivli (E), Thane - 421201, this new branch aims to strengthen the company's presence in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and improve access to quality education for students in Dombivli and surrounding areas. The centre will offer coaching for school sections (State Board, ICSE, CBSE), science stream (IIT-JEE, NEET, State-Level Entrance Exams), and commerce stream (Classes XI & XII, CA, CS, Fintech courses). This expansion aligns with the company's vision of delivering outcome-oriented education through a blend of traditional classroom teaching and technology-enabled learning.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Arihant Academy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Opening of New Branch at Ambernath, Thane, Mumbai'.
announcements.ai_summary: Arihant Academy Limited has announced the opening of a new Study Centre at Ambernath, Thane, Mumbai, located at 3rd Floor, Office No. 302-308, Panvelkar Plaza, Opposite Dombivali Nagri Sahakari Bank, Station Road, Ambernath (E), Thane - 421501. This expansion is part of the company's ongoing strategy to strengthen its presence in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and improve accessibility to quality education. The new centre will offer coaching for school sections (State Board, ICSE, CBSE), Science stream (IIT-JEE, NEET), and Commerce stream (Classes XI & XII, CA, CS, Fintech courses). This initiative aligns with the company's vision of delivering high-quality, outcome-oriented education through a blend of traditional and technology-enabled learning.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Successful commissioning of 200 MW (AC) / 269 MW (DC) Solar Power capacity for Coal India Limited. The Disclosure is attached herewith.'.
announcements.ai_summary: KPI Green Energy Limited has successfully commissioned 200 MW (AC) / 269 MW (DC) of Solar Power capacity for Coal India Limited. This commissioned capacity is part of a larger 300 MW (AC) / 405 MW (DC) grid-connected ground-mounted Solar PV project being executed by KPI Green Energy on an EPC basis at GIPCL's Solar Park in Khavda, Gujarat. This commissioning further strengthens KPI Green Energy's presence in Khavda, a significant renewable energy hub. The company is on track to achieve its ambition of building a 10 GW clean energy portfolio by 2030.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Minda Corporation Limited has informed regarding acquisition of further shares in Spark Minda Green Mobility Systems Private Limited(WOS) under right issue.
announcements.ai_summary: Minda Corporation Limited has acquired an additional 2,50,00,000 equity shares in its wholly-owned subsidiary, Spark Minda Green Mobility Systems Private Limited, for an aggregate amount of Rs. 25,00,00,000. This acquisition was made pursuant to a Rights Issue and took place on July 19, 2026. Spark Minda Green Mobility Systems Private Limited had a turnover of Rs. 5362.07 Lakhs for FY 2025-26. The company has stated that this transaction is done at "arm's length" despite the subsidiary being a related party. The information has been submitted to the stock exchanges for record and will also be available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: C2C Advanced Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates (Letter to Our Shareholders from the Chief Executive Officer of the Company)
announcements.ai_summary: C2C Advanced Systems Limited has provided a letter to its shareholders from the Chief Executive Officer, following a Board meeting on July 18, 2026. The CEO has accepted the position and highlighted the company's achievements, including deep domain expertise in Defense, Homeland security, Critical infrastructure, and Industry 5.0, with its MAGI-CS ISR platform being a significant indigenous development. The company has delivered several systems globally, including a combat management system for the Royal Malaysian Navy and a navigational platform where it is the sole vendor. C2C Advanced Systems is also entering European markets through Romania and establishing bases in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and the USA. The company is also focusing on building C2C innovation and research (CIRC) and aims to become India's leading innovation engine within 10 years.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Pace Digitek Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 20, 2026, titled "Press release".
announcements.ai_summary: Pace Digitek Limited, through its material subsidiary Lineage Power Private Limited (LPPL), has entered into a strategic cooperation agreement with MEGMEET Electrical India Private Limited. This agreement, dated July 20, 2026, expands their existing five-year collaboration in telecom power solutions to include AI data center power infrastructure. Under the terms, MEGMEET will act as a strategic supplier of AI data center power systems and related products to LPPL, providing technical support, product upgrades, training, and after-sales services. Product supply will be managed through mutually agreed purchase orders.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'receipt of charging permission from Chief Electrical Inspector in respect of its 100 MW (AC) / 128 MW (DC) Grid-connected ground-mounted solar PV project for MAHAGENCO. The disclosure is attached herewith.'.
announcements.ai_summary: KPI Green Energy Limited has announced the receipt of charging permission from the Chief Electrical Inspector in Nagpur for its 100 MW (AC) / 128 MW (DC) grid-connected solar PV project. This project, executed on a Turnkey EPC basis for Maharashtra State Power Generation Company Limited (MAHAGENCO) at Ramthi, Narkhed, District Nagpur, Maharashtra, marks the company's entry into the state of Maharashtra. This development adds a significant state-utility project to KPI Green Energy's operating portfolio, showcasing its execution capabilities for large-scale solar projects.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Bosch Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation about the receipt of trading approval'.
announcements.ai_summary: Bosch Limited has received trading approval from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited for 2460 equity shares. These shares, with a face value of Rs. 10/- each, were issued at a premium of Rs. 35190/- per share to promoters Robert Bosch Investment Nederland B.V. and Robert Bosch LLC on a preferential basis. The trading approval was granted on July 17, 2026, and the shares are admitted to dealings on the exchange from July 20, 2026. The distinctive numbers for these shares range from 32051461 to 32053920.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Indian Emulsifiers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 20, 2026, titled "Indian Emulsifiers Limited Secures Two Major Direct Export Orders from a Leading U.S. Customer".
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Emulsifiers Limited (IEML) has secured two significant direct export orders from a leading U.S. customer, totaling USD 700,621 (approximately INR 6,74,56,130). These orders reaffirm the company's product quality and technical expertise in the global specialty chemicals market. The orders will be fulfilled through IEML's wholly-owned subsidiary, Polaris Specialty Chemicals Inc., once it is capitalized. The company is prioritizing immediate execution of these orders, demonstrating its manufacturing capacity to handle large international commitments. IEML expects continued order momentum in the U.S. market, particularly in the Oil & Gas, Food, Technical Textile Auxiliaries, and Water Treatment sectors.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited's Metals & Minerals (M&M) business has secured multiple orders from leading domestic metals and mining companies. One significant order is for Package #BE-01C of an 18 MTPA Iron Ore Handling Plant in Chhattisgarh for a public sector company, aimed at increasing its iron ore production capacity to 100 MTPA by 2030. L&T will handle the design, engineering, procurement, installation, and commissioning of the downhill conveyor system, screening plant, stockpile, yard equipment, and Rapid Wagon Loading System. Additionally, L&T has secured various Design & Build and Balance of Plant packages for the expansion of a Steel Plant in West Bengal and an EPC order for a Zinc Processing Plant from a major private sector metals producer.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: SG Finserve Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 20, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: SG Finserve Limited has entered into a partnership with BharatPe Money and Succesship Technologies to enhance digital credit access for merchants. This collaboration launches a digital lending solution designed to provide faster, transparent, and paperless merchant loans, adhering to the Reserve Bank of India’s Digital Lending Guidelines. The partnership leverages SG Finserve's lending expertise, BharatPe's merchant network, and Succesship's technology platform to simplify the borrowing process, reduce documentation, and improve the customer experience for India's MSMEs.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited has announced an expansion of its engagement with L&T Technology Services (LTTS) by adding over 1,100 seats in Pune. This expansion increases LTTS's managed office portfolio with Smartworks to over 2,750 seats across multiple cities. The combined expected rental revenue from these locations is approximately INR 115 Crore, with the Pune expansion contributing around INR 55 Crore over a tenure of 60 months. This development highlights the growing demand for flexible and scalable workplace solutions from enterprises.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: WABAG Secures Large Order Inflow from BWSSB for Two Energy-Efficient Wastewater Treatment Facilities
announcements.ai_summary: VA Tech Wabag Limited has secured a 'Large' order from the Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB) for two energy-efficient wastewater treatment facilities. The contract involves the Design, Build, Operate (DBO) of a 100 MLD Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) at Byramangala and a 60 MLD STP at Bellandur, along with a 25 MLD Tertiary Treatment Plant (TTP) at Byramangala. The scope includes Design, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Commissioning (EPC) of these facilities, incorporating biogas-based power generation. The STPs will utilize the Activated Sludge Process with a Biological Nutrient Removal system, while the TTP will use Ultrafiltration for high-quality treated water. This award represents the second phase for the Bellandur facility, which WABAG previously executed.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Hindustan Copper Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 20, 2026, titled "Press Release issued by Hindustan Copper Ltd regarding Annual Plan Meeting for the Financial Years 2026 27 and 2027 28 ".
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) held its Annual Plan Meeting on April 17-18, 2026, in Kolkata to discuss its strategic growth trajectory for Financial Years 2026-27 and 2027-28. The meeting was attended by top leadership, including Chairman and Managing Director Mr. Sanjiv Kumar Singh, and Directors. announcements.ai_summary: Praj Industries Limited has announced the launch of an Advanced Precision Fermentation Lab at Praj Matrix on April 20, 2026. This initiative aims to drive next-generation biotechnology and accelerate India's transition to low-carbon biomanufacturing, aligning with the Government of India's BioE3 vision. The lab, described as one of a kind globally, will focus on high-capacity, AI-enabled precision fermentation and next-generation bioprocesses to improve efficiency and reduce scale-up risks. This will enable Praj and its subsidiary, Praj HiPurity Systems, to deliver advanced fermentation solutions to the pharmaceutical, food, cosmetics, biofuels, and beverage sectors. The facility will integrate discovery, process development, and high-purity manufacturing.

The order determined a stamp duty liability of Rs. 1,27,92,189/- along with a penalty of Rs. 1,25,00,000/-, aggregating to Rs. 2,52,92,189/-. This issue arose from a circular issued in 2025 by the Additional District Magistrate, Collector of Stamps, disputing the applicable stamp duty rate for dematerialized shares under the Indian Stamp Act, 1899, as amended by the Finance Act, 2019. E2E Networks Limited has already filed a writ petition before the Hon’ble High Court of Delhi regarding this matter, and the proceedings are currently under judicial consideration.

announcements.ai_summary: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd (Himadri) has increased its stake in International Battery Company, Inc. (IBC) through an additional investment of USD 0.66 million, as announced on June 19, 2026. This latest investment raises Himadri's aggregated stake in IBC from 17.29% to 20.47% on a fully diluted basis, encompassing both common and preferred stock. Prior to this, Himadri had invested an aggregate of USD 5.43 million in IBC. The increased investment reinforces Himadri's commitment to advanced battery technologies and reflects confidence in IBC's technology platform and commercialization roadmap. This strategic partnership supports the commercial deployment of Himadri's Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) Cathode Active Materials and advanced Anode Materials. Himadri gains strategic access to IBC's R&D center in California, manufacturing facility in South Korea, and the upcoming Gigafactory in Bengaluru, India.
