Between June 16, 2026, and June 17, 2026, the promoter sold 1,35,78,471 equity shares. Prior to this sale, the promoter held 1,44,55,671 equity shares, representing 82.40% of the total voting capital. Post-sale, the promoter's holding reduced to 8,77,20,505 equity shares, representing 77.40% of the total voting capital. This transaction was conducted at a consideration of approximately ₹3,094 crore.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Kamat Hotels (I) Limited has informed the Exchange about Opening of "IRA by Orchid Hotel, Bhavnagar".
announcements.ai_summary: Kamat Hotels (India) Limited has announced the opening of its new property, "IRA by Orchid Hotel, Bhavnagar," on June 19, 2026. This 50-key hotel, operating under a leased model, features Deluxe, Executive, and Suite rooms, a multi-cuisine restaurant, 24-hour in-room dining, a gym, and five banquet venues capable of hosting up to 500 guests. The hotel is strategically located in ISCON Mega City, Bhavnagar, offering convenient access to local amenities and transit routes, and aims to cater to business, pilgrimage, and leisure travelers in the Saurashtra region.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 19, 2026, titled "Mahindra Lifespaces Acquires 15-Acre Land Parcel in Kandivali East with Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹5,600 Crore".
announcements.ai_summary: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited has announced the acquisition of a 15-acre land parcel in Kandivali East, Mumbai, with an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹5,600 crore. The development potential of this land is approximately 1.8 million square feet. This strategic acquisition is part of the company's plan to expand its Mumbai portfolio and strengthens its presence in the Kandivali micro-market. The land parcel benefits from excellent connectivity and is supported by established social infrastructure, with further enhancement expected from the upcoming Borivali-Thane Twin Tunnel.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange to please refer to the letter dated June 18, 2026 informing that Wipro Limited would acquire an additional 20% stake in Aggne Global IT Services Private Limited and that the transaction was expected to be completed by June 30, 2026.In continuation to the aforesaid letter, it is hereby informed that the said transaction has been completed on June 18, 2026. The Company received intimation to this effect on June 19, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Wipro Limited has completed the acquisition of an additional 20% stake in Aggne Global IT Services Private Limited on June 18, 2026. This follows their prior communication on June 18, 2026, which indicated the transaction was expected to conclude by June 30, 2026. The company received official intimation of the completion on June 19, 2026. This acquisition strengthens Wipro's holding in Aggne Global IT Services Private Limited.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Satin Creditcare Network Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 19, 2026, titled "Announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Satin Creditcare Network Limited has announced its entry into Kerala, marking a significant milestone in its South India expansion. The company has commenced operations with the launch of branches in Aroor and Cherthala (Alappuzha district) and the inauguration of its Circle Office in Kochi. This expansion brings Satin Creditcare's presence to 32 states and Union Territories across India. The Kochi Circle Office will serve as the operational and administrative hub for Kerala, overseeing branch operations and growth strategies. This move further strengthens the company's established presence in South India, which already includes Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana. Satin Creditcare has appointed a Circle Head with over 15 years of experience in the Kerala market to lead this expansion. The announcement was made on June 19, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Intense Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 19, 2026, titled "Intense Technologies Announces Retirement of Founder Mr. C.K. Shastri; Celebrates Decades of Visionary Leadership".
announcements.ai_summary: Intense Technologies Limited has announced the retirement of its Founder and Managing Director, Mr. C.K. Shastri, effective from the closing of business hours on June 19, 2026. The retirement is due to age and a desire to focus on health and personal wellness. Mr. Shastri's tenure has been marked by his visionary leadership in transforming a startup into a global enterprise, renowned for its IP-powered and AI-led platforms. He played a pivotal role in establishing Indian intellectual property and enterprise software products on the global stage, leading the company through a competitive tech landscape. His commitment to innovation, customer success, and excellence has resulted in proprietary platforms trusted by Fortune 500 companies. The press release, dated June 19, 2026, also highlights his dedication to corporate excellence, transparency, and mentorship.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Lloyds Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about a release on Acquisition of Equity Shares of Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Lloyds Enterprises Limited (LEL) has announced a definitive agreement to acquire an additional 17.98% stake in Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited (SISCOL), a prominent structural steel fabricator in India. This acquisition will increase LEL's group holding in SISCOL, as its material subsidiary, LEWL, had previously acquired a 52.16% stake. SISCOL offers a full-stack service in structural steel, encompassing design, engineering, fabrication, and erection, and has a proven track record since 2018 with 187 fabrication projects across 22 states. The acquisition is expected to significantly enhance the combined business's scale and reach, particularly in heavy structural fabrication. The announcement was made following a Board of Directors meeting on June 18, 2026, and additional details are available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Closure of Buy Back
announcements.detail: CMS Info Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Closure of Buy Back with effect from Jun 19, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: CMS Info Systems Limited has completed its buyback program, with the extinguishment of 49,39,126 equity shares of face value ₹10 each. These shares were acquired at a price of ₹340 per share, for an aggregate consideration of ₹167,93,02,840. Following the extinguishment, the company's issued, subscribed, and fully paid-up share capital has reduced to 15,96,98,415 equity shares, with a total value of ₹159,69,84,150. This action is in compliance with SEBI (Buy-Back of Securities) Regulations, 2018.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited has secured a new contract valued at Rs 4.62 crore from Eastern Railway for works in the Sealdah division. The project involves the design, drawing, supply, and erection of 25 KV OHE and allied electrical works, including modifications to affected OHE, in connection with the "Extension of Platform at DEB, BEB, BPC, BP & NH of Sealdah Division". The contract is to be executed within 12 months from the date of the Letter of Acceptance, which was issued on June 18, 2026. This order is considered to be in the ordinary course of business for the company.

announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities
announcements.detail: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Grant of stock options under 'Trent Limited - Employee Stock Option Plan 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: Trent Limited's Nomination and Remuneration Committee, at its meeting held on June 19, 2026, approved the grant of 11,13,500 stock options to eligible employees under the 'Trent Limited - Employee Stock Option Plan 2026'. This grant is in accordance with the SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021, and follows shareholder approval via Postal Ballot on May 27, 2026. These options are exercisable into equity shares of face value ₹1/- each. The exercise price determined for these options is ₹2,652/-. The options will vest after a specified period, subject to performance conditions, and once vested, can be exercised within a maximum of one year.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Suprajit Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Podcast Featuring our Chairman - Mr. K. Ajith Kumar Rai'.
announcements.ai_summary: Suprajit Engineering Limited has announced that a podcast featuring its Chairman, Mr. K. Ajith Kumar Rai, is now available. The podcast details the journey of building the Suprajit Group. The company has provided a link to this podcast for public access. Suprajit Engineering Limited has explicitly stated that this podcast does not contain any Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) or any other material information requiring disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Viviana Power Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about disclosure received from Mrs. Priyanka Choksi and Mr. Richi Choksi under Regulation 29(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers), Regulations, 2011
announcements.ai_summary: Mrs. Priyanka Choksi and Mr. Richi Choksi, Promoters and Directors of Viviana Power Tech Limited, acquired shares through open market transactions on June 19, 2026. Mrs. Priyanka Choksi acquired 8,742 equity shares, and Mr. Richi Choksi acquired 2,101 equity shares. This disclosure is made in accordance with Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The company has requested that this information be taken on record.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Jullundur Motor Agency (Delhi) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 31A (6) (c) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.
announcements.ai_summary: Jullundur Motor Agency (Delhi) Limited informed the stock exchanges on June 19, 2026, about a change in its promoter status in compliance with Regulation 31A (6) (c) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Following the demise of Smt. Santosh Sondhi, a Promoter, her shareholding has been transmitted to her daughter, Smt. Shuchi Arora, who is also a Promoter and Director. Consequently, Smt. Santosh Sondhi has ceased to be a Promoter. The total shareholding of the promoters and promoter group remains unchanged at 51.00%. The updated list of Promoters and Promoter Group members shows Shuchi Arora holding 90,73,711 shares (39.73%) and Deepak Arora holding 13,25,500 shares (5.80%), among others.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Incorporation of Wholly Owned Subsidiary (WOS). The disclosure is attached herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: KPI Green Energy Limited announced on June 19, 2026, the incorporation of its wholly owned subsidiary, "KPGC One Private Limited," on June 18, 2026. This incorporation is in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The new subsidiary has an authorized and subscribed capital of Rs. 1,00,000/-, consisting of 10,000 Equity Shares of ₹ 10/- each. KPGC One Private Limited is established with the objective of generating, storing, transmitting, distributing, purchasing, selling, and supplying electricity and other forms of energy from renewable sources. The cost of acquisition for these shares was Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only), and the consideration was cash. The subsidiary has not yet commenced business operations, so its turnover is Nil.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Arfin India Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Arfin India Limited announced on June 19, 2026, that it has received an order from its distributor, JFE Shoji India Private Limited, a domestic entity of Japan's JFE Shoji Corporation. The order is for the supply of Aluminium Deox products, including Primary Shots/Cubes, Secondary Aluminium Ingots, and Secondary Aluminium Wire Rod. The specific terms and conditions, consideration, and execution timeline of this order are detailed in Annexure A, as per SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-POD-1/CIR/2023/123 dated July 13, 2023. The company has requested that this information be taken on record.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Nintec Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 19, 2026, titled "NINtec Adds Another AI Mandate    1.10 Million Engagement with a Finland-Based AI Company.".
announcements.ai_summary: NINtec Systems Limited has issued a press release on June 19, 2026, announcing a new engagement titled "NINtec Adds Another AI Mandate — €1.10 Million Engagement with a Finland-Based AI Company." This release details the contract secured by its wholly owned subsidiary, NINtec Systems BV, with a Finland-based client. The subsidiary will act as a Strategic Technology Partner, supporting the client's AI platform and technology operations. The contract is perpetual and valued at approximately EUR 1.10 million (around Rs. 12.10 Cr), underscoring the company's growing involvement in the AI technology sector.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Nintec Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: NINtec Systems Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary NINtec Systems BV in the Netherlands, has secured a perpetual contract with a Finland-based AI company. Under this agreement, NINtec will serve as a Strategic Technology Partner, providing support for the client's AI platform, integrations, and overall technology operations. The contract value is approximately EUR 1.10 million, which translates to around Rs. 12.10 Cr. This international agreement highlights the company's role in supporting advanced technology operations for global clients.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: NDL Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: NDL Ventures Limited has received an Order dated June 17, 2026, from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, directing the convening of meetings for Equity Shareholders and Unsecured Creditors. This is in connection with the proposed Scheme of Merger by Absorption of Hinduja Leyland Finance Limited (Transferor Company) into NDL Ventures Limited (Transferee Company). The NCLT has directed the Transferee Company to convene these meetings to consider and approve the Scheme. This intimation is a further development following the company's earlier disclosure on May 20, 2026, regarding observation letters from BSE and NSE. Further developments will be intimated as per applicable regulations.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Capacite Infraprojects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 19, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Capacit'e Infraprojects Limited announced that its Finance and Operation Committee of the Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 19, 2026, allotted 350 Senior, Secured, Rated and Unlisted Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs). Each NCD has a face value of INR 10,00,000, aggregating to a total of INR 35,00,00,000 (Indian Rupees Thirty-Five Crore Only). The allotment was made on a private placement basis. The meeting commenced at 1:00 PM and concluded at 1:25 PM. This disclosure follows up on a previous outcome dated June 17, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: InfoBeans Techno. Ltd. has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: InfoBeans Technologies Limited has been recognized as the "Best Employer Brand" for the 8th consecutive year and for "Best CSR Practices" by the World HRD Congress. These awards are a testament to the company's culture, trust, and belonging, and its "people first" culture. The "Best CSR Practices" award highlights the transformation of over 500 lives through free computer education and skill development for underprivileged youth. InfoBeans, a global AI-led digital transformation company, has a presence in the US, Europe, and the Middle East.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Butterfly Gandhimathi Appliances Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Receipt of the  Golden Peacock Award for Exo-Innovation  for the year 2026 by the Instituteof Directors, India'.
announcements.ai_summary: Butterfly Gandhimathi Appliances Limited has received the prestigious ‘Golden Peacock Eco-Innovation Award’ for the year 2026 for its product “RENZ 3B COOKTOP”. The company has also been recognized for meeting the standards of the “Golden Peacock Excellence Model,” highlighting its commitment to sustainability. The award ceremony is scheduled for Friday, July 03, 2026, in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. This disclosure is being made as a measure of good corporate governance practices and does not fall under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Kirloskar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update of material subsidiary'.
announcements.ai_summary: Kirloskar Industries Limited has informed the stock exchanges about an update concerning its material subsidiary, Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Limited (KFIL). KFIL has disclosed an intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. This intimation relates to a meeting held on Thursday, June 18, 2026, between KFIL's management and representatives from Molecule Ventures, an institutional investor. The discussion focused on the operational overview of KFIL, and no unpublished price-sensitive information was shared. Kirloskar Industries Limited has provided this update for the record.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: COMPLIANCE WITH REGULATION 30 & 51 OF SEBI (LODR) REGULATIONS, 2015 - FUNDING OF 11TH SEMI ANNUAL INTEREST IN ESCROW ACCOUNT MAINTAINED IN BANK OF INDIA WRT MTNL BOND SERIES VI (INE153A08097)
announcements.ai_summary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited (MTNL) has funded the 11th semi-annual interest payment for its 6.85% MTNL Bond Series VI (INE153A08097) on June 18, 2026. This payment was made into an escrow account maintained with the Bank of India and was due on June 21, 2026. This action is in compliance with Regulation 30 and 51 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The company has informed the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) about this compliance.

announcements.subject: Product launch
announcements.detail: Puravankara Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of the registration certificate of Project 'Miami By Purva'
announcements.ai_summary: Puravankara Limited has received a registration certificate from the Maharashtra Real Estate Regulatory Authority (MAHARERA) for its new residential project named 'Miami By Purva'. The project is located at C S No. 6 & 7/697 in Mumbai City, 400026, and has been assigned the registration number PR1170002600857. The project was registered with MAHARERA on June 18, 2026, and is intended for the domestic market. Details of the project are also available on the RERA website. This announcement is made in accordance with Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: DCM Shriram Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: DCM Shriram Limited has announced an update regarding its renewable power initiatives. Further to a previous communication on March 12, 2026, where the Board of Directors had approved an equity investment of up to Rs. 87 crores for a minimum 26% stake in Special Purpose Vehicles to obtain approximately 48 MW of additional renewable power for its Bharuch Plant, the Board met again on June 19, 2026. During this meeting, an additional equity investment of up to Rs. 18 crores was approved, bringing the total approved equity investment to Rs. 105 crores. This increased investment is intended to secure an additional approximately 10 MW of renewable power supply, raising the total renewable power supply to approximately 58 MW and the Bharuch Plant's overall renewable power supply to approximately 108 MW.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: DCM Shriram Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 19, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: DCM Shriram Limited's Board of Directors met on June 19, 2026, to discuss and approve an equity investment. Following a previous approval of up to Rs. 87 crores for a minimum 26% stake in Special Purpose Vehicles to secure approximately 48 MW of renewable power for its Bharuch Plant, the board has now approved an additional equity investment of up to Rs. 18 crores. This brings the total approved equity investment to Rs. 105 crores, aimed at securing an additional approximately 10 MW of renewable power supply. Consequently, the Bharuch Plant's total renewable power supply will increase to approximately 58 MW, with the overall renewable power supply reaching approximately 108 MW. Further details regarding this investment proposal will be provided once finalized.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Power Company Limited has received a Letter of Intent (LOI) from REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited, a subsidiary of REC Limited, for the acquisition of Ryapte Power Transmission Limited. This project involves the construction and commissioning of approximately 250 km of transmission lines, including 400 kV D/C lines, 220 kV D/C lines, and 220 kV underground cables across Karnataka. The project also includes establishing two greenfield substations: a 400/220 kV AIS substation at Ryapte in Tumkur District and a 400/220 kV GIS substation at Doddathaggalli near Hoskote. The transmission services are to be provided on a Build-Own-Operate-Transfer basis for 35 years from the Scheduled Commercial Operation Date (SCOD), which is set for 30 months after the SPV transfer.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Jubilant Pharmova Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Jubilant Pharmova Limited has announced the completion of a United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) inspection at its subsidiary, Jubilant HollisterStier LLC (JHS), contract manufacturing facility in Spokane, WA, U.S.A. The inspection concluded on June 17, 2026. During the inspection, the USFDA issued eight observations, none of which are related to sterility assurance concerns. JHS is committed to addressing these observations comprehensively and will submit its response within 15 business days. Jubilant HollisterStier LLC is a contract manufacturer of sterile injectables and ophthalmics, with facilities in North America serving the pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical industries. Jubilant Pharma Limited, a Singapore-based wholly-owned subsidiary of Jubilant Pharmova Limited, operates this facility.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bliss GVS Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Addendum to Public Announcement and Detailed Public Statement for the Open Offer made by Anupam Rasayan Limited, the acquirer for the addition of PAC.
announcements.ai_summary: Bliss GVS Pharma Limited has announced an addendum to the Public Announcement and Detailed Public Statement concerning an open offer. The acquirer, Anupam Rasayan India Limited, along with Mates Visa Consultancy Private Limited, acting as a person in concert, is making this open offer. The offer is for the acquisition of up to 2,77,26,848 fully paid-up equity shares of Bliss GVS Pharma Limited. These shares represent 26.00% of the expanded voting share capital. The face value of each equity share is ₹ 1. The addendum, dated July 17, 2026, formally includes Mates Visa Consultancy Private Limited as a party acting in concert with the acquirer. This update has been shared with both BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: JK Lakshmi Cement Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Company'S Clarification / Representation To The Proxy Advisory Report Issued By Institutional Investor Advisory Services'.
announcements.ai_summary: JK Lakshmi Cement Limited has submitted a clarification and representation to the proxy advisory report issued by Institutional Investor Advisory Services (IiAS) concerning the resolutions for its 86th Annual General Meeting (AGM) scheduled for July 30, 2026. The company addressed factual errors identified in the IiAS report, including the correct date of the AGM notice (July 2, 2026, not July 6, 2026) and the classification of Dwarkesh Energy Limited as a Promoter Group entity, not a Promoter, with Bengal & Assam Company Limited being the sole Promoter. Furthermore, JK Lakshmi Cement corrected the remuneration figures for Dr. Arun Kumar Shukla, stating it is ₹68.4 million instead of ₹123.6 million, and for Shri Shrivats Singhania, which is ₹123.6 million. The company expects that based on these clarifications, IiAS may release an addendum to its report.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Update under Regulation 30 read with Para A Part A of Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: MedPlus Health Services Limited has informed the Exchange about an update concerning its subsidiary, Optival Health Solutions Private Limited. Optival Health Solutions Private Limited has received a suspension order for a Drug License for a store located in Karnataka. The order, received on July 18, 2026, from the Assistant Director, Drugs Control Administration, Vijayapura Circle, Vijayapura, Karnataka, suspends the Drug License for two days for the store situated at Indi Sindagi Road, Bijapur, Karnataka. This action is pursuant to Rule 65 of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, and Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945. The company estimates a potential revenue loss of Rs 0.53 lacs due to this suspension.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: TVS Srichakra Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: TVS Srichakra Limited, through its step-down wholly owned subsidiary TVS Sensing Solutions Private Limited, has entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 5,100 equity shares, representing 51% of the paid-up equity share capital of Weber Drivetrain Private Limited. This acquisition was approved by the Board of Directors of TVS Sensing Solutions Private Limited on July 19, 2026. Weber Drivetrain Private Limited, which deals with Electric Motors & Controls for EV Vehicles, has an authorized capital of Rs. 15,00,000 and an issued/subscribed/paid-up capital of Rs. 1,00,000 (10,000 Equity Shares of Rs.10/- each). For the Financial Year 2026, Weber reported a turnover of Rs. 14.17 Cr. The acquisition does not involve related party transactions, and the promoter/promoter group/group companies do not have any interest in the entity being acquired.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Deccan Transcon Leasing Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of 15.34% equity stake in Deccan Shipping & Logistics Sdn. Bhd., Malaysia
announcements.ai_summary: Deccan Transcon Leasing Limited's Board of Directors, on July 19, 2026, approved the acquisition of 2,32,870 equity shares, representing 15.34% of the paid-up equity share capital of Deccan Shipping & Logistics Sdn. Bhd., Malaysia ("DSL Malaysia"), from Mr. Bejoy Varghese Vallikkunnel. This acquisition will increase the Company's shareholding in DSL Malaysia from the current 55.14% (8,36,939 equity shares) to 70.48% (10,69,809 equity shares). The transaction is contingent upon the execution of a Share Purchase Agreement, fulfillment of customary closing conditions, and compliance with all applicable laws and regulatory requirements in India and Malaysia, including FEMA. The Board meeting commenced at 02:15 P.M. and concluded at 02:30 P.M. (IST).

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Deccan Transcon Leasing Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Revocation of Certain Reclassification Requests under Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Deccan Transcon Leasing Limited's Board of Directors, in their meeting on July 19, 2026, reviewed queries from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited regarding a promoter reclassification matter. The Board approved the revocation of its earlier approval granted on March 06, 2026, for the reclassification of Mr. Jaidev Menon Parath, Ms. Karthika Menon, and Mr. Pranav Jaidev under Regulation 31A of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The reclassification requests for these individuals, including their relatives, have been revoked as they involved no shares or 0.00% holding. The Company will continue to pursue reclassification requests for other applicants in compliance with applicable regulations.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: DECCANTRAN: Deccan Transcon Leasing Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Board Comments on the Fine Levied by the Exchange in relation to the Non-Compliance pertaining to the Promoter Reclassification Matter.
announcements.ai_summary: Deccan Transcon Leasing Limited's Board of Directors met on July 19, 2026, to discuss and comment on a fine levied by the Exchange concerning a promoter reclassification matter. The Board noted that the delay in submitting the reclassification application under Regulation 31A of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, was due to exceptional medical circumstances affecting Mr. M. Veeresham, father of Mr. Miriyala Shekhar, which delayed the receipt of necessary documents. The Board concluded that the delay was not deliberate and was beyond the Company's reasonable control. The management had submitted a waiver application to NSE, which granted a substantial waiver of the penalty. The Board advised strengthening internal compliance monitoring to ensure timely filings.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: MPS Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the First Motion Order passed by the Honble National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai Bench in relation to the Scheme of Amalgamation of ADI BPO Services Limited with MPS Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: MPS Limited has announced that the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Chennai Bench, has passed a First Motion Order on July 02, 2026, in relation to the Scheme of Amalgamation of ADI BPO Services Limited with MPS Limited. The NCLT has dispensed with the requirement of convening meetings of shareholders and creditors for ADI BPO Services Limited and secured creditors of MPS Limited. However, the NCLT has directed that meetings of the equity shareholders and unsecured creditors of MPS Limited be convened on Saturday, August 22, 2026, at 10:00 A.M. (IST) and 11:30 A.M. (IST), respectively. These meetings will be held at the company's registered office or through Video Conferencing/Other Audio Visual Means. The company received the certified copy of the order after a delay and is proceeding with the intimation after clarifying minor typographical errors.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bajel Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Incorporation of a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Bajel Projects Limited has announced the incorporation of a new wholly-owned subsidiary named BAJEL T AND D PROJECTS AND CONTRACTING - L.L.C - S.P.C

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Global Limited has informed the Exchange about Q1 performance and growth update.
announcements.ai_summary: Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Global Limited has reported a strong performance for the first quarter of FY27 (ended June 30, 2026), with turnover increasing by approximately 65+% compared to the same period in FY26. This growth was driven by effective project execution across existing contracts. The company maintains a healthy order book of ₹1,015.18 Crores (excluding GST), providing significant revenue visibility. Furthermore, Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Global Limited has a robust bid pipeline valued at ₹21,814 Crores, which includes ₹3,398 Crores of new offers submitted in Q1 FY27. The development of its new Pre Engineered Building (PEB) Manufacturing Facility is also progressing as planned, expected to enhance manufacturing capacity.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Spunweb Nonwoven Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Spunweb Nonwoven Limited has announced its participation in the SME Investor Conference 2026, organized by Finavenue Growth Fund & Torin Wealth, which took place on July 18, 2026. The company shared a presentation and a corporate video during the event. No unpublished price-sensitive information was disclosed at the conference. This update follows a previous communication on July 14, 2026. The company is a manufacturer of spunbond nonwoven fabrics.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about General Updates - Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulatons, 2015 - Allotment of Equity Shares on a Preferential Basis (for consideration in cash)
announcements.ai_summary: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED's Board of Directors, via Circular Resolutions dated July 18, 2026, approved the allotment of 1,32,56,470 Equity Shares on a Preferential Basis for cash consideration. Each share has a face value of ₹10/- and was issued at a price of ₹347/-, which includes a premium of ₹337/- per share. The total aggregate amount for this allotment is ₹459,99,95,090. These shares were allotted to the allottees as previously approved in the Extra-Ordinary General Meeting held on June 28, 2026. Following this allotment, the company's Paid-Up Equity Share Capital now stands at 18,94,96,175 Equity Shares, totaling ₹1,89,49,61,750.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Kapston Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015. '.
announcements.ai_summary: Kapston Services Limited has formed a new wholly-owned subsidiary, "KAPSTON HOME SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED" (KHSPL), to enter the Business to Consumer (B2C) Home Services Market Place. KHSPL will offer services including Cleaning, Maid Services, Electrical, Plumbing & Carpentry (EPC), and Beauty & SPA services. The company is developing a technology platform for this venture and will conduct a soft/test/BETA launch on April 19, 2026, in Hyderabad. A commercial launch for Hyderabad is planned for the following month, with expansion to other metro cities scheduled for Financial Year 2026-27. This move signifies Kapston Services Limited's strategic expansion into the B2C segment, aiming to become a dominant e-commerce platform for home services manpower solutions.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Amagi Media Labs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 19, 2026, titled "Amagi Managed Services Modernizes Broadcasting Operations for AccuWeather®".
announcements.ai_summary: Amagi Media Labs Limited has announced a significant modernization of AccuWeather's broadcasting operations through an expanded engagement. AccuWeather is transitioning from traditional satellite and hardware infrastructure to a unified, cloud-based, internet-driven system managed by Amagi. This new system will handle both linear TV and streaming workflows in a single platform, enhancing efficiency, flexibility, and scalability across various platforms. The transformation, centered at Amagi's Master Control Room (MCR) in Princeton, N.J., integrates AccuWeather's technology stack and managed operations under Amagi's purview. This move aims to provide AccuWeather with enhanced agility and faster channel customization. Amagi's role extends beyond providing cloud playout technology to actively operating, monitoring, and optimizing critical broadcast environments. The entire solution is built on Amagi's tech stack and managed services, ensuring seamless and rapid customizations.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: KSH International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of commissioning of Roof Top Solar Power Plant'.
announcements.ai_summary: KSH International Limited announced the successful commissioning of its rooftop solar power plant at the company’s Supa Facility, located at Plot No. F-223, Supa Parner Industrial Park, Mauje Palve Khurd, Taluka Parner, Dist – Ahmednagar, Maharashtra – 414 301. The rooftop solar power plant has a capacity of 3220 kWp. The commissioning took place on May 18, 2026. The power generated from this plant will be utilized for captive consumption, aiming to reduce operational costs of the Supa Facility and enhance overall sustainability. This initiative aligns with one of the objects of the company's Offer as disclosed in its Prospectus dated December 18, 2025.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Gradiente Infotainment Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Gradiente Infotainment Limited announced the official launch of its flagship Beauty Pageant Intellectual Property (IP), "GRADIENTE MISS SHE INDIA 2026," envisioned as one of India's most prestigious platforms. The event is scheduled from November 16, 2026, to November 21, 2026, and will cater to both domestic and international markets, featuring Indian and NRI contestants. Through this initiative, the company aims to establish a globally recognized women-centric entertainment and lifestyle platform, thereby strengthening its presence in the media, entertainment, and experiential event industry. The estimated project cost for this initiative is approximately Rs. 3.50 Crores. Based on current business projections, the company expects potential revenue generation of approximately Rs. 10 Crores from sponsorships, licensing, media rights, partnerships, ticketing, and promotional associations, subject to commercial negotiations and execution timelines.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: IDBI Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about change in the Board of Directors
announcements.ai_summary: IDBI Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about a change in its Board of Directors. Shri Samaresh Parida (DIN 01853823) and Shri Jambunathan Narayanan (DIN 05126421) have ceased to be Independent Directors on the Board of IDBI Bank Ltd. with effect from May 18, 2026, following the completion of their two terms. This intimation is made in accordance with Regulations 30 & 51 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
announcements.detail: Simran G. Mehra has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 10 (5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.ai_summary: Simran G. Mehra has submitted a disclosure to the Exchange under Regulation 10(5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, concerning Savita Oil Technologies Limited. This regulation typically pertains to inter-se transfers of shares among qualifying persons. However, the specific details of the acquisition, including the number of shares acquired, the percentage of total voting capital, the transaction date, and the consideration paid, are not provided in this particular announcement. Investors should refer to the full disclosure for comprehensive information regarding this substantial acquisition.

announcements.subject: Qualified Institutional Placement
announcements.detail: Craftsman Automation Limited has informed the Exchange about qualified Institutional Placement
announcements.ai_summary: Craftsman Automation Limited's Fund Raising Committee has approved the allotment of 22,98,850 equity shares of face value Rs. 5 each to eligible Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIBs). The issue price for these shares is Rs. 8700 per equity share, which includes a premium of Rs. 8695 per equity share and a discount of Rs. 266.13 per equity share (2.97% of the floor price). This Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) aggregates to approximately Rs. 1,99,999.95 Lakhs. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased from Rs. 11,92,77,915 (comprising 2,38,55,583 equity shares) to Rs. 13,07,72,165 (comprising 2,61,54,433 equity shares). The QIP issue opened on June 15, 2026, and closed on June 18, 2026. A list of allottees who received more than five percent of the offered shares is attached as Annexure A.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Camlin Fine Sciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Press Release issued by the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Camlin Fine Sciences Limited has announced the clearance decision from the French stock market authority (AMF) regarding its mandatory tender offer for the remaining shares of Vinpai. This clearance allows for the release of the offer document and other related information. Previously, on November 27, 2025, Camlin Fine Sciences Limited acquired a majority stake of 78.68% in Vinpai's share capital, representing 84.89% of its voting rights, at EUR 3.60 per share. Following the conversion of convertible bonds, the company now holds 83.82% of Vinpai's share capital and 80.85% of its voting rights. The mandatory tender offer will be conducted at the same price of EUR 3.60 per Vinpai share for the remaining shares not held by Camlin Fine Sciences Limited. The timetable and terms of this offer are detailed in the offer document.

announcements.company: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited
announcements.subject: Rumour Verification - Regulation 30(11)
announcements.detail: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Rumour Verification - Regulation 30(11)
announcements.ai_summary: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited has responded to a news article published on June 18, 2026, which stated that the company's shares gained 3% as the promoter seeks to retain a 21.9% stake. The company has stated that it is unaware of any such developments. The response from Prudential Corporation Holdings Limited, the promoter, has also been shared, referring readers to a disclosure made on May 17, 2026, which was submitted pursuant to Regulation 30A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Pennar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Pennar Industries Limited has approved the allotment of 30,00,000 Convertible Equity Warrants on a preferential basis to Pennar Holdings Private Limited, a promoter entity. The issue price per warrant is Rs. 168, aggregating to Rs. 50.40 crore. The company has received 25% of the warrant issue price, amounting to Rs. 12.60 crore, with the remaining 75% due upon the allotment of fully paid-up equity shares of face value Rs. 5 each per warrant. This allotment is in accordance with SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, and has received shareholder and stock exchange approvals. The company also disclosed that Mr. Aditya Rao, a promoter, has created a pledge over a portion of his shareholding. There is currently no change in the paid-up share capital of the company as a result of the warrant allotment.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: TREJHARA SOLUTIONS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding 'Cyber security incident with no material impact'.
announcements.ai_summary: Trejhara Solutions Limited reported a suspected cyber security incident on June 18, 2026, involving the compromise of an email account belonging to one of its employees. Upon detection, the company promptly secured the affected account and initiated containment and remediation measures, including intimation to CERT-In. The company confirmed that the incident has not impacted its core systems or business operations. Furthermore, no data exfiltration has been identified, and there has been no disruption to the company’s operations. Trejhara Solutions Limited stated that the overall impact of the incident on the organization is nil.

announcements.subject: Closure of operations
announcements.detail: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015   Stoppage of Production activities on account of Annual Maintenance at its 100% Subsidiary namely Vintage Coffee Private Limited factory
announcements.ai_summary: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Limited announced on June 18, 2026, that its 100% subsidiary, Vintage Coffee Private Limited, will undergo an annual maintenance shutdown. The production activities at its factory located in Rachur Village, Veldanda Mandal, Nagarkurnool District, Telangana, will be halted from June 19, 2026, to July 02, 2026, for an estimated period of 14 days. This scheduled maintenance is a normal operational activity aimed at enhancing efficiency and ensuring the long-term sustainability of its operations. The company confirmed that the operations of its other 100% subsidiary, Delecto Foods Private Limited, will continue uninterrupted during this period. As the company does not maintain division-wise accounts, specific financial contributions from Vintage Coffee Private Limited are not applicable.

announcements.subject: Conversion
announcements.detail: Future Market Networks Limited has informed the Exchange about lapse of warrants and forfeiture of upfront payment
announcements.ai_summary: Future Market Networks Limited announced on June 18, 2026, that 2,94,00,000 warrants, allotted on a preferential basis on December 18, 2024, have lapsed. These warrants entitled holders to convert them into an equivalent number of equity shares within 18 months from the allotment date, with the conversion period expiring on June 17, 2026. Since the allottees failed to exercise their option by the stipulated deadline, the warrants lapsed effective June 18, 2026. Consequently, the upfront amount of INR 6.52 Crores, representing 25% of the issue price received at the time of allotment, has been forfeited by the company. Specifically, promoter Surplus Finvest Private Limited had 95,00,000 warrants allotted at INR 11.21/- per warrant, converted 61,18,574 warrants, and 33,81,426 warrants lapsed, leading to a forfeiture of INR 0.94 Crores.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Tiger Logistics (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Tiger Logistics (India) Limited has secured a new import break bulk logistics mandate from Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), as announced on June 18, 2026. This project involves the movement of 13 over-dimensional cargo units, each weighing 89 MT, from Italy to India. The total value of this order is approximately ₹4 crore, which includes handling charges. This new mandate reinforces the company's established relationship with BHEL, a major public sector engineering and manufacturing enterprise. Tiger Logistics currently has several orders under execution for BHEL from the previous financial year, having already successfully delivered 28 machine components.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tiger Logistics (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 18, 2026, titled "Press Release dated 18th June 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Tiger Logistics (India) Limited announced on June 18, 2026, that it has secured a new import break bulk logistics mandate from Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL). The project involves the movement of 13 over-dimensional cargo units, each weighing 89 MT, from Italy to India. This mandate carries a total value of approximately ₹4 crore, including handling charges. This development further strengthens Tiger Logistics' long-standing relationship with BHEL, reflecting confidence in its project logistics capabilities. The company currently has several orders under execution from BHEL from the last financial year, with 28 machine components already successfully delivered. Mr. Harpreet Singh Malhotra, Chairman & Managing Director, emphasized the trust built over years of executing complex and high-value logistics assignments for large PSUs.

announcements.subject: Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up
announcements.detail: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding execution of a Manufacturing Collaboration Agreement between Amber Group (Amber Enterprises India Limited including all its subsidiaries & affiliates) with Oppo Mobiles India Private Limited on 18th June 2026  for manufacturing of Mobiles Phone in India, which will lead to adoption of new line of business in Amber Group.
announcements.ai_summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited, through its Amber Group, has entered into a Manufacturing Collaboration Agreement with Oppo Mobiles India Private Limited on June 18, 2026. This agreement is for the manufacturing of mobile phones in India, marking a new line of business for the Amber Group. Oppo Mobiles India Private Limited is a licensed manufacturer for OPPO, OnePlus, and Realme brands in India. The collaboration will leverage Oppo's global product expertise and quality standards with Amber Group's manufacturing scale, operational capabilities, and local supply-chain strengths to enhance local value addition.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: DOMS Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of Press Release by FILA, Foreign Corporate Promoter of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: FILA – Fabbrica Italiana Lapis ed Affini S.p.A. has successfully completed an accelerated bookbuilding offering of 4,248,184 equity shares of DOMS Industries Limited. This sale represents 7.00% of DOMS' outstanding equity share capital and generated gross proceeds of approximately INR 934.74 crore (approximately €85.26 million). The shares were sold at a price of INR 2,200.34 per share. This transaction was announced on June 17, 2026, following a press release on June 16, 2026. The offering was not for publication or distribution in the United States, Canada, South Africa, Australia, Japan, or other restricted jurisdictions.

announcements.subject: Press Release (Revised)
announcements.detail: TruAlt Bioenergy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated Jun 18, 2026, titled "TruAlt Bioenergy secures ₹150 crore financial assistance approval under PM JI-VAN Yojana for Sustainable Aviation Fuel Project".
announcements.ai_summary: TruAlt Bioenergy Limited announced on June 18, 2026, that it has secured approval for financial assistance of ₹150 crore under the Government of India's PM JI-VAN Yojana. This funding is designated for the company's proposed commercial-scale Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) project. The approval was granted by the Centre for High Technology (CHT) under the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas (MoPNG). The ₹150 crore financial assistance is expected to incentivize approximately 7-10% of the project's capital expenditure, thereby enhancing its viability. The planned SAF facility aims for a production capacity of 10 crore litres per annum, contributing to India's energy transition and aviation decarbonization objectives.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: California Software Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 18, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: California Software Company Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 18, 2026, approved in principle the exploration of acquiring up to a 51% equity stake in Tech Aggregators Private Limited (Cashter). This potential acquisition is subject to satisfactory due diligence, valuation, negotiations, and the execution of definitive agreements, as well as necessary approvals. The Board also approved the execution of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Tech Aggregators Private Limited to establish a framework for evaluating the transaction and authorized the commencement of comprehensive due diligence by independent professional advisors. Key management personnel have been authorized to execute the MoU, coordinate due diligence, engage advisors, and negotiate transaction terms.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Endurance Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about capacity addition for manufacturing Lithium-Ion Battery packs at the Company's existing facility at Mindewadi, Pune.
announcements.ai_summary: Endurance Technologies Limited is expanding its manufacturing capabilities by adding capacity for Lithium-Ion Battery packs at its existing facility in Mindewadi, Pune. The company has decided to add a capacity of 3,640 battery packs per month specifically for the four-wheeler segment. This capacity addition is expected to be completed in the third quarter of the current financial year, with an investment of approximately Rs. 62 crore, funded through internal accruals. This move aims to meet anticipated growth in the electric mobility sector, and the company is in advanced discussions with a four-wheeler EV OEM for supply.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Mukta Arts Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Whistling Woods International Limited, subsidiary of Mukta Arts Limited recognized as  Great Place to Work .'.
announcements.ai_summary: Whistling Woods International Limited, a subsidiary of Mukta Arts Limited, has been recognized as a 'Great Place to Work' by Great Place To Work®, India. This certification is valid from June 2026 until June 2027 for Mid-Size Organizations. This recognition highlights the positive work environment within the subsidiary, which is a part of the larger Mukta Arts Limited group.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - approved raising of funds by way of issuance of equity shares through qualified institutional placement for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 2000 crores, representing an enhancement of earlier approved limit from Rs. 1000 crore to Rs. 2000 crore, subject to the approval of the shareholders and other statutory approval
announcements.ai_summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 18, 2026, approved a significant fund-raising initiative. The company plans to raise capital not exceeding Rs. 2,000 Crores through the issuance of equity shares via a Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) to Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIBs). This represents an enhancement of the previously approved limit from Rs. 1,000 Crores to Rs. 2,000 Crores. The primary objective of this QIP is to achieve compliance with the Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS) requirements. The fund-raising is subject to shareholder approval and other necessary statutory approvals.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: New Delhi Television Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on acquisition of GoodTimes Channel.
announcements.ai_summary: New Delhi Television Limited has provided an update on its proposed acquisition of the business undertaking of the "GoodTimes" Channel from Lifestyle & Media Broadcasting Limited. This transaction, previously disclosed on September 19, 2025, December 18, 2025, and March 20, 2026, is now expected to be completed within approximately one more month. The consummation of the acquisition is contingent upon receiving all necessary statutory and regulatory approvals, as well as fulfilling customary conditions precedent. Investors should monitor for further updates regarding the finalization of this acquisition.

announcements.subject: Closure of operations
announcements.detail: ORIENT CERATECH LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Closure of operations
announcements.ai_summary: Orient Ceratech Limited (formerly Orient Abrasives Limited) announced that its Board of Directors, at a meeting held on June 18, 2026, approved the sale of the Company's Windmills (Power Division). The Board meeting commenced at 3:30 PM and concluded at 4:30 PM on the same day. Following the completion of this transaction, the Power Division will no longer form part of the Company's operations. Consequently, Orient Ceratech Limited will cease to present any further segment reporting pertaining to this division. This decision was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
