announcements.detail: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 18, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited, at its meeting held on June 18, 2026, approved raising funds up to an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 2,000 Crores (

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: MSP Steel & Power Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: MSP Steel & Power Limited has entered into a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Elevate Solar Energy Private Limited for the procurement of solar power. The agreement is for a contracted quantity of 10MWp (DC) of electricity per annum at a tariff rate of Rs 3.17 per unit, for a term of 25 years from the execution date. This PPA is executed under the Group Captive Open Access Permissions mechanism to optimize energy costs and increase renewable energy consumption. MSP Steel & Power Limited also intends to acquire a 26% shareholding in Elevate Solar Energy Private Limited, corresponding to their contracted energy quantity, subject to a Shareholders' Agreement to be executed later.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Brigade Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 18, 2026, titled Revocation of the Environmental Clearance (EC) for Residential Project 'Brigade Morgan Heights' in Chennai.
announcements.ai_summary: Brigade Enterprises Limited has issued a press release on June 18, 2026, regarding the revocation of the Environmental Clearance (EC) for its residential project 'Brigade Morgan Heights' in Chennai. The company considers the revocation by the State Level Environment Impact Assessment Authority (SEIAA) to be legally unsustainable and factually incorrect. Brigade Enterprises reiterates that the project site consists of private patta lands, not wetlands, and that public notices were issued without any objections. The company also notes that the Hon'ble Madras High Court had previously dismissed a Public Interest Litigation against the project.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Rajoo Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 18, 2026, titled "RAJOO ENGINEERS LTD. ADVANCES ITS MANUFACTURING EXCELLENCE THROUGH A MAJOR UPGRADE OF SHREE YANTRALAYA - THE MACHINE SHOP".
announcements.ai_summary: Rajoo Engineers Limited has issued a press release on June 18, 2026, detailing a major upgrade of its machine shop, Shree Yantralaya. This upgrade involves commissioning advanced machining technologies from Okuma, Huron, and Jyoti, enhancing the company's in-house manufacturing capabilities. The enhanced facility will improve precision, consistency, and productivity in producing large, complex, and high-value machine components for extrusion systems. This investment aims to increase value addition, reduce lead times, and strengthen quality standards.

announcements.subject: Issue of Securities
announcements.detail: Share India Securities Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, the Finance Committee, at its meeting held today, i.e., June 18, 2026, has approved the issuance of up to 50,000 secured, rated, senior, listed, taxable, transferable, redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) of face value INR 10,000/- each, on a private placement basis.
announcements.ai_summary: Share India Securities Limited's Finance Committee, in a meeting held on June 18, 2026, approved the issuance of up to 50,000 secured, rated, senior, listed, taxable, transferable, redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs). Each NCD has a face value of INR 10,000/-, aggregating up to INR 50,00,00,000/-. This issuance will be conducted on a private placement basis, as part of the company's earlier disclosed plan to raise funds up to INR 3,00,00,00,000/- through debt securities.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Sarda Energy & Minerals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disruption at Hydro Power plant of Madhya Bharat Power Corporation Ltd.'.
announcements.ai_summary: Sarda Energy & Minerals Limited has announced a disruption at the hydro power plant of its subsidiary, Madhya Bharat Power Corporation Ltd. On June 18, 2026, a transmission tower collapsed due to heavy rains, causing a temporary shutdown of the plant. The company is currently assessing the damage and the time required for restoration. Fortunately, the resulting loss is covered under insurance. Further updates on the restoration progress are expected.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Prime Securities Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 18, 2026, titled "Intimation under Regulation 30".
announcements.ai_summary: Prime Securities Limited has issued a press release regarding an M&A transaction where it acted as the sole advisor. The announcement details the acquisition of a controlling stake in Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited (SISCOL) by Lloyds Engineering Works Limited (LEWL). This consolidation aims to create one of India's most integrated engineering, structural fabrication, and EPC platforms. SISCOL, a leading structural steel infrastructure solutions provider, reported operating revenues of approximately Rs. 817 Cr, EBITDA of Rs. 92 Cr, and PAT of Rs. 44 Cr for FY26, with an order book of Rs. 1,134 Cr. LEWL has shown significant growth, with revenues increasing from Rs. 98 Cr in FY19 to over Rs. 3,000 Cr.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: QMS Medical Allied Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 18, 2026, titled "QMS Medical Allied Services Limited Migrates to NSE  Mainboard".
announcements.ai_summary: QMS Medical Allied Services Limited has successfully migrated its 1.93 crore equity shares (face value of Rs. 10 each) to the Mainboard of the National Stock Exchange (NSE) from NSE Emerge, effective June 18, 2026. This migration reflects the company's operational scale, financial performance, strong governance, and growing role in the pharma marketing and preventive healthcare sectors. The company aims to capitalize on the shift towards patient-focused engagement in pharma marketing and expects its Services business to double in revenue by FY27, contributing approximately 50% of revenues by FY29. The product business is projected to grow through expanded distribution, own brands, self-manufacturing, and strategic partnerships. For FY26, QMS Medical Allied Services reported consolidated revenues of Rs. 172.9 crore and EBITDA of Rs. 25.9 crore.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Advait Energy Transitions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure received under Regulation 29(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Sharesand Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.'.
announcements.ai_summary: Advait Energy Transitions Limited has received a disclosure from its promoters, Mr. Shalin Sheth and Mrs. Rejal Sheth, in compliance with Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure pertains to their shareholding and voting rights in the company. The specific details of the shareholding changes or acquisitions are enclosed with the disclosure for the company's records.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bharat Forge Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 18, 2026, titled "Kalyani Strategic Systems Ltd andAM General Sign Strategic Partnership to Offer Distinct Mounted Artillery GunSystems for World Armies".
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Forge Limited's wholly-owned defense subsidiary, Kalyani Strategic Systems Limited (KSSL), signed a strategic partnership with AM General on June 18, 2026, at the Eurosatory defense exposition in Paris, France. This partnership aims to offer distinct mounted artillery gun systems for world armies, providing compact, robust, mobile, all-weather, all-terrain Next-Gen Mounted Artillery gun platforms. The collaboration seeks to support broader allied distribution, positioning the platform as a scalable, exportable artillery solution for partner nations. Leveraging this partnership, AM General has proposed to participate in the U.S. Army Mobile Tactical Cannon (MTC) program, with delivery planned in 2027 upon down-selection. The MArG system features a 52-Caliber 155mm Cannon, patented Soft Recoil Technology, automated load-assist, and an advanced all-weather fire control suite.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Vaishali Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Vaishali Pharma Limited provided a clarification on June 18, 2026, regarding an observation from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited concerning its application for in-principle approval. Members had previously approved, via a special resolution through postal ballot on March 15, 2026, the issuance of up to 61,23,000 equity shares to Kesar Pharma Limited (KPL) on a preferential basis. The consideration was non-cash, involving a swap for 21,52,575 equity shares of KPL, initially valued at Rs. 56.89 per share. However, a Registered Valuer's report determined KPL's equity shares at Rs. 56.79 per share, resulting in a Rs. 0.10 per share difference. To align with the valuation, Vaishali Pharma Limited will now receive the aggregate differential amount of Rs. 2,15,258 in cash from Kesar Pharma Limited, ensuring the transaction adheres to the valuation report and regulatory requirements.

announcements.company: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of shareholders for reclassification of shareholding entities from "Promoter Group" category to "Public" category.
announcements.ai_summary: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited announced on June 18, 2026, that its shareholders approved the reclassification of two Promoter Group entities to the "Public" category. The approval was obtained on June 16, 2026, through a Postal Ballot, in accordance with Regulation 31A(3)(a)(vii) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The entities reclassified are Ebono Private Limited and GS E-commerce Private Limited, both of which held Nil shares in the company. This follows prior Board approvals on January 28, 2026, and April 28, 2026, and No-Objection letters received from the Stock Exchanges.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has informed the Exchange about the completion of Slump sale of Meerganj Unit.
announcements.ai_summary: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has completed the slump sale of its Meerganj Unit to Forever Global Enterprises Limited on June 18, 2026. This transaction is in continuation of the Board Meeting outcome dated April 20, 2026, and the Business Transfer Agreement executed on the same date. The company has received a purchase consideration of Rs. 305 Crores (Rupees Three Hundred and Five Crores only) for the transfer of the sugar factory located at Meerganj, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, as a going concern. The conveyance deed in connection with the Meerganj Unit has also been executed and registered.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about incorporation of Wholly Owned Subsidiary.
announcements.ai_summary: OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited has announced the incorporation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, "Invincible Minds Private Limited," on June 17, 2026. This follows the Board of Directors' approval on May 27, 2026, for the incorporation and investment in this subsidiary. The Certificate of Incorporation was received on June 18, 2026. Invincible Minds Private Limited will operate in the Financial Services sector as part of OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited's strategic initiative to expand its presence in non-lending business activities and allied financial services. The company will subscribe to the entire initial paid-up share capital of the subsidiary, comprising 90,00,000 equity shares with a face value of INR 10 each.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation to the Stock Exchanges regarding HRRL Refinery'.
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) has provided an update on the restoration work at its joint venture, HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (HRRL). Following a localized fire in a Crude Distillation Unit (CDU) heat exchanger stack on April 20, 2026, the CDU restoration work has been successfully completed and the unit has been restarted. HRRL has commenced production of key petroleum products including BS-VI High Speed Diesel (HSD), LPG, Petcoke, and Naphtha. Sales of LPG and Petcoke have already begun, with dispatches of BS-VI HSD expected by the end of the current week. Production and dispatches of BS-VI Motor Spirit (MS) are anticipated to start next week. HPCL and HRRL management are focused on ensuring safe and efficient operations as production ramps up to optimal capacity.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Lloyds Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Lloyds Enterprises Limited, along with its material subsidiary Lloyds Engineering Works Limited (LEWL) and Streamland Estate LLP, has entered into a Share Purchase, Share Subscription and Shareholders’ Agreement dated June 18, 2026, to acquire a controlling stake in Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited (SISCOL). The aggregate acquisition will be for 3,57,80,117 equity shares, representing 88.12% of SISCOL's total outstanding equity share capital, for a total consideration of approximately Rs. 1,073.40 Cr. Specifically, Lloyds Enterprises Limited will acquire 73,00,000 shares for Rs. 219 Cr, LEWL will acquire up to 2,11,80,117 shares for Rs. 635.40 Cr, and Streamland Estate LLP will acquire 73,00,000 shares for Rs. 219 Cr. This acquisition is expected to create a significant integrated platform in the engineering and EPC sector.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Lloyds Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 18, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Lloyds Enterprises Limited met on Thursday, June 18, 2026, and approved the acquisition of equity shares of Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited (SISCOL). A Share Purchase, Share Subscription and Shareholders’ Agreement (SPSSSHA) was executed on June 18, 2026, between Lloyds Enterprises, its material subsidiary Lloyds Engineering Works Limited, Streamland Estate LLP, SISCOL, and SISCOL's shareholders. Pursuant to this agreement, the three entities will collectively acquire 3,57,80,117 equity shares, constituting 88.12% of SIS

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue- Acquisition of shares
announcements.ai_summary: LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED has disclosed a material issue regarding the acquisition of shares in Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited (SISCOL). On June 18, 2026, the company entered into a Share Purchase, Share Subscription and Shareholders’ Agreement (SPSSSHA) with Lloyds Enterprises Limited, Streamland Estate LLP, SISCOL, and its shareholders. Through this agreement, LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED, Lloyds Enterprises Limited, and Streamland Estate LLP will jointly acquire up to 3,57,80,117 equity shares of SISCOL, representing 88.12% of its total outstanding equity share capital, for a total consideration of approximately INR 1,073.40 Cr. LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED will acquire up to 2,11,80,117 shares (52.16%) for approximately INR 635.40 Cr, partly through cash and partly through a share swap. The acquisition is subject to member approval at an EGM and other necessary authorities.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 18, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED held a Board Meeting on June 18, 2026, where they approved the acquisition of equity shares in Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited (SISCOL). A Share Purchase, Share Subscription and Shareholders’ Agreement (SPSSSHA) was executed on the same date. Under this agreement, LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED, along with Lloyds Enterprises Limited and Streamland Estate LLP, will collectively acquire up to 3,57,80,117 equity shares of SISCOL, representing 88.12% of its total outstanding equity share capital, for a total consideration of approximately INR 1,073.40 Cr. Specifically, LLOYDS ENGINEERING WORKS LIMITED will acquire up to 2,11,80,117 shares (52.16%) for approximately INR 635.40 Cr through a combination of cash and share swap. The Board also decided to issue and allot up to 7,06,74,554 Equity Shares at a premium of Rs. 70.25 per share, subject to member approval at an EGM and relevant authorities.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Completion of Acquisition of Associated Power Structures Private Limited (formerly known as Associated Power Structures Limited) ( APSPL ).
announcements.ai_summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited has announced the completion of its acquisition of Associated Power Structures Private Limited (APSPL). This acquisition was carried out through both primary and secondary transactions, resulting in Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited acquiring 55% of APSPL's equity shares. Consequently, APSPL has now become a subsidiary of Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited. The company received intimation of this completion on June 18, 2026, at 14:30 p.m. IST. This information will also be published on the company's website, www.waareertl.com.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Godrej Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of Key Information Document for issue of up to 1,00,000 Rated, Listed, Unsecured, Redeemable, Non-Convertible Debentures aggregating up to Rs. 1,000 Crore on Private Placement Basis, in one or more tranches.
announcements.ai_summary: Godrej Industries Limited's Management Committee of the Board of Directors has approved the Key Information Document for the issuance of up to 1,00,000 Rated, Listed, Unsecured, Redeemable, Non-Convertible Debentures on a private placement basis, as of June 18, 2026. This issuance will be in one or more tranches and aggregates up to Rs. 1,000 Crore. Specifically, the company will issue 50,000 debentures for Series 1 and 50,000 debentures for Series 2, each with a face value of Rs. 1,00,000/-, aggregating to Rs. 500 Crore for each series. This move is in accordance with SEBI regulations for the issue and listing of non-convertible securities.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Oil Country Tubular Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 18, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Oil Country Tubular Limited announced the allotment of 41,95,000 equity shares of face value Rs. 10/- each, fully paid up, to United Steel Allied Industries Private Limited on June 18, 2026. This allotment is a result of the conversion of 41,95,000 Zero Coupon Optionally Convertible Non-Cumulative Preference Shares (OCPS) into equity shares, as per the terms of the OCPS issue. Following this allotment, the company's total paid-up equity shares have increased from 5,19,89,530 to 5,61,84,530. These newly allotted equity shares will rank pari-passu with the existing equity shares of the company. The issuance is considered a preferential allotment and involves a total of 41,95,000 equity shares.

announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities
announcements.detail: Quess Corp Limited has informed the Exchange about  grant of RSUs.
announcements.ai_summary: Quess Corp Limited has announced the grant of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) to eligible employees under the Quess Stock Ownership Plan 2026 (QSOP 2026). The Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Company approved the grant of 40,34,061 options on June 18, 2026. This grant includes an additional 5,00,000 RSUs based on the achievement of compounded Total Shareholders Return growth, with 4,00,000 RSUs granted to the Chief Executive Officer and 1,00,000 RSUs to the Chief Financial Officer. These options represent 40,34,061 equity shares of face value of Rs. 10 each. The QSOP 2026 is in compliance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021. The exercise price of the shares will be the face value of the shares as on the date of exercise.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Karur Vysya Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 18, 2026, titled "Karur Vysya Bank partners with Tambaram City Municipal Corporation to make Mullai Nagar greener; launches Sponge Park".
announcements.ai_summary: Karur Vysya Bank Limited has issued a press release dated June 18, 2026, announcing its partnership with Tambaram City Municipal Corporation to enhance environmental sustainability. Under its flagship initiative 'KVB Bhoomi', the bank has launched a 'Sponge Park' in Mullai Nagar, Tambaram. This nature-based urban infrastructure project is designed to capture, store, and naturally filter rainwater, thereby reducing urban flooding and replenishing groundwater resources. The initiative aims to address challenges posed by rapid urbanization, declining groundwater levels, and seasonal waterlogging. The inauguration ceremony was attended by the Honourable Minister for Human Resource Management, Government of Tamil Nadu, along with officials from the Bank and the Municipal Corporation.

announcements.subject: Memorandum of Understanding/Agreements
announcements.detail: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Execution of Share Purchase Agreements on 18th June 2026, by IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited ( IL JIN ), a Material Subsidiary of Amber Enterprises India Limited ( the Company  /  Amber ), for Acquisition of Additional Equity Stake by IL JIN in Ascent Circuits Private Limited, a subsidiary of IL JIN and a Step-down Subsidiary of the Company. Pursuant to the execution of the SPAs, IL JIN proposed to acquire an additional 38.50% equity stake in Ascent in one or more tranches, resulting in an increase in its shareholding from 60% to 98.50%.
announcements.ai_summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited, through its material subsidiary IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited (IL JIN), has executed Share Purchase Agreements (SPAs) on June 18, 2026, to acquire an additional equity stake in Ascent Circuits Private Limited. Ascent Circuits Private Limited is a subsidiary of IL JIN and a step-down subsidiary of Amber Enterprises India Limited. Pursuant to the SPAs, IL JIN proposes to acquire an additional 38.50% equity stake in Ascent, increasing its shareholding from the current 60% to 98.50%. This acquisition will result in IL JIN attaining near-complete ownership and effective control over Ascent, aiming for closer operational alignment, streamlined governance, and enhanced synergies across its subsidiaries. The details of the transaction, including the parties involved, are provided in the annexures to the intimation.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: State Bank of India has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 18, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: State Bank of India's Central Board, in its meeting held on 18th June 2026, has approved a proposal for raising funds up to ₹60,000 Crore. The funds will be raised through the issuance of debt instruments, including Long Term Bonds, Basel III compliant Additional Tier 1 Bonds, and Basel III compliant Tier 2 Bonds. This fundraising can be done in INR and/or any other convertible currency, either through public offer or private placement, targeting Indian and/or Overseas investors during FY27. The approval is subject to necessary government approvals where required.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Sportking India Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Sportking India Limited has announced the successful commencement of commercial operations for its solar power project. This project, established under a Solar Power Purchase Agreement (SPPA) with Evincea Renewable Seven Private Limited, began operations on 18th June 2026. The company anticipates this initiative will reduce its power costs by approximately 12-13% annually, contributing to sustainable growth and enhanced energy efficiency. The project also aims to reduce the company's carbon footprint by increasing the share of clean energy in its overall power consumption.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Castrol India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release titled as "Castrol India highlights rising demand for smoother riding experiences with new  Bike Smooth, Toh Life Smooth  campaign".
announcements.ai_summary: Castrol India Limited has launched a new campaign titled "Bike Smooth, Toh Life Smooth" for its recently introduced Castrol Activ Full Synthetic range, effective June 18, 2026. The campaign highlights the increasing demand among Indian two-wheeler riders for smooth and dependable performance in their daily commutes. It uses a humorous narrative to illustrate the impact of a rough ride on a rider's day. The campaign reflects the evolving expectations of riders who value a smooth and hassle-free experience, recognizing that their two-wheeler is crucial for their daily lives. Castrol India aims to convey that a smooth ride positively influences the rest of the day. The company has been evolving alongside Indian riders for over 25 years, adapting to their expectations and engagement with brands.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bharat Coking Coal Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 17, 2026, titled "Site Hand-Over of Dugdha Coal Washery to JSW Steel Limited".
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Coking Coal Limited (BCCL) has announced the formal site handover of its 2.0 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) capacity Dugdha Coal Washery to JSW Steel Limited on June 17, 2026. This marks a historic step in the monetization of coal sector assets in India and is the first such initiative for a coal washery. The handover, which took place at Koyla Bhawan, aims to modernize assets, enhance operational efficiency, and optimize resource utilization through private sector participation. This project is expected to increase coal beneficiation capacity, promote better utilization of domestic coking coal, and increase the availability of washed coking coal. It will also contribute to reducing reliance on imported coking coal and saving foreign exchange, aligning with the Indian government's 'Mission Coking Coal'. The partnership with JSW is anticipated to improve the coal supply chain, promote sustainable and modern coal processing, create new employment opportunities, and boost industrial development in Jharkhand and surrounding regions.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 18, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited has announced an upward revision of its FCNR (B) deposit rates for Non-Resident Indians (NRIs). Effective June 18, 2026, NRIs can now earn a higher interest rate of 7.13% per annum on US Dollar FCNR (B) deposits for tenures ranging from 3 to 5 years. This adjustment follows the Reserve Bank of India’s special FCNR (B) swap facility aimed at encouraging higher NRI fund inflows. The deposits offer competitive returns, tax-free interest earnings in India with full repatriability of principal and interest, and capital protection against forex fluctuations. The deposit has a one-year lock-in period, with premature withdrawals permitted after one year as per bank norms. Equitas also offers NRO and NRE Fixed and Recurring Deposits with competitive rates, such as 7.75% p.a. for 888 days on Fixed Deposits and 7.10% p.a. from 12 to 15 months on Recurring Deposits.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: JBM Auto Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 18, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: JBM Auto Limited has announced a strategic investment of INR 750 Crores from Motilal Oswal Alternates (MO Alternates) into its subsidiary, JBM Ecolife Mobility Private Limited. This investment is aimed at scaling e-bus deployment across India and is considered the largest ever investment by an Indian investor in electric mobility. The capital will be used to deploy approximately 2,000 energy-efficient e-buses, projected to reduce CO2 emissions by 2.5 billion kgs and save 1 billion litres of diesel over their lifetime. This initiative is expected to generate employment for over 7,000 people, with the company targeting approximately 5,000 e-buses on Indian roads within the next 12 months. EY acted as the exclusive financial advisor, and Trilegal and Khaitan & Co. served as legal advisors for this transaction.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bharat Wire Ropes Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Wire Ropes Limited announced on June 18, 2026, that it has received a communication dated June 17, 2026, from the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB). This communication, digitally signed on June 18, 2026, permits the restart of manufacturing activities at the company's Chalisgaon Plant. The update follows an earlier disclosure made on June 10, 2026, regarding a notice issued by the MPCB concerning the same plant. Consequently, Bharat Wire Ropes Limited has promptly resumed its operations at the Chalisgaon plant,

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Creative Newtech Limited Partners with Ravel Electronics to Strengthen India's Fire and Life Safety Technology Ecosystem
announcements.ai_summary: Creative Newtech Limited has entered into a strategic partnership with Ravel Electronics Private Limited, announced on June 18, 2026, to bolster India's Fire and Life Safety Technology Ecosystem. Under this agreement, Creative Newtech Limited will act as the Master Distributor for Ravel Electronics' Conventional and Addressable Fire Alarm Systems across India. This collaboration aims to enhance the availability and market reach of globally compliant fire safety solutions, addressing the growing demand for advanced systems in various sectors due to increased emphasis on building safety and regulatory compliance. Creative Newtech will also focus on market expansion and channel development for Ravel's brand, AARAL.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: PRESTIGE: Prestige Estates Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about launch of plotted development project "Prestige Gardenia Estates - Phase 2" in Devanahalli, Bangalore.
announcements.ai_summary: Prestige Estates Projects Limited has announced the launch of "Prestige Gardenia Estates - Phase 2," a plotted development project in Devanahalli, Bangalore, on June 18, 2026. This new phase is situated on approximately 21 acres and comprises 195 plots with a total development area of just under 0.5 million square feet. The project has an estimated revenue potential of Rs. 400 Crores. Located near Kempegowda International Airport and major transportation routes, the development offers modern amenities and green spaces. Phase 1 of Prestige Gardenia Estates was met with immediate success and sold out at launch, indicating strong demand for well-connected, sustainable living in North Bengaluru.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: FSN E Commerce Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 18, 2026, titled "Nykaa Sets the Course for Its Next Growth Chapter; Targets USD 5 Billion+ GMV Beauty and Lifestyle Business by FY30".
announcements.ai_summary: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited, operating as Nykaa, has unveiled its ambitious FY30 vision, targeting a USD 5 billion+ Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) for its Beauty and Lifestyle business. This strategic outlook was presented at their Annual Investor Day 2026 on June 18, 2026. Nykaa aims to accelerate its role in India's consumption growth by expanding its presence across Beauty, Fashion, Consumer Brands, Retail, and B2B Distribution. The company projects a 2-3X revenue growth and 4-5X EBITDA growth by FY30, with an expected EBITDA margin in the low to mid-teens and a Return on Capital Employed (ROCE) exceeding 40%. This growth will be driven by disciplined execution, operating leverage, and capital-efficient investments, with a long-term goal of serving 200 million cumulative consumers by FY36.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Rossell Techsys Limited has informed the Exchange about Addition in Promoter / Promoter group by way of gift of shares
announcements.ai_summary: Rossell Techsys Limited has announced an addition to its Promoter Group through a gift of shares. On June 17, 2026, Mr. Harsh Mohan Gupta transferred 100 shares each to Harsh Samara Gupta Trust and Harsh Rishab Gupta Trust, totaling 200 shares. This transaction is an off-market, inter-se transfer by way of gift, with no consideration involved. The transferor, Mr. Harsh Mohan Gupta, is an existing promoter, and the transferees are family trusts settled by existing promoters, with beneficiaries also being part of the Promoter/Promoter Group. Consequently, there is no change in the overall shareholding of the Promoter and Promoter Group, nor any change in the control of the Company.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Man Industries (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Man Industries (India) Limited and its step-down subsidiary in Saudi Arabia, National Pipe Company Limited (NPC), have secured new orders totaling approximately Rs.1,000 Crores. Man Industries (India) Limited received orders worth approximately Rs.300 Crores, while NPC secured orders valued at approximately Rs.700 Crores. These orders are for the supply of various types of pipes and are expected to be executed within a timeframe of 6 to 9 months. Following the receipt of these new orders, the consolidated unexecuted order book of Man Industries (India) Limited now stands at approximately Rs.4,100 Crores. The company highlighted that these orders underscore the trust customers place in their technological and executional capabilities.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Univastu India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 17, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Univastu India Limited has submitted a revised outcome for its Board Meeting held on July 17, 2026, superseding a previous submission made on July 18, 2026. The primary update concerns the allotment of 17,43,399 fully paid-up equity shares of face value ₹10 each to eligible warrant holders. This allotment is pursuant to the exercise of convertible warrants issued on a preferential basis and the receipt of the balance warrant exercise consideration. The company had previously allotted 6,83,000 convertible warrants at an issue price of ₹216 per warrant on January 17, 2025. Following a 2:1 bonus issue approved on October 14, 2025, the entitlement for outstanding warrants was adjusted, reserving 11,62,266 equity shares for warrant holders. Two warrant holders, Mr. Manish Mehta and Mr. Vikram Kathuria, did not exercise their conversion rights within the prescribed period, leading to the forfeiture of their 25% initial payment. Flightech Solutions Private Limited and SSNK Consultancy Services Private Limited have partially exercised their warrants, with shares allotted proportionally to the consideration received.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015- Redemption of FCCBs
announcements.ai_summary: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about the redemption of its outstanding Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds (FCCBs). The company redeemed FCCBs aggregating to USD 23.90 million, along with accrued interest, in accordance with their terms and conditions. This action is a continuation of disclosures made on March 26, 2026, and July 13, 2026. Furthermore, the unutilized FCCB commitment of USD 215.1 million has also been cancelled, following approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited has received confirmation regarding the revocation of closure orders issued by the Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board (APPCB) for its manufacturing facilities located at Karakambadi, Tirupati District, and Nunegundlapalle Village, Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh. These closure orders were initially issued on April 30, 2021. The revocation was communicated via Order.No.634/APPCB/HO/ECS/TPT-2021 and Order.No.635/APPCB/HO/ECS/TPT-2021, both dated July 18, 2026. The company stated that there has been no loss incurred due to this disclosure and reiterated its commitment to environmental, health, and safety standards.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Tunwal E-Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Chairman & Managing Director of Tunwal E-Motors Limited, Mr. Jhumarmal Tunwal Appointed as Vice President of SME Chamber of India'.
announcements.ai_summary: Tunwal E-Motors Limited announced that its Chairman & Managing Director, Mr. Jhumarmal Tunwal, has been appointed as the Vice President of the SME Chamber of India. This appointment, made by Mr. Chandrakant Salunkhe, recognizes Mr. Tunwal's contributions to entrepreneurship, manufacturing, and electric mobility. As Vice President, he will focus on promoting entrepreneurship, supporting MSME development, advocating for policy reforms, and encouraging technology adoption. Mr. Tunwal expressed his honor and commitment to working with the Chamber to create opportunities for entrepreneurs and strengthen the MSME ecosystem. This appointment is effective from July 18, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 18, 2026, titled "Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited's Partner NATCO Pharma Limited receives USFDA Tentative Approval for Olaparib Tablets, 100 mg and 150 mg".
announcements.ai_summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited announced that its partner, NATCO Pharma Limited, has received Tentative Approval from the US Food & Drug Administration (USFDA) for Olaparib Tablets, 100 mg and 150 mg. These tablets are therapeutically equivalent to AstraZeneca's Lynparza Tablets. Alembic Pharmaceuticals will distribute the product in the U.S., while NATCO Pharma will manufacture it. The estimated U.S. market size for Olaparib Tablets is approximately USD 1.4 billion for the twelve months ending March 2026. Alembic Pharmaceuticals has a total of 244 ANDA approvals from the USFDA, including 20 tentative approvals. The Para IV litigation is ongoing.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: C2C Advanced Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''. Board comments on fine levied by the exchange.
announcements.ai_summary: The company has informed the Exchange regarding an update. The Board will be commenting on a fine levied by the exchange. Further details on the nature of the fine and the Board's response are not yet disclosed.

announcements.detail: Karur Vysya Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Revision in Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rates'.
announcements.ai_summary: Vedanta Oil and Gas Limited has received an intimation under Regulation 30A of the SEBI LODR Regulations from its promoter group entities, including Twin Star Holdings Ltd., Vedanta Resources Limited, Vedanta Holdings Mauritius II Limited, and Welter Trading Limited, on July 17, 2026. announcements.ai_summary: Vedanta Power Limited has received an intimation under Regulation 30A of the SEBI LODR Regulations from its promoter group entities, including Twin Star Holdings Ltd., Vedanta Resources Limited, Vedanta Holdings Mauritius II Limited, and Welter Trading Limited, on July 17, 2026. announcements.detail: Vedanta Power Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Power Limited has provided prior intimation under Regulation 29(1)(d) of the SEBI LODR Regulations regarding a Board Meeting scheduled for July 22, 2026. The primary agenda item is to consider and approve the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Additionally, the Board will consider proposals for raising funds through various modes, including private placement, qualified institutions placement, or preferential issue, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. The company has also confirmed that the trading window closure period, as previously informed on June 27, 2026, remains in effect.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Eurotex Industries and Exports Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Non Applicability Certificate of Corporate Governance'.
announcements.ai_summary: Karur Vysya Bank Limited has announced a revision in its Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rates (MCLR) effective from July 22, 2026. The overnight MCLR will increase from 8.75% to 8.85%, and the one-month MCLR will rise from 8.65% to 8.75%. The three-month MCLR will remain unchanged at 8.95%. The six-month MCLR will be revised from 9.10% to 9.15%, and the one-year MCLR will be adjusted from 9.25% to 9.35%. This update is in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 18, 2026, titled "Press Release for the Quarter ended 30th June, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited has released its Un-audited (Standalone and Consolidated) Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a Total Income of ₹341.6 Crores in Q1 FY27, an increase of 8.7% compared to ₹307.9 Crores in Q1 FY26. EBITDA increased by 1.3% to ₹74.3 Crores from ₹63.9 Crores, with the EBITDA margin improving to 21.8% from 20.9%. Profit After Tax (PAT) rose by 0.1% to ₹51.6 Crores from ₹45.9 Crores, and the PAT margin expanded to 15.1% from 14.9%. The company also highlighted that its ₹200 crores debottlenecking capex is fully funded through internal accruals, maintaining a debt-free status. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited declared its first interim dividend of ₹24.9 crores.

announcements.ai_summary: Vikran Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about the redemption of 20 (Twenty) Unsecured, Rated, Unlisted, Redeemable, Non-Convertible Debentures (ISIN: INE01R507033) on July 16, 2026. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 18, 2026, titled "Solex Energy Hosts Ghana High Commissioner to Advance India Ghana Renewable Energy Collaboration".
announcements.ai_summary: Solex Energy Limited has issued a press release dated July 18, 2026, detailing a meeting with H.E. Prof. Kwasi Obiri-Danso, the High Commissioner of Ghana to India, and a Ghanaian delegation. The discussions focused on strengthening international cooperation in renewable energy and advancing collaboration in the solar sector between India and Ghana. Solex Energy proposed a phased partnership to establish an end-to-end solar manufacturing ecosystem in Ghana, including local production of components, technology transfer, and capacity building. The company also emphasized developing indigenous talent through skill development programs and expressed intent to collaborate with the International Solar Alliance (ISA) to support Ghana's clean energy transition. Solex Energy currently has an operational manufacturing capacity of 4 GW and a Vision 2030 roadmap to reach 10 GW for solar modules and 10 GW for solar cells.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Intimation of incorporation of subsidiary companies.
announcements.ai_summary: REC Limited has announced the incorporation of two new wholly-owned subsidiary companies: Beed Parli Power Transmission Limited and Yavatmal Power Transmission Limited. These entities are subsidiaries of REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited, which is itself a wholly-owned subsidiary of REC Limited. Both newly incorporated companies have an authorized and paid-up capital of ₹5,00,000 each and are yet to commence business operations. Beed Parli Power Transmission Limited was incorporated on July 17, 2026, following the allocation of an intra-state transmission project by the Government of Maharashtra. Yavatmal Power Transmission Limited was also incorporated in relation to a similar project allocation. These companies will be transferred to the successful bidder selected through the Tariff Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) guidelines.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sahasra Electronic Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Business Update Q1 F.Y.27
announcements.ai_summary: Sahasra Electronic Solutions Limited has provided a provisional business update for Q1 FY27, reporting significant year-on-year growth. The company's standalone revenue for Q1 FY27 reached ₹33.0 crores, a 61% increase YoY, while consolidated revenue grew by 117% YoY to ₹48.0 crores compared to Q1 FY26. A major development was the inauguration of the company's semiconductor facility in Bhiwadi by key government officials, marking a milestone in its semiconductor journey. Sahasra also installed two new SMT lines at its Bhiwadi EMS facility, increasing its total manufacturing capacity to 12 SMT lines and entering the FinTech segment. Furthermore, the promoters have formed a 60:40 joint venture with UK-based UltraMax, named UltraMax Sahasra Energy Private Limited, to establish an integrated lithium battery pack and battery management system manufacturing facility in Bhiwadi.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts.
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Power Company Limited has received a Letter of Award (LOA) from Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI) for providing pumped storage services. The contract is for a 324 MW / 2,592 MWh Pumped Storage Plant (PSP) and will be for a duration of 40 years from the Scheduled Commencement of Supply Date. The company will commence supply of storage capacity within 36 months of the effective date of the Pumped Storage Purchase Agreement (PPA). The annual fixed charge for the 324 MW capacity is ₹351.3 crore, based on an annual fixed charge of ₹1.0841826 crore/MW/Year with an annual cycle loss of 24.61%. SECI will sign the PPA with Tata Power after signing a Pumped Storage Sale Agreement with buying entities.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Business Update   Expansion of Retail Media Portfolio through Launch of In-Store Fragrance Solutions
announcements.ai_summary: Radiowalla Network Limited has announced a strategic expansion of its retail media portfolio by launching in-store fragrance solutions. This move enhances the company's multisensory customer engagement platform, complementing its existing offerings of in-store audio, digital signage, and digital media solutions. The company's integrated platform is currently utilized by over 700 brands across more than 33,000 locations, serving diverse sectors including retail, hospitality, and automotive. The new fragrance solution integrates with the company's technology-driven features like AI-powered music curation and multilingual voiceovers to create immersive brand experiences. Radiowalla is observing increased demand from organized retail chains in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities and is also expanding its presence in the Middle East and Africa. This expansion aims to bolster the company's ability to deliver comprehensive multisensory retail media solutions.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 18, 2026, titled "NATCO received Tentative Approval for Olaparib Tablets from the United States Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA)".
announcements.ai_summary: Natco Pharma Limited has received tentative approval from the United States Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) for its Olaparib Tablets (100 mg and 150 mg). This approval, received on July 18, 2026, confirms that the tablets are bioequivalent to the reference listed drug, Lynparza® tablets of AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals, for the indicated use. Natco Pharma will manufacture the Olaparib tablets, and its partner, Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, will handle the distribution in the U.S. The company notes that Para IV litigation is ongoing. The estimated U.S. sales for Olaparib tablets were approximately USD 1.4 billion for the 12 months ending March 2026.

In SLP(C) No. 24361-24364/2023, the Supreme Court has directed JPL to deposit the award amount concerning Respondent No. 1, Amar Kumar Singh, and Respondent No. 2, Kishan Lal, within four weeks from July 15, 2026. The Court has clarified that this deposit will not be considered a concession by JPL and will not have a binding effect on any pending proceedings. The prayer by the respondent workmen for the release of the amount has been rejected at this stage. The company has enclosed a copy of the order, which was made available on July 17, 2026, and states that it does not foresee any material impact on its operations.

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: Chemplast Sanmar Limited has informed the Exchange about Disruption of Operations
announcements.ai_summary: Chemplast Sanmar Limited has reported a minor fire incident that occurred on the morning of July 17, 2026, at approximately 10:30 AM at its Ethylene-Di-Chloride (EDC) manufacturing plant in Karaikal, Puducherry. Fortunately, there were no injuries or casualties. The company is currently assessing the impact of the fire on the equipment, instruments, and electrical installations within the EDC plant. Chemplast Sanmar Limited is taking all necessary measures to restore operations at the EDC plant as soon as possible and will provide further updates on material developments. The damage caused by the fire is adequately covered by insurance. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Cipla Limited has informed the Exchange about USFDA inspection at InvaGen manufacturing facility in Central Islip, Long Island, NY, USA

Cipla Limited has stated its commitment to working closely with the USFDA and addressing the observation comprehensively within the stipulated time. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Ahlada Engineers Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Ahlada Engineers Limited's Management Committee of the Board of Directors, in a meeting held on April 18, 2026, approved the incorporation of a subsidiary company in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The proposed subsidiary, which will be a wholly-owned entity of Ahlada Engineers Limited, will focus on the trading, distribution, and marketing of steel products and other allied products, including Steel Doors, Windows, and RO water purifier Systems. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - Disclosure of Divergence in asset classification and provisioning for NPAs
announcements.ai_summary: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited has disclosed divergences in asset classification and provisioning for Non-Performing Assets (NPAs) as per the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) Risk Assessment Report for the fiscal year 2024-25. As of March 31, 2025, the bank reported Gross NPAs of ₹750 crore, while the RBI assessed them at ₹919 crore, indicating a divergence of ₹169 crore. Similarly, Net NPAs reported were ₹254 crore, with the RBI assessment at ₹423 crore, a divergence of ₹169 crore. Provisions for NPAs reported were ₹495 crore, and the RBI assessed them at ₹537 crore, a divergence of ₹42 crore. The reported Profit before Provisions and Contingencies for the year ended March 31, 2025, was ₹1,226 crore, and the reported Net Profit after Tax (PAT) was ₹501 crore. The adjusted (notional) Net Profit after considering the divergence in provisioning is ₹459 crore. The bank has stated that this divergence has no impact on the Profit and Loss for FY 2026-27.

announcements.ai_summary: NAVA LIMITED has reported an inadvertent email incident involving its material subsidiary, Maamba Energy Ltd. Walker Chandiok & Co LLP, mistakenly sent draft management accounts for Maamba Energy Ltd. for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, to an unintended recipient. This disclosure is made as a matter of abundant caution and good corporate governance.

The Hon’ble Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh, Shri Vinai Kumar Saxena, unveiled a commemorative plaque marking this significant milestone. This achievement advances India’s first demonstration-scale geothermal power project at Puga, aiming to provide clean, dependable, and round-the-clock energy to Ladakh, especially during the region's severe winters. The project is a joint initiative by ONGC Energy Centre, the UT Administration of Ladakh, and LAHDC-Leh, under a five-year collaboration renewed in June 2026. Director (Technology and Field Services) Shri Vikram Saxena represented ONGC, emphasizing the company's commitment to innovation and energy security for Ladakh and India.

The RBI has imposed a monetary penalty of ₹ 5.80 Lakhs on the company. This penalty is for non-compliance with specific provisions of the Reserve Bank of India (Know Your Customer) Directions, 2016. announcements.detail: Sterlite Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 17, 2026, titled "STL expands its optical connectivity portfolio in the US with theCONCAT solution".
announcements.ai_summary: Sterlite Technologies Limited, through its US subsidiary STL Optical Connectivity NA, LLC, has announced the expansion of its optical connectivity portfolio in the US with the launch of its new advanced FTTH solution, CONCAT. This launch follows successful field trials conducted on the networks of a major US telecom service provider. The CONCAT solution is designed to enable faster fiber rollouts with reduced deployment complexity and labor, potentially offering up to 71% in labor cost savings by minimizing field splicing through factory-assembled, pre-connectorized fiber segments. This plug-and-play solution simplifies fiber deployment by shifting critical processes to a controlled manufacturing environment, ensuring consistent quality and lower operational risk. CONCAT is suitable for new builds, network expansions, and overbuild programs aiming to meet aggressive broadband coverage and speed targets.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Bharat Gears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'. We refer to our letter dated January 23, 2026 wherein, pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (the Regulations), we informed you that at the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company held on January 23, 2026, the Board considered the legal opinion and opined that the power to determine the citizenship status of Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company vests exclusively with the Central Government and, accordingly, concluded that until any direction or order is issued by the Central Government in respect of his citizenship status, the citizenship status of Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company, continues to remain unchanged and he shall be regarded as a citizen of India. Thus, he shall continue to discharge his responsibilities as Chairman and Managing Director.This is to further inform you that the Board members have received an intimation from Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company vide his e-mail dated April 16, 2026 that he has received a communication from the Regional Passport Office regarding the revocation of his passport, with a right of appeal to the Central Passport Office. Acting on legal advice, he has promptly filed an appeal on April 15, 2026 before the competent authority at the Central Passport Office, seeking (i) a stay of the revocation during the pendency of the appeal and (ii) quashing of the revocation order.Mr. Kanwar has further clarified that as he concludes that the Central Passport Office is the authority empowered to adjudicate the revocation, he has immediately informed the Board at this substantive juncture i.e., upon filing the appeal.Mr. Kanwar has reiterated that the determination of his citizenship status lies exclusively with the Central Government (Ministry of Home Affairs) and the Board of Directors of the Company duly noted this position at its meeting held on January 23, 2026, after considering the independent legal opinion. Separately, he has also written to the Secretaries of the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Ministry of External Affairs vide his letter dated March 30, 2026 (through Speed Post on April 04, 2026), seeking clarification on his citizenship status, to which reply is still awaited.Mr. Kanwar has also assured that he remains fully mindful of his fiduciary duties and will continue to keep the Board promptly informed of any material developments and advised that the statutory authorities be informed accordingly in a fair and transparent manner.The Company will keep you informed of any material developments in this matter, as and when required, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.You are requested to kindly take the same on record.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Bharat Gears Limited provided an update regarding the citizenship status of its Chairman and Managing Director, Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar. Following a communication from the Regional Passport Office regarding the revocation of his passport, Mr. Kanwar filed an appeal on April 15, 2026, seeking a stay and quashing of the revocation order. He has reiterated that the determination of his citizenship status rests exclusively with the Central Government. Mr. Kanwar has also written to the Ministry of Home Affairs and Ministry of External Affairs for clarification, with a reply still awaited. He assured the board of his continued commitment to his fiduciary duties and will keep them informed of material developments.

announcements.subject: Press Release

announcements.ai_summary: Embassy Developments Limited has provided an update on legal proceedings concerning land held by its subsidiary, Embassy East Business Park Limited (EEBPL). On June 15, 2026, the Division Bench of the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka set aside a previous order dated May 12, 2026, which had allowed a writ petition by EEBPL and nullified a resumption order by the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board (KIADB) for approximately 78 acres of land. The CoE will focus on developing repeatable delivery methodologies and enterprise-grade execution to embed AI into core business workflows across various industries. Wipro is also building a global talent pool of Forward Deployed Engineers trained on Claude models to work within client environments. A key objective is to certify 10,000 Front-Line Delivery Experts on Claude usage within the next 18 months, enhancing their capability to design, deploy, and operate AI-enabled systems. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Inventure Growth & Securities Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Inventure Growth & Securities Limited has filed a criminal complaint with the Senior Inspector of Police, MIDC Police Station, Andheri East, Mumbai, and a copy has been marked to the Joint Commissioner of Police, Economic Offences Wing (EOW), Mumbai. This action is taken due to fraudulent activities and misuse of the company's name and corporate identity by unknown third parties. These perpetrators have illicitly cloned the company's name and goodwill to illegally solicit and misappropriate public investment monies. They have set up a proprietary concern and a bank account under the deceptively identical name "Inventure Growth and Securities," omitting the word "Limited." The fraudulent operations are channeled through Current Account No. 103226900000252 with Yes Bank Limited, Chembur Branch, Mumbai. Counterfeit documents bearing the company's name were fabricated to deceive retail clients into delivering deposits. The company is seeking investigative and preventive intervention against these unauthorized third-party perpetrators.

announcements.detail: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 16, 2026, titled "Inox Wind Signs MoU with Inox Clean for the Supply of 1,500 MW of Wind Turbines".
announcements.ai_summary: Inox Wind Limited (IWL) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Inox Clean Energy (Inox Clean) to supply 1,500 MW of wind turbines. The agreement involves supplying IWL’s advanced 3.3 MW and 4X MW wind turbines for renewable energy projects developed by Inox Clean across India. This collaboration is part of the INOXGFL Group’s integrated renewable strategy, aiming to create a comprehensive renewable energy ecosystem. Inox Clean, the Group's renewable IPP and solar cell & module manufacturing business, plans to add over 3 GW of renewable capacity annually and targets an operational portfolio of 14 GW by FY29. Approximately 20%–30% of these annual additions are expected to be wind, providing multi-year order visibility for Inox Wind.

announcements.subject: Rumour Verification - Regulation 30(11)
announcements.detail: Pine Labs Limited has informed the Exchange about Rumour Verification - Regulation 30(11)
announcements.ai_summary: Pine Labs Limited has issued a clarification under Regulation 30(11) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, in response to an article published by entrackr.com on June 15, 2026. The company states that the media reports regarding its profit story and gift card income stream being impacted are speculative, incorrect, and misleading. Pine Labs primarily operates through co-branded program structures where any breakage income belongs to the partner brand, not Pine Labs, and has never constituted a material part of its revenue or profit. Under these arrangements, unutilized balances are retained by the brand partner for reinvestment in customer acquisition and engagement. Consequently, the company does not foresee any meaningful impact on its business, revenue, or profitability, even with potential additional guidance or regulations from the RBI regarding breakage income.

announcements.detail: Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited has informed the Exchange that Al Tasnim Group, one of the leading food distribution companies in the Sultanate of Oman, will distribute Aeroplane Rice products in the Sultanate of Oman.
announcements.ai_summary: Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited has announced a strategic distribution agreement with Al Tasnim Group, a leading food distribution company in Oman. This partnership will enable Al Tasnim Group to distribute Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar's Aeroplane Rice products across the Sultanate of Oman. The collaboration aims to strengthen the presence of premium-quality Aeroplane Brand rice products in the Omani market by leveraging Al Tasnim Group's extensive distribution network and market expertise. This move is part of Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar Exports Ltd.'s international growth strategy, focusing on delivering superior food products and enhancing customer satisfaction. The arrangement reflects a shared commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainable business growth between the two companies, further bolstering trade relations between India and Oman.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Dev Accelerator Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Monthly Newsletter - May 2026 Edition'.
announcements.ai_summary: Dev Accelerator Limited has released its Monthly Newsletter for May 2026. This newsletter provides updates on the company's progress, market signals, and ongoing work. The company highlights its focus on understanding and optimizing existing spaces rather than solely on cost. In recent news, DevX was featured on the cover of Mint Catalyst, discussing the future of work and the rise of Tier 2 cities for building teams. Additionally, DevX has opened a new office at Million Minds Tech City in Ahmedabad, an IT SEZ inaugurated by Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Gujarat CM Bhupendra Patel. The newsletter also references a Cushman & Wakefield report and notes India's leadership in the APAC flexible office market, with Bengaluru leading in flexible office stock among 20 APAC cities. The company emphasizes that its business is measured by the people it serves, not just square footage.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Physicswallah Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition/Investment in Guiding Light Education Technologies Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Physicswallah Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting on July 16, 2026, approved the Tranche II acquisition of Guiding Light Education Technologies Private Limited ("Sarrthi IAS"). This follows the initial Shareholders' Agreement and Share Purchase Agreement dated September 2, 2025, to acquire up to 85% of Sarrthi IAS in six tranches from FY2026 to FY2031, based on an EBITDA-based valuation. Physicswallah Limited had previously completed Tranche I, acquiring 40% of Sarrthi IAS, making it an associate. For Tranche II, the Board approved an Addendum to the SPA, revising the valuation methodology and purchase consideration, leading to the acquisition of an additional 1,100 equity shares, representing 11% of Sarrthi IAS, for INR 71,81,47,100. Upon completion of Tranche II, Physicswallah Limited's shareholding in Sarrthi IAS will increase from 40% to 51%, making Sarrthi IAS a subsidiary of the company. The acquisition of the remaining tranches will proceed in accordance with the original EBITDA-based valuation mechanism.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Arihant Academy Limited has informed the Exchange about Clarification on Market Rumours.
announcements.ai_summary: Arihant Academy Limited issued a clarification on July 16, 2026, addressing market rumours regarding an alleged takeover, acquisition, or merger of Mahesh Tutorials (MT Educare Ltd.). The company categorically denied these claims, stating that such reports are misleading and unauthorised. Arihant Academy Limited clarified that it has only extended coaching support to certain eligible students of Mahesh Tutorials on a purely humanitarian and best-effort basis, which commenced last month. This arrangement is solely intended to support affected students due to operational challenges faced by MT Educare Ltd. and does not constitute a takeover, acquisition, merger, transfer, or assumption of MT Educare Ltd.'s business, employees, assets, liabilities, or contractual obligations. Investors are advised to rely only on official communications from Arihant Academy Limited.

announcements.ai_summary: OSEL Devices Limited has entered into a strategic OEM Cooperation Agreement with Colorlight Cloud Tech Ltd., Shenzhen, China, on July 16, 2026. This partnership aims to transform OSEL's operational model from importing core LED display technology to becoming a self-reliant domestic manufacturer under the "Make in India" initiative. Colorlight, a global leader in LED display control systems and video processors, will provide product designs, Bill of Materials (BOM), CKD/SKD kits, and components. This collaboration will enable OSEL to indigenously manufacture LED controllers and/or video processors at its advanced facility.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: CEAT Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: CEAT Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 16, 2026, approved a significant capital expenditure for capacity addition. The company plans to add approximately 53,000 tyres per day to its existing capacity, which is currently about 80,000 tyres per day and operating at ~95% utilization. This expansion is expected to be implemented progressively in phases by the end of FY2031. The total investment required for this expansion is approximately Rs. 1,205 Crores, which will be funded through a mix of internal accruals and debt. This expansion is being undertaken because the existing production capacity for two-wheeler tyres at the Nagpur plant is nearing full utilization, necessitating proactive capacity planning.

announcements.detail: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Operations Update for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, titled "Ajmera Realty reports sales value and collections of INR 146 crore and INR 173 crore respectively."
announcements.ai_summary: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd (ARIIL) released its operational update for Q1FY27 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) on July 16, 2026, reporting a sales value of INR 146 crore, marking a 35% year-on-year growth. Collections for the quarter stood at INR 173 crore. The sales area for Q1FY27 was 43,737 sq. ft., which represents a 31% year-on-year decrease, while collections decreased by 26% year-on-year. Mr. Dhaval Ajmera, Director - Corporate Affairs, noted that performance was impacted by global geopolitical tensions, elevated input costs, cautious homebuyer sentiment, and a planned absence of new project launches during the quarter. The company is now calibrating its deep launch pipeline for optimal project rollouts.

announcements.ai_summary: Jindal Worldwide Limited has provided an update on expected export growth due to the India-UK Free Trade Agreement (FTA), as per Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company views the FTA as a landmark development that will significantly enhance the competitiveness of Indian textile exports and create substantial long-term growth opportunities. The agreement is expected to eliminate tariffs on Indian textile products, providing a level playing field in the UK market. Jindal Worldwide Limited anticipates its exports to grow by approximately 15-20% in FY27 and aims to more than double its exports over the next three years, driven by improved market access and enhanced global competitiveness.

The company also emphasized its robust governance frameworks and responsible manufacturing practices. These recognitions are expected to reinforce stakeholder value creation and leadership in plant transformation.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 16, 2026, titled "Waaree Energy Storage Solutions Commences India s Advanced Automated BESS Container Manufacturing Facility."
announcements.ai_summary: Waaree Energy Storage Solutions Pvt Ltd (Waaree ESS), a subsidiary of Waaree Energies Limited, announced on July 16, 2026, the commencement of its Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Container Manufacturing Facility. This facility boasts a manufacturing capacity of 5.15 GWh, which has been uprated from an originally planned 3.5 GWh due to production throughput debottlenecking and improved battery cell energy density. The facility incorporates advanced Industry 4.0 technologies, including Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), intelligent material handling, automated assembly lines, and sophisticated testing and quality assurance systems. Designed for utility-scale and commercial & industrial applications, this BESS container facility represents the first milestone in Waaree ESS's ambitious 20 GWh manufacturing roadmap. Furthermore, within the current financial year, Waaree ESS plans to operationalize an additional 5.15 GWh of Battery Pack Manufacturing and 3.5 GWh of Lithium Cell Manufacturing to establish a robust domestic energy storage ecosystem.

announcements.ai_summary: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has announced the integration of UIDAI’s Aadhaar Offline Verification Framework into its health benefits platforms, following its registration as an Offline Verification Seeking Entity (OVSE). This integration, effective July 16, 2026, enables secure, consent-based identity verification for members, reducing paperwork and the risk of identity misuse. The capability allows for quick and secure identity verification with explicit consent, sharing only necessary information. This move aims to simplify verification, safeguard member privacy, and enhance trust in the healthcare benefits ecosystem by reducing manual documentation and supporting faster claims processing for insurers and employers. The Aadhaar Offline Verification capability will be extended to TPAs, insurers, and pension funds utilizing Medi Assist’s technology platforms.

announcements.ai_summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) and Google Cloud have jointly launched the Consumer Business Group (CBG) Gemini Experience Center (GEC) in Kolkata. This center is focused on accelerating the adoption of agentic AI for the Consumer Business Group vertical. The Kolkata GEC is TCS's eighth such center globally and its third in India, following centers in Chennai (Retail) and Bengaluru (BFSI). TCS plans to establish a total of 10 GECs worldwide by the end of 2026, with four of them in India. This initiative aims to strengthen TCS's global innovation footprint and its partnerships with hyperscalers to assist enterprises in AI-enabled transformation. The center will allow consumer businesses to co-create, test, and scale AI-led offerings.
