announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Rategain Travel Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 16, 2026, titled "Press Release on  Citrus Leisure Partners with RateGain s UNO Direct Stack to Power the End-to-End Direct Booking Journey Across Sri Lanka ".
announcements.ai_summary: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited has announced a strategic partnership with Citrus Leisure PLC, a leading hospitality group in Sri Lanka. Through this partnership, Citrus Leisure will leverage RateGain's UNO Direct Stack to enhance its end-to-end direct booking journey across its hotel portfolio. The UNO Direct Stack will integrate guest acquisition, digital marketing, website management, booking conversion, distribution, and pricing intelligence into a single platform. This initiative aims to help Citrus Leisure increase direct revenue, improve booking conversion rates, and reduce reliance on third-party booking channels. This consolidation of revenue-generating capabilities is considered one of the most comprehensive by a Sri Lankan hospitality group. The press release was issued on July 16, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Equippp Social Impact Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release titled "EQUIPPP Signs MoU with Telangana State Legislature Secretariat to build, operate and transfer 119 Constituency Development & Sustainability Bridge Foundations".
announcements.ai_summary: Equippp Social Impact Technologies Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Telangana State Legislature Secretariat. This agreement is to build, operate, and transfer 119 Constituency Development & Sustainability Bridge Foundations, with one foundation to be established in each Assembly Constituency in Telangana. These foundations will function as independent non-profit Section 8 companies under the Companies Act, dedicated to constituency development and sustainability. They will act as a bridge between MLAs, government departments, technology partners, social impact investors, corporations, CSR foundations, philanthropies, development agencies, NGOs, and academia. The press release regarding this MoU was issued on July 16, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Smarten Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 16, 2026, titled "Smarten Appoints Ranjit Singh as Chief Operating Officer to Drive the Next Phase of Operational Excellence".
announcements.ai_summary: Smarten Power Systems Limited has announced the appointment of Ranjit Singh as its Chief Operating Officer (COO), effective August 1, 2026. This appointment was approved by the Board on July 14, 2026. Mr. Singh is an industry veteran with over five decades of experience and is expected to enhance the company's manufacturing, operations, and business scalability. Smarten Power Systems is an Indian company specializing in power backup and solar energy solutions for residential and commercial use, with a presence across India and exports to over 17 countries. The company focuses on advancing renewable energy adoption through continuous investment in design, research, development, and manufacturing capabilities. This press release was issued on July 16, 2026.

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: Equippp Social Impact Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about the execution of Memorandum of Understanding with The Secretary To Legislature (ASSEMBLY) Telangana State Legislature Secretariat, Hyderabad on 15th July 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Equippp Social Impact Technologies Limited has executed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with The Secretary To Legislature (ASSEMBLY) Telangana State Legislature Secretariat, Hyderabad, on July 15, 2026. This MoU outlines the plan to build, operate, and transfer 119 Constituency Development & Sustainability Bridge Foundations, with one foundation in each Assembly Constituency in Telangana. These foundations will function as independent non-profit Section 8 companies focused on constituency development and sustainability. They aim to facilitate cross-sector collaboration by connecting MLAs, government departments, technology partners, investors, corporations, and NGOs. MLAs will act as Constituency Development Champions, identifying priorities and facilitating resource mobilization, but will not be involved in the day-to-day management of the Foundations.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Shyam Metalics And Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 16, 2026, titled "Shyam Metalics Commissions Aluminium Foil Facility in Odisha; Aluminium FRP plant on Track for September Launch".
announcements.ai_summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited has announced the commissioning of its Aluminium Foil facility in Sambalpur, Odisha, through its step-down subsidiary, SMEL Steel Structural Pvt. Ltd. This facility has an installed operational capacity of 18,000 tonnes per annum (TPA) and can produce foils with thicknesses ranging from 6 to 40 microns. Additionally, the company confirmed that its Aluminium Flat Rolled Products (FRP) facility is in its final readiness phase and is scheduled for a commercial launch by September 2026. The FRP facility will have an installed capacity of 60,000 TPA and will produce products with thicknesses between 0.3 to 4.0 mm. The total investment in these aluminium facilities in Sambalpur is approximately INR 800 crore.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bajaj Auto Limited has informed the Exchange about ad hoc announcement made by Bajaj Mobility AG (formerly PIERER Mobility AG), a step-down subsidiary of Bajaj Auto Limited titled - Preliminary figures for Q2 / 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Bajaj Auto Limited has informed the Exchange about an ad hoc announcement made by its step-down subsidiary, Bajaj Mobility AG (formerly PIERER Mobility AG). The announcement provides preliminary figures for the second quarter of 2026 (Q2/2026). Key highlights include a revenue of EUR 370 million for Bajaj Mobility AG in Q2/26, a significant increase from EUR 231 million in Q2/25. Motorcycle sales for Q2/26 reached 48,672 units, a 71% rise compared to 28,471 units in Q2/25. The company expects an EBITDA margin of approximately 8.7% for Q2/26, a notable improvement from -55.6% in Q2/25. These figures reflect strong performance and growth for the subsidiary.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Biocon Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Company Statement'.
announcements.ai_summary: Biocon Limited has announced that its subsidiary, Biocon Malaysia, has received approval from the European Medicines Agency (EMA) for a new drug product fill finish line. This new facility is for Semglee® (insulin glargine) at its insulin manufacturing site in Malaysia. The company expects to commence supplies to Europe from this new line starting in the second quarter of the financial year 2027 (Q2FY27). This development signifies an expansion in Biocon's insulin manufacturing capabilities and its reach into the European market.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Acme Solar Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 16, 2026, titled "ACME Solar raises INR 2,646.64crore project funding for 450MW/1800MWh FDRE Project from REC Ltd".
announcements.ai_summary: Acme Solar Holdings Limited has announced that it has secured INR 2,646.64 crore in long-term project funding from REC Ltd for its 450MW/1800MWh ACME Greentech Seventh Assured Peak Power Project. This funding will be utilized for the development and construction of the project. REC Ltd will be the sole financier for this project for a tenure of 20 years. The Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) for this project was previously signed with SJVN Limited at a tariff of INR 6.74 per unit for a period of 25 years. The project integrates renewable energy technologies, including Solar and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), to ensure predictability and dispatchability.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release titled KPI Green Energy Receives Inter-State Power Trading Licence from CERC, Enabling Pan-India Market Participation'.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: KPI Green Energy Limited has received an Inter-State Power Trading Licence (Category IV) from the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC). This license complements the existing intra-state power trading license from the Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission (GERC). The combined approvals enable KPI Green Energy to participate in pan-India power trading, establishing a comprehensive platform. This strategic move allows the company to access demand centers across multiple states, dynamically allocate power based on market conditions for improved realisations, and engage with a wider spectrum of customers.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Firstsource Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 16, 2026, titled "Firstsource Launches Kairos   The Operating System Powering Intelligence That Operates".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Firstsource Solutions Limited has issued a press release on April 16, 2026, announcing the launch of "Kairos — The Operating System Powering Intelligence That Operates." Kairos is described as an embedded intelligence engine designed to build and operate agentic workflows across enterprise transformation. The company highlights that the gap in operational performance between enterprises successfully leveraging AI and those still struggling has reached 540 basis points and is widening. Firstsource Solutions, an RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group company, states that Kairos integrates within existing operations to run agentic workflows end-to-end and is accountable for outcomes, having been tested internally before market release.

The hotel will feature 56 rooms and aims to cater to business travelers and corporate clients, with amenities including an all-day dining restaurant, banqueting facilities, a gym, spa, and swimming pool. This strategic move diversifies the subsidiary's business portfolio and expands into the hospitality sector with scalable growth opportunities, aiming to create long-term value from the current financial year onwards.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 16, 2026, titled "ABD Maestro Wins  Distiller of the Year  at the 15th Icons of Whisky India Awards 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited has announced that its subsidiary, ABD Maestro Private Limited, has won the 'Distiller of the Year' award at the 15th Icons of Whisky India Awards 2026. This accolade marks ABD Maestro's first anniversary and its establishment of a portfolio of ten brands. The company's brand ARTHAUS Blended Malt Scotch also received the 'Campaign Innovator of the Year' award. The Icons of Whisky Awards are considered a respected global benchmark for innovation, craftsmanship, and leadership in the alcobev production industry. ABD Maestro was the only Indian company to receive the 'Distiller of the Year' honor, standing alongside six other international players. This recognition highlights the growing appetite among Indian consumers for premium, globally benchmarked spirits.

The order inflow aligns with increasing investments in transmission infrastructure globally and domestically.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Aequs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release, titled "Aequs and IIT Dharwad Roll Out Advanced Materials R&D Ecosystem".
announcements.ai_summary: Aequs Limited announced on May 15, 2026, the establishment of an advanced research and development ecosystem for materials science and manufacturing innovation in collaboration with the Indian Institute of Technology - Dharwad (IIT-D) at the IIT-D campus. This facility is equipped to support advanced material characterization, failure analysis, manufacturing process simulation, and optimization, fostering deeper industry-academia collaboration. This initiative will lay the foundation for a dedicated "IIT Dharwad – Aequs Research and Development Center" to accelerate applied research and bridge the gap between laboratory science and industrial application. Aravind Melligeri, Executive Chairman and CEO of Aequs, emphasized the commitment to strengthening India’s advanced manufacturing ecosystem. Prof. Venkappayya R. Desai, Director of IIT-D, highlighted the importance of strengthening industry-aligned research and providing students with real-world exposure.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Greaves Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 15, 2026, titled "Please find attached the Press Release issued by Greaves Electric Mobility Limited, subsidiary of the Company, with the heading  Ampere Magnus G Max by Greaves Electric Mobility wins  Family Scooter of the Year  at Times Drive Auto Summit and Awards 2026 .Please take the same on record.
announcements.ai_summary: Greaves Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange about a press release issued by its subsidiary, Greaves Electric Mobility Limited (GEML). GEML's e-scooter, the Ampere Magnus G Max, has won the 'Family Scooter of the Year' award at the Times Drive Auto Summit and Awards 2026. This recognition highlights GEML's Ampere brand's growing position in the Indian electric mobility market, driven by its focus on dependable, family-oriented electric scooters. The Ampere Magnus G Max, launched in January 2026, offers a certified range of 142 kms, LFP battery technology, and 33L boot space. Vikas Singh, Managing Director of Greaves Electric Mobility, stated that the award reinforces their commitment to providing practical, safe, and durable electric mobility solutions for Indian families at an affordable price point.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Arvind SmartSpaces Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 15, 2026, titled "We are attaching herewith a copy of Media Release dated 15th June, 2026, being issued by the Company titled as  Arvind SmartSpaces adds new horizontal development project in Metal, South Ahmedabad with a top-line potential of Rs. 180 crore.".

This project, located on Kerala-Nalsarovar Road, is a Joint Development project spanning 58.25 acres and offering a saleable area of 2.5 million square feet. The company views South Ahmedabad as a promising micro-market for plotted developments and weekend homes due to increasing demand and improved infrastructure. Mr. Priyansh Kapoor, MD and CEO of Arvind SmartSpaces, expressed optimism about capitalizing on growth opportunities in the horizontal real estate segment in Ahmedabad.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 15, 2026, titled "Oil India Limited Signs MoU with CSIR for Collaborative Research and Technology Development".
announcements.ai_summary: Oil India Limited (OIL) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) on June 15, 2026, to foster collaborative research and technology development in the energy sector. This MoU aims to leverage the strengths of both organizations in areas such as upstream and downstream oil and gas operations, hydrocarbon reservoir optimization, enhanced oil recovery (EOR), renewable energy, sustainable energy practices, and critical minerals. The collaboration is intended to develop efficient and cost-effective solutions focused on operational efficiency. This initiative underscores OIL's commitment to enhancing its technological capabilities through strategic partnerships with leading research institutions, supporting innovation-driven growth and the nation's energy security objectives.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: GMR AIRPORTS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Monthly Traffic Update for May 2026
announcements.ai_summary: GMR Airports Limited has released its monthly traffic update for May 2026, indicating a resilient performance across its portfolio airports. In May 2026, the company served approximately 11 million passengers, marking a year-on-year increase of 0.6 million or 6.1%. Domestic traffic contributed 8.3 million passengers (up 7.9% YoY), while international traffic reached 2.4 million passengers (up 0.4% YoY). The company has sustained monthly traffic above 10 million passengers since October 2025. For the year-to-date FY27, GMR Airports has surpassed 20.4 million passengers, its highest ever, with domestic traffic at a record 15.8 million passengers, largely driven by Delhi Airport's performance, which accounts for approximately 68% of the total traffic. The company also achieved record-breaking ATM (Aircraft Movement) figures and cargo volumes in May 2026 and YTD FY27, particularly at Delhi Airport. Hyderabad Airport reported its highest domestic passenger and domestic ATM figures since December 2025, and Goa Airport recorded its highest total passenger and domestic passenger figures in YTD FY27.

This strategic move aims to strengthen the company's global footprint.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Shriram Properties Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 15, 2026, titled "Shriram Properties Signs JDA for Premium Residential Project in Bengaluru".
announcements.ai_summary: Shriram Properties Limited has signed a Joint Development Agreement (JDA) for a 9.1-acre land parcel located at Doddagubbi, North-East Bengaluru. The company plans to develop an apartment complex on this land, with a development potential of approximately 6.7 lakh sqft and an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) potential exceeding ₹600 crores. The project is slated for launch during the current financial year. This strategically located site offers excellent connectivity to key areas of Bengaluru, including major IT hubs and commercial centers. The development will focus on thoughtfully planned homes, natural ventilation, green spaces, and modern lifestyle conveniences, with a scenic lake-facing setting. This JDA further strengthens Shriram Properties' development pipeline in Bengaluru and aligns with their strategy of expanding through asset-light development models in high-potential micro-markets.

announcements.subject: Press Release

The construction contract is valued at over ₹850 crore and covers the complete civil and structural works for the project. Embassy Citadel, a ~1.6 million sq. ft. development with an estimated gross development value of ~₹8,800 crore, will feature 316 residences, two exclusive triplex mansion homes, and extensive amenities across seven lifestyle floors, including a 79th-floor Sky Lounge. This appointment marks Embassy Developments' strategic expansion into Mumbai's residential market, with the development designed as a vertically integrated luxury ecosystem focused on wellness and hospitality-inspired living.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: TCI Express Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Please find enclosed the BRSR of FY 2025-2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: TCI Express Limited has submitted its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR) for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, as required by SEBI regulations. The report is an integral part of the company's Annual Report for FY 2025-26 and is available on their website. The BRSR highlights TCI Express's commitment to addressing challenges like climate change and regulatory expectations through a proactive approach. Key initiatives include increasing renewable energy to 20% of total consumption through solar energy investments. The company also expanded its electric and alternative fuel-based last-mile delivery fleet by 13.2% and promoted rail transport, avoiding approximately 1439 tCO₂e in FY 2025-26. Furthermore, TCI Express prioritized EPD-certified and recycled materials in the construction of new warehouses and buildings.

announcements.ai_summary: Phantom Digital Effects Limited's Board of Directors met on July 15, 2026, and noted a Review Notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) dated June 30, 2026, regarding a fine levied for the delayed submission of Audited Financial Results for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The Board acknowledged the company's proactive intimation on May 28, 2026, about the anticipated delay due to the consolidation of financial statements from newly acquired overseas subsidiaries, Milk Visual Effects Limited (UK) and Tippet Studio Inc. (USA). The audit is currently at an advanced stage, and the company is working to complete remaining formalities to convene Audit Committee and Board meetings for approval of the financial results.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "Investor Release: 15 July 2026, Kolkata".
announcements.ai_summary: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited announced record financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with Revenue reaching Rs. 1,432 Cr, EBITDA at Rs. 313 Cr, and Profit After Tax (PAT) at Rs. 228 Cr. The company highlighted a 33% increase in Revenue and a 27% increase in PAT compared to the previous year. The press release also detailed two significant growth projects: the development of indigenous Carbon Nanotube (CNT) technology with a planned capex of Rs. 70 Crores for a 200 MTPA manufacturing facility targeted for commissioning in Q4FY27, and advancements in entering premium speciality applications through Super Speciality Carbon Black. These initiatives are part of the company's strategy to become a diversified, future-ready global advanced materials company.

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) - receipt of Order from Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health
announcements.ai_summary: Jain Resource Recycling Limited received an Order dated July 14, 2026, from the Office of the Joint Director of Industrial Safety and Health-I, Chennai, under Section 40(2) of the Factories Act, 1948. This order, intimated on July 15, 2026, follows a furnace accident at the company's Unit-II, located at Plot Nos. R1, R2 & R3, SIPCOT Industrial Complex, Pappankuppam, Gummidipoondi, Tiruvallur – 601201, on July 14, 2026. The directive mandates the company to undertake specific corrective and preventive measures, including implementing enhanced safety protocols, repairing and restoring affected infrastructure, and obtaining requisite certifications. Operations at Unit-II cannot recommence until these measures are completed. The company is currently examining the order, initiating action plans for implementation, and preparing an appropriate response for submission to the authorities.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Raghav Productivity Enhancers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "Press Release for the quarter ended June 30, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Raghav Productivity Enhancers Limited (RPEL) announced its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 15, 2026, reporting its highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. On a year-over-year basis, revenue increased by 49% to ₹ 87 Crores, EBITDA grew by 62% to ₹ 26 Crores, and PAT rose by 68% to ₹ 20 Crores, with volumes up 25% to 97K MT. The company noted continued growth momentum, a sequential increase in value-added products driving higher realizations and margin expansion, marking the fourth consecutive quarter of improving 'per MT profitability'. Export volumes increased by 34% quarter-on-quarter, with higher transportation costs fully passed on. The ongoing brownfield expansion and debottlenecking project remains on track for commissioning in October 2026.

announcements.detail: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited, formerly Bartronics India Limited, issued a revised disclosure on July 15, 2026, clarifying its investment in Huwel Lifesciences Private Limited ("Huwel"). The company has made a further investment aggregating to INR 7,50,00,400, revising the previously disclosed amount of INR 4,00,00,000 from the intimation dated April 08, 2026. Pursuant to this investment, Avio Smart Market Stack Limited has acquired 2.06% of the paid-up equity share

announcements.detail: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Security Cover certificate Regulation 54(3) SEBI LODR'.
announcements.ai_summary: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited submitted its Security Cover Certificate to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. on July 15, 2026. This certificate

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: PC Jeweller Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
announcements.ai_summary: PC Jeweller Limited announced on July 15, 2026, a significant update regarding the clearance of its outstanding debt. The company successfully cleared and repaid all outstanding debt to one additional bank, adhering to the terms of a Settlement Agreement dated September 30, 2024. With this recent repayment, PC Jeweller Limited has now fully discharged the outstanding debts of 4 out of its 14 consortium banks. Notably, the outstanding debts for all these four banks were prepaid well in advance of their scheduled due dates. This action aligns with the company's stated objective of achieving a debt-free status within the current quarter.

announcements.subject: Symbol Change of company
announcements.detail: AMIRCHAND: Members of the Exchange are hereby informed that the symbol of Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited shall be changed from AMIRCHAND to AEROPLANE w.e.f. July 20, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: The National Stock Exchange of India Limited issued a circular on July 14, 2026, informing all members about a forthcoming change in the trading symbol for Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited. Effective from July 20, 2026, the company's existing trading symbol "AMIRCHAND" will be officially changed to "AEROPLANE". This change is being implemented across the Exchange to update the company's identifier for trading purposes. Investors and market participants should note this new symbol for all future transactions and references concerning Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited. This ensures accurate identification and compliance with exchange records.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Reliance Industrial Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a Press Release dated July 15, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Reliance Industrial Infrastructure Limited reported its unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 15, 2026. The company's total consolidated income declined by 18.4% year-over-year to ₹1,492 lakh, down from ₹1,828 lakh in the same period of the previous fiscal year, primarily due to the completion of certain fixed-term contracts. Consolidated Net Profit for the quarter reduced by 8.4% year-over-year to ₹284 lakh, compared to ₹310 lakh previously. Earnings Per Share (Basic and Diluted) also decreased by 8.3% to ₹1.88 from ₹2.05 year-over-year. Consolidated EBITDA stood at ₹333 lakh, a 23.8% decrease from ₹437 lakh, and Profit Before Tax was ₹299 lakh, a 25.4% decrease from ₹401 lakh. The full unaudited financial results and media release are available on the company's website at www.riil.in.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Mcleod Russel India Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Mcleod Russel India Limited informed the Exchange on July 15, 2026, that National Asset Reconstruction Company Limited (NARCL), acting as an assignee of HDFC Bank Limited's debt, sought to withdraw its Section 7 application under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The application was originally filed against the Company for an alleged default amount of approximately ₹444.55 crores. The withdrawal was requested due to a Sanction Letter dated April 2, 2026, and subsequent modifications issued by NARCL to the Company for debt restructuring. The Hon'ble NCLT, Kolkata bench, dismissed the application as withdrawn, granting liberty to NARCL to revive it if the restructuring process fails. The Company received e-mail communication of this development on July 14, 2026, and is currently awaiting a certified copy of the order, which has not yet been uploaded on the NCLT website.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: India Pesticides Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation regarding approval of the Fungicide
announcements.ai_summary: India Pesticides Limited announced on July 15, 2026, that it has received Technical Equivalence (TEQ) approval in the European Union (EU) for one of its Fungicide products. This achievement is considered a significant milestone in the Company's global expansion strategy. The approval is expected to strengthen India Pesticides Limited's export business by enhancing its access to the European market. The company anticipates that this development will contribute positively to its export revenues and augment foreign exchange earnings for the country.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Certificate on non-convertible securities as per Regulation 52(7) and 52(7A) of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations 2015'.
announcements.ai_summary: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited confirmed on July 15, 2026, that the proceeds from its non-convertible securities were utilized for the specific purposes for which they were raised. The company provided a certificate in compliance with Regulation 52(7) and 52(7A) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The intimation explicitly stated that there were no material deviations in the use of proceeds from the issue of non-convertible debt securities compared to the objects outlined in the offer document. This confirms proper fund utilization as per regulatory requirements.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: The Karnataka Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "Karnataka Bank announces joining of Mrs. Biji Sreekrishnavilas Sankaranarayanan as its new Executive Director".
announcements.ai_summary: The Karnataka Bank Limited announced the joining of Mrs. Biji Sreekrishnavilas Sankaranarayanan as its new Executive Director, effective from July 15, 2026. Mrs. Biji S.S. is a Strategic Banking Leader bringing 31 years of extensive experience from a South Indian bank, covering corporate banking, retail & branch banking, liabilities, secured assets, transformation, and digital modernization. Her proven track record includes steering nationwide banking networks as independent profit centres, scaling corporate banking verticals, strengthening risk frameworks, improving asset quality, and enhancing customer acquisition models. The Bank expressed confidence that her expertise and leadership will significantly contribute to its continued growth and success.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: HDB Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: HDB Financial Services Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1FY27), which were approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on Wednesday, July 15, 2026. The company recorded its highest ever quarterly Profit After Tax (PAT) of ₹785 Crores, marking a significant growth of 38.3% year-on-year compared to ₹568 Crores in Q1FY26. Disbursements for Q1FY27 stood at ₹17,629 Crores, an increase of 16.2% year-on-year, while asset quality continued to improve with Gross Stage 3 at 2.34%. Net interest income rose by 19.9% to ₹2,509 crore from ₹2,092 crore, and pre-provisioning operating profit increased by 25.0% to ₹1,752 crore from ₹1,402 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Adani Power Limited has informed the Exchange about Signing of Power Supply Agreement for the long-term supply of 1600 MW Thermal Power
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Power Limited (APL) has signed a 25-year Power Supply Agreement (PSA) with Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL) for the long-term supply of 1600 MW of thermal power. This power will be supplied from a new 2x800 MW Ultra-Supercritical Thermal power plant, which APL will establish and operate on a Design, Build, Finance, Own & Operate (DBFOO) basis. The coal linkage for this power plant has been allocated under the SHAKTI Policy of the Government of India. This agreement follows a previous intimation made by the company on March 15, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "Key highlights of the financial performance for the quarter ended June 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited announced its financial performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with Profit After Tax (PAT) at ₹155 Crores, a 52% year-on-year increase. Gross Non-Performing Assets (GNPA) improved to 2.24% and Net Non-Performing Assets (NNPA) to 0.85% on Gross Loan Portfolio (GLP). The GLP grew by 26% year-on-year to ₹37,612 crores, with secured assets forming 73% of the portfolio. Total Deposits grew by 22% year-on-year to ₹35,756 crores, and CASA increased by 31% year-on-year. The bank's Capital Adequacy Ratio stood at 20.2%. The Board also approved Tier-1 Capital of Rs. 728 crores via Share Warrants under a Preferential route, with Rs. 103 crores received in June 2026.

announcements.subject: Adoption of new line(s) of business
announcements.detail: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange about Adoption of new line(s) of business
announcements.ai_summary: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited's Board of Directors, in their meeting on July 15, 2026, approved a capital expenditure (capex) of ₹128 Crores for expanding the capacity to manufacture Anthraquinone and Carbazole from 2600 MTPA to 5300 MTPA. This is an addition to the previously approved ₹120 Crores capex for a 2600 MTPA facility. The project will be implemented in two phases, with Phase 1 (2600 MTPA) expected by Q2FY27 and Phase 2 (2700 MTPA) by Q2FY28. Additionally, the Board approved a ₹70 Crores capex for setting up India's first manufacturing facility for Carbon Nano Tubes (CNT) in West Bengal using in-house developed technology. These expansions are aligned with the company's vision to grow into high-value products.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Indiqube Spaces Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "IndiQube Accelerates North India Expansion with 3.9 Lakh Sq. Ft. Office Supply on Noida Expressway.".
announcements.ai_summary: Indiqube Spaces Limited has announced a significant expansion in North India with the addition of a new property spanning approximately 3.9 lakh sq. ft. in Sector 142, Noida. Located on the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway, this 14-floor development is the company's largest center in the NCR region and marks a key step in its North India growth strategy. The new property will be transformed into an integrated, amenitized, and experience-led work environment, catering to the evolving needs of enterprises seeking flexibility and operational readiness. This expansion aligns with IndiQube's strategy of building scale in high-growth corridors by acquiring full buildings.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation'.
announcements.ai_summary: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary Amara Raja Advanced Cell Technologies Private Limited, has commissioned its Customer Qualification Plant (CQP) at its Giga Corridor in Telangana. This facility, with an investment of ₹500 crore, is part of the company's larger ₹9,500 crore, 16 GWh Gigafactory program. The CQP, with an initial capacity of 60 MWh, will manufacture lithium-ion cells in cylindrical and prismatic formats for customer qualification and approval. Commercial-scale cell production is targeted to begin within the next year, with 2 GWh manufacturing on track for CY2027. The commissioning of the CQP aims to accelerate the industrialization of new cell technologies and reduce execution risk as the company scales manufacturing.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Muthoot Microfin Limited has informed the Exchange about Asset Liability Management Certificate for the month  ended June 30, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Muthoot Microfin Limited has submitted its Provisional Asset Liability Management statement for the month ended June 30, 2026, in compliance with SEBI circular SEBI/HO/DDHS/DDHS-PoD/P/CIR/2025/0000000137 dated October 15, 2025. The statement provides a breakdown of outflows across various time buckets, including outflows related to Capital and Reserves & Surplus. Specifically, under Reserves & Surplus, the company reported outflows of ₹2,75,635.60 for the period between 15 days to 30/31 days and ₹5,798.10 for the period beyond 30/31 days. Under Reserves under Sec 45-IC of RBI Act 1934, outflows of ₹24,997.90 were reported for the period between 15 days to 30/31 days and ₹1,164.70 for the period beyond 30/31 days.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Intimation of expansion of order book_DPEL_VIPL
announcements.ai_summary: Divine Power Energy Limited and its wholly owned subsidiary, Vimlesh Industries Private Limited, have secured new orders from existing customers. Divine Power Energy Limited received fresh orders from JAY BEE INDUSTRIES for approximately ₹1.87 Crore and from VOLTOMATIC POWER LIMITED for approximately ₹3.85 Crore. Vimlesh Industries Private Limited secured an order from LUMINOUS POWER TECHNOLOGIES PVT. LTD. for approximately ₹2.88 Crore. These orders underscore the continued confidence of their customers in the company's operational capabilities, product quality, and reliable service. The repetitive nature of these orders from existing clients highlights the company's commitment to customer satisfaction and its ability to foster long-term business relationships.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: TVS Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: TVS Holdings Limited, through its subsidiary Home Credit India Finance Private Limited, has entered into a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) on July 15, 2026, to acquire 100% of the issued, subscribed, and paid-up share capital of Varthana Finance Private Limited. Varthana Finance Private Limited, formerly known as Thirumeni Finance Private Limited, is a Non-Banking Financial Company registered with the Reserve Bank of India. Upon completion of this transaction, Varthana Finance Private Limited will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Home Credit India Finance Private Limited and a step-down wholly owned subsidiary of TVS Holdings Limited. The acquisition is contingent upon receiving the necessary approvals from the Reserve Bank of India and other relevant statutory and regulatory authorities, as stipulated in the SPA.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: WeWork India Management Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "WeWork India launches Member Services, a first-of-its-kind business services platform for members".
announcements.ai_summary: WeWork India Management Limited has announced the launch of "Member Services," a new business services platform designed exclusively for its members. This platform aims to provide enterprise-grade business solutions and access to a curated network of WeWork India-vetted partners. Member Services will offer a comprehensive suite of solutions covering administration and technology, human resources, finance and legal, sustainability and governance, and marketing. The initiative is intended to enhance the value of flexible workspaces by extending support beyond the physical office space, particularly benefiting startups and SMBs. This launch underscores WeWork India's commitment to simplifying access to essential services for its members to facilitate business growth.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Vinati Organics Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Vinati Organics Limited has subscribed to an additional 1,71,10,000 fully paid-up equity shares of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Veeral Organics Pvt. Ltd. These shares, with a face value of ₹ 10/- each, were subscribed at par, amounting to ₹ 17,11,00,000/- (Rupees Seventeen Crore Eleven Lakh only) through a rights issue. The newly issued shares will rank pari-passu with the existing equity shares of Veeral Organics Pvt. Ltd. Veeral Organics Pvt. Ltd. is in the Chemical Industry and had a turnover of ₹ 21.94 Crore in the last financial year. This transaction is considered a related party transaction but is conducted at arm's length, and as Veeral Organics Pvt. Ltd. is a wholly-owned subsidiary, further provisions under SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, for related party transactions are not applicable.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Seamec Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Partial Modification to Outcome of Board meeting dated July 14, 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: Seamec Limited has issued a partial modification to the outcome of its Board Meeting held on July 14, 2026. The modification clarifies that shareholder approval will be sought through a Postal Ballot. This update is due to a typographical error in the previous submission made on July 14, 2026. The company requests that this correction be taken on record by the Stock Exchanges.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Virtual Galaxy Infotech Limited has informed the Exchange about execution of an Addendum to the Agreement with DCB Commercial Bank PLC, Tanzania
announcements.ai_summary: Virtual Galaxy Infotech Limited has executed an Addendum to its existing Software License and Service Level Agreement with DCB Commercial Bank PLC, Tanzania. This agreement extends the post-implementation support and maintenance services for the Company's E-Banker Core Banking Solution Software. The partnership with DCB Commercial Bank PLC, Tanzania, has been ongoing for over ten (10) years, and this Addendum signifies a continuation of this relationship for an additional ten (10) year period. The agreement is set to remain in force for a total of twenty (20) years from the main agreement's execution date of May 28, 2016, extending until May 27, 2036. The aggregate contract value for this agreement is approximately USD 15,39,848.00, exclusive of applicable taxes.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Oriental Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release'.
announcements.ai_summary: Oriental Hotels Limited (OHL) has announced its Unaudited Financial Results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a revenue of INR 114.4 crores, EBITDA of INR 26.6 crores, and a Profit After Tax (PAT) of INR 11.4 crores for the quarter. OHL highlighted that its hotels are advancing their sustainability agenda, with 71% of total energy consumption sourced from renewable energy, aligned with IHCL’s ESG+ framework. The press release also noted that IHCL's brand Taj has been ranked as India’s Strongest Brand 2026 and World’s Strongest Hotel Brand 2025, and OHL has three Taj-branded hotels in its portfolio. The company is undertaking extensive asset enhancement initiatives and expects sustained performance due to continued strength in domestic demand.

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: Mukand Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
announcements.ai_summary: Mukand Limited has executed a Term Sheet on July 15, 2026, with AGP DC Infra Private Limited for the sale of land parcels. The sale includes land admeasuring approximately 35,548.93 square metres (8.78 Acres) and a portion of land admeasuring approximately 1691.64 sq. mtrs (0.42 Acres) for a northern access road. The composite consideration for the land and non-exclusive right of way is approximately Rs. 506 crore, based on a rate of Rs. 55 crore per acre. Mukand Limited has received an advance of Rs. 10 crore from the purchaser. The transaction is subject to obtaining necessary approvals and permissions from the Government of Maharashtra and other concerned authorities, fulfillment of conditions precedent, and satisfactory completion of due diligence by the purchaser.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Bharat Road Network Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Road Network Limited and its subsidiary, Orissa Steel Expressway Private Limited, have received a notice from the Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO) for an investigation under Section 212(1)(c) and calling of information under Section 217(1) of the Companies Act, 2013. The SFIO's investigation is into the affairs of SREI Infrastructure Finance Limited and other companies. The notice was received on July 14, 2026. Currently, the company states that there is no material impact on its financial, operational, or other activities. Bharat Road Network Limited and its subsidiary will cooperate with the SFIO during the investigation.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Ems Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts, Receipt of Letter of Acceptance from UP Jal Nigam (Urban), Varanasi
announcements.ai_summary: EMS Limited has received a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from UP Jal Nigam (Urban), Varanasi, for the Laying of Sewer Network and House Connection work in 18 Problematic Wards of Nagar Nigam, Varanasi. This domestic contract has an estimated order value of approximately Rs. 10,284.76 lakhs, excluding GST. The scope of work includes surveying, soil investigation, design, and supply of all necessary materials and labor on a turnkey basis for laying and jointing sewer networks and providing sewer house connections. The execution period for this order is 24 months. This award follows EMS Limited's earlier intimation of being the lowest bidder for this tender.

announcements.subject: Issue of Securities
announcements.detail: Ather Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about issue of Securities
announcements.ai_summary: Ather Energy Limited has announced a significant fundraising initiative through a preferential issue, aiming to raise up to INR 1,200 Crores. This will be achieved by issuing 16,26,016 fully paid-up equity shares at an issue price of INR 1,230 each to India-Japan Fund, a qualified institutional buyer. Additionally, 7,936,507 convertible warrants, each convertible into one equity share, will be issued at an issue price of INR 1,260 per warrant. These warrants are being allotted to Hero MotoCorp Limited, Mr. Tarun Sanjay Mehta, and Mr. Swapnil Babanlal Jain, who are promoters of the company. The fundraising is subject to regulatory and statutory approvals, as well as the approval of the company's shareholders. The total consideration for the equity shares from India-Japan Fund is INR 1,99,99,99,680, and the aggregate subscription amount for warrants from Hero MotoCorp Limited is INR 9,59,99,99,220.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Ather Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 15, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Ather Energy Limited's Board of Directors met on July 15, 2026, and approved a fund-raising exercise aggregating up to INR 1,200 Crores. This will be achieved through a preferential issue comprising equity shares and convertible warrants. Specifically, 16,26,016 fully paid-up equity shares with a face value of INR 1 each will be issued at an issue price of INR 1,230 each (including a premium of INR 1,229) to India-Japan Fund. Additionally, 79,36,507 convertible warrants, each convertible into one equity share of INR 1 face value, will be issued at an issue price of INR 1,260 per warrant (including a premium of INR 1,259) to Hero MotoCorp Limited, Mr. Tarun Sanjay Mehta, and Mr. Swapnil Babanlal Jain. These issuances are subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals.

announcements.subject: Preferential issue
announcements.detail: Sambhv Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about Preferential issue of Convertible Equity Warrants
announcements.ai_summary: Sambhv Steel Tubes Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 15, 2026, approved the preferential issue of up to 8,695,400 Fully Convertible Equity Warrants. Each warrant has a face value of ₹10 and will be issued at a price of ₹115, which includes a premium of ₹105 per warrant. The total fundraising from this issue is expected to be up to ₹999,971,000. This preferential issue is subject to shareholder approval and other required regulatory approvals. The company also scheduled its 1st Extraordinary General Meeting for August 10, 2026, to seek member approval for these proposals.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange with respect to receipt of grant of an AMFI Registration Number by our wholly owned subsidiary.
announcements.ai_summary: OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited has announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Invincible Minds Private Limited, has received an AMFI Registration Number (ARN). This follows the incorporation of Invincible Minds Private Limited on June 17, 2026. The ARN was granted via an email received on July 14, 2026, from the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI). The ARN is valid from July 13, 2026, to July 12, 2029.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Bombay Dyeing & Mfg Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligation AndDisclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015'.
announcements.ai_summary: Bombay Dyeing & Mfg Company Limited has provided an update regarding a Civil Appeal filed by SEBI before the Hon'ble Supreme Court. The appeal is against an order by the Hon'ble Securities Appellate Tribunal that had set aside a SEBI order concerning the company. The Hon'ble Supreme Court heard the matter on July 13, 2026, issued notice, and directed the company and others to file their replies, as per its order uploaded on July 15, 2026. Importantly, the Supreme Court has not granted any stay against the operation of the Securities Appellate Tribunal's order. The matter will be listed for further hearing in due course. The company will continue to inform the stock exchanges of any material developments.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has been awarded new orders totaling INR 1343.45 Million from DRDO, Indian Navy, Defence PSUs, State Government, and Private Industries in the ordinary course of its business. Additionally, IDL Explosives Limited, a step-down subsidiary of the company, has secured work valued at INR 552.20 Million, which is executable over a period of two years. This update is being provided to shareholders for their information.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Schaeffler India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "Schaeffler India Social Innovation Fellowship 2026 27 to Empower Innovators Addressing India s Social Challenges".
announcements.ai_summary: Schaeffler India Limited has announced the launch of the Schaeffler India Social Innovation Fellowship 2026-27, an initiative to empower individuals developing innovative and sustainable solutions for social and environmental challenges in India. This marks the fifth year of the fellowship, which aims to identify, support, and accelerate 10 high-potential social innovators, with a focus on entrepreneurs from Tier II, Tier III, and rural areas. The program will provide financial grants, structured mentorship, industry exposure, and access to innovation ecosystems. The 24-week cohort program, delivered by IIMA Ventures at IIM Ahmedabad, will equip fellows with business, impact, and investor readiness capabilities. Since its inception in 2021, the fellowship has supported over 41 early-stage social innovators.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Dcx Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of investment in ELTX Systems Pvt Ltd., an Associate and Joint Venture (Joint Venture with ELTA Systems Limited, Israel) of the Company through a right issue.'.
announcements.ai_summary: DCX Systems Limited has made a further investment in ELTX Systems Private Limited (ELTX), an associate and joint venture with ELTA Systems Limited, Israel, through a rights issue. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Fedbank Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "Press Release - Financial and Operational Performance of the Company for the quarterended June 30, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Fedbank Financial Services Limited has announced its financial and operational performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a Profit After Tax (PAT) growth of 52.5% year-on-year, reaching ₹114.4 crore for Q1 FY27. Net Interest Income saw a significant increase of 38.7% year-on-year to ₹371.9 crore, while Operating Profit grew by 49.9% year-on-year to ₹187.5 crore. Assets Under Management (AUM) increased by 34.7% year-on-year to ₹21,136 crore. Disbursements for the quarter were ₹6,760 crore, representing a 13.9% year-on-year growth. The press release also indicates that the company is focused on empowering emerging India with easy access to loans.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Snowman Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "Snowman Logistics to establish a 10,000-pallet facility in Hyderabad".
announcements.ai_summary: Snowman Logistics Limited has announced plans to establish a new 10,000-pallet temperature-controlled warehouse facility in Hyderabad. This facility will be developed under an asset-light Built-to-Suit (BTS) model, with construction commencing immediately. The new warehouse is scheduled to be operational by the second quarter of the next financial year and will cater to a temperature range of -25℃ to +20℃. Strategically located along the NH-44 corridor, it will serve the growing demand for temperature-controlled storage in Hyderabad's northern logistics belt, driven by sectors such as seafood, ice cream, QSR, fruits & vegetables, and pharmaceuticals. This expansion will increase Snowman's capacity in Hyderabad to 16,800 pallets and reinforce its cold chain network across key consumption and production hubs.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release - TCS Launches Industrial AI Solutions Lab in Bengaluru Powered by NVIDIA'.
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has announced the launch of its Industrial AI Solutions Lab in Bengaluru, powered by NVIDIA. This new facility, located at TCS's Global Axis campus, is designed to accelerate the development and deployment of AI-led solutions for the mobility and manufacturing sectors. The lab will enable enterprises to move from pilot projects to production-scale deployments by allowing them to design, test, and validate Industrial AI solutions. TCS aims to leverage its domain expertise and NVIDIA's AI infrastructure to rapidly prototype and simulate use cases across various industries, ultimately shaping the future of mobility and industrial systems.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: LTM Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "LTM to account for the largest implementations as L&T drives an AI powered Workplace Transformation with Microsoft 365 Copilot".
announcements.ai_summary: LTM Limited has announced that it is leading the deployment of Microsoft 365 Copilot across the L&T Group, marking one of India's largest enterprise AI workplace transformations. Approximately 140,000 employees across the group will have Microsoft 365 Copilot enabled, with LTM spearheading this initiative. The company highlighted that its AI-powered assistant, RAIma, has already achieved a 70% improvement in IT and HR query resolution and a 15% increase in employee engagement and HR productivity. Over 23,000 developers are utilizing AI tools daily, supported by more than 1,300 AI experts and enablement leads. LTM will also deploy solutions like Agent A.S.K. for sales and RAIma for HR support.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "Sun Pharma receives approval to manufacture and market generic semaglutide in South Africa".
announcements.ai_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has announced that it has received approval from the South African Health Products Regulatory Authority (SAHPRA) to manufacture and market a generic version of semaglutide injection in South Africa. This approval is for the treatment of adults with inadequately controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise. Sun Pharma plans to launch the product, available in two strengths (2 mg/1.5 mL and 4 mg/3 mL) as a pre-filled, multi-dose injectable pen, in the coming days. This marks South Africa as the second market, after India, where Sun Pharma has secured approval for generic semaglutide. The company highlighted its commitment to improving access to generics and making evidence-based treatment options available to patients and healthcare professionals.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tembo Global Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 15, 2026, titled "Tembo Global Industries  Subsidiary Secures Government Licence for Ammunition Manufacturing".
announcements.ai_summary: Tembo Global Industries Limited announced that its subsidiary, Tembo Classic Engineering Private Limited (TCEPL), has secured a crucial government licence from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India. This licence authorizes TCEPL to manufacture ammunition of various calibers, marking a significant entry into the defence and security manufacturing sector. The company, formerly known as Tembo Defence Products Private Limited, is now positioned to commence commercial production as per its schedule. This development aligns with India's 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' and 'Make in India' initiatives, aiming to boost self-reliance in defence manufacturing. The Managing Director, Mr. Sanjay J. Patel, highlighted this as a landmark achievement that strengthens the company's commitment to supporting national self-reliance and creating opportunities in both domestic and global defence markets.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 14, 2026, titled "Receipt of final approval by our subsidiary, Caplin Steriles Limited, from the USFDA for Foscarnet Sodium Injection.".
announcements.ai_summary: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited announced on May 14, 2026, that its subsidiary, Caplin Steriles Limited (CSL), received final approval from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA). This approval is for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) for Foscarnet Sodium Injection (6000 mg/250 mL Infusion Bag). This product is a generic therapeutic equivalent of the Reference Listed Drug (RLD) Foscavir Injection, manufactured by Clinigen Healthcare Ltd. Foscarnet Sodium Injection is an antiviral medication used to treat CMV retinitis in AIDS patients and HSV infection in immunocompromised individuals. According to IQVIA™, the US sales for Foscarnet Sodium Injection (6000 mg/250 mL Infusion Bag) were approximately $15 million for the 12-month period ending March 2026. Caplin Steriles Limited has now developed and filed 54 ANDAs in the USA, securing 55 approvals to date.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Network People Services Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 14, 2026, titled "Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015   Press Release    NPST Wins Three Cooperative Bank Orders for Its Bank-in-a-Box Platform. ".
announcements.ai_summary: Network People Services Technologies Limited (NPST) has secured three new orders from cooperative banks for its Bank-in-a-Box platform, as announced on May 14, 2026. One bank will implement NPST's acquiring switch along with Qynx, while the other two will deploy Qynx only. Qynx is NPST's offline acquiring platform designed to manage the full spectrum of offline merchant payment acceptance, including QR and Soundbox processing, device logistics, and field support. This move is expected to enhance NPST's recurring revenue pipeline and support long-term growth by providing cooperative banks with modern digital banking and payments infrastructure. The Bank-in-a-Box platform is a SaaS-based solution covering UPI, IMPS, Banking Connect, merchant acceptance, fraud monitoring, and an omnichannel SuperApp.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Capri Global Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 14, 2026, titled "Capri Global Capital Limited ( Capri Loans ) crosses 1,000 Gold Loan Branches across India".
announcements.ai_summary: Capri Global Capital Limited announced on May 14, 2026, that its Gold Loan business has successfully crossed 1,000 branches across India. This expansion strengthens the company's last-mile credit access and nationwide presence, operating across 16 States and Union Territories. Key states with a high concentration of branches include Rajasthan (168), Uttar Pradesh (136), Gujarat (134), Madhya Pradesh (117), and Haryana (108). The company aims to provide customers with quick, secure, and transparent gold-backed financing closer to their homes, addressing immediate liquidity requirements. This milestone reinforces Capri Loans' commitment to expanding accessible and timely credit solutions in urban, semi-urban, and rural markets.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Indoco Remedies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 14, 2026, titled "Indoco Remedies successfully clears Malta Medicines Authority audit".
announcements.ai_summary: Indoco Remedies Limited has announced that its manufacturing facility for solid oral dosage forms, located at Baddi (Unit I), successfully cleared an audit by the Malta Medicines Authority. The inspection took place from January 29, 2026, to February 3, 2026. Following the audit, the facility has received EU GMP certification, confirming its compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice requirements as stipulated by the EC Directive. This certification underscores Indoco Remedies' commitment to quality and adherence to global regulatory standards. The company's Managing Director, Ms. Aditi Panandikar, highlighted this as a reflection of their focus on maintaining high-quality standards for both domestic and international markets.

announcements.company: Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited
announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited has informed the Exchange about GKSL scales up Renal Care: 100 units AI-Powered Haemodialysis Machines to be inducted across network. First 8 machines to go live at Gujarat Multi Speciality Hospital, Godhra, Gujarat, within 10 days following completion of all required inspections
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited (GKSL) has announced a significant expansion in its renal care services by procuring 100 AI-powered Haemodialysis machines. The first phase of deployment will see 8 of these machines operational at its Gujarat Multi Speciality Hospital in Godhra, Gujarat, within 10 days, following the completion of all required inspections. These AI-enabled machines offer advanced features such as real-time data analysis for fluid balance, blood pressure trends, and ultrafiltration response, enabling safer and more personalized patient treatment. The remaining 92 machines will be progressively deployed across GKSL's network of dialysis centers in Gujarat, aiming to substantially scale up access to high-quality, technology-enabled renal care. This initiative aligns with the company's strategic objective to expand dialysis capacity and enhance patient care across its facilities.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Please find attached a media release by Jio Platforms Limited, a subsidiary of the Company, titled  Jio Platforms Surges into Global Top 20 in latest WIPO Patents Ranking.
announcements.ai_summary: Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) is providing an update regarding its subsidiary, Jio Platforms Limited (JPL). JPL has achieved a significant milestone by ranking among the global top 20 in the latest Patent Co-operation Treaty (PCT) rankings released by the World Intellectual Property Organisation (WIPO). JPL climbed an impressive 320 places to reach the 20th position for the year 2025, making it one of the fastest-rising innovators globally. This achievement places JPL among other leading technology innovators such as Huawei, Samsung, Qualcomm, and Google. JPL's patent portfolio is heavily focused on next-generation digital technologies, including 5G, 6G, artificial intelligence, and cloud-native platforms. This recognition highlights JPL's R&D productivity and its contribution to India's vision of becoming a global deep-tech powerhouse.

announcements.company: Dalmia Bharat Sugar and Industries Limited
announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Dalmia Bharat Sugar and Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 14, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Dalmia Bharat Sugar and Industries Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting on Tuesday, July 14, 2026, approved the development of an integrated sugar project in Tanzania. This project will be executed through Eagle Agrotech Tanzania Limited (EATL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Eagle Agrotech Holdings Limited (EAHL), where Dalmia Bharat Sugar holds a 51% equity stake, and Symphony Global LLC holds the remaining 49%. The project, with an estimated cost of US$132 million, includes developing sugarcane plantations and establishing a sugar manufacturing unit along with a cogeneration facility. It envisages an integrated sugar estate over 10,000 hectares, with potential expansion to 20,000 hectares. The initial sugar manufacturing capacity will be approximately 70,000 MT per annum, expandable to 150,000 MT per annum, alongside a 20 MW cogeneration facility. This initiative marks a significant step in the company's international growth strategy, aiming for geographical diversification and entry into global bio-energy markets, addressing a structural sugar deficit in East Africa.

This collaboration aims to combine Formycon's biosimilar development expertise with OneSource's end-to-end biologics manufacturing capabilities to support Formycon's global biosimilar programs. The partnership is driven by a shared commitment to enhance global access to biosimilars through reliable and scalable manufacturing. OneSource's integrated biologics platform, approved by regulatory authorities like the US FDA and EMA, complements Formycon's strong track record in biosimilar development and commercialization.

This accolade highlights Lupin's commitment to cultivating a culture of purpose, trust, and inclusion, while contributing to nation-building through expanded healthcare access, community development, and societal impact. The Nation Builders category acknowledges organizations that extend their impact beyond business performance by contributing to employment, people development, community advancement, and nation-building, alongside fostering exceptional workplace cultures.

announcements.ai_summary: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited has entered into a Strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of Tripura. This partnership aims to accelerate the State's Digital Media and Creator Ecosystem by strengthening its digital economy through media technology, creator ecosystem development, and AI-enabled digital media infrastructure. The collaboration focuses on developing digital media platforms, creator initiatives, digital marketing capabilities, and media intelligence solutions. It seeks to create an integrated digital ecosystem that supports content creators, enhances digital public services, and fosters innovation within the state's media and technology landscape, while also creating opportunities for local talent.

announcements.ai_summary: Welspun Corp Limited has announced the receipt of significant new orders for the supply of pipes for Oil & Gas export projects from its India facility, cumulatively valued at approximately Rs. 1,400 Crore. This substantial addition boosts the company's consolidated global order book to Rs. 23,650 Crore, equivalent to approximately US$2.5 billion. This expanded order book provides strong revenue visibility and ensures continuity of operations across both its Indian and USA manufacturing facilities. The scheduled execution for these orders is over FY27 and FY28, positioning the company for sustained growth momentum in the coming two fiscal years.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press noted dated July 14, 2026, titled "Defense and Aerospace major, Sigma Advanced Systems, Acquires UK based Bromford Precision Solutions for INR 153 crores".
announcements.ai_summary: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited announced on July 14, 2026, the acquisition of 100% of the equity share capital of Bromford Precision Solutions Limited, a UK-based specialist manufacturer of high-precision aeroengine components. The transaction is valued at approximately GBP 11.89 million, which is equivalent to INR 153 crore, and is expected to close by the end of July 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. This acquisition, representing an enterprise value to adjusted EBITDA multiple of approximately 4.6x, is a significant milestone in Sigma's international growth strategy, strengthening its position within the Rolls-Royce supply chain and complementing its UK division, Nasmyth Group. Bromford's capabilities in manufacturing complex aeroengine ring components and other structures directly complement Sigma's expertise in larger components, offering a deeper full-range product offering for global aerospace and power generation customers.

Requisite approvals under the National Security and Investment Act, UK, have already been obtained.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Max Estates Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 13, 2026, titled "Max Estates Launches The Terraces at Estate 361, Gurugram".
announcements.ai_summary: Max Estates Limited has launched "The Terraces at Estate 361, Gurugram," as detailed in a press release dated May 13, 2026. This new residential offering is located on Dwarka Expressway and features 1.5 & 2-bedroom smart homes and duplex loft residences. The project has a gross development value (GDV) of ₹1,200 crore and is part of Estate 361, which has an overall GDV of ₹9,000 crore across 18.23 acres. Phase 1 of The Terraces includes 120 residences, with prices starting at ₹2.4 crore. The development is designed as an intergenerational community, incorporating smart residences, shared terraces, wellness, nature, and managed living.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: VA Tech Wabag Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 13, 2026, titled "WABAG and PEAK Announce First Bio-CNG Project in Ghaziabad".
announcements.ai_summary: VA Tech Wabag Limited (WABAG) and PEAK Sustainability Ventures (PEAK) announced on May 13, 2026, the development of their first Bio-CNG plant in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh. This project is a key milestone under their waste-to-energy initiative, which was initially announced on January 29, 2024, with a shared vision to establish 100 Bio-CNG plants at sewage treatment facilities across India and other markets. The Ghaziabad plant will be developed at the 70 MLD Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) in Dundaheda under a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model on a Public-Private Partnership basis. The project will be executed through a newly incorporated special purpose vehicle named GHAZIABAD BIOENERGY PRIVATE LIMITED, jointly formed by WABAG and PEAK.

announcements.subject: General Updates

The purpose of this new SPV is to facilitate the Network Expansion Scheme in the Western Region, specifically to cater to pumped storage potential near Satara, up to 4500 MW, as Part A of the project. PFC Consulting Limited has been nominated as the Bid Process Coordinator (BPC) by the Ministry of Power, Government of India, for the selection of developers through tariff-based competitive bidding for Independent Transmission Projects (ITPs), as per a gazette notification dated March 24, 2026. announcements.ai_summary: Antony Waste Handling Cell Limited has provided an update following a natural calamity at its Waste-to-Energy plant site. Incessant rains caused a landfill collapse, resulting in severe damage to the administrative building where 23 employees were present. Tragically, nine employees lost their lives in this incident. The company is providing comprehensive support to the affected employees and their families. This includes bearing all hospital, medical, and counselling expenses for injured employees, as well as covering funeral and last-rites expenses. Each bereaved family will receive financial assistance of ₹ 25,00,000, comprising ex-gratia support and benefits from statutory welfare/insurance schemes and the company's group insurance policy. Furthermore, Antony Waste will offer employment to an immediate family member of each deceased employee where suitable and will cover the educational expenses of their minor children. A dedicated company representative has been assigned to each affected family.

announcements.ai_summary: Tiger Logistics (India) Limited has secured two significant air import contracts from Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) for the transportation of approximately 310 MT of project cargo to Visakhapatnam. The total business value of these contracts is approximately ₹8.8 crore. The cargo will be transported via three chartered flights, with 80 MT originating from France and 210 MT from Saudi Arabia. Tiger Logistics will manage these shipments on an end-to-end ex-works basis, encompassing air freight, customs clearance, and local transportation from the origin countries to Visakhapatnam. This award highlights the company's growing expertise in handling time-sensitive and specialized air cargo for public sector undertakings.

announcements.ai_summary: SIS Limited has commenced its share buyback program on August 13, 2026, as approved by its Board of Directors. The company plans to repurchase equity shares with a face value of ₹5 each from shareholders, excluding promoters and persons in control, through the stock exchange mechanism. The buyback is capped at a maximum amount of ₹106.00 Crores, with individual share repurchases not exceeding ₹478.50 per share. The buyback is scheduled to conclude on November 20, 2026, or earlier if the maximum buyback size is deployed or if the company decides to close it prematurely after deploying at least 75% of the earmarked funds, which amounts to ₹79.50 Crores.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: VMS TMT Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 13, 2026, titled "VMS TMT LimitedAnnounces Q 1 FY2 7 Results".
announcements.ai_summary: VMS TMT Limited has announced its Unaudited Financial Results for the First Quarter ended June 30, 2026, via a press release dated August 13, 2026. The company reported a Total Income of ₹24,787.89 Lakhs for Q1 FY27, compared to ₹21,339.35 Lakhs in Q1 FY26, indicating a 16.16% year-on-year revenue growth. EBITDA for the quarter stood at ₹1,218.93 Lakhs, a decrease from ₹2,061.76 Lakhs in the prior year's quarter, and Net Profit was ₹446.75 Lakhs, down from ₹857.64 Lakhs in Q1 FY26. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Jet Freight Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: JSW Cement Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 13, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Cement Limited announced its consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 13, 2026. The company reported a revenue of ₹1,896 crore, marking a 22% year-on-year increase from ₹1,560 crore in Q1 FY26. Total volume sold grew by 15% YoY to 3.81 Million Tonnes, with cement volume increasing by 27% YoY to 2.34 Million Tonnes. The Business Transfer Agreement was executed on 13 August 2026.

The fire occurred in the early hours of August 13, 2026, and has been brought under control. The company is currently assessing the extent of damage and the impact on operations. While operations in the affected area are temporarily disrupted, other divisions, including 828 Chips, Filament Yarn, PPSF, and Washline, remain unaffected and are operating normally. The company has informed its insurance provider, as the assets are adequately covered. It features fast-charging capability, allowing the battery to charge from 0 to 80% in just 2 hours and 30 minutes, and boasts a quick acceleration of 0 to 30 km/h in 3.7 seconds.
