announcements.detail: Relaxo Footwears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding current production capacity of the Company s manufacturing plants.
announcements.ai_summary: Relaxo Footwears Limited has informed the exchange about an optimization of its total manufacturing capacity. The company's manufacturing plants, RFL-I and RFL-II, located in Bahadurgarh, Haryana, which were built in 1994 and 1999 respectively, are undergoing reconstruction and renovation for infrastructure enhancement and safety compliance. Additionally, the company is expanding into the fashionable footwear segment, requiring specialized production lines and more complex manufacturing processes. Consequently, the total manufacturing capacity across all plants has been reassessed and optimized to 9,10,000 pairs per day, down from the previous capacity of 10,50,000 pairs per day.

This plan includes the Synthetic Iron Oxide Pigments (SIOP) Capacity Expansion Project, which aims to increase capacity from 30,000 Metric Tonnes (MT) to 45,000 MT through a two-phase expansion. Phase 1, adding 7,000 MT to reach approximately 37,000 MT, is expected by Q4 FY28. Phase 2 will add another 8,000 MT. The company will also undertake improvements to its Sahupuram Power Plant, expected by Q4 FY28, to enhance efficiency and reduce costs. These initiatives are intended to strengthen the pigment portfolio, increase sales, improve competitiveness, and expand market presence both domestically and internationally.

announcements.ai_summary: Elgi Equipments Limited has released its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated sales of Rs. 1,062 Crores, a 23% increase from Rs. 867 Crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous year (2025-26). Standalone sales grew by 28% to Rs. 645 Crores from Rs. 503 Crores. Consolidated Profit After Tax (PAT) before exceptional items rose by 29% to Rs. 111 Crores from Rs. 86 Crores. Standalone PAT was Rs. 90 Crores, up from Rs. 82 Crores in the same period last year. The company experienced double-digit growth driven by India and American markets, while Europe and Australia remained subdued. The automotive business also saw double-digit growth. Elgi Equipments maintains a positive outlook for the second quarter of 2026-27, expecting to achieve its budgeted performance despite geopolitical tensions and rising costs.

The contract includes designing, engineering, manufacturing, transportation, erection, electrical works, installation, data acquisition, testing, commissioning, project financing, permits, insurance, and a mandatory 10-year Operation & Maintenance (O&M) of the rooftop solar systems. The projects are to be executed within 9 months from the issuance of the signed Power Purchase Agreement (PPA).

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: DMCC SPECIALITY CHEMICALS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Press Release on financial performance for QIFY27.".
announcements.ai_summary: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Limited has released its financial performance for the first quarter of the Financial Year 2027 (Q1FY27) via a press release dated August 12, 2026. The company reported a significant increase in revenue and profitability during the quarter, primarily driven by a substantial rise in sulphur and sulfuric acid prices, which also resulted in inventory gains. The Managing Director and CEO, Bimal Goculdas, noted that these gains are temporary and profits are expected to normalize as prices moderate. The company managed increased receivables and inventory through short-term borrowings. Despite global supply chain disruptions, both Dahej and Roha facilities operated without interruption, and cost increases were fully passed on to customers, strengthening customer relationships. The Boron segment met its quarterly targets with improved demand, pricing, and supply. Exports to Latin America, China, and Japan are offsetting a subdued European market in the speciality chemicals segment, indicating progress in geographic diversification.

announcements.detail: EFC (I) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 13, 2026, titled "EFC (I) Limited to Acquire 100 percent Stake in Ultrafresh Modular Solutions Limited".
announcements.ai_summary: EFC (I) Limited has announced its intention to acquire a 100% equity shareholding in Ultrafresh Modular Solutions Limited ("Ultrafresh") through a Share Acquisition Agreement. This strategic acquisition aims to strengthen EFC's furniture manufacturing and Design & Build (D&B) businesses by integrating Ultrafresh's established production facility for modular furniture solutions in North India. Ultrafresh, a 51% subsidiary of TTK Prestige Limited with a 25-year industry presence, is a recognized brand in modular kitchens, wardrobes, and customized modular furniture, operating through an integrated model of design, manufacturing, supply, and installation. The acquisition is subject to the fulfillment of conditions precedent and other terms stipulated in the agreement.

Ultrafresh contributed a turnover of ₹36.3 Crores, representing 1.2% of TTK Prestige's consolidated turnover for FY 2025-26, and had a Net Worth of ₹(16.66) Crores, representing (0.8)% of the consolidated net worth as of March 31, 2026. EFC (I) Limited is a publicly listed company engaged in managed office solutions, Design & Build turnkey solutions, and furniture manufacturing.

This partnership aligns with Paisalo's strategy of using alliances to expand reach while maintaining credit discipline, focusing on accessibility, affordability, and awareness.

announcements.ai_summary: Kapston Services Limited's subsidiary, Kapston Home Services Private Limited, officially launched its home services business operations on August 12, 2026. This new venture aims to provide technology-enabled home services, including cleaning, pest control, electrical, plumbing, and beauty treatments, through an online platform. The launch signifies a strategic move by Kapston Services Limited to expand its service portfolio and strengthen its presence in the growing B2C market in India. Actor Mr. Nagarjuna Akkineni has been appointed as the Brand Ambassador for Kapston Home Services Private Limited to enhance brand visibility and support growth.

announcements.company: The Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited
announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: The Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: The Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited has received Environmental Clearance (EC) from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India, dated August 12, 2026. This clearance is for its Belkundi Iron & Manganese Ore Mine, located in Dist-Keonjhar, Odisha, covering an area of 1276.79 Hect. (as per RoR) / 1276.949 Hect. (as per DGPS), with mining restricted to 920.6 ha. The EC permits a production capacity of 1.8 MTPA Iron Ore and 0.3 MTPA Manganese Ore. Additionally, it allows for the installation of crushers with capacities of 100 TPH and 200 TPH, and screening plants of 400 TPH and 200 TPH. The proposal was recommended by the EAC in its 9th meeting on July 17, 2026, and the EC was granted under the violation category based on S.O 804 (E) dated March 14, 2017.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Bhagyanagar India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of   the Executive Committee of the board of Bhagyanagar India Limited in their meeting held today, i.e., August 13, 2026 inter-alia, considered and approved the allotment of 15,01,434 Equity Shares of face value of Rs. 2/- (Rupees Two Only) each for cash, at an issue price of Rs.348/- (Rupees Three Hundred and Forty Eight Only) per Equity Share including premium of Rs.346/- (Rupees  Three Hundred and Forty Six Only) per share.

These shares have a face value of Rs. 2/- each and were issued for cash at an issue price of Rs. 348/- per Equity Share, which includes a premium of Rs. 346/- per share. This allotment follows the approval of shareholders at an Extraordinary General Meeting held on July 23, 2026, and subsequent in-principle approvals from BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange Limited. The allotment is in compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, and SEBI (ICDR) Regulations.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release - TCS and Vodafone join forces to drive AI-led digital transformation for UK enterprises'.
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Consultancy Services Limited (TCS) has announced a strategic partnership with Vodafone Business, the enterprise arm of VodafoneThree, to drive AI-led digital transformation for UK enterprises. This collaboration aims to accelerate digital transformation, unlock new opportunities, and deliver stronger outcomes for UK enterprise customers by modernizing technology, accelerating digital adoption, reducing complexity, and enabling scalability. The partnership will focus on areas such as cloud transformation, AI and automation, cybersecurity, network modernization, data and analytics, IoT, and managed services. This initiative builds on VodafoneThree's £11 billion investment in its UK network. The press release was issued on August 13, 2026.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited has secured a mega order as part of a strategic partnership with Together AI to build India’s largest NVIDIA B300 AI Factory. This marks L&T's entry into the AI Factory business, where it will deploy NVIDIA B300 infrastructure at its Chennai data center campus to power Together AI’s AI-native cloud platform for large-scale training and inference. The AI Factory, hosted at Vyoma.AI's Chennai data centre campus, will have a capacity of 10,000 B300 NVIDIA GPUs. This integrated AI Factory combines hyperscale data centre infrastructure, accelerated computing, high-performance networking, and AI infrastructure operations. The announcement was made on August 13, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: BIRLASOFT LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 13, 2026, titled "Birlasoft Recognised as  Enterprise Innovator  by HFS Research for Application Modernization".
announcements.ai_summary: Birlasoft Limited has issued a press release dated August 13, 2026, announcing its recognition as an 'Enterprise Innovator' by HFS Research for its Application Modernization services. This recognition highlights Birlasoft's engineering depth and AI-led approach in enabling enterprises to modernize legacy applications and accelerate AI-native transformation. The HFS Horizons report evaluates service providers, and Birlasoft's inclusion among 32 global providers underscores its strength in legacy application modernization. The company has completed over 450 application modernizations and 75+ full-stack programs, utilizing its Birlasoft Cogito platform, an AI-led modernization engine that reportedly drives 40% faster coding and up to 35% deployment effort savings.

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: Nephrocare Health Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
announcements.ai_summary: Nephrocare Health Services Limited's overseas step-down wholly-owned subsidiary, Nephrocare Health Care Services, Philippines Inc., has entered into an Asset Transfer Agreement (ATA) dated August 12, 2026, with Juan Nephro Dialysis Center. This agreement is for the acquisition of identified assets related to a dialysis center located in Davao City, Philippines. The total consideration for this acquisition is PhP 71,800,000 (Philippine Pesos Seventy-One Million Eight Hundred Thousand Pesos Only). The subsidiary is the purchaser, and Juan Nephro Dialysis Center is the seller. The transaction is subject to the terms and conditions outlined in the ATA.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Rmc Switchgears Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts worth Rs. 1,88,52,000/-
announcements.ai_summary: RMC Switchgears Limited has received Letters of Award (LOA) from Anand Transformers Private Limited totaling ₹1,88,52,000 (One Crore Eighty Eight Lakh Fifty Two Thousand Rupees). These awards are for a "Turnkey Contract for providing new Service connection with Extension of Infrastructure, if required (Phase III)" for Transformer Distribution Boxes. This new order is expected to strengthen the company's order book and positively contribute to its revenue and growth prospects. The company will provide further material updates as required.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Thyrocare Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding communication received from Promoter regarding sale of 1,57,69,696 Equity Shares of the Company by Promoter - Docon Technologies Private Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Docon Technologies Private Limited, a Promoter of Thyrocare Technologies Limited, has sold 1,57,69,696 equity shares of the Company through market trades on August 13, 2026. These shares represent approximately 9.90% of the total paid-up equity share capital. Following this transaction, Docon Technologies Private Limited remains a Promoter, and its shareholding in Thyrocare has reduced from 60.92% to 51.02% of the total paid-up equity share capital. The settlement of this transaction will be carried out in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Accent Microcell Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Accent Microcell Limited's Board/Management has approved a capital expenditure of ₹[Not Specified] for the installation of a 4.45 MW Wind Turbine Generator (WTG) on a turnkey basis. This expenditure will be funded through internal accruals or borrowings. A Purchase Order was placed on August 12, 2026, with Inox Wind Limited for this turnkey installation. The rationale behind this investment is to offset and reduce the company's electricity costs at Plant-I and Plant-II, and to meet the anticipated energy requirements of Phase-I of Plant-III. Upon installation and commissioning, the company expects a substantial reduction in its monthly electricity bills, which should positively impact operating profit margins and provide a competitive edge.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Hexaware Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Hexaware and upGrad Enterprise Expand Collaborationfor Global Enterprise AI Programs'.
announcements.ai_summary: Hexaware Technologies Limited and upGrad Enterprise are expanding their collaboration to offer global enterprise AI programs. This initiative builds upon their previous work in strengthening AI capabilities within Hexaware's workforce, including GenAI upskilling and the launch of the Agentic AI Academy. Under the new arrangement, upGrad Enterprise will be Hexaware's preferred partner for enterprise AI capability development. Both companies will collaborate on go-to-market strategies and client engagement, transitioning their relationship from internal skilling to a broader global alliance. The programs will include verticalized AI learning tracks, role-based Agentic AI programs, executive AI innovation labs, and AI-enabled coding centers. These initiatives aim to support enterprises in scaling their AI business and service lines by upskilling professionals.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Aurionpro Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 13, 2026, titled "Aurionpro secures another significant win from a Global Hyperscale Data Centre Operator".
announcements.ai_summary: Aurionpro Solutions Limited has secured a significant order from a global hyperscale data centre operator to build and project-manage the digital infrastructure for its upcoming AI-ready data centre in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra. The order is valued at close to INR 100 Crores. This win deepens Aurionpro's existing partnership with the hyperscaler and demonstrates the customer's confidence in Aurionpro's technological capabilities and project execution expertise. The order strengthens Aurionpro's position as a partner of choice in the rapidly expanding data centre market, particularly in the AI-ready infrastructure segment. Aurionpro aims to contribute to India's digital and AI transformation by providing full-stack data centre solutions, combining expertise across mechanical, architectural, structural, and fit-out disciplines with advanced technology capabilities. This integrated approach allows Aurionpro to build and manage innovative, scalable, and future-ready data centre infrastructure for hyperscale operators and the emerging AI-driven data centre ecosystem.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Magellanic Cloud Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 13, 2026, titled "Magellanic Cloud Limited Wholly Owned Subsidiary Provigil Surveillance Limited Receive Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) Worth ₹3.73 Crore".
announcements.ai_summary: Magellanic Cloud Limited has announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Provigil Surveillance Limited, has received a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) for a contract valued at ₹3.73 crore. This contract involves the Supply, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning (SITC) and Operations & Maintenance (O&M) of an E-Surveillance System across a specific section of the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor (WDFC). The project is to be executed over a five-year period on an OPEX model, aiming to enhance the protection of critical railway infrastructure. The scope includes E-surveillance, remote monitoring, asset and facility protection, operational surveillance, perimeter security, dock management, recording infrastructure, and Command and Control Centre functionality. This award reinforces Provigil Surveillance Limited's position in securing large-scale, mission-critical infrastructure for government and PSU entities.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bikewo Green Tech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 13, 2026, titled "BikeWo Signs MoU with Hala Mobility for EV Fleet Deployment; Envisions 10,000-Vehicle Scale-Up Over Three Years".
announcements.ai_summary: Bikewo Green Tech Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Hala Mobility to explore the deployment and management of electric vehicle (EV) fleets. The initial phase of this collaboration proposes the deployment of approximately 1,000 electric vehicles, with a strategic intent to scale up to approximately 10,000 vehicles over the next three years. This partnership combines BikeWo's electric mobility and fleet operations capabilities with Hala Mobility's participation in the mobility ecosystem. The companies will work on establishing the framework for EV deployment, fleet utilization, vehicle management, and related operational requirements. Insights from the initial deployment will inform the scope and pace of subsequent expansion. The potential scale-up to 10,000 vehicles is contingent on the outcome of the initial phase and mutually agreed commercial and operational arrangements.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Railtel Corporation Of India Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Railtel Corporation of India Ltd. has received a Work Order from Deendayal Port Authority for the Design, Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning, along with Operation and Maintenance of an Integrated Gate Automation System (IGAS) at Kandla. The contract has a duration of 5 years. The broad consideration for this order is Rs. 63,00,36,301, excluding tax. The order is to be executed by August 16, 2031. This is a domestic order, and neither the promoter, promoter group, nor group companies have any interest in Deendayal Port Authority. The order does not fall within related party transactions.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Magellanic Cloud Limited has informed the Exchange about Provigil Surveillance Limited Receives Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) Worth ₹3.73 Crore
announcements.ai_summary: Provigil Surveillance Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Magellanic Cloud Limited, has received a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) for a contract valued at ₹3,73,00,000. This contract involves the Supply, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning (SITC) along with Operations & Maintenance (O&M) of an E-Surveillance System for a period of five years on an OPEX model. The project will cover a specific section of the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor (WDFC). The scope includes CCTV-based theft prevention, remote monitoring, asset and facility protection, operational surveillance, perimeter security, dock management, recording infrastructure, and Command and Control Centre functionality. This award highlights Provigil Surveillance Limited's growing presence in critical public-sector infrastructure and the trust placed by leading Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) in the company's surveillance and security capabilities. The contract is aligned with the company's core business of providing integrated surveillance, security, and technology solutions.

announcements.subject: Qualified Institutional Placement
announcements.detail: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has informed the Exchange about qualified Institutional Placement - Allotment
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has announced the allotment of 67,430,883 fully paid-up Equity Shares through a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP). The issue price for these shares was ₹ 370.75 per Equity Share, which includes a premium of ₹ 368.75 per Equity Share and a discount of ₹ 19.51 per Equity Share (5.00% of the floor price of ₹ 390.26). The total amount raised through this QIP is ₹ 25,000 million. The QIP opened on April 9, 2026, and closed on April 13, 2026. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased from ₹1,625,635,316 (812,817,658 Equity Shares) to ₹1,760,497,082 (880,248,541 Equity Shares). The list of allottees who received more than five percent of the offered shares is attached as Annexure A.

announcements.company: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited
announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about updates regarding Scheme of Amalgamantion / Merger.
announcements.ai_summary: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has received an order from the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Ahmedabad Bench, dated April 13, 2026, regarding the proposed Scheme of arrangement and amalgamation between Triumph Offshore Private Limited (Transferor Company) and Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited (Transferee Company). The NCLT order directs Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited to convene a meeting of its Equity Shareholders on May 25, 2026. Additionally, the NCLT has dispensed with the requirement of convening meetings for the Equity Shareholders of Triumph Offshore Private Limited, as well as for the Secured and Unsecured Creditors of both companies. This is a continuation of the company's disclosure on November 22, 2024, when the Board of Directors had approved the Scheme, subject to regulatory approvals.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Zota Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Postal Ballot Notice   Response to Proxy Advisory Firm'.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Zota Health Care Limited has issued a Postal Ballot Notice and provided a response to a proxy advisory firm, Institutional Investor Advisory Services (IiAS). The company is seeking shareholder approval via postal ballot, from March 18, 2026, to April 16, 2026, for a resolution authorizing the board to give loans, guarantees, or security, and to acquire securities of other bodies corporate in excess of the limits specified under Section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013. The company clarifies that this authorization is for future business expansion, investment opportunities, strategic acquisitions, and support to subsidiaries, including Davaindia Health Mart Limited, which contributes substantially to revenue. The company also states that the transactions will depend on future fund requirements of subsidiaries.

announcements.company: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited
announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited has informed the Exchange about Key Performance Highlights for the Quarter and Year Ended March 31, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited has announced its Key Performance Highlights for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026. For the full fiscal year 2026, the company reported revenue of INR 769 Crores, a 40% year-on-year increase, with an EBITDA margin of 36.5% and Profit After Tax (PAT) of INR 243 Crores, a 7% year-on-year growth. The company also highlighted a significant surge in pre-sales, reaching INR 1,157 Crores for FY26, marking a 137% year-on-year increase. For the fourth quarter of FY26, revenue was INR 308 Crores (up 62% YoY), with an EBITDA margin of 39.4% and PAT of INR 101 Crores. Sri Lotus Developers has provided a pre-sales guidance of INR 1,800–2,000 Crores for FY27 and maintains a net debt-free status with industry-leading realisations of INR 69,000 per sq. ft.

Foundation, Suruchi Foundation, and Swati Foundation, each receiving 2,65,821 shares. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased to Rs. 52,14,75,210/-, comprising 10,42,95,042 equity shares. This announcement was made on May 12, 2026.

announcements.subject: Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Kalpataru Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.ai_summary: Kalpataru Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 12, 2026, approved a Composite Scheme of Arrangement under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The scheme involves Kalpataru Retail Ventures Private Limited (Demerged Company), Kalpataru Properties (Thane) Private Limited (Resulting Company), Alder Residency Private Limited, Kalpataru Residency Private Limited, Ardour Developers Private Limited, Aspen Housing Private Limited (all Transferor Companies), and Kalpataru Limited (Transferee Company). The Appointed Date for this arrangement is April 01, 2026, or such other date as may be approved by the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT). The scheme is subject to necessary approvals from the NCLT and other appropriate authorities.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: N R Agarwal Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: N R Agarwal Industries Limited announced that its Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 12, 2026, approved the alteration of the Memorandum of Association (MOA) of the Company. This alteration is subject to shareholder approval via a Special Resolution and other necessary approvals. The approved changes include renumbering the existing Clause 35A to Clause 36 and inserting a new Clause 37. The new clause will enable the company to develop, construct, and utilize its land or immovable property for industrial galas, sheds, units, warehouses, or commercial/industrial complexes, and to deal with such units or spaces. It also permits entering into agreements or joint ventures for development, construction, and marketing, and raising finance for these purposes.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Radico Khaitan Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 12, 2026, titled "After Dark Blue Unveils an All-New Premium Avatar, Strengthening Its Presence in the Deluxe Whisky Segment".
announcements.ai_summary: Radico Khaitan Limited has unveiled an all-new premium avatar for its After Dark Blue Grain Whisky, aiming to strengthen its presence in the deluxe whisky segment. This relaunch, effective from June 12, 2026, will be rolled out first in Uttar Pradesh and then in other markets over the next six months. The refreshed design language aligns with evolving consumer preferences and the growing demand for contemporary, aspirational whisky experiences in the Indian spirits market. Mr. Abhishek Khaitan, Managing Director, stated that the deluxe whisky segment is one of the largest in India and represents an attractive aspirational price point for consumers trading up. After Dark's growth of over 60% in FY26 reflects its strong consumer connect, and the new packaging is a strategic initiative to sustain this growth by enhancing the brand's contemporary appeal.

announcements.detail: Juniper Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release titled  Juniper Green Energy Commissions Additional 167 MW Wind Capacity '.
announcements.ai_summary: Juniper Green Energy Limited has announced the commissioning of an additional 167 MW of wind capacity across five projects, completed in phases since July 01, 2026. This brings the company's total operational capacity to approximately 2,575 MWp, an increase from the previous ~2,408 MWp. The newly commissioned capacity comprises 37 wind turbines, including 27 turbines of 5 MW each and 10 turbines of 3.15 MW each, located in Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Maharashtra. This expansion strengthens Juniper's operational portfolio, which now includes ~2,114 MWp Solar, ~461 MW Wind, and ~500 MWh BESS.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Raj Rayon Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Raj Rayon Industries Limited -Announces Rs. 650 Crore Phase II Expansion".
announcements.ai_summary: Raj Rayon Industries Limited's Board of Directors has approved a Phase II expansion program at its Silvassa facility, involving an investment of Rs. 650 crore. This expansion will add 300 TPD of polyester yarn capacity and 50 TPD of recycled polyester yarn capacity, with full commissioning expected in CY2028. The project is anticipated to generate revenue of Rs. 2,700–3,000 crore per annum at peak utilization, with FY29 being the first full year of commercialization. Additionally, the company will enter the fabrics segment with approximately 10 TPD capacity and double its Value-Added Dope-Dyed Yarn (DDY) capacity, both targeted for Q3 FY27. This expansion also signifies the company's entry into recycled polyester yarns and technical textiles, aiming for value-added, specialty, and sustainable products to constitute approximately 80% of revenue at peak utilization.

The NCLT order, in I.A. (IB) No. 342/KB/2023 in Company Petition (IB) No. 891/KB/2020, allowed an application filed by the Company's erstwhile Resolution Professional. This application sought the avoidance of certain preferential transactions under Section 43 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The Tribunal directed UCO Bank to refund INR 9.07 Crore to the Company, along with interest at 9%. Additionally, the NCLT directed the Joint Venture entities, specifically McNally - Trolex JV, McNally -AML JV, and McNally -Trolex- Kilburn JV, to refund INR 15.18 Crore to the Company, also with interest at 9%.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Shriram Properties Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Steady start to the year with strong operational momentum".
announcements.ai_summary: Shriram Properties Limited issued a press release on August 12, 2026, titled "Steady start to the year with strong operational momentum," detailing its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1FY27). The company reported strong operational performance with quarterly sales increasing by 10% year-on-year to ₹484 crore (0.85 msf), and pre-tax profits marginally higher at ₹18 crore. Key operational highlights include successful new launches in Chennai and Kolkata, such as "Forest View" plots in Kolkata and the premium residential project "King Life" in Koyambedu, Chennai. Gross customer collections grew 8% year-on-year to ₹365 crore, and over 690 units were handed over to customers during the quarter. The company maintains its full-year outlook, expecting pre-sales momentum to strengthen with multiple launches planned in the upcoming quarters.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Pennar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Pennar Industries Limited has announced its financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a consolidated total income of ₹884.55 Crore, an increase of 3.58% compared to ₹854.00 Crore in Q1 FY26. EBITDA stood at ₹106.79 Crore, up by 13.26% from ₹94.29 Crore in the prior year's quarter. Profit Before Tax (PBT) was ₹46.80 Crore, a 16.04% increase from ₹40.33 Crore in Q1 FY26, and Profit After Tax (PAT) was ₹35.41 Crore, up by 10.79% from ₹31.96 Crore in Q1 FY26. These warrants are convertible into equity shares within 18 months of allotment. Upon full conversion of warrants, NB Holdings, USA will hold 49.90% of JCL's paid-up equity share capital. announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Mallcom (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding receipt of the certified copy of the NCLT Order passed by the Hon ble NCLT, Kolkata Bench, in relation to the Scheme of Amalgamation between Mallcom (India) Limited and its wholly-owned subsidiary, Mallcom VSFT Gloves Private Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Mallcom (India) Limited announced on August 12, 2026, that the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Kolkata Bench, vide its order dated July 9, 2026 (received today), did not approve the Scheme of Amalgamation. The scheme was between Mallcom (India) Limited (Transferee Company) and its wholly-owned subsidiary, Mallcom VSFT Gloves Private Limited (Transferor Company), under Section 233 of the Companies Act, 2013. The NCLT, in C.P. No. 172/KB/2025, ruled that the requirement under Section 233(1)(b) for approval by members holding at least 90% of total shares was not fulfilled. Consequently, proceedings related to the scheme pending before the Regional Director were quashed. The company is currently evaluating its further course of action, if any, in this matter.

announcements.detail: Unihealth Hospitals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "UMC Hospitals, Navi Mumbai Successfully Treats Complex Pancreatic Complication Through Advanced Minimally Invasive Surgery".
announcements.ai_summary: Unihealth Hospitals Limited has issued a press release dated August 12, 2026, highlighting a successful complex pancreatic complication treatment at its UMC Hospitals facility in Navi Mumbai. The press release details the case of a 33-year-old man who developed a large walled-off pancreatic necrosis following severe pancreatitis. The patient, who also had Type 1 diabetes and high cholesterol, had previously undergone a two-week hospitalisation at another facility. After experiencing persistent symptoms, evaluation at UMC Hospitals revealed the complication. Dr. Harsh Sheth, Consultant – Bariatric & GI Laparoscopic Surgeon at UMC Hospitals, successfully treated the patient using an advanced minimally invasive laparoscopic approach, avoiding a conventional large open operation. The press release is available on the company's website, www.unihealthonline.com.

announcements.ai_summary: Thomas Cook (India) Limited has issued a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Thomas Cook India launches India Forex Report 2026 - Unveiling key shifts in how Indians buy, carry and spend forex". The report, based on transaction data from April 2025 to March 2026, highlights emerging trends in the Indian forex market. Key findings include Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities contributing 53% to forex demand, a growing preference for destination-specific currencies, increased digital adoption by younger consumers (25% now transacting digitally), and a shift towards card and digital payment experiences. The report also notes expanding study abroad demand and a strong preference for forex cards among corporate travellers (84% usage).

announcements.ai_summary: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about an investment in its wholly-owned subsidiary, Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd., Saudi Arabia. On August 12, 2026, the company infused the second tranche of investment amounting to Saudi Riyal (SAR) 5,10,000. This investment was for the subscription of 75 shares at SAR 6800 per share, equivalent to approximately Rs. 1,30,96,801/-. This infusion aims to support the operations and growth of the subsidiary in Saudi Arabia.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Nucleus Software Exports Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Stanbic IBTC Bank advances Transaction Banking capabilities through Nucleus Software s FinnAxia® 9.0 upgrade".
announcements.ai_summary: Nucleus Software Exports Limited has issued a press release dated August 12, 2026, announcing that Stanbic IBTC Bank has advanced its Transaction Banking capabilities through an upgrade to Nucleus Software's FinnAxia® 9.0. This milestone signifies a decade-long partnership focused on innovation in transaction banking. The upgrade enhances Stanbic IBTC Bank's platform to deliver integrated payments, collections, liquidity management, and cash management solutions. It aims to improve operational agility, automation, connectivity, and digital customer experiences, providing a scalable foundation for future growth. The adoption of FinnAxia® 9.0 aligns with Stanbic IBTC Bank's strategy to leverage technology for client value creation and operational excellence, addressing the evolving demands for real-time, digitally enabled banking services across Africa.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: United Foodbrands Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Corporate Presentation - August 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: United Foodbrands Limited has released a Corporate Presentation for August 2026. This presentation, available on the company's website at www.unitedfoodbrands.in under the Investors section, provides insights into the company's strategic initiatives and future business developments. The presentation highlights United Foodbrands' leading position in the casual dining restaurant (CDR) format, with 266 restaurants across India, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. It also details the year-on-year growth for Q1FY27 across its three growth engines: Barbeque Nation (+43.4% YoY), International (+46.6% YoY), and Premium CDR (+36.2% YoY). The company emphasizes its scalable, multi-brand dining platform, proven unit economics, captive customer base, and significant expansion headroom, noting a large whitespace for expansion across markets.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Divyadhan Recycling Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about the order received from Regional Director, Western Region approving the shifting of registred office of the company from the State of Maharashtra to the State of Uttar Pradesh.
announcements.ai_summary: Divyadhan Recycling Industries Limited has received approval from the Regional Director, Western Region, for the shifting of its registered office from the State of Maharashtra to the State of Uttar Pradesh. This approval follows an application filed by the company and a special resolution passed by its members on May 15, 2025. The company had previously informed the exchanges about its intention to shift its registered office on April 22, 2026, and May 15, 2026. The original order was received by the company on August 11, 2026.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Jyothy Labs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'General Updates'.
announcements.ai_summary: Jyothy Labs Limited's Board of Directors has approved the transfer and assignment of leasehold rights for the company's manufacturing facility located in Jammu. The facility, situated at Lane 2, Phase II, SIDCO Industrial Complex, Bari Brahmana, Jammu & Kashmir, admeasuring approximately 15 kanals, will be transferred to M/s. Aikyam Flexipack Private Limited. The transaction is for a consideration of approximately Rs. 9.93 crores and is expected to be concluded by March 31, 2027, subject to the fulfillment of mutually agreed conditions.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: AVG Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: AVG Logistics Limited has secured a long-term contract from a renowned Cement Manufacturer in India for multimodal logistics solutions. Under this agreement, AVG Logistics will deploy a fleet of 30 heavy-duty EV Trucks to manage inbound and outbound logistics for raw materials and finished goods across key industrial corridors in the North East region. The contract has a tenure of 5 years, with an option to extend for an additional 3 years. AVG Logistics will also establish, operate, and maintain dedicated EV charging stations to support zero-emission supply chain practices. This strategic partnership is expected to provide long-term revenue stability and enhance operational efficiency, contributing positively to the company's financial standing and profitability.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: JSW Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about execution of Shareholders  Agreement by JSW Neo Energy Limited with Druk Green Power Corporation Limited for the joint development of the 920 MW Punatsangchhu-III Hydroelectric Project, Bhutan
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Energy Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary JSW Neo Energy Limited (JSWNEL), has entered into a Shareholders' Agreement with Druk Green Power Corporation Limited (DGPC), a company wholly owned by the Royal Government of Bhutan. This agreement is for the joint development of the 920 MW Punatsangchhu-III Hydroelectric Project located in Bhutan. The project will be developed on a Build-Own-Operate-Transfer basis through a special purpose joint venture company to be incorporated in Bhutan. DGPC will hold a 51% equity stake, while JSWNEL will hold a 49% equity stake in the joint venture. The incorporation of the joint venture company is pending.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Race Eco Chain Limited has informed regarding updated on Disclosure of material issue submitted on 30th June, 22026
announcements.ai_summary: Race Eco Chain Limited has provided an update regarding the sale of its stake in M/s. Prime Industries Limited, an associate company. The company previously disclosed the sale of 2,10,000 equity shares, representing approximately 0.99% of Prime Industries' share capital, on June 30, 2026. However, the delivery and settlement of this transaction occurred on July 1, 2026. Consequently, Race Eco Chain Limited ceased to have significant influence over Prime Industries, and Prime Industries is no longer considered an associate company, effective July 1, 2026, instead of the previously stated June 30, 2026. The company has requested that this revised effective date be recorded. All other details of the disclosure remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: Change in Auditors
announcements.detail: Master Components Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
announcements.ai_summary: Master Components Limited has informed the Exchange about the resignation of its Statutory Auditors, M/s. Bhalchandra D Karve and Associates, Chartered Accountants. The resignation is effective from the close of business hours on Thursday, August 13, 2026. The company has enclosed the resignation letter dated August 12, 2026, along with Annexure-A. The reason for the change is stated as the company's decision for restructuring its statutory audit process and assignments in line with its amalgamation with an unlisted private limited company. The Audit Committee and the Board of Directors will take note of this resignation in their upcoming meetings. The information is also being uploaded to the company's website.

announcements.subject: Stock split
announcements.detail: Bansal Wire Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 12, 2026, has considered and approved subdivision of 1 equity share of Rs. 5 each into 5 equity shares of Rs. 1 each.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Bansal Wire Industries Limited, in a meeting held on August 12, 2026, approved a stock split. This involves subdividing each of the company's 1 equity share with a face value of Rs. 5 into 5 equity shares, each with a face value of Rs. 1. This subdivision is subject to shareholder approval. The Board also approved an alteration to the Capital Clause of the Memorandum of Association to reflect this change, increasing the authorized share capital to Rs. 90,00,00,000, divided into 89,00,00,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 1 each and 10,00,000 6% redeemable preference shares of Rs. 10 each. The company will decide on the record date for this sub-division after obtaining shareholder approval. Additionally, Shri Ramesh Kumar Choubey was appointed as an Additional Director (Non-Executive, Independent Director) for a term of five years, effective August 12, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. Smt. Sunita Bindal resigned as an Independent Director, effective August 12, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Kotyark Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Press Release & Media Release dated August 12, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Kotyark Industries Limited has announced a significant biodiesel allocation totaling ₹173.45 Crore from Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs), including IOCL, BPCL, and HPCL. This allocation is for supplies in Gujarat during the period of June to August 2026, with an execution period of 92 days from the Award of Contract. The Chairman & Managing Director, Mr. Gaurang Rameshchandra Shah, stated that this achievement strengthens the company's participation in the OMC biodiesel supply ecosystem and reflects growing engagement with major OMCs. Kotyark Industries Limited aims to demonstrate its manufacturing capabilities, execution discipline, and commitment to reliable supply. The company is well-positioned to cater to the requirements of OMCs, bulk buyers, and industrial customers, leveraging its expanded manufacturing capacity and flexible multi-feedstock platform.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Release    HCLTech recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant  for Public Cloud Optimization and Transformation Services .
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Limited has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Public Cloud Optimization and Transformation Services. This marks a continuation of their leadership position, having been recognized in similar assessments from 2021 through 2025. The company emphasizes its advanced cloud capabilities, driven by its Public Cloud Optimization and Transformation Services (PCOTS) business and a strong partner ecosystem. HCLTech leverages automation for enhanced operational resilience and continuous optimization. They offer industry-focused, cloud-native solutions with robust DevOps practices and global centers of excellence, enabling enterprises to accelerate time-to-value and improve compliance. The company is also expanding its engagement with enterprises and mid-sized businesses through flexible commercial frameworks, including sustainability-linked and experience-based models.

announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities
announcements.detail: Religare Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Options to purchase securities
announcements.ai_summary: Religare Enterprises Limited's Nomination and Remuneration Committee, in a meeting held on August 12, 2026, granted 13,195 stock options under the Religare Enterprises Limited Employee Stock Option Plan 2019. These options are convertible into 13,195 equity shares, each with a face value of Rs. 10. The exercise price for these stock options is Rs. 227.35 per equity share. The stock options will vest in five equal annual installments of 20% each, with the first installment due upon completion of one year from the grant date. The scheme is in conformity with SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021, and has been approved by the Board of Directors and Shareholders.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Paradeep Phosphates Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Paradeep Phosphates Limited has successfully incorporated a wholly-owned subsidiary named "Fertilizer Innovation Foundation – India" on August 11, 2026. This not-for-profit entity, established in India, will focus on research, innovation, knowledge dissemination, capacity building, and allied activities within the fertilizer and agriculture sector. The subsidiary aims to support sustainable agricultural practices, improve fertilizer use efficiency, and strengthen sector innovation through collaborations with national and international institutions. The incorporation aligns with the company's long-term sustainability and strategic objectives. The company has subscribed to 100% of the initial paid-up share capital of the subsidiary, with cash consideration involved.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Dabur India Limited has informed the Exchange about Allotment of Equity Shares under Dabur Employees Stock Option Scheme 2000
announcements.ai_summary: Dabur India Limited announced on August 12, 2026, that its Nomination & Remuneration Committee has approved the allotment of 4,638 equity shares of Rs. 1 each. These shares were allotted pursuant to the exercise of options by employees of the company and its subsidiaries under the Dabur Employees Stock Option Scheme 2000. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased from Rs. 177,39,52,388 (comprising 177,39,52,388 equity shares of Re. 1 each) to Rs. 177,39,57,026 (comprising 177,39,57,026 equity shares of Re. 1 each). The newly allotted equity shares will rank pari passu with the existing equity shares of the company. The committee's resolution was passed at 10:11 a.m. on August 12, 2026.

announcements.ai_summary: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Limited has received a show cause notice dated August 11, 2026, from the Office of the Commissioner of GST & Central Excise, Audit-I Commissionerate, Chennai. The company is required to respond to this notice, the details of which are provided in Annexure-1. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company has declared that the information provided in the annexure is true, correct, and complete to the best of its knowledge and belief. This announcement was made on August 12, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Opening of 3 - Screen Multiplex at Metro World Mall, Gurugram, Haryana
announcements.ai_summary: Cineline India Limited is expanding its presence in the Delhi NCR region with the opening of a new 3-screen multiplex under its "MovieMax Multiplex" brand. Located at Metro World Mall, Sector 56, Gurugram, Haryana, this is MovieMax's second property in Gurugram and fifth in the Delhi NCR area. The multiplex spans approximately 16,000 sq. ft. and offers a seating capacity of 477 seats across its three screens, including recliner, executive, and prime seating options. It is equipped with advanced 2K Christie/GDC Server projection systems for enhanced picture quality. The cinema is strategically situated in a high-potential catchment area with strong residential and commercial activity, and is conveniently accessible from Sector 54 Chowk Metro Station. This expansion was announced on August 12, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Greaves Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, issued by Greaves Electric Mobility Limited, subsidiary of the Company,  titled "Ampere Magnus G Max Gets Smarter With 30+ Connected Features Powered by NxG.io for Everyday Bharat Riders.".
announcements.ai_summary: Greaves Cotton Limited's subsidiary, Greaves Electric Mobility Limited, has announced a significant upgrade to its Ampere Magnus G Max electric scooter. The upgraded model now features over 30 connected features powered by the NxG.io software platform, enhancing rider experience with functionalities like Cruise Control, Hill Hold Assist, and Turn-by-Turn Navigation. These features are accessible through an intuitive Ampere Connect App, offering real-time charging status, live tracking, geo-fencing, theft and tow alerts, remote diagnostics, and service booking. The company has also introduced a new cinnamon copper color option alongside premium dual-tone colors. The Ampere Magnus G Max with these new features is priced at INR 1,09,999. This announcement was made on August 12, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Computer Age Management Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a  "Press Release titled   IIT Madras, CAMS to launch initiatives to boost next-generationFinTech innovation" dated 12th August 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Computer Age Management Services Limited (CAMS) has announced a renewed collaboration with IIT Madras to boost next-generation FinTech innovation through the CAMS IIT Madras FinTech Innovation Lab (CIFIL). This initiative, established in 2022 as part of CAMS' CSR efforts, combines CAMS' financial technology expertise with IIT Madras' academic and research capabilities. The expanded partnership, formalized with a new MoU signed on August 12, 2026, will focus on emerging areas like AI in financial services, digital payments, blockchain, cybersecurity, WealthTech, InsurTech, digital lending, data analytics, and financial inclusion. CIFIL aims to enhance research, support startups, foster industry collaboration, and advance professional education in the BFSI sector. The lab will also focus on developing intellectual property, facilitating technology transfer, and commercializing research-led solutions to strengthen India's digital financial ecosystem.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 12, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited's Board of Directors, at their meeting held on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, from 10:30 a.m. to 11:1

announcements.subject: Press Release (Revised)
announcements.detail: SJVN Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "SJVN Achieves COD of 75 MW Jamui Solar PowerProject in Bihar".
announcements.ai_summary: SJVN Limited announced on August 12, 2026, that it has achieved the Commercial Operation Date (COD) for its 75 MW Jamui Solar Power Project in District Jamui, Bihar. The project, executed through its wholly-owned subsidiary SJVN Green Energy Limited (SGEL), is projected to generate approximately 90 million units of electricity in its first year and around 3,522 million units over a 25-year period. Developed over approximately 300 acres of land near Village Hadhadiya, Kakanchaur, the project incurred an estimated cost of ₹342 crore. The power generated will be supplied to the State of Bihar at a fixed tariff of ₹2.96 per unit, and the project has created approximately 15-20 direct and 50-100 indirect employment opportunities.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Atlas Cycles (Haryana) Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Atlas Cycles (Haryana) Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on August 12, 2026, from 10:20 a.m. to 11:00 a.m., approved an extension for the execution of the Sale Deed for 20 acres of land in Sonepat, Haryana. The buyer had requested an extension until December 31, 2026, for the completion of the sale. Pursuant to the Agreement to Sell entered into on December 7, 2024, the Company has already received an advance of Rs. 45.00 crores. Furthermore, the buyer has committed to paying an additional Rs. 15.00 crores by October 30, 2026. The Company will provide further intimations as and when any other material development occurs regarding this land sale.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Axis Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Axis Bank Limited successfully allotted U.S.$300,000,000 5.348 per cent. Senior Notes on August 12, 2026. These new Notes will be consolidated to form a single series with the U.S.$300,000,000 5.348 per cent. Senior Notes previously issued on June 30, 2026, under the U.S.$5,000,000,000 Global Medium Term Note Programme. The issuance and allotment were completed in compliance with applicable laws and regulatory requirements, as stated in furtherance to previous letters dated December 26, 2025, and August 4, 2026. The Notes are slated for listing on the Global Securities Market of the India International Exchange (IFSC) Limited and the Debt Securities Market of the NSE IFSC Limited.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Interaction with Electronic Media
announcements.ai_summary: Symphony Limited announced that its management will interact with the electronic media channel NDTV Profit on August 12, 2026. The interaction is scheduled to discuss the business overview of the Company. Investors should note that the date is subject to change, and the interaction may be postponed or cancelled due to exigencies. Details of the telecast will be subsequently placed on the Company's website, www.symphonylimited.com, for wider dissemination of information to members. This update was signed by Mayur Barvadiya, Company Secretary and Head - Legal.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Viviana Power Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about receiving bid confirmation for L1 Stage   successful bidder having amount of Rs. 113 Crores (inclusive taxes).
announcements.ai_summary: Bajel Projects Limited has been awarded an Ultra Mega EPC Order for a Transmission Line project by PowerGrid Corporation of India Limited, acting on behalf of their SPV, M/s WR ER Part A Power Transmission Limited. This order is part of the WR -ER Inter -Regional Network Expansion Scheme-Part A under the TBCB route. The contract is for Transmission Line Package TL05, involving specific bypass and LILO configurations for 765kV D/C lines. This order is considered within the ordinary course of the company's business, and none of the promoters or group companies have any interest in the awarding entity. The specific value of the order is not explicitly stated but falls under the "Ultra-Mega Orders" category, which is for Rs. 400 Crores and above, as per the company's classification.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Praxis Home Retail Limited has informed regarding reclassification of shareholding of Promoter category into Public category.
announcements.ai_summary: Praxis Home Retail Limited has submitted a revised disclosure regarding the reclassification of shareholding from the 'Promoter/Promoter Group' category to the 'Public' category, as per Regulation 31A of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. This follows applications received on June 09, 2025, from various promoter and promoter group members. The disclosure includes a detailed list of these individuals and entities, such as Kishore Biyani, Sangita Kishore Biyani (holding 1.24%), Avni Kishore Biyani (holding 2.51%), and Surplus Finvest Private Limited (holding 3.24%), along with their respective shareholdings as of the reporting date. The company will undertake necessary actions in accordance with SEBI regulations.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Magellanic Cloud Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, regarding the receipt of Purchase Orders from NCR Corporation Private by IVIS International Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Magellanic Cloud Limited's wholly owned subsidiary, IVIS International Private Limited, has secured multiple purchase orders from NCR Corporation India Private Limited. These orders are for providing E-Surveillance Solutions across 1,000 Punjab National Bank (PNB) ATM sites. The aggregate value of these purchase orders is approximately ₹18.4 Crore, with a tenure of 5 years, encompassing both Capex and Opex components. This development strengthens Magellanic Cloud's presence in the Banking & Financial Services E-Surveillance sector, particularly for large-scale ATM surveillance deployments.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Bajel Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts.
announcements.ai_summary: Viviana Power Tech Limited has been declared the L1 stage successful bidder for two projects concerning the conversion of HT overhead 11 KV open lines to MVCC overhead conductor and underground networking in the Petlad and Nadiad divisions under MGVCL's SI Scheme Robust-III. The total value of this bid confirmation is Rs. 113 Crores, inclusive of taxes. This L1 status, along with other new project awards, is expected to increase the company's total unexecuted projects value to over Rs. 1400.00 Crores. Further details, as required by SEBI regulations, will be provided once the Letter of Intent of Award is received.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Airo Lam limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Airo Lam Limited has incorporated two wholly owned subsidiaries outside India: Airolam USA LLC in the United States of America and Airolam EUROPE in Wroclaw, Poland. Both newly incorporated subsidiaries will engage in the trading of plywood and laminates. Airolam USA LLC has been set up with a capital of 20,000 shares at a face value of USD 10 per share, with 100% of the shares held by Airo Lam Limited. The principal business activity of both subsidiaries is the trading of plywood and laminates and other ancillary products. The promoter/promoter group/group companies of Airo Lam Limited do not have any interest in these entities beyond Airo Lam Limited being the sole owner.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Newjaisa Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "NewJaisa Technologies Limited Enters into Distribution Partnership with Redington Limited to Expand Availability of Refurbished Computing Products Across India".
announcements.ai_summary: Newjaisa Technologies Limited has entered into a Distribution Agreement for Refurbished Products with Redington Limited, effective July 29, 2026. Redington has been appointed as a non-exclusive distributor for Newjaisa's refurbished products across India. This partnership will enable Redington to resell the products to dealers, resellers, and end customers, thereby expanding the availability of Newjaisa's refurbished computing products through an established technology distribution ecosystem. The agreement provides Newjaisa with an additional distribution channel, complementing its existing sales and distribution networks, and is expected to enhance its reach to customers through both online and offline channels.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: We hereby informed the Exchange of the press release titled "SEPC Reports 40% YoY Revenue Growth in June Quarter Despite Overseas margin Headwinds". Detailed letter is enclosed.
announcements.ai_summary: SEPC Limited has announced its consolidated financial results for the first quarter (Q1 FY27) ended June 30, 2026, reporting a 40% year-on-year revenue growth. Total income for Q1 FY27 stood at ₹282 Cr, an increase from ₹202 Cr in Q1 FY26. The company secured a fresh SAIL Pellet Plant order worth ₹952 Cr in August 2026, which is in addition to its existing order book. Despite overseas margin headwinds, particularly from ongoing execution in the Middle East, SEPC reported total orders on hand of ₹10,670 Cr as of June 30, 2026, comprising a domestic order book of ₹5,270 Cr and an international order book of ₹5,400 Cr. The company reported a net loss of ₹11 Cr for the quarter, compared to a profit of ₹17 Cr in Q1 FY26, attributing the margin pressure to specific overseas contracts and implementing cost and pricing measures.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Newjaisa Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Newjaisa Technologies Limited has entered into a Distribution Agreement for Refurbished Products with Redington Limited, effective July 29, 2026. Under this agreement, Redington has been appointed as a non-exclusive distributor for Newjaisa's products across India. This partnership aims to leverage Redington's established technology distribution network to expand the availability and reach of Newjaisa's professionally refurbished computing products through organized distribution channels. Redington will have the right to resell Newjaisa's refurbished products to dealers, resellers, and end customers. This arrangement provides Newjaisa with an additional distribution channel and is expected to strengthen its distribution reach and enhance product availability. A detailed press release will be disseminated separately.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Krystal Integrated Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Acquires 100% Stake in Citelum India from France Government Owned EDF Group".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Krystal Integrated Services Limited announced on August 12, 2026, that it has acquired 100% of the equity stake in Citelum India Private Limited from its current shareholders, including Citelum S.A.S., France. Citelum India will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Krystal Integrated Services Limited. This acquisition marks Krystal's entry into the City Lighting & Urban Infrastructure segment. The company targets an annual revenue of ₹300–350 crore from this new vertical over the next 3–4 years and plans to invest approximately ₹100 crore in engineering capabilities, technology platforms, and business expansion.

announcements.detail: Magellanic Cloud Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Purchase Orders received by IVIS International Private Limited from NCR Corporation India Private for E-surveillance Solutions at Punjab National Bank ATM sites'.

These orders are for providing E-Surveillance Solutions at Punjab National Bank (PNB) ATM sites.
