announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Government Revises ACC PLI Timelines for Ola Electric;Company Secures Full Five-Year Incentive WindowThrough CY2031, Unlocking Up to ₹7,240 Crore".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Ola Electric Mobility Limited announced on August 12, 2026, that the Ministry of Heavy Industries (MHI) has revised the timelines for its ACC Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme. This revision secures a full five-year incentive window through CY2031 for Ola Electric's 20 GWh allocation, potentially unlocking up to ₹7,240 crore in cumulative PLI incentives. Disbursements will be made quarterly, starting from the next quarter. Ola Electric's wholly-owned subsidiary, Ola Cell Technologies Private Limited (OCT), is the beneficiary. The company expects to reach 6 GWh of installed cell-manufacturing capacity by the end of the current quarter, ahead of the revised December 2026 timeline.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: GSP Crop Science Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Press release on the financial performance of the company for quarter ended 30th June, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: GSP Crop Science Limited reported its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 12, 2026. Revenue from operations remained stable at ₹3,860 million. Gross profit grew by 10% year-on-year to ₹1,424 million, with margins improving to 37%. Profit After Tax (PAT) increased by 16% year-on-year to ₹264 million. The company also announced the acquisition of the remaining 21% equity stake in GSP Intermediates Private Limited (GIPL) on June 11, 2026, making GIPL a wholly-owned subsidiary. GIPL commissioned its ETP & MEEA plant at Saykha GIDC, strengthening manufacturing infrastructure.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Acme Solar Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Full redemption of offshore dollar bonds through domestic refinancing".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Acme Solar Holdings Limited has announced the full redemption of its offshore dollar bonds through domestic refinancing. This action was completed on August 12, 2026. The company has successfully refinanced INR 2,147 crore of existing Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) which were due for redemption. This strategic move aims to optimize the company's capital structure and reduce its foreign currency exposure. The refinancing was executed through a combination of domestic debt instruments.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Max Estates Limited has informed the Exchange about the allotment of 51,525 equity shares pursuant to the exercise of stock options.
announcements.ai_summary: On August 11, 2026, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of Max Estates Limited approved the allotment of 51,525 equity shares. These shares were allotted to option holders who exercised their stock options under the Max Estates Employee Stock Option Plan 2023. Each equity share has a face value of INR 10/-. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased from INR 1,63,51,34,100/- to INR 1,63,56,49,350/-, comprising 16,35,64,935 equity shares of INR 10/- each. The event occurred on August 11, 2026, at 17:22 Hrs (IST).

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Completion of Sale of land at Podanur under Phase I
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Everest Industries Limited has completed the sale of vacant, excess land at Kurichi Village, Podanur, Madukkarai Taluk, Coimbatore District, Tamil Nadu, to G Square Properties Private Limited. The transaction, which was initially approved by the board on August 29, 2025, involved the sale of 16.84 acres of land, equivalent to 18.99 acres as per Patta and 19.41 acres as per FMB. The Sale Deed was executed and registered on April 10, 2026. This sale is part of Phase I of the land disposal, with the company having previously provided updates on October 27, 2025, January 25, 2026, and April 1, 2026. The contribution of this land to the company's turnover, revenue, income, and net worth for the last financial year is not applicable as it is vacant, excess land.

announcements.subject: Press Release (Revised)
announcements.detail: Manorama Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated May 11, 2026, titled "Revised Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Manorama Industries Limited has issued a revised press release on May 11, 2026, detailing its strong financial performance for the fourth quarter and the full financial year ended March 31, 2026. For FY26, the company reported a revenue increase of 76.1% year-on-year to ₹13,577 Million, with EBITDA growing by 92.5% year-on-year to ₹3,677 Million. Profit After Tax (PAT) surged by 108.1% year-on-year to ₹2,332 Million. The press release also highlighted a standalone PAT margin of 17.2% for FY26 and a diluted EPS of ₹39.05, an increase of 108.5% year-on-year. The company is a pioneer in the manufacturing of Cocoa Butter Equivalent (CBE), specialty fats & butters, and exotic products.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: International Conveyors Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: International Conveyors Limited has acquired 87,105 equity shares of Jain Resource Recycling Limited for a cash consideration of ₹5 Crore. This acquisition, which took place on May 11, 2026, represents an investment purpose for International Conveyors Limited. Jain Resource Recycling Limited, incorporated in 2022, specializes in recycling non-ferrous metal scrap and producing lead, copper, and aluminum alloys, with its lead ingots being London Metal Exchange-registered. The target entity's turnover for FY 2024-25 was ₹7125.77 Crore. No specific governmental or regulatory approvals were indicated as required for this acquisition.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Softtech Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 29(1) and 29(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 '.
announcements.ai_summary: Softtech Engineers Limited has submitted disclosures regarding shareholding changes under Regulation 29(1) and 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Fedex Finance Pvt Ltd acquired 22,46,998 equity shares of SoftTech Engineers Limited on May 7, 2026, through the market. Concurrently, Elimath Advisors Pvt Ltd disposed of shares on the same date. These disclosures are being made to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited for their information and records.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Graphite India Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Graphite India Limited (GIL) announced on May 11, 2026, that it has acquired additional shares in GrafTech International Ltd., a NYSE-listed company, through secondary market transactions/Overseas Portfolio Investment (OPI) scheme. This latest acquisition involved an investment of INR 62.25 Crores, increasing GIL's stake in GrafTech from 6.82% to 9.79%. The total investment by GIL in GrafTech International Ltd. to date stands at INR 230.38 Crores. GrafTech International Ltd., with a market capitalization of 24

announcements.company: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited
announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited (the Company)  has informed the Exchange about General Updates that the Company has completed the sale of equity shares of Clean Max Sapphire Private Limited to Clean Max Taurus Private Limited on 11 May 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited announced on May 11, 2026, the completion of the sale of equity shares of Clean Max Sapphire Private Limited. The equity shares were sold to Clean Max Taurus Private Limited. This transaction follows a previous disclosure made by the Company on May 07, 2026. The completion of this sale is in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: BLACKBUCK LIMITED has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: BlackBuck Limited has informed the Exchange that its non-material wholly owned subsidiary, ZZ Logistics Solutions Private Limited (ZZLSPL), has been struck off by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. This action was taken following an application filed by ZZLSPL itself. Consequently, ZZLSPL ceased to exist as a wholly owned subsidiary of BlackBuck Limited effective May 11, 2026. The disclosure indicates that ZZLSPL was a non-material subsidiary with nil turnover, revenue, income, and net worth since its incorporation, and therefore, the disposal was carried out by way of strike-off, with no consideration received.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Rossell Techsys Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition - Lease of new facility
announcements.ai_summary: Rossell Techsys Limited is expanding its operational capacity by leasing a new facility adjacent to its current manufacturing unit. This expansion involves adding 2,10,000 Sq feet of space, with 1,40,000 Sq feet expected to be operational within 4-5 months and the remaining 70,000 Sq feet within 8-12 months. The total investment for this initiative is Rs. 30 Crores, which will be financed through a mix of debt and internal accruals. This move is intended to support the growing execution of customer programs and enhance operational efficiency, throughput, and flexibility.

announcements.subject: Sale or disposal
announcements.detail: BLS International Services Limited has informed the Exchange that Reired BLS International Services Private Limited (Wholly owned subsidiary of the Comapny) has been strike off/ closed.
announcements.ai_summary: BLS International Services Limited has announced the strike-off and closure of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Reired BLS International Services Private Limited. This follows earlier approvals for the closure, and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs has now confirmed the approval of the E-form STK-2. Consequently, Reired BLS International Services Private Limited will be officially closed and struck off as of May 11, 2026. This action is a formalization of the subsidiary's closure.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Premier Energies Limited has informed the Exchange about Updates on Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Premier Energies Limited has announced that it and Syrma SGS Technology Limited have decided not to proceed with the proposed acquisition of a 51% equity stake in K-Solare Energy Private Limited. This joint venture was previously disclosed on October 23, 2025. The decision to terminate discussions with K-Solare was made amicably after mutual discussions and evaluation of evolving strategic considerations, with no material financial implications arising from this termination. Premier Energies Limited remains committed to the solar inverter and renewable energy electronics segment and is exploring alternative approaches for business development in this area.

announcements.subject: Retirement
announcements.detail: Oriental Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Retirement
announcements.ai_summary: Oriental Hotels Limited has announced the retirement of Mr. Vijay Sankar, an Independent Director, effective from the end of business hours on May 11, 2026, upon completion of his term. This disclosure is made in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company has provided the requisite disclosure as per Schedule III of the Listing Regulations and SEBI Circular dated January 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation regarding request received from M/s Solan Developers Private Limited for Reclassification from "Promoter and Promoter Group" Category to "Public" Category pursuant to Regulation 30 & 31A of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.
announcements.ai_summary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited has received a request from M/s Solan Developers Private Limited to be reclassified from the "Promoter and Promoter Group" category to the "Public" category. This request is being made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. M/s Solan Developers Private Limited currently holds zero shares in the company. The Board of Directors will review this request and consider it in an upcoming board meeting, in accordance with SEBI regulations. The company will inform the stock exchange of the Board's decision.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange about the Receipt of Order passed by the Hon ble NCLT, Chennai Bench, in relation to the Scheme of amalgamation between Dr. Agarwal s Eye Hospital Limited and Dr. Agarwal s Health Care Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited has received an Order from the Hon’ble NCLT, Chennai Bench, dated May 05, 2026, concerning the Scheme of amalgamation between Dr. Agarwal’s Eye Hospital Limited (AEHL) and Dr. Agarwal’s Health Care Limited (AHCL). The NCLT has directed AEHL and AHCL to convene meetings of their respective Equity Shareholders, Secured Creditors, and Unsecured Creditors on July 02, 2026, to consider and approve the amalgamation scheme. The formal written order was uploaded on the NCLT website on May 11, 2026. The scheme is still subject to other necessary statutory and regulatory approvals.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Shoppers Stop Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 30 read with Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended ( SEBI Listing Regulations ) - Receipt of request seeking re-classification from  Promoter Group  category to  Public Shareholder  category of Shoppers Stop Limited ( the Company )'.
announcements.ai_summary: Shoppers Stop Limited has received requests from Sycamore Properties Private Limited and Content Properties Private Limited, currently classified under the Promoter Group, seeking re-classification to the 'Public Shareholder' category. These requests, dated May 11, 2026, are made in accordance with Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The re-classification is subject to the consideration and approval of the Company's Board of Directors.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: State Bank Of India has informed the Exchange regarding 'withdrawal of nomination
announcements.ai_summary: State Bank of India has informed about the withdrawal of nomination by Shri Dharmendra Singh Shekhawat for the election of Directors to the Central Board. His nomination was previously found valid under Section 19A of the State Bank of India Act, 1955. Consequently, his name will be removed from the list of candidates. The General Meeting of Shareholders to elect directors is scheduled for May 15, 2026, at 03:00 PM via Video Conferencing (VC) / Other Audio Visual Means (OAVM).

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Inventure Growth & Securities Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.'.
announcements.ai_summary: Inventure Growth & Securities Limited disclosed on May 11, 2026, that the Hon’ble Bombay High Court has appointed a Sole Arbitrator in disputes stemming from an Agreement for Sale of Shares dated August 13, 2014. The company, through its Chairman & Managing Director Kanji B. Rita, contested its impleadment in the arbitration, asserting it was not a signatory to the arbitration agreement. The High Court observed that the Arbitral Tribunal would decide whether the company is bound by the agreement. Crucially, the court passed no findings against Inventure Growth & Securities Limited, keeping all rights and contentions of the parties open for future proceedings. This update follows a previous announcement made on April 10, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Garware Technical Fibres Limited has informed the Exchange about Certified True copy of the Resolution passed by the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 08, 2026, approving the buyback.
announcements.ai_summary: Garware Technical Fibres Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 08, 2026, approved a buyback of the company's equity shares. This approval is in compliance with the SEBI (Buy-Back of Securities) Regulations, 2018, and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013. The buyback is subject to necessary approvals from regulatory authorities such as SEBI, RBI, and stock exchanges. A certified true copy of the Board Resolution has been provided.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Afcons Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 11, 2026, titled ""Afcons forays in Europe"".
announcements.ai_summary: Afcons Infrastructure Limited has been selected as the most suitable bidder for the rehabilitation and construction of a railway line in Croatia, marking its foray into Europe. This project follows the company being declared the Lowest Bidder (L1) on July 21, 2025, for the reconstruction of an existing track and construction of a second track on the Dugo Selo – Novska railway line, including overhead electrification and signalling & telecommunication works. This will be Afcons' largest international order to date, underscoring its commitment to global infrastructure development. The project involves the reconstruction of the existing track and the construction of a second track railway line.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Ather Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'press release titled  Rizta crosses 3 Lakh unit milestone driving accelerated growth for Ather".
announcements.ai_summary: Ather Energy Limited announced that its family scooter, the Rizta, has crossed the 3 lakh unit sales milestone within two years of its launch. The Rizta, introduced in April 2024, has become the company's largest volume driver, contributing 76% of Ather's total sales volumes in FY26. The scooter reached the 1 lakh unit sales mark within 11 months and crossed 3 lakh units in the subsequent 11 months, indicating strong consumer demand. Ather Energy has seen significant market share growth in Southern India, becoming a leader in the region, and has also expanded its market share in 'middle India' by 4X since the Rizta's launch. In Northern states, market share has grown over 3X. Approximately 70% of Rizta customers are families with children, highlighting its appeal for everyday family usage.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: PVR INOX Limited has submitted to the exchange presentation on Investor update for the Fourth Quarter & Financial Year ended 31st March, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: PVR INOX Limited has submitted a presentation to the stock exchanges providing an investor update for the Fourth Quarter and Financial Year ended March 31, 2026. This presentation is for general informational purposes and does not constitute an offer or solicitation. It contains forward-looking statements based on numerous assumptions that are subject to risks and uncertainties, and actual events or results may differ significantly from anticipated developments.

announcements.subject: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
announcements.detail: Rishabh Singhi has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 10 (5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.ai_summary: Rishabh Sunil Singhi has submitted a prior intimation under Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, regarding a proposed acquisition of equity shares in VMS TMT Limited. The acquisition will be an off-market inter-se transfer amongst promoters. Rishabh Sunil Singhi proposes to acquire 13,22,164 equity shares, representing 2.66% of the total share capital of VMS TMT Limited. The proposed date of acquisition is on or after June 17, 2026. This acquisition is being undertaken pursuant to the exemption available under Regulation 10(1)(a)(ii) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, as it involves an inter-se transfer among promoters of the company. The acquisition is expected to be completed not earlier than four working days from the date of this intimation.

announcements.subject: Product launch
announcements.detail: The Federal Bank  Limited has informed the Exchange about Product launch
announcements.ai_summary: The Federal Bank Limited has announced the launch of a new variant of its FCNR (B) deposit, named the FCNR Max Deposit Scheme, on June 11, 2026. This product launch is in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The FCNR Max Deposit Scheme is designed for Non-Resident Indian (NRI) customers. The bank is introducing this new scheme to cater to the international market.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: JK Paper Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition update
announcements.ai_summary: JK Paper Limited has updated the Exchange on its acquisition of shares in Borkar Packaging Private Limited (BPPL) on June 11, 2026. In accordance with the Share Purchase Subscription and Shareholders Agreement dated July 28, 2025, the company acquired an additional 40,08,899 equity shares of BPPL. These shares have a face value of Rs. 10/- each and represent 15.40% of BPPL's total paid-up share capital. Following this acquisition, JK Paper Limited's total shareholding in Borkar Packaging Private Limited has increased to 87.36% of the company's total paid-up share capital.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sagility acquires CareSeed to accelerate AI-led quality operations and Medicare Advantage performance transformation
announcements.ai_summary: Sagility Limited, through its step-down subsidiary Sagility LLC, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire CareSeed LLC on June 11, 2026. This acquisition is intended to accelerate the company's AI-led quality operations and Medicare Advantage performance transformation. CareSeed LLC, operating in the USA healthcare analytics and technology sector, reported a turnover of US$ 5.1 million in CY2025. The acquisition aligns with Sagility's strategy to enhance its healthcare analytics capabilities and expand into quality measurement and risk adjustment solutions. The Board of Directors of Sagility Limited proposed this acquisition/investment at their meeting held on June 11, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Integra Essentia Limited has informed the Exchange about Outcome of Rights Issue Committee
announcements.ai_summary: Integra Essentia Limited's Rights Issue Committee has approved the allotment of 68,75,92,710 Fully Paid-up Rights Equity shares. These shares have a face value of Re. 1/- each and were issued at a price of Rs. 1.45/- per share, including a premium of Rs. 0.45/- per share. This allotment follows the Letter of Offer dated May 14, 2026, and the approval from BSE Limited. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up capital has increased to 175,52,83,254. The Board meeting to approve this allotment commenced at 7:50 P.M. and concluded at 8:20 P.M. on June 11, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Anupam Rasayan India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 11, 2026, titled  Anupam Rasayan India Limited becomes the first company in the world to commercialise ETFA (Ethyl trifluoroacetate) using flow chemistry"".
announcements.ai_summary: Anupam Rasayan India Limited has issued a press release on June 11, 2026, announcing that it has become the first company globally to commercialize ETFA (Ethyl trifluoroacetate) using flow chemistry. This product, a Chemical Intermediate, was launched on June 11, 2026, and caters to both domestic and international markets, including countries like the USA and Japan. This development is being disclosed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The press release will also be hosted on the company's website.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: VMS TMT Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates on Off-market lnter-se transfer of Equity Shares between Promoters and Promoter group and  Disclosure under Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations 2011 intimation
announcements.ai_summary: VMS TMT Limited has announced a proposed off-market inter-se transfer of equity shares between promoters and the promoter group, in compliance with Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The transaction is scheduled to take place on or after June 17, 2026. This transfer is being conducted under Regulation 10(1)(a)(ii) of the SEBI SAST Regulations, which exempts such inter-se transfers among qualifying promoter group entities from the open offer requirement. The aggregate shareholding of the Promoter and Promoter Group in VMS TMT Limited will remain unchanged before and after this transaction.

announcements.subject: Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Indo Thai Securities Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 and other applicable Regulations of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended ( SEBI (LODR) Regulations ).
announcements.ai_summary: Indo Thai Securities Limited has received an order from the NCLT, Indore Bench, dated June 10, 2026, regarding its Scheme of Arrangement with Indo Thai Financial Services Limited. The NCLT has directed that a meeting of the Equity Shareholders of Indo Thai Securities Limited (ITSL) be convened within 45 days from the order date to approve the scheme. Additionally, a meeting of the Unsecured Creditors of ITSL will also be convened within 45 days for the same purpose. The NCLT has dispensed with the requirement for meetings of Secured Creditors of ITSL and both Secured and Unsecured Creditors of Indo Thai Financial Services Limited (ITFSL), as ITFSL has no secured or unsecured creditors. The scheme is still subject to applicable regulatory and other approvals.

announcements.subject: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
announcements.detail: Smt. Alaknanda Boob Business Trust and Asha Ashok Boob has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 10 (5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.ai_summary: Smt. Alaknanda Boob Business Trust and Mrs. Asha Ashok Boob, who are promoter group members of Clean Science and Technology Limited, are proposing to acquire a total of 66,38,000 equity shares of Rs. 1/- each from Mrs. Nilima Krishnakumar Boob. This acquisition will be conducted via inter-se transfer by way of gift. Specifically, Smt. Alaknanda Boob Business Trust will acquire 58,00,000 shares (5.46% of total equity), and Mrs. Asha Ashok Boob will acquire 8,38,000 shares (0.79% of total equity). This transaction is scheduled to occur on or after June 6, 2026, and is exempt from open offer requirements under Regulation 10(1)(a)(ii) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, as the aggregate holding of the promoter and promoter group will remain unchanged.

announcements.company: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited
announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 29(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition and Takeover) Regulations, 2011'.
announcements.ai_summary: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited has disclosed a transfer of 10,00,000 equity shares, representing 1.52% of the paid-up equity share capital, through an OFS (Offer for Sale) transaction on June 9, 2026. Following this disposal, Mr. Santosh Kumar Yadav's holding has decreased from 31.01% (20,299,950 shares) to 30.25% (19,799,950 shares), and Mrs. Anju Devi's holding has decreased from 36.21% (23,700,000 shares) to 35.44% (23,200,000 shares). The total holding of the transferors, who belong to the Promoter group, has reduced from 67.22% to 65.69%. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition and Takeover) Regulations, 2011.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Board comments on fine levied by the Exchange
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Coking Coal Limited has provided an update regarding a fine levied by the Exchange. The company's board has commented on the matter, and further details are expected to be disclosed.

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: S. P. Apparels Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
announcements.ai_summary: S. P. Apparels Limited has entered into a Loan Agreement with its wholly-owned subsidiary, S.P. Apparels (UK) (P) Limited, for a loan facility of up to GBP 40,00,000. This facility is exclusively for the subsidiary's business and operations. The loan has a tenure of 3 years or payable on demand, whichever is earlier, and will bear an interest rate of 9% per annum, payable with annual rests. The agreement does not include special rights such as the right to appoint directors or first rights to share subscription. S. P. Apparels Limited holds 100% shares in the borrower.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited's Debenture Fund Raising Committee has decided to prematurely close its public issuance of up to 30,00,000 Secured Redeemable Non-convertible Debentures. The face value of each debenture is ₹ 1,000, with a base issue size of up to ₹ 1,500 million and an option to retain oversubscription up to ₹ 1,500 million, aggregating to a total issue limit of ₹ 3,000 million. The issue, which was originally scheduled to close on Friday, June 19, 2026, will now close on Friday, June 12, 2026. This early closure is in accordance with the Prospectus dated June 1, 2026, and the company's letter dated June 1, 2026.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Entero Healthcare Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 11, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: The Board of Directors of Entero Healthcare Solutions Limited, in a meeting held on June 11, 2026, approved the allotment of 3,420 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 each to an eligible employee upon exercise of options vested under the Entero Employee Stock Option Plan 2023. The Board also noted the grant of 17,500 fresh Employee Stock Options under the existing "Entero Employee Stock Option Plan 2023," following the approval of the Nomination & Remuneration Committee. The Board Meeting commenced at 03:00 p.m. (IST) and concluded at 03:50 p.m. (IST).

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: PCBL Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition by Commissioning of a new specialty production line with a gross capacity of 20,000 MTPA at its Mundra Plant in Gujarat
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: PCBL Chemical Limited has successfully commissioned a new specialty production line with a gross capacity of 20,000 MTPA at its Mundra Plant in Gujarat. This state-of-the-art line is designed to serve high-growth, value-added application segments such as high-speed printing, digital printing, and ultraviolet (UV) printing. The addition increases the Company’s total specialty production capacity to 132 KT per annum, aligning with its strategic focus on increasing value-added products, improving margins, and driving sustainable long-term growth. The new line is expected to ramp up progressively over the coming months.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd. has informed the Exchange regarding 'Receipt Of Best Employer Brand Award 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Limited has been honored with the Madhya Pradesh Best Employer Brand Award 2026. The award ceremony was organized by the WORLD HRD Congress on June 11, 2026, in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. This recognition acknowledges organizations that excel in fostering a people-centric work culture, employee engagement, talent development, and creating an inspiring workplace. The award highlights AABL's dedication to its employees, strong leadership, learning initiatives, and a culture built on trust, collaboration, and excellence. The company views this award as a testament to the contributions of its workforce.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: GNG Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'sale of equity shares of the Company by Vidhi S Khandelwal, Promoter of the Company for achieving Minimum Public Shareholding'.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Vidhi S Khandelwal, a Promoter of GNG Electronics Limited, sold 44,87,203 equity shares, representing 3.94% of the total issued and paid-up equity share capital, on June 11, 2026. This sale was conducted to achieve the Minimum Public Shareholding requirements as per SEBI circulars. Following this transaction, the shareholding of the Promoter and Promoter Group members in the Company has reduced from 78.71% to 74.77% of the paid-up equity share capital. The Company has now met the Minimum Public Shareholding requirements mandated under the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Rules and SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations.

announcements.subject: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
announcements.detail: Thomas Cook  (India)  Limited has informed the Exchange about Giving Corporate Guarantee under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Thomas Cook (India) Limited has informed the stock exchanges about the renewal of a Corporate Guarantee. On June 11, 2026, the Sub-Committee of the Board of Directors authorized the renewal of an existing Corporate Guarantee of THB 53 Million to Deutsche Bank AG. This guarantee is provided on behalf of Asian Trails Limited (Thailand), a subsidiary of Thomas Cook (India) Limited. The renewal of this guarantee will enable Asian Trails Limited to continue its business operations smoothly, which is expected to benefit the parent company. Thomas Cook (India) Limited will charge a commission on an arm's length basis for providing this guarantee.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Cochin Shipyard Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations
announcements.ai_summary: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) has announced the incorporation of a new Joint Venture company, "Green Maritime Propulsion Private Limited," on June 11, 2026. This JV was formed in partnership with HBL Engineering Limited (HBL) following a Joint Venture Agreement signed on March 25, 2026. announcements.subject: Other Restructuring
announcements.detail: Centum Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange of an update on the Court-Supervised Restructuring Proceedings (Redressement Judiciaire) of Centum T&S Group S.A., France and Centum T&S (Centum Technologies et Solutions), France.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on Jun 11, 2026, has decided to raise the fund of the Company by way of issue of  equity shares on rights basis
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited, in their meeting held on June 11, 2026, approved a Rights Issue to raise funds aggregating up to ₹330.00 Crores. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Anjani Portland Cement Limited has informed the Exchange about Transition in Brand Name
announcements.ai_summary: Anjani Portland Cement Limited, a subsidiary of Chettinad Cement Corporation Private Limited (CCCPL) which holds 75.00% of its equity, has approved a gradual transition of its cement brand from "Anjani" to "Chettinad Cement". This brand harmonization initiative, driven by the parent company CCCPL, aims to strengthen brand equity under a unified national brand, improve market visibility, optimize sales and distribution channels, and enhance marketing and operational efficiencies. The company's subsidiary, Bhavya Cements Private Limited, will also transition its "Bhavya" brand to "Chettinad". This brand transition is expected to leverage the established brand recall and integrated business strengths of the Chettinad group, leading to long-term value creation. Mr. A Narayana Rao, Sr. Vice President – Marketing, has been internally transferred to Chettinad Cement Corporation Private Limited as part of this integration.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Gala Precision Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: Gala Precision Engineering Limited has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to acquire approximately 10.16 acres of industrial land in Village Vardha, Taluka Wada, District Palghar, Maharashtra. The company has paid earnest money as per the MOU terms.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Happiest Minds Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 11, 2026, titled "Happiest Minds Launches Rel(AI)Build, an Agentic AI Platform to Transform Enterprise Software Delivery".
announcements.ai_summary: Happiest Minds Technologies Limited has announced the launch of Rel(AI)Build, a proprietary Agentic AI development platform, and the Agentic Development Lifecycle (ADLC) methodology. This platform is designed to transform how organizations build, modernize, and operate software systems by integrating AI-driven automation, governance, and human oversight. Rel(AI)Build orchestrates specialized AI agents across the entire software development lifecycle, from planning to operations, enabling parallel execution and continuous learning. The platform features a composable Agent Core that integrates with existing enterprise ecosystems and includes built-in governance, policy controls, and auditability. A key aspect is its token-sensitive architecture, which optimizes AI model usage and helps control costs and improve efficiency. This launch was announced on June 11, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Elgi Equipments Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Elgi Equipments Limited has announced a key management change. Mr. Indranil Sen, currently the Chief Financial Officer, is slated to move into a new role as Business Head for Americas (USA & Brazil) and Europe. This transition will take effect upon the onboarding of a new Chief Financial Officer, after which a formal announcement will be made. The company has also stated that this information is being hosted on its website, www.elgi.com.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Avonmore Capital & Management Services  Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 11, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited has issued a press release dated June 11, 2026, announcing its strategic positioning to capitalize on India's expanded ethanol policy. The company's Special Purpose Vehicle, Premier Green Innovations Private Limited (PGIPL), with existing operations in Himachal Pradesh and Odisha, is expected to benefit from increased ethanol consumption. This follows the Government of India's decision to exempt petrol blended with 22%–30% ethanol (E22–E30) from excise duty and the launch of E85 fuel. These initiatives are seen as a significant acceleration of India's National Biofuel Programme.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Pine Labs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 11, 2026, titled "The AI Agent Can Now Pay. Pine Labs Launches P3P - India s First Agentic Payment Protocol Built on UPI".
announcements.ai_summary: Pine Labs Limited has issued a press release announcing the launch of P3P, India's first Agentic Payment Protocol built on UPI. This protocol enables AI agents to complete UPI payments without requiring human authentication, addressing a critical gap in agentic commerce. P3P extends UPI's existing mandate framework, allowing consumers to authorize payments upfront, after which AI agents can autonomously browse, select, negotiate, and pay without interruption. The protocol, developed in conjunction with Grantex and HTTP 402, aims to provide secure and auditable agent-to-agent transactions for merchants, facilitating a frictionless commerce journey.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Som Distilleries & Breweries Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.ai_summary: Som Distilleries & Breweries Limited has announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Woodpecker Green Agri Nutrients Private Limited ("Woodpecker Green Agri"), has commenced commercial production at its brewery facility in Uttar Pradesh. This commencement is effective from June 10, 2026. The company views this as a significant milestone for its growth and expansion strategy, expecting it to bolster manufacturing capabilities, improve supply chain efficiencies, and strengthen its presence in Northern India. This development is anticipated to positively contribute to the company's long-term growth plans and market expansion objectives.

announcements.ai_summary: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited has announced a change in its website domain. announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Fractal Launches Cogentiq E-Commerce: AI that Acts on Profit Signals in Minutes
announcements.ai_summary: Fractal Analytics Limited has announced the launch of Cogentiq E-Commerce, an AI-native Always-on E-Commerce Profit Engine designed for consumer products companies. Launched on June 11, 2026, this solution monitors and acts on key profit signals such as stock levels, media spend, keywords, content, and pricing across e-commerce channels like Amazon, enabling accelerated decision-making within minutes. Cogentiq E-Commerce aims to eliminate complexity and combat decision paralysis often associated with AI-powered solutions in e-commerce. It monitors over 70 profit-driving marketplace signals daily for each Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) and recommends corrective actions to prevent missed revenue opportunities. Amazon marketplace integration is live, with plans for expansion to other platforms.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Almondz Global Securities Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 11, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Almondz Global Securities Limited has issued a press release on June 11, 2026, highlighting its strategic positioning to benefit from India's expanded ethanol policy. The company welcomes the Government of India's decision to exempt petrol blended with 22%-30% ethanol (E22-E30) from excise duty and the introduction of E85 fuel for flex-fuel vehicles. These initiatives are expected to significantly boost ethanol consumption nationwide. Through its Special Purpose Vehicle, Premier Green Innovations Private Limited (PGIPL), which has operational sites in Himachal Pradesh and Odisha, Almondz is poised to capitalize on the growth in India's ethanol sector. PGIPL is well-positioned to participate in the next phase of India's ethanol expansion, following the successful implementation of E20 fuel.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Rain Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about release of Annual Sustainability Report by Rain Carbon Inc., Wholly owned Subsidiary Company for the Financial Year ended December 31, 2025.
announcements.ai_summary: Rain Industries Limited has announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Rain Carbon Inc., has released its Annual Sustainability Report for the Financial Year ended December 31, 2025. The report, made public on June 11, 2026, is available on Rain Carbon Inc.'s website. The report details the company's sustainability initiatives for 2025, including embedding double materiality into its strategic framework, strengthening supply chain integrity, and expanding its Technology Innovation Center in Hamilton, Canada. It also highlights advancements in sustainable graphite anode active materials for lithium-ion batteries and transforming graphite processing byproducts.

announcements.subject: General Updates

This classification was communicated by the USFDA via a communication dated June 10, 2026. This update follows Cipla's previous intimation regarding the inspection on April 17, 2026.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) has received a Limited Notice to Proceed (LNTP) from Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC) for the 1x800 MW Durgapur supercritical thermal power station's main plant package. This LNTP, received on June 10, 2026, allows BHEL to commence advance engineering and order critical long-lead items for the project. The full order for the supply and execution of the main plant package (Boiler, Turbine, Generator) is expected to be awarded to BHEL by DVC upon completion of 10 months from the issuance of the LNTP. The value of the LNTP contract is over Rs. 90 Cr. excluding GST. Both BHEL and DVC are Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Prestige Estates Projects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 11, 2026, titled "Prestige Group and BACL Unveil a Landmark Convention & Integrated Destination in Bengaluru Airport City".
announcements.ai_summary: Prestige Estates Projects Limited, in partnership with Bengaluru Airport City Limited (BACL), has announced a new integrated destination in Bengaluru Airport City. This development, unveiled on June 11, 2026, will feature a state-of-the-art convention and exhibition centre, luxury hotels under the St. Regis and Marriott Marquis brands, premium office spaces, and curated food and beverage experiences. The project aims to create a world-class business, hospitality, and cultural hub, enhancing Bengaluru's appeal as a global gateway. The development is designed to serve global travellers, event organisers, corporations, visitors, and residents, strengthening Bengaluru's position as a dynamic centre for commerce and collaboration.

announcements.subject: Post Buyback Public Announcement
announcements.detail: Garware Technical Fibres Limited has informed the Exchange about post Buyback Public Announcement
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Garware Technical Fibres Limited has announced the post-buyback public announcement regarding its buyback of 16,17,500 equity shares. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Lancor Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Lancor Holdings Limited has announced that its multi-storied residential project, Lancor Ananya, located in Chennai, has received RERA approval. announcements.detail: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited has informed the Exchange about Amalgamation/Merger

This scheme of arrangement is being undertaken under the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013. Both SSFL and CFL are public limited companies. The proposed amalgamation is subject to the sanction of the Regional Director/NCLT and requires requisite approvals from the shareholders and/or creditors of SSFL. Further, the scheme is contingent upon compliance with applicable laws and receipt of necessary regulatory, statutory, or other approvals, including from the Reserve Bank of India, Stock Exchanges, and the Securities and Exchange Board of India.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bartronics India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 11, 2026, titled "Avio Smart Market Stack Limited Strengthens Diagnostics & Healthcare Vertical Through Strategic Discussions with Mediciti Institute".
announcements.ai_summary: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited (formerly Bartronics India Limited) has initiated strategic discussions with Mediciti Institute of Medical Sciences (MIMS), Hyderabad, to explore opportunities in its diagnostics and healthcare vertical. These discussions focus on research collaboration, clinical validation, and the adoption of advanced molecular diagnostic technologies. Huwel Lifesciences, ASMS's strategic molecular diagnostics partner, showcased its portfolio of indigenous diagnostic technologies, including solutions for tuberculosis, sepsis, HPV screening, and antimicrobial resistance. The discussions aimed to strengthen disease detection, improve clinical decision-making, and enhance healthcare outcomes across India by integrating innovative molecular diagnostic solutions within Mediciti's healthcare ecosystem. Potential pilot programs and product evaluations are being considered to assess the impact on routine diagnostic workflows.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Housing & Urban Development Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'MoU between HUDCO and the Government of Odisha'.
announcements.ai_summary: Housing & Urban Development Corporation Limited (HUDCO) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of Odisha on July 10, 2026, in Bhubaneswar. This MoU aims for HUDCO to provide term loans up to ₹1,00,000 Crore (Rupees One Lakh Crore) over a period of 5 years. These funds will be utilized for various urban infrastructure projects in Odisha, including land acquisition for housing and infrastructure projects under the Urban Challenge Fund (UCF), Bhubaneswar-Cuttack-Puri-Paradeep Economic Region (BCPPER), and Mukhyamantri Sahari Vikas Yojana (MSVY). Additionally, HUDCO will offer Project Preparation and Capacity Building support through its UiWIN initiative, encompassing technical structuring, DPR preparation, financial modelling, and outcome-based training for Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).

announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger

announcements.subject: General Updates

announcements.ai_summary: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited has issued a press release dated July 11, 2026, announcing the commissioning of INS Mahendragiri into the Indian Navy. This advanced stealth frigate, constructed by MDL, is the fourth ship of the Nilgiri class frigates built under Project 17A. The design was developed by the Indian Navy's Warship Design Bureau, with detailed design and construction undertaken by MDL. INS Mahendragiri measures 149 metres in length and 17.8 metres in breadth, with a displacement of approximately 6,400 tonnes. The commissioning ceremony was attended by the Hon'ble Raksha Mantri, Shri Rajnath Singh, highlighting India's progress towards self-reliance in defence manufacturing.

announcements.detail: KFin Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a Press Release dated August 11, 2026, titled "KFinTech Launches Klarity, an enterprise-grade Agentic AI solution to Eliminate Signature Fraud in BFSI".
announcements.ai_summary: KFin Technologies Limited has announced the launch of "Klarity," an enterprise-grade Agentic AI solution designed to combat signature fraud within the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector. This innovative solution aims to significantly reduce fraud losses and minimize wrongful rejections of genuine signatures. Klarity achieves this by going beyond basic visual signature comparison, analyzing micro-stroke dynamics such as stroke stress, pen pressure variation, curvature velocity, and entry-exit stroke angles. The solution offers a 3x acceleration in end-to-end verification turnaround time and maintains a False Acceptance Rate (FAR) of less than 0.01% for high-value transactions. Klarity integrates biometrics, automated workflow orchestration, and human-in-the-loop governance to provide a comprehensive approach to signature verification.

announcements.detail: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "Sentynl Therapeutics and Mereo BioPharma Announce Option and License Agreement for alvelestat in Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency- Associated Lung Disease (AATD-LD)".
announcements.ai_summary: Zydus Lifesciences Limited, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Sentynl Therapeutics, Inc., has entered into an option and license agreement with Mereo BioPharma Group plc for alvelestat, a potential first-in-class oral treatment for Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency-Associated Lung Disease (AATD-LD). Announced on August 11, 2026, the agreement grants Sentynl the exclusive right to commercialize alvelestat in the United States upon option exercise, with Mereo retaining rest of the world rights. Mereo will receive an upfront option fee and is eligible for up to $40 million in upfront and R&D payments until NDA filing, plus double-digit tiered royalties on U.S. sales. Sentynl will also have global manufacturing rights and will collaborate with Mereo to refine the Phase 3 design, which could commence in early 2027.
