announcements.ai_summary: Innovision Limited has secured a new mandate from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for user fee collection at the Aashpur Fee Plaza. This plaza is located on National Highway 91 in Uttar Pradesh. The company will act as the User Fee Collection Agency for this project. This award extends Innovision Limited's toll management operations in Uttar Pradesh and reinforces its focus on this business vertical. The company emphasizes its strategy of participating in open, competitive processes to strengthen its position for future bidding opportunities. This new mandate is part of a steady accumulation of individual plaza engagements, maintaining an asset-light model with working capital as the primary requirement for expansion.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: GUJARAT ENERGY LIMITED has informed the Exchange about General Updates - Outcome of Board Meeting - Promoter Reclassification - Reg 31A of Listing Regulations
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Energy Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 11, 2026, considered and approved the request from Gujarat State Energy Generation Limited (GSEG), a promoter, to reclassify its shareholding from the "Promoter" category to the "Public Shareholder" category. This decision is subject to compliance with Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The Board reviewed GSEG's request, which was made in view of a change in the corporate structure pursuant to a Scheme of Arrangement. The Board meeting commenced at 3:00 P.M. and concluded at 4:45 P.M.

announcements.subject: Other Restructuring
announcements.detail: Vision Infra Equipment Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Incorporation of Wholly Owned Foreign Subsidiary
announcements.ai_summary: Vision Infra Equipment Solutions Limited has incorporated a new Wholly Owned Foreign Subsidiary named VISION INFRA EQUIPMENT L.L.C. The incorporation took place on August 10, 2026, in the United Arab Emirates, registered with the Department of Economy and Tourism of Dubai. The subsidiary has a capital of AED 1,00,000, divided into 100 shares of AED 1,000 each, with Vision Infra Equipment Solutions Limited holding 100% of the shareholding. The new entity will be involved in the trading and rental of construction equipment and machinery. The consideration for the shares was cash, with a total subscription cost of AED 1,00,000.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Speciality Restaurants Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Speciality Restaurants Limited has announced its financial results for the first quarter of FY27 (Q1FY27) via a press release dated August 11, 2026. On a consolidated basis, the company reported a total income of ₹ 131.30 crore, an increase of 14.66% from ₹ 114.51 crore in Q1FY26. EBITDA grew by 21.28% to ₹ 28.61 crore, and profit after tax (PAT) saw a significant jump of 38.87%, reaching ₹ 7.11 crore compared to ₹ 5.12 crore in the prior year's quarter. On a standalone basis, total income was ₹ 125.79 crore, up 15.69%, with PAT increasing by 21.13% to ₹ 6.88 crore. The company highlighted that profit growth significantly outpaced revenue growth, reflecting improved operating efficiency. Avik Chatterjee has taken charge as Chief Executive Officer to lead the company's next phase of growth.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Le Merite Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about Cancellation of Proposed Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Le Merite Exports Limited has informed the stock exchanges about the cancellation of its proposed acquisition of an additional 14.5% equity stake (14,500 equity shares) in Le Merite Tactical & Defence Solutions Private Limited (LMTDSPL) from Mr. Nand Nandan Sureka. This acquisition was previously approved by the Board of Directors on June 23, 2026, for a consideration not exceeding ₹1,45,000. The cancellation is due to Mr. Nand Nandan Sureka's unwillingness to proceed with the sale and transfer of shares. Consequently, there will be no change in the company's existing shareholding in LMTDSPL.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: The Byke Hospitality Ltd has informed the Exchange about signing of Agreements/Memorandum of Understanding
announcements.ai_summary: The Byke Hospitality Limited has announced the signing of Agreements/Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for upcoming properties, which are considered material in importance. The company has entered into an agreement to operate "The Byke Astara Club Resort" in Nashik, featuring 10 Villas (30 keys) and 24 Suite Apartments (48 keys), along with club amenities. Additionally, a MOU has been signed for a property on Sahar Road, Andheri East, Mumbai, to be operated under "The Byke" brand, comprising 59 keys. Another MOU is for a hotel property in Borivali East, Mumbai, to be managed and operated under "The Byke" brand, with 49 keys and hospitality amenities. These agreements are part of the company's ongoing operational strategy to optimize asset allocation.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Anondita Medicare Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Participation in ET Immersions   Japan Edition'.
announcements.ai_summary: Anondita Medicare Limited has announced the participation of its Managing Director, Mr. Anupam Ghosh, and other associates in the 'ET Immersions – Japan Edition'. This event is scheduled to take place in Tokyo, Japan, from August 29, 2026, to September 2, 2026. The program includes the ET Global Future Business & Leadership Summit on August 31, 2026, interactions with Japanese business leaders, discussions on India-Japan opportunities, visits to leading Japanese organizations, and networking opportunities. The participation aims to provide insights into global business practices and foster business interactions. The company has confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during the event.

announcements.subject: Rumour Verification - Regulation 30(11)
announcements.detail: UltraTech Cement Limited has informed the Exchange about Rumour Verification - Regulation 30(11)
announcements.ai_summary: UltraTech Cement Limited has informed the stock exchanges regarding a material price movement observed in its shares on August 11, 2026. The company stated that there was no specific event or information in the mainstream media that could have triggered this price movement. The company believes the movement appears to be purely market-driven. This disclosure is for the information and record of the exchanges.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Transteel Seating Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 11, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Transteel Seating Technologies Limited held a Board of Directors meeting on August 11, 2026, during which Mr. Rohit Raghunath Jadhav was appointed as an Additional Director in the capacity of Non-Executive Independent Director, effective from the same date. Mr. Jadhav is a qualified Company Secretary and Law graduate with extensive experience in corporate law, secretarial matters, and regulatory compliance, including SEBI regulations and IPO processes. The company confirmed that Mr. Jadhav is not debarred from holding a director's office by any SEBI or other authority. The board meeting commenced at 4:00 PM and concluded at 4:30 PM.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: JSW Dulux Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 11, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Dulux Limited announced outcomes from its Board of Directors meeting held on August 11, 2026. The board considered and approved the subdivision of its equity shares. Each existing equity share of Rs. 10 face value will be split into 10 equity shares of Re. 1 face value. This corporate action is subject to shareholder approval via Postal Ballot and other necessary regulatory clearances. The company also approved alterations to its Memorandum and Articles of Association to reflect this change. The total issued and paid-up capital will be Rs. 1,26,69,00,000, comprising 1,26,69,00,000 equity shares of Re. 1 each.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Hindustan Composites Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates that Members have approved the slump sale of Friction Business Undertaking
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Composites Limited's members have approved the slump sale of its Friction Business Undertaking through a special resolution passed via postal ballot on August 11, 2026. This sale, conducted as a going concern, was approved under Section 180(1)(a) of the Companies Act, 2013, and Regulation 37A of the Listing Regulations. The Friction Business Undertaking generated a turnover of INR 315.04 crores for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, representing 84% of the company's total turnover. Its net worth as of March 31, 2026, was INR 69.52 crores, accounting for 7.50% of the company's net worth. The agreement for sale was executed on June 30, 2026, and completion is subject to prior approvals.

announcements.subject: Stock split
announcements.detail: JSW Dulux Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 11, 2026, has considered and approved subdivision of 1 equity shares of Rs. 10 each into 10 equity shares of Re. 1 each.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of JSW Dulux Limited, in their meeting held on August 11, 2026, approved a stock split. Each existing equity share with a face value of Rs. 10 will be subdivided into 10 equity shares, each with a face value of Re. 1. This subdivision is subject to shareholder approval via Postal Ballot and any necessary regulatory or statutory approvals. The company's total capital will be Rs. 1,26,69,00,000, divided into 1,26,69,00,000 equity shares of Re. 1 each. The record date for this split will be determined and intimated later, after shareholder approval.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Mcnally Bharat Engineering Company Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
announcements.ai_summary: McNally Bharat Engineering Company Limited has received a favorable judgment from the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi on August 3, 2026, in a matter concerning Metso India Private Limited. The court dismissed a petition filed under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, as infructuous and directed the release of the amount deposited with the court, along with accrued interest, to the company. The company received this order on August 10, 2026. The court's decision was based on the fact that Metso India Pvt. Ltd.'s claim, arising from an arbitral award, was extinguished due to the approval of McNally Bharat Engineering Company Limited's Resolution Plan under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, as the claim was not part of the approved plan.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Fusion Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Fusion Finance Limited has announced that its shareholders have approved the reclassification of Mr. Devesh Sachdev and his family members from the "Promoter & Promoter Group" category to the "Public" category. This approval was obtained through a postal ballot on August 08, 2026, in accordance with Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The reclassification affects a total of 28,67,019 shares, representing 1.77% of the total shareholding. The reclassified individuals and entities will be considered "Public" category shareholders effective August 08, 2026.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Hma Agro Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''.
announcements.ai_summary: Mohammad Kamil Qureshi, a member of the Promoter Group of HMA Agro Industries Limited, has acquired 4,25,75,347 equity shares through a gift deed from Mr. Wajid Ahmed, a promoter and immediate relative. This acquisition was disclosed under Regulation 7(2)(a) read with Regulation 6(2) of the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. The disclosure was made on August 11, 2026, and the company has taken this information on record. No further actions or approvals are mentioned as pending.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: RHI MAGNESITA INDIA LTD has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "Press Release for quarter ended 30 June 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: RHI Magnesita India Limited has issued a press release dated August 11, 2026, detailing its unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1 FY27). The company reported a strong start to FY27 with healthy growth in revenue and profitability, despite facing pricing pressures, cost inflation, and competitive intensity. The press release highlights the successful leadership transition with the appointment of Pankaj Malhan as Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer, while Parmod Sagar continues as Chairman. RHI Magnesita India Limited emphasizes its commitment to executing its strategy, enhancing stakeholder value, and building a more resilient business through its differentiated 4PRO business model and solution-led approach.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Integra Essentia Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Integra Essentia Limited has issued a clarification regarding information circulating in the public domain about an alleged large order received by the company. The company explicitly states that it does not endorse or concur with the contents of this information, clarifying that it has neither been authorized nor issued by Integra Essentia Limited. Investors and stakeholders are advised to exercise caution and not rely on any unsolicited messages or campaigns concerning the company from unauthorized sources. Integra Essentia Limited confirms its regularity in making necessary disclosures and that no material information requiring disclosure is pending. The company is examining the matter and will take appropriate action to safeguard its interests.

announcements.subject: Rescission/termination(s)
announcements.detail: Kody Technolab Limited has informed the Exchange about termination of Joint Venture Agreement
announcements.ai_summary: Kody Technolab Limited has announced the termination of its Joint Venture Agreement with Vira Drones SA, Switzerland, which was originally intended for the joint development and commercialization of advanced aerial systems and the establishment of a joint venture company in India. The decision to terminate the agreement was mutually reached after discussions between both parties. The company has stated that this termination is not expected to have any material adverse impact on its financial position, business operations, or ongoing activities. Kody Technolab Limited will continue to concentrate on its existing business operations and strategic initiatives.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Approval of request of Reclassification from Promoter Group category to public Category pursuant to Regulation 31A of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Aakash Exploration Services Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 11, 2026, considered and approved the reclassification request from M/s. Deval Energy Resources Private Limited, seeking to move from the "Promoter Group" category to the "Public" category of shareholders. This reclassification is in accordance with Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The Board noted that shareholder approval for this reclassification is not applicable as M/s. Deval Energy Resources Private Limited and its related persons together hold 0.00% of the total voting rights in the company. The Board also appointed Mr. Vihan Vipul Haria as an Additional Director, designated as Whole Time Director, for a period of three years effective August 11, 2026, subject to member approval.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: KSS Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: KSS Limited has announced that the first meeting of its newly constituted Monitoring Committee is scheduled for Friday, August 14, 2026, at 2:00 PM. This meeting follows the formation of the 'Implementation and Monitoring Committee' (IMC) on August 11, 2026, in compliance with the NCLT order dated August 5, 2026, and in accordance with the approved Resolution Plan. The agenda for the meeting includes reviewing actions taken towards the implementation of the Resolution Plan to date and discussing further steps and timelines for its execution.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Blue Dart Express Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "Press Release announcing 'Rakhi Express Offers' on Domestic and International Shipments".
announcements.ai_summary: Blue Dart Express Limited has announced special 'Rakhi Express Offers' for domestic and international shipments, valid from July 27 to August 28, 2026. These offers aim to facilitate the sending of Rakhis, personalized gifts, and festive packages during the Raksha Bandhan season. For domestic priority shipments, special flat rates are available for packages up to 2.5 kg, with rates ranging from ₹200 for 0.5 kg to ₹1100 for 2.5 kg during different periods within the offer validity. Discounts of up to 50% are offered on eligible international shipments weighing between 0.5 kg and 3 kg. The company emphasizes its commitment to ensuring these packages are handled with care and delivered with speed and reliability through its integrated air and ground network.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about Execution of Business Transfer Agreement with Vyoma.AI Limited (Vyoma), Wholly owned Subsidiary of the Company and execution of Share Purchase Agreement towards sale of entire stake held in L&T Network Services Private Limited to Vyoma
announcements.ai_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited (L&T) has executed a Business Transfer Agreement (BTA) with its wholly-owned subsidiary, Vyoma.AI Limited (Vyoma), for the slump sale of L&T's Data Center and Cloud Services Business (DC Business) to Vyoma for ₹1,400 crore, subject to closing adjustments. Additionally, L&T has executed a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) with Vyoma and its wholly-owned subsidiary, L&T Network Services Private Limited (LTNSPL), to divest its entire 100% stake in LTNSPL to Vyoma for ₹30 crore, also subject to closing adjustments. Both considerations will be discharged through the issuance of fully paid equity shares of Vyoma. Upon closing, LTNSPL will become an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of L&T through Vyoma. The completion of these transactions is contingent upon the fulfillment of agreed-upon closing conditions.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Godrej Consumer Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "Godrej Consumer Products appoints Aasif Malbari as Managing Director & CEO".
announcements.ai_summary: Godrej Consumer Products Limited announced on August 11, 2026, the appointment of Aasif Malbari as its new Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately. Aasif Malbari, who previously served as Global Chief Financial Officer and President Godrej Africa, succeeds Sudhir Sitapati. Malbari brings extensive experience from the FMCG and auto industries, including a significant transformation of GCPL's Africa business, which saw EBITDA margins grow from approximately 9% in FY24 to around 15% in FY26. He also played a key role in scaling businesses and a USD 1 billion fundraise in the electric vehicle sector during his tenure at Tata Motors.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Firstsource Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "This is to inform that a Press Release titled    Firstsource and Cresta Partner to Accelerate AI-Powered Customer Experience Transformation  is attached along with this letter.You are kindly requested to take the same on record and oblige.".
announcements.ai_summary: Firstsource Solutions Limited has issued a press release dated August 11, 2026, announcing a strategic partnership with Cresta, a customer experience AI platform. This collaboration aims to accelerate AI-powered customer experience transformation for enterprises. The partnership integrates Cresta's AI platform with Firstsource's domain expertise, systems integration capabilities, and operational AI knowledge. Firstsource has established a dedicated AI Center of Excellence to facilitate these joint deployments, enabling rapid scaling and optimization of AI solutions with built-in accountability.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Commencement of commercial production of CPVC Resin Plant at Vilayat, Gujarat in collaboration with Lubrizol Advanced Materials India Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Grasim Industries Limited has announced the commencement of commercial production at its CPVC Resin Plant located in Vilayat, Gujarat. This facility, developed in collaboration with Lubrizol Advanced Materials India Private Limited, has a planned capacity of approximately 50,000 metric tonnes per annum. The commencement of operations marks a significant step in Grasim's strategy to expand its downstream chlor-alkali derivatives portfolio and bolster domestic manufacturing under the "Make in India" initiative. This follows the inauguration of the plant disclosed on June 16, 2026.

announcements.subject: Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.detail: Rachana Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.ai_summary: Rachana Infrastructure Limited has received a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from the Office of The Executive Engineer Botad (R&B) Division for the construction of the Four Laning of Barwala-Salingpur-Botad Road (SH-118) from Km 00/00 to 22/500 in the state of Gujarat. The total contract value for this domestic order is ₹ 91,35,69,461, excluding GST. The company is required to furnish a performance security of ₹ 4,56,79,000 within 10 days of receiving the LOA. The execution of this contract is expected to take 18 months from the date of issuance of the Work Order. This order does not involve related parties or promoter group companies.

announcements.subject: Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: Ritco Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates for the month of July 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Ritco Logistics Limited has secured new business in its Transportation and Warehousing verticals, valued at approximately INR 342 Crores. A significant contract worth approximately ₹334 Crore has been awarded by HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (HRRL) for pan-India Polymer Granule distribution from Pachpadra, Rajasthan. This contract is expected to enhance Ritco Logistics' market leadership in the petrochemical sector and accelerate the scaling of its digital supply chain ecosystem, including AI route optimization and automated fleet management. The company aims to strengthen its integrated logistics capabilities and expand long-term customer relationships.

announcements.company: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited
announcements.subject: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
announcements.detail: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
announcements.ai_summary: The Risk Management Committee of Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited, on August 11, 2026, approved the issuance of a corporate guarantee. This guarantee is for a facility being availed by its subsidiary, Clean Max Rudra Private Limited, from Federal Bank Limited. The corporate guarantee will be extended in favor of the lender for INR 92,00,00,000 (Indian Rupees Ninety-Two Crore only) as security for term loan facilities. The company stated that the promoter, promoter group, and group companies have no interest in this transaction, and the guarantee is at arm's length. The corporate guarantee provided will be a contingent liability for the company, but as of the disclosure date, there is no impact on the company.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Crizac Limited Informs the exchange about the update with regard to disclosure dated June 15, 2026 on proposed Acquisition of Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares and Compulsory Convertible Debentures of Edument Consultancy Private Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Crizac Limited has provided an update on its proposed acquisition of Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares and Compulsory Convertible Debentures of Edument Consultancy Private Limited. The acquisition, initially disclosed on June 15, 2026, has not yet been completed due to ongoing requisite formalities. The company now expects the completion of the acquisition to be extended by approximately two months, with a revised expected completion date of October 12, 2026. There are no changes to the underlying transaction, consideration, or other material terms of the acquisition, only the extension of the completion timeline. Crizac Limited will provide further disclosures to the stock exchanges regarding any material developments.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Jaykay Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of AS9100:D and ISO 9001:2015 Certifications by Allen Reinforced Plastics Limited, step-down subsidiary of Jaykay Enterprises Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Jaykay Enterprises Limited has informed the stock exchanges that its step-down subsidiary, Allen Reinforced Plastics Limited, has obtained AS9100:D and ISO 9001:2015 Certifications. These certifications cover the "Design, Development, Manufacturing, Assembling and Testing of FRP and allied products" and were issued by Intertek Testing Services NA, Inc. The certifications are valid until August 09, 2029. This achievement provides immediate commercial advantages for tender eligibility, compliance, and market expansion in the Defense & Industrial segments. The certifications were officially issued on August 10, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Presentation on New line of Business
announcements.ai_summary: TCPL Packaging Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 11, 2026, approved the company's entry into the manufacturing of lithium-ion battery separator films. This will be undertaken through a subsidiary company that is proposed to be incorporated for this purpose. The company plans to invest approximately Rs. 125 crore in this new venture, with the deployment of funds scheduled over the next 18 months. Project implementation is expected during 2026 and 2027, with commercial production targeted for early 2028. This strategic move is supported by the strong growth trajectory in battery demand globally and in India, driven by electric vehicles and energy storage systems.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: TCPL Packaging Limited has informed the Exchange about Press Release on New line of Business
announcements.ai_summary: TCPL Packaging Limited announced its strategic entry into the new business of manufacturing lithium-ion battery separator films through a proposed subsidiary company. This venture will allow the TCPL Group to participate in the Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) battery supply chain and cater to the growing demand for lithium-ion batteries in electric vehicles and energy storage systems. The proposed investment for this new line of business is approximately Rs. 125 crore, which will be deployed over the next 18 months. This move leverages TCPL's existing capabilities in specialized films, polymer processing, precision manufacturing, R&D, process control, and stringent quality assurance. The company's Board of Directors approved this strategic decision at their meeting held on August 11, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Prakash Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Prakash Industries Limited has issued a press release on August 11, 2026, detailing its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported Net Sales of ₹1032 Crores, a slight decrease from ₹1037 Crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year. EBITDA increased to ₹154 Crores from ₹144 Crores, resulting in an improved EBITDA margin of 14.9% compared to 13.9%. Profit After Tax for the quarter was ₹71 Crores, down from ₹91 Crores in the prior year due to the adoption of the new tax regime, which made the tax exemption under section 80-IA unavailable. During the quarter, the company extracted approximately 3.3 lac MT of coal and is targeting 1.2 Mn tonnes for the current financial year.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Matrimony.Com Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Matrimony.Com Limited has submitted the fact sheet of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, to the Exchange. The fact sheet, which includes key financial metrics such as Billings, Revenue, Deferred Revenue, Operating expenses, and EBITDA, is also hosted on the company's website, www.matrimony.com. For the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the company reported Billings of ₹1,360 million and Revenue of ₹1,305 million, with a year-on-year growth of 7.8% and 13.2% respectively. Deferred Revenue stood at ₹1,065 million as of June 30, 2026, reflecting a 28.4% year-on-year increase.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Hindustan Construction Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "HCC secures Rs. 524 crore NHPC contract in J&K".
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Construction Company Limited (HCC) has secured a contract worth approximately Rs 524.17 crore from NHPC Limited for works at the Salal Power Station in Jammu & Kashmir. The project involves civil and hydro-mechanical works to ensure the full functionality of the dam's undersluices and has a duration of 27 months. This contract leverages HCC's extensive experience in executing landmark infrastructure projects in Jammu & Kashmir, including previous work on the Salal Hydroelectric Project. The rehabilitation of the undersluices is expected to enhance operational efficiency, improve sediment management, and strengthen the dam's long-term safety.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Matrimony.Com Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "Matrimony posts strong Q1 PAT growth of 127% y/y".
announcements.ai_summary: Matrimony.com Limited has announced its audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a Profit After Tax (PAT) of Rs 19.1 crores, marking a significant year-on-year growth of 127.5% and a quarter-on-quarter growth of 96.2%. Consolidated revenue stood at Rs 130.5 crores, an increase of 13.2% year-on-year and 11.7% quarter-on-quarter. The matchmaking segment also saw strong performance, with revenue growing by 13.6% year-on-year to Rs 129.5 crores and adding 2.72 lakhs paid subscriptions in Q1. Chairman and Managing Director Murugavel Janakiraman expressed optimism about continued growth momentum for the financial year.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Hma Agro Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Mohammad Kamil Qureshi, a member of the Promoter Group of HMA Agro Industries Limited, has disclosed the acquisition of 4,25,75,347 equity shares through a gift from Wajid Ahmed. This transaction, which occurred on August 3, 2026, represents an inter-se transfer of shares among the promoter group. The disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The company has forwarded these disclosures to the Bombay Stock Exchange Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited for their records.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Vilin Bio Med Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Vilin Bio Med Limited has received an Observation Letter with 'No Objection' from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) dated August 10, 2026, regarding the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation of M/s Chemgenix Laboratories Private Limited into M/s Vilin Bio Med Limited. This follows their previous intimation on February 16, 2026, concerning the amalgamation under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The scheme is still subject to various statutory and regulatory approvals, as well as approvals from the respective shareholders and creditors of both companies. The NSE's Observation Letter is available on the company's website, www.vilinbio.com.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "Ola Electric to Unveil Next Chapter of Ola Energy on Independence Day".
announcements.ai_summary: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has issued a press release on August 11, 2026, announcing that it will unveil the "next chapter of Ola Energy" on Independence Day, August 15, 2026. The company emphasized its focus on developing indigenous energy technologies to strengthen India's energy ecosystem and contribute to energy independence. This year, Ola Electric will not hold an on-ground Sankalp event; instead, the announcements will be made directly across its official channels. Further details are expected to be shared on August 15, 2026. Ola Electric is India's leading electric vehicle manufacturer, specializing in vertical integration of technology and manufacturing for EVs and their components, including battery cells.

announcements.subject: Press Release

This subscription is in response to an offer from Saraswat Bank to eligible member-borrowers with low share-linkage levels, in accordance with applicable norms. The subscription is part of the ordinary course of the existing lender-borrower relationship and is linked to the company's existing credit facilities. announcements.subject: Press Release

The initial investment for this venture is approximately INR 186 crore. The platform will integrate advanced automation, digital manufacturing, AI, and sustainability principles. Phase 1 will have an installed capacity of 500,000 denims.

The project cost of approximately ₹186.30 crore will be funded through a combination of equity contribution (30%) and term loans (70%), which may be adjusted based on lender stipulations.

This marks TCS's ninth GEC globally and its second in Latin America, aimed at accelerating AI adoption and business transformation across industries. The new facility is equipped with over 3,000 industry- and context-aware AI agents built by TCS with Gemini Enterprise, designed to integrate seamlessly into customer environments. Demonstrations at the launch included AI-led solutions for intelligent process assessment, fraud investigation in financial institutions, automated insurance claims processing, and generative AI for data acceleration. The center will empower organizations in the region with advanced AI capabilities to drive innovation, productivity, and data-driven decision-making.

The customer franchise grew to approximately 16 million.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: CDSL has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment of equity shares to Centrico Insurance Repository Limited (CIRL), subsidiary of Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL) by RIX Systems & Solutions Private Limited (RIX). '
announcements.ai_summary: Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL) has announced an update regarding its subsidiary, Centrico Insurance Repository Limited (CIRL). Following SEBI's approval for CIRL's proposed investment in RIX Systems & Solutions Private Limited (“RIX”), RIX has allotted its first tranche of equity shares to CIRL on May 08, 2026. This allotment is in line with the disclosure made by CDSL on February 25, 2026, regarding SEBI's approval for the investment. The information is also available on CDSL's website.

announcements.subject: Demise
announcements.detail: LIC Housing Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Demise of Mr Sanjay Dayal, Chief Operating Officer of the company on May 09, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: LIC Housing Finance Limited has announced the untimely demise of its Chief Operating Officer, Dr. Sanjay Dayal, on May 9, 2026. Dr. Dayal was appointed to this position on April 10, 2026. This disclosure is made in compliance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company has provided further details as required by SEBI in Annexure A.

announcements.subject: Defaults on Payment of Interest/Principal
announcements.detail: Defaults on payments of principle and interest.
announcements.ai_summary: RKEC Projects Limited has reported defaults on the payment of both principal and interest. Further details regarding the extent and nature of these defaults are not provided in this announcement.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: TRANSWORLD SHIPPING LINES LIMITED has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: TRANSWORLD SHIPPING LINES LIMITED has successfully completed the sale of its vessel, M.V. SSL Gujarat, to Avana Logistek Limited on June 10, 2026. The sale was finalized following the execution of the Protocol of Delivery and Acceptance between the buyer and seller, with the vessel being delivered at Pipavav Anchorage, India. This update follows a previous letter dated April 27, 2026, regarding the sale. The company has submitted this information for record and dissemination.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Pine Labs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update on Acquisition'.
announcements.ai_summary: Pine Labs Limited has successfully completed the acquisition of 100% stake in Shopflo Technologies Private Limited on June 10, 2026. This acquisition was carried out by purchasing shares from the existing shareholders of Shopflo. As a result of this transaction, Shopflo Technologies Private Limited has now become a wholly owned subsidiary of Pine Labs Limited, effective from June 10, 2026. This follows the Board of Directors' approval for the acquisition, which was previously disclosed on April 25, 2026. The company will make this information available on its investor relations website.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Dj Mediaprint & Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 10, 2026. The Board approved the Conversion of 2,92,001 (Two Lakhs, Ninety-Two Thousand, and One Only) Warrants Convertible Into 2,92,001 (Two Lakhs, Ninety-Two Thousand, and One Only) Equity Shares of Face Value of Rs 10/- Each Including Premium of Rs. 104/-
announcements.ai_summary: DJ Mediaprint & Logistics Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 10, 2026, approved the conversion of 2,92,001 warrants into equity shares. Each warrant is convertible into one equity share of face value Rs 10/- each, with a premium of Rs 104/- per share. This conversion is based on a prior shareholder approval from October 06, 2024, and the allotment of warrants on January 02, 2025. The company received an aggregate amount of ₹2,49,66,000, representing 75% of the issue price per warrant, from the allottees for this conversion. Following this, the company's issued, subscribed, and paid-up equity share capital has increased to ₹34,66,98,520, comprising 3,46,69,852 equity shares of ₹10/- each.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Aditya Infotech Limited has informed the Exchange about Incorporation of Joint Venture Company under the name and style "Corelink Cable Technology Private Limited"
announcements.ai_summary: Aditya Infotech Limited (AIL) has announced the incorporation of its joint venture company, "Corelink Cable Technology Private Limited," on June 10, 2026. This JV, formed in partnership with Orient Cables (India) Limited, will focus on the manufacturing of electric cables, including LAN and CCTV cables, terminated assemblies, connectors, and allied products. AIL and Orient Cables will each hold a 50% stake in the JV. The initial paid-up share capital of the JV is proposed to be ₹2,00,00,000, with AIL and Orient each subscribing for ₹1,00,00,000 worth of equity shares. The face value of each equity share is ₹10. This disclosure follows earlier intimations dated February 12, 2026, and April 16, 2026.

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: Hindalco Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about an update on fire incident at Oswego Plant of Novelis a wholly owned subsidiary
announcements.ai_summary: Hindalco Industries Limited has provided an update regarding its wholly owned subsidiary, Novelis Inc. The hot mill at Novelis's Oswego, New York facility, which was previously impacted by a fire incident, has now become operational as of June 10, 2026. During the outage, Novelis utilized its global network of hot mills to ensure supply continuity for its customers. The company is now working with customers to ramp up supply and is accelerating the implementation of a standardized operating system to enhance dependable supply and product quality. Novelis has also expressed gratitude to the Oswego community for its support during the recovery process.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Time Technoplast Limited (TTL) has executed a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) with Systoverse Private Limited (SPL) to acquire a 76% stake in SPL. This acquisition is a strategic move to strengthen TTL's High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Pipe portfolio, accelerate inorganic growth, and establish an operational presence in Maharashtra. The remaining 24% stake in SPL will be held by its existing shareholders. TTL's total projected investment for this transaction is approximately Rs. 25 Crores, which includes the 76% equity stake acquisition, plant upgradations, modernization, capacity expansion, and capital expenditure for plant and machinery. The acquisition aligns with the 'Make in India' initiative by combining sustainability and innovation, enabling TTL to offer efficient and durable pipe solutions.

announcements.subject: Amendment to AOA/MOA
announcements.detail: Affle 3i Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
announcements.ai_summary: Affle 3i Limited has announced the alteration of its Memorandum of Association (MOA) and Articles of Association (AOA), effective June 10, 2026, following shareholder approval via a postal ballot. The key alteration involves the Authorised Share Capital clause, which has been revised. The new Clause V states that the Company's Authorised Share Capital is now Rs. 310,000,000, divided into 155,000,000 equity shares of Rs. 2 each. This change allows for the company's capital to be increased or reduced and for shares to be divided into different classes with varied rights.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about 'Letter to Shareholders - Notice of meeting of the Equity Shareholders'.
announcements.ai_summary: DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited has informed exchanges on June 10, 2026, regarding the dispatch of letters to shareholders whose email addresses are not registered. These letters provide a web-link and path to access the Notice of the Meeting of Equity Shareholders. This meeting is scheduled for July 13, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. (IST) through Video Conference/Other Audio Visual Means, as per the directions of the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal (Principal Bench, New Delhi). The company had previously informed about the circulation of this notice on June 10, 2026. The meeting will consider matters as directed by the NCLT, in compliance with circulars from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and SEBI.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: IZMO Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'izmo Corporate Presentation'.
announcements.ai_summary: IZMO Limited has released an "izmo Corporate Presentation" on June 10, 2026, in accordance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The presentation is available on the company's website, www.izmoltd.com. The presentation highlights IZMO's business model, which operates on two engines: a Digital SaaS Cashflow Engine (including izmocars, izmostock, izmoemporio, and FrogData) and a Semiconductor Growth Engine (izmomicro). The company, founded in 1995 and listed on the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange, has a global footprint with offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. The presentation details the company's evolution from auto-retail software to semiconductors, with the formation of the izmo Microsystems subsidiary in 2022 and plans for capacity expansion in integrated SiPh lines and optical transceivers by 2026.

announcements.subject: Conversion
announcements.detail: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Conversion
announcements.ai_summary: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Limited has approved the allotment of 9,80,000 fully paid-up Equity Shares to Mr. Rajesh Balkrishna Rathi, a promoter, on June 10, 2026. This allotment is pursuant to the conversion of 9,80,000 warrants, each convertible into one equity share of face value Rs. 2. The warrants were originally allotted on a preferential basis at an issue price of Rs. 1,019.75 per warrant. Mr. Rathi had previously paid 25% of the consideration (Rs. 254.94 per warrant) and has now remitted the remaining 75% (Rs. 764.81 per warrant), aggregating to Rs. 74,95,13,800. The total consideration for the warrants was Rs. 1,019.75 per warrant, amounting to Rs. 100,00,00,000. These newly allotted equity shares will rank pari-passu with existing equity shares.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Canara Bank has informed the Exchange regarding 'Revision in Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR) w.e.f. 12.06.2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: Canara Bank has announced a revision in its Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR) effective from June 12, 2026. The Overnight MCLR will increase from 7.90% to 7.95%. The One Month MCLR will be revised from 7.95% to 8.00%. The Three Month MCLR will move from 8.20% to 8.25%. The Six Month MCLR will be adjusted from 8.55% to 8.60%. The MCLR for One Year, Two Year, and Three Year tenors will remain unchanged at 8.75%, 9.00%, and 9.05% respectively. This revision is for the information and records of the exchanges.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Globe International Carriers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ': Disclosure under Regulation 29 (2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.: Disclosure under Regulation 29 (2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.Disclosure Under Regulation 29(2)'.
announcements.ai_summary: Globe International Carriers Limited has disclosed a transaction under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Govind Kripa Enclave LLP, a promoter, acquired 1,00,000 equity shares representing 0.09% of the total voting capital on 04th June 2026. Prior to this acquisition, Govind Kripa Enclave LLP held 49,66,000 shares, constituting 4.43% of the voting capital. Post-acquisition, their holding increased to 50,66,000 shares, representing 4.52% of the total voting capital. The transaction was executed on the NSE market for a value of 26,64,235.20.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Jindal Photo Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Jindal Photo Limited has announced the extension of its 0% Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares (NCPS). Following in-principle approval from the Directors and receipt of consent from the holders, the tenure of 1,50,00,000 Redeemable Preference Shares (Series II) has been extended from June 10, 2026, to June 10, 2031. Additionally, the tenure of 40,00,000 Redeemable Preference Shares (Series III) has been extended from September 22, 2026, to September 22, 2031. All other terms and conditions of these preference shares remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: Redemption
announcements.detail: Share India Securities Limited has informed the Exchange about the partial redemption of face value of NCD Series A (ISIN: INE932X07023) and NCD Second Issue (ISIN: INE932X07031).
announcements.ai_summary: Share India Securities Limited has partially redeemed the principal amount of its Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) issued on a private placement basis. On June 10, 2026, the company completed payments for the partial redemption of NCD Series A (ISIN: INE932X07023) and NCD Second Issue (ISIN: INE932X07031). Following the redemption, the face value per NCD for Series A has reduced from Rs. 62,500/- to Rs. 50,000/-, and for the Second Issue, it has reduced from Rs. 87,500/- to Rs. 75,000/-. These payments were completed by 11:52 a.m. on June 10, 2026.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Univastu India Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: On June 9, 2026, a Joint Venture (JV) between Bootes Infrastructure Limited and Univastu India Limited, where Univastu India Limited holds a 49% share, received a 'Letter of Award' from the Aligarh Development Authority, Government of Uttar Pradesh. The JV has been awarded the project for the development of ADA's land near Soot Mill Circle, Baroula Jafrabad, Aligarh, under a Public Private Partnership (PPP) Model on a Land Monetization framework through a Joint Development Agreement (JDA) on a revenue-sharing basis. The project involves the development of approximately 25,091 Sq. Mtrs. of land. The concession period for the project is 96 months, including construction, sales, and operation & maintenance. The revenue share payable to Aligarh Development Authority will be determined based on the bid submitted by the selected developer and the JDA terms.

announcements.subject: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
announcements.detail: Optiemus Infracom Limited has informed the Exchange about Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
announcements.ai_summary: On June 10, 2026, the Operations and Administration Committee of Optiemus Infracom Limited's Board of Directors approved an enhancement of the Corporate Guarantee to CSB Bank Limited. The guarantee amount has been increased from Rs. 35.50 Crores to Rs. 60 Crores. This enhanced guarantee is to secure credit facilities availed or to be availed by Optiemus Electronics Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Optiemus Infracom Limited. The transaction is being conducted on an arm's length basis, and the promoter/promoter group has no interest in this transaction. The meeting of the committee commenced at 04:30 P.M. and concluded at 04:50 P.M. on the same day.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Jet Freight Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011'.
announcements.ai_summary: Jet Freight Logistics Limited has informed the stock exchanges about a disclosure received from the Promoter of the company concerning the substantial acquisition of shares and takeovers. This disclosure is a consequence of the allotment of 2,22,40,000 warrants on a preferential basis, approved by the Board of Directors on June 05, 2026. Each warrant is priced at ₹18/- and is convertible into one fully paid-up equity share of face value ₹5/-. The warrants have been allotted to members of the Promoter Group, including Ms. Thea Richard Theknath. This announcement is made pursuant to Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: GAIL (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: GAIL (India) Limited has announced that its subsidiary, Konkan LNG Limited (KLL), has received a sanctioned order from the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) on June 3, 2026, regarding the reduction of its equity share capital. The scheme, filed in June 2025, involves the cancellation and extinguishment of 14,81,10,440 equity shares of KLL. Consequently, GAIL's shareholding in KLL will increase to 100%, and MSEB Holding Company Limited's shareholding will be reduced to Nil. The certified true copy of the NCLT order was received by GAIL on June 10, 2026. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: CDSL has informed the Exchange about SEBI Approval for investment in Sahamati Foundation.
announcements.ai_summary: Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL) has received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to invest ₹1 crore in Sahamati Foundation. This investment represents 2% of Sahamati Foundation's paid-up share capital. The approval is subject to CDSL maintaining its net worth requirements as per SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018. Sahamati Foundation is a Section 8 company and a member-driven industry alliance focused on the Account Aggregator (AA) ecosystem, having recently received recognition as a Self-Regulatory Organisation (SRO) for the AA ecosystem from the RBI on June 05, 2026. For the financial years ending March 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, Sahamati Foundation reported turnovers of ₹12,60,43,816/-, ₹15,06,55,720/-, and ₹12,12,57,573/- respectively. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Petronet LNG Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - Details of penalty paid against Notice for non-compliance with SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Petronet LNG Limited has paid penalties to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited for non-compliance with Regulation 17(1) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The company incurred a non-compliance period of 58 days, from January 16, 2026, to February 28, 2026, and from March 18, 2026, to March 31, 2026. The total penalty paid to BSE was Rs. 3,42,200 after TDS, and a similar amount of Rs. 3,42,200 was paid to NSE. The company had communicated with NSE and BSE officials regarding the matter but proceeded with the payment as per their calculations.

announcements.subject: Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up
announcements.detail: PPAP Automotive Limited Partners with Hutchinson, to develop advanced body sealing systemsfor India s Passenger Vehicle Industry
announcements.ai_summary: PPAP Automotive Limited has entered into a partnership agreement with HUTCHINSON, a global leader in automotive sealing solutions, to manufacture advanced body sealing systems for India's passenger vehicle industry. This collaboration, effective from April 1, 2026, will grant PPAP Automotive Limited exclusive rights in India to manufacture, market, and sell these systems, leveraging HUTCHINSON's advanced technologies, licensed know-how, and ongoing technical support. HUTCHINSON will provide essential technical know-how, engineering support, design assistance, and process support for the development and commercialization of these products in India. PPAP Automotive Limited will pay consideration for the transfer of technical know-how and licensed technology, along with ongoing royalty payments for the use of intellectual property.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: PPAP Automotive Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 10, 2026, titled "PPAP Automotive Limited Partners with Hutchinson, to develop advanced body sealing systems for India s Passenger Vehicle Industry".
announcements.ai_summary: PPAP Automotive Limited has entered into a technology partnership agreement with Hutchinson, a global group specializing in multi-material solutions. Under this agreement, PPAP will collaborate with Hutchinson to manufacture advanced body sealing systems in India for the passenger vehicle segment. This partnership will leverage Hutchinson's advanced technologies, licensed know-how, and ongoing technical support. The collaboration aims to enhance PPAP's technological capabilities and expand its automotive body-sealing systems portfolio to meet the evolving requirements of OEMs in India. Production will be carried out at PPAP Automotive Limited's existing manufacturing facilities.

announcements.subject: Forfeiture
announcements.detail: Intimation of Lapse and Cancellation of Warrants & forfeiture of Upfront Amount
announcements.ai_summary: Servotech Renewable Power System Limited has announced the lapse and cancellation of 58,50,000 convertible warrants that were allotted on December 10, 2024, at a price of Rs. 167.40 per warrant. These warrants were convertible into equity shares of face value Rs. 1 each within 18 months from the allotment date, with the last date for conversion being June 09, 2026. As the allottee, Sarika Bhatia, a promoter, did not exercise the conversion option within the stipulated period, the warrants have lapsed effective June 10, 2026. Consequently, the upfront amount of Rs. 24,48,22,500, representing 25% of the issue price, has been forfeited by the company.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: This is to inform you that Rane Steering Systems Private Limited, Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company has entered into Power Purchase Agreement with Hexa Energy BH Eleven Private Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Rane Holdings Limited's wholly owned subsidiary, Rane Steering Systems Private Limited (RSSL), has entered into a Power Purchase Agreement with Hexa Energy BH Eleven Private Limited for renewable energy procurement. Additionally, RSSL will acquire a 26.00% equity stake in Hexa Energy BH Eleven Private Limited through a Share Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement. Hexa Energy BH Eleven Private Limited is engaged in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity through renewable sources. The acquisition is expected to be completed within 30 days from the signing of the Power Purchase Agreement. This move aims to comply with regulatory requirements for captive power consumption.

announcements.subject: Product launch
announcements.detail: KRBL Limited has informed the Exchange about Product launch
announcements.ai_summary: The company KRBL Limited has announced the launch of a new product, "India Gate Poha," under its flagship brand "India Gate." This marks the company's entry into the everyday kitchen staples category. The product is a thick poha and is targeted at the domestic market. The launch date was June 10, 2026. This expansion into a new product category is intended to broaden KRBL Limited's consumer offerings.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Bosch Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Sub-Committee Meeting held on Jun 10, 2026 pertaining to allotment of equity shares
announcements.ai_summary: Bosch Limited's Sub-Committee of the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on June 10, 2026, approved the allotment of 1,230 equity shares each to Robert Bosch Investment Nederland B.V and Robert Bosch LLC, totaling 2,460 equity shares. This allotment is pursuant to a Preferential Allotment approved by shareholders through Postal Ballot on May 08, 2026, and received in-principle approval from stock exchanges on June 02, 2026. The shares were allotted at a price of INR 35,200/- per equity share, including a premium of INR 35,190/-. Following this allotment, the company's total issued and paid-up share capital has increased from Rs. 29,49,36,400 (2,94,93,640 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each) to Rs. 29,49,61,000 (2,94,96,100 equity shares of face value of Rs. 10/- each). The newly allotted equity shares will rank pari passu with existing equity shares. The company is taking steps to file the corporate action with the depository and will apply for listing and trading approvals for these shares.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations )   Commencement of Operations of New Hospital Facility at Mathura, Uttar Pradesh
announcements.ai_summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has commenced operations of its new hospital facility, Sanskriti Ayurvedic P.G. Medical College & Hospital, located at Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, effective June 10, 2026. This facility has a bed capacity of 100 beds and an approximate area of 60,000 sq. ft., with an OPD capacity of 8 OPD. This expansion is part of the company's strategy to enhance its healthcare infrastructure and accessibility to Ayurvedic services across India. The new facility is expected to contribute to the company's growth and its mission of providing holistic healthcare solutions.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Prakash Pipes Limited has informed regarding the acquisition of 26% equity share capital of BECIS Solar 3 Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Prakash Pipes Limited has been allotted 1,30,23,152 fully paid-up equity shares of BECIS Solar 3 Private Limited, each with a face value of ₹1/-, on June 9, 2026. This allotment represents an investment of ₹1,30,23,152 by Prakash Pipes Limited in BECIS. The company's shareholding in BECIS remains at 26% of the issued and paid-up equity share capital, fulfilling the requirements of the Electricity Rules, 2005. This investment is for the development and construction of a solar power project intended to supply power to Prakash Pipes Limited. This follows an earlier intimation on December 18, 2025, regarding the proposed acquisition.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Aksh Optifibre Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Aksh Optifibre Limited has provided an update regarding an application filed under Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 ("IBC") by Shantanu Investments Private Limited. The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Jaipur Bench, initially had divergent opinions from its members. A third nominated member has now concurred with the Technical Member, holding that the IBC application is maintainable. The matter has been referred back to the original bench for further orders. Aksh Optifibre Limited believes the order has errors and has filed an appeal before the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT), pursuing all available legal remedies to safeguard stakeholder interests.

announcements.subject: Granting/withdrawal/surrender/cancellation/suspension of key licenses/ regulatory approvals
announcements.detail: Nitiraj Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange about Granting/withdrawal/surrender/cancellation/suspension of key licenses/ regulatory approvals
announcements.ai_summary: Nitiraj Engineers Limited has received a Type Certificate from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA), Government of India, for its agricultural drone model "NADR10". The certificate, bearing No. T05260000094/00, was issued under the Drone Rules, 2021, confirming the drone meets prescribed standards for design, construction, specifications, performance, and operational safety. The NADR10 is a medium-class agricultural spraying drone with a 10-litre capacity. This certification allows the company to manufacture and market the drone within the regulatory framework. Obtaining this certificate involved extensive testing and technical evaluations over several years. The company expects this to strengthen its position in the drone ecosystem and the precision agriculture sector. Nitiraj Engineers Limited will continue to enhance its drone capabilities and expand its product offerings.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 10, 2026, titled "J.K. Shah Classes (JKSC) signs MoU with Japan s CPA Excellent Partners ".
announcements.ai_summary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has announced a press release dated June 10, 2026, detailing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed between J.K. Shah Classes (JKSC), a Veranda enterprise, and Japan-based CPA Excellent Partners (CPAEP). This collaboration aims to strengthen global talent pathways in accounting and finance by facilitating talent development, placement, recruitment, and career support for accounting and finance professionals. The partnership will create structured international career pathways for learners in Veranda Learning's commerce vertical, enabling Indian commerce graduates to access global roles, including opportunities in Japan.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Announcement of approval of the Scheme of Arrangement by the Board of Directors of Astra Microwave Products Limited ( AMPL  /  Demerged Company ) pursuant the Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended ( SEBI Listing Regulation )
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Astra Microwave Products Limited (AMPL), at a meeting held on June 10, 2026, approved a Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of its Space, Meteorology, and Hydrology Business into its wholly-owned subsidiary, Astra Space Technologies Private Limited (ASTPL). ASTPL will issue shares to AMPL shareholders based on a determined share ratio. The transaction will be carried out on a going concern basis. This scheme is subject to approvals from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), SEBI, BSE Limited, and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited, along with other necessary permissions.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Wanbury Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 10, 2026, titled "Press Release on Quality inspection by the Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) at Tanuku, Andhra Pradesh".
announcements.ai_summary: Wanbury Limited has announced that its API manufacturing site located in Tanuku, Andhra Pradesh, has successfully completed a quality inspection by the Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA), Australia's drug regulatory agency. Upon receiving the GMP certificate, Wanbury will be enabled to ship an additional 3 APIs. The company also noted that another API site in Patalganga received a GMP certificate from MFDS (Korean FDA) following an inspection in April 2026. Wanbury Limited remains committed to cGMP compliance and continuous improvement. This press release was issued on June 10, 2026.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Jash Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Corporate Announcement'.
announcements.ai_summary: Jash Engineering Limited reported consolidated orders received in May 2026 amounting to Rs. 34 Cr, with Rs. 15 Cr from the Indian market and Rs. 19 Cr from international markets. Significant contributors include Pulkit Projects and Laxmi Civil Engineering Services Pvt. Ltd. in India, and Hilla Sewerage (Iraq) and JN Bentley (UK) internationally. As of June 1, 2026, the company's total consolidated order book stands at Rs. 888 Cr, comprising Rs. 261 Cr for the Indian market and Rs. 627 Cr for international markets, with Rs. 369 Cr specifically for the USA. announcements.ai_summary: Hyundai Motor India Limited has provided an update on the fire incident at its supplier, Mobis India Limited, which had caused a temporary disruption to the company's production. As of June 10, 2026, the company is arranging automotive parts from alternate sources to normalize production. Operations at the Pune plant and Chennai Plant 2 remain largely unaffected, with the disruption primarily confined to Chennai Plant 1. Production at Chennai Plant 1 is expected to regain pace by June 15, 2026, and all production operations are projected to return to normal by June 22, 2026. The company anticipates recovering any production loss within the next quarter and does not expect a significant impact on retail sales in June 2026 due to adequate inventory.

announcements.ai_summary: Fino Payments Bank Limited has released its business performance update for June 2026, highlighting resilient growth in its liability base and loan referral business. The bank opened approximately 3.1 lakh new deposit accounts, marking a 31% year-on-year (YoY) increase, bringing the total count to 1.8 crore accounts. Renewal income grew by 6% YoY to ₹20.8 crore, and average total deposits increased by 11% YoY to ₹2,755 crore. Digital engagement improved significantly, with FinoPay active customers rising by 38% YoY to approximately 8.4 lakh. Loan referral disbursals, a pilot for the proposed Small Finance Bank, surged by 253% to approximately ₹240 crore, while transaction business throughput decreased by 35% YoY to ₹2,830 crore due to the shift from cash to UPI, though the pace of degrowth has eased.

announcements.ai_summary: Suven Life Sciences Limited will be presenting five scientific posters at the Alzheimer's Association International Conference (AAIC) 2026, held in London, UK, from July 12-15, 2026. The presentations will include updates on the global Phase-3 Masupirdine clinical program for Agitation associated with Alzheimer's Dementia and the Usmarapride Phase-2 clinical development program. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 10, 2026, titled "Adani Dioxycle Partnership to Advance Low-Carbon Chemical Manufacturing".
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL), the flagship company of the Adani Group, has entered into a long-term partnership with Dioxycle, a French clean-technology company. This collaboration aims to develop and scale low-carbon chemical production in India. The initiative will commence with a pilot facility at an Adani Group site to produce formic acid using captured carbon dioxide and renewable electricity. Following successful validation, the partners intend to scale the technology for commercial manufacturing. This partnership leverages Dioxycle's electrically driven chemical manufacturing technology with Adani Group's clean-energy capabilities, infrastructure, and project execution expertise. The companies will also explore other critical chemicals used across industries seeking to reduce emissions.

announcements.ai_summary: Elecon Engineering Company Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 10, 2026. The Gear Division reported a 16.3% year-on-year revenue increase to Rs. 416 crores in Q1 FY27, with EBIT growing 14.7% YoY to Rs. 75 crores and maintaining an EBIT margin of 17.9%. The order intake for the Gear Division rose 18.8% YoY to Rs. 570 crores, and the open order book increased by 46.9% YoY to Rs. 1,043 crores, indicating strong future revenue visibility. The company's consolidated revenue for Q1 FY27 was Rs. 521 crores, a 6.1% increase compared to the adjusted Q1 FY26 revenue of Rs. 491 crores. announcements.ai_summary: Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited has announced the inauguration of two new retail stores under its wellness brand, "NEAT EVERYDAY". This expansion is part of the company's strategy to grow its wellness and beauty division, offering a curated range of nutraceutical, wellness, beauty, and personal care products. announcements.ai_summary: Delta Autocorp Limited, also known as Deltic, has announced the acceleration of its on-ground expansion with the opening of a new Company-Owned Company-Operated (COCO) showroom in Mahuda, Jharkhand. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: JBM Electric Vehicles, a part of JBM Auto, has launched its next-generation 'GALAXY' electric luxury coach at Prawaas 5.0 in Gandhinagar on July 10, 2026. The coach was unveiled by Shri Nitin Gadkari, Hon'ble Union Minister of Transport & Highways, in the presence of Shri Nishant Arya, Chairman of JBM Electric Vehicles. The 'GALAXY' coach offers a unique configuration of 22 Maharaja reclining seats plus 20 plush sleeper berths with an onboard washroom, and an alternative with 24 Maharaja reclining seats plus 20 plush sleeper berths without a washroom. This new model is designed to maximize operator revenue potential and passenger convenience for inter-city travel by offering the highest seating capacity in its segment combined with the largest luggage space. The JBM 'GALAXY' platform has already demonstrated operational capabilities of over 900 kms per day, and JBM EV continues to hold the leading market share in the Indian electric luxury coach segment. The 'GALAXY' coach will be available in three variants: seater, sleeper, and seater-sleeper.

announcements.ai_summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited has announced with profound grief the sudden and untimely demise of Mrs. Sarita Garware Ramsay, Joint Managing Director of the company, on July 09, 2026. Mrs. Ramsay, holding DIN: 00136048, had been serving as a Joint Managing Director since 2002. The company acknowledged her significant wisdom, experience, and contributions, which were deeply valued by the Board and the company. Her passing is considered an irreparable loss to the company. The Board of Directors and all employees have expressed their deepest condolences to the bereaved family.

This initiative aims to address the growing threat of antimicrobial resistance (AMR), which causes approximately 10 lakh patient deaths annually in India. The Wockhardt Antibiotic Academy is an open scientific learning platform for the registered medical fraternity across India, designed to facilitate continuous medical education through knowledge exchange, scientific discussions, and sharing of real-world clinical experiences among healthcare professionals. The initiative seeks to create a deeper understanding of drug resistance and promote evidence-based solutions to save patients' lives.
