The company signed a Letter of Intent (LoI) worth Rs. 147.11 Crore with JSW Port Logistics Private Limited for the manufacture and supply of 7 BOSM rakes, comprising 329 BOSM wagons. This marks Jupiter Wagons' second order from the JSW Group within six weeks, following a previous Rs. 122.88 Crore order from JSW (South) Rail Logistics Private Limited in June 2026, bringing the cumulative order intake from the JSW Group to approximately Rs. 270 Crore. Additionally, Orissa Alloy Steel Private Limited (OASPL) has placed a Purchase Order valued at Rs. 64.16 Crore for the manufacture and supply of 150 wagons under the LSFTO Scheme.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Jupiter Wagons Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, titled "Jupiter Wagons secures 100 MW/400 MWh BESS capacity in West Bengal; targeting ₹1,000 crore order book".
announcements.ai_summary: Jupiter Wagons Limited (JWL) has been declared the successful bidder for two standalone Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects with a combined capacity of 100 MW/400 MWh in West Bengal, through e-reverse auctions conducted by West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd (WBSEDCL). These projects, located at Jeerat and Kharagpur, will be executed and operated by JEM, a subsidiary of JWL. The scope includes the supply and commissioning of an approximately INR 400 Crore BESS project, which will operate under a 15-year BOO model with WBSEDCL. These wins significantly expand Jupiter Electric Mobility's BESS business, increasing its order book to approximately 500 MWh, valued at over INR 500 Crore, with a target of reaching an INR 1,000 Crore BESS order book by FY27.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'intimation - investment in WOS'.
announcements.ai_summary: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 10, 2026, approved further investments in its wholly-owned subsidiaries. The company will invest up to Rs. 500 Crores in Amara Raja Advanced Cell Technologies Private Limited, in addition to an existing approval of Rs. 2,000 Crores, to establish Gigafactories/Plants. Additionally, Rs. 50 Crores will be invested in Amara Raja Power Systems Limited, supplementing an existing approval of Rs. 50 Crores, to support operational and manufacturing requirements. These investments can be made through loan, equity, or other modes in one or more tranches.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: JSW Steel Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, titled "JSW Steel reports Consolidated Crude Steel Production of 24.02 Lakh Tonnesfor July 26".
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Steel Limited reported consolidated crude steel production of 24.02 Lakh tonnes for July 2026, marking a 3% year-on-year growth. Indian operations contributed 23.39 Lakh tonnes, a 4% increase, while JSW Steel USA – Ohio produced 0.63 Lakh tonnes, a 13% decrease. The company noted that production figures for the transferred undertaking of Bhushan Power and Steel Limited (BPSL) to JSW-JFE Steel Limited in March 2026 have been adjusted for year-on-year comparison. Capacity utilization for Indian operations stood at 87% in July 2026, with BF3 at Vijayanagar ramping up well post-restart and operating above 80% of its rated capacity. JSW Steel is part of the US$25 billion JSW Group and aims to increase its combined crude steel capacity to 54.8 MTPA over the next four years.

announcements.subject: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
announcements.detail: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board in its meeting held on August 10, 2026 have considered and approved the proposal to issue / provide Corporate Guarantee/Letter of Comfort/Post Dated Cheques (PDCs) to secure the loan provided/to be provided by Banks/Financial Institutions/Non-Banking Finance Companies (NBFCs) to Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited, for an amount upto Rs. 8 Crores
announcements.ai_summary: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange that its Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 10, 2026, approved the issuance of a Corporate Guarantee, Letter of Comfort, or Post-Dated Cheques (PDCs) to secure a loan for its subsidiary, Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited. The guarantee will be for an amount up to Rs. 8 Crores (Rupees Eight Crores Only). The Board also approved the submission of Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026. Additionally, the company announced the setting up of a new manufacturing plant for its Intelligent Ambient Comfort (IAC) Division in Chakan, Maharashtra, with a capital outlay of around Rs. 156.23 Crores. This project will cater to new orders from Mahindra & Mahindra and is expected to achieve a peak annualized turnover of approximately Rs. 440 Crores post-commissioning. The plant is scheduled for commissioning in two phases: Q4 FY 2027 and Q1 FY 2028.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Signoria Creation Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: Signoria Creation Limited's Board of Directors, through a resolution by circulation on August 10, 2026, has approved the establishment of a new factory/manufacturing unit for readymade garments on leasehold premises. This expansion is expected to enhance the company's production capacity. The company's existing manufacturing capacity is 865,000 pieces per annum, with a utilization of approximately 95% (828,609 pieces). The proposed capacity addition involves approximately 17,500 sq. ft. of additional manufacturing/stitching space at Plot Nos. 127 and 128, Scheme Sumer Nagar, Village Kalyanpura, Mansarovar, Jaipur, Rajasthan, taken on lease. This is expected to result in an additional production capacity of approximately 535,000 pieces per annum, to be added within approximately 1 month. The investment required for this capacity addition is ₹75,00,000 (Seventy-Five lakh Rupees), which will be funded through internal accruals.

announcements.subject: Utilisation of Funds
announcements.detail: Patel Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Utilisation of Funds  raised through Rights Issue
announcements.ai_summary: Patel Engineering Limited has submitted a statement of deviation or variation for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, concerning the utilization of funds raised through a Rights Issue. The total amount raised through the Rights Issue on December 22, 2025, was Rs. 3,989.68 million. During the current reporting period, the company transferred Rs. 21.55 million from the escrow account to the monitoring account for general corporate purposes, adjusting the excess issue expense against general corporate purposes as per the Letter of Offer.

Furthermore, Flywings will establish a new training facility at Taloja and a sales & marketing office at Andheri, Mumbai, as part of its Maharashtra expansion. For the fiscal year 2026, the company reported a Revenue from Operations of Rs. 24.51 crore, a 21.3% year-on-year growth, with an Operating Margin of 64.6%. Net Profit for FY26 increased by 8% year-on-year to Rs. 11.64 crore, and Total Assets grew by 62.6% year-on-year to Rs. 107.99 crore.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Flywings Simulator Training Centre Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Energy Limited has announced a significant capacity addition, increasing its total installed capacity to 14,920 MW. Since April 2026, the company has added 1,166 MW of renewable capacity, which represents over 94% of its total organic capacity addition target for FY26. Additionally, 300 MW of inorganic thermal capacity has been added following the acquisition of Maruti Clean Coal and Power Limited. Renewable energy now accounts for 60% of JSW Energy's total installed capacity, comprising 3,125 MW of wind, 2,360 MW of solar, 1,696 MW of hybrid, and 1,781 MW of hydro power. The thermal portfolio stands at 5,958 MW. The company is on track to achieve its 3 GW greenfield capacity addition target for FY2027 and aims to reach 30 GW of generation capacity and 40 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2030, with a goal of carbon neutrality by 2050.

announcements.subject: Press Release

announcements.ai_summary: Aegis Logistics Limited has commissioned a specialized storage terminal for Ammonia at Pipavav Port, effective August 10, 2026. The figures include sales from its subsidiary, Mahindra Electric Automobile Limited, for Utility Vehicles, and from Mahindra Last Mile Mobility Limited and SML Mahindra Limited for Vans, E-Rickshaws, E-Carts, 3W-Pass, 3W-Goods, and Zor Grand Electric vehicles. The reported numbers are preliminary and have not been independently verified or audited.

On August 14, 2026, Sweta Sheth, Principal – Investor Relations, will attend the Equirus Annual India Conference in Mumbai. Subsequently, on August 17, 2026, Sandeep Mahindroo (Financial Controller and Head – Investor Relations), Ganesh Ramasubramanian (AVP – Investor Relations), and Sweta Sheth will participate in the Motilal Oswal 22nd Annual Global Investor Conference, also in Mumbai. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Thomas Cook  (India)  Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, titled "Thomas Cook India strengthens footprint in Gujarat with new outlet in Ahmedabad".
announcements.ai_summary: Thomas Cook (India) Limited has opened a new outlet in Ahmedabad's Nikol area, expanding its presence in Gujarat. This marks the company's fifth location in Ahmedabad and twelfth across the state, aiming to enhance customer access to its travel and holiday services. The new outlet will serve various customer segments including families, couples, millennials, GenZ, business travelers, and seniors, offering a full range of domestic and international holiday packages, group tours, personalized trips, cruises, and travel insurance. The company is leveraging its AI-powered booking platform to facilitate seamless vacation planning and reservations. This expansion is driven by Gujarat's growing travel market, characterized by a preference for year-round short breaks, group travel with specific cultural and dietary needs, and increasing interest in spiritual tourism.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Consultancy Services Limited (TCS) has informed the stock exchanges about receiving threat-intelligence alerts alleging possible exposure of certain employee information. Following an investigation, TCS has not found any credible evidence of a breach of its systems or customer environments. The company stated that the referenced information appears to be over four years old and limited to basic employee details, with no indication of customer data, customer systems, or TCS operational systems being impacted. The attacker claimed to have used password spray and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) fatigue, against which TCS has had strong safeguards in place for over two years, and these controls remain effective. TCS will continue to monitor the environment and assess any new information.

announcements.ai_summary: On August 10, 2026, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of JTL Industries Limited passed a resolution by circulation approving the grant of 11,42,500 Employee Stock Options (Options) under the JTL Industries Employee Stock Option Scheme – 2025. These options are convertible into an equal number of Equity Shares of the Company, each with a face value of Re. 1/-. The options are granted at an exercise price of Rs. 20/- per Option. After vesting, options can be exercised within a maximum period of 2 years from the respective vesting date.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, titled "Zydus launches REVAHALE , India s first once-daily nebulised LAMA for COPD".
announcements.ai_summary: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has issued a press release on August 10, 2026, announcing the launch of REVAHALE™ (Revefenacin). This product is India's first once-daily nebulised Long-Acting Muscarinic Antagonist (LAMA) indicated for the maintenance treatment of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). REVAHALE™ offers sustained 24-hour bronchodilation through a convenient nebulised delivery platform, addressing challenges faced by patients with inhaler-dependent therapies, particularly the elderly or those with severe respiratory impairment. The therapy is compatible with standard jet nebulisers and has demonstrated significant improvements in lung function with a favourable safety profile in clinical studies.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, titled "Exicom Opens FY27 with Order Wins Across Both Businesses as Revenue Grows Sharply Year on Year ".
announcements.ai_summary: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has announced its financial results for the first quarter of FY27, reporting significant order wins across both its business segments. On a standalone basis, revenue grew by approximately 57% year-on-year to ₹237 crore, and EBITDA more than doubled to approximately ₹21 crore, resulting in an EBITDA margin of 8.8% for Q1 FY27. On a consolidated basis, revenue increased by 61% to ₹331 crore, and the EBITDA loss narrowed to approximately ₹22 crore from ₹39 crore in the same period last year. The company's consolidated gross margin was 31.7%, down from 39.4% a year ago, attributed to external cost pressures and exchange rate volatility. The company is actively addressing these cost pressures and building supply chain resilience.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Press Release on the performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Patel Engineering Limited has announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting strong performance. The company's consolidated revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 was ₹1,280.74 crore, a 3.83% increase year-on-year from ₹1,233.45 crore in Q1 FY26. Consolidated operating EBITDA stood at ₹179.60 crore with a margin of 14.02%, up from ₹165.33 crore in the prior year. Consolidated net profit attributable to owners of the parent increased by 24.49% year-on-year to ₹93.48 crore, with a margin of 7.30%, compared to ₹75.09 crore in Q1 FY26. The company's order book as of June 30, 2026, was ₹14,636 crore. Key operational highlights include the Subansiri Lower Hydropower Project reaching 1,000 MW operational capacity and the Kwar Hydropower Project dam concrete works crossing 50% completion.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Canara Bank has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: Canara Bank has been penalized by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) with a monetary penalty of Rs.1,49,450.00. This penalty is due to specific violations related to currency chest operations, including CC Remittance Shortage amounting to Rs.1,24,100/-, Mutilated Notes in CC Remittance amounting to Rs.23,350/-, and Counterfeit notes in CC Remittance amounting to Rs.2,000/-. The bank received this communication and order from the RBI on August 10, 2026. The financial impact of this action is limited to the penalty amount of Rs.1,49,450.00.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Venus Pipes & Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Venus Pipes & Tubes Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 10, 2026, reporting an all-time high revenue of INR 320.5 Crores. This represents a year-on-year growth of 16.0% compared to Q1FY26 (INR 276.4 Crores) and a 6.1% increase from Q4FY26 (INR 302.2 Crores). EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 51.5 Crores, a 14.7% increase year-on-year, with EBITDA margins at 16.1%. Profit After Tax (PAT) was INR 26.4 Crores, a 6.5% increase year-on-year, with PAT margins at 8.2%. Revenue from Welded Pipes/Tubes grew by 21% and Seamless Pipes/Tubes by 15% year-on-year. Domestic sales showed robust growth of 31%, while exports constituted approximately 30% of revenues, amounting to INR 94 Crores. The company's forward integration into Pipe spooling is on track for commencement by December 2026. The company anticipates continued strong demand and plans to increase the contribution of higher-value products to its revenue mix.

announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015 - Approval of Scheme of Amalgamation of Dsquare Solutions Private Limited (Step down Subsidiary) with Hansa Customer Equity Private Limited (Subsidiary Company)
announcements.ai_summary: R K Swamy Limited's Board of Directors has approved a Scheme of Amalgamation for the merger of Dsquare Solutions Private Limited, a step-down subsidiary, with Hansa Customer Equity Private Limited, a material wholly-owned subsidiary. The Board meetings approving this scheme were held on August 10, 2026. Dsquare Solutions Private Limited is engaged in Customer and Marketing Analytics Services, while Hansa Customer Equity Private Limited provides Data Analytics and Digital Marketing Consultancy Services. Dsquare is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Hansa Cequity, which in turn is a wholly-owned subsidiary of R K Swamy Limited. The appointed date for the Scheme is April 1, 2026, and the amalgamation is subject to necessary statutory and regulatory approvals.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015   Expansion and Modernization of Manufacturing Facilities across SegmentsWe wish to inform you that, the Board of Directors of K.P.R. Mill Limited ("the Company") in its meeting held on 10th August 2026 has approved a comprehensive capacity expansion and modernization plan across the Textile Value Chain.
announcements.ai_summary: K.P.R. Mill Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 10, 2026, approved a comprehensive capacity expansion and modernization plan across its Textile Value Chain. The total investment for these projects amounts to Rs. 1,225 Crores, with an expected turnover of around Rs. 2,000 Crores. Key greenfield projects include a new Ready Made Garment manufacturing facility in Odisha with a capacity of 45 million garments per annum, costing Rs. 450 Crores and expected to be completed by the 1st Quarter of 2027-28. Additionally, a new processing factory in Perundurai, Coimbatore, with a capacity of 10,000 MT per annum, will cost Rs. 250 Crores and is slated for completion in the 2nd Quarter of 2027-28. A new Sweater Manufacturing factory in Karumathampatti, Coimbatore, with a capacity of 2.5 million garments per annum, will cost Rs. 75 Crores and is targeted for completion in the 4th Quarter of 2026-27. Modernization and expansion projects include a knitted fabric facility in Arasur, Coimbatore, to produce 15,000 MT per annum for Rs. 90 Crores, and another in Neelambur, Coimbatore, to produce 20,000 MT per annum for Rs. 100 Crores, both expected by the 3rd and 4th Quarters of 2026-27, respectively. Two spinning mill units at Karumathampatti are also undergoing modernization and expansion, costing Rs. 85 Crores and Rs. 175 Crores, with completion expected in the 3rd and 4th Quarters of 2026-27. The entire capital expenditure will be funded through internal accruals.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Jash Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Corporate Announcement'.
announcements.ai_summary: Jash Engineering Limited has announced significant operational expansions and order book updates as of August 1, 2026. The company has successfully commissioned a major expansion at its Unit 1 foundry, increasing casting production capacity by 50%, and has also expanded its cast gate and cast valve manufacturing capacity by over 30%, both completed in July 2026. Furthermore, Jash Engineering has received all necessary approvals from Saudi authorities, enabling them to proceed with applying for land for their proposed Saudi plant. In July 2026, the company secured consolidated orders worth Rs. 75 Cr, with Rs. 34 Cr from the Indian market and Rs. 41 Cr from international markets. As of August 1, 2026, the consolidated order book stands at Rs. 932 Cr, comprising Rs. 293 Cr for the Indian market and Rs. 639 Cr for international markets, with Rs. 369 Cr specifically for the USA. announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: M & B Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: M & B Engineering Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 10, 2026, approved a brownfield expansion project for heavy structural steel. This project will add 10,000 MTPA to the existing capacity of 12,000 TPA at their Sanand plant, specifically for the Phenix Division. The company expects to commission this new capacity by the first quarter of FY28. The investment required for this expansion is approximately Rs. 30 Crores, which will be financed through a term loan and internal accruals. This expansion is driven by the growing opportunities in India's data center and high-rise construction sectors, which increasingly utilize steel for faster project execution and structural strength.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Man Infraconstruction Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, titled  MICL group launches Marina Vista at Pali Hill, Bandra (West), Mumbai, achieves 30% Pre-Sales commitment at launch."
announcements.ai_summary: Man Infraconstruction Limited ("MICL Group") has launched its ultra-luxury residential project, Marina Vista, located at Pali Hill in Bandra (West), Mumbai. The project has achieved a 30% pre-sales commitment at launch, reflecting strong demand for the Bandra (West) micro-market. Marina Vista has an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of over Rs. 500 crores. The company received its RERA registration for this project in June 2026. MICL Group intends to maintain this strong sales momentum going forward, attributing the homebuyers' confidence to the trust placed in the MICL brand.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bajel Projects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Bajel Projects Limited has secured two significant EPC orders from Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID) under the Western Region–Eastern Region (WR-ER) Inter-Regional Network Expansion Scheme. The first order, TL06, is for transmission line packages associated with the "WR -ER Inter-Regional Network Expansion Scheme – Part A" and qualifies as a Mega order. The second order, TL02, also part of the same scheme, is for a 765kV D/C Line, Part-II, and qualifies as an Ultra-Mega order. The scope of TL06 includes the design, supply, erection, testing, and commissioning of new 400kV double-circuit transmission lines connecting Jamshedpur (New) with Ranchi (New) and New PPSP. The scope of TL02 covers the construction of a new 765kV double-circuit transmission line from Raigarh (Tamnar) to Jamshedpur (New), Part-II. Together, these orders, valued at INR 400 Cr+ for TL06 and INR 300Cr+ for TL02, will reinforce inter-regional power evacuation capacity between the Western and Eastern Regions, strengthening grid connectivity across Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand.

These target companies collectively possess an operational renewable power capacity of approximately 1.4 GWp, with ReNew Hans Urja Private Limited having 810 MWp and ReNew Solar Photovoltaic Private Limited having 506.25 MWp. Upon completion, these entities will become step-down subsidiaries of CESC Limited. The acquisition is from ReNew Solar Power Private Limited. Further details regarding the transaction are provided in Annexure-A and a press release is enclosed.

announcements.detail: Man Infraconstruction Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, titled  MICL group secures IOA for ultra-luxury sea-view development with ₹ 1,000+ crore GDV off Bandstand, Bandra West, Mumbai."
announcements.ai_summary: Man Infraconstruction Limited (MICL Group) has announced securing an Intimation of Approval (IOA) for its ultra-luxury sea-view residential development located off Bandstand, Bandra West, Mumbai. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: T T Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, titled "Submission of Press Note".
announcements.ai_summary: On August 10, 2026, T T Limited issued a press release detailing its strategic growth roadmap and financial performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported Revenue from Operations of Rs. 46.42 crore and Profit Before Tax (PBT) of Rs. 25.90 lakh. Profitability was impacted by a 15-20% increase in cotton and polyester yarn prices, a 70-80% rise in packaging material costs, higher labor and operating costs due to inflation, increased freight costs, and supply chain disruptions from the Middle East conflict. Despite these challenges, T T Limited is set to double its stitching capacity at its Howrah garment facility to approximately 300 machines over the next three months. The company is also focusing on developing new business relationships and onboarding large-scale institutional and retail customers, including successfully adding D’Mart during the quarter.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Paisalo Digital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 10, 2026, titled "Paisalo Digital s Business Correspondent Ecosystem surpasses USD 1 Billion in Gross Transaction Value".
announcements.ai_summary: Paisalo Digital Limited announced on August 10, 2026, that its Business Correspondent (BC) ecosystem has surpassed USD 1 Billion in Gross Transaction Value (GTV). This significant milestone highlights the increasing scale and strategic importance of Paisalo's BC channel, which plays a crucial role in expanding access to formal financial services for underserved borrowers. The company has developed an extensive technology-enabled financial inclusion platform, combining physical distribution, bank partnerships, and digital infrastructure. As of Q1FY27, Paisalo's network includes 5,995 touchpoints across 23 states, supported by 1,574 Business Correspondents and partnerships with public sector banks like State Bank of India, Bank of India, and Indian Overseas Bank. This achievement validates the BC channel as a scalable last-mile distribution engine and strengthens the company's low-cost customer acquisition strategy.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding operations update for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026 dated April 10, 2026, titled "Ajmera Realty scales new heights with INR 1,701 Cr pre-sales; beats FY26 guidance and clocks highest ever annual collections".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited announced its operational update for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, with pre-sales reaching INR 1,701 crore, exceeding the FY26 guidance and marking the highest ever annual collections. The company achieved sales area of 6,60,246 sq. ft, up 11% YoY, and collections of INR 1,103 crore, up 71% YoY. Ajmera Realty launched four projects in FY26, aggregating an estimated GDV of INR 3,088 crore, with strong buyer interest in its flagship developments. This announcement was made on April 10, 2026.

announcements.subject: Product launch
announcements.detail: Park Medi World Limited has informed the Exchange about launch of Hospital in Panchkula
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Park Medi World Limited has announced the successful launch of its new multi-super specialty hospital in Panchkula on April 10, 2026. This expansion aims to address the growing demand for advanced healthcare services in Haryana, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, and Chandigarh, reducing the need for patients to travel to metropolitan areas for specialized treatments. The new facility is equipped with advanced diagnostics, modular operation theatres, and critical care infrastructure, offering comprehensive care across specialties like oncology, neurosciences, orthopedics, and cardiology, including robotic-assisted procedures. The hospital is designed with a significant proportion of beds dedicated to high-acuity critical care services. This launch, combined with the ongoing expansion of its Mohali facility, will bring the Group's total bed capacity in the Tricity region to approximately 850 beds, strengthening its integrated healthcare ecosystem in North India.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Vidya Wires Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Vidya Wires Limited has announced that its Managing Director, Mr. Shailesh Rathi, is scheduled to participate in a TV interview with Zee Business. The interview is planned for Wednesday, May 13, 2026, at 10:35 AM. The company has clarified that no unpublished price-sensitive information (UPSI) is intended to be discussed during this interview. announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities
announcements.detail: Lenskart Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding grant of stock options pursuant to approval of Nomination and Remuneration Committee
announcements.ai_summary: Lenskart Solutions Limited's Nomination and Remuneration Committee, through a circular resolution passed on May 8, 2026, approved the grant of 347,000 Employee Stock Options under the Lenskart Employee Stock Option Plan, 2021. These options are for eligible employees of the company, its group companies, subsidiaries, or associate companies, both in India and outside India. Each option is convertible into one equity share of the company, with a face value of INR 2 each. The exercise price for these options is set at INR 389 per share, calculated as the average closing price for 30 days prior to the grant, with a maximum discount of 25% on such price. The details of the grant are in accordance with SEBI (SBEB) Regulations, 2021.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Lenskart Solutions Limited ("the Company") has informed the Exchange about the acquisition of shareholding in Quantduo Technologies Private Limited ("Quantduo"), resulting in Quantduo becoming wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Oberoi Realty Limited has informed the Exchange about investment in share capital of wholly owned subsidiary
announcements.ai_summary: Oberoi Realty Limited has invested Rs. 268.50 Crore on June 9, 2026, to subscribe to further shares of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Centerstage Realty Private Limited. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Jagran Prakashan Limited has informed the Exchange about disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations
announcements.ai_summary: Jagran Prakashan Limited has informed the exchange about a new application filed in a company petition pending before the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Allahabad. announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Sanginita Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 09, 2026 for Allotment of 1,52,87,356 Equity Shares for consideration other than cash on a Preferential Basis.
announcements.ai_summary: Sanginita Chemicals Limited's Board of Directors met on June 9, 2026, and approved the allotment of 1,52,87,356 fully paid-up equity shares. Post-allotment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased from Rs. 25,90,15,500/- to Rs. 41,18,89,060/-, representing an increase from 2,59,01,550 equity shares to 4,11,88,906 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Welspun Corp Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates- Sale of 4.5% equity stake in East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry by the Company s Wholly owned subsidiary Welspun Mauritius Holdings Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Welspun Corp Limited has informed the Exchange about the divestment of a 4.5% equity stake in its subsidiary, East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry (EPIC), located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This sale was executed by Welspun Mauritius Holdings Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Welspun Corp Limited, through negotiated trades on the Tadawul Stock Exchange on June 9, 2026. The aggregate consideration received for this divestment is SAR 283.46 million (approximately US$ 75.59 million). Following this sale, Welspun Pipes Inc., USA, another wholly-owned subsidiary, will continue to hold a 22% equity stake in EPIC. The total income of EPIC for the financial year ending March 31, 2026, was SAR 2,298 million, with a profit before tax of SAR 621 million and a net worth of SAR 1,564 million.

announcements.subject: Voluntary Delisting
announcements.detail: Hitech Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Voluntary Delisting
announcements.ai_summary: Hitech Corporation Limited has announced its intention to voluntarily delist its equity shares from the BSE and NSE. This proposal is being made by Geetanjali Trading and Investments Private Limited, a member of the promoter group, along with other promoters and members of the promoter group. The Acquirer has expressed its intention to acquire all equity shares held by public shareholders. The Floor Price for this delisting proposal has been set at Rs. 252/- per equity share, while the Indicative Offer Price is Rs. 353/- per equity share. The Board of Directors, in its meeting on June 9, 2026, has taken on record the due diligence report and the share capital audit report, both dated June 9, 2026, as required by SEBI Delisting Regulations.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Anupam Rasayan India Limited has informed the Exchange about Draft Letter of Offer filed by the Manager to the Offer with SEBI yesterday, relating to the mandatory open offer by our Company to the public shareholders of Bliss GVS Pharma Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Anupam Rasayan India Limited has announced that the Manager to the Offer, SBI Capital Markets Limited, filed the Draft Letter of Offer with SEBI on June 8, 2026. The open offer is being made in accordance with Regulation 3(1) read with Regulation 4 of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. A copy of the Draft Letter of Offer is enclosed and will also be hosted on the company's website.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bliss GVS Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Submission Of Draft Letter Of Offer In Relation To The Open Offer Made To The Public Shareholders Of Bliss GVS Pharma Limited Under The SEBI (Substantial Acquisition Of Shares And Takeovers) Regulations, 2011

announcements.subject: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
announcements.detail: Parv Jain has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) 01 SESI (Substantial Acguisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011
announcements.ai_summary: Parv Jain has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This filing indicates a potential change in shareholding or control concerning Magnum Ventures Limited. Investors should review the detailed disclosure to understand the specific transaction, which could involve the acquisition or disposal of shares. The implications of this disclosure on the company's stock performance will depend on the nature and scale of the reported transaction.

announcements.ai_summary: Nitiraj Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the outcome of its Board Meeting held on June 09, 2026. Specific details of the outcomes are not provided in the announcement.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bonlon Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Bonlon Industries Limited has received 'in-principle' approvals from both BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited for the listing of 22,00,000 equity shares. These shares, with a face value of Rs. 10 each, were allotted at a premium of Rs. 23 each, resulting in a total issue price of Rs. 33 per equity share. The shares were allotted to M/s Bon Lon Securities Limited and M/s Harshit Finvest Private Limited, both of which are members of the promoter group. The listing and admission to dealings on the exchanges will occur upon confirmation from NSDL/CDSL for the credit of these shares to the beneficiaries' accounts.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 09, 2026, titled "Press Release in connection with the execution of Term Sheet for the acquisition 100% stake in Winwin Speciality Insulators Limited".
announcements.ai_summary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited has entered into a Term Sheet for the proposed acquisition of 100% stake in Winwin Speciality Insulators Limited. This strategic acquisition will add capabilities in manufacturing high-voltage ceramic insulators up to 1200 kV and polymeric insulators up to 400kV, along with a heritage brand established in 1961. The transaction includes a state-of-the-art automated production facility on a 47.7-acre land parcel with port access in Visakhapatnam SEZ. The enterprise value for this proposed transaction is approximately INR 315 Crores. Further details will be provided upon execution of definitive agreements, completion of due diligence, and legal review.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Hinduja Global Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 09, 2026, titled "Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Shri. Yogi Adityanath flags off Project GANGA initiativein association with HGS s broadband vertical to connect 20 lakh households".
announcements.ai_summary: Hinduja Global Solutions Limited has announced the flagging off of Project GANGA by the Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister, Shri. Yogi Adityanath, on June 9, 2026. This initiative, in association with HGS's broadband vertical, OneOTT Intertainment Limited (OIL), aims to connect over 20 lakh households with high-speed broadband across Uttar Pradesh within the next 2-3 years. Project GANGA is a large-scale digital inclusion and social upliftment initiative that will develop up to 10,000 local entrepreneurs as Digital Service Providers (DSPs) and is expected to generate over 100,000 employment opportunities, with a focus on women. This project follows an MOU signed in March 2026 between the State Transformation Commission of Uttar Pradesh and OIL.

announcements.ai_summary: BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Limited has approved the allotment of 40,843 equity shares of Rs. 1/- each to eligible employees upon the exercise of vested options under the Bluestone Jewellery and Lifestyle Limited – Employee Stock Option Plan 2014. announcements.ai_summary: Onward Technologies Limited has made a Post Buyback Public Announcement regarding its buyback of up to 5,48,780 equity shares. announcements.subject: Monthly Business Updates

Additionally, the company has reported molasses production and own consumption/sales in MTs, as well as power generated, captive consumption, and export to the grid in Lakh Units for its cogeneration facilities. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Execution of Binding Term Sheet amongst Dixon Technologies (India) Limited, Gemtek Technology Co., Ltd., and Dixon Electroconnect Private Limited for setting up of a Joint Venture arrangement.
announcements.ai_summary: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited, along with Gemtek Technology Co., Ltd. and its wholly-owned subsidiary Dixon Electroconnect Private Limited, has entered into a binding term sheet on June 9, 2026, to establish a joint venture. This venture will focus on manufacturing and supplying Optical Transceiver - SFP and BOSA, or other mutually agreed telecom products in India. Upon completion, Dixon Technologies will hold 60% of the total paid-up share capital of Dixon Electroconnect, while Gemtek Technology will hold the remaining 40%. The consummation of this proposed transaction is contingent upon the signing of definitive agreements, fulfillment of customary conditions precedent, and obtaining any necessary statutory and regulatory approvals.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Maral Overseas Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR, 2015'.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Maral Overseas Limited is consolidating its garment unit operations. The unit at D-347, Sector-63, Noida will be merged with the existing operations at A-37, Sector-64, Noida by August 31, 2026. This consolidation aims to improve operational efficiencies and optimize resource utilization. Assets, inventories, and business activities from the D-347 unit will be transferred to the A-37 unit. Consequently, a lease termination notice for the D-347 unit has been issued, with the lease expiring by August 31, 2026. This is an internal operational realignment within the Garment Division and is not expected to impact the company's overall business operations.

announcements.subject: Sale or disposal
announcements.detail: CARYSIL LIMITED has informed the Exchange about voluntary dissolution of a Company
announcements.ai_summary: Carysil Limited has announced the voluntary strike-off and dissolution of its wholly owned step-down subsidiary in the United Kingdom, Carysil Brassware Limited. This dissolution is effective from June 9, 2026, in accordance with the UK Companies Act, 2006. Consequently, Carysil Brassware Limited has ceased to be a subsidiary of Carysil Limited. For the financial year ending March 2026, Carysil Brassware Limited contributed Nil to the consolidated turnover and Nil to the net worth of Carysil Limited. The dissolution was a voluntary process, and no sale agreement or consideration was involved.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: JSW Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Infrastructure Limited has received a Letter of Award (LOA) from Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Authority, Kolkata, for the Integrated Development of Outer Container Terminal & Berth no. 1 through 5 at Netaji Subhash Dock. This project, awarded on a Design Build Finance Operate Transfer (DBFOT) basis through a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) mode, involves constructing two new outer container handling berths and taking over five existing berths. The combined capacity of these berths will be 0.93 million TEUs, equivalent to 13 million tonnes per annum, for handling containers and multipurpose cargo. The concession agreement will be valid for a period of 30 years from the date of award. The company was notified of this award on June 8, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Jaykay Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 Certifications by JK Digital & Advance Systems Private Limited, WOS of Jaykay Enterprises Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Jaykay Enterprises Limited has announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, JK Digital & Advance Systems Private Limited, has received two significant certifications: ISO 14001:2015 for Environmental Management System and ISO 45001:2018 for Occupational Health & Safety Management System. These certifications were awarded by BSCIC Certifications Private Limited for the scope of "Manufacture and Sale of Additive Manufactured Sterile Revision Surgery Hip Implants, Augments, Spinal Implants and Patient Specific Implants." The receipt of these ISO certifications validates Jaykay Enterprises Limited's focus on Additive Manufacturing technology and marks a milestone for JK Digital's Medical Implants business, demonstrating compliance with internationally recognized standards. These new certifications complement the previously obtained ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 9001:2015 certifications.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts

This project will be executed on an Engineering Procurement Construction (EPC) / Turnkey Basis in the state of Telangana. The total value of the contract is Rs. 235,07,01,000/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Thirty-Five Crores Seven Lakhs One Thousand Only), excluding GST. The construction period for this project is stipulated to be 24 months.

announcements.subject: General Updates

announcements.ai_summary: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has received in-principle approvals from both the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and BSE Limited for the listing of equity shares. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Adani Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Signing the Securities Purchase and Subscription Agreement for Acquisition of 100% Equity Shares of Intellismart Infrastructure Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Limited has signed a Securities Purchase and Subscription Agreement (SPSA) on June 9, 2026, to acquire 100% of the equity share capital of Intellismart Infrastructure Private Limited. The agreement was signed with National Investment and Infrastructure Fund, Energy Efficiency Services Limited, and Intellismart Infrastructure Private Limited. announcements.detail: Taj GVK Hotels & Resorts Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 09, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Taj GVK Hotels & Resorts Limited is set to open its new luxury hotel, Taj Yelahanka, in Bengaluru by September 2026, subject to requisite approvals. This 256-key hotel, located in North Bengaluru, is expected to commence operations in the coming months. The property is strategically positioned to benefit from the strong demand for corporate travel, MICE activities, and growing leisure traffic in Bengaluru. The company also holds an adjacent 4-acre land parcel that may be developed as part of Phase II, potentially making the entire project a significant landmark in the Yelahanka micro-market. announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Vodafone Idea Limited has informed regarding Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015 regarding Update on material litigation
announcements.ai_summary: Vodafone Idea Limited has received a significant update regarding a material litigation concerning One Time Spectrum Charges (OTSC). On June 8, 2026, the Hon'ble Bombay High Court quashed demand notices issued by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) for OTSC amounting to Rs. 2,113 crores, which were levied on the company (erstwhile Idea Cellular Limited) and erstwhile Spice Communications Limited. The court also ordered the return of bank guarantees previously provided to the DoT. This litigation pertains to spectrum charges for the period from July 1, 2008, to December 31, 2012, and from January 1, 2013, onwards. The company had challenged these demands, arguing they altered the financial terms of their licenses. The DoT had previously revised these demands to Rs. 3,322 crores during the merger of Vodafone India Ltd. and Vodafone Mobile Services Ltd. with Idea Cellular Limited in 2018.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: JSW Steel Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 09, 2026, titled "JSW Steel reports Consolidated Crude Steel Production of 22.93 Lakh Tonnes for May 26".
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Steel Limited has announced its consolidated crude steel production for May 2026, reaching 22.93 Lakh tonnes, a 15% year-on-year growth. This increase was driven by the full operational status of the Dolvi unit and the ramp-up of JVML operations, as one blast furnace at the Vijayanagar plant was under planned maintenance in May 2025. The steel business undertaking of Bhushan Power and Steel Limited (BPSL), a subsidiary, was transferred to JSW-JFE Steel Limited in March 2026, and its production figures have been adjusted for comparative purposes. Blast Furnace 3 at Vijayanagar is currently undergoing a capacity upgrade shutdown, expected to restart in the latter half of June 2026. Indian operations achieved a capacity utilization of approximately 98% excluding the shutdown BF3, and 87% including it. JSW Steel, the flagship of the US$23 billion JSW Group, aims to increase its combined crude steel capacity to 54.8 MTPA over the next four years.

This strategic move aims to address challenges faced by rural and community hospitals by developing an intelligent healthcare operating system. The combined organization will support over 2,000 healthcare organizations and 150,000 clinicians across the U.S., with continued support and investment in existing products and future innovation.

This appointment is to provide Investor Relations Advisory Services to the company. All future communications concerning investors and stakeholders should be directed to this email address.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Premier Energies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 09, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Premier Energies Limited has announced the inauguration of its new 5.6 GW solar module manufacturing facility at Seetharampur, Telangana, on July 09, 2026. The facility features advanced G12R TOPCon module manufacturing lines, India's first Zero Bus Bar manufacturing unit, AGV-enabled material movement, and AI-powered quality inspection systems, capable of producing one solar module every four seconds. Concurrently, the company performed a groundbreaking ceremony for its 6 GWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) facility and an 18,000 metric tonnes per annum aluminium frames facility. These expansions increase Premier Energies' total module manufacturing capacity to 11.1 GW, aiming to strengthen its domestic and international market presence and contribute to India's self-reliant clean-energy ecosystem. The new Seetharampur campus spans 75 acres.

The Certificate of Incorporation was received on July 9, 2026. Solar SA Investments (Pty) Ltd is an Investment Holding Company and is a step-down subsidiary of Solar Industries India Limited. The initial capital subscription was in cash amounting to ZAR 12,000, with Solar Industries India Limited holding 100% shareholding.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Proventus Agrocom Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 09, 2026, titled "Press release on operational readiness of Phase 1 of its state-of-the-art manufacturing facility at Surat, Gujarat".
announcements.ai_summary: Proventus Agrocom Limited has announced the operational readiness of Phase 1 of its state-of-the-art manufacturing facility located in Surat, Gujarat. This development is a significant step in the company's manufacturing expansion strategy and aims to build a scalable and integrated manufacturing platform for its brand, ProV. The Surat facility, spanning approximately 2,00,000 sq. ft., is equipped with advanced processing, packaging, and automation technologies. This expansion is expected to increase the aggregate pouch manufacturing capacity from the current 1.5 lakh pouches per day to over 4 lakh pouches per day by the end of FY27, a more than 2.5x increase. Additionally, the Bihar processing facility is being expanded to a targeted capacity of 2,500 tonnes per annum over the next three years.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 09, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Limited, in their meeting held on July 09, 2026, approved the appointment of Mr. Narasimha Raju K.A. as the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the Company, effective from July 09, 2026. Mr. Narasimha Raju K.A. is a Chartered Accountant with over 20 years of experience in finance, accounting, corporate governance, and strategic leadership. He previously served as the CFO of the Company from March 15, 2021, to March 26, 2025, and has experience in IPOs, investor relations, and mergers and acquisitions.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: TechD Cybersecurity Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Subject: Intimation of Nationwide Roadshow of the  TECHD ONE  Platform in association with Enterprise IT World CIO500 Conference & Awards 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: TechD Cybersecurity Limited is undertaking a nationwide roadshow for its "TECHD ONE" platform, an AI-native unified platform for Security, Compliance & Privacy. This roadshow is being conducted in association with the Enterprise IT World CIO500 Conference & Awards 2026, commencing on July 10, 2026, in Chennai and concluding on September 25, 2026, in Delhi. The roadshow series is expected to be attended by over 1,500 CIOs and CISOs from various sectors across India. The company is showcasing its platform's capabilities, including attack surface monitoring and OT/ICS security.

announcements.company: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited
announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 09, 2026, titled "GE Shipping takes delivery of 2015 built Long Range 2 Tanker  Jag Laxman ".
announcements.ai_summary: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited (GE Shipping) has announced the delivery of a 2015-built Long Range 2 Tanker named "Jag Laxman," with a deadweight tonnage (dwt) of approximately 109,990. The company had contracted to purchase this vessel in Q1 FY27, and the transaction has been financed entirely from internal accruals. Following this acquisition, GE Shipping's owned fleet now comprises 41 vessels, including 26 Tankers and 15 Dry Bulk Carriers, aggregating 3.35 million dwt. The company also noted that it has contracted to sell one secondhand Long Range 2 Product Tanker, with the sale expected to be completed in Q2 FY27.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Pace Digitek Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 09, 2026, titled "Press Release dated July 09, 2026, for entering into an entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with M/s. Onward Solar Power Private Limited and M/s. Kalpa Power Private Limited".

Under these agreements, LPPL will serve as a preferred BESS supply partner, providing integrated BESS solutions including DC Blocks, Power Conversion Systems (PCS), and Energy Management Systems (EMS). The collaborations aim to strengthen product supply partnerships and accelerate the deployment of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across India. Definitive agreements and purchase orders will govern project-specific commercial terms.

announcements.ai_summary: Rajputana Industries Limited has announced an increase in its installed manufacturing capacity at its facility in Reengus, Rajasthan. This revision is based on a certification by an Independent Chartered Engineer after physical verification and review of production records. The revised yearly installed capacities are: 5,800 MT for Aluminium Winding Wire & Strips, Ingots and Rods; 4,300 MT for Copper Winding Wire/Strips, Billets, Ingots, Rods and Mother Tubes; 5,600 MT for Brass Rods, Wire, Mother Tube, Billets and Ingots; 2,400 MT for Nickel Iron Based Alloys; and 36,000 KM for Electric Cable and Conductor. The company petitions, "Mahendra Mohan Gupta and Ors. v. Devendra Mohan Gupta and Ors., C.P. No. 64 of 2023" and "Shailendra Mohan Gupta and Ors. v. Jagran Media Network Investment Private Limited, C.P. No. 57 of 2025," were listed on June 1, 2026. During the June 1st hearing, arguments were heard for C.P. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: AWL Agri Business Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 09, 2026, titled "Press Release Titled "AWL Agri Business Limited backs expansion of regenerative Mustard Programme after demonstration farms delivers up to 30% higher yields".".
announcements.ai_summary: AWL Agri Business Limited announced on July 9, 2026, the successful results of the Solvent Extractors' Association of India’s (SEA) Regenerative Mustard Model Farm Programme, which delivered mustard yield improvements of up to 30 per cent in the 2025–26 Rabi season. The first phase covered 3,000 demonstration plots across Rajasthan, Haryana, and Madhya Pradesh, with AWL Agri Business Limited as the lead sponsor, partnering with Bunge India, Louis Dreyfus India, Godrej Agrovet, VVF India, JR Agro Industries, Arihant Solvex, and Solidaridad Network Asia as the implementation partner. The programme will expand during 2026–27 to include over 400 groundnut and soybean model farms and more than 3,000 regenerative mustard model farms across three states. This initiative aims to strengthen India's edible oil value chain and enhance farmer livelihoods, addressing the nation's 55–60 per cent edible oil import dependency.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Jindal Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 09, 2026, titled "Jindal Stainless  Hisar and Jajpur units win multiple CII National Awards for energy efficiency and low-carbon initiatives".
announcements.ai_summary: Jindal Stainless Limited announced on July 9, 2026, that its Hisar and Jajpur manufacturing units received multiple honours at the 10th CII National Energy Efficiency Circle Competition 2026, held in New Delhi on July 2-3. The Hisar unit won the National Award for Best Energy Efficient Case Study and the National Award for Best Case Study on Low Carbon/Carbon Neutral Initiative, having implemented 112 energy efficiency projects over four years, resulting in a 584,903 tCO₂e greenhouse gas emission reduction. The Jajpur unit was recognized under the BEE PAT/CCTS Scheme and for Effective Implementation of ISO 50001 Energy Management System, with over 100 energy conservation projects leading to a cumulative carbon emission reduction of over 471,398 tCO₂e. Overall, the company implemented over 200 energy efficiency projects over the last four years, achieving a cumulative emissions reduction of over 1.05 million tCO₂e.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 09, 2026, titled "Press Release dated 09th July, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited announced its financial results for the quarter ending June 2026 (Q1 FY27) in a press release dated July 9, 2026. The company reported a consolidated Profit After Tax of ₹116 crore, marking a 24% year-on-year growth. Total revenue for the quarter increased by 18% to ₹336 crore, and Assets Under Management (AUM) grew by 21% year-on-year to ₹1,06,300 crore. Profit Before Tax also saw a 24% increase to ₹156 crore. The company also highlighted crossing the ₹1 lakh crore AUM milestone and a 16% year-on-year increase in Mutual Fund Distribution Revenue to ₹132 crore.

announcements.ai_summary: Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR) has entered into a long-term agreement with GAIL (India) Ltd. to establish a state-of-the-art Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) dispensing station at CONCOR's Inland Container Depot (ICD) in Khodiyar, Ahmedabad. announcements.ai_summary: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Limited has issued a press release regarding an update on Semalix Injection Disposable Pens. As a precautionary measure, the company is implementing a voluntary recall for select batches of Semalix injection disposable pens. This action is in response to a product recall notification from its manufacturer, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. (DRL), for a technical evaluation. Torrent Pharmaceuticals has emphasized that patient safety is paramount and there is no risk to patients currently on this treatment. All other SKUs of Semaglutide sold by Torrent, including the oral formulation, remain unaffected.

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: TTK Prestige Limited has informed the Exchange about Disruption of Operations at our Roorkee plant due to natural calamity (Floods)
announcements.ai_summary: TTK Prestige Limited has reported a disruption of operations at its manufacturing unit in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, due to heavy rains and flooding on July 9, 2026. The company is currently assessing potential damage to its assets, but has clarified that all assets are adequately insured. TTK Prestige Limited does not anticipate any material impact on its overall operations due to sufficient manufacturing capacities at its other locations. The company will continue to monitor the situation and provide updates on the resumption of production.

announcements.ai_summary: HCLFoundation, the corporate social responsibility arm of HCLTech, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Urban Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh, to advance sustainable waste management practices in Hardoi, Prayagraj, and Agra. The initiative includes the donation of E-drain carts and E-garbage loaders to Hardoi Nagar Palika Parishad, and the unveiling of three reverse vending machines. announcements.detail: Havells India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 09, 2026, titled "Havells Enters Battery Energy Storage Segment Through Strategic Collaboration with Pixii AS".
announcements.ai_summary: Havells India Limited has announced a strategic collaboration with Pixii AS, a Norway-based energy storage technology company, to develop and introduce advanced Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) for the Indian market. This collaboration aims to combine Havells' manufacturing capabilities and market understanding with Pixii's energy storage technology to provide reliable and efficient solutions for the clean energy transition. The companies will work through a phased roadmap, including pilot installations, co-development of solutions, and eventually local manufacturing in India. The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed in the presence of the Ambassador of Norway to India.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 9, 2026, titled "TCS begins FY27 with continued growth; wins multiple AI transformation deals".
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has reported its financial results for the quarter ending June 30, 2026, indicating continued growth and success in securing AI transformation deals. The company's Q1 FY27 revenue stood at ₹72,275 crore, showing a 2.2% quarter-on-quarter and 13.9% year-on-year growth in INR, with a 0.4% QoQ growth in constant currency. Annualized AI revenue reached US$ 2.6 billion in Q1FY27, a 13.6% increase QoQ. The operating margin was 24.0%, and the net margin was 19.2%. TCS secured a total contract value (TCV) of US$ 9.5 billion in Q1, including a significant US$ 800 million mega deal with SKF and multi-million dollar agreements with ServiceNow and a Europe-based Fortune Global 500 company. The company declared a dividend of ₹12 per share, with a record date of July 15, 2026, and a payment date of July 31, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: United Drilling Tools Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 09, 2026, titled "Repeat Export Order".
announcements.ai_summary: United Drilling Tools Limited (UDTL) has announced receiving a repeat export order from M/s Trident East Limited, Russia, for the supply of PUMA Connectors and accessories. This order follows the successful execution and performance evaluation of UDTL's initial trial order and signifies a substantial increase in quantity, reflecting the customer's confidence in UDTL's capabilities. This repeat order is a significant milestone, validating the performance of UDTL's specialized connectors in demanding conditions and marking a transition to a commercial supply relationship. UDTL is the only manufacturer in India capable of producing these highly specialized connectors for critical oil and gas applications. The company anticipates this order will foster a long-term strategic partnership with Trident East Limited and open opportunities in the Russian and other international markets.

Certain proposed allottees were found ineligible under SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, and have been removed. The Board has proposed replacing them with new allottees, subject to shareholder approval at the Extra-Ordinary General Meeting (EGM) scheduled for July 17, 2026. The company also approved a Corrigendum to the EGM Notice to incorporate observations from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The revised list includes Desai Ajaykumar Havabhai being replaced by Arti Manish Kheradi for 40,000 equity shares, Bhupendra Damjibhai Jivani being replaced by Jivani Jay Bhupendrbhai for 40,000 equity shares, and Dhara Mehta being replaced by Agam Vikramkumar Mehta for 2,80,000 warrants.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Press Release - THE LEELA UNVEILS THE LEELA COORG FOREST SANCTUARY
announcements.ai_summary: The Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Limited has announced the unveiling of "The Leela Coorg Forest Sanctuary," the new identity for its recently acquired retreat in Coorg. This reimagined identity emphasizes the property's unique setting amidst 76 acres of ancient forests and coffee plantations within the Western Ghats. The rebranding aligns with The Leela's vision of creating luxury destinations deeply rooted in their local surroundings. This addition to their portfolio highlights immersive, nature-led experiences, where the forest itself is a defining element of the guest experience, offering a connection with nature through thoughtful luxury and authentic Indian hospitality.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 09, 2026, titled "Solex Energy Bags Rupees 628.37 Crore Work Order for N-Type TOPCon Solar Modules".
announcements.ai_summary: Solex Energy Limited has announced securing a significant work order worth ₹628.37 crore for N-Type TOPCon Solar Modules. The contract includes the supply of N-Type TOPCon G12R Glass-to-Glass Solar PV Modules rated at 615 Wp and 620 Wp. This order reinforces Solex Energy's position as a manufacturing partner for large-scale renewable energy projects. The company manufactures its solar modules at its facilities near Surat, Gujarat. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Clarification on certain media reports relating to project  Three Sixty North, Gurugram
announcements.ai_summary: Oberoi Realty Limited has issued a clarification regarding media reports about the 'Three Sixty North' project in Gurugram. The Punjab and Haryana High Court, in an order dated July 7, 2026, directed the Director, Town and Country Planning to decide a complaint filed by Advance India Projects Limited by July 20, 2026, or within two weeks thereafter on a day-to-day basis. The company intends to pursue necessary legal action.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: General Business Announcement about Associate company - Energy In Motion Limited (EIM) Signs 500 MWh Battery Pack Deal with Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL)
announcements.ai_summary: Ravindra Energy Limited has announced a significant development for its associate company, Energy In Motion Limited (EIM). EIM has signed a Letter of Agreement (LOA) with Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL), the world's largest battery manufacturer, for a supply partnership. Under this agreement, CATL will supply 0.5 GWh of its Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) cells, specifically the upgraded CB7T0 cell Model & L324D06 battery pack platform. These battery packs will be configured into 400.6 kWh systems for EIM's E-Tractor 4x2 Ashwa series, designed for heavy commercial vehicles. EIM will be the launch customer for this new generation of CATL battery systems in India, integrating them into swappable battery boxes customized for India's operating conditions. EIM is actively building an electric heavy commercial vehicle ecosystem, including megawatt-scale charging/swapping stations, with a target of 40 operational stations by the end of March 2027. CATL, with a market capitalization of approximately $280 billion USD, held a 39.2% share of the global power battery market in 2025.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Biocon Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 09, 2026, titled " Biocon Announces Publication of Pivotal Clinical Data Supporting Effectiveness of Yesafili , a Biosimilar to Eylea® (Aflibercept) ".
announcements.ai_summary: Biocon Limited has announced the publication of pivotal clinical data supporting the effectiveness of Yesafili™, a biosimilar to Eylea® (Aflibercept). The key findings, published in the British Journal of Ophthalmology and Expert Opinion on Biological Therapy, demonstrate that patients continuing on MYL-1701P or switching from reference aflibercept to MYL-1701P showed similar safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity outcomes through a 20-week extension. The studies also indicate comparable improvements in visual acuity and retinal thickness across diverse diabetic macular edema (DME) populations. MYL-1701P, developed by Biocon, was approved and granted interchangeable designation as Yesafili™ by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in May 2024. This publication marks a significant milestone as Biocon prepares for the upcoming launch of Yesafili™ in the United States.

announcements.subject: Strikes/Lockouts/Disturbances
announcements.detail: Antony Waste Handling Cell Limited has informed the Exchange about strikes/lockouts/disturbances
announcements.ai_summary: Antony Waste Handling Cell Limited has reported a serious incident at its Waste to Energy facility in Pimpri Chinchwad, Pune, Maharashtra. On July 8, 2026, a waste mound outside the facility destabilized due to exceptionally heavy rainfall and collapsed onto the administration building, causing structural damage. Emergency response measures were immediately initiated, with personnel from the Fire Brigade, NDRF, Indian Army, company officials, and PCMC officials present. Efforts are underway to ascertain the number of injured or affected individuals. The company's immediate priority is to support rescue and relief operations and provide assistance to the municipal corporation, local administration, and emergency agencies. Preliminary information suggests the incident was triggered by unprecedented weather conditions, and no immediate material impact on the company's operations is expected.

announcements.detail: Automotive Axles Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates regarding Karnataka State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB) w.r.t non-complianceunder the provisions of Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
announcements.ai_summary: Automotive Axles Limited received a notice dated July 30, 2026, from the Karnataka State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB) on August 4, 2026, concerning non-compliance with the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974. The notice cited exceeding prescribed standards for Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) treated water parameters at their Mysuru plant. The company was required to submit an action taken report within 7 days. Automotive Axles Limited responded on August 7, 2026, explaining the exceedance and detailing corrective measures, with subsequent STP Treated Water Analysis confirming all parameters were within the prescribed limits. The company has also reviewed and strengthened its internal communication mechanisms to ensure timely reporting of regulatory communications.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Datamatics Global Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 09, 2026, titled "Datamatics Launches TruAI Underwriting to Transform Insurance Underwriting with Agentic AI.".
announcements.ai_summary: Datamatics Global Services Limited has issued a press release on April 09, 2026, announcing the launch of "TruAI Underwriting." This new solution is an Agentic AI-based platform designed to significantly enhance and streamline the insurance underwriting process. TruAI Underwriting aims to assist insurers in assessing financial and medical risks with greater speed, consistency, and accuracy, particularly for complex, data-intensive cases. The solution ingests and analyzes data from various structured and unstructured sources, extracts relevant parameters, identifies risk indicators, and provides contextual recommendations to underwriters. It is designed to reduce underwriting turnaround time by up to 70%, lower costs by up to 50%, and improve accuracy by up to 25%. The final underwriting decision remains with the human underwriter, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.
