announcements.company: GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited
announcements.subject: Sale or disposal
announcements.detail: GMR Power And Urban Infra Limited has informed the Exchange about divestment of entire stake  of 26% held by the Company in Portus Ventures Private Limited, a Joint Venture of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited, along with Shree Naman Developers Private Limited, has entered into a share purchase agreement with Adani Airport City Limited for the sale of its entire 26% stake in Portus Ventures Private Limited. Portus Ventures Private Limited is a joint venture company involved in land development activities at Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Mumbai, and is currently in the pre-planning and construction phases. GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited is exiting this joint venture due to the majority shareholder's exit and to align with the GMR Group's strategic focus on identified real estate opportunities within its existing businesses. Consequently, Portus Ventures Private Limited will cease to be a joint venture of GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Fertilizers and Chemicals Travancore Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: The Ministry of Mines, Government of India, has appointed Shri. Anupam Misra, currently Director (Marketing) of The Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore Limited (FACT Ltd.), as the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL). This appointment will take effect from the date Shri. Misra assumes charge of the post on or after July 1, 2026, following his relief from FACT Ltd. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Fino Payments Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Business Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Fino Payments Bank Limited has provided a business performance update for May 2026, showing a 29% year-over-year increase in new deposit accounts opened, reaching approximately 2.9 lakh. Average total deposits grew by 10% year-over-year to around ₹2,762 crore, indicating strong deposit mobilization. Digitally active customers increased by 19% year-over-year to approximately 62.6 lakh, with FinoPay active customers growing by 22% to 7.2 lakh. Loan referral disbursals saw a significant increase of 186% year-over-year to ₹210 crore. However, transaction business throughput decreased by 48% to ₹2,546 crore, and B2B digital throughput was down 100% compared to May 2025, attributed to an ecosystem shift from cash to UPI and a focus on higher-quality merchants. The bank is reassessing key product features for digital payment services.

announcements.subject: Other Restructuring
announcements.detail: Persistent Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Other Restructuring
announcements.ai_summary: Persistent Systems Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 8, 2026, approved the transfer of 100% shareholding of Persistent Systems UK Limited from Persistent Systems Limited, India, to Aepona Group Limited, Ireland. This move is part of an internal restructuring initiative aimed at achieving entity rationalization and operational efficiency within the group. Following the execution of a Share Purchase Agreement, Persistent Systems UK Limited will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Aepona Group Limited, Ireland. There are no anticipated benefits to the promoter or promoter group from this restructuring, and the change in shareholding pattern pertains solely to the transfer of Persistent Systems UK Limited's shares.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'information pertaining to the unlisted insurance subsidiaries of the Company'.
announcements.ai_summary: Bajaj Finserv Limited has provided an update on its unlisted insurance subsidiaries, Bajaj General Insurance Limited and Bajaj Life Insurance Limited, regarding information submitted to the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) and the General/Life Insurance Councils. For Bajaj General Insurance Limited, the Gross Direct Premium underwritten for May 2026 was Rs. 1,343 crore, compared to Rs. 1,322 crore in May 2025, and Rs. 4,009 crore year-to-date May 2026, up from Rs. 3,725 crore in the same period of 2025. For Bajaj Life Insurance Limited, total new business for the month ended May 31, 2026, was Rs. 1,235.93 crore, a significant increase from Rs. 745.25 crore in the corresponding period of 2025. Year-to-date figures for Bajaj Life Insurance Limited show total new business of Rs. 2,172.93 crore up to May 31, 2026, compared to Rs. 1,464.62 crore up to May 31, 2025. This information is provisional and subject to a limited review by statutory auditors.

announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities
announcements.detail: Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange about allotment of fully paid-up equity shares pursuant to exercise of employee stock options un-der  Indiabulls Limited Employee Stock Option Scheme   2025 .
announcements.ai_summary: Indiabulls Limited has informed the stock exchanges about the allotment of 51,61,464 fully paid-up equity shares of face value INR 2/- each on June 8, 2026. These shares were issued to eligible employees upon the exercise of their vested employee stock options under the ‘Indiabulls Limited Employee Stock Option Scheme – 2025’. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased to Rs. 465,90,87,204, comprising 232,95,43,602 fully paid-up equity shares of face value Rs. 2/- each.

announcements.subject: Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we hereby inform the exchange that the Company has received an Order dated 5th June 2026 on 8th June 2026, passed by Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Chandigarh Bench, bearing Order No. CA(CAA) No. 11/Chd/Pb/2026, wherein the Hon'ble Tribunal approved the dispensation of the meeting of equity shareholders, secured and unsecured creditors of AmberPR Technoplast India Private Limited and Amber Enterprises India Limited and the First Motion Application has been allowed by the Hon'ble Tribunal and stands disposed of accordingly.
announcements.ai_summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has received an Order dated June 5, 2026, which was received on June 8, 2026, from the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Chandigarh Bench. The NCLT order, bearing reference CA(CAA) No. 11/Chd/Pb/2026, approves the dispensation of meetings for equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors of AmberPR Technoplast India Private Limited and Amber Enterprises India Limited. This order allows the First Motion Application, and it stands disposed of accordingly. This development is part of the Scheme of Amalgamation of AmberPR Technoplast India Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, with and into Amber Enterprises India Limited. The company will continue to keep the Stock Exchanges informed of further developments as per applicable laws.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: IFB Agro Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 30 of Listing Regulations'.
announcements.ai_summary: IFB Agro Industries Limited has submitted a representation to the Chief Secretary of the Government of West Bengal requesting an independent investigation into the alleged illegal interference by Excise authorities in the company's liquor business. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company will continue to keep the stock exchanges informed of any further developments on this matter, as it has done previously.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Panacea Biotec Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 08, 2026, titled "Launch of the DENSTAR project: advancing the licensure of a tetravalent liveattenuateddengue vaccine (DengiAll®) in sub-Saharan Africa and to facilitate its global access".
announcements.ai_summary: Panacea Biotec Limited has announced the launch of the DENSTAR project, aimed at advancing the licensure of its tetravalent live-attenuated dengue vaccine, DengiAll®, in sub-Saharan Africa and facilitating its global access. This four-year initiative is funded by the Global Health European & Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership 3 Joint Undertaking (GH EDCTP3 JU) and aligns with the EDCTP3 mission to combat neglected tropical diseases. The project, coordinated by the Sclavo Vaccines Association, involves a consortium of 10 partners from nine countries. Panacea Biotec, as the developer of DengiAll®, is a key partner in this public-private partnership focused on promoting broader and equitable access to dengue prevention tools.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Grasim Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors, at its meeting held today, i.e. 8th June 2026, has approved capex of Rs. 3,094 Crore to expand Lyocell, third-generation Cellulosic Staple Fibre (CSF), capacity at Harihar, Karnataka.
announcements.ai_summary: Grasim Industries Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 8, 2026, approved a capital expenditure of Rs. 3,094 Crore for the expansion of its Lyocell, a third-generation Cellulosic Staple Fibre (CSF), capacity at Harihar, Karnataka. This expansion is part of Phase II and will add 110,000 tonnes per annum (TPA) of Lyocell capacity, comprising two lines of 55,000 TPA each. The commissioning timeline for the first 55,000 TPA line is mid-2028, and the second line is expected by mid-2030. This new capacity addition, combined with Phase I, will bring the total Lyocell capacity at Harihar to 165,000 TPA. The investment will be financed through a mix of internal accruals and borrowed funds.

announcements.subject: Retirement
announcements.detail: Gokul Agro Resources Limited has informed the Exchange about Retirement
announcements.ai_summary: Gokul Agro Resources Limited has announced the completion of tenure for three Independent Directors: Mr. Keyoor Madhusudan Bakshi, Mr. Pankaj Mangharam Kotak, and Ms. Pooja Hemang Khakhi. These directors have concluded their second and final term on the Board of Directors, ceasing to hold office as of the close of business hours on June 8, 2026. Additionally, Mr. Pankaj Mangharam Kotak has also stepped down as a Director of Riya Internation Pte. Ltd., a material subsidiary of the company, effective the same date. The company has submitted letters from the respective directors confirming the completion of their tenures.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: IRB Infrastructure Developers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Project wise Toll Revenue for the month of May 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: IRB Infrastructure Developers Limited has reported its project-wise toll revenue for May 2026. The consolidated toll revenue for the IRB Group, which includes IRB Infrastructure Developers Ltd. and its sponsored InvITs, reached Rs. 8,427 million (Rs. 843 Crores) in May 2026. This represents a year-on-year increase of 25% compared to Rs. 6,725 million (Rs. 672 Crores) collected in May 2025. The disclosure includes toll revenue figures for various subsidiaries and entities, such as IRB MP Expressway Pvt Limited, IRB Ahmedabad Vadodara Super Express Tollway Private Limited, and CG Tollway Limited. Notably, several projects commenced toll collection in early 2026, contributing to the overall revenue.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Update on NCLT hearing - Resurgent India Special Situations Fund Vs Future Consumer Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Future Consumer Limited has provided an update on the NCLT hearing concerning the case filed by Resurgent India Special Situations Fund. Both counsels presented their arguments before the bench, focusing on the company's contention that it is not an NBFC and the limitation period for filing the company petition. After hearing the parties, the matter has been reserved for orders. The company will continue to provide further updates on this matter.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Rushil Decor Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Regularization of Commercial Operations' at RHPL Laminate Sheets Manufacturing Unit at Mansa, Gujarat.
announcements.ai_summary: Rushil Decor Limited has announced the successful commencement of regular commercial operations at its RHPL Laminate Sheets Manufacturing Unit located in Mansa, Gujarat. This follows a previous intimation on May 14, 2026, regarding a temporary shutdown for technological upgradation. The company is providing this update pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations for the information and record of the exchange.

announcements.subject: Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.detail: Touchwood Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange about Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.ai_summary: Touchwood Entertainment Limited, as the Lead Member of a Consortium with Hometown Properties Private Limited, has received a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Limited (DMRC). The LOA is for the property development on a 8,903.77 Sq. mtr. area land plot at Mohan Estate Metro Station of Line-6 of the Delhi Metro Network. Touchwood Entertainment Limited holds a 70% stake in the consortium, while Hometown Properties Private Limited holds 30%. The project will be executed as per the terms and conditions outlined in the Request for Proposal (RFP), LOA, and definitive agreements to be entered into with DMRC. This award is in the normal course of the company's business.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Shanti Gold International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 08, 2026, titled "Shanti Gold International Limited announces Commencement of Production at its new expanded manufacturing facility".
announcements.ai_summary: Shanti Gold International Limited has issued a press release on June 08, 2026, announcing the commencement of production at its newly expanded manufacturing facility. Located at Ground to 3rd Floor, Plot No. 1, Compartment No. 5, Concast House, Marol Co-operative Industrial Estate, Vasanji Road, Andheri East, Mumbai - 400059, the facility began operations on June 08, 2026. This expansion, previously announced on January 22, 2026, is projected to add approximately 4,000 kgs per annum to the company's manufacturing capacity. The facility is equipped with advanced machinery and infrastructure, aiming to enhance the company's ability to serve existing customers and pursue new partnerships in both Indian and international markets.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Shanti Gold International Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of Commercial Production - Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Shanti Gold International Limited has officially commenced commercial production at its new manufacturing facility located at Ground to 3rd Floor, Plot No. 1, Compartment No. 5, Marol Co-operative Industrial Estate, Vasanji Road, Andheri (East), Mumbai – 400069. This commencement, effective from June 08, 2026, is expected to increase the company's annual capacity by approximately 4,000 kg per annum. This expansion follows a previous disclosure made on January 22, 2026. The company has also uploaded a press release detailing this development on its website, www.shantigold.in.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: JNK India Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of order
announcements.ai_summary: JNK India Limited has secured a significant international order from CC7 Emirates Engineering Solutions L.L.C., UAE, on June 8, 2026. The order is for the design, engineering, manufacture, procurement, and supply of an Incinerator Package on an FCA basis. Additionally, the company will provide assistance on a per diem basis for erection, commissioning, and witness of performance tests for the TA’ZIZ Salt Project, ADNOC, Abu Dhabi, UAE. The project delivery schedule is set for December 2027. This order is classified as "Large" based on its value, which falls between ₹0 Cr and ₹100 Cr. Further details regarding the order's specific value are not disclosed in the provided text.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Intimation of opening of 25th retail store for lab-grown diamond jewellery under the brand name  ORIGEM
announcements.ai_summary: Goldiam International Limited has announced the opening of its 25th retail store for lab-grown diamond jewellery under the brand name "ORIGEM". The new store is located at Shop No. M-0019, Urban Square Mall, Plot No. F-210 to 223, Udyog Vihar, RIICO Industrial Area, Gaurav Path, Sukher, Udaipur, Rajasthan – 313001. The store opened to the public on June 8, 2026. This expansion aligns with the company's strategy to broaden its retail footprint and enhance customer engagement in key markets.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Akash Infra Projects Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material event under Regulation 30 of LODR
announcements.ai_summary: Akash Infra Projects Limited has filed a Commercial Execution Petition on June 8, 2026, before the Hon'ble Commercial Court at Ahmedabad. This action is taken under section 36 of the Arbitration And Conciliation Act, 1996, for the enforcement of an arbitration award. The company is seeking to recover an aggregate claim amount, including interest, of Rs. 117.84 Crore from the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation, as per an arbitration award dated January 31, 2022. Since the arbitration award is in favor of the company, there is no expected negative financial impact; rather, it represents a claim for recovery.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Aye Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of WALCO held on Jun 08, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Aye Finance Limited's Working Committee of the Asset and Liabilities Committee (WALCO) met on June 8, 2026, and approved the offer and issuance of senior, secured, rated, listed, redeemable, transferable, non-convertible debentures. The total amount for these debentures is up to the Indian Rupee equivalent of USD 15 million. Each debenture will have a face value of INR 1,00,000 and will be issued at par, in dematerialized form, on a private placement basis. The meeting commenced at 3:15 P.M. (IST) and concluded at 3:45 P.M. (IST). Further details as required by SEBI Listing Regulations are annexed.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Dev Accelerator Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 08, 2026, titled "DevX Scales Bengaluru Portfolio with Prestige Group, adds 1.11 Lakh sq. ft.".
announcements.ai_summary: Dev Accelerator Limited has issued a press release on June 8, 2026, announcing a significant expansion of its Bengaluru portfolio in partnership with the Prestige Group. This expansion adds 1.11 lakh sq. ft. of Grade A+ office space, creating over 1,200 seats and is projected to generate approximately ₹2.2 crore in monthly revenue. The first asset, located at Lakeshore Drive, is expected to launch on August 1, 2026, with an investment of approximately ₹10 crore for fit-outs and infrastructure. The second development, Prestige Featherlite Tech Hub, focuses on the "Walk to Work" model. This strategic move aims to capitalize on the high demand in Bengaluru's Outer Ring Road micro-market.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Avantel Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Avantel Limited has secured a new contract from the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), Ministry of Defence, Government of India, for the Development and Testing of Satellite Terminals for GSAT. The total value of this domestic contract is Rs. 9.94 Crores, inclusive of applicable taxes. The contract is for manufacturing and service and is expected to be executed by December 2028. The terms include a warranty period of 24 months. This development is an important update for investors regarding the company's order book and future revenue streams.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Fineotex Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 08, 2026, titled "Press Release on Expansion of  Manufacturing Capacity".
announcements.ai_summary: Fineotex Chemical Limited, through its US subsidiary CrudeChem Technology LLC, is significantly expanding its manufacturing capacity at its Texas facility. The expansion will add 150 million pounds per annum, increasing the total capacity from 200 million pounds per year to 350 million pounds per year. This strategic move, announced on June 08, 2026, aims to support the growing global demand for specialty chemicals, particularly for the oilfield and energy sectors. The increased production capability is expected to enhance the company's ability to serve existing customers and capitalize on future growth opportunities in North America.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted a Press Release with the Stock Exchange titled Motherson has commissioned its first captive solar project in Uttar Pradesh, India, marking a step forward in industrial decarbonization.
announcements.ai_summary: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has commissioned its first captive solar project in Uttar Pradesh, India, through its subsidiary Onega Solar Private Limited, via its energy business company, Motherson New Energy Limited (MNEL). This 15 MWp ground-mounted solar facility, located in Mahoba, will supply clean, renewable energy to multiple Motherson manufacturing plants in the state, supporting the Group's clean energy transition strategy. The project is expected to generate approximately 23.4 GWh of renewable electricity annually, reducing CO₂ emissions by an estimated 17,000 MT per year. This initiative aims to reduce the carbon footprint of Motherson's manufacturing operations, improve long-term energy cost visibility, and enhance operational resilience. The project was developed in partnership with ib vogt.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Apar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Correction in Distinctive Number Range mentioned in Outcome of Board meeting for Allotment of Equity Shares against exercise of ESARs granted to eligible Employees under APAR Industries Limited Employee Stock Appreciation Rights Plan 2024.

The corrected distinctive number range for the allotted shares is from 40396466 to 40402385. All other details of the allotment remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Viyash Scientific Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates-Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Viyash Scientific Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary Alivira Animal Health Limited (Ireland), has entered into a binding agreement on June 8, 2026, to acquire 100% of the shareholding in BioForLife Italia s.r.l. (Milan, Italy). The total consideration for this acquisition is EUR 16.975 million, comprising EUR 15.0 million payable at closing and EUR 1.975 million as deferred consideration. BioForLife Italia s.r.l. reported annual sales of approximately EUR 9.0 million for CY 2025 and is engaged in the marketing and distribution of animal health products for companion animals. This acquisition is subject to the fulfillment of applicable conditions precedent and the receipt of necessary statutory and regulatory approvals. The transaction does not involve related parties, and the promoter, promoter group, or group companies have no interest in the entity being acquired.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited (WAAREERTL) has received a Letter of Intent (LOI) for the execution of an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contract for a 300MW/450MWp Ground Mount Solar project. The contract also includes two years of operation and maintenance services. The order has been awarded by Sunsational Power Private Limited (SPPL), a domestic entity. The project is scheduled for completion during the financial year 2026-27. This announcement was made on June 8, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Intimation Under Regulation 30 And Regulation 31A Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Reclassification Of Promoter To Public Category
announcements.ai_summary: Maha Rashtra Apex Corporation Limited has informed the stock exchanges regarding the reclassification of Mr. T Satish U Pai from the Promoter category to the Public category, as per Regulation 31A of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Maha Rashtra Apex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 08, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Maha Rashtra Apex Corporation Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 8, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM, approved the request for the reclassification of Mr. T Satish U Pai from the Promoter category to the Public category. This decision is subject to the approval of the stock exchanges. The Board considered and approved this reclassification in compliance with SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Reliance Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update by the Company'.
announcements.ai_summary: Reliance Infrastructure Limited is taking steps to participate in the Artificial Intelligence (AI) and related new-age technologies sector. Through its subsidiaries, the company has incorporated AI and technology-driven activities into its business framework. As part of this strategic move, three subsidiaries have been renamed to reflect their new focus: Reliance AI World Private Limited, Reliance AI Apex Private Limited, and Reliance AI One Private Limited. This initiative signifies the company's expansion into emerging technology areas.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: DEE Development Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'UPDATES ON THE MONTHLY EXECUTION AND ORDER POSITION OF THE COMPANY'.
announcements.ai_summary: DEE Development Engineers Limited has provided an update on its monthly execution and order position for the period of May 1st, 2026, to May 31st, 2026. The company's total order book stood at INR 2,433.90 crore as of May 31st, 2026. During May 2026, DEE Development Engineers Limited saw order inflows of INR 631.91 crore and executed orders worth INR 107.83 crore. The cumulative order inflow for FY 2026-27, as of May 31st, 2026, reached INR 681.85 crore, with cumulative order execution at INR 177.51 crore for the same period. The company also noted an interim order from the Punjab State Electricity Regulatory Commission (PSERC) revising the tariff for Malwa Power Private Limited.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 08, 2026, titled "Press Release under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015".
announcements.ai_summary: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited has secured a significant export contract valued at approximately INR 208 crore (US$21.97 million) for the supply of 40,000 units of 155 mm M107 artillery shell bodies. This order is to be executed over a six-month period, with production and deliveries scheduled for completion within this timeframe. The contract represents a strategic expansion for Sigma, moving from fuze manufacturing to producing complete artillery shell components. The company has obtained the necessary Export Authorisation from the Department of Defence Production. This development highlights Sigma's capability in high-volume, mission-critical defence manufacturing for international clients.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: State Bank Of India has informed the Exchange about Update on IPO of SBI Funds Management Limited
announcements.ai_summary: State Bank of India has provided an update regarding the Initial Public Offering (IPO) of its subsidiary, SBI Funds Management Limited (SBIFM). The company has corrected a previous disclosure stating that the Bid/Offer Period for QIBs will close on Thursday, July 16, 2026, not Wednesday, July 15, 2026. The price band for the IPO has been fixed at ₹545 to ₹574 per equity share of face value ₹1. An employee discount of ₹54 per equity share will be offered to eligible employees. The minimum bid lot has been set at 26 equity shares and multiples thereof.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Kalpataru Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement (Merger by Absorption) of Kalpataru Hills Residency Private Limited, a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary with Kalpataru Properties (Thane) Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Kalpataru Limited ( KL  or  the Company ) and their respective shareholders
announcements.ai_summary: Kalpataru Limited has announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Kalpataru Properties (Thane) Limited (KPTL), and its step-down subsidiary, Kalpataru Hills Residency Private Limited (KHRPL), have approved a Scheme of Amalgamation. The Boards of Directors of both KPTL and KHRPL met on July 8, 2026, and approved the merger of KHRPL into KPTL under Section 233 of the Companies Act, 2013. Following the effectiveness of this scheme, Kalpataru Limited will continue to hold a 100% stake in KPTL. This internal restructuring aims to streamline the group's structure, optimize operations, and reduce costs, with no significant impact anticipated on the company's consolidated or standalone financial position. The scheme is subject to approvals from the Regional Director, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, and other required regulatory and statutory authorities, as well as approvals from the classes of members and/or creditors of both companies.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: GUJARAT ENERGY LIMITED has informed the Exchange about General Updates - Intimation for allotment of Equity Shares by GSPL Transmission Limited, Resulting Company under the Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Energy Limited (GEL) has provided an update regarding the allotment of equity shares by GSPL Transmission Limited (GTL), the Resulting Company under a Composite Scheme of Amalgamation and Arrangement. On July 8, 2026, the Board of Directors of GTL approved the allotment of 31,27,43,617 equity shares, each with a face value of ₹10, to GEL's equity shareholders as of the Record Date, July 2, 2026. GTL will apply for listing and trading permission for these shares from the NSE and BSE. This allotment is a part of the scheme involving Gujarat State Petroleum Corporation Limited, Gujarat State Petronet Limited, GSPC Energy Limited, Gujarat Gas Limited (now GEL), and GTL.

announcements.subject: Demerger
announcements.detail: Kalpataru Limited has informed the Exchange about Order received from National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench Court III, Special Bench for approving the withdrawal of Scheme of Arrangement of Demerger of undertaking from Kalpataru Properties Limited (formerly known as Kalpataru Properties Private Limited), a step down wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, into the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Kalpataru Limited has announced that it has received an order from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench Court III, Special Bench, on July 8, 2026. This order permits the withdrawal of the Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of the undertaking of Kalpataru Properties Limited, a step-down wholly owned subsidiary, into Kalpataru Limited. This withdrawal follows the Executive Committee of the Board of Directors' earlier approval on June 2, 2026, to withdraw the scheme concerning Project Magnus situated at Bandra (East), Mumbai. The company has disseminated this information on its website.

announcements.subject: Agreements

announcements.ai_summary: NLC India Limited has entered into a Joint Venture Agreement with National Aluminium Company Limited (NALCO) to establish a Joint Venture Company (JVC). This JVC will focus on developing a 4×270 MW (1,080 MW) Coal based Thermal Captive Power Plant in Angul, Odisha. The primary objective is to meet the captive power requirements for NALCO's 0.5 MTPA Aluminium Smelter Expansion Project. The JVC will be incorporated with a 50:50 equity participation from both NLC India Limited and NALCO. The agreement includes a 25-year Fuel Supply Agreement (FSA) with NLCIL and a 25-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with NALCO for 100% power offtake.

Pepperfry plans to add 35 new stores by the end of August 2026, significantly expanding its presence across key metros, Tier 1, and Tier 2 cities. The company remains on track to expand its retail footprint to over 250 stores in the near term, reinforcing its long-term vision to build one of India’s largest omnichannel furniture and home retail platforms. This expansion is expected to enhance customer access, deepen market penetration, and support business growth during a strong consumption period. Pepperfry also achieved a significant operational milestone, recording its first profitable quarter in Q4 FY26, reflecting improved operating efficiency and stronger business fundamentals. This strategic move aligns with TCC Concept Limited’s broader strategy of building category-leading, technology-enabled consumer businesses through scalable omnichannel platforms.

announcements.ai_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited announced on July 08, 2026, a strategic partnership between its subsidiary L&T Vyoma and Fortanix Inc. This collaboration aims to deliver sovereign, secure software-as-a-service offerings for enterprises and government organizations in India, leveraging NVIDIA Confidential Computing technology. announcements.subject: Press Release

announcements.ai_summary: KFin Technologies Limited has issued a press release on July 8, 2026, announcing the acceleration of same-day physical SIPs through its Finex transformation program. This initiative aims to redefine wealth creation by significantly improving onboarding speed for investors, distributors, and Asset Management Companies (AMCs). The Finex program leverages AI-driven exception processing and AI-powered recognition (OCR/ICR) to digitize physical onboarding documents instantly. This transforms the traditional physical SIP registration process, which historically took 21 to 30 days, into a same-day reality by replacing sequential handling with an intelligent, parallel processing pipeline.

announcements.ai_summary: The Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Limited has issued a press release announcing its ranking as the World's #2 Best Hotel Brand in the Travel + Leisure World's Best Awards 2026 Survey. This prestigious recognition places The Leela among the world's finest luxury hospitality brands and reinforces its position as the leading Indian luxury hospitality brand globally. Additionally, The Leela Palace Udaipur was ranked the No. 2 Resort in India and featured in the top 100 Hotels in the World, while The Leela Palace New Delhi was ranked #2 among the Best City Hotels in India in the same survey. This marks a significant milestone for the brand, which has previously been ranked the World's Best Hotel Brand in 2020 and 2021.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Marksans Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 08, 2026, titled "Marksans Pharma signed a definitive agreement to acquire 100 percent share capital of a German based Company namely ABCnow GmbH".
announcements.ai_summary: Marksans Pharma Limited has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of the share capital of ABCnow GmbH, a German-based pharmaceutical company. This acquisition aims to expand Marksans Pharma's presence in regulated European markets and strengthen its forward-integration strategy by gaining direct market access in the European Union. ABCnow GmbH is a pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution company headquartered in Flensburg, Germany, primarily engaged in the marketing and distribution of OTC products. As of December 31, 2025, ABCnow GmbH reported a turnover of €227,233.69. The transaction is not a related party transaction, and the promoters of Marksans Pharma have no interest in ABCnow GmbH.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: INOX India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 08, 2026, titled "INOX India Ltd secures multiple orders worth Rs. 939 Cr.".
announcements.ai_summary: INOX India Limited has secured multiple new orders worth a total of ₹939 Crore, received between May 21, 2026, and July 8, 2026. These orders span across the company's business segments, including Industrial Gas (₹871 Cr), LNG (₹44 Cr), and Cryo-scientific Solutions (₹16 Cr), along with Beverage Keg orders worth ₹8 Cr. A significant portion of these orders was boosted by a 'Mega' order in the Industrial Gas business vertical from the space exploration industry. The company also received 'Minor' orders for vaporizers and storage tanks, and multiple orders for LNG business vertical components such as storage tanks, dispensers, semi-trailers, and LNG Fuelling station equipment. A 'Minor' order was also received from ITER. These new orders reinforce INOX India's position as a leading provider of cryogenic technology solutions globally.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 08, 2026, titled "PNG launches the flagship store of YOOU, a brand around evolving identities of modern women".
announcements.ai_summary: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited has announced the launch of its flagship store for YOOU, a new lightweight diamond jewellery brand, on August 8, 2026, in Amanora Mall, Hadapsar, Pune. This 1,445 sq. ft. store is designed to offer a contemporary retail experience focused on individuality and self-expression. YOOU offers lightweight diamond jewellery in 14, 18, 22, and 9-karat gold, blending modern aesthetics with PNG Jewellers' established trust and craftsmanship. The brand aims to provide versatile jewellery suitable for everyday wear, not just special occasions. The store features elegant interiors and curated displays, showcasing a wide range of rings, earrings, chains, pendants, bracelets, bangles, mangalsutras, and men's jewellery. This launch marks a significant step for PNG Jewellers in catering to consumers seeking jewellery that aligns with their daily lives and personal style.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 08, 2026, titled "Maruti Suzuki Annual Integrated Report 2025-26 The Next Million, New Momentum: Every Engine of Growth in Motion".
announcements.ai_summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has announced the release of its Annual Integrated Report for the fiscal year 2025-26, themed "The Next Million, New Momentum". This report details the company's growth drivers, including the revival of the small car segment, expansion of its SUV portfolio, multi-powertrain strategy, capacity enhancements, and strong export performance. In FY 2025-26, Maruti Suzuki achieved record annual sales of 24.22 lakh vehicles and exports of 4.47 lakh vehicles. The company is optimistic about reaching its next million-vehicle sales milestone sooner than expected. Furthermore, the Chairman estimates the Indian car industry will grow to 6.1 to 6.3 million units by FY 2030-31, with a significant faster growth in the small car segment. The company also plans to invest Rs. 561 crore in the first phase to establish four biogas plants, aiming to utilize locally available resources for a zero-emission fuel alternative to imported CNG.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 08, 2026, titled "PNG launches YOOU, a lightweight diamond jewellery brand reflecting the evolving identities of modern women".
announcements.ai_summary: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited has issued a press release announcing the rebranding of its lightweight diamond jewellery brand, Litestyle, to "YOOU". This rebranding aims to reflect a renewed vision focused on individuality, self-expression, and everyday luxury for modern women. The YOOU brand, built on PNG Jewellers' legacy since 1832, offers lightweight diamond jewellery in 14, 18, 22, and 9 karat gold. The brand's collections are designed for versatile wear, suitable for both work and social occasions, and include items like rings, earrings, chains, pendants, bracelets, bangles, mangalsutras, and men's jewellery. YOOU currently operates 13 exclusive brand outlets across Maharashtra and Goa, with an additional shop-in-shop presence in five states. The press release was issued on August 08, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Rushil Decor Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 08, 2026, titled "Press Release on Financial Performance for the Quarter ended on 30th June, 2026.".
announcements.ai_summary: Rushil Decor Limited has released its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. For Q1 FY27, the company reported Revenue from Operations of Rs. 2,290 million, a 27.8% year-on-year increase. Gross Profit stood at Rs. 892 million, up 19.9% YoY. EBITDA was Rs. 182 million, with an EBITDA Margin of 7.9%. The company's Laminates segment revenue was Rs. 736 million, a 65.3% YoY increase, with a blended realization of Rs. 836. The MDF segment revenue was Rs. 1,456 million, up 17.2% YoY, with a blended realization of Rs. 27,781. The company also provided division sales volume details, including Laminates at 8,80,319 sheets and MDF at 52,417 CBM.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Coastal Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Coastal Corporation Limited has clarified its banking records regarding repayment obligations. The company confirmed that it has maintained the requisite funds for scheduled repayments within applicable timelines. The banker, via an email dated August 08, 2026, explained that certain entries in bank records reflect subsequent-day/manual processing and value-dating due to MTM/FCY movements and working capital limit utilization. Specifically, interest recovery for a Cash Credit/Overdraft account on May 31, 2025, was a manual processing date, not a delay. Similarly, EMI recoveries on December 01, 2025, were manually processed by the bank on the subsequent working day, with value dating to November 30, 2025, indicating no delay from the borrower's side. The company has provided a copy of the banker's email for reference.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Delhivery Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 08, 2026, titled "Delhivery Elevates Vani Venkatesh".
announcements.ai_summary: Delhivery Limited has announced the elevation of Vani Venkatesh to the role of Deputy CEO, effective immediately, as per a press release dated August 08, 2026. Ms. Venkatesh, who joined Delhivery in February 2025 as Chief Business Officer, will now lead Revenue functions, Marketing, and Customer Experience, working closely with the Operations teams. This move is part of the company's strategy to strengthen its executive leadership. In related organizational changes, Ajith Pai, Chief Operating Officer and Key Managerial Personnel (KMP), will be moving on from the company effective September 15, 2026, after transitioning his responsibilities. The press release also highlights that Delhivery is India's largest logistics services provider.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Captain Polyplast Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 08, 2026, titled "PRESS RELESE FOR Q-1 F.Y. 2026-27".
announcements.ai_summary: Captain Polyplast Limited has announced its unaudited financial results for the first quarter of Fiscal Year 2026-27 (Q1 FY27), reporting a 16.3% year-on-year growth in total income to ₹81.66 crore. The company's EBITDA surged by 26.7% YoY to ₹9.86 crore, with an EBITDA margin expansion of 99 basis points to 12.07%. Net profit increased by 8.5% to ₹4.66 crore. Key operational highlights include securing an order worth ₹11.8 crore from MSEDCL for 500 solar pumps under the PM-KUSUM Scheme. The company also commenced production at its new 70,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility near Ahmedabad. The press release was issued on August 8, 2026.

announcements.detail: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 08, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited reported strong financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with operating revenue of ₹1,167 crore, a 13.9% year-on-year increase from ₹1,024 crore in Q1 FY26. EBITDA grew by 35.4% to ₹175 crore, improving the EBITDA margin to 15.0% from 12.6%. Profit After Tax (PAT) stood at ₹101 crore, up from ₹65 crore in the same quarter last year, with the PAT margin rising to 8.4% from 6.2%. The company's Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) business was the primary growth driver, with CDMO revenue reaching ₹964 crore and CDMO EBITDA increasing by 36.8% to ₹163 crore, supported by volume growth and improved API prices. The management expressed confidence in continued sustainable growth due to a strong pipeline and prudent capital allocation.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Press Release for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited announced its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 8, 2026. The company reported an 11% year-on-year revenue growth, reaching Rs. 2026 Cr, driven by strong performance across its segments. The Pantaloons segment saw a 10% increase in revenue, with its format retail like-for-like (LTL) standing at 4% year-on-year, and OWND growing by 55% due to store additions. The luxury portfolio grew 30% year-on-year, and the TMRW portfolio delivered 11% year-on-year growth. The company also added over 45 new stores, expanding its retail footprint to over 7.9 million sq. ft. EBITDA for the quarter was Rs. 167 Cr, a slight decrease from Rs. 169 Cr in the previous year, with an EBITDA margin of 8.2%.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has shared a letter from its Managing Director, Mr. Baddam Karunakar Reddy, addressed to its shareholders. The letter discusses the company's philosophy of building enduring institutions rather than just products or companies, emphasizing values, capability, and long-term thinking. It highlights the acquisition of Premier Explosives as a strategic decision to enhance the company's depth, capability, and responsibility, particularly in the context of India's accelerating self-reliance in defence manufacturing. The Managing Director views this integration as creating a new, stronger story by combining the heritage and expertise of both entities within India's defence ecosystem.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has issued a tear sheet providing key performance highlights and an overview of its business. The company reported a 70% year-on-year increase in Revenue from Operations, a 33% year-on-year increase in EBITDA (excluding other income), and a 25% year-on-year increase in Profit After Tax (PAT). The tear sheet also outlines the company's vision for 2036, projecting a 30% CAGR for Revenue, 41% CAGR for EBITDA (Ex OI), and 64% CAGR for PAT between 2021-2026, with an average EBITDA margin of 23%. Apollo Micro Systems is a Tier-I Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) in the Defence technology sector, with capabilities in design, development, manufacture, integration, and life-cycle support of advanced weapon systems. The company is authorized under the Arms Act, 1959, to manufacture missile-class weapon systems, torpedoes, aerial bombs, and loitering munitions.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Bajel Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging of order for Transmission Line.
announcements.ai_summary: Bajel Projects Limited has announced the bagging of a Mega EPC order for Transmission Line works from PowerGrid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL), acting on behalf of their SPV, M/s WR ER Part A Power Transmission Limited. This order pertains to Transmission Line Package TL06, which involves the LILO of Ranchi (New)- New PPSP 400kV D/C line at Jamshedpur (New), covering sections from Jamshedpur (New) to LILO towards Ranchi (New) and Jamshedpur (New) to LILO towards New PPSP. The project is part of the "WR -ER Inter -Regional Network Expansion Scheme-Part A" executed through the Tariff Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) route and is a domestic EPC contract. The associated timeline for this order is 27 months from the date of issuance of the Notification of Award. The company has confirmed that its promoters and group companies have no interest in the awarding entity, and this transaction is not a related party transaction.

announcements.subject: Updates

The company has sold approximately 2.34 lac square feet of commercial space through this e-auction. The total sale value generated from this transaction is approximately Rs. 1,236 crore. NBCC (India) Limited will receive a marketing fee of 1% of the total sale value. This information is available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Bajel Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging of order for Transmission Line.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 08, 2026, titled "Press Release for the quarter ended 30th June 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has announced its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1FY27). The company reported a revenue of ₹251 crore, an increase of 88% year-on-year from ₹134 crore in Q1FY26. EBITDA (excluding exceptional items) stood at ₹54 crore, up 31% from ₹41 crore in the prior year's quarter. Profit After Tax (PAT) was ₹28 crore, a 43% increase from ₹19 crore in Q1FY26. The consolidated order book as of August 8, 2026, stands at ₹1704 crore. The press release highlights these figures as delivering the highest ever Q1 revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, along with a record order book.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Sattva Engineering Construction Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 08, 2026, titled "Receipt of a Purchase Order from M/s. Bimbo Bakeries India Private Limited".
announcements.ai_summary: Sattva Engineering Construction Limited has secured a purchase order from Bimbo Bakeries India Private Limited, a subsidiary of Grupo Bimbo. The order involves civil construction works at Bimbo Bakeries India's manufacturing facility in Serkadu Village, Tamil Nadu. The basic order value is ₹9.51 crore excluding GST, with a total purchase order value of ₹11.22 crore including applicable taxes. The project is scheduled for completion within 20 weeks. Payment terms include 90% against RA Bills, payable within 15 days of certification and invoice submission, with the remaining 10% due after commissioning and handover against a Performance Bank Guarantee valid for the Defect Liability Period. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Eveready Industries India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 08, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Eveready Industries India Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th June 2026, on 8th August 2026. The company reported a consolidated revenue from operations of INR 407.7 crore, a 9% year-on-year growth from INR 374.1 crore in Q1 FY26. EBITDA stood at INR 61.5 crore, with an EBITDA margin of 15.1%, remaining stable year-on-year. Profit after tax grew by 22.3% to INR 37.0 crore compared to INR 30.2 crore in Q1 FY26. The battery segment revenue grew by 11.9%, driven by strong alkaline battery performance, and commercial production has commenced at their Jammu alkaline facility.

announcements.subject: Updates

The specific details regarding the number of shares, face value, issue price, and premium are yet to be disclosed.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about remittance of 1st tranche of loan granted to Mbodla Investments (PTY) LIMITED, South Africa (Joint Venture).
announcements.ai_summary: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited has remitted the first tranche of a loan amounting to US$ 1,00,000, equivalent to INR 95,26,500, to its South African joint venture, Mbodla Investments (PTY) LIMITED. This loan is intended to meet the capital expenditure and working capital needs of Mbodla Investments (PTY) LIMITED and will be utilized exclusively for legitimate business purposes. The loan has a tenure of up to June 30, 2031, with an interest rate of 6 months term SOFM plus a 5% spread, currently at 8.68%, resetting semi-annually. Principal repayment will commence after a one-year moratorium, in 16 equal quarterly installments. Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited holds a 49% share capital in Mbodla Investments (PTY) Ltd. The company has obtained necessary permissions from regulatory authorities for this remittance.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited has received permission from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization to import for sale and distribution of Trastuzumab Deruxtecan 100mg/5mL lyophilized powder for concentrate for solution for infusion (Brand name: Enhertu®) for an additional indication. This approval is for the adjuvant treatment of adult patients with HER2-positive breast cancer who have residual invasive disease following neoadjuvant Trastuzumab and taxane-based treatment. The company received this permission on August 7, 2026. This paves the way for the marketing of Enhertu® in India for this specific indication, subject to any further statutory approvals.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Digitide Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015'.
announcements.ai_summary: Digitide Solutions Limited has disclosed a cybersecurity incident affecting data of one of its subsidiaries, following claims of unauthorized access by an anonymous source. The company and its subsidiary have initiated their cyber incident response protocols and are conducting a thorough investigation to determine the nature and potential impact of the breach. Based on their preliminary assessment as of August 08, 2026, Digitide Solutions Limited has not identified any material impact on its operations or financial standing. The company will continue to monitor the situation and will make further disclosures as required by applicable laws and regulations. This information will also be available on the company's website, www.digitide.com.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Update on USFDA inspection at our formulations facility located at Sanand, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
announcements.ai_summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited has received the Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) from the United States Food & Drug Administration (USFDA) for its formulations facility located in Sanand, Ahmedabad, Gujarat. This update follows a previous intimation dated May 16, 2026, regarding the USFDA inspection conducted at the facility from May 06, 2026, to May 15, 2026. The USFDA has classified the inspection status of the Sanand facility as Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI). Consequently, the inspection is now considered closed.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Cassation Court, Dubai, UAE Judgment in the matter of RSM General Trading LLC
announcements.ai_summary: Honasa Consumer Limited has received a judgment from the Cassation Court in Dubai, UAE, dated July 29, 2026, which was received by the company on August 07, 2026. This judgment dismisses the appeals filed by both Honasa Consumer Limited and RSM General Trading LLC. The Cassation Court has upheld the Court of Appeals' previous judgment from February 11, 2026, which awarded RSM General Trading LLC AED 1,707,407.06 (INR 4,43,12,369/-) as compensation for damages. Notably, RSM General Trading LLC's appeal for AED 45,000,000 in damages was rejected. The company clarifies that an Arbitral Award dated May 14, 2025, as amended on June 26, 2026, by the Indian Arbitral Tribunal, was in favor of Honasa Consumer Limited, permanently injuncting RSM General Trading LLC from initiating proceedings in Dubai courts and requiring RSM to pay damages to Honasa Consumer Limited. Due to these reliefs granted by the Arbitral Tribunal, the company expects no financial impact from the Cassation Court's judgment. The company also notes that under Indian Civil Procedure Code, 1908, the Cassation Court judgment may not be conclusive as the agreement's governing law is Indian law, and disputes are subject to arbitration or the exclusive jurisdiction of New Delhi courts.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: NMDC Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: NMDC Limited has announced new prices for Iron Ore effective from August 8, 2026. The price for Lump Ore, with specifications of 65.5% iron content and a size of 10-40mm, has been fixed at ₹5,250 per ton. Additionally, the price for Fines Ore, with 64% iron content and a size of -10mm, will be ₹4,500 per ton. It is important to note that these prices are FOR (Free On Rail) prices and do not include various additional charges such as Royalty, DMF, NMEDT, Cess, Forest Permit Fee, transit fee, GST, environmental Cess, and other applicable taxes. This announcement provides clarity on the pricing structure for NMDC's key products.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: PNC Infratech Limited has informed regarding Resolution Plan submitted by the Company under CIRP for Gwalior Bypass Project Ltd (Corporate Debtor) in 2020 - Plan not approved - Settlement reached by the Company with the erstwhile Promoter/Director of the Corporate Debtor - Rs. 20.00 Crore Compensation received by the Company towards costs incurred by it as part of settlement.
announcements.ai_summary: PNC Infratech Limited has announced a settlement regarding the Gwalior Bypass Project Ltd (Corporate Debtor) CIRP. The company's resolution plan, approved by the Committee of Creditors (CoC) in 2020, was not approved by the NCLT due to protracted legal proceedings involving Mr. Nakul Bharana, an erstwhile director. To resolve the matter, PNC Infratech entered into an amicable settlement with Mr. Bharana and received Rs. 20.00 Crore as compensation for costs incurred. The company has also issued a No Objection Certificate (NOC) to Mr. Bharana on April 7, 2026. This settlement aims to finally resolve the dispute, which involved a performance bank guarantee of Rs. 29.51 Crores that had been valid for nearly six years.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Rajputana Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 08, 2026, titled "A defining Milestone: Debt-free Status Achieved".
announcements.ai_summary: Rajputana Stainless Limited has announced achieving debt-free status as of April 8, 2026, marking a significant milestone post-listing. The company has successfully repaid its entire outstanding debt amounting to Rs. 96.01 Crores. This repayment includes term loans, working capital facilities, and unsecured borrowings, aligning with the stated utilization of its IPO proceeds. This strategic move signifies a strengthened financial position for the company.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Max Healthcare Institute Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of controlling stake in 250 bed Kalinga Hospital Ltd.
announcements.ai_summary: Max Healthcare Institute Limited announced on April 8, 2026, its approval to acquire a controlling stake of approximately 58.39% in Kalinga Hospital Ltd. This acquisition pertains to a 250-bedded multi-specialty hospital located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, known as ‘Kalinga Hospital’. The company will enter into a share purchase agreement to facilitate this transaction. To support Kalinga Hospital Ltd.'s operational and developmental needs, Max Healthcare has approved providing loans up to ₹100 Crore for construction, renovation, and equipment. Additionally, the company will issue a corporate guarantee to a bank or financial institution for the refinancing of $5 million in External Commercial Borrowings of Kalinga Hospital Ltd.'s existing promoter. The acquisition is being financed by a Senior Secured Term Loan of up to ₹300 Crore.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Max Healthcare Institute Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 08, 2026, titled "Max Healthcare forays in Bhubaneswar, Odisha; to acquire controlling stake in 250 bed Kalinga Hospital".
announcements.ai_summary: Max Healthcare Institute Limited has issued a press release on April 8, 2026, announcing its foray into Bhubaneswar, Odisha, through the acquisition of a controlling stake in Kalinga Hospital Ltd. The company's board has approved the share purchase agreement for this acquisition, which represents approximately 58.39% of Kalinga Hospital Ltd. To support the hospital's growth, Max Healthcare will provide loans up to ₹100 Crore for construction, renovation, and equipment upgrades. Furthermore, a corporate guarantee will be issued for $5 million in External Commercial Borrowings related to the refinancing of the existing promoter's debt. announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Bartronics India Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Tejas Networks Ltd. has announced that it has won the Golden Peacock Innovative Product/Service Award 2026 for its WavePlexus™ portfolio of Radio Access Network (RAN) products. This award is administered by the Institute of Directors and is considered a benchmark for corporate innovation and governance. The company also received certification for meeting the rigorous standards of the Golden Peacock Excellence Model, demonstrating a commitment to sustainability-driven excellence. The judging panel for the award was chaired by former Chief Justice of India, Hon’ble Justice Uday U. Lalit, along with other distinguished members. The WavePlexus™ portfolio consists of modular, energy-efficient 4G and 5G radio and baseband products, including advanced 32TR and 64TR Massive MIMO solutions, which comply with both 3GPP and O-RAN standards. These products are deployed in carrier-grade networks globally and are designed for world-class performance, lower power consumption, and reduced total cost of ownership.

announcements.detail: Oberoi Realty Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of Hotel Horizon Private Limited Private Limited under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 - Update
announcements.ai_summary: Oberoi Realty Limited, along with its consortium partners Shree Naman Developers Private Limited and JM Financial Properties and Holdings Limited, has completed the implementation of the Resolution Plan for Hotel Horizon Private Limited (HHPL) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. announcements.ai_summary: Le Travenues Technology Limited (ixigo) has provided an update regarding its acquisition of a majority stake in Brevistay Hospitality Private Limited. This strategic move aims to strengthen ixigo's hotels business and enhance its customer-centric approach in the Indian travel market. The company was impressed by Brevistay's growth in a competitive landscape without significant capital raises, their execution capabilities, market understanding, and ability to build strong hotel partner relationships. Brevistay's flexible-stay inventory is seen as a good fit for ixigo's transportation-focused customer segments. The acquisition combines Brevistay's hotel contracting expertise and supply network with ixigo's AI technology, user base, and multi-modal travel ecosystem. This integration is expected to result in a combined hotel network of over 10,000 properties. The company has released Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) to address investor queries about this acquisition.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Reliance Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 07, 2026, titled "Media Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Reliance Infrastructure Limited has formally requested SEBI, NSE, and BSE to review the surveillance framework linked to the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC). The company is specifically seeking a review of the Additional Surveillance Measure (ASM) framework and its associated trading restrictions, which it believes are adversely impacting its over 7 lakh public shareholders. Reliance Infrastructure argues that the current restriction of trading only once a week with a narrow ±5% price band leads to mechanical and predictable price movements, which may not accurately reflect the company's business fundamentals or long-term value. The company has urged regulators to reconsider the once-a-week trading restriction and implement safeguards to protect shareholder value and investor confidence. Reliance Infrastructure's shares are otherwise actively traded, indicating sustained investor participation.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: MMP Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 07, 2026, titled "MMP Industries Limited Production Commencement of Low Tension Power Cables".
announcements.ai_summary: MMP Industries Limited (MMPIL) announced the commencement of production of Low Tension Power Cables (LTPC) at its Bhandara manufacturing facility on July 07, 2026. This initial facility has an installed capacity of 100 MT per month, intended for product validation, customer approvals, and process optimization. This milestone signifies MMPIL's strategic entry into the LTPC segment, expanding its portfolio of value-added electrical infrastructure products. Concurrently, the company is progressing with its Greenfield Low Tension Power Cable and Covered Conductor manufacturing facility at MIDC Umred, Maharashtra, which will have a planned manufacturing capacity of 6,000 MTPA. Construction activities for the Greenfield facility are underway, aligning with the company's execution roadmap, and upon completion, will significantly enhance MMPIL's manufacturing capabilities and market presence in the power transmission and distribution value chain.

This expansion includes the establishment of a new greenfield manufacturing facility in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, which is expected to commence operations by Q4FY28. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Midwest Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 07, 2026, titled "Midwest Limited along with Midwest Energy Limited and Non-Ferrous Materials Technology Development Technology Centre (NFTDC) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with PT Perushaan Mineral Nasional (Persero), Indonesia''s state-owned strategic minerals enterprise".
announcements.ai_summary: Midwest Limited, along with Midwest Energy Limited and the Non-Ferrous Materials Technology Development Centre (NFTDC), signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on July 07, 2026. The MoU was executed with PT Perusahaan Mineral Nasional (Persero) ("PERMINAS"), Indonesia's state-owned strategic minerals enterprise. This agreement establishes a framework for the parties to evaluate potential collaboration across the rare earth value chain in Indonesia. The scope of collaboration encompasses upstream exploration, resource assessment, mining, processing, extraction, refining, and downstream manufacturing, with a specific focus on Rare earth magnet production. This initiative marks Midwest Limited's first structured collaboration with a Southeast Asian state-owned strategic minerals enterprise, reinforcing its strategy in the rare earth sector. The parties will establish a joint working group to plan and monitor the project implementation.

The company and its group entity, SOTC Travel, are observing a trend where travelers are aligning their vacations with various regional festivals across India, such as Onam in Kerala, Pongal in Tamil Nadu, Ganesh Chaturthi in Maharashtra, Navratri in Gujarat, Durga Puja in Eastern India, Mysore Dasara in Karnataka, Dussehra in North India, and Diwali pan-India. These festivals are creating opportunities for extended breaks, leading travelers to combine celebrations with spiritual journeys, cultural immersions, family holidays, and international getaways. The press release details specific travel patterns from various Indian cities linked to these festivals, indicating a strong connection between festive occasions and travel planning.

announcements.ai_summary: Euro Panel Products Limited's flagship brand, EUROBOND, has achieved a significant milestone by becoming India's only Aluminium Composite Panel (ACP) brand to secure NABL accreditation for 51 parameters for mechanical and chemical testing. The certification process involved rigorous verification of lab equipment, staff competence, and process integrity, adhering to ISO/IEC 17025 standards.

announcements.ai_summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited has informed the stock exchanges on August 7, 2026, that it has terminated the agreement dated February 11, 2022, with Novartis India Limited (NIL) concerning the distribution and promotion of select brands in India. This termination is a consequence of a change in the controlling shareholding of NIL. Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited will continue to commercialize the affected brands until September 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities
announcements.detail: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Options to purchase securities
announcements.ai_summary: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited's Nomination and Remuneration Committee, in a meeting held on August 7, 2026, approved the grant of 25,25,000 Stock Appreciation Rights Units (SAR Units) under the LTHL Stock Appreciation Rights Scheme – 2024 to eligible employees. The number of shares to be issued and allotted upon exercise will be calculated based on the appreciation per SAR unit, the number of SAR units exercised, and the market price on the date of exercise. The SAR Price is determined as the closing price on the stock exchange with higher trading volume on the day preceding the grant date, which is Rs. 112.79 per SAR Unit. Vested SAR Units can be exercised by Grantees within one year from the vesting date.

announcements.subject: Memorandum of Understanding/Agreements
announcements.detail: TRANSWORLD SHIPPING LINES LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Memorandum of Understanding/Agreements
announcements.ai_summary: Transworld Shipping Lines Limited has signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) on August 7, 2026, for the sale of its vessel, M.V. SSL Brahmaputra, to Avana Logistek Limited. The sale consideration for the vessel is US$ 11,400,000. The agreement details, as required by SEBI regulations, have been submitted for record and dissemination. The parties involved are Transworld Shipping Lines Limited and Avana Logistek Limited, and they are not related parties.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Universal Cables Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity Expansion.
announcements.ai_summary: Universal Cables Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 7, 2026, approved an increase in the total outlay for its ongoing capacity expansion project. The project's budget has been raised from Rs. 550 crore to approximately Rs. 617 crore to enhance the capacity of its Medium Voltage and High Voltage power cable businesses through debottlenecking. This expansion is in continuation of the disclosure made on February 6, 2026, and updated details are enclosed as Annexure-C. Additionally, the Board approved a proposal for Birla Furukawa Fibre Optics Private Limited, a joint venture between Universal Cables Limited and Furukawa Electric Co, Ltd., Japan, to augment its optical fibre production capacity by nearly three times. This augmentation includes establishing a state-of-the-art "Preform" manufacturing facility with an estimated outlay of USD 500 Million (approximately Rs. 4800 crore), to be funded by internal accruals, equity, and debt. The JV's capacity expansion project in India is targeted for completion by December 31, 2028, with technical collaboration from Lightera LLC, USA/Furukawa Electric Co, Ltd., Japan.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Smarten Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Incorporation of a Wholly-owned subsidiary outside India'.
announcements.ai_summary: Smarten Power Systems Limited announced on August 07, 2026, that its Board of Directors approved the investment in a wholly-owned subsidiary incorporated in China. The subsidiary, named Hangzhou Smarten Electric Power Technology Co., Ltd., was incorporated on July 21, 2026, in Zhejiang, China. This new entity will operate in the Technology, Industrial Automation & New Energy Solutions industry. Its business scope includes technology development, technical consulting, software and IoT services, and trade in industrial automation, power, renewable energy, and AI solutions. The Board Meeting commenced at 04:50 P.M. IST and concluded at 05:10 P.M. IST.
