This approval was granted at a board meeting that commenced at 15:30 IST and concluded at 19:45 IST. The incorporation is subject to obtaining all requisite approvals and completing applicable statutory and regulatory formalities. The company will provide a final intimation to the stock exchanges upon the successful incorporation of this new subsidiary. This strategic move aims to expand the company's global presence and market reach.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: NRB Bearing Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: NRB Bearings Limited announced strong unaudited consolidated financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, via a press release on August 7, 2026. Consolidated Revenue from Operations grew by 19.2% year-on-year to ₹370 crores in Q1 FY27, up from ₹310 crores in Q1 FY26. Consolidated Profit After Tax (PAT) increased by 15% year-on-year to ₹38 crores in Q1 FY27, compared to ₹33 crores in Q1 FY26. Standalone results also showed healthy growth, with sales rising 14.7% year-on-year, PAT by 31.7% year-on-year, and EBITDA by 21.7% year-on-year. A key milestone in July 2026 was the successful acquisition of Mahant Tool Room (MTR Private Limited), which secured the AS9100D Aerospace Certification, significantly expanding NRB Group’s capabilities and market reach into Aerospace and Defence applications.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Universus Photo Imagings Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Universus Photo Imagings Limited received a Show Cause Notice from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) via email on August 06, 2026. The notice outlines SEBI's observations on certain transactions and issues pertaining to governance within the company. SEBI has provided the company with an opportunity to file a reply to the notice. Universus Photo Imagings Limited has stated its commitment to extend full support and cooperation to SEBI regarding any inquiries. This disclosure was made on August 07, 2026, under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Cyient Dlm Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: Cyient DLM Limited has informed the Exchange that the Income Tax Department, India, has levied a penalty of ₹4,11,000 on the company. This penalty was imposed under Section 271FA of the Income-tax Act, 1961, due to the delayed filing of Form 61A under Section 285BA of the Act. The company received this communication on August 6, 2026. Cyient DLM Limited stated that this discrepancy was operational in nature and has been appropriately addressed. Apart from the penalty imposed, the company has confirmed that there has been no significant impact on its financial, operational, or other activities.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Press release titled  NTPC Green Energy Limited wins 200 MW/ 800 MWh BESS capacity in WBSEDCL s 500 MW/ 2000 MWh Standalone BESS Tender.
announcements.ai_summary: NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL), a subsidiary of NTPC Limited, has been declared a successful bidder in an e-reverse auction conducted by the West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (WBSEDCL). NGEL has secured 200 MW/800 MWh of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) capacity in WBSEDCL's tender for standalone BESS projects. The discovered tariff for this capacity is ₹4.35 lakh per MW per month. The tender aimed to establish 500 MW/2000 MWh of standalone BESS capacity through a Tariff-Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) process. The e-reverse auction concluded on August 7, 2026. This achievement positions NGEL to contribute to the development of energy storage solutions in West Bengal.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: SEPC Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates on Order received from TCIL, its cancellation and subsequent action
announcements.ai_summary: SEPC Limited has provided a general update regarding a banning order received from Telecommunications Consultants India Limited (TCIL) on August 5, 2026. This order is in furtherance to earlier intimations concerning a Letter of Intent (LOI) for a Smart Prepaid Metering Project in Punjab, which was subsequently cancelled. SEPC Limited strongly contests the basis of the banning order and rejects all contentions and allegations made by TCIL. To safeguard its business interests and protect shareholder value, the company has immediately challenged the banning order before the appropriate authorities and is pursuing all necessary legal remedies to seek an immediate stay and subsequent quashing of this order. The company will keep the Stock Exchanges informed of any material developments.

announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger
announcements.detail: MPS Limited has informed the Exchange about the Completion of the Merger of American Journal Experts, LLC, Delaware, with and into MPS North America, LLC.
announcements.ai_summary: MPS Limited has announced the effective completion of the Second Merger, involving the amalgamation of American Journal Experts, LLC, Delaware, with and into MPS North America LLC. This merger became effective on August 3, 2026, following confirmation from the relevant State authority. MPS North America LLC is now the surviving entity and has assumed all assets, rights, liabilities, and obligations of American Journal Experts, LLC, Delaware, including those acquired through the First Merger. This development follows earlier intimations dated May 15, 2025, and August 1, 2026, regarding the two-step merger process. The company has provided detailed disclosures as required by Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, which are also available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Rollatainers Limited has informed the Exchange about Increase in Authorised Share Capital of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Rollatainers Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, approved an increase in the company's authorized share capital. The authorized share capital will be raised from the existing ₹65,00,00,000 (Rupees Sixty-Five Crores) to ₹79,00,00,000 (Rupees Seventy-Nine Crores). This increase necessitates a consequent alteration of Clause V of the Memorandum of Association of the company. The proposed change involves increasing the number of Equity Shares from 47,00,00,000 Equity Shares of ₹1 each to 61,00,00,000 Equity Shares of ₹1 each, while the number of Preference Shares remains unchanged at 18,00,00,000 Preference Shares of ₹1 each. This increase in authorized share capital is subject to the approval of the company's members at the forthcoming General Meeting.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Vindhya Telelinks Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "Submission of Press Release.".
announcements.ai_summary: Vindhya Telelinks Limited has issued a press release on August 7, 2026, detailing its financial results for the first quarter of FY 2026-27. The company reported a net profit of ₹2,809.97 lakhs, a significant increase of 34.5% compared to ₹2,089.91 lakhs in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. The Cable segment demonstrated strong performance with EBITDA rising to ₹4286.09 lakhs from ₹1592.45 lakhs year-on-year, driven by a favorable product mix and increased contribution from Optical Fibre Cables. The company highlighted its well-positioned status to capitalize on the growing demand for optical connectivity solutions, fueled by investments in hyperscale data centers, AI, cloud computing, FTTH, and 5G. Despite some execution headwinds in government-funded EPC projects, VTL's diversified business model showed resilience.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Patil Automation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "Patil Automation Strengthens Defence Automation Presence; Increases Stake in Mii Robotics to 70%".
announcements.ai_summary: Patil Automation Limited announced on August 07, 2026, that its Board of Directors approved the acquisition of an additional 10% equity stake in Mii Robotics Private Limited. This acquisition will increase Patil Automation's total shareholding in Mii Robotics from 60% to 70%. The strategic move aims to strengthen Patil Automation's presence and capabilities in the rapidly evolving defence automation segment. Mii Robotics specializes in automation solutions for grinding and processing applications in the defence industry, along with providing automation consultancy and support services. The transaction is expected to be completed within 30 days, subject to customary closing formalities, fostering deeper collaboration between the two entities.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: RITES Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "RITES & HPCL sign MoU for rail infra consultancy".
announcements.ai_summary: RITES Limited has announced a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed with Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) on August 7, 2026, for rail infrastructure consultancy services. Under this MoU, RITES will provide comprehensive consultancy services for the development of railway sidings across HPCL's facilities, covering the entire process from concept to commissioning. This includes feasibility studies, surveys, detailed project reports, engineering, project management, construction supervision, and coordination with Indian Railways for approvals. The collaboration aims to enhance rail-based logistics for petroleum product movement by developing new sidings, improving rail connectivity, and upgrading existing infrastructure, leveraging RITES' expertise in railway infrastructure.

announcements.subject: Other Restructuring
announcements.detail: Renaissance Global Limited has informed the Exchange about internal Corporate Restructuring of Renaissance Global Limited (RGL) Group Companies.
announcements.ai_summary: Renaissance Global Limited (RGL) announced on August 7, 2026, that its Board of Directors has approved an internal corporate restructuring of the RGL Group of Companies. The objective is to simplify the global corporate footprint and optimize the cross-border holding structure. The approved transactions include the transfer of 19% of Renaissance FMI Inc (USA) stock from RGL to Renaissance Global Brands Inc (RGBI) (USA) via a Share Swap Agreement. Additionally, RGL will make an investment in Renaissance Retail Limited (RRL) (India) through a Share Purchase Agreement and/or Share Swap Agreement. Furthermore, 100% of Renaissance Global Brands Inc (RGBL) (USA) stock will be transferred from RGL to RRL (India) through a Share Purchase Agreement and/or Share Swap Agreement. Upon completion, RFMI, USA will become a wholly owned subsidiary of RGBI, USA, which in turn will become a wholly owned subsidiary of RRL, India. There are no stated benefits to the promoter or promoter group from this restructuring.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release, titled "Commissioning of 2 GW Power Electronics Manufacturing Facility at Ratlam"
announcements.ai_summary: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited has announced the commissioning of its 2 GW Power Electronics Manufacturing Facility at Ratlam, Madhya Pradesh, as per a press release dated August 07, 2026. This facility is a significant part of the company's greenfield manufacturing expansion project, aimed at enhancing its integrated manufacturing capabilities within the rooftop solar value chain. Following the commissioning of a 2 GW solar panel manufacturing facility in May, this power electronics facility marks another milestone. The new facility will produce solar inverters, UPS systems, and related solutions, increasing Fujiyama's total power electronics manufacturing capacity to 4.2 GW. This expansion is expected to strengthen the company's position in the rapidly growing rooftop solar market.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Limited has announced a strong performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1 FY27), as detailed in their press release dated August 07, 2026. Revenue from operations increased by 18% year-on-year (YoY) to ₹987 million and by 13% quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) to ₹987 million. EBITDA rose 21% YoY and 50% QoQ to ₹387 million, with an EBITDA margin of 39%. Profit after tax (PAT) saw a significant increase of 87% YoY and 53% QoQ, reaching ₹350 million. The core gases revenue grew 20% YoY and 13% QoQ to ₹973 million, driven by volume growth from merchant plants. The company expects revenue contribution from the East India onsite plant from Q2 FY27. Capex guidance for FY27 is ₹2,500 million.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Chandan Healthcare Limited has informed the Exchange about Divestment of Company's Entire Stake in Chandan Pharmacy Limited to Chandan Hospital Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Chandan Healthcare Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 6, 2026, approved the divestment of the company's entire 53.56% stake, representing 1,72,992 equity shares of Rs. 10 each, in Chandan Pharmacy Limited. This stake is being sold to Chandan Hospital Limited, a group company, for a consideration of Rs. 16,77,10,554.24. This valuation is proportionate to the total valuation of Rs. 31,31,36,168, based on an independent valuation report dated August 3, 2026, issued by Mr. Gaurav Gaurav. Upon completion, Chandan Pharmacy Limited will cease to be a subsidiary of Chandan Healthcare Limited. The company believes this transaction will allow for a sharper focus on its core, higher-margin diagnostics business and provide investors with a cleaner view of the diagnostics segment's performance. The proceeds from the sale are expected to strengthen the balance sheet and provide capital for growth.

The allotment was made to Ms. Nikhita Nishid Shah, a non-promoter, upon receipt of the balance 75% of the issue price per warrant. announcements.ai_summary: Blue Water Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about the acquisition of 18,800 shares, representing 47% of the paid-up capital/voting rights, in Blue Water Logistics Company Limited, Thailand. This acquisition makes the Target Company an Associate Company of Blue Water Logistics Limited, subject to mutually agreed terms and applicable statutory/regulatory approvals. The company also clarified that a previous disclosure regarding a "Branch Office" in Thailand was an inadvertent oversight and typographical error; the entity is indeed an Associate Company. This clarification is made in reference to a letter dated August 04, 2026. The company assures that due care will be exercised in future disclosures.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Innomet Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Innomet Advanced Materials Limited has received a Purchase Order (PO) dated 06.08.2026, with order number P.O 3010364383, from FEDERAL-MOGUL GOETZE (INDIA) LTD. The total consideration for this purchase order amounts to Rs. 1,08,96,120/-. This information is being disclosed as per Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Chandan Healthcare Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Chandan Healthcare Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 6, 2026, approved the divestment of the company's entire 53.56% stake in Chandan Pharmacy Limited. This stake, comprising 1,72,992 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, will be sold to Chandan Hospital Limited, a group company. The transaction is valued at Rs. 16,77,10,554.24/-, based on a total valuation of Rs 31,31,36,168/- as per an independent valuation report dated August 3, 2026. Upon completion, Chandan Pharmacy Limited will cease to be a subsidiary of Chandan Healthcare Limited. The company believes this divestment will allow for a sharper focus on its core, higher-margin diagnostics business and provide investors with a cleaner view of its diagnostics operations.

announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations ) intimating NCLT order dated 06th August 2026 directing the meeting of Equity Shareholders, Secured Creditors and Unsecured Creditors of the Company in connection with the Scheme of Amalgamation.
announcements.ai_summary: Ugro Capital Limited has received an order from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, dated 06th August 2026. This order directs the convening of meetings for the Equity Shareholders, Secured Creditors, and Unsecured Creditors of Ugro Capital Limited. These meetings are scheduled to consider and approve the Scheme of Amalgamation between Profectus Capital Private Limited and Ugro Capital Limited. The meetings will be held within 90 days of the NCLT order being uploaded and can be conducted via video conferencing or other audio-visual means. The Scheme is still subject to applicable regulatory and other approvals.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: VORTEX ENGINEERING SECURES PURCHASE ORDER FROM ONE OF THE INDIA S LARGESTPUBLIC SECTOR BANKS FOR 540 ATM MACHINES
announcements.ai_summary: Vakrangee Limited's subsidiary, Vortex Engineering Private Limited, has secured a significant purchase order from one of India's largest Public Sector Banks. The order is for the supply, installation, and maintenance of 540 ATM machines and 1 KVA UPS for a period of 5 years. The total contract value for this order is ₹37.79 crore. This new order is a repeat order for Vortex Engineering and strengthens Vakrangee Group's presence in the financial access ecosystem, particularly in rural and underbanked markets. Vortex Engineering has a strong track record, having supplied over 15,500 ATM machines and holding 9 patents in the field of ATMs and cash dispensers.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Escorts Kubota Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015'.
announcements.ai_summary: Escorts Kubota Limited has announced its intention to launch a new tractor series under the Kubota brand shortly. This disclosure, made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, signifies an expansion of the company's product offerings. The new tractor series will be introduced under the established Kubota brand, indicating a strategic move to leverage this brand's market presence. Further details regarding the specific models or launch timeline are not provided in this announcement.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Jindal Worldwide Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015  - Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Jindal Worldwide Limited's Board of Directors has approved a Rights Issue to raise up to ₹650 crore from existing shareholders. This move is a key part of the company's strategy to become debt-free by FY27, aiming for a significant turnaround. The funds raised will be used to strengthen the company's balance sheet and reduce its debt. To facilitate this Rights Issue, shareholder consent will be sought for an increase in the company's authorised share capital. The company believes this deleveraging will provide greater operational flexibility, improve its credit profile, and enhance long-term value for stakeholders. Mr. Amit Agrawal, Vice Chairman & Managing Director, stated that this is a defining moment to fundamentally reset the balance sheet and invest in growth.

announcements.subject: General Updates

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Hindalco Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Hindalco Industries Limited has provided an update on the proposed acquisition of AluChem Companies, Inc. by its step-down wholly owned subsidiary, Aditya Holdings LLC. Due to a partial shutdown of the U.S. federal government, the statutory timelines under the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS) review framework were tolled, impacting the ongoing review process. The acquisition is now anticipated to reach finality by September 2, 2026, subject to receiving final clearance. Hindalco Industries Limited will provide further updates as material developments occur or upon completion of the review process.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Dabur India Limited has informed the Exchange about Update- Stay order granted today by Hon'ble Delhi High Court, on FSSAI''s prohibitory order dated August 03, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Dabur India Limited has received a stay order from the Hon'ble Delhi High Court on August 07, 2026, against the prohibitory order issued by FSSAI on August 03, 2026. The FSSAI order had prohibited the use of "100%" in certain food products and their sale. This stay order provides a temporary reprieve for Dabur India Limited. Any material updates regarding this matter will be communicated to the stock exchanges in due course.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: AVSL Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: AVSL Industries Limited has provided an update regarding the recovery of seized stock and cash pursuant to a court order. The company had imported 2,240 bags of PVC Processing Aid, valued at ₹72,89,555, which were stored at a third-party warehouse. In June 2026, a portion of this consignment could not be located, leading the company to suspect misappropriation. Following legal action, authorities recovered 400 bags of PVC Processing Aid (10 metric tons) and ₹13,50,000 in cash. The company has been granted interim custody of this recovered material and cash, subject to furnishing surety and bond. While this provides partial relief, the matter remains under investigation, and the final financial impact and responsible parties are yet to be determined.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Globus Spirits Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations 2015  Press Release - w.r.t. QIP Launch.".
announcements.ai_summary: Globus Spirits Limited has successfully raised ₹200 crore through a Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) by allotting 23,80,952 equity shares at an issue price of ₹840 per equity share. This capital raise aims to broaden its institutional shareholder base and strengthen financial flexibility. The proceeds will be used for repayment/prepayment of outstanding borrowings and for general corporate purposes, supporting the company's consumer-led growth strategy. The company welcomes new and existing institutional investors, reflecting confidence in its strategy and execution. The QIP further strengthens the company's balance sheet and its ability to accelerate its consumer business while maintaining financial discipline.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Kewal Kiran Clothing Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "extract ad".
announcements.ai_summary: Kewal Kiran Clothing Limited has issued a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "extract ad". The announcement does not contain specific financial figures, share counts, or transaction details relevant to investors. It is a general update regarding a press release. No further actions or approvals are mentioned in the provided text.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Hindalco Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: Hindalco Industries Limited announced on August 7, 2026, a proposed capacity expansion at its Kuppam unit in Chitoor, Andhra Pradesh. The existing capacity is up to 20 Kilo-Tonnes Per Annum, with a utilization rate between 80% and 85%. The company plans to add up to 10 Kilo-Tonnes Per Annum of capacity, with the addition expected to be completed by FY2029. The investment required for this expansion is ₹768 crores, excluding interest during construction of ₹40 crores. The expansion will be financed through internal accruals and debt, driven by the rationale of growth and expansion. This information is in accordance with SEBI Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed the Mahindra Group's Sustainability Report for the Financial Year 2025-26
announcements.ai_summary: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has released its Sustainability Report for the Financial Year 2025-26 on August 7, 2026. This report covers Mahindra & Mahindra Limited and its group subsidiaries, providing a comprehensive overview of the Group's sustainability strategy, initiatives, and performance across environmental, social, and governance (ESG) parameters. The report emphasizes the interconnectedness of business resilience and planetary resilience, highlighting investments in clean energy, electrification, resource efficiency, and inclusive growth. The company's philosophy of "Rise" guides its commitment to creating a future that is more resilient, inclusive, and Planet Positive, demonstrating that doing good business and doing good go hand in hand. The report is also available on the company's website.

announcements.company: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited
announcements.subject: Diversification/Disinvestment
announcements.detail: Paras Defence And Space Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about the proposal of Divestment of its equity stake in Krasny Paras Defence Technologies Private Limited [Associate]
announcements.ai_summary: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 07, 2026, approved the divestment of its entire equity stake in its Associate, Krasny Paras Defence Technologies Private Limited. The company holds 47.50% stake, comprising 5,22,500 equity shares of face value ₹ 10 each. Following the transaction, Krasny Paras will no longer be an Associate of Paras Defence. The turnover contributed by Krasny Paras to the consolidated turnover of Paras Defence in FY 25-26 was ₹ 0.59 Crore, representing 0.12%, and its net worth as of March 31, 2026, was ₹ 0.63 Crore. The agreement for sale is yet to be entered into, and the consideration amount is not finalized, pending due diligence. The proposed transaction is expected to be completed by December 31, 2026. The buyer is Krasny Defence Technologies Limited, which is not part of the promoter or promoter group.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Kabra Extrusion Technik Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 07, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Kabra Extrusion Technik Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 07, 2026, approved a preferential issue of up to 32,00,000 equity shares. These shares will have a face value of ₹ 5 each and will be issued at a price of ₹ 375 per share, including a premium of ₹ 370. The total amount raised from this issue will be up to ₹ 120,00,00,125. The issue is open to persons/entities belonging to the 'Promoter & Promoter Group and Non-Promoters Category'. The company will convene an Extraordinary General Meeting on September 02, 2026, to seek shareholder approval for this preferential issue, which is also subject to other necessary statutory and regulatory approvals.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: JSW Dulux Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Dulux Limited has disclosed an order received from the Tamil Nadu GST Department on August 06, 2026. The order, issued under Section 73 of the CGST Act/Rules, 2017, pertains to excess Input Tax Credit (ITC) claimed for the period April 2017 to March 2018. The total liability, including a penalty, amounts to Rs. 1,75,699/-. The company is currently in the process of responding to the authorities within the stipulated timeframe. This order is subject to further submissions and potential outcomes.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting Held on Friday, 07th August, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Jindal Worldwide Limited, in a meeting held on August 07, 2026, approved raising funds up to Rs. 650 Crore through a rights issue of equity shares. The face value of these shares is Rs. 1/- each. The specific terms, including the issue price and rights entitlement ratio, will be decided by a newly constituted 'Securities Issuance Committee'. This fundraising is subject to regulatory and statutory approvals, including those from SEBI. Additionally, the Board approved increasing the company's authorized share capital from Rs. 101 Crore to Rs. 146 Crore, which requires member approval at the upcoming 40th Annual General Meeting. The company will notify shareholders of the record date subsequently.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Sattva Engineering Construction Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Sattva Engineering Construction Limited has announced the receipt of a Purchase Order from M/s. Bimbo Bakeries India Private Limited, a subsidiary of Grupo Bimbo. The order, referencing Purchase Order No. PO26-0009686, was received via email on August 6, 2026. This marks the company's re-entry into the Industrial & Utility Building segment. The significant terms of the contract include 90% payment against RA Bills within 15 days of invoice submission, and 10% after commissioning and handover against a Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) valid for the Defect Liability Period (DLP). The DLP is set at 1 Year, with a Liquidated Damages (LD) clause of 0.5% per week, capped at 10% of the balance work after the agreed timeline, including a 10-day grace period. The order is for the construction of civil works and facilities at Bimbo Bakeries' manufacturing plant in Serkadu Village, Tamil Nadu, and is to be executed within 20 Weeks.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Utssav CZ Gold Jewels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 07, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Utssav CZ Gold Jewels Limited has announced the allotment of 8,50,000 equity shares of Face Value Rs. 10 each, fully paid up, to Mr. Pankajkumar Hastimal Jagawat. This allotment is a consequence of the conversion of 8,50,000 convertible warrants previously held by him. The allotment was made for cash, with the receipt of the remaining exercise price of Rs. 166.5 per warrant, aggregating to Rs. 14,15,25,000. These newly allotted shares will rank pari passu with existing equity shares. The company's paid-up share capital has increased from Rs. 24,14,80,000 (24,14,800 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 each) to Rs. 24,99,80,000 (2,49,98,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 each). The Board Meeting where this was approved commenced at 12:30 PM and concluded at 1:30 PM on August 7, 2026.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: JK Tyre & Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: JK Tyre & Industries Limited announced that its Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 7, 2026, approved an investment of up to Rs. 1.38 Crore for acquiring a 26% equity stake in STTY RE Banmore Ltd. (formerly STFN RE Ltd.). STTY RE Banmore Ltd. was incorporated on March 10, 2025, and its name was changed on July 8, 2026. For the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026, STTY RE Banmore Ltd. had a turnover of Nil, a Profit after Tax of ₹(0.62) lakh, and a Net Worth of ₹0.38 lakh. STTY RE Banmore Ltd. is a subsidiary of Sago Trading Ltd., a Promoter Group Constituent, and the acquisition is being conducted on an "arm's length" basis, approved by the Audit Committee. The target entity operates in the Power Generation using solar energy industry, and JK Tyre & Industries Limited plans to utilize STTY RE Banmore Ltd. to set up a 6 MWp Solar Power Project under the Captive Power Route. The entire capital expenditure of approximately Rs. 17.70 Crore for the project will be met by STTY RE Banmore Ltd.

announcements.subject: Public Announcement - Buyback of Shares
announcements.detail: Industrial Investment Trust Limited has informed the Exchange about public Announcement - Buyback of Shares - Submission of Public Announcement for buyback of 16,66,667 (Sixteen Lacs Sixty Six Thousand Six Hundred and Sixty Seven) fully paid-up Equity Shares of the face value of INR 10 each ( Equity Shares ) of Industrial Investment Trust Limited (the  Company ) at a price of INR 150/- (Indian Rupees One Hundred And Fifty Only) per Equity Share payable in  cash  on proportionate basis ( Buyback ).
announcements.ai_summary: Industrial Investment Trust Limited has submitted a Public Announcement for a buyback of its equity shares. The company plans to buy back 16,66,667 fully paid-up equity shares, each with a face value of INR 10. The buyback price is set at INR 150 per equity share, payable in cash on a proportionate basis. This buyback was approved by the Board of Directors on August 5, 2026. The Public Announcement, dated August 6, 2026, was released on August 7, 2026, in compliance with SEBI regulations and published in the Financial Express and Jansatta newspapers.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Limited has announced the opening of a new store. The new "Kalamandir" format store was launched in Mysore, Karnataka, on August 7, 2026. This expansion is in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company has informed the stock exchanges about this development for their records.

announcements.company: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited
announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited has informed the Exchange about monthly business performance update for the month of July 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited has released its monthly business performance update for the month of July 2026. The update includes key metrics such as Retail Weighted Received Premium (RWRP), Annualized Premium Equivalent (APE), Retail APE, New Business (NB) premium, and NB sum assured. For July 2026, RWRP stood at ₹15.38 billion with a year-on-year growth of 13.4%, and APE was ₹21.36 billion with a year-on-year growth of 14.6%. NB premium for the month was ₹48.66 billion, showing a 21.3% year-on-year growth, while NB sum assured reached ₹4,896.65 billion, with a 31.8% year-on-year growth.

announcements.detail: Regarding update on health of Mr. Mohansingh Parmar, Managing Director of the Company'.
announcements.ai_summary: GSM Foils Limited has provided an update regarding the health of its Managing Director, Mr. Mohansingh Parmar.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited, through its subsidiary L&T Energy Hydrocarbon Offshore (LTEH Offshore), has secured a batch of orders from Oil & Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC). These orders are for the Pipeline Replacement Project (PRP-X) and the Well Head Platforms Project, located off India's west coast. The PRP-X project involves the engineering, procurement, construction, installation, and commissioning (EPCIC) of multiple subsea pipeline segments and associated modifications. The Well Head Platforms Project entails the EPCIC of four Well Head Platforms. LTEH Offshore, a provider of integrated EPCIC solutions for the offshore oil and gas industry, will leverage its in-house engineering capabilities and fabrication facilities for these projects. Mr. Parthasarathi Chatterjee, Senior Vice President & Head – L&T Energy Hydrocarbon Offshore, stated that these orders reaffirm LTEH Offshore's position as a trusted partner in developing India's offshore energy infrastructure.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: GK Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "GK Energy Limited Delivers Strong Q1 Performance with Revenue at Rs. 505 Crore and PAT up 62%".
announcements.ai_summary: GK Energy Limited announced strong financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting Revenue from Operations of ₹505.19 crore, a significant 71.10% increase from ₹295.27 crore in the same quarter last year. The company's EBITDA rose by 47.72% year-on-year to ₹86.11 crore, up from ₹58.30 crore in Q1 FY2025–26. Profit After Tax (PAT) demonstrated robust growth, reaching ₹59.67 crore, a 61.55% increase compared to ₹36.94 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. This performance was driven by strong execution under renewable energy frameworks, increasing demand for decentralized solar infrastructure, and the company's low-capex operating model. The company's Chairman & Managing Director, Mr. Gopal Kabra, highlighted the opportunities in India's renewable energy transition and the company's commitment to delivering sustainable growth.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bank Of Baroda has informed the Exchange about Outcome of Capital Raising Committee Meeting
announcements.ai_summary: Bank of Baroda's Capital Raising Committee, in a meeting held on August 07, 2026, approved the raising of additional capital up to Rs. 6,000 crore. This capital will be raised through Additional Tier 1 (AT1) and/or Tier II bonds, in suitable tranches, up to March 31, 2027, and potentially beyond if deemed expedient. This decision follows the Board of Directors' approval on May 08, 2026. The meeting commenced at 11:00 AM and concluded at 12:05 PM. The bank has informed the stock exchanges as per regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "Press Release on expansion of the iconic bakery and confectionery brand, Flurys, inNorth India with a new café in Gurugram".
announcements.ai_summary: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited announced on August 07, 2026, the expansion of its iconic bakery and confectionery brand, Flurys, into North India. The brand has opened its first standalone café in Gurugram, located at Galleria Market, marking a significant step in its regional growth strategy. Flurys, founded in 1927, is set to open more tea rooms and cafés across Delhi and other parts of North India. The new Gurugram café features signature confections, beloved classics, and European café culture, including unique offerings like the Nolen Gur Crème Brûlée. This expansion aligns with Flurys' approach to evolving for a new generation while preserving its heritage.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: SAAKSHI: Saakshi Medtech and Panels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the receipt of In-Principle Approval from NSE for the proposed preferential issue.
announcements.ai_summary: Saakshi Medtech and Panels Limited has received In-Principle Approval from the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on August 06, 2026, for a proposed preferential issue. The approval, valid for fifteen days from the NSE's letter date, allows the company to issue 20,22,940 equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each on a preferential basis. This issue is part of a share swap transaction with Laxmi Engineering Industries Bhopal Pvt Ltd, where the shares will be allotted to the promoters at an issue price of Rs. 207 per equity share for consideration other than cash. The company has informed the exchange in compliance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Godrej Consumer Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "Double-digit revenue and profit growth ".
announcements.ai_summary: Godrej Consumer Products Limited (GCPL) announced its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 07, 2026. The company reported a strong performance with consolidated sales growing by 19% year-on-year, driven by an underlying volume growth of 9%. Standalone business sales increased by 12% with 7% volume growth, while Indonesia sales grew by 15% and Africa, USA, and Middle East sales saw a significant jump of 47% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA grew by 14% year-on-year, and consolidated net profit increased by 11% year-on-year. The company's Managing Director and CEO, Sudhir Sitapati, highlighted the strong start to FY27, with healthy underlying earnings quality despite commodity pressures.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Audit Committee and Independent Director Report certifying the distribution of proceeds regarding fractional entitlements pursuant to scheme of Amalagamation '.
announcements.ai_summary: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Limited (VDCL) has submitted reports from its Audit Committee and Independent Directors, dated August 6, 2026, certifying the distribution of proceeds related to fractional entitlements. This distribution is a consequence of the Scheme of Amalgamation between Medinova Diagnostic Services Limited (MDSL) and VDCL, which was sanctioned by the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Hyderabad bench. The reports confirm the details of the proceeds distributed to eligible shareholders of MDSL who were entitled to fractional shares. This action is in accordance with SEBI's Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/POD-2/P/CIR/2023/93 dated June 20, 2023.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sarda Energy & Minerals Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd. has announced an update regarding its wholly-owned subsidiary, Sarda Metals & Alloys Ltd. The Directorate General of Foreign Trade, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, has upgraded the subsidiary's status from a Three Star Export House to a Four Star Export House. This upgraded status is valid for a period of five years, commencing from June 30, 2026, and will remain in effect until June 30, 2031. This upgrade signifies a positive development for the subsidiary's export performance and recognition.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Religare Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Religare Enterprises Limited (REL) has informed the Exchange about a regulatory update concerning its Scheme of Arrangement. The scheme involves the transfer of REL's demerged undertaking to Religare Finvest Limited (RFL) and requires approvals from various regulatory bodies. While the Scheme received observation letters with no objection from NSE and no adverse observations from BSE on July 7, 2026, and was initially approved by the Board on February 14, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has not acceded to the applications seeking its no-objection or prior approval. REL received this communication on August 6, 2026, and RFL on August 07, 2026. The company and RFL will engage with the RBI to provide further necessary clarifications.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: UCO Bank has informed the Exchange regarding 'Revision in Benchmark Rates'.
announcements.ai_summary: UCO Bank has announced revisions to its benchmark rates, effective from August 7, 2026. The bank's Asset Liability Management Committee (ALCO) reviewed and decided on these changes. While the Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR) for all tenors, including Overnight, One Month, Three Month, Six Month, and One Year, remains unchanged at 7.90%, 8.20%, 8.45%, 8.70%, and 8.80% respectively, other benchmark rates have been adjusted. Specifically, the 3-month TBLR has been revised from 5.30% to 5.25%, and the 12-month TBLR from 5.80% to 5.65%. The UCO G-Sec Rate (1 year) has increased from 5.57% to 5.80%, and the 10-year G-Sec Rate YTM % p.a. has moved from 6.85% to 6.96%. Rates for 6-month TBLR, Repo Linked Rates (UCO Float and UCO Prime), Base Rate, and BPLR remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Religare Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015-Update on Demerger Scheme
announcements.ai_summary: Religare Enterprises Limited (REL) has announced that its application for a Scheme of Arrangement, involving the transfer of its demerged undertaking to Religare Finvest Limited (RFL), has not been acceded to by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). This follows earlier approvals from NSE and BSE for the scheme, which was initially approved by REL's Board on February 14, 2026. Both REL and RFL received communication from the RBI on August 6, 2026, and August 7, 2026, respectively, stating that their requests for no-objection or prior approval have not been granted. The company and RFL will now engage with the RBI to provide further clarifications as required.

announcements.ai_summary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited (MTNL) has informed the exchanges on August 7, 2026, regarding its default in the payment of principal installments and interest to various banks as of July 31, 2026. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, and SEBI Circular No SEBI/HO/CFD/CMD1/CIR/P/2019/140. The total outstanding principal amount is Rs 7,794.34 crore, with an overdue interest of Rs 1,780.27 crore, bringing the total current default amount to Rs 9,574.61 crore. The defaults have occurred with lenders including Union Bank of India, Bank of India, Punjab National Bank, State Bank of India, UCO Bank, Punjab and Sind Bank, and Indian Overseas Bank, with the earliest NPA date being August 12, 2024.

announcements.subject: Rights Issue
announcements.detail: Sunrest Lifescience Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 07, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 1 : 1, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 1 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 35 per share.
announcements.ai_summary: Sunrest Lifescience Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 7, 2026, approved a Rights Issue. The company will issue equity shares in a ratio of 1:1, meaning one new equity share for every one equity share held. The issue price for these shares has been fixed at Rs 35 per share. The Board also approved the Letter of Offer, application form, and other necessary documents for filing with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and other relevant authorities. These documents will be dispatched to eligible equity shareholders as of the Record Date, which is August 10, 2026. The company has also been allotted the International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) INE0PLZ20020 for the Rights Entitlement.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Blue Star Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Investor Update for the First Quarter ended on June 30, 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: Blue Star Limited has released its Investor Update for the First Quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 7, 2026. The company experienced revenue growth of 13.3% to Rs 3,377.92 crore in Q1FY27 compared to Rs 2,982.25 crore in Q1FY26, despite facing headwinds such as commodity price escalation and currency depreciation. EBITDA for the quarter was Rs 174.95 crore, with a margin of 5.2%, a decrease from Rs 199.99 crore (6.7% margin) in the prior year's quarter. Net profit de-grew by 15.1% to Rs 102.53 crore from Rs 120.82 crore in Q1FY26. However, the carried-forward order book as of June 30, 2026, increased by 13.5% to Rs 7,764.38 crore.

announcements.ai_summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Škoda Digital S.R.O. of the Czech Republic on August 6, 2026. The purpose of this agreement is to explore potential business opportunities in the field of railway digitalization solutions, specifically focusing on AI-based systems and other advanced digital rail technologies. This MOU does not involve any commercial terms at this stage, as it is solely for the mutual exploration of collaboration. Neither party has any shareholding in the other, and Škoda Digital S.R.O. is not related to Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited's promoters or group companies. Both parties have agreed to negotiate in good faith towards a definitive agreement, which will be subject to their respective managements' approvals.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: JSW Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about the update on the acquisition of Maruti Clean Coal and Power Limited by the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Energy Limited has provided an update on its acquisition of Maruti Clean Coal and Power Limited (MCCPL). The company has finalized the purchase of 100% of MCCPL's equity shares, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. MCCPL operates a 300 MW thermal power plant in Chhattisgarh, with a long-term Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) for 195 MW (net) and additional capacity sold in the merchant market. The acquisition was valued at an Enterprise Value of ₹1,410 crore, with the asset showing an FY26 EBITDA of approximately ₹279 crore. This move is expected to be EBITDA and PAT-accretive, reduce net leverage, and strengthen the company's balance sheet. The total installed capacity of JSW Energy Limited now stands at 14,835 MW.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: JSW Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "JSW Energy Completes 300 MW Maruti Clean Coal Acquisition, taking installed capacity to 14,835 MW".
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Energy Limited has successfully completed the acquisition of 100% equity shares of Maruti Clean Coal and Power Limited (MCCPL), which operates a 300 MW thermal power project in Chhattisgarh. MCCPL has now become a wholly-owned subsidiary of JSW Energy Limited. This acquisition was initially announced on June 13, 2026, with definitive agreements signed with Kolahai Infotech Private Limited and SFI Parcel Services Private Limited. The transaction values MCCPL at an Enterprise Value of ₹1,410 crore, with its FY26 EBITDA reported at approximately ₹279 crore. The acquired asset is expected to be EBITDA and PAT-accretive from the outset, while also reducing JSW Energy's net leverage. With this acquisition, JSW Energy Limited's total installed capacity has increased to 14,835 MW.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Z-Tech (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "Z-Tech expands its geographical footprint as its latest park, Tawi Wonderland, is inaugurated by the Hon ble Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, Shri Omar Abdullah. This is Jammu s first Waste-to-Art park".
announcements.ai_summary: Z-Tech (India) Limited has announced the inauguration of its latest park, Tawi Wonderland, in Jammu and Kashmir on August 7, 2026. The park was inaugurated by the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, Shri Omar Abdullah, and is noted as Jammu's first Waste-to-Art park. This initiative, developed under the Jammu Smart City Mission, transforms discarded municipal waste into illuminated artistic attractions. Following the positive reception and encouragement from dignitaries, Z-Tech (India) Limited is now exploring opportunities to develop similar projects in other major urban centers across Jammu & Kashmir, including Srinagar, Katra, Anantnag, and Baramulla, aligning with the company's vision of "One District. One Park."

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Indusind Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 07, 2026, titled "EazyDiner and IndusInd Bank Launch a Lifetime-Free Credit Card That Saves You Rs. 21,495 a Year to Eat Out".
announcements.ai_summary: IndusInd Bank Limited has announced the launch of a lifetime-free credit card in partnership with EazyDiner, titled "EazyDiner and IndusInd Bank Launch a Lifetime-Free Credit Card That Saves You Rs. 21,495 a Year to Eat Out." This credit card, the EazyDiner IndusInd Bank Platinum Rupay Credit Card, offers significant savings on dining and convenience of UPI payments. Cardholders can save up to ₹21,495 annually with zero fees, including ₹18,000 in extra dining savings through the EazyDiner app, a complimentary BookMyShow 'Buy One Get One' movie ticket monthly (worth ₹2,400 annually), and a three-month complimentary EazyDiner Prime membership (worth ₹1,095). EazyDiner Prime members receive guaranteed discounts of 25% to 50% at over 40,000 premium restaurants. The card also allows linking to UPI apps for payments at QR codes while earning points. The press release was issued on August 7, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sona Blw Precision Forgings Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Reg 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations
announcements.ai_summary: Sona Blw Precision Forgings Limited has received an order dated July 31, 2026, from the Office of the Commissioner of GST & Central Excise, Chennai. The order demands the reversal/recovery of Input Tax Credit (ITC) amounting to INR 2,15,03,832/- along with applicable interest. Additionally, a penalty of INR 21,05,192/- has been imposed under section 73(9) read with section 122(2)(a) of the CGST/TNGST Act 2017. The alleged violation pertains to the non-reversal of ITC claimed in respect of excess GST charged by certain suppliers between April 2022 and March 2024. The company is evaluating the order and proposes to avail appropriate legal remedies, including filing an appeal, and does not expect any material adverse financial or operational impact based on its preliminary assessment. The order was received by the company on August 6, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Varroc Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "Varroc Engineering Revenue shows strong growth of  30% YoY and Highest ever PBT before exceptional items and JV post divestment".
announcements.ai_summary: Varroc Engineering Limited announced its un-audited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 06, 2026. The company reported a consolidated revenue from operations of ₹26,342 million for Q1 FY27, representing a year-on-year growth of 29.9%, which is the highest quarterly revenue post-divestment. Profit Before Tax (PBT) before exceptional items and JV profit for Q1 FY27 stood at ₹1,132 million, an increase of 38% compared to ₹822 million reported in Q1 FY26. This strong performance reflects the resilient Indian economy and the positive environment in the automotive sector. The press release also highlights growth across various automotive segments, including a 91% YoY growth in EV 2W volume.

announcements.subject: Amendment to AOA/MOA
announcements.detail: Aequs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
announcements.ai_summary: On August 07, 2026, the Board of Directors of Aequs Limited approved an alteration to Clause III(A) (Main Objects) of the Company's Memorandum of Association (MOA). This amendment is intended to align the company's main objects with the business activities planned under a proposed Scheme of Amalgamation. The scheme involves the amalgamation of Aequs Limited with Aerostructures Manufacturing India Private Limited, Aequs Engineered Plastics Private Limited, and Aequs Force Consumer Products Private Limited. announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities

announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Aequs Limited, in a meeting held on August 07, 2026, approved the adoption of the Aequs Restricted Stock Unit Plan 2026 ("RSU 2026"). This plan will utilize 1,500,000 ungranted stock options from the existing Aequs Employee Stock Option Plan 2025 pool. The Board also approved an amendment to the Aequs Employee Stock Option Plan 2025 to extend its benefits to eligible employees of associate and joint venture companies, both existing and future, in India and abroad. These initiatives are subject to the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021, and require the approval of the Company's shareholders at the upcoming Annual General Meeting. The Board also approved the notice for the 26th Annual General Meeting.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Parag Milk Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "Parag Milk Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Press Releases on Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 6, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Parag Milk Foods Limited's Board of Directors has approved a significant expansion of its cheese manufacturing capacity, doubling it from the current 60 metric tonnes per day (MT/day) to approximately 120 MT/day. This brownfield expansion is a strategic move to capitalize on the growing demand for cheese and whey protein, with an estimated capital expenditure of Rs. 105 Cr. The funding for this expansion will be a mix of internal accruals and debt, and it is projected to be completed by FY28. This initiative aims to strengthen the company's position in the cheese market, where its 'Go Cheese' brand holds a substantial ~35% market share, and also cater to institutional clients. The Indian cheese market is forecast to grow substantially, from INR 129 billion in 2025 to INR 620 billion by 2034, driven by urbanization and changing food preferences. Additionally, the company announced the appointment of Mr. Rakesh Kothari as Chief Financial Officer & Key Managerial Personnel, effective August 7, 2026. The Board also approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter ended June 30, 2026.

These Notes are proposed to be listed on the Global Securities Market of India International Exchange IFSC Limited and the Debt Securities Market of NSE IFSC Limited. The issuance is a RegS Drawdown and is not intended for distribution in the United States.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: The Indian Hotels Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 07, 2026, titled "IHCL ACCELERATES PORTFOLIO EXPANSION; REACHES 628 HOTELS MARKS A YEAR OF INORGANIC & SUSTAINED ORGANIC GROWTH WITH 373 IN OPERATIONS AND A PIPELINE OF 255 HOTELS".
announcements.ai_summary: The Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) announced on April 07, 2026, that it has reached a portfolio of 628 hotels, marking a year of significant inorganic and sustained organic growth. The company currently has 373 hotels in operation and a pipeline of 255 hotels. IHCL's Executive Vice President - Real Estate & Development, Ms. Suma Venkatesh, highlighted a record of 250 signings through inorganic and organic growth, expanding its brandscape and presence in the midscale segment. This includes the onboarding of Claridges Collection, acquisition of a controlling stake in Atmantan, and Brij hospitality. Ginger has expanded its portfolio to over 250 hotels across 150+ locations. IHCL also signed 19 hotels under the Taj brand, including one in Cairo and a 500-key hotel in Patna. The company opened over 30 hotels this fiscal year, entering new markets and strengthening its presence in existing ones, bringing the total operating hotels to 373 with over 33,000 rooms. IHCL is on track to achieve its goal of a 700-hotel portfolio under its "Accelerate 2030" strategy.

announcements.subject: Press Release

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Birla Estates Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited, has achieved bookings exceeding ₹1,600 crores for its luxury project, Birla Arika Phase 2 in Gurugram. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: EFC (I) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 07, 2026, titled "EFC ACHIEVES OVER 90 PERCENT OCCUPANCY IN RECORD TIME AT SPRINT BUSINESS CENTER WAKADEWADI, PUNE, A FULLY OWNED ASSET OF THE COMPANY.".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: EFC (I) Limited has announced a significant operational milestone with its fully owned asset, Sprint Business Center in Wakadewadi, Pune, achieving over 90% occupancy in record time.
