The Board also approved the potential issuance of equity shares and other eligible securities, including convertible instruments and warrants, through private placement or Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP). Additionally, Mr. Deenadayal Tripurasetty was appointed as an Additional Director (Non-Executive & Independent Director) effective May 06, 2026, pending shareholder approval for a five-year term.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Servotech Renewable Power System Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Servotech Renewable Power System Limited has secured a new order from South Central Railway - Vijayawada Division for a 1415 kW solar rooftop project. This project involves the design, engineering, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of grid-connected rooftop solar systems across multiple railway sites. The order is to be executed within 6 months of the Letter of Acceptance (LOA) being issued. This is a domestic order, and the company's promoters or group companies have no interest in the entity awarding the contract.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Apcotex Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Apcotex Industries Limited's Board of Directors, in their meeting held on May 6, 2026, approved a change in project entity from Amplus Ceres Solar Private Limited to Amplus Ampere Private Limited due to power unavailability. The Board has authorized company officials to negotiate, execute, and sign revised transaction documents, including a Non-Binding Term Sheet, Binding Term Sheet, Power Purchase Agreement (PPA), Share Acquisition and Shareholders Agreement (SASHA), and any other necessary agreements. This decision is a continuation of their earlier intimation dated March 27, 2026. Detailed disclosures regarding this acquisition are enclosed as Annexure B.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Intimation of proposed incorporation of Step-Down Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company of Dabur India Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Dabur India Limited has announced the proposed incorporation of a new step-down wholly owned subsidiary in the United States of America. This new entity, to be named "Trustline Brands Inc." or a similar name, will be incorporated in Delaware, USA. Upon incorporation, it will become a step-down wholly owned subsidiary of Dabur International Limited, which is itself a wholly owned subsidiary and a related party of Dabur India Limited. The event occurred on May 6, 2026, at 10:21 A.M. (JST). This information is being disclosed under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The details of this incorporation are available on the company's website, www.dabur.com.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 06, 2026, approved a significant capacity expansion. The company will be adding a New Lamination Line (SCF) with a capacity of 1200 LSF/P.A. at its facility in Waluj, Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar, Maharashtra. The project cost for this expansion is estimated at Rs. 191 Crores plus applicable taxes. The new capacity is expected to be added within 14 months. This expansion is part of the company's strategy to enhance its production capabilities in specialty films. The existing capacity of the company is 4200 LSF/P.A., which is currently at optimum utilization.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: KPIT Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of strategic stake in Cymotive Technologies LTD ("Cymotive"), a leading automotive cybersecurity specialist headquartered in Israel.
announcements.ai_summary: KPIT Technologies Limited's Board of Directors, in their meeting on May 6, 2026, approved the acquisition of a strategic stake in Cymotive Technologies LTD. Cymotive is a leading automotive cybersecurity specialist based in Israel, founded by senior Israeli cybersecurity leaders and CAR/AD, the automotive software company of the Volkswagen Group. Cymotive specializes in end-to-end vehicle lifecycle cybersecurity, including secure architecture, threat modeling, intrusion detection, continuous monitoring, and regulatory compliance. This acquisition is expected to strengthen KPIT's capabilities in automotive cybersecurity, a critical area for the company, and enhance its value proposition to global OEMs by enabling an integrated approach to embedding cybersecurity into automotive systems.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Vishal Mega Mart Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: The subsidiary of Vishal Mega Mart Limited, Airplaza Retail Holdings Private Limited, has received an order from the Court of Additional District Magistrate, Rampur. This order imposes a penalty of Rs. 2,00,000/- on the subsidiary. The penalty stems from a violation of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, where a sample of 'Turmeric Powder' collected from the subsidiary's Rampur store on April 03, 2025, was found not to be in confirmation with the relevant provisions of the law. Specifically, Rs. 80,000/- has been imposed on the Store Manager and Rs. 1,20,000/- on the subsidiary. The company has been informed of this order on May 05, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Nandani Creation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 06, 2026, titled company with its  Brand  Jaipur Kurti  accelerates Expansion with Signing of Two Prime Franchisee Stores in key commercial hubs of India- Karol Bagh and Rohini, Delhi. ".
announcements.ai_summary: Nandani Creation Limited, through its brand "Jaipur Kurti," is expanding its retail presence by signing agreements for two new franchisee stores in Karol Bagh and Rohini, Delhi. These stores are scheduled to open in May 2026 and will offer the latest collections for women's wear brands "Jaipur Kurti" and "Amaiva." The company aims to strengthen its direct retail and sales channel network and provide an omnichannel experience to customers. The franchise partner for these locations has a proven retail background, successfully operating over 12 Patanjali stores. This expansion signifies Nandani Creation's commitment to strategic growth through experienced partners and prime retail locations, enhancing accessibility for its customer base.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: NMDC Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: NMDC Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates. No specific details beyond this general notification were provided in the filing.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Further to the intimation letter dated August 02, 2025, we hereby inform that the Companyhas completed an additional investment of ₹ 2.5 million in the wholly owned subsidiaryof the Company   Advanced Nutrazyme Private Limited [ ANPL ] by way of investing inthe rights issue of 2,50,000 Equity Shares of ₹ 10 each. With this, the investment of theCompany in ANPL has increased to ₹3 million divided into 3,00,000 Equity Shares of ₹10each.
announcements.ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited has completed an additional investment of ₹2.5 million in its wholly owned subsidiary, Advanced Nutrazyme Private Limited (ANPL). This investment was made through a rights issue of 2,50,000 Equity Shares, each with a face value of ₹10. Following this additional investment, the company's total investment in ANPL has increased to ₹3 million, represented by 3,00,000 Equity Shares of ₹10 each. This update follows a previous intimation dated August 02, 2025.

announcements.subject: Amendment to AOA/MOA
announcements.detail: Wakefit Innovations Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
announcements.ai_summary: Wakefit Innovations Limited has informed the Exchange about the approval from its members to alter the Memorandum of Association (MOA) through a postal ballot by remote e-voting. This amendment includes modifications to existing object clauses and the inclusion of new object clauses. The changes primarily focus on expanding the company's business activities related to designing, manufacturing, marketing, and trading of furniture, furnishing products, home and lifestyle products, and appliances. The company will also be involved in providing assembly, installation, after-sales services, and transportation. The information regarding these amendments is available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 06, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 6, 2026, approved raising funds up to ₹1,000 Crores through Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) or other permissible modes. The company also plans to raise funds via a preferential issue of equity shares to Non-Promoters. These fundraising initiatives are subject to shareholder approval and other necessary regulatory and statutory approvals. The funds will be raised through public and/or private offerings of equity shares and/or convertible securities in one or more tranches. The Board meeting commenced at 5:00 PM and concluded at 7:00 PM.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Canara Bank has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: Canara Bank has been penalized by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) with a monetary penalty of Rs. 2,49,658.00 (Rupees Two Lakh Forty Nine Thousand Six Hundred Fifty Eight Only). This penalty was imposed for the violation of Delayed Reporting by a Currency Chest. The bank received this order on June 6, 2026. The impact on the bank's financial and operational activities is limited to the amount of the penalty itself. Canara Bank has informed the stock exchanges about this regulatory action.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: The Karnataka Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 06, 2026, titled "Karnataka Bank Conducts Third Party Products Conference 2026-27".
announcements.ai_summary: The Karnataka Bank Limited has issued a press release dated June 6, 2026, titled "Karnataka Bank Conducts Third Party Products Conference 2026-27". The conference, held at the bank's Head Office in Mangaluru on June 6, 2026, brought together senior leadership, regional teams, and channel partners to strategize for the financial year 2026-27. Shri Raghavendra S Bhat, Managing Director & CEO, presided over the event and emphasized leveraging Third Party Products (TPP) for fee-based income, the importance of customer protection and transparency, ethical selling practices, and the role of technology. The conference also aligned with the Government of India's vision of "Insurance for All by 2047" and focused on enhancing collaboration between banks and insurance partners.

announcements.subject: Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.detail: Creative Newtech Limited received Advance Work Order (AWO) from BSNL for BharatNet Middle Mile Network Project in Odisha Telecom Circle having a total project value of approximately INR 3,194.83 Crore
announcements.ai_summary: Creative Newtech Limited, along with its consortium partner, has been awarded an Advance Work Order (AWO) by Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) for the BharatNet Middle Mile Network Project in the Odisha Telecom Circle. The total project value is approximately INR 3,194.83 crore. This significant order encompasses the Design, Supply, Construction, Installation, Upgradation, Operation, and Maintenance of the BharatNet Middle Mile Network within the Odisha Telecom Circle. This project is a key component of the Government of India's BharatNet programme, aimed at strengthening the digital infrastructure in rural and underserved areas. The details of this AWO are disclosed as per Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Amendment to AOA/MOA
announcements.detail: Pudumjee Paper Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
announcements.ai_summary: Pudumjee Paper Products Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 6, 2026, approved an alteration to the Memorandum of Association (MOA) of the company. This amendment involves the insertion of a new incidental object clause to enable the economically efficient utilization of surplus electricity generated from the company's renewable energy facilities. The company will now be permitted to sell, supply, transfer, trade, or otherwise deal with such surplus electricity through power exchanges, distribution licensees, government authorities, or other legally permissible modes. This alteration to Clause 3(b) of the MOA is subject to the approval of the company's shareholders through a Postal Ballot.

announcements.subject: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
announcements.detail: BirlaNu Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on disclosure dated July 10, 2025, submitted under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations )
announcements.ai_summary: BirlaNu Limited has provided an update on a Standby Letter of Credit (SBLC) previously disclosed on July 10, 2025. The SBLC, issued in favor of ICICI Bank UK PLC, Germany Branch, was originally for an aggregate amount of up to EUR 10.73 million to secure working capital demand loan facilities for BirlaNu International GmbH, Germany. The validity of this SBLC has been extended by an additional 3 months, increasing its total validity period from 12 months to 15 months. All other terms and disclosures related to the SBLC remain unchanged. This update is in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Geekay Wires Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Geekay Wires Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: North Eastern Carrying Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 06, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: North Eastern Carrying Corporation Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 06, 2026, approved the allotment of 45,00,000 equity shares. These shares, with a face value of Rs. 10 each, will be allotted at an issue price of Rs. 15.18 per share to Mr. Sunil Kufnar Jain, a Promoter of the Company. The total value of this allotment is approximately Rs. 6.83 Crores. This allotment has been made on a preferential basis through the conversion of unsecured loans into equity. The board meeting commenced at 4:00 PM and concluded at 4:25 PM.

announcements.subject: Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: Ritco Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates for the month of May 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Ritco Logistics Limited has reported its Monthly Business Updates for May 2026, announcing the securing of new business worth approximately ₹10.07 crores. This achievement reinforces the company's presence across key industrial routes and highlights its expanding geographic footprint and focus on long-term client partnerships. Within the Transportation Vertical, Ritco secured a 1-year contract with SLR worth ₹3.50 crore for movement from Bellary to Rajkot, strengthening its position in the PSU and bulk commodity logistics segment. Additionally, two contracts were secured with RINL, valued at a combined ₹5.80 crore: a 1-year contract from Raipur to various destinations (₹4.40 crore) and a 6-month contract from Hyderabad to Ahmedabad and Chennai (₹1.40 crore). The company also secured a 1-year contract with BHEL for movement from Trichy to Satpura.

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
announcements.ai_summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has entered into a Shareholders’ Agreement to invest in a newly incorporated Canadian Corporation, named 17989377 Canada Inc. The agreement was executed with Difgen Holdings LLC and Mr. Sukhad Juneja. Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited will hold a 45% equity stake in the Canadian Corporation, with Difgen Holdings LLC also holding 45% and others holding the remaining 10%. The purpose of this investment is to establish a platform for the development, commercialization, distribution, and marketing of pharmaceutical products specifically for the Canadian market. The agreement includes significant terms such as the right to appoint directors, a first right to share subscription in case of capital issuance, and the right to restrict changes in the capital structure.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: AVRO INDIA LIMITED has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
announcements.ai_summary: Avro India Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 06, 2026, approved the sale of certain plant and machineries. The sale will be conducted at fair value on June 30, 2026, and the buyer will be Avro Recycling Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Avro India Limited. This transaction is subject to the approval of the shareholders. The board meeting commenced at 3:00 PM and concluded at 3:59 PM.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: NIBE Limited has informed the Exchange about Nibe Defence and Aerospace Limited, subsidiary of Nibe Limited ( the Company ) has been granted license for manufacturing and proof testing of Firearms by Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India
announcements.ai_summary: Nibe Limited has announced that its subsidiary, Nibe Defence and Aerospace Limited, has been granted a license by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. This license permits the manufacturing and proof testing of firearms and ammunition under the provisions of the Arms Act, 1959, and related rules. The grant of this license is significant as it expands Nibe Limited's capabilities within the defence manufacturing value chain, particularly for Arms of Caliber above 12.7 MM, reinforcing its commitment to developing advanced technologies and precision-engineered systems.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Patel Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Press for Opening of 52 Store Patel R Mart.
announcements.ai_summary: Patel Retail Limited has announced the opening of its 52nd Patel's R Mart store located at H. No 457 Bapgaon, Bhiwandi. This new store, launched on June 06, 2026, is part of the company's strategy to expand its presence in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR). The company aims to provide customers with convenient access to groceries and daily essentials. This expansion is expected to strengthen Patel Retail Limited's market position in a rapidly developing residential and commercial area.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Beardsell Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Court order protecting company's IPR'.
announcements.ai_summary: Beardsell Limited has received a court order from the Hon’ble High Court of Madras on June 4, 2026, which dismisses an appeal filed by Beardsell Polymers Private Limited and others. This dismissal upholds a perpetual injunction previously granted in favor of Beardsell Limited, protecting its corporate name/trademark "BEARDSELL" against infringement and passing off. The company had initiated legal proceedings against the opponents for trademark infringement. The court's decision will not have any material financial impact on Beardsell Limited.

announcements.subject: Other Restructuring
announcements.detail: Update of NIIT Learning Solutions (Canada) Limited a step down wholly owned subsidiary of the Company - Capital Restructuring
announcements.ai_summary: NIIT Learning Systems Limited has announced a capital restructuring of its step-down wholly owned subsidiary, NIIT Learning Solutions (Canada) Ltd. ("NIIT Canada"). The restructuring involves reducing the par value of NIIT Canada's common shares by CAD 5,058,493.00, returning this amount to its sole shareholder, NIIT (Ireland) Limited. This action is being taken because NIIT Canada's capital requirements have reduced following the completion of a large training contract in September 2025, and its current cash balance of CAD 9.9 million materially exceeds its operational needs. Post-restructuring, NIIT Canada's share capital will be CAD 4,138,767, with 9,197,260 common shares of par value CAD 0.45 each. This restructuring is not expected to have any material adverse impact on the financials of the subsidiaries or the consolidated financials of the company.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Bhageria Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Bhageria Industries Limited has clarified to the stock exchanges regarding a significant increase in its trading volume. The company stated that it has been prompt in disclosing all material information as required by SEBI regulations. To the best of their knowledge, there are no undisclosed material events or information that could be influencing the share price. Therefore, the observed increase in trading volume is considered to be purely market-driven. The company reiterated its commitment to timely disclosure of any unpublished price sensitive information upon its crystallization and approval.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: EMA Partners India Limited has informed the Exchange about further to our intimation dated July 02, 2026 disclosing payment of acquisition consideration in terms of the Share Purchase and Subscription Agreement ( SPSA ) executed for the acquisition of 100% equity shares of M/s Talent Hired The Job Store Private Limited ( Taggd ), including subscription of equity shares under Private Placement via preferential basis. We would like to inform you that EMA Partners India Limited ( EMA Partners ) has been allotted today i.e. July 06, 2026, 66,691 Equity Shares of face value ₹ 1 (Rupee One) each, issued by Taggd to the Company at a price of ₹ 1,141 per share (including premium of ₹ 1,140 per share), aggregating Rs. 7,60,94,431/- (Rupees Seven Crores Sixty Lakhs Ninety-Four Thousand Four Hundred and Thirty-One only) on a preferential basis, in terms of the SPSA.
announcements.ai_summary: EMA Partners India Limited has been allotted 66,691 equity shares of its subsidiary, M/s Talent Hired The Job Store Private Limited ("Taggd"), on July 6, 2026. These shares, with a face value of ₹ 1 each, were issued by Taggd to EMA Partners at a price of ₹ 1,141 per share, which includes a premium of ₹ 1,140 per share. The total consideration for this allotment amounts to ₹ 7,60,94,431 (Rupees Seven Crores Sixty Lakhs Ninety-Four Thousand Four Hundred and Thirty-One only). This allotment is part of the acquisition process as per the Share Purchase and Subscription Agreement (SPSA) and was made on a preferential basis.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about update on  Acquisition.
announcements.ai_summary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited has provided an update regarding its acquisition of TruBridge, Inc. ("Target") by its wholly-owned subsidiary, Inventurus Knowledge Solutions, Inc. ("IKS Inc."). As of July 6, 2026, the Company has issued a corporate guarantee for a maximum aggregate amount of USD 603,750,000 in favor of various lenders, including Citibank N.A., Deutsche Bank AG Singapore Branch, and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., Hong Kong Branch, as well as Axis Trustee Services Ltd. as the security agent. This guarantee is in relation to financing facilities of up to USD 575,000,000 to be availed by IKS Inc. The corporate guarantee will be treated as a contingent liability. The proceeds from these facilities will be used for refinancing certain existing indebtedness of IKS Inc., including the refinancing of a USD 70,000,000 term loan facility availed in FY 2025-26, for which the Company's existing corporate guarantee of USD 77,000,000 has now been released.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: RITES Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation regarding Major Order Secured.
announcements.ai_summary: RITES Limited has secured a significant order for the "Supply and Commissioning of 4000 HP Cape Gauge Diesel Electric Locomotives" from Volantis Asset Finance (Pty) Ltd., South Africa. This international contract is valued at USD 35,820,000 (Thirty-Five Million Eight Hundred and Twenty Thousand US Dollars). The execution of this order is expected to take 20 months from the signing of the contract agreement. RITES will sign the formal contract agreement after due diligence is completed by both parties, at which point the order will be added to the company's order book. This order does not involve related parties.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Press Release   Taurian MPS Strengthens International Market Access with New Dealer Appointments Across Kenya, Ghana, Thailand and Nepal.
announcements.ai_summary: Taurian MPS Limited has announced the appointment of new authorized dealers in Kenya, Ghana, Thailand, and Nepal, as of July 6, 2026. This strategic move aims to bolster the company's international distribution network and enhance its market presence across East Africa, West Africa, South-East Asia, and South Asia. These new partnerships are expected to improve customer engagement, application support, and after-sales service in these key regions. The company, a specialized engineering manufacturer of processing equipment, believes this expansion will allow it to serve customers more effectively by being closer to their operational locations. This initiative is part of Taurian MPS's broader strategy to strengthen its global reach and cater to demand in the aggregates, mining, infrastructure, and mineral-processing sectors.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Greenleaf Envirotech Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Greenleaf Envirotech Limited has received three Letters of Acceptance (LOAs) from M/s. Water Corporation of Odisha (WATCO) with an aggregate value of ₹14.63 Crores, excluding applicable GST. These orders are for the design, drawing, construction, testing, and commissioning of a Sewerage System, Sewage Treatment Plant (STP), and Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP), including Operation and Maintenance (O&M). The contracts require the submission of an Initial Security Deposit and, where applicable, an Additional Performance Security. The agreement is to be executed within 15 days from the date of the Letter of Acceptance. The execution timeline for these orders is 12 Months. The company will also need to comply with the terms and conditions of the respective tender documents.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: BGR Energy Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: BGR Energy Systems Limited has informed the stock exchanges that the resolution seeking approval for an increase in its Authorized Share Capital and consequent alteration to the Capital Clause of the Memorandum of Association of the Company, which was put to vote through a Postal Ballot Notice dated May 25, 2026, has been deemed passed. The e-voting period concluded on Sunday, July 5, 2026. Following this approval, the Authorized Share Capital of the Company has been increased from ₹1,00,00,00,000/- (Rupees One Hundred Crores only) divided into 10,00,00,000 equity shares of face value ₹10/- each, to ₹2,00,00,00,000/- (Rupees Two Hundred Crores only) divided into 20,00,00,000 equity shares of face value ₹10/- each.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Disclosure regarding interview/podcast of Chairman & Managing Director with Sumit Mehrotra, former Senior Anchor @cnbcawaaz
announcements.ai_summary: Anlon Healthcare Limited has disclosed that its Chairman & Managing Director, Mr. Punitkumar Rasadia, participated in an interview/podcast with Sumit Mehrotra, former Senior Anchor at CNBC Awaaz, on July 06, 2026. During the interview, Mr. Rasadia discussed various aspects of the company, including its business performance, industry outlook, market conditions, operational updates, growth strategy, future plans, capital expenditure, financial performance guidance, potential acquisitions/disinvestments, and capacity expansion. The company has confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information (UPSI) was shared during this interaction. Links to access the interview/podcast have been provided.

announcements.subject: Options to purchase securities
announcements.detail: Trident Limited has informed the Exchange about Options to purchase securities
announcements.ai_summary: Trident Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 06, 2026, has approved and recommended the Trident Employees Stock Option Plan 2026 for eligible employees of the Company, its Subsidiary Company(ies), and Associate Company(ies). This plan requires shareholder approval as per the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021. The plan encompasses 25,47,97,783 stock options, each exercisable into one equity share of face value Re. 1/- fully paid-up, representing 5% of the total issued capital as of July 6, 2026. The pricing formula for the exercise price is set at the closing market price of the shares on the recognized stock exchange on the day before the grant date. The Board meeting commenced at 11:00 A.M. IST and concluded deliberations on this item at 6:00 P.M. IST.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting - Trident Employees Stock Option Plan 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Trident Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 06, 2026, has approved and recommended the Trident Employees Stock Option Plan 2026 for eligible employees of the company and its subsidiaries and associates. This plan is subject to the approval of the shareholders and is in compliance with the SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021. The plan covers a total of 25,47,97,783 stock options, which are exercisable into an equal number of equity shares of face value Re. 1/- each. This represents 5% of the total issued capital as of July 6, 2026. The exercise price for these options will be equal to the closing market price of the shares on the recognized stock exchange on the date immediately preceding the grant date. The Board meeting commenced at 11:00 A.M. IST and concluded deliberations on this agenda item at 6:00 P.M. IST, with the meeting continuing for other agenda items.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Repro India Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Repro India Limited announced the dissolution of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Repro DMCC, effective from July 06, 2026. Repro DMCC, incorporated under the Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC), United Arab Emirates, had not commenced any business operations since its incorporation and was not considered a material subsidiary of the Company. The official dissolution certificate was received from the DMCC authority on July 06, 2026, confirming the completion of the dissolution process. Consequently, Repro DMCC has ceased to be a wholly-owned subsidiary of Repro India Limited. The Company expects no material impact on its business operations, revenue, or financial position due to this dissolution.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Blue Jet Healthcare Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of Investment and Finance Committee'.
announcements.ai_summary: Blue Jet Healthcare Limited's Investment and Finance Committee, at its meeting held on July 6, 2026, from 7:00 pm to 7:30 pm, approved the preliminary placement document dated July 6, 2026, for a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) of equity shares with a face value of ₹ 2 each. The committee approved the floor price for the Issue at ₹ 531.70 per Equity Share, determined as per SEBI ICDR Regulations. The Issue was authorized to open on July 6, 2026, with July 6, 2026, also fixed as the 'relevant date'. The Company retains the discretion to offer a discount of not more than 5% on the floor price, as previously approved by shareholders on June 17, 2026. The final Issue price will be determined in consultation with the book running lead managers.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Om Power Transmission Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Om Power Transmission Limited's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on July 06, 2026, from 04:00 P.M. (IST) to 04:50 P.M. (IST), approved the proposal for incorporating a new subsidiary company in India, subject to requisite statutory and regulatory approvals. The Board also approved seeking shareholder approval for two special businesses via Postal Ballot through remote e-voting. These include borrowing money in excess of paid-up share capital and free reserves under Section 180(1)(c) of the Companies Act, 2013. Additionally, shareholders' approval will be sought to create a charge, mortgage, pledge, hypothecation, or security on the Company’s assets up to Rs. 1000 crores. announcements.detail: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 06, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited (EIEL) has secured two prestigious Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) projects from Uttar Pradesh Jal Nigam (Rural) under the Government of India's Namami Gange Programme, with a combined order value of ₹256.92 crore. These projects, announced on July 06, 2026, expand EIEL's HAM portfolio to five projects. The first project involves the development of a 45 MLD Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) and associated infrastructure at Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyay Nagar (DDU Nagar), valued at ₹126.78 crore (excluding GST). The second project is for a 60 MLD STP and associated infrastructure at Lohta, Varanasi, valued at ₹130.14 crore (excluding GST). announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Sunlite Recycling Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 06, 2026, titled "Press Release for Capacity Expansion".
announcements.ai_summary: Sunlite Recycling Industries Limited announced a strategic capacity expansion worth ₹37 Crore, to be completed by Q1 FY2027-28. This expansion will be executed through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Sunlite Aluminium Private Limited, and will also involve expanding value-added products at the parent company. The copper products capacity will increase from 25,000 MT to 45,000 MT, adding 20,000 MT with an investment of ₹24 Crore. The value-added products capacity will grow from 2,540 MT to 3,540 MT, adding 1,000 MT with an investment of ₹13 Crore, including advanced copper processing technologies and an Upward Continuous Casting (Upcast) Machine. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Raymond Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 06, 2026, titled "Raymond Limited Appoints Former BEL CMD Bhanu Prakash Srivastava as CEO   Defence to Lead Next Phase of Strategic Growth".
announcements.ai_summary: Raymond Limited has announced the appointment of Bhanu Prakash Srivastava as the Chief Executive Officer – Defence, effective July 06, 2026. This appointment signifies Raymond's strategic expansion into India's defence and aerospace sector. Bhanu Prakash Srivastava brings nearly four decades of experience from Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), where he served as CMD. During his tenure at BEL, he was instrumental in tripling market capitalization from approximately ₹51,000 crore to ₹1.5 lakh crore, securing over ₹55,000 crore in new orders, and launching more than 100 products. He also led mission-critical programs in radar, naval and sonar systems, missiles, electronic warfare, and tactical communications. In his new role at Raymond, he will spearhead the company's defence business, focusing on strategic vision, operational roadmap, and growth for a technology-led defence platform, aligning with India's 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' initiative.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bluspring Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 06, 2026, titled "A Bluspring subsidiary, STEAG India s order book stands at ₹5,100 Cr with new deals".
announcements.ai_summary: Bluspring Enterprises Limited has announced that its subsidiary, STEAG Energy Services (India) Private Limited (STEAG India), has secured new deals that bring its total order book to ₹5,100 Crores. These new contracts are long-term deals, with an approximate contract value across 5 years. The contracts include a deal with BALCO worth ₹2,050 Crores for comprehensive O&M of a 1,740 MW plant, commencing July 01, 2026. Additionally, STEAG India has secured contracts with Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited worth ₹1,219 Crores for comprehensive O&M of a 1,800 MW plant (3x600 MW), and with Vedanta Power Limited worth ₹406 Crores. Another contract with Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited (VAML) is valued at ₹1,437 Crores. STEAG India, which was acquired by Bluspring on May 21, 2026, for an equity value of ₹180 Crore, offers end-to-end services to power plants and manages 7GW of power plants globally.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Vikram Solar Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 06, 2026, titled "Press Release for successful roll out of the First Module from the New Manufacturing Mega Facility in Tamil Nadu".
announcements.ai_summary: Vikram Solar Limited has announced the formal commissioning of its new manufacturing mega-facility located at Gangaikondan, Tamil Nadu, as of July 06, 2026. This marks the successful roll-out of the first solar module from this plant. The new facility, spread across 6 lakh sq. ft., is a greenfield module manufacturing plant and represents a significant step in Vikram Solar's expansion journey and commitment to strengthening India's domestic solar manufacturing capabilities. It is a highly automated plant built to the latest standards, incorporating advanced automation and digital manufacturing technologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and reliability. The facility is expected to generate employment for over 1,500 skilled professionals and supports regional industrial development. This expansion is part of the company's progression, building on the recent launch of its Vallam plant and laying the groundwork for planned vertical integration across cell, wafer, and ingot manufacturing.

announcements.detail: Info Edge (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 06, 2026, titled "Naukri Scales AI-Powered Recruitment Solutions Across Enterprises and Jobseekers".
announcements.ai_summary: Info Edge (India) Limited has announced the broad rollout of its AI-powered recruitment platform, including AI-Rex, Talent Pulse, and PremiumX, across enterprises and for jobseekers. This expansion leverages deep AI capabilities and over two decades of proprietary hiring data to move Naukri beyond recruitment listings into recruiter productivity, talent intelligence, and premium hiring solutions. The company invested approximately ₹70 crore in AI during FY26, with an expected investment of ₹150 crore in FY27. The platform currently holds over 118 million candidate profiles, with approximately 25,000 new profiles added daily, and serves about 13 million monthly active users. This initiative aims to strengthen customer outcomes, create new revenue opportunities, and enhance Naukri's long-term competitive advantage.

announcements.detail: Oberoi Realty Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 05, 2026, titled "Press release titled ''Oberoi Realty Achieves Gross Bookings of Approximately Rs. 8,109 Crore at Three Sixty North, Gurugram''".
announcements.ai_summary: Oberoi Realty Limited has announced a significant milestone with gross bookings of approximately ₹8,109 crore at its luxury residential development, Three Sixty North, in Gurugram. This project marks the company's expansion into the National Capital Region (NCR). The bookings encompass approximately 13.52 lakh sq. ft. of RERA carpet area, equivalent to 23.10 lakh sq. ft. of saleable area. Three Sixty North, situated on 14.8 acres on Golf Course Extension Road, Sector 58, Gurugram, is designed to include seven residential towers, landscaped spaces, a clubhouse, and a retail boulevard. Chairman and Managing Director, Mr. Vikas Oberoi, highlighted the strong customer trust and the company's commitment to quality and disciplined execution as key drivers for this success. This achievement reinforces Oberoi Realty's strategy of focusing on product excellence rather than geographical limitations.

announcements.ai_summary: Kay Cee Energy & Infra Limited has secured a work order from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for utility shifting works related to the 765 KV Anta –Phagi Transmission Line Circuit–II at Ch. 311+700 KMs of the Delhi –Mumbai Expressway. The project involves height raising above NH-4E under DVE Package-10. NHAI has directly engaged the company for this project, which will be executed under the supervision of Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Prasaran Nigam Limited (RVPNL). The scope of work includes balance tower erection and stringing works, material delivery, dismantling of existing towers, and allied civil and erection works. The aggregate value of this work order is ₹9,05,74,647/-, inclusive of GST.

announcements.subject: Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up
announcements.detail: Interarch Building Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up
announcements.ai_summary: Interarch Building Solutions Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 6, 2026, unanimously approved entering into a Joint Venture Agreement with ER Steel Inc., Canada. This joint venture aims to explore and develop the Open Web Steel Joists (OWSJ) business for the North American market. The collaboration will establish a platform for jointly evaluating the design, engineering, manufacturing, and supply of OWSJ products. Interarch will lead engineering, detailing, manufacturing, and quality compliance from India, while ER Steel will focus on market development, customer relationships, sales, and marketing in Canada and North America. Detailed disclosures regarding this arrangement are provided in Annexures A and B.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release'.
announcements.ai_summary: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has announced the appointment of Gaurav Bhatnagar as its new Chief TPA Officer, effective August 6, 2026. In this role, Bhatnagar will lead the company's TPA business, focusing on operational excellence, enhancing member experience through technology, and strengthening partnerships with insurers and hospitals to drive future growth. Bhatnagar brings over 18 years of experience in commercial operations and scaling businesses across various sectors, including his recent role at Coupang Advertising in Seoul and as Senior Vice President at Permira. His appointment is expected to accelerate Medi Assist's growth and redefine the healthcare experience for its members across India. He will be based in Bengaluru and report to the CEO.

announcements.ai_summary: Danish Power Limited has been awarded a new order worth approximately INR 37.17 crores (inclusive of GST) from a Renewable EPC Company. The order is for the supply of Ester Filled Inverter Duty Transformers. The execution of this order is expected to take between 5 to 6 months. The scope of the contract includes the design, manufacture, testing, and supply of these transformers. The promoter and promoter group of Danish Power Limited do not have any interest in the entity awarding the order, and the transaction does not fall within related party transactions.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Ksb Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: KSB Limited has announced a capacity expansion at its Shirwal plant by constructing an additional shed on newly acquired adjacent land. This expansion is driven by future business visibility in the Energy (Conventional and Nuclear) and Oil and Gas sectors. The new shed will be utilized for manufacturing Project pumps, along with associated activities like Piping, Painting, and Packing. The existing Shirwal plant has a capacity of approximately 1200 pumps per year and is operating at 90% utilization. The proposed capacity addition is estimated at 20%, expected to be completed by 2027. The investment required for this expansion is tentatively INR 400 Million, which will be financed solely through internal accruals.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Fino Payments Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about performance update for July 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Fino Payments Bank Limited provided a business performance update for July 2026. Deposit accounts opened increased by 9% year-on-year to 3,27,771, and renewal income grew by 5% to ₹23.6 crore. Average total deposits saw a 12% increase to ₹2,766 crore, while digitally active customers rose by 21% to 66.3 lakh. FinoPay active customers showed significant growth of 34% to 8.9 lakh. However, transaction business throughput decreased by 25% to ₹3,074 crore, and digital payments services B2B UPI P2M throughput was down 100% from ₹3,200 crore. Loan referral disbursements surged by 304% to ₹241 crore. The bank is progressing with its Small Finance Bank implementation within RBI's stipulated timelines.

announcements.detail: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about intimation regarding sanction of the Scheme of Arrangement and Amalgamation between Triumph Offshore Private Limited and Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited and their respective shareholders and creditors by the Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench.
announcements.ai_summary: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited (formerly Reliance Naval and Engineering Limited) has received sanction from the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench, for the Scheme of Arrangement and Amalgamation. This scheme involves Triumph Offshore Private Limited (Transferor Company) and Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited (Transferee Company), along with their respective shareholders and creditors. The order sanctioning the scheme was passed on August 6, 2026, under Sections 230 to 232 read with Section 66 and Section 52 of the Companies Act, 2013. The Scheme will become effective upon the filing of the certified copy of the order with the Registrar of Companies, Ahmedabad, Gujarat. This announcement follows a previous letter dated June 22, 2026.

announcements.detail: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited (KOEL) announced on August 6, 2026, that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Kirloskar Americas Corporation (KAC), will acquire 4900 units, representing a 49% stake, in Engines LPG, LLC dba Wildcat Power Gen, USA. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Muthoot Microfin Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "Press release".
announcements.ai_summary: Muthoot Microfin Limited has announced its unaudited financial performance for the first quarter of the financial year 2026-27. The company achieved its highest-ever Q1 disbursements at Rs. 2,645 crore, a 48.9% year-over-year growth, with its Assets Under Management (AUM) increasing by 18.0% YoY to Rs. 14,457 crore. Profitability improved significantly, with Profit After Tax (PAT) reaching Rs. 81.3 crore, a 12x increase YoY and 14% QoQ. Credit Cost improved by 173 bps YoY to 2.6%, and the company's overall Collection Efficiency (CE) improved to 97.97%. CRISIL upgraded the company's long-term credit rating to AA-/Stable and reaffirmed its A1+ CP rating. The Non-JLG portfolio expanded to 24%, and gold loan disbursements commenced under a co-lending partnership with Muthoot Fincorp Limited.

The company's Managing Director noted operational resilience in delivering this revenue growth amidst a complex market. KFIL is a listed entity where Kirloskar Industries Limited holds a material stake.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Britannia Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "Britannia s Consolidated Sales for the quarter grew 9.5%, while Net profit grew 14.1%".
announcements.ai_summary: Britannia Industries Limited reported its consolidated sales for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, at Rs 4,964 Crores, marking a 9.5% growth year-over-year. Net profit for the same period stood at Rs 593 Crores, an increase of 14.1%. The company's standalone sales also grew by 10.0% compared to the previous year. The Chief Executive Officer & Managing Director highlighted navigating increased fuel and shipment costs due to the West Asia conflict, achieving healthy volume and value growth, with profits growing ahead of topline. Key categories saw positive sequential momentum, with mid-teens revenue growth exiting the quarter, driven by e-commerce and General Trade, supported by increased advertisement and promotion spends. Innovation, such as the Dubai Kunafa Croissant, and localized campaigns also contributed to the performance. The company's international business also saw a sequential recovery.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Capacity Expansion - Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh
announcements.ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited's Management Committee of the Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 06, 2026, approved a significant capacity expansion project in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh. This expansion includes setting up a 66 MN BL per year Dual Mode Distillery and increasing the bottling capacity from the current ~6 MN cases per year to an aggregate of ~13 MN cases per year. This will involve establishing a new automated bottling unit and refurbishing the existing molasses distillery. This initiative follows the company's earlier approval on January 16, 2026, for the acquisition of assets in Uttar Pradesh to enhance its Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) bottling and distillery capacities.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Dabur India Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: Dabur India Limited has provided an update regarding actions taken or orders passed by the United States Food & Drug Administration (US FDA). Following an inspection of its Silvassa manufacturing plant that identified data integrity and maintenance lapses, the US FDA had issued an Import Alert (IA) 66-40 on June 10, 2026. Dabur India Limited has now received a Warning Letter from the US FDA, which summarizes these events. The company has been proactively engaging with the US FDA, providing regular progress updates on its corrective and preventive action plan. Substantial mitigating actions, including data integrity training and closure of infrastructure gaps within 30 days, have been completed. The US FDA has requested further details on the remediation activities.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: TVS Motor Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "TVS MOTOR ACCELERATES GLOBAL EV EXPANSION WITH TVS IQUBE LAUNCH IN KENYA, THE FIRST INDIAN OEM TO INTRODUCE A PREMIUM ELECTRIC SCOOTER IN AFRICA".
announcements.ai_summary: TVS Motor Company Limited has announced its strategic expansion into the African market with the launch of its premium electric scooter, the TVS iQube, in Kenya on August 6, 2026. This marks TVS Motor as the first Indian Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) to introduce a premium electric scooter in Africa. The TVS iQube is equipped with a 4.6 kW hub-mounted motor, achieving a top speed of 82 km/h and accelerating from 0-40 km/h in 4.2 seconds. The scooter is available in two variants: TVS iQube 3.5 with a 3.5 kWh battery offering a real-world range of 115 kms, and TVS iQube 2.2 with a 2.2 kWh battery providing a range of 75 kms. The launch leverages the extensive after-sales network of Car & General, a company with over two decades of presence in Kenya. This move aligns with TVS Motor's commitment to sustainable mobility on a global scale.

The Industrial business diversified into new segments, while the Distribution & Aftermarket business saw strong growth driven by service and a successful high-horsepower repowering project. announcements.ai_summary: Nucleus Software Exports Limited has announced the launch of FinnOne Neo® 9.0 and FinnAxia® 9.0 in Vietnam at the first Nucleus Synapse Vietnam event on August 06, 2026. This event, attended by over 100 CXOs and senior leaders from Vietnam's banking, financial services, and technology sectors, focused on "AI in Lending: From Potential to Performance in Vietnam". The new versions of their digital lending and transaction banking platforms are designed to enhance AI-powered lending and connected transaction banking, offering features like AI-based credit decisioning, pre-delinquency prediction, and enhanced SME loan capabilities. Nucleus Software is strengthening its commitment to the Vietnamese market through this dual-platform launch.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: PTC Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "Aerolloy Technologies Signs Landmark Agreement with Airbus for Titanium Castings for A320neo, A330neo and A350 Programmes  ".
announcements.ai_summary: PTC Industries Limited has issued a press release on August 06, 2026, announcing a significant agreement between its wholly-owned subsidiary, Aerolloy Technologies, and Airbus. Aerolloy Technologies will develop, produce, and supply Titanium castings for Airbus aircraft programmes, specifically for the A320neo, A330neo, and A350 programmes. The agreement outlines a pathway to serial production, subject to Airbus's qualification and programme requirements. This partnership validates PTC ONE™ and supports the "Make in India, Make for the World" initiative by creating advanced Titanium aerospace components in India for global commercial aircraft. Aerolloy will supply fully machined, ready-to-fit Titanium castings.

announcements.detail: Entertainment Network (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "Updated Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Entertainment Network (India) Limited has issued a revised press release dated August 6, 2026, to correct a typographical error in their Q1FY27 financial results announcement. The digital business revenue for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, was incorrectly stated as "Rs. 21.1 Crores" and has now been corrected to "Rs. 31.1 Crores." All other information in the original press release remains unchanged. The company reported consolidated revenues of ₹113 Crores and EBITDA growth of 42% to ₹8.7 Crores for Q1FY27. The digital business revenue of ₹31.1 Crores represents a 43.3% year-on-year increase and now accounts for 30.2% of the company's total revenue.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tilaknagar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "Tilaknagar Industries & Imperial Blue Record Highest-Ever Sales in Karnataka in July 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Tilaknagar Industries Limited, on August 6, 2026, issued a press release announcing that both Tilaknagar Industries and its brand Imperial Blue recorded their highest-ever sales in Karnataka during July 2026. The company achieved sales of 3 lakh cases in Karnataka, representing a year-on-year growth of approximately 30%. Imperial Blue brand alone recorded over 1.5 lakh cases, with a growth of over 50% compared to the previous year. This performance led to a 40% market share in the Prestige & Above segment and a 43% market share in the Deluxe Whisky segment for Imperial Blue in Karnataka for July 2026.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Hexaware Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Hexaware Joins the Microsoft Intelligent Security Association(MISA)'.
announcements.ai_summary: Hexaware Technologies Limited has announced its membership in the Microsoft Intelligent Security Association (MISA) as of August 6, 2026. MISA is an ecosystem of companies that integrate with Microsoft Security to enhance cybersecurity for organizations. Hexaware's end-to-end security solution for Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, available on the Microsoft Marketplace, assists clients in their Zero Trust journeys by offering unified Extended Detection and Response (XDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), and other cloud security capabilities. This membership signifies Hexaware's strengthened cybersecurity offerings, built on Microsoft Security technology and powered by Hexaware's Tensai® Security Ops frameworks.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Swiggy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "Swiggy Eyes INR 10,000 Cr. Adj. EBITDA by FY31, Backed by Affordability in Food and Differentiated Instamart Strategy".
announcements.ai_summary: Swiggy Limited has announced its ambitious FY31 vision at Capital Markets Day 2026, targeting an Adjusted EBITDA of ₹10,000 Cr. This projection is supported by a projected tripling of consolidated Gross Order Value (GOV) to approximately ₹2.5 Lakh Cr. from ₹67,734 Cr. in FY26, indicating a GOV CAGR exceeding 30% through 2031. The company's confidence stems from its focus on solving large consumer problems and disciplined execution within the food delivery, quick commerce, and out-of-home consumption sectors. Specifically for Food Delivery, Swiggy anticipates GOV growth of 2.5-3.5x and an Adjusted EBITDA of approximately ₹5,000 Cr. by FY31, driven by initiatives like "Toing" and other affordability-focused strategies. This growth is expected to capitalize on the Indian food services market, projected to expand from ~$90 Bn in 2026 to ~$150 Bn by 2031, by addressing a frequency gap where ~70% of users transact less than monthly and by enhancing affordability.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Magellanic Cloud Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, pertaining to the Receipt of LOA from Western Railway, Ratlam Division by Provigil Surveillance Limited, wholly owned subsidiary.
announcements.ai_summary: Magellanic Cloud Limited announced on August 06, 2026, that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Provigil Surveillance Limited, secured a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from Western Railway, Ratlam Division. The project is valued at ₹12,12,64,565.55 and involves the Supply, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning (SITC) of advanced telecom infrastructure and CCTV surveillance systems. This initiative is part of the Upgradation and Replacement of Telecom Passenger Amenities and various station facilities across Ratlam Division, specifically in preparation for Simhastha 2028. Provigil Surveillance Limited will deploy a comprehensive telecom and e-surveillance ecosystem, including enterprise-grade CCTV systems, IP-based communication infrastructure, and passenger information systems. The project is scheduled for completion within nine months. Joseph Sudheer Reddy Thumma, Chairman and Managing Director, signed the press release.

announcements.ai_summary: Magellanic Cloud Limited has announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Provigil Surveillance Limited, has received a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from Western Railway, Ratlam Division. The LOA is valued at ₹12,12,64,565.55 and pertains to the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of telecom material, specifically a CCTV Surveillance System. This project aims to upgrade and modernize telecom passenger amenities and associated infrastructure across railway stations under the Ratlam Division in preparation for Simhastha 2028. The scope includes deploying an integrated surveillance and communication ecosystem with CCTV, AI-enabled video analytics, face recognition, IP-MPLS networking, optical fibre connectivity, Wi-Fi, IP telephony, and associated civil and telecom works. This award is expected to strengthen Provigil Surveillance Limited's order book and expand its presence in India's railway surveillance and digital infrastructure sector.

announcements.ai_summary: PNC Infratech Limited has issued a clarification regarding recent media reports and a press release from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) concerning the Kanpur-Lucknow Expressway Project. The company confirmed that the construction of the 6-lane upgradable to 8-lane expressway (Package-2) from km 28.500 to 73.744, with a Bid Project Cost of Rs. 1513.00 Crore, was completed. Provisional and Final Completion Certificates were issued to Awadh Expressway Private Limited, a subsidiary of PNC Infratech, on October 1, 2025, and February 2, 2025, respectively. The project is currently under a 15-year maintenance period by the concessionaire. While recent heavy rains affected approximately 300 meters of the expressway, which is less than 0.5% of the total length, the concessionaire has undertaken immediate repair and rectification measures, with ongoing work on remaining stretches. Traffic on the expressway is reported to be smooth.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: SEPC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "Press Release    SEPC secures Rs.854.57 crore Letter of Acceptance for Pellet Plant BOP including Civil & Structural (Pellet Package-2) for 4.08Mtpa CSExpansion of SAIL-ISP Burnpur".
announcements.ai_summary: SEPC Limited has secured a Letter of Acceptance (LoA) from Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) – IISCO Steel Plant (ISP), Burnpur, for the Pellet Plant BOP including Civil & Structural Works (Pellet Package-2). This project is part of SAIL's 4.08 MTPA Crude Steel Expansion Project. The order is valued at ₹854.57 Crore (net of Input Tax Credit) and is expected to be completed over a period of 32 months. This significant order further strengthens SEPC Limited's position in the industrial EPC segment and highlights the trust of marquee customers in the company's engineering capabilities and project execution expertise. SEPC Limited has a diversified portfolio across industrial infrastructure, water and wastewater management, roads, and mining.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Satin Creditcare Network Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "Announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Satin Creditcare Network Limited has launched a large-scale flood relief drive to support approximately 15,000 families affected by floods in Assam. The company has committed ₹1 crore towards relief and assistance efforts across affected communities. A fleet of 15 relief vehicles has been deployed to commence on-ground relief operations in nearly 200 villages across the flood-affected districts of Sivasagar, Charaideo, and Jorhat. Relief materials including mosquito nets, bedsheets, kitchen utensils, food supplies, and drinking water will be distributed. Around 150 employees have been mobilized to support the distribution of relief materials. Satin Creditcare Network Limited has had a growing presence in Assam since 2017 and operates 227 branches across the Northeast.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Kolte - Patil Developers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "Kolte-Patil Developers announces a landmark Mumbai expansion with the signing of six projects totalling Rs. 6000 crore in GDV, marking a defining milestone in the Company's growth journey".
announcements.ai_summary: Kolte-Patil Developers Limited has announced a significant expansion in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) with the signing of six society redevelopment projects. These projects have a combined estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of Rs. 6,000 crore, marking the company's largest annual business development addition in MMR to date. The projects are strategically located in well-established residential micro-markets including Santacruz West, Andheri West (Lokhandwala), Oshiwara, Versova, Ghatkopar East, and Vashi. This expansion reinforces MMR as a priority market for Kolte-Patil Developers Limited, increasing their presence across Mumbai's Western and Central suburbs and Navi Mumbai.

announcements.company: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited
announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 06, 2026, titled "SDHI Wins Order from Svitzer to Build four TRAnsverse 3200 Tugs".
announcements.ai_summary: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has secured a contract from Denmark-based towage operator Svitzer A/S to construct four advanced TRAnsverse 3200 tugs. Deliveries are scheduled to commence in early 2028. These high-specification vessels, co-developed by Robert Allan Ltd. and Svitzer, feature a unique hydrodynamic hull design and omni-directional propulsion, capable of safely guiding large ships through severe weather and restricted port channels. The tugs will deliver an 80-tonne bollard pull and are up to 15% more fuel efficient than conventional designs. This is Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited's fourth consecutive export contract, reaffirming the growing confidence of global category leaders in their ability to deliver to international standards.

announcements.ai_summary: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited has announced a press release regarding its bank facilities. CRISIL Ratings has assigned a 'BBB+/Stable' long-term rating and a 'Crisil A2' short-term rating to the company's bank loan facilities aggregating to Rs 100 crore. These ratings reflect the company's established market position in the steel tubes and pipes segment, consistent operational performance, and prudent financial management. The 'Stable' outlook indicates CRISIL's expectation of continued demand benefit from infrastructure, construction, and industrial sectors, alongside a balanced capital structure. The assigned ratings are expected to enhance the company's credibility with lenders and stakeholders, providing greater financial flexibility for expansion plans and working capital needs.
