On June 5, 2026, The Adani Harbour International FZCO, a step-down subsidiary of APSEZ, established a Wholly Owned Subsidiary (WOS) named Harbour International Shipping FZCO in the UAE. This new entity has been formed to manage the company's offshore operations locally, aligning with APSEZ's broader marine strategy to diversify its global fleet. The incorporation of Harbour International Shipping FZCO is a step towards building one of the world's largest integrated marine platforms and expanding the geographic reach of APSEZ's marine business.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has changed the domain name of its website from www.motilaloswalgroup.com to www.motilaloswal.com.
announcements.ai_summary: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited has announced a change in its website domain name. The company's website will now be accessible at www.motilaloswal.com, transitioning from its previous domain, www.motilaloswalgroup.com. This change is effective immediately, and all users accessing the old domain will be automatically redirected to the new one. This transition ensures that all information, documents, and services previously available on www.motilaloswalgroup.com remain accessible. The company has implemented measures to guarantee a smooth and seamless transition for all stakeholders. This update is in compliance with Regulation 46 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Happiest Minds Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.ai_summary: Happiest Minds Technologies Limited has received the Certified True Copy of the Final Order from the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Bengaluru Bench, approving the Composite Scheme of Arrangement. This scheme involves PureSoftware Technologies Private Limited (Wholly Owned Subsidiary–Transferor Company) and Happiest Minds Technologies Limited (Holding Company–Transferee Company). The NCLT approved the scheme on May 29, 2026, and the company received the certified copy on June 5, 2026. The Appointed Date for this merger is April 01, 2026. This follows earlier disclosures made on November 14, 2025, August 29, 2025, August 22, 2025, and February 04, 2025.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Navin Fluorine International Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Navin Fluorine International Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, Navin Fluorine Advanced Sciences Limited (NFASL), has entered into agreements on June 5, 2026, to invest in a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) named Pro-Zeal Green Power Twenty Private Limited. NFASL will invest up to ₹5.50 crores in the SPV through equity shares and compulsory convertible debentures, acquiring a 26% stake. The remaining 74% will be invested by Prozeal Green Power Private Limited. This investment is for a 5MW hybrid power supply at NFASL's Dahej Unit, with a lock-in period of 15 years. The arrangement is expected to lead to significant savings on power costs and support the company's sustainability initiatives. The SPV was incorporated on December 18, 2025, and has no prior turnover.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Balrampur Chini Mills Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 05, 2026, titled "BCML and the Lucknow Cantonment Board Launch Landmark Bioplastics Adoption Initiative at Bioyug Green Command 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Balrampur Chini Mills Limited (BCML) has announced a landmark initiative to promote bioplastics adoption in collaboration with the Lucknow Cantonment Board. This initiative, named Bioyug Green Command 2026, was launched on June 5, 2026, with the Defence Minister, Shri Rajnath Singh Ji, as the Chief Guest. The program aims to advance India's bioplastics ecosystem and reduce plastic waste. This collaboration follows a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) and BCML's first institutional order for compostable PLA-based products earlier this year. The event also highlighted the "Building Skills. Transforming Futures – Balrampur Bioyug Bioplastic 3D Printing Project," a women-focused initiative in Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Shalibhadra Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure in terms of Regulation 29(2) of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011'.
announcements.ai_summary: Ayushi Doshi, who belongs to the promoter/promoter group of Shalibhadra Finance Limited, has acquired 1,00,000 shares carrying voting rights. Before this acquisition, Ayushi Doshi held 7,54,100 shares, representing 2.44% of the total share/voting capital. After acquiring an additional 1,00,000 shares, her total holding has increased to 8,54,100 shares, which constitutes 2.77% of the total share/voting capital. This acquisition is disclosed under Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Indo Thai Securities Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Update on Repayment of Inter-Corporate Loan''.'.
announcements.ai_summary: Indo Thai Securities Limited has fully repaid an inter-corporate loan availed from Yash Technologies Private Limited. The entire outstanding loan amount, along with all applicable interest, has been settled as of June 5, 2026. Consequently, the company's outstanding loan balance with Yash Technologies Private Limited is now Nil, and all obligations under the loan agreements have been discharged. This repayment signifies a positive development for the company's financial standing, reducing its liabilities.

announcements.subject: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
announcements.detail: Rajesh Jain has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 10 (5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.ai_summary: Rajesh Jain has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This filing pertains to a substantial acquisition of shares and takeovers, indicating a change in ownership or control of Panacea Biotec Limited. Investors should monitor further filings related to this disclosure to understand the full implications of Rajesh Jain's actions on the company's shareholding pattern. The specific details of the acquisition, including the number of shares acquired and the percentage of voting capital involved, are expected to be provided in subsequent disclosures or filings.

announcements.subject: Change in Auditors
announcements.detail: BEML Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
announcements.ai_summary: BEML Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 29, 2026, appointed M/s. Chandra Wadhwa and Co. as the Cost Auditor for the company. This appointment is for a period of three years, covering the financial years from 2026-27 to 2028-29. The company received the consent and necessary certificate from M/s. Chandra Wadhwa and Co. on June 05, 2026. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Amendment to AOA/MOA
announcements.detail: CL Educate Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
announcements.ai_summary: CL Educate Limited is proposing to shift its registered office from the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi to the State of Maharashtra. This move requires an amendment to Clause II (the Situation Clause) of the company's Memorandum of Association. The Board of Directors has consented to this shift on June 05, 2026. The proposed amendment is subject to the approval of the shareholders and the Central Government, in accordance with Sections 12 and 13 of the Companies Act, 2013. The company will also update its website with this information.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Orchid Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update on Scheme of Arrangement' that in continuation of our earlier intimations dated March 18, 2026, with respect to the merger petition, we would like to inform that Hon ble National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai ( NCLT ) on June 05, 2026, i.e. today has allowed our petition sanctioning the scheme of Amalgamation and Arrangement of Dhanuka Laboratories Limited with Orchid Pharma Limited and their respective Shareholders and Creditors, by virtue of which, the Amalgamating Company would stand transferred to and vested in or deemed to have been transferred to and vested in Amalgamated Company on a going concern basis.
announcements.ai_summary: Orchid Pharma Limited has received a significant update regarding its merger with Dhanuka Laboratories Limited. On June 05, 2026, the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Chennai, sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation and Arrangement between Dhanuka Laboratories Limited (Amalgamating Company) and Orchid Pharma Limited (Amalgamated Company). This sanction means that Dhanuka Laboratories Limited will be transferred to and vested in Orchid Pharma Limited on a going concern basis. This development follows earlier intimations dated March 18, 2026, concerning the merger petition. The company will submit the order copy from the NCLT once it becomes available.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting held on Friday, 05th June 2026 - Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015("SEBI Listing Regulations")
announcements.ai_summary: Sagar Cements Limited announced on June 05, 2026, that its Board of Directors has approved a Scheme of Amalgamation for the merger of its subsidiary, Andhra Cements Limited (ACL), with Sagar Cements Limited (SCL). This merger is being undertaken pursuant to Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The company has obtained a Valuation Report dated June 05, 2026, from M/s BOO Valuation Advisory LLP, and a Fairness Opinion dated June 05, 2026, from Anand Rathi Advisors Limited, confirming the share exchange ratio. The Scheme is subject to approvals from the shareholders and creditors of SCL, as directed by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), and also requires clearance from BSE Limited, National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE), Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), and other necessary regulatory or statutory authorities.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Outcome of the Board Meeting dt 5th June 2026 for the Merger with Sagar Cements Ltfd
announcements.ai_summary: Andhra Cements Limited (ACL) announced that its Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 5, 2026, approved a Scheme of Amalgamation for its merger with its holding company, Sagar Cements Limited (SCL). This merger will be undertaken pursuant to Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The scheme is contingent upon obtaining necessary approvals from shareholders and creditors, as directed by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), and from regulatory bodies including BSE Limited, NSE, and SEBI. The Board also took note of a Valuation Report dated June 5, 2026, by M/s BDO Valuation Advisory LLP and a Fairness Opinion dated June 5, 2026, by Anand Rathi Advisors Limited, both confirming the share swap ratio for the proposed merger. The board meeting commenced at 3:00 PM and concluded at 3:30 PM.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: SBC Exports Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Hold on Preferential Issue Approved by the Board on 29th May, 2026 Due to Procedural Complexities
announcements.ai_summary: SBC Exports Limited has announced a hold on its proposed Preferential Issue, which was approved by the Board of Directors on May 29, 2026. The hold is due to certain procedural and regulatory complexities encountered during the implementation process. The company is currently reviewing and working to resolve these matters to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations before proceeding. Further updates regarding the proposed allottees, relevant date, and other information will be provided in the next Board Meeting, contingent upon the resolution of these complexities. SBC Exports Limited reserves the right to withdraw, modify, defer, or reconsider the preferential issue as per applicable laws and regulatory requirements.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Heritage Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 05, 2026, titled "Heritage Foods Celebrates 35th Foundation Day and new products launch".
announcements.ai_summary: Heritage Foods Limited is celebrating its 35th Foundation Day on June 5, 2026, and has launched new products. Founded in 1992, the company has grown into a trusted dairy brand by empowering dairy farmers and providing nutritious products. The company has focused on strengthening its dairy ecosystem and sourcing network by expanding its procurement footprint and adding new chilling infrastructure. To commemorate its foundation day, Heritage Foods has launched Heritage Creamy Shakes in Badam and Mango variants, packaged in 195 ml glass bottles priced at ₹40 each, targeting Gen Z and young millennials. Additionally, they have introduced Frozen Malai Paneer Cubes, offering convenience with the quality of fresh paneer.

announcements.subject: Diversification/Disinvestment
announcements.detail: Park Medi World Limited has informed the Exchange about Diversification/Disinvestment
announcements.ai_summary: Park Medi World Limited's wholly owned subsidiary, Aggarwal Hospital and Research Services Private Limited, has approved the divestment of its 55% shareholding in Devina Derma Private Limited for INR 0.06 crore. This divestment is part of the company's strategic restructuring and realignment initiatives. Upon completion of the transaction, Devina Derma Private Limited will cease to be a subsidiary of Aggarwal Hospital and Research Services Private Limited and, consequently, of Park Medi World Limited. The divestment was initiated due to the sellers' failure to fulfill certain pre-requisite conditions in the transactional documents, which could have negatively impacted the Group's operational efficiency and financial flexibility. The Board believes this decision will streamline the corporate structure and allow the Group to redeploy resources towards core priorities.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Repco Home Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Redemption of Commercial Paper'.
announcements.ai_summary: Repco Home Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the redemption of Commercial Paper. Consequently, the said Commercial Papers stand fully redeemed upon maturity.

This disclosure pertains to the proposed acquisition of equity shares of GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited. GMR Estate Management Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of GMR Enterprises Private Limited (a promoter of the target company), intends to acquire up to 7,46,00,000 equity shares of GMR Power and Urban Infra Limited through off-market transactions. This acquisition represents up to 9.55% of the total share capital of the target company. The shares will be acquired from GMR Enterprises Private Limited, and the acquisition is planned to occur any time after 4 working days from the date of this intimation, at a price not exceeding specified limits.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Allotment of Employee Stock Options
announcements.ai_summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited has allotted 12,100 equity shares of Re.1/- each, fully paid up, on June 5, 2026. These shares were allotted to eligible employees who exercised their stock options under the Dr. Reddy’s Employees Stock Options Scheme, 2002, and the Dr. Reddy’s Employees ADR Stock Options Scheme, 2007. The exercise price per share was Re.1/-, with no premium per share. Following this allotment, the total issued shares of the company have increased to 83,46,70,070, and the total issued share capital now stands at Rs. 83,46,70,070/-. The shares are identified by distinctive numbers 834656971 to 834669070 and have ISIN number INE089A01031.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Radico Khaitan Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update on Scheme of Amalgamation'.
announcements.ai_summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Allahabad Bench, has issued an order on June 1, 2026, which was uploaded on June 5, 2026, concerning the Scheme of Amalgamation between Radico Khaitan Limited and its wholly owned subsidiaries: Radico Spiritzs India Private Limited, Equibuild Realtors Private Limited, Compaqt Era Builders Private Limited, Accomreal Builders Private Limited, Firstcode Reality Private Limited, Destihomz Buildwell Private Limited, Proprent Era Estates Private Limited, and Binayah Builders Private Limited. The NCLT has directed the dispensation of meetings for the equity shareholders of the Transferor Companies. Additionally, the meetings of the equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors of the Transferee Company, Radico Khaitan Limited, have also been dispensed with. This update follows a previous letter dated October 29, 2025, regarding the amalgamation scheme.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Viji Finance Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
announcements.ai_summary: Viji Finance Limited has received in-principle approval from BSE and NSE for the issuance of 12,75,00,000 warrants convertible into an equivalent number of equity shares. The issuance will be on a preferential basis to non-promoter/other persons. Each warrant will be issued at a price of not less than ₹2.80, which includes a premium of ₹1.80 per warrant. The face value of each equity share will be ₹1. The in-principle approvals were received on June 4, 2026, from BSE and NSE respectively. This disclosure is made as a material event in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements), 2015.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Jet Freight Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 05, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Jet Freight Logistics Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on June 5, 2026, approved the allotment of 3,74,27,694 warrants convertible into equity shares on a preferential basis. This allotment is to persons belonging to the promoter group and non-promoter group categories. The issue price per warrant is Rs. 18, which includes a warrant subscription price of Rs. 4.5 per warrant and a warrant exercise price of Rs. 13.5 per warrant. The total aggregate value of this allotment is Rs. 67,36,98,492.00. The company has already received Rs. 16,84,24,625.00, representing 25% of the issue price per warrant, as warrant subscription price. The Board's decision follows prior approvals from the company's members at an EGM on February 20, 2026, and in-principle approvals from BSE and NSE on May 21, 2026. The list of allottees includes individuals like Tyra Richard Theknath, Tyrus Richard Theknath, Thea Richard Theknath from the promoter group, and several non-promoter individuals and entities such as Alphacap Corporate Services Private Limited and R2VFX Studios Private Limited.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Vital Chemtech Limited has informed the Exchange about our subsidiary Company Vital Synthesis Limited has received Provisional Consent Order from Gujarat Pollution Control Board, Which provides Consolidated consent and authorization (CC&A) for the Manufacturing of the items/Products as mentioned in the order AWH-157796.
announcements.ai_summary: Vital Chemtech Limited has announced that its subsidiary, Vital Synthesis Limited, has received a Provisional Consent Order from the Gujarat Pollution Control Board. This order provides consolidated consent and authorization (CC&A) for the manufacturing of specific items/products. The Provisional Consent Order (CCA) was received by the company on June 4, 2026, and is valid until March 26, 2031. The approval is crucial for legal compliance, environmental protection, and social responsibility.

announcements.ai_summary: Docon Technologies Private Ltd has submitted a disclosure to the Exchange under Regulations 31(1) and 31(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Asian Energy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Empanelment by Oil India Limited for Seismic Data Acquisition Services'.
announcements.ai_summary: Asian Energy Services Limited has been empanelled by Oil India Limited (OIL) for seismic data acquisition services. This empanelment is valid for three years and covers on-land 2D and 3D seismic data acquisition services across OIL's onshore acreages in India. The company is now eligible to participate in future tenders issued by OIL for seismic data acquisition. While this empanelment positions Asian Energy Services for future business, specific contract awards will depend on separate tendering processes and compliance with OIL's technical and commercial requirements. This development is expected to strengthen the company's position in the integrated Oil & Gas segment.

announcements.ai_summary: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Limited has announced the opening of its 83rd store under the "Kalamandir" format. The new store is located in R.R. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka, and commenced operations on June 5, 2026. This expansion is part of the company's ongoing strategy to increase its retail footprint.

announcements.subject: Post Buyback Public Announcement
announcements.detail: Sarla Performance Fibers Limited has informed the Exchange about post Buyback Public Announcement
announcements.ai_summary: Sarla Performance Fibers Limited has submitted a post-buyback public advertisement to the stock exchanges. This announcement pertains to the company's buyback of up to 40,00,000 fully paid-up equity shares, each with a face value of ₹1/-, at a price of ₹110/- per share. The total aggregate amount for the buyback did not exceed ₹44,00,00,000/-. The buyback was conducted on a proportionate basis through the tender offer route, in accordance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Buy-Back of Securities) Regulations, 2018. The post-buyback advertisement was published on June 5, 2026, in the Financial Express (English), Janasatta (Hindi), and Janadesh (Gujarati) newspapers.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Bajaj Electricals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Entry into a new category/ business line under its Lighting Solutions segment'.
announcements.ai_summary: Bajaj Electricals Limited has announced its strategic decision to enter the 'Cables' category within its existing Lighting Solutions segment. This expansion is driven by the growing demand observed in the Cables industry and forms part of the company's broader initiatives to diversify its business operations and achieve sustainable growth. The company plans to commence operations in this new product category shortly. The quantum of investment for this venture will be determined based on market opportunities, anticipated scale of operations, and other relevant internal and external factors. Bajaj Electricals Limited will provide further updates to the stock exchanges on any material developments as required by regulatory frameworks.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Juniper Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Juniper Hotels Limited has clarified a typographical error regarding the execution date of a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) for the acquisition of 100% share capital of Juniper Hospitality Assets Private Limited (JHAPL). The SPA was executed on June 04, 2026, not June 02, 2026, as initially stated due to a typographical error. The company confirmed that the disclosure was made within the prescribed timeline under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and there was no delay. Additional disclosures as required by SEBI regulations are enclosed as Annexure – I and will be available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Hindustan Construction Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 05, 2026, titled "HCC wins Rs.127 crore Bhutan hydro project contract".
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Construction Company Limited (HCC) has secured a contract worth approximately ₹127 crore from Wangchhu Hydroelectric Power Limited (WHPL) in Bhutan. The contract involves construction works for the Wangchhu Hydroelectric Project, specifically the construction of diversion tunnels, hydromechanical gates, and cofferdams. The project is scheduled for completion within nine months. This award follows a technical and financial evaluation by WHPL and highlights HCC's expertise in executing complex hydroelectric projects in challenging geographies. The diversion works are crucial for the timely commencement of the project's primary civil works and adherence to the overall implementation schedule.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 05, 2026, titled "Press release on receipt of order".
announcements.ai_summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited has secured a significant supply order valued at Rs. 435.71 crore (exclusive of GST) for High Tension (HT) and Low Tension (LT) Power Cables. This order is for the execution of the 310 MW HYD22 to HYD26 Data Center Projects located in Hyderabad, Telangana. The projects will be executed by prominent companies including Larsen & Toubro Ltd (for HYD22 & 23), Sterling and Wilson Ltd (for HYD24 & 25), and Blue Star (for HYD26). The company has disclosed this information via a press release dated July 5, 2026, and it is also available on their website. This order represents a substantial new business development for Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited.

announcements.ai_summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited announced on July 5, 2026, the receipt of a significant domestic supply order. The order is valued at Rs. 4,35,71,13,171/-

announcements.subject: Issue of Securities
announcements.detail: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about issue of Securities
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Power Company Limited is issuing 1,50,000 Unsecured, Senior, Redeemable, Rated, Listed, Taxable, Non-cumulative Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) on a private placement basis. The total issue size aggregates to ₹1,500 crore, with each NCD having a Face Value of ₹1,00,000. These NCDs are proposed to be listed on the Debt Segment of the Bombay Stock Exchange of India Limited (BSE). The deemed date of allotment is tentatively July 14, 2026, and the maturity date will be 5 years from the allotment date. The coupon/interest offered will be on a fixed-rate basis through price bidding on BSE's Electronic Bidding Platform (EBP), with annual interest payments. The NCDs are unsecured, and there are no special rights or privileges attached.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Update under Regulation 30 read with Para A Part A of Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: MedPlus Health Services Limited announced that its subsidiary, Optival Health Solutions Private Limited, received a suspension order for a drug license. The order, received on July 4, 2026, was issued by the Asst. Commissioner & Licensing authority, Food & Drug Administrations, Nashik Maharashtra. It mandates a five-day suspension of the drug license for a store located at Samta Nagar, Nashik, Maharashtra. The violation cited is under Rule 65 of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, and Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945. The company estimates a potential revenue loss of Rs 0.75 lacs due to this suspension.

announcements.subject: Issue of Securities
announcements.detail: Unihealth Hospitals Limited has informed the Exchange about issue of Securities
announcements.ai_summary: Unihealth Hospitals Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 3, 2026, approved the issuance of up to 12,50,000 fully paid-up equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each at a price of Rs. 520.31 per share. These shares will be allotted to Mr. Bhaskar Kotecha and Dr. Chirag Kotecha via a preferential issue on a private placement basis, for consideration other than cash. This allotment is part of the acquisition of 49.81% shareholding in Victoria Hospital Limited (VHL) for a total consideration based on a share swap ratio of 4.89152 : 1. The fair value of the equity shares was determined at Rs. 520.31 per share by Mr. Bhavesh M. Rathod, Registered Valuer, as per the Valuation Report dated July 3, 2026. The Board also approved the Share Swap Agreement (SSA) between Unihealth Hospitals Limited and Victoria Hospital Limited, Uganda.

announcements.detail: Piramal Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Filing of Company Petition in Company Scheme Application No. C.A. CAA84MB2026 with the Honorable NCLT seeking sanction of the Scheme.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: GE Vernova T&D India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "GE Vernova T&D India Limited Announces First Quarter FY 2026-27 Results".
announcements.ai_summary: GE Vernova T&D India Limited has announced its financial results for the first quarter of the fiscal year 2026-27, ending June 30, 2026. The company reported a revenue of INR 18.4 billion, a significant 38% year-on-year increase from INR 13.3 billion in the same quarter of the previous year. EBITDA stood at INR 4.6 billion (25.1%), up 19% year-on-year from INR 3.9 billion (29.1%). Profit After Tax (PAT) was INR 3.6 billion (19.8%), a 25% increase from INR 2.9 billion (21.9%) in the prior year's first quarter. However, order bookings for the quarter were INR 11.4 billion, a 30% decrease compared to INR 16.2 billion in the quarter ended June 2025. Key wins during the quarter included multiple orders for CTs and CVTs from GE Grid Renewable LLC for North America, a 400 kV GIS order from GE Grid Solutions, S.A. for Spain, and an order for a 150 MVA 245 kV transformer from a semiconductor player. The company also successfully commissioned several projects, including 400 kV bays for Adani KPS-3 and RTM package at Khavda, Gujarat, and 400 kV and 220 kV GIS bays for the NEA Khimti Site in Nepal.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Chalet Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "CHALET HOTELS EXPANDS GROWTH PIPELINE; MARKS ATHIVA S ENTRY INTO HYDERABAD AND PUNE BUSINESS DISTRICTS".
announcements.ai_summary: Chalet Hotels Limited has announced the expansion of its growth pipeline with the addition of two new hotel developments under its brand, ATHIVA®. These properties will add 150 keys in Hyderabad and 231 keys in Pune, marking ATHIVA's entry into these business districts. The hotels will be leased from SPVs of Mindspace Business Parks REIT under a long-term lease arrangement. For the Hyderabad hotel, an existing building will be repurposed, while in Pune, Mindspace REIT will develop the building structure on a grey shell basis, with Chalet handling the interior fit-outs. This capital-efficient model defers Chalet's capital expenditure to a later stage. The move aligns with Chalet's strategy of embedding hospitality assets within large-scale business parks to leverage captive demand and mitigate site-acquisition risks. The press release was issued on August 05, 2026.

announcements.ai_summary: Chalet Hotels Limited has entered into two binding Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) with two SPVs of Mindspace Business Parks REIT for long-term lease of premises, aligning with its investment and expansion strategy. In Pune, the company will lease premises for 231 rooms under a Grey Shell arrangement, with capacity addition expected by FY2030-31, requiring an investment of Rs. 10.8 Million per key for fit-out. In Hyderabad, premises for 150 rooms will be leased under a Warm Shell arrangement, with capacity addition anticipated by FY2028-29, and an investment of Rs. 13.5 Million per key for fit-out. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Whirlpool of India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Whirlpool of India Limited has announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter and three months ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a consolidated revenue from operations of Rs. 2,727 Cr, a 12% year-on-year increase, driven by market share gains in refrigerators and washers, industry volume growth, price increases, and product premiumization. The company maintained its #2 position in MBO volume market share for combined refrigerators and washers and holds the #1 position in MBO volume market share for direct cool refrigerators. Consolidated Profit Before Tax (PBT) stood at Rs. 139 Cr, a 29% decrease year-on-year, and Profit After Tax (PAT) was Rs. 103 Cr. The decrease in profits was attributed to significant commodity inflation, increased crude oil prices, currency depreciation, new energy regulations, and incremental e-waste provisions, which were partially offset by price increases and cost productivity initiatives. The company's subsidiary, Elica India, reported a 26% increase in revenue and a 22% improvement in PBT for the same quarter.

announcements.ai_summary: BLS International Services Limited has announced that ICRA Limited has assigned a long-term rating of ICRA AA- with a Stable outlook and a short-term rating of ICRA A1+ to the Company's rated instruments aggregating Rs. 300 crore. This is ICRA's first credit assessment of the Company, with the assigned grades being one notch above BLS International's existing CRISIL ratings. The long-term rating of ICRA AA-(Stable) is one notch above the Company's current CRISIL A+ (Stable), and the short-term rating of ICRA A1+ is one notch above its current CRISIL A1. These ratings cover a proposed long-term Term Loan and fund-based limits totalling Rs. 44 crore, rated ICRA AA-(Stable), and non-fund-based limits of Rs. 256 crore, rated ICRA A1+. ICRA highlighted the company's strong competitive position in a high-entry-barrier global industry, its robust growth trajectory with operating income increasing from Rs. 850 crore in FY2022 to Rs. 2,998 crore in FY2026, and healthy profitability with segment EBITDA margins of around 40% in the core visa and consular services business.

The acquisition is considered an arm's length transaction, approved by the Audit Committee, and is being undertaken to increase the sourcing of renewable power and reduce power costs. Sago Trading Limited, a member of the Promoter Group, holds 100% of STLC RE 1 Limited's equity share capital.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Hindalco Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "Novelis Reports First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Results".
announcements.ai_summary: Hindalco Industries Limited has issued a press release on August 5, 2026, regarding the first quarter fiscal year 2027 results of its wholly owned subsidiary, Novelis Inc. Novelis reported a net income attributable to common shareholders of $164 million, a 71% year-over-year increase, and an adjusted EBITDA of $516 million, up 24% year-over-year. Rolled product shipments were 916 kilotonnes, a 5% decrease year-over-year, while adjusted EBITDA per tonne shipped increased by 30% to $563. The company also highlighted the resumption of operations at its Oswego hot mill in early June. Net sales for the quarter increased by 23% to $5.8 billion, primarily driven by higher aluminum prices.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: The Company has received a request from Mr. Chand Arora seeking his reclassification from "Promoter/Promoter Group" of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Delta Manufacturing Limited has received a request from Mr. Chand Arora, seeking his reclassification from the 'Promoter/Promoter Group' category to the 'Public' category, as per Regulation 31A of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015. The company confirmed receiving this request on August 5, 2026. It is noted that Mr. Chand Arora currently holds no equity shares in the company as of August 5, 2026, and is not associated with its management or key managerial positions. The Board of Directors will consider this request at an upcoming meeting and will subsequently seek no-objection from the Stock Exchanges for the proposed reclassification.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment of Debt Securities'.
announcements.ai_summary: CESC Limited has announced the allotment of debt securities following a Committee of the Board of Directors meeting held on August 5, 2026. The company has approved the allotment of 25,000 Secured, Unlisted, Redeemable, Rated Non-Convertible Debentures, each with a face value of Rs. 1,00,000/-, aggregating to Rs. 250 Crore. These debentures have been allotted on a private placement basis to Axis Bank Limited. This allotment follows previous communications on July 29, 2026, and August 3, 2026.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited has disclosed that the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has issued an administrative warning letter dated July 31, 2026, to the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. This action stems from an investigation into trading activities between October 2023 and December 2023, where certain designated persons in the middle management group allegedly contravened SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations 2015. The company has confirmed receiving the letter on August 4, 2026, and has initiated necessary actions against the involved individuals. Importantly, SEBI's letter is cautionary and does not impose any fines, penalties, or operational restrictions on the company.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Cellecor Gadgets Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Cellecor Gadgets Limited has announced the promotion of Naginder Patil to the position of Vice President – South Business, effective August 2026. This promotion recognizes his leadership and significant contributions to strengthening the company's presence in the South Indian market. Naginder Patil previously served as the South Business Head, where he played a crucial role in driving business growth and expanding Cellecor's footprint across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka. In his new role, he will continue to lead the company's growth strategy in South India, focusing on expanding market reach, strengthening retail presence, enhancing channel performance, and driving business excellence. This announcement is in line with the company's commitment to keeping stakeholders informed about its growth initiatives.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Afcons Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about intimation w.r.t. redemption of commercial paper of Rs. 50 crores
announcements.ai_summary: Afcons Infrastructure Limited has informed the stock exchanges regarding the redemption of its Commercial Paper. The Commercial Paper, with an issue size of Rs. 50 Crores and bearing ISIN INE101I14EO7, was issued on August 5, 2025. The company has fully redeemed this Commercial Paper on August 6, 2026, which was its maturity date. This information is provided for the kind information and record of the exchanges.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Medico Remedies Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.ai_summary: Medico Remedies Limited has secured a government supply order valued at USD 1,406,450 (approximately INR 13.38 Crores) from PROMESE/CAL in the Dominican Republic. This order is for the supply of tablets, capsules, and dry syrups. PROMESE/CAL is the program responsible for the centralized purchase and distribution of medicines, health supplies, and laboratory reagents for the National Public Health System in the Dominican Republic. Medico Remedies Limited is expected to complete the supply of the full order within 3 months. The company has confirmed that neither the promoter nor the promoter group has any interest in PROMESE/CAL, and this transaction does not fall within related party transactions.

announcements.subject: Post Buyback Public Announcement
announcements.detail: Orbit Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about post Buyback Public Announcement
announcements.ai_summary: Orbit Exports Limited has announced the publication of its Post Buyback Public Announcement on August 5, 2026, in accordance with Regulation 24(vi) of the SEBI Buyback Regulations. The company is undertaking a buyback of 8,90,822 fully paid-up Equity Shares, each with a face value of Rs. 10, from existing shareholders as of the record date, July 15, 2026. The buyback is being conducted on a proportionate basis through the tender offer route via the Stock Exchange Mechanism at a price of ₹ 250 per equity share, aggregating to ₹ 22,27,05,500, excluding transaction costs. The Post Buyback Public Announcement has been published in the Financial Express (English), Jansatta (Hindi), and Mumbai Lakshadeep (Marathi). A copy of this announcement will be available on the company's website (www.orbitexports.com), the Manager to the Buyback's website (www.saffronadvisor.com), and the websites of SEBI (www.sebi.gov.in), BSE (www.bseindia.com), and NSE (www.nseindia.com) during the buyback period.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations - Enhancement of manufacturing capacity
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Neuland Laboratories Limited, in their meeting held on August 5, 2026, approved the execution of an irrevocable, unconditional, and continuing Corporate Guarantee of Rs. 40 crores in favour of Gland Pharma Limited. This guarantee is in connection with the obligations of Neuland Laboratories Limited under a Loan Licence Agreement to be entered into with Gland Pharma Limited. Under this agreement, Gland Pharma Limited will establish dedicated manufacturing capacity and incur capital expenditure for the manufacture of certain products. The Corporate Guarantee secures the due payment and performance by Neuland Laboratories Limited of its obligations under the Loan Licence Agreement. There is no immediate impact on the financials of Neuland Laboratories Limited, as the guarantee represents a contingent liability. A press release regarding this decision is enclosed as Annexure A.

announcements.detail: Oriana Power Limited has informed the Exchange about incorporation of wholly owned subsidiary.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about incorporation of wholly owned subsidiary company by Adani Airport Holdings Limited, wholly owned subsidiary of the company.
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Enterprises Limited has announced the incorporation of a new wholly owned subsidiary, AAHL Global IFSC Limited, by its wholly owned subsidiary, Adani Airport Holdings Limited (AAHL). The certificate of incorporation for AAHL Global IFSC Limited, incorporated on July 16, 2026, was received by Adani Enterprises Limited on August 5, 2026. AAHL Global IFSC Limited will be engaged in Global Treasury Centre activities, as permitted under IFSCA (Finance Company) Regulations, 2021, and operates within the Financial Services industry. AAHL Global is a step-down wholly owned subsidiary of Adani Enterprises Limited.

announcements.ai_summary: Neuland Laboratories Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 5, 2026, approved the execution of a deed of Corporate Guarantee for ₹40 crores. The corporate guarantee secures the due payment and performance by Neuland Laboratories Limited under this agreement. The company received the Certificate of Amalgamation on August 5, 2026, following their prior disclosure on July 21, 2026. This update confirms the successful completion of the amalgamation process.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Navin Fluorine International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 05, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Navin Fluorine International Limited held a Board Meeting on August 05, 2026, where they approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company also sanctioned a capital expenditure of ₹90 crores for establishing adoption capacities at their Surat unit. This expenditure is intended to progress products within the Advanced Materials portfolio from lab scale to commercial scale qualification. The meeting commenced at 01:30 P.M. (IST) and concluded at 04:05 P.M. (IST). The financial results, along with the Limited Review Report from Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP, are enclosed.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Garware Technical Fibres Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Garware Technical Fibres Limited has announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, via a press release dated August 05, 2026. The company reported a consolidated net profit before tax of Rs. 86.4 Cr. Consolidated Net Sales increased by 31.4% to Rs. 482.4 Cr in Q1FY27 compared to Rs. 367.2 Cr in Q1FY26. Profit before tax increased by 22.7% to Rs. 86.4 Cr in Q1FY27 from Rs. 70.4 Cr in Q1FY26. Profit After Tax (PAT) rose by 21.5% to Rs. 64.5 Cr in Q1FY27 from Rs. 53.1 Cr in Q1FY26. Earnings Per Share (EPS) increased by 22.6% to Rs. 6.56/- in Q1FY27 from Rs. 5.35 in Q1FY26. The growth was driven by the Synthetic Cordage segment, Salmon Aquaculture business, and the Geosynthetics business, despite inflationary pressures from raw material costs and freight rates.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Cantabil Retail India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Cantabil Retail India Limited has issued a press release dated August 05, 2026, detailing its Un-Audited Financial Results for the Quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a 13% revenue growth to ₹ 178.8 crores from ₹ 158.7 crores in Q1 FY26, and a 21% EBIDTA growth to ₹ 59.4 crores from ₹ 49.0 crores in Q1 FY26. The EBIDTA margin improved to 33.2% from 30.8% in the prior year. Profit After Tax (PAT) grew by 11% to ₹ 16.3 crores from ₹ 14.7 crores in Q1 FY26, with a PAT margin of 9.1%. The company operates 667 stores with a total retail area of 9.42 lakh sq. ft. and recorded a robust Same Store Growth (SSG) of 4.04% for Q1 FY27.

announcements.subject: Retirement
announcements.detail: Smartlink Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about Retirement of Mr. Pradeep Anant Rane (DIN 01446215) as Independent Director of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Smartlink Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about the retirement of Mr. Pradeep Anant Rane (DIN 01446215) as an Independent Director. The Board of Directors and Management expressed their appreciation for his contributions during his tenure. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The information will also be available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: Thomas Scott (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
announcements.ai_summary: Thomas Scott (India) Limited has entered into a Licensing agreement and a Global Designated Supplier Agreement with ABG-Dockers LLC for the Dockers® brand in India, effective August 5, 2026. Under these agreements, Thomas Scott (India) Limited will be the exclusive licensee for the Dockers® brand in India, responsible for product design, development, manufacturing, distribution, retail, and e-commerce operations. Furthermore, the company has been appointed as a Global Designated Supplier, enabling it to manufacture Dockers products for the brand's international partner network. The agreement is a long-term brand-licensing arrangement.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Gland Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "Gland Pharma and Neuland Laboratories Announce Strategic Collaboration for Sterile API Manufacturing".
announcements.ai_summary: Gland Pharma Limited has issued a press release dated August 5, 2026, announcing a strategic collaboration for Sterile API Manufacturing with Neuland Laboratories Limited. This partnership aims to expand sterile API manufacturing capabilities through a new, cGMP state-of-the-art sterile suite. Under this long-term CDMO partnership, Gland Pharma will establish a sterile manufacturing suite for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) specifically for microparticle depot products. The collaboration leverages Neuland's expertise in complex API development and manufacturing.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted with the Stock Exchange a disclosure on incorporation of indirect wholly owned subsidiary, namely, Samvardhana Motherson Adsys Tech Holland Holding B.V.
announcements.ai_summary: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited (SAMIL) has informed the stock exchange about the incorporation of an indirect wholly owned subsidiary, Samvardhanan Motherson Adsys Tech Holland Holding B.V. (“SMAST BV”), on August 4, 2026, under the laws of the Netherlands. SMAST BV has been incorporated as an aerospace business entity and will hold the international businesses of the aerospace vertical of Motherson Group. The initial subscribed share capital of SMAST BV will consist of 100 shares of face value Euro 1/- per share. This incorporation is part of SAMIL's strategy to expand its aerospace and advanced systems business globally.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Capri Global Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "Capri Loans Unveils Integrated Brand Campaign Featuring Nayanthara; Launches New Gold Loan Film Reinforcing Trust and Financial Empowerment ".
announcements.ai_summary: Capri Global Capital Limited, operating under the brand name ‘Capri Loans’, has launched a new integrated brand campaign featuring acclaimed actor Nayanthara on August 5, 2026. The campaign, with themes #DreamsGetWings for the brand film and #TryCapriGoldLoans for the gold loan film, reinforces Capri Loans' commitment to providing accessible, transparent, and customer-centric financial solutions. The brand film highlights Nayanthara's inspiration from everyday Indians and positions Capri Loans as a trusted partner for timely financial support. The gold loan film emphasizes the value of gold as a financial asset and showcases Capri Loans' transparent, respectful, and secure lending process for quick access to funds with dignity. This campaign aims to enhance customer trust and financial empowerment.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Rox Hi Tech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "ROX Hi-Tech Limited Achieves Cisco Preferred Partner Status in Networkingand Security, Strengthening Its Enterprise Technology Leadership".
announcements.ai_summary: ROX Hi-Tech Limited has achieved Cisco Preferred Partner status in both Networking and Security under the Cisco Partner Program, as announced on August 5, 2026. This recognition signifies Cisco’s highest partner designation and underscores ROX Hi-Tech's expertise in delivering advanced networking and cybersecurity solutions to enterprises. The Preferred Partner status is awarded based on strong technical capabilities, certified expertise, customer success, and the ability to deliver high-quality technology solutions aligned with Cisco’s standards. These achievements reinforce ROX Hi-Tech's position as a trusted enterprise technology partner, enhancing its ability to support customers in networking infrastructure modernization, cybersecurity transformation, and cloud connectivity. The company aims to build secure, resilient, and future-ready IT environments for its clients.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Prime Focus Limited has informed the Exchange about Disposal of the Suit filed against Reliance Alpha Services Private Limited and others   Commercial Suit No. 104 of 2025
announcements.ai_summary: Prime Focus Limited, along with promoter Mr. Namit Malhotra, has successfully withdrawn a Commercial Suit No. 104 of 2025 filed on July 25, 2023, against Reliance Alpha Services Private Limited, Reliance Mediaworks Limited, and Reliance Land Private Limited. The suit, which involved a loan agreement dated February 25, 2019, and a business transfer agreement dated November 19, 2014, was listed before the Hon’ble Bombay High Court on August 4, 2026. The court was informed that the disputes between the parties have been amicably resolved and the matter has been settled. Consequently, the Hon’ble High Court permitted the withdrawal of the suit, dismissing it as withdrawn. This action marks the resolution of a significant legal dispute for the company.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "Wipro and Rubrik Launch Enterprise Resilience as a Service to Deliver Continuous Cyber Resilience".
announcements.ai_summary: Wipro Limited, an AI-powered technology services and consulting company, along with Rubrik, a Security and AI Operations company, announced the launch of Enterprise Resilience as a Service (ERaaS) on August 5, 2026. This new service is designed to help enterprises prevent, withstand, and rapidly recover from cyber and operational disruptions, moving beyond traditional backup and disaster recovery models. ERaaS will operate as a continuously managed, enterprise-wide capability across technology, operations, and business processes, enabling continuous assessment of resilience posture, support for recovery decisions, and automation of recovery workflows. The AI capabilities will be operationalized through Wipro’s AI-powered delivery platform WINGS, part of Wipro Intelligence™. This initiative strengthens Wipro's enterprise technology leadership by offering a proactive and self-optimizing resilience solution.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Infosys and Metsä Group Expand Strategic Collaboration to Drive AI-led IT Transformation'.
announcements.ai_summary: Infosys Limited has announced an expansion of its strategic collaboration with Metsä Group, a global forest industry company based in Finland. This multi-year engagement will see Infosys support Metsä Group's IT landscape transformation towards a more efficient, unified, and AI-ready operating model, providing end-to-end IT services across its global operations. Infosys will manage Metsä Group's application management, cloud operations, workplace services, on-site IT/OT interface support, and service desk operations. The collaboration will leverage Infosys Topaz Fabric, an agentic services suite, to embed intelligence across Metsä Group's IT operations, aiming to improve service delivery, speed up issue resolution, and achieve cost savings. This expanded collaboration was announced on August 5, 2026.

announcements.subject: Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.detail: Dynamic Services & Security Limited has informed the Exchange about Awarding of order(s)/contract(s) to its Subsidiary
announcements.ai_summary: Dynamic Services & Security Limited has announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, The Bharat Battery Manufacturing Private Limited, has secured a work order from the PCMM Office, North Central Railway, Subedarganj. The execution of this order is scheduled in phases, with deliveries expected between August 5, 2026, and November 4, 2026, November 1, 2026, and December 31, 2026, and March 1, 2027, and March 31, 2027.

This acquisition is intended to fulfill the company's green energy requirements, optimize energy costs, and ensure compliance with regulatory mandates for captive power consumption under electricity laws. The proposed acquisition is not a related party transaction, and the promoter group has no interest in the entity being acquired.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: RattanIndia Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Investors Presentation for the Quarter ended June 30, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: RattanIndia Enterprises Limited has released an Investors Presentation for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The presentation highlights key financial and operational achievements, including a consolidated total income of ₹1,871 Cr and consolidated EBITDA of ₹50 Cr for Q1 FY27. The company's retail arm, Cocoblu Retail, reported a total income of ₹1,810 Cr, driven by Amazon ecosystem integration and vendor expansion. In the EV market, Revolt holds approximately 50% market share with an expanding dealer network of 223 stores and plans to launch the RV-X. The company is also focusing on its Gen Z brand portfolio, NeoBrands, with seven Amazon-native brands, and its defence-grade drone technology business, NeoSky, which has secured strategic government contracts.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Sat Kartar Life  Limited has informed the Exchange about Proposal for Establishment of new hospital -cum-therapy centre in Gurugram, Haryana.
announcements.ai_summary: Sat Kartar Life Limited is proposing to establish a new hospital-cum-therapy centre in Gurugram, Haryana, with an estimated investment of approximately ₹1 crore. The establishment of this unit is subject to obtaining necessary licenses, registrations, and regulatory approvals. This initiative is part of the company's broader expansion strategy to enhance its integrated Ayurveda and wellness healthcare services.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Vinyas Innovative Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 05, 2026.

Additionally, NBCC will provide Project Management Consultancy (PMC) for the construction of an office complex and residential complex for the Reserve Bank of India at Nelapadu and Inavolu, Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, valued at Rs. 780.38 Crore. Further details are available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Paisalo Digital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "Paisalo Digital delivers AI-driven momentum with 128% YoY surge in disbursements; AUM up 28% YoY at Rs 67,074 Mn".
announcements.ai_summary: Paisalo Digital Limited has issued a press release on August 05, 2026, highlighting significant financial performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1FY27). The company reported a 128% year-on-year (YoY) surge in disbursements, reaching Rs. 17,309 million, and its Assets Under Management (AUM) grew by 28% YoY to Rs. 67,074 million. Total income increased by 19% YoY to Rs. 2,603 million, and Profit After Tax (PAT) rose by 30% YoY to Rs. 613 million. The company also noted a 64 basis points YoY reduction in borrowing costs. Paisalo Digital has expanded its distribution network to 5,995 touchpoints, including 696 new additions in Q1FY27, and its customer franchise has grown to approximately 18 million. The company's GNPA and NNPA improved YoY to 0.70% and 0.49% respectively.

announcements.subject: Press Release

This premium water purifier features filters designed to last up to three years, app-enabled health monitoring, and advanced mineralization. It is available on the Urban Company app and website starting at ₹22,000. The Na@ve M3 Pro aims to offer a better ownership experience by minimizing maintenance and reducing the total cost of ownership, with customers potentially saving over ₹26,000 over nine years due to its long-life filters and reduced servicing needs. The proposed centre will be located at Tower B, 68 Avenue, Sector 68, Gurugram, Haryana – 122001, covering approximately 4,000 sq. ft. with an estimated investment of ₹1 crore, funded by IPO funds. The centre is expected to be operational by October 15, 2026, and will have a proposed bed capacity of 10-15 beds. The establishment is subject to applicable licenses, registrations, and regulatory approvals.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tembo Global Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "Press Release on Commencement of Production of Specialised UAV Components by JR UAV Limited at Kashidkopar ".
announcements.ai_summary: Tembo Global Industries Limited has issued a press release on August 5, 2026, regarding the commencement of production of specialised UAV components by JR UAV Limited at Kashidkopar. JR UAV Limited, a strategic joint venture between Tembo Global Industries Limited, JR UAV Europe, and JR PROPO Japan, will begin manufacturing within 90 days for orders received by JR UAV Italy. This facility is designated for precision components for unmanned aerial platforms, marking an expansion into the defence and aerospace sector. The initiative aligns with the Indian government's "Make in India" and "Atmanirbhar Bharat" programs.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: JTL INDUSTRIES LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding 'Earnings Press Release for the quarter ended June 30, 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: JTL Industries Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 5, 2026. The company reported a record quarterly Revenue from Operations of ₹7,216 million, a 32.7% year-on-year growth. EBITDA also reached a record high of ₹587 million, a 151.2% year-on-year increase, with an expanded EBITDA margin of 8.1%. Profit after Tax (PAT) stood at ₹354 million, reflecting a 113.7% year-on-year growth. Sales volume for the quarter was 1,18,513 metric tons, a 17.8% year-on-year increase. The reported PAT includes ₹27.8 million of additional non-cash depreciation from an asset revaluation at JTL Defence in March 2026; the normalized PAT, excluding this adjustment, would be ₹382 million.

The commencement of production is expected to enhance the Group's presence in the global UAV supply chain and support India's "Make in India" and "Atmanirbhar Bharat" initiatives.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Matrix Geo Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release - Matrix Geo Wins Key Railway Infrastructure Inspection Project from Northeast Frontier Railway'.
announcements.ai_summary: Matrix Geo Solutions Limited has received a Letter of Acceptance (LoA) from Northeast Frontier Railway for a significant railway infrastructure inspection project. The project involves the drone-based assessment of 25 kV Overhead Equipment (OHE) infrastructure within the Lumding Division. This assignment will utilize drone technology to conduct visual, thermal, and geometrical inspections, generating high-resolution data for maintenance planning and monitoring. The project is crucial for ensuring the reliability and safety of electrified railway operations. Matrix Geo Solutions will integrate drone operations, geospatial intelligence, and engineering assessment under railway operational and safety protocols.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited is expanding its retail footprint with the inauguration of two new branches in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. These new outlets will be located in Mogaippair West and Puraisaiwakkam. The official opening ceremony for both branches is scheduled to take place on August 23rd, 2026, which falls on a Sunday. This expansion aims to increase the company's market presence and accessibility for customers in these areas. The company has informed the stock exchange about this development for public record.

announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger
announcements.detail: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Outcome of Board Meeting - Scheme of Merger
announcements.ai_summary: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited (MMFSL) has announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on August 5, 2026, where it approved a Scheme of Merger by Absorption. The scheme involves the merger of Mahindra Rural Housing Finance Limited (MRHFL) with MMFSL. MRHFL will be absorbed into MMFSL, leading to the dissolution of MRHFL without winding up, subject to necessary regulatory and other approvals. The proposed merger aims to consolidate lending businesses, create a simplified operating architecture, and enhance operating leverage. The appointed date for the scheme is April 01, 2027, or another date approved by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench. The entire assets and liabilities of MRHFL will be transferred to MMFSL at their carrying values, and MRHFL's NCDs will become MMFSL's NCDs with the same terms.

announcements.ai_summary: Panacea Biotec Limited has received a Letter of Award from the United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund (UNICEF) for the supply of bivalent Oral Polio Vaccine (bOPV). This award is for an amount of approximately US$ 8.205 million, which is equivalent to approximately Rs. 78.24 Crore, for supply in Calendar Year 2028. This follows a previous intimation on October 03, 2025, regarding a Long-Term Agreement for bOPV supply from April 1, 2026, to March 31, 2030. The order is for bOPV in 10 and 20 dose presentations and is an international contract. The execution of this order is scheduled for Calendar Year 2028.

announcements.ai_summary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has received approval from the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Chennai Bench - I, for a Scheme of Amalgamation. This scheme involves Veranda K-12 Learning Solutions Private Limited (Transferor Company) and Veranda Administrative Learning Solutions Private Limited (Transferee Company). The NCLT order was dated July 31, 2026, and the e-copy was uploaded on the NCLT website on August 04, 2026. The amalgamation will become effective from the appointed date upon filing the NCLT order with the Registrar of Companies through e-form INC-28, at which point the Transferor Company will be dissolved. This is a significant step in the restructuring of the company's subsidiaries.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: TechEra Engineering (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'General Update'.
announcements.ai_summary: TechEra Engineering (India) Limited has secured a Development-cum-Supply Order from the Indian Air Force for the design, development, and supply of a Multifunction Probe Deburring Tool. This order is referenced against a drawing related to the Rafale programme, marking TechEra Engineering's entry into the maintenance and support supply chain for the Indian Air Force's Rafale fleet. While the current prototype order is modest in value, successful qualification is expected to open doors for recurring bulk supply orders from other Indian Air Force depots. The company, a specialized precision engineering firm, aligns with India's 'Make in India' and 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' initiatives.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Hatsun Agro Product Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "Hatsun Agro  Product plans ₹1000 crore capex in FY27 to enhance Production".
announcements.ai_summary: Hatsun Agro Product Limited plans to invest approximately ₹1,000 crore in capital expenditure (capex) in FY27 to enhance its production capabilities. The funds will be allocated towards expanding the company's milk procurement and distribution network, as well as upgrading its production facilities and marketing efforts. This investment is part of Hatsun Agro's strategy to increase its product pack sales to roughly 2.4 crore per day within the next two years, up from the current 1.84 crore packs. The company reported revenues of ₹9,959 crore in FY26 and expects to reach close to ₹12,000 crore in FY27 with a projected 19% growth in Q1 FY27.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 05, 2026, titled "Ola Electric Expands into Utility-Scale Energy Storage; Signs first MoU with Axis Energy".
announcements.ai_summary: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Axis Energy for the potential deployment of up to 20 GWh of battery energy storage systems by 2032. This MoU is the first major partnership for Ola Mahashakti, Ola's upcoming energy storage platform for commercial, industrial, and utility-scale applications, scheduled to launch on August 15, 2026. The agreement includes a ramp-up to 5 GWh annually from 2028. Axis Energy is developing a significant pipeline of storage-backed renewable projects, requiring large-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) to enhance grid reliability and integrate renewable energy. This partnership marks a significant new growth avenue for Ola in utility-scale BESS.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited has announced its expansion into Aerocity, Delhi NCR, with a new managed office space of approximately 1.41 lakh sq. ft. at 4 Worldmark. This new centre is located near Indira Gandhi International Airport and is situated in one of Delhi NCR's rapidly growing commercial hubs. The expansion aims to cater to multinational corporations, GCCs, and large enterprises seeking premium managed workspaces in the region. Smartworks is partnering with Bharti Real Estate for this asset, further strengthening its relationships with leading developers across India. This move signifies the company's continued focus on expanding its footprint in key enterprise corridors and high-growth office markets.

This injunction, initially ordered on February 1, 2023, required the company to provide adequate security. CARE Ratings Limited complied with the February 1, 2023 order without prejudice to its rights in ongoing appeals. The court's decision to lift the injunction was made on June 3, 2026, and the company received the order copy on June 4, 2026. This development follows earlier disclosures made by the company on February 3, 2023, and April 20, 2023, regarding the injunction.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Kshitij Polyline Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 04, 2026, titled "Kshitij Polyline Limited reports strong turnaround in FY 2026; revenue up 46%, PAT at ₹3.55 Crore, Omkar Speciality Chemicals Limited acquisition payment completed, recycling expansion underway .
announcements.ai_summary: Kshitij Polyline Limited has reported a strong turnaround in FY2026, with revenue increasing by 46.3% to ₹44.75 crore from ₹30.58 crore in FY2025. The company's Profit After Tax (PAT) stood at ₹3.55 crore, a significant improvement from a loss of ₹9.30 crore in the previous fiscal year. The acquisition payment for Omkar Speciality Chemicals Limited has been completed, and the company is undertaking recycling expansion. Total income rose to ₹46.92 crore from ₹32.38 crore in FY2025, and Profit Before Tax (PBT) was ₹3.97 crore, compared to a loss of ₹9.47 crore in FY2025. This announcement was made via a press release dated June 4, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: InterGlobe Aviation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 04, 2026, titled "IndiGo temporarily suspends operations to six international destinations as part of network optimization; Retains 1,800+ weekly international flights despite adjustments".
announcements.ai_summary: InterGlobe Aviation Limited (IndiGo) has issued a press release dated June 4, 2026, announcing the temporary suspension of operations to six international destinations as part of network optimization. These destinations include Langkawi, Krabi, Ho Chi Minh, Hong Kong, and Shanghai, with operations suspended from July 1, 2026, and Siem Reap from July 3, 2026, until September 30, 2026. IndiGo plans to resume bookings for these services on October 1, 2026, with the possibility of earlier reinstatement if market conditions improve. Despite these adjustments, the airline will maintain over 1,800 weekly international flights. These changes are a response to traditionally softer demand in the upcoming quarter and a challenging cost environment, aiming to align capacity with market conditions while ensuring network reliability.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: JK Lakshmi Cement Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of 26% in Equity Shares of Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) i.e. DynoSpark Private Limited for purchase of solar power under the applicable captive power route.
announcements.ai_summary: JK Lakshmi Cement Limited's Committee of Directors, in a meeting held on June 4, 2026, approved the investment of 26% in the Equity Shares of Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) DynoSpark Private Limited and Elevate Solar Energy Private Limited. The project involves setting up a 25 MW (AC)/36.25 MW (DC) Solar Power Plant with a 20 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) at its Udaipur Unit. The project implementor is Oriana Power Limited. For DynoSpark Private Limited, the financial year ended March 31, 2026, showed Nil turnover, a Profit after tax of ₹(0.66) Lakh, and a Net worth of ₹0.34 Lakh.

The company is awaiting the final examination order and will take appropriate legal recourse. There is currently no material financial impact on the company or its operations. The business operations of FDC Limited continue as usual.

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: ANDHRA PAPER LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Disruption of Operations
announcements.ai_summary: ANDHRA PAPER LIMITED is experiencing a continued disruption of manufacturing operations at its Kadiam Unit, following the revocation of a lockout on May 29, 2026. Despite arrangements for resumption, workmen have not returned to duties, resulting in a production loss of approximately 205 tons per day. The company is actively engaging with workmen representatives and authorities to resolve the impasse and restore normal operations. The cumulative financial impact as of June 3, 2026, is considered a material event. Management anticipates a resolution within a short timeframe, allowing for a phased restoration to full operational capacity. The company will continue to inform the stock exchanges of further developments.

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has informed the Exchange about Execution of Joint Venture Agreement with Orgonew Private Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has executed a Joint Venture Agreement with Orgonew Private Limited on June 4, 2026. This agreement follows the outcome of the Board Meeting held on April 20, 2026. The purpose of the joint venture is to develop, manufacture, market, distribute, and commercialise phyto bio-active based functional food products and other products for human consumption and/or usage. This will be done through a newly formed Joint Venture Company (JVC). The joint venture will leverage Orgonew's proprietary nano-curcumin coating platform and DBO's manufacturing infrastructure and commercial reach.
