announcements.ai_summary: Tega Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Tega Industries Australia Pty Ltd, has been voluntarily de-registered by the Australian Securities & Investments Commission (ASIC) with effect from June 02, 2026. This de-registration was communicated to the company via email on June 04, 2026. This action is part of the previously approved process of voluntary de-registration and reduction of share capital by way of return of capital to the parent company. The company has stated that Tega Industries Australia Pty Ltd was not a material subsidiary, and its de-registration will not impact the business operations of Tega Industries Limited. The disclosure will be hosted on the company's website, www.tegaindustries.com.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Tata Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 04, 2026, titled "Tata Technologies launches the 4th edition of InnoVent hackathon for engineering students, in collaboration with Emerson and Amazon Web Services (AWS), focused on  AI at the Edge ".
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Technologies Limited has launched the 4th edition of its InnoVent hackathon for engineering students, titled "InnoVent-27," on June 4, 2026. This initiative is a collaboration with Emerson’s Test & Measurement business and Amazon Web Services (AWS), with a specific focus on 'AI at the Edge'. The hackathon aims to provide engineering students across India with a platform to develop innovative solutions for the Automotive, Industrial Heavy Machinery, and Aerospace sectors by leveraging AI at the Edge. Top participants will be offered job opportunities, along with cumulative cash prizes totaling INR 4.5 lakhs, access to AWS cloud computing services, NI test & measurement tools, and mentorship from industry experts. The contest encourages participation from 3rd and 4th-year engineering students, including women engineers.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Aarti Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 04, 2026, titled "Aarti Industries Achieves EcoVadis Platinum Rating 2026, Ranking Among the Top 1% of Companies Globally".
announcements.ai_summary: Aarti Industries Limited has announced that it has achieved the prestigious EcoVadis Platinum Rating for 2026, securing a position among the Top 1% of companies globally assessed by EcoVadis. The company received an outstanding score of 87/100, marking a significant improvement from its previous score of 78 and a substantial progression from 38 in 2017. This rating reflects a decade-long commitment to sustainability and reinforces Aarti Industries' position as a leading performer in environmental, labor, ethics, and sustainable procurement practices. The Platinum Rating signifies the maturity of their sustainability management systems and their dedication to integrating sustainability into their business strategy and operations. This achievement strengthens their standing as a trusted partner for customers who prioritize responsible and resilient supply chains.

announcements.company: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited
announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited has announced the inauguration of its Extra High-Voltage (EHV) Switchgear Manufacturing Facility, S3 Unit-II, in Nashik on June 04, 2026. This facility is part of the company's previously announced greenfield Switchgear Business project, which aims to establish a new manufacturing plant in Western India. The project, with a total estimated cost of approximately Rs. 748.20 Crores (net of taxes), is designed to double the existing Switchgear manufacturing capacity and cater to a complete product range including MV and EHV Switchgear, Substation Automation Systems, and Power Electronics solutions. The company expects that 97% of the capital expenditure incurred for this facility will be utilized for the greenfield project.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Premier Energies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 04, 2026, titled "Premier Energies Recognised as Grade A Manufacturer in Wood Mackenzie s Global Solar PV Module Manufacturer Ranking 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Premier Energies Limited has been recognized as a Grade A Solar PV Module Manufacturer in Wood Mackenzie's Global Solar PV Module Manufacturer Ranking 2026, as announced on June 4, 2026. This places the company among the Top 25 global manufacturers and Top 3 in India. The ranking evaluates manufacturers based on capacity utilization, technology maturity, financial strength, supply chain resilience, ESG performance, product reliability, and R&D capabilities. Premier Energies currently operates 11.1 GW of annual solar PV module manufacturing capacity and is set to expand its solar cell manufacturing capacity to 10.6 GW later this year. The company is also undertaking a ₹12,500 crore capital expenditure program to enhance upstream solar manufacturing and diversify into adjacent clean energy segments like inverters, batteries, and transformers. This recognition validates Premier Energies' manufacturing excellence and reliability as a global solar partner.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: MGEL: Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited has informed the Exchanges regarding a press release dated June 4, 2026, announcing Group Mangalam's opening of five new NEAT Everyday stores across Ahmedabad, Gujarat, combining time-honoured traditions, natural ingredients, and an omnichannel vision for India.
announcements.ai_summary: Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited (MGEL) announced the launch of 'NEAT Everyday,' its new personal care venture, on June 4, 2026. This launch signifies Group Mangalam's entry into India's growing nutraceuticals and wellness sector. Five retail outlets have been simultaneously opened across Ahmedabad, Gujarat, to cater to the increasing consumer demand for natural, transparent, and effective wellness products. The brand aims to integrate ancient wellness wisdom into modern routines, focusing on natural ingredients, cold-pressed purity, and traditional practices. This expansion is part of Group Mangalam's omnichannel vision for India, leveraging over eight decades of expertise in agriculture, edible oils, manufacturing, and global trade. The company anticipates that the Indian beauty and personal care market will reach USD 34 billion by 2028.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Aban Offshore Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Aban Offshore Limited has provided an update regarding Company Appeal (AT) (CH) (Ins) No.477/2025 before the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) at Chennai. The Learned Counsel for the Appellant has presented subsequent developments deemed relevant for the adjudication of the appeal. The Tribunal has heard the Learned Counsel for the parties and has deferred the hearing of the appeal until the second week of July. The interim order dated January 21, 2026, will remain in effect until then. The appeal is scheduled to be listed again on July 13, 2026.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Venus Remedies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Venus Remedies Limited Secures Renewal of Prestigious DSIR in-house R&D Recognition'.
announcements.ai_summary: Venus Remedies Limited has successfully secured the renewal of its in-house Research & Development (R&D) recognition from the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR), Government of India, for its R&D unit, Venus Medicine Research Centre (VMRC). This renewal confirms that VMRC continues to meet the stringent conditions set by DSIR, including operating a dedicated R&D unit with defined research objectives, qualified scientific staff, and separately accounted R&D expenditure. The recognition supports VMRC's ongoing work in areas such as antimicrobial resistance, including the development of VRP-034, a novel polymyxin B formulation that has received USFDA Qualified Infectious Disease Product (QIDP) designation, and the GASAR resistance surveillance study.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: CEAT Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates

A search operation was conducted by the ED at the company's premises from June 1, 2026, to June 3, 2026. The search was conducted under the provisions of the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999, and no penalty or restriction has been imposed on the company as a result of this search. The company's officers provided all necessary information and documents requested by the ED during the operation. Vedanta Limited has stated that there is no impact on its financial, operational, or other activities due to this investigation.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Tata Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding letters being sent to those Shareholders whose e-mail IDs are not registered with Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has announced the launch of India's first flex-fuel car, the Wagon R, on June 4, 2026. This initiative aligns with the national vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat and aims to reduce crude oil imports by allowing vehicles to run on any blend of ethanol and petrol from E20 to E100. The launch, attended by Union Ministers Shri Nitin Gadkari and Shri Hardeep Singh Puri, signifies a step towards national energy security and sustainability. Flex-fuel vehicles are expected to create demand for ethanol, benefiting farmers and the rural economy. Maruti Suzuki's introduction of this technology in a popular model like the Wagon R, which has previously pioneered alternate fuels like CNG and LPG, underscores their commitment to innovation and supporting government goals for clean mobility.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: WESTLIFE FOODWORLD LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 04, 2026, titled "McDonald's India (W&S) unveils a new brand campaign-'Let's Family at McD' to mark 30 years of being woven into everyday Indian life.  ".
announcements.ai_summary: Westlife Foodworld, the operator of McDonald's restaurants in West and South India, has launched a new brand campaign titled 'Let’s Family at McD' to commemorate 30 years of its presence in India. The campaign features a brand anthem written by Prasoon Joshi and celebrates the countless moments the brand has been a part of, emphasizing the feeling of togetherness. The campaign redefines "family" to include friends, colleagues, and chosen circles, reflecting modern Indian relationships. It positions McDonald's as an everyday social space for informal connections, moving beyond just planned outings.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Hindalco Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 04, 2026, titled "Hindalco strengthens engineered system aluminium window business with launch of Eternia s flagship Experience Centre in New Delhi".
announcements.ai_summary: Hindalco Industries Ltd. is expanding its engineered system aluminium window business with the launch of its flagship Eternia experience centre in Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi. This move aligns with the rising demand for premium, system-driven building solutions in India. The company is also strengthening its manufacturing presence in North India with a new facility in Bilaspur, which will include high-capacity manufacturing and integrated R&D capabilities. Eternia has experienced significant growth, with nearly 65% CAGR over the last three years, and the company is targeting over ₹1,000 crore in revenue by FY29. The windows and façade segment in India is an estimated ₹40,000 crore market opportunity, with premium segments growing at approximately 15% CAGR.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: InfoBeans Techno. Ltd. has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 04, 2026, titled " InfoBeans Technologies Achieves ISO 42001:2023Certification ".
announcements.ai_summary: InfoBeans Technologies Ltd has achieved ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification, becoming an early adopter of the world's first international standard for Artificial Intelligence Management Systems (AIMS). This certification, issued by Staunchly Management and System Services Limited, validates InfoBeans' adherence to global standards in AI governance, risk management, responsible development, and lifecycle oversight for both its internally developed and third-party AI solutions. The scope of the certification covers internally developed AI tools, third-party AI solutions integrated by InfoBeans, and all supporting functions involved in AI usage, governance, risk management, and lifecycle oversight. This demonstrates a comprehensive commitment to responsible AI practices across the company's AI operations.

announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Satin Creditcare Network Limited, in their meeting held on June 04, 2026, approved the issue and allotment of up to 38,50,000 Fully Convertible Warrants to Trishashna Holdings & Investments Private Limited, an entity belonging to the Promoter & Promoter Group. The 'Relevant Date' for determining the minimum issue price of these warrants was set as June 04, 2026. The company is seeking shareholder approval for this issuance through a Postal Ballot.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 04, 2026, titled "CG Semi commences commercial production at its G1 OSAT facility in Sanand, Gujarat".
announcements.ai_summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited announced on July 04, 2026, through its subsidiary CG Semi Private Limited, the commencement of commercial production at its G1 Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) facility in Sanand, Gujarat. This facility, a joint venture between CG Power, Renesas Electronics Corporation, and Stars Microelectronics, has a peak capacity of up to 300 million units per year. CG Semi is investing over ₹7,600 crore over five years to develop two OSAT facilities, G1 and G2, with G2 currently under development. The commencement of commercial production marks a significant step in India's semiconductor manufacturing journey, with the company focusing on training Indian engineers and strengthening the semiconductor talent base.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: SJVN Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 04, 2026, titled "Hon'ble Prime Minister Inaugurates SJVN's 1000 MW Bikaner Solar Power Project".
announcements.ai_summary: SJVN Limited announced on July 04, 2026, the inauguration of its 1000 MW Bikaner Solar Power Project by the Hon'ble Prime Minister. This project, developed by SJVN Green Energy Limited (SGEL) in Bikaner, Rajasthan, represents India's largest single EPC solar project under the Domestic Content Requirement (DCR) category at a single location. The project was developed with an investment of approximately ₹5,492 crore across nearly 5,000 acres. It is expected to generate approximately 2,454.84 million units of power annually. The inauguration ceremony was attended by various dignitaries and company officials.

The total value of this order is approximately Rs. 235.92 Crore, including GST. The scope of work involves design, manufacture, supply, transport, installation, testing, and commissioning of these systems, along with a 5-year warranty and remote monitoring. The installation is to be completed within 60 days from the date of the Notice to Proceed. Oswal Pumps Limited has confirmed no interest from its promoter group in MSEDCL and that this is not a related party transaction.

announcements.ai_summary: Unihealth Hospitals Limited announced its Board of Directors has approved the acquisition of an additional 49.81% equity stake in its Uganda subsidiary, Victoria Hospital Limited (VHL), through a strategic share swap transaction. This acquisition will increase UniHealth's shareholding in VHL from 50.00% to 99.81%, making it an almost wholly owned subsidiary. The transaction is expected to enhance future earnings attributable to UniHealth shareholders, simplify the Group structure, and strengthen its East African growth platform. The acquisition will be implemented by issuing 12,50,000 fully paid-up equity shares of Unihealth Hospitals Limited on a preferential basis to Mr. Bhasker Kotecha and Dr. Chirag Kotecha, the existing shareholders of Victoria Hospital Limited, in exchange for their 49.81% holding. The transaction is subject to requisite shareholder and regulatory approvals.

Voler Car Limited notes that it was not given an opportunity to present its revised, enhanced financial proposal before the CoC's decision and has not been apprised of the reasons for non-selection. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Avalon Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Press Release for the Quarter Ended June 30, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Avalon Technologies Limited announced its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 4, 2026. The company reported a significant 49.8% year-on-year growth in Revenue from Operations to ₹484.4 crore, with Total Income rising by 49.9% to ₹487.2 crore. EBITDA increased by 93.9% to ₹58.0 crore, and EBITDA margin stood at 12.0%. Profit After Tax (PAT) saw a substantial increase of 145.3% to ₹34.9 crore. Key highlights include the eighth consecutive quarter of sequential performance improvement, an order book increase of 23.4% YoY, and the operationalization of brownfield expansion for domestic demand in Chennai. The company also secured EN 15085-2 certification, enhancing its capabilities in railway welding applications.

announcements.ai_summary: Ganesh Consumer Products Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 4, 2026. The company's consumer-facing B2C business saw a decline of 4.1% YoY, while the B2B segment declined by 17.9% YoY.

announcements.detail: Rashi Peripherals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Press Release on Proposed Joint Venture with Restar Corporation, Japan, approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at their Meeting held on August 4, 2026.".
announcements.ai_summary: Rashi Peripherals Limited has announced a proposed joint venture with Restar Corporation, a leading Japanese electronics and technology company. The Board of Directors approved this JV on August 4, 2026. Under the agreement, Rashi Peripherals will transfer its semiconductor business division into a wholly owned subsidiary, which will be headquartered in Bengaluru, with a step-down subsidiary in Singapore. Restar Corporation will acquire a 26% equity stake in this subsidiary, and the JV is scheduled to commence operations in October 2026. The partnership will focus on delivering advanced Image Sensing Solutions for Industrial and Automotive applications, with localized engineering and technical services. The governance structure will have RP tech holding 74% and Restar Corporation holding 26% of the shares. The JV will be headquartered in Bengaluru and will leverage a network across five major cities. The company plans to hire over 50 local engineers within two years and will provide direct training by Japanese design experts.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed Press Release for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: ASK Automotive Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 4, 2026. The company reported a consolidated revenue of ₹1361 Crores for Q1 FY27, marking a significant year-on-year growth of 52.1% compared to ₹895 Crores in Q1 FY26. This growth was driven by a 33.4% passthrough impact of increased alloy prices and a 25.3% overall net revenue growth, despite a strategic reduction in the Wheel Assembly business by 6.6%. The EBITDA for the quarter stood at ₹164 Crores, a 32.7% increase year-on-year, with an EBITDA margin of 12.0%, which was impacted by the rise in alloy prices. Profit After Tax (PAT) grew by 28.8% year-on-year to ₹85 Crores, with a PAT margin of 6.3%. Earnings Per Share (EPS) increased to ₹4.32 from ₹3.35 in the prior year's corresponding quarter, also reflecting a 28.8% year-on-year growth. This marks the eleventh consecutive quarter of robust performance for the company since its listing.

This transfer occurred on August 4, 2026, and is in compliance with the undertaking given to the exchanges at the time of listing. A total of 1,58,199 equity shares were transferred to various individuals, including Nachiket Kodkani, V R Nakra, Sachin Palekar, and Anish Shah, among others. These shares were transferred pursuant to the exercise of stock options granted under the Company’s Employees’ Stock Option Scheme. The details of the grantees and the number of shares transferred to each are provided in Annexure I.

announcements.detail: Kore Digital Limited has informed the Exchange about Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)

The order involves the supply of 3D Modelling, Development of Drawings, Fabrication, and Supply of Spares using full density metal 3D Printing Technology. The execution period for this contract is four months. The corrected broad consideration for this order is Rs. 8.20 Lakhs. The entity awarding the order is a domestic entity, and there is no disclosed interest of promoters or group companies in Indian Oil Corporation Limited.

announcements.subject: Forfeiture
announcements.detail: Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Forfeiture
announcements.ai_summary: Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Limited's Board of Directors, through a resolution passed by circulation on August 04, 2026, approved the lapse of 20,00,000 Share Warrants. These warrants were originally issued to AIO Growth Capital Fund SPC on January 31, 2025. The lapse occurred because the warrant holder failed to remit the balance 75% of the warrant subscription amount within the stipulated eighteen-month period. Consequently, the application money of ₹3,25,00,000, representing 25% of the aggregate warrant subscription amount received at the time of subscription, has been forfeited by the company. This event will not result in any change to the company's issued, subscribed, and paid-up equity share capital, as no equity shares were allotted against the lapsed warrants.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Escorts Kubota Limited has informed the Exchange about Groundbreaking Ceremony of Greenfield Manufacturing Facility of the Company at YEIDA Industrial Area, Uttar Pradesh
announcements.ai_summary: Escorts Kubota Limited announced that the groundbreaking ceremony for its new greenfield manufacturing facility is scheduled for August 20, 2026. This facility will be located on land allotted by the Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority (YEIDA) at Sector-10, Gautam Buddha Nagar, YEIDA Industrial Area, in the vicinity of the Noida International Airport (Jewar), Uttar Pradesh. This intimation follows a previous communication dated March 24, 2026, regarding the project. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information is proposed to be shared during the event. This expansion signifies a strategic move to enhance manufacturing capabilities.

RS Mantri And Associates, Practicing Company Secretaries, as the Secretarial Auditor for a term of five consecutive years. announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: Dabur India Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: Dabur India Limited is responding to a news item dated August 4, 2026, regarding a prohibitory order from FSSAI concerning the "100%" claim on its honey product labels. The company clarifies that its product declarations comply with legal and regulatory frameworks and are consistent with industry practices, asserting it has never made misleading claims. Previously, on April 8, 2026, FSSAI had issued a notice regarding the "100% Pure" claim on one of its products, to which Dabur responded by clarifying that such a claim was not being used on the specific product label. Dabur is exploring options regarding the prohibitory order received on August 3, 2026, at 7 p.m. As a proactive measure, Dabur had already begun transitioning product labels and advertisements to remove the "100%" claim, with most affected labels/advertisements/websites either already transitioned or in the process of doing so. The company is engaging constructively with FSSAI to resolve the matter and reiterates its commitment to product purity and quality.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Happy Forgings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Press release dated 4th August 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Happy Forgings Limited has announced its consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, via a press release dated August 04, 2026. The company reported a 27.0% year-on-year (YoY) increase in Revenue from Operations to ₹449 crores. Gross Profit grew by 33.1% YoY to ₹273 crores, with Gross Profit Margin improving by 276 basis points to 60.7%. EBITDA increased by 39.3% YoY to ₹141 crores, and EBITDA Margin expanded by 275 basis points to 31.3%. Profit After Tax (PAT) rose by 39.2% YoY to ₹91 crores, with PAT Margin improving by 178 basis points to 20.4%. Finished Goods Volume increased by 23.1% to 17,793 MT, and Realisation grew by 3.2% to ₹253/kg. The contribution from Machined products increased to 90% of revenues.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors of Exicom Power Solutions B.V., Netherlands ("Exicom B.V."), a material subsidiary of the Company has  approved the conversion of Optionally Convertible Debentures ("OCDs")   into ordinary equity shares and consequently, Company's shareholding in Exicom BV stand diluted.
announcements.ai_summary: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited announced that its material subsidiary, Exicom Power Solutions B.V., Netherlands ("Exicom B.V."), has approved the conversion of Optionally Convertible Debentures (OCDs) aggregating to USD 1.5 million into ordinary equity shares. This conversion, along with previous conversions totaling USD 7 million, has resulted in a dilution of the company's shareholding in Exicom B.V. from 92.23% to 90.29%. Exicom B.V. will continue to be a material subsidiary of the company. The OCDs were issued to a third-party foreign investor with an option to convert into equity shares. The conversion is subject to the completion of requisite formalities under applicable Dutch laws.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: UGRO Capital Limited reported a significant scale-up of its embedded merchant finance platform, GROx (formerly MyShubhLife), in the first quarter of FY27. GROx disbursed Rs. 1,853 crore during the quarter, with over 60,000 loans disbursed monthly. The GROx Assets Under Management (AUM) increased to Rs. 3,003 crore as of June 30, 2026, a 32% quarter-on-quarter growth. The portfolio maintained a yield of approximately 26% and a Gross Non-Performing Asset (GNPA) ratio of 2.1%. The company also completed its Emerging Market branch build-out, with its 317-branch network now fully established and stable. UGRO Capital is progressing on its strategic realignment, aiming for a self-sustained, annuity-led earnings profile.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Symphony Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Symphony Limited Reports Second-Highest June QuarterRevenue and EBITDA".
announcements.ai_summary: Symphony Limited reported its second-highest June quarter consolidated revenue and EBITDA, driven by India-led growth, disciplined execution, and strategic diversification. Consolidated revenue from operations stood at Rs. 378 crore, an 8% increase year-on-year, while consolidated EBITDA rose by 26% to Rs. 48 crore. Standalone revenue grew by 5% to Rs. 241 crore, with EBITDA increasing by 25% to Rs. 30 crore. The company's Beyond India Summer Products (BISP) delivered Rs. 560 crore in trailing twelve-month revenue, contributing 48% to strategic diversification. Bonaire USA recorded 35% revenue growth, and GSK China saw 43% revenue growth. The Board of Directors approved the first interim dividend of ₹1 per share (face value: ₹2) for FY 2026–27, with a total payout of approximately ₹6.87 crore.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Wonderla Holidays Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "https://www.wonderla.com/investor-relations/shareholder-information?subSection=outcome-of-meetings".
announcements.ai_summary: The company announced its first-quarter financial results for the period ending June 30, 2026, reporting its best-ever Q1 performance. Total income increased by 41% year-on-year to Rs. 25,210 lakhs, and EBITDA rose by 39% year-on-year to Rs. 12,199 lakhs. The company recorded 12.25 lakhs footfalls during the quarter. The Hyderabad Park and resort businesses achieved their best-ever Q1 performance. The Chennai Park, in its first year of operations, contributed Rs. 45 crore in revenue with 2.42 lakhs footfalls. The company plans to continue investing in customer experience and aims to convert this momentum into sustained and profitable growth throughout the rest of FY27.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release'.
announcements.ai_summary: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has announced significant upgrades to its AI-powered healthcare technology platform, MAven Intelligent Document Processing (MAven IDP), MAgnum, and MAven Guard. These upgrades aim to make cashless healthcare more accessible and seamless for patients. Notably, Medi Assist TPA, a wholly owned subsidiary, now completes over 50% of cashless pre-authorisations in under five minutes, enabling faster patient admissions and treatment. The enhanced claims experience has resulted in a Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 67, and calls from claimants have dropped by over 60%. MAven IDP processes hospitalisation documents for faster decision-making, while MAgnum provides real-time visibility to hospitals on patient qualification and claim status.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Shreedhar Spinners Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: Shreedhar Spinners Limited's Board of Directors has approved a proposal to enhance the company's cotton yarn manufacturing capacity. The capacity will be increased from 10,000 MT per annum to 12,000 MT per annum, representing a 2,000 MT per annum increase, or approximately 20%. This expansion will be achieved through the installation of additional plant and machinery and the upgradation of existing manufacturing infrastructure. The project is aimed at meeting growing demand, improving operational efficiency, and supporting the company's long-term growth strategy, particularly in Maharashtra and North Indian markets. The estimated investment required is approximately ₹45.00 Crores, which will be financed through internal accruals and debt. The capacity is expected to be commissioned by Q2, FY2027-28.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Zydus announces Final Approval from the USFDA for Indocyanine Green for Injection with 180-Days CGT exclusivity".
announcements.ai_summary: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has received final approval from the USFDA for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) for Indocyanine Green for Injection, USP, 25 mg/vial. This sterile lyophilised powder is a generic equivalent to Diagnostic Green LLC's IC-Green®. The USFDA has designated the application as a Competitive Generic Therapy (CGT), making it eligible for a 180-day exclusivity period upon first commercial marketing. Indocyanine Green for Injection is an optical imaging agent used in various surgical procedures and ophthalmic angiography. The product will be manufactured at Zydus' USFDA-approved injectable plant in Jarod, Gujarat, and marketed in the US by Zydus Pharmaceuticals (USA) Inc. The company plans to launch the product shortly.

The total value of these orders amounts to ₹2,44,46,650. This award is expected to strengthen the company's order book and positively contribute to its revenue and growth prospects. The execution of these orders is to be completed within 12 months from the commencement date. RMC Switchgears Limited will provide further material updates as required by SEBI regulations.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: UNO Minda Limited has informed the Exchange regarding outcome of Board Meeting concluded on August 04, 2026 for scheme of merger of Minda Onkyo India Pvt. Ltd. with Uno Minda Ltd.
announcements.ai_summary: UNO Minda Limited's Board of Directors, following recommendations from the Audit Committee and Independent Directors, has approved a Scheme of Amalgamation to merge its subsidiary, Minda Onkyo India Pvt. Ltd. ("MOIPL"), with UNO Minda Limited ("UML"). The merger will proceed under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013, and is subject to approvals from shareholders, creditors, and the National Company Law Tribunal. The company will also file the Scheme with the Stock Exchanges in compliance with SEBI regulations. The Board meeting concluded on August 04, 2026.

announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger
announcements.detail: UNO Minda Limited has informed the Exchange about Amalgamation/Merger
announcements.ai_summary: UNO Minda Limited's Board of Directors has approved a Scheme of Amalgamation for the merger of its subsidiary, Minda Onkyo India Pvt. Ltd. ("MOIPL"), with UNO Minda Limited ("UML"). This amalgamation will be undertaken under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013, along with other applicable provisions. The scheme is contingent upon obtaining necessary statutory and regulatory approvals, including the consent of shareholders and creditors of both companies, and approval from the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal. UNO Minda Limited will also file the Scheme with the Stock Exchanges as per SEBI regulations.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: DEE Development Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: DEE Development Engineers Limited has announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported a revenue of ₹294.5 crore, a year-on-year growth of 31.6%. Operating EBITDA increased by 38.7% to ₹50 crore, with an improved EBITDA margin of 16.9%. Profit After Tax (PAT) grew by 22.4% to ₹16.1 crore. The company's closing order book stood at ₹2,428 crore as of June 30, 2026, representing a 92.5% year-on-year growth. Additionally, the company has an L1 position of ₹12 crore. Revenue recognition of approximately ₹25 crore was deferred due to geopolitical disruptions in the Middle East and customer issues, which is expected to be recognized in the coming quarter as dispatches have normalized. The company also plans to seek shareholder approval for a preferential issue to reduce debt by approximately ₹225 crore.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: RHI MAGNESITA INDIA LTD has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "MINPRO to accelerate refractory recycling and circular mineral solutions in India s growing industrial markets".
announcements.ai_summary: RHI Magnesita India Limited, along with Khemka Refractories Pvt. Ltd., has successfully completed their joint venture, which will operate under the brand MINPRO. This new entity is focused on accelerating refractory recycling and circular mineral solutions in India. MINPRO combines RHI Magnesita's global expertise in refractory recycling with Khemka Refractories' regional capabilities and network. Jyotirmoy Bhattacharjee has been appointed as the Chief Executive Officer of MINPRO. The company will establish a state-of-the-art refractory recycling platform in Odisha to recover, process, and reuse spent refractory materials, aiming to increase the availability of circular minerals and improve resource efficiency for customers.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Pidilite Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Pidilite Industries Limited announced its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, via a press release dated August 4th, 2026. On a standalone basis, Net Sales grew by 22.2% to INR 4,237 Crores, with Underlying Volume Growth (UVG) at 11.3%. Earnings before Interest, Tax & Depreciation (EBITDA) increased by 26.2% to INR 1,121 Crores, and Profit After Tax rose by 27.7% to INR 830 Crores. Consolidated Net Sales for the quarter were INR 4,541 Crores, a 21.3% increase, with consolidated EBITDA margin improving to 26.3%. Gross Margin experienced a contraction due to inflationary impacts.

There is no disclosed interest of promoters or group companies in the entity awarding the order, and it does not fall under related party transactions.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: KSH International Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of production at New Upcast Facility situated at Village Biradwadi, Chakan, Tal. Khed, Dist. Pune
announcements.ai_summary: KSH International Limited has commenced production at its new in-house Upcast Facility located in Village Biradwadi, Chakan, Tal. Khed, Dist. Pune, effective August 04, 2026. This facility, Unit No. 5, will produce copper rods for captive consumption and warehouse purposes. The new facility adds a total upcast capacity of 5,000 MT per annum, with the capacity expected to be fully operational during Q2 FY 2026-27. The investment for this facility is INR 67.13 Million, financed through internal accruals and debt. This backward integration aims to strengthen the supply chain, enhance cost efficiency, and improve sustainability efforts.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Magson Retail And Distribution Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 04, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Magson Retail and Distribution Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on August 04, 2026, detailing the allotment of 0% Unsecured Compulsory Convertible Debentures (CCDs) and Equity Shares. Following board and shareholder approvals, and in-principle approval from NSE, the company received INR 3,00,00,000/- from Non-Promoter/Public allottees as Debenture Subscription Money for CCDs. Additionally, INR 1,00,04,976/- was received as Equity Shares Subscription money from Non-promoter/Public allottees. These funds are for raising capital through the issuance of CCDs convertible into equity shares and for the preferential issue of equity shares.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Suba Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Suba Hotels Ltd. has announced the opening of Quality Inn Bhavishya, Brookfield, Whitefield, Bengaluru, further expanding its footprint in Karnataka and reinforcing its strategic growth in one of India's most dynamic commercial markets".
announcements.ai_summary: Suba Hotels Limited has issued a press release dated August 04, 2026, announcing the opening of Quality Inn Bhavishya in Brookfield, Whitefield, Bengaluru. This new hotel, a collaboration with Choice Hotels International, aims to cater to business travelers, leisure guests, and long-stay visitors with its 72 rooms and modern amenities. The hotel is strategically located in Whitefield, with convenient proximity to key areas and transport hubs. Suba Hotels operates a portfolio of 7 brands across 60 cities, focusing on franchising and property management.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Suba Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Suba Hotels Limited has announced the successful launch of its new hotel, Quality Inn Bhavishya, located in Brookfield, Bengaluru. This expansion marks the company's sixth operational hotel in Bengaluru and the second Quality Inn in the city, operating under its partnership with Choice Hotels. The hotel features 72 rooms across Executive, Premium, and Club categories, along with a multi-cuisine restaurant named CINNAMON and a banquet facility called THE SENATE. The strategic rationale behind this expansion is to strengthen the company's presence in Bengaluru and capitalize on the dynamic commercial market.

announcements.detail: Mahamaya Steel Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates for the month of July 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Mahamaya Steel Industries Limited has provided a business update for July 2026, reporting sales figures. The company announced that its sales volume for the month of July 2026 reached 15589.190 Metric Tons (MT). This information is shared as per Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015. Investors can note this sales performance for the specified period.

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Limited has informed the Exchange that this is in continuation to our earlier intimation dated July 24, 2026 submitted to the Stock Exchanges andpursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, regarding the impact on operations of the Company's manufacturing facility located at Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, U.T.   396230, due to unprecedented heavy rainfall and flood-like conditions. The Company wishes to inform that operations at the said manufacturing facility have resumed.
announcements.ai_summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Limited has informed the Exchange that operations at its manufacturing facility located in Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, have resumed. This update is in continuation of their earlier intimation dated July 24, 2026, which reported disruptions due to unprecedented heavy rainfall and flood-like conditions. The company is currently assessing the extent of any loss or damage caused by the event and has duly intimated the incident to its insurance company, for which it has coverage. Necessary measures for the restoration and normalization of operations have been undertaken at the Silvassa plant.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Emami Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Emami reports resilient 15% topline growth".
announcements.ai_summary: Emami Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 4, 2026, reporting a resilient 15% topline growth. Consolidated revenues increased to ₹1,039 crore, with the domestic business growing by 20% and international business declining by 12%. EBITDA grew by 6% to ₹226 crore, despite higher input costs. The company also highlighted strategic investments, including increasing its stake in Axiom Ayurveda (AloFrut) to make it a wholly owned subsidiary and acquiring a majority stake in IncNut, strengthening its presence in the personalized beauty and personal care segment. The Hair & Scalp Care category showed strong performance with 11% growth.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Capillary Technologies India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Capillary Technologies Acquires the CustomerGlu Platform.".
announcements.ai_summary: Capillary Technologies India Limited has announced the acquisition of the CustomerGlu software platform and associated intellectual property from Marax AI, Inc., through its subsidiary Capillary Pte Ltd, via an asset purchase agreement. This acquisition, detailed in a press release dated August 4, 2026, aims to integrate CustomerGlu’s interactive engagement layer with Capillary's AI core to redefine customer retention and engagement. CustomerGlu, founded by Prateek Gupta, Raman Shrivastava, and Sumant Subrahmanya, utilizes GenAI to predict buying behavior and trigger in-app gamified actions. This strategic move is expected to eliminate engineering bottlenecks and enable marketers to launch interactive UI experiences directly into digital products in near real-time, bypassing heavy IT dependencies.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: BASF India Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 14.18% stake in the equity share capital of Clean Max Galapagos Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: BASF India Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 4, 2026, approved the acquisition of a 14.18% stake in Clean Max Galapagos Private Limited. This acquisition is for an amount not exceeding INR 9.45 million and is intended to procure approximately 4,240 MWh per year of renewable power (solar) for its Navi Mumbai manufacturing site under a Group Captive Power Generation Mechanism. The transaction's closing is contingent upon the signing of definitive agreements, including a Shareholders’ Agreement and a 25-year Power Purchase Agreement, along with the receipt of requisite approvals. This acquisition is not a related party transaction, and no promoters or promoter group companies hold any stake in the acquired entity.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Patel Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Press Release with respect to Expansion of Distribution Network for "Indian Chaska"Brand Products".
announcements.ai_summary: Patel Retail Limited has announced the expansion of its "Indian Chaska" brand distribution network into Madhya Pradesh, as detailed in a press release dated August 4, 2026. This move brings the total number of states where the brand is available to 8, along with 1 Union Territory. The company aims to strengthen its channel presence, improve product availability, and deepen market penetration in this high-potential region. This expansion is expected to enhance nationwide market coverage and brand visibility. Prior to this, "Indian Chaska" was distributed in Maharashtra, Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand, Uttarakhand, Delhi (UT), Goa, and Bihar. The company anticipates this expansion will create a scalable platform for future business growth.

announcements.subject: Other Restructuring
announcements.detail: BASF India Limited has informed the Exchange about the Closure of plants of Care Chemicals business of the Company at Dahej manufacturing site
announcements.ai_summary: BASF India Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 4, 2026, approved the closure of the sulfation and low-temperature reactor plants of its Care Chemicals business at the Dahej manufacturing site. This decision was driven by a changing competitive landscape in India, leading to overcapacities, high costs, and margin pressure. The closure is anticipated by the end of calendar year 2026, subject to necessary approvals. The Care Chemicals business will continue its operations with other chemical products. In the financial year 2025-26, the Dahej Care Chemicals operations contributed Rs. 542 crore in revenue, representing 4% of the company's total revenue.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited has informed the Exchange about
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited (IMFA) reported a record performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1 FY27), with revenue at ₹960.45 crore, a significant increase from ₹641.54 crore in Q1 FY26. The company's EBITDA for Q1 FY27 was ₹281.27 crore, up from ₹125.47 crore in the prior year's quarter, and Profit After Tax (PAT) stood at ₹191.49 crore, compared to ₹91.48 crore in Q1 FY26. IMFA's Greenfield Project (KNR 1) is progressing as planned, with the first furnace expected to begin output in August 2026 and the second in September 2026. The KNR 2 project is fully operational. An additional 65 MWp hybrid energy capacity has been secured through a long-term offtake arrangement with Enfinity Global, expected by June 2027, which will increase the company's renewable energy consumption to approximately 40%. The ethanol project is nearing completion, with trial runs anticipated in October 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Belrise Industries Limited has acquired india tipper body business of Hyva (india) Pvt. Ltd.".
announcements.ai_summary: Belrise Industries Limited announced on August 04, 2026, that it has acquired the India Tipper body business of Hyva (India) Pvt. Ltd., a subsidiary of JOST Werke SE, through a Business Transfer Agreement (BTA). This acquisition, valued at approximately USD 5.65 million (representing an Enterprise Value to EBITDA multiple of approximately 3.60x), is a strategic step to strengthen Belrise's position as a Tier-0.5 supplier in the commercial vehicle sector. The acquired business specializes in tipping solutions for construction, mining, and infrastructure sectors and serves all top five commercial vehicle OEMs in India. The transaction is expected to enhance Belrise's capabilities and presence in high-growth sectors.

announcements.ai_summary: In a Board meeting held on August 04, 2026, Belrise Industries Limited approved the acquisition of the India Tipper body business of Hyva (India) Pvt. Ltd., a subsidiary of JOST Werke SE. This acquisition will be conducted on a slump sale basis through a Business Transfer Agreement (BTA). The total consideration for this transaction is USD 5.65 million, which is approximately INR 543.88 million. This move is part of the company's strategy to expand its presence in the commercial vehicle segment and diversify its product portfolio.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Outcome of the meeting of Board of Directors as per Regulation 30 and 33 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 [SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015]
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Bharat Seats Limited, in their meeting held on August 04, 2026, approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, which did not contain any adverse remarks from the auditors. announcements.subject: Rights Issue
announcements.detail: Sunrest Lifescience Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 04, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 1 : 1, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 1 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 35 per share.
announcements.ai_summary: Sunrest Lifescience Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 04, 2026, approved a rights issue of equity shares. The company will issue equity shares in a ratio of 1:1, meaning one new equity share for every one equity share held by existing shareholders. The issue price for these shares is set at Rs. 35 per share. The record date for determining eligibility of shareholders for this rights issue is August 10, 2026. The rights issue will open on August 18, 2026, with the last date for on-market renunciation of rights entitlement being August 28, 2026. The issue is scheduled to close on September 02, 2026, and the company reserves the right to extend this period, though it will not remain open for more than 30 days from the opening date. A total of 4,291,200 equity shares with a face value of Rs. 10 each will be offered through this rights issue.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Keystone Realtors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Keystone Realtors Limited has issued a press release on August 4, 2026, detailing its strong performance for the first quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 (Q1FY27). The company reported a 72% year-on-year revenue growth, with revenue from operations increasing from ₹273 Crores in Q1FY26 to ₹470 Crores in Q1FY27. Profit After Tax (PAT) saw a significant surge of 221% year-on-year, reaching ₹52 Crores in Q1FY27 from ₹16 Crores in Q1FY26, and EBITDA margin expanded to 21.3% from 10.1% in the prior year. Pre-sales for the quarter amounted to ₹617 Crores, and collections were ₹599 Crores. The company added two new projects with an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹547 Crores and maintains a healthy pipeline of upcoming launches with an estimated GDV of ₹8,000 Crores across the MMR. Keystone Realtors also achieved dual "AA- (with Stable Outlook)" credit ratings from ICRA and CRISIL.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: VRL Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 04, 2026, regarding buy back.
announcements.ai_summary: VRL Logistics Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 4, 2026, approved a proposal to buy back up to 87,50,000 fully paid-up equity shares, representing 5.00% of the company's total equity share capital. The buyback will be conducted through the "tender offer" route, with a record date to be decided subsequently. The offer price is set at ₹320 per equity share, with a face value of ₹10 each. The total buyback size will not exceed ₹28,000 lakhs (₹280 Crore), which represents 24.51% of the company's paid-up equity share capital and free reserves as per the financial year ended March 31, 2026, audited financial statements. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Zydus Wellness Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Zydus Wellness Limited released its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 4, 2026, reporting a consolidated Net Sales growth of 66.7% to ₹14,299 million, up from ₹8,577 million in the corresponding period of the previous year. EBITDA for the quarter stood at ₹2,417 million, a 55.3% increase, and Net Profit was ₹1,189 million. The company highlighted strong performance across its brands, with Sugar Free maintaining a 96.1% market share in the sugar substitute category. Glucon-D held a 59.1% market share, and RiteBite Max Protein continued to lead the nutrition protein bars category. Everyuth led the scrubs and peel-off categories with market shares of 49.4% and 75.5% respectively, and improved its ranking in facial cleansing. Nycil maintained leadership in the prickly heat category with a 32.9% market share. Nutralite achieved double-digit growth, and Complan maintained its fourth rank in the nutritional drink category, with the company launching Complan Power Play milk shake and VieMax Diabetes Care.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Intellect Design Arena Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "- Swaziland Building Society goes live with Intellect s eMACH.ai Treasury, powering their strategic transition to commercial banking".
announcements.ai_summary: Intellect Design Arena Limited announced on August 4, 2026, that Swaziland Building Society (SBS) has successfully gone live with Intellect's eMACH.ai Treasury suite. This implementation is a crucial step in SBS's strategic transition to becoming SBS Bank Eswatini, following its provisional commercial banking license from the Central Bank of Eswatini. Intellect has been a technology partner to SBS since 2018, providing solutions for Core Banking, Lending, and Treasury. The eMACH.ai Treasury solution enables SBS to automate complex workflows across FX, Money Market, and Fixed Income Securities, achieving 100% automation and optimizing yields. This move from manual, spreadsheet-based tracking to a sophisticated, multi-asset strategy is vital for SBS as it transforms into a full-service commercial bank after over six decades focused on mortgage financing.

The repayment of these debentures will be secured by a first pari-passu charge on book debts/loan receivables, with a security cover equivalent to 1.00 time the aggregate outstanding value of debentures. The debentures are proposed to be listed on the Wholesale Debt Market Segment of BSE Limited.

announcements.ai_summary: Godrej Properties Limited (GPL) announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on August 04, 2026. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: UNO Minda Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Uno Minda DeliversRecord Quarterly Revenue, Robust Performance Across Segments".
announcements.ai_summary: UNO Minda Limited announced its Q1 FY27 financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting a consolidated revenue of ₹ 5,557 crore, a 26% year-on-year increase from ₹ 4,420 crore in Q1 FY26. Profit after tax (PAT) attributable to shareholders reached ₹ 296 crore in Q1 FY27, a 24% YoY growth from ₹ 239 crore in Q1 FY26. This robust performance was driven by strong operational execution and sustained momentum across segments, including Switches, Lighting, Alloy Wheel, Seating, and EV Systems. The press release was issued on August 04, 2026.

announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger

announcements.ai_summary: Godrej Properties Limited announced on August 04, 2026, that its Board of Directors has approved a Scheme of Amalgamation. This scheme will merge Godrej Housing Projects Private Limited ("GHPPL"), formerly known as "Godrej Housing Projects LLP," with Godrej Properties Limited ("GPL"). GPL currently owns 95% of GHPPL's paid-up equity share capital, with the remaining 5% held by Godrej Projects Development Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of GPL. The amalgamation is contingent upon obtaining requisite approvals and the sanction from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), as well as approvals from shareholders, creditors, and the Central Government. The Board Meeting where this was approved took place on August 04, 2026, from 10:30 a.m. to 11:25 a.m.

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: We wish to inform the Exchange of a fire incident occurred during the early hours of 4th August 2026 at the factory of our material subsidiary, IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited ("IL JIN"), situated Plot No. 28, Ecotech - III, Extn - II Udyog Kendra, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201306.
announcements.ai_summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has reported a fire incident at the factory of its material subsidiary, IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited ("IL JIN"), located at Plot No. 28, Ecotech - III, Extn - II Udyog Kendra, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The fire occurred in the early hours of August 4, 2026, and was brought under control with the help of the factory's fire safety team and local authorities. While there were no employee fatalities, one IL JIN employee sustained minor injuries and has been discharged. Tragically, two personnel from the local fire authorities lost their lives during firefighting operations, and three others were injured and are receiving medical treatment. The company is assessing the impact on operations and property damage, noting that assets are adequately insured. Operations in unaffected areas are expected to resume promptly, while the affected area's restoration is underway. The cause of the fire is under investigation.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Limited (MSWIL) has announced its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reported revenues of Rs. 3,407 crores for Q1FY27, representing a 37% year-on-year increase, indicating that it is consistently outperforming industry growth despite a challenging cost environment. The company attributes its substantial revenue growth and enhanced customer confidence to timely expansion into Greenfield projects and the successful ramp-up of new customer programs. However, profitability was impacted by higher average copper prices compared to the prior year and significant minimum wage revisions in multiple states. MSWIL is continuing constructive discussions with its customers to recover cost increases and maintain business momentum. The company also highlighted the dedication of its employees as a key driver of its success.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: LT Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "Please find enclosed herewith copy of Press Release on  LT Foods on-boards Celebrity Chef Ranveer Brar; launches new DAAWAT® Delight campaign . ".
announcements.ai_summary: LT Foods Limited has announced the onboarding of Celebrity Chef Ranveer Brar as the brand ambassador for its DAAWAT® brand. To mark this association, the company has launched a new campaign for its DAAWAT® Delight Basmati offering, featuring Chef Ranveer Brar. The campaign, conceptualized by BBDO India, aims to highlight the "Superior Flavour Absorption" proposition of DAAWAT® Delight Basmati through relatable dining moments and Chef Brar's storytelling style. The new brand film, set in a restaurant, emphasizes the role of rice in elevating the flavor of every dish. The campaign will be rolled out across television, digital, and social media platforms. LT Foods aims to leverage this association to inspire consumers and celebrate authentic Indian cuisine, further strengthening DAAWAT®'s position in the premium basmati category.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Pace Digitek Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "for commissioning an additional 2.5 GWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) manufacturing line by M/s. Lineage Power Private Limited ( Material Subsidiary ),".
announcements.ai_summary: Pace Digitek Limited has announced that its material subsidiary, Lineage Power Private Limited, has commissioned an additional 2.5 GWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) manufacturing line. This expansion increases the Group's total installed BESS manufacturing capacity from 2.5 GWh to 5 GWh. The commissioning of this new line is a significant milestone for Pace Digitek's BESS business, enabling it to scale manufacturing capabilities in response to rising demand for battery energy storage solutions. The enhanced capacity will improve the company's ability to execute its growing BESS order book, project pipeline, and product supplies, while also boosting manufacturing flexibility and delivery capabilities for utility-scale and Commercial & Industrial (C&I) applications. This development builds on the company's track record of manufacturing over 300 utility-scale BESS containers, representing approximately 1.5 GWh, in the past year.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bikewo Green Tech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 04, 2026, titled "BikeWo Signs MoU to Acquire Majority Stake in Enlite EV Care, Expanding EV Services Portfolio".
announcements.ai_summary: Bikewo Green Tech Limited has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to acquire a majority stake in Enlite EV Care, a company specializing in electric vehicle service and maintenance. This proposed acquisition is a strategic move to expand BikeWo's integrated electric mobility ecosystem by incorporating organized vehicle servicing, maintenance, and lifecycle support. The initiative aims to establish a network of EV Care Centres, primarily targeting B2B customers and commercial electric vehicle fleets, offering services such as preventive maintenance, diagnostics, repairs, and battery support. BikeWo and Enlite EV Care will jointly evaluate locations and operating models for these centres, intending to integrate digital capabilities for vehicle health monitoring and predictive maintenance.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Update on USFDA inspection at InvaGen manufacturing facility in Hauppauge, Long Island, New York, USA
announcements.ai_summary: Cipla Limited has received the Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) for its wholly-owned subsidiary, InvaGen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Jain Irrigation Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 02, 2026, titled " Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd. Commissions Industrial-Scale High-Tech Biochar Facility Among the World s Largest Single-Unit Biochar Reactors ".
announcements.ai_summary: Jain Irrigation Systems Limited (JISL) has commissioned an industrial-scale, high-tech biochar facility in Jalgaon, Maharashtra, with a capacity of approximately 20,000 tonnes per annum. This facility, which processes over 50 metric tonnes of agricultural and fruit processing residue daily, is among the world's largest single-unit biochar reactors. The project aims to advance climate-smart agriculture, circular manufacturing, and commercial-scale engineered carbon removal, positioning India at the forefront of the global biochar and carbon removal movement. JISL has collaborated with global experts to design and implement this pioneering initiative, which is the first of multiple reactors planned by the company.

announcements.ai_summary: The Commercial Court at Dwarka, New Delhi, has returned a plaint filed by Bull Value Incorporated VCC Sub-Fund and related parties in Civil Suit No. CS 628/2025. Consequently, the status quo directions in the matter have been vacated. The court noted that the plaintiff failed to produce FCCB title documents, which were the basis of their claim as a bondholder under the Ultimate Holding Company FCCBs Issue, despite being given two opportunities. This observation is significant as the proceedings challenged Delphi World Money Limited's actions without the plaintiff substantiating their bondholder status.

announcements.detail: Max India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 03, 2026, titled "Antara Senior Care Forays into Integrative Medicine, Launches  One-of-a-kind Clinic for Treatment of Chronic Conditions".
announcements.ai_summary: Max India Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, Antara Senior Living Limited, has launched the Antara Integrated Wellness Clinic (AIWC) in Gurugram on June 03, 2026. This clinic offers integrative medicine, combining modern medical practices with evidence-based holistic therapies, to manage chronic conditions for seniors. The AIWC aims to provide personalized care plans by a multidisciplinary team, focusing on the root cause of illness rather than just symptoms. This initiative represents a significant step in Antara's senior care ecosystem, addressing the growing health challenges of an aging population. The clinic's approach aligns with global recognition of integrative medicine for improving chronic disease management and enhancing quality of life.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 03, 2026, titled "NATCO Pharma Limited and Lupin Limited receive approval from U.S. FDA for Eribulin Mesylate Injection".
announcements.ai_summary: Natco Pharma Limited and Lupin Limited have received approval from the U.S. FDA for Natco's Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) for Eribulin Mesylate Injection, 1 mg/2ml (0.5 mg/ml) Single-Dose Vials. This bioequivalent product is intended for the treatment of adults with metastatic breast cancer and unresectable or metastatic liposarcoma. The reference listed drug, Halaven® Injection by Eisai, Inc., had estimated annual sales of USD 43.7 million in the U.S. as of April 2026. Natco Pharma Limited is an R&D-oriented oncology player with 9 manufacturing sites and 2 R&D facilities in India, approved by various international regulatory authorities.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed the production release of the Company for first quarter of FY 2027.
announcements.ai_summary: Vedanta Iron And Steel Limited announced its production numbers for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, on July 3, 2026. The company reported a 4% year-on-year increase in iron ore production, reaching 2.6 Mn DMT. Specifically, Goa mines' production surged by 166% year-on-year to 0.6 Mn DMT, while Odisha's saleable ore production grew by 78% quarter-on-quarter and 59% year-on-year to 1.2 Mn DMT. Karnataka mines produced 0.9 Mn DMT, a 46% quarter-on-quarter decrease, in line with mine planning for future volumes. Additionally, the company achieved its highest-ever pig iron production at its Goa plant, reaching 238 kt, an increase of 12% year-on-year, and steel saleable production rose 4% year-on-year to 582 KT.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Sonata Software Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR'.
announcements.ai_summary: Sonata Software North America, Inc (SSNA), a subsidiary of Sonata Software Limited, had filed an Involuntary Petition under Chapter 7 of the United States Bankruptcy Code against OBSA Operating Company, LLC (OBSA). The Court dismissed this Involuntary Petition as a sanction against OBSA for its failure to comply with Rule 1007(a)(2) of the United States Federal Rules of Bankruptcy Procedure. Consequent to this dismissal, OBSA executed a separate general assignment for the benefit of its creditors ("ABC") under California law. This assignment is an out-of-court process to conclude the affairs of an insolvent debtor, serving as an alternative to Chapter 7 bankruptcy, and includes creditors such as SSNA. This update on legal proceedings is provided pursuant to Regulation 30(6) read with Schedule III, Part A, Para B(8) of the SEBI LODR.

announcements.detail: Mangalam Organics Limited has informed the Exchange about Disruption of Operations due to the fire incident that occurred on July 16, 2025, at its Camphor Plant I located Khopoli, the appointed Insurance Surveyor has completed the assessment of the loss arising out of the aforesaid fire incident and has submitted the final survey report to the Insurer.
announcements.ai_summary: Mangalam Organics Limited provided an update regarding the fire incident that occurred on July 16, 2025, at its Camphor Plant I in Kumbhivali Village, Khopoli. The appointed Insurance Surveyor has completed the assessment of the loss and submitted the final survey report to the insurer, The New India Assurance Company Limited, as of July 3, 2026. As per the survey report, the assessed loss and corresponding insurance claim submitted to the insurer amounts to ₹12.58 Crore (Rupees Twelve Crore and Fifty-Eight Lakhs only). The loss is covered under the Company's insurance policy, subject to its terms and conditions. The Company is actively pursuing the matter with the insurer for the final settlement and disbursement of the insurance claim. No amount has been realized by the Company as of the date of this disclosure.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited received an order from the Excise Commissioner, Uttar Pradesh, Prayagraj (U.P. Excise Department) on July 2, 2026. The order imposed a penalty of ₹1,00,000 (Rupees One Lakh only) on the Company. This penalty was for alleged non-compliance with Section 74 of the United Provinces Excise Act, 1910, and certain provisions of the Uttar Pradesh Excise (Distillery Establishment and Operation) Rules, 2018. The violation involved storing Liquor, ENA, and Tetra Packs (Country Liquor) at locations other than those prescribed by excise regulations and license conditions. The financial impact is limited to the penalty amount of ₹1,00,000, and the order does not materially impact the Company's operations, which continue normally.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Protean eGov Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about signing of Memorandum of Understanding with North East Centre of Technology Application and Reach (NECTAR) on July 3, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Protean eGov Technologies Limited announced on July 3, 2026, that it has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the North East Centre for Technology Application and Reach (NECTAR), an autonomous institution under the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India. The purpose of this MoU is to jointly undertake projects in digital governance, ICT, geospatial technologies, capacity building, and technology-enabled socio-economic development, with a specific focus on the North Eastern Region. This collaboration aims to combine Protean’s experience in building population-scale digital public infrastructure with NECTAR’s expertise in technology applications and regional development. The MoU seeks to create a framework for identifying and implementing transformative projects to enhance public service delivery and address last-mile development challenges.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Rubicon Research Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Rubicon Research Limited announced on July 3, 2026, that the United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) conducted an unannounced inspection of its manufacturing facility in Pithampur, Madhya Pradesh, from June 29, 2026, to July 3, 2026. This was the first US FDA inspection of this facility since its acquisition by the company last year. Upon conclusion of the inspection, a Form 483 was issued to the company, containing 2 observations that are procedural in nature and do not relate to data integrity. The company is confident of working closely with the regulator to successfully conclude the evaluation in a timely manner. Rubicon Research Limited remains confident of ramping up commercial operations at this facility from Q1 of calendar year 2027.

announcements.ai_summary: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited announced its production release for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, achieving its highest-ever quarterly aluminium production of 632 thousand tonnes, a 5% increase year-on-year and 3% quarter-on-quarter. This growth was driven by volumes from a new smelter and operational efficiency, with BALCO contributing 168 thousand tonnes, including 24 thousand tonnes from its new smelter. Odhav, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on Thursday, July 2, 2026, around 9:30 PM. This expansion into the marine sector is driven by the company's expertise in specialized construction and asset management, positioning it to capitalize on emerging opportunities in the port infrastructure sector.

announcements.detail: Allcargo Global Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 03, 2026, titled "Submission of Press Release on Allcargo Global Limited commences trading on NSE and BSE following demerger from Allcargo Logistics Limited".
announcements.ai_summary: Allcargo Global Limited (AGL) commenced trading on the National Stock Exchange (NSE: AGL) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE: 544602) on July 03, 2026. This landmark listing follows its demerger from Allcargo Logistics Limited, completing a four-year restructuring initiative by the Allcargo Group. The restructuring has created four independent listed entities: Allcargo Global, focusing on international supply chain operations; Allcargo Logistics Limited, dedicated to domestic supply chain logistics; Allcargo Terminals Limited, operating container freight stations and inland container depots; and TransIndia Real Estate Limited, developing real estate and logistics infrastructure assets. This strategic reorganization aims to establish sharper corporate structures and enhance operational focus, thereby unlocking long-term value for stakeholders across each business with dedicated management teams and Boards of directors.

announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Ltd. (HCLTech) announced the successful completion of its acquisition of HPE’s Telco Solutions business on August 3, 2026. This acquisition, initially announced in December 2025, significantly strengthens HCLTech’s leadership in AI- and engineering-led telecom solutions, building upon the integration of HPE's Communications Technology Group (CTG) in 2024. The transaction expands HCLTech's capabilities to assist Communications Service Providers (CSPs) in modernizing applications, adopting AI-led solutions, and monetizing networks, positioning the company to accelerate AI-led autonomous operations from radio to core. Furthermore, it broadens HCLTech's presence in the CSP market across North America, LATAM, Europe, and Asia Pacific, including Japan, enhancing its global delivery capabilities and telecom portfolio with IP, solutions, and integration services for OSS, HSS, and 5G Sub.
