announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: INOX India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 03, 2026, titled "Result Press Release for the Quarter ended on 30th June, 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: INOX India Limited released its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1 FY27) on August 03, 2026. The company reported a revenue of ₹382 Cr, marking an 8.3% year-on-year (YoY) growth. EBITDA for the quarter stood at ₹90 Cr, a 1.4% YoY increase, with an EBITDA Margin of 23.5%, while Profit After Tax (PAT) was ₹61 Cr, achieving a PAT Margin of 15.9%. Export revenue contributed significantly at ₹222 Cr, accounting for 58% of total revenues, with export orders now exceeding ₹1,140 Cr, providing strong revenue visibility for coming quarters. Order inflow for the quarter was ₹532 Cr, increasing the total order book to ₹1,686 Cr, and the Industrial Gases division contributed 53% to overall revenue. During Q1 FY27, INOX India secured a major order for large cryogenic storage tanks from the space exploration industry, along with six additional tanks from the same customer, and also entered the semiconductor infrastructure space.

announcements.ai_summary: Stove Kraft Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting a robust performance. Revenue from operations grew by 41.3% year-on-year to ₹480.6 crores, while Gross Profit increased by 46.0% to ₹190.4 crores. EBITDA saw a significant jump of 50.9% to ₹53.8 crores, and Profit After Tax (PAT) surged by 63.5% to ₹17.1 crores. The company highlighted exceptional growth in the Induction Cooktop category, which increased by 315.9% year-on-year. Core categories like Pressure Cookers and Non-stick Cookware also showed healthy growth of 21.8% and 41.3% respectively. This performance marks the strongest first-quarter result for Stove Kraft Limited since its inception.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Kaya Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 03, 2026, titled "Press Release for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.".
announcements.ai_summary: Kaya Limited issued a press release on August 03, 2026, announcing its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1 FY27). The company reported Revenue from operations at ₹ 60.1 crores for Q1 FY27, marking a growth of 14% over the corresponding quarter Q1 FY26. The Clinic business registered a revenue growth of 16% over Q1 FY26, with Services business also growing by 16% driven by categories like Brightening & Pigmentation, Acne & Scars, and Anti-Aging. The Skin business witnessed a growth of 19%, Hair business showed a 17% growth, and Product business grew by 16%, mainly driven by Nutraceutical, Lighter and Brighter, and Anti-Aging categories. The Profit/(Loss) after tax for Q1 FY27 was ₹ (15.2) crores, compared to a loss of ₹ (14.2) crores in Q1 FY26, with the higher loss primarily driven by the impact of GST 2.0 changes effective September 2025, which restricted input tax credit availability.

announcements.subject: Strikes/Lockouts/Disturbances
announcements.detail: DCW Limited has informed the Exchange about strikes/lockouts/disturbances
announcements.ai_summary: The operations at DCW Limited's Dhrangadhra plant in Gujarat have been temporarily suspended due to flooding and waterlogging caused by heavy rains since August 01, 2026. The company was intimated of this on August 03, 2026. While rainfall has become intermittent, normal operations are expected to resume in approximately 10 to 15 days, contingent on weather conditions and restoration efforts. The delay is attributed to flooding of the ground floor and underground areas of the plant. DCW Limited is implementing measures to ensure the safety of equipment, materials, and personnel, and will provide further updates to stakeholders on significant developments and the plant's operational status.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 03, 2026, titled "Press Release in respect of acquisition of 99.49% of the total voting power in Kirloskar South East Asia Co. Limited ('KSEA')".
announcements.ai_summary: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Limited has announced the completion of its acquisition of 99.49% of the total voting power in Kirloskar South East Asia Co. Limited (KSEA). This acquisition, effective August 3, 2026, makes KSEA a subsidiary of Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Limited. KSEA, incorporated in 2016 and based in Bangkok, Thailand, is engaged in the trading of compressors in the South-East Asian market. The company aims to strengthen its regional presence, enhance customer engagement, and improve sales and after-sales support through this strategic move. This acquisition is expected to enable Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Limited to respond more effectively to customer needs and expand its market coverage in the region.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: This is to inform you that the Board of Directors of Kansai Nerolac Paints Limited has, in the Board meeting held today i.e. on Monday, 3rd August, 2026, inter alia considered and approved the proposal for capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: Kansai Nerolac Paints Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on August 3, 2026, approved significant capacity additions across its plants. The Sayakha Plant will see an addition of 1,750 KL/month for Industrial Paints (Auto Paints, ARF-Auto Refinish, and Thinner) and 1,215 MT/month for Powder Coating, along with 815 MT/month for Industrial Resins. The Bawal Plant will add 1,625 KL/month for Industrial Paints (Auto Paints and Thinner), and the Hosur Plant will add 900 KL/month for Industrial Paints (Auto Paints and Thinner). The total investment for these expansions is Rs. 204 Crores at Sayakha, Rs. 143 Crores at Bawal, and Rs. 65 Crores at Hosur, to be financed through internal cash accruals. These capacity additions are planned to be completed in a phased manner by the end of FY 2028-29, driven by the estimated growth in the automotive paint industry.

announcements.ai_summary: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited has announced its financial results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, via a press release dated August 3, 2026. This performance reflects the company's ongoing portfolio transformation strategy and execution excellence. Key growth drivers included the General Medicines portfolio, which saw top five promoted brands outperforming the market, and advancements in the Respiratory and Vaccines businesses. The Oncology business also showed strength.

announcements.detail: Jindal Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 03, 2026, titled "Press release".
announcements.ai_summary: Jindal Stainless Limited (JSL) has announced its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1FY27). The company reported a consolidated net revenue of INR 11,279 crore, an increase of 10.5% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at INR 1,329 crore, and Profit After Tax (PAT) was INR 769 crore, showing year-on-year growth of 1.5% and 7.6% respectively. Finished goods sales volume was 580,805 tonnes, down 7.3% year-on-year. The consolidated net debt was INR 2,950 crore, with a net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.14x. The company experienced resilient performance despite supply chain pressures, driven by demand in key sectors like mobility, infrastructure, and manufacturing.

Mastek will leverage its expertise in engineering, data, and AI within the healthcare sector to implement the platform for healthcare organizations across North America, the UK, Europe, and the Middle East. This collaboration is a significant step towards Mastek's goal of becoming a leading AI transformation partner in the healthcare industry.

MNPPL is a Special Purpose Vehicle formed for operating and expanding "Shanku's Water Park" in Mehsana, Gujarat. This investment will provide Imagicaaworld with a 50% equity stake in MNPPL, which currently owns Shanku's Water Park via a slump sale arrangement. The SPV plans to raise additional capital for new attractions and facilities over the next 12-18 months. Imagicaaworld will also provide Operations & Management services, receiving management fees ranging from 6% to 10% based on agreed parameters. This acquisition is part of Imagicaaworld's strategy to deepen its presence in Gujarat and leverage its expertise in park operations.

announcements.subject: Press Release (Revised)
announcements.detail: Update on Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: The Karnataka Bank Limited has announced the launch of "KBL Finsurance," a new comprehensive digital portal designed to streamline its insurance business operations. This platform will facilitate the creation, tracking, and monitoring of insurance business leads across the bank's entire branch network. The project is powered by SprintMoney, a fintech company specializing in white-labelled digital solutions for financial institutions. KBL Finsurance empowers branch personnel with real-time capabilities for lead generation, tracking policy status, and accessing business management information system (MIS) reports. The bank has established tie-ups with insurance partners to ensure seamless integration with the new platform. This stoppage is attributed to demands from local laborers for full-time wages and benefits, despite an existing agreement from August 18th, 2020, which acknowledged an oversupply of personnel and limited their workdays to 4-5 per month with HPC wages. The company has taken several actions in response, including mailing letters to the SSP Dhanbad and DIG (CISF), BCCL, lodging an FIR at Baghmara Police Station, and informing relevant authorities at BCCL headquarters.

The company will not proceed with the allotment of these warrants and assures stakeholders that this withdrawal will not materially impact business operations or financial stability. The company may explore alternative capital raising avenues.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Mamata Machinery Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 02, 2026, titled "Mamata Machinery has been granted a patent in the European Unionfor its invention titled "Multi-Purpose Sealing Module"".
announcements.ai_summary: Mamata Machinery Limited has announced the grant of a patent in the European Union for its invention, a "Multi-Purpose Sealing Module for plastic film based bags and pouches making machines". The patent, European Patent No. 4467325 (EP4467325 B1), was published on May 13, 2026. This technology is already patented in India, and an application has been filed in the United States. With the European Union patent secured, Mamata Machinery will be able to offer this sealing solution to customers in the European market, strengthening its position in the global flexible packaging machinery industry. The company has over 35 years of experience and more than 5,400 machine installations in 80 countries.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Advait Energy Transitions Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Advait Energy Transitions Limited, through its subsidiary Advait BESS Bhesaan Private Limited, has executed a Battery Energy Storage Purchase Agreement (BESPA) with Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited (GUVNL). This agreement is for the development of a 150 MW/300 MWh standalone Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Project. The BESPA was executed on June 1, 2026, following a tariff-based competitive bidding process conducted by GUVNL under Phase-VIII, supported by Viability Gap Funding (VGF) through the Power System Development Fund (PSDF). Advait BESS Bhesaan Private Limited will develop, own, and operate the BESS Project near the 220kV Bhesan AIS S/S sub-station of GETCO in Gujarat. The project will make the contracted battery energy storage capacity available to GUVNL on a long-term basis.

announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Shipping Corporation of India Limited, in their meeting held on May 8, 2026, noted non-compliance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, for the quarter ended December 31, 2025. This non-compliance led to fines of Rs. 5,42,800 (inclusive of 18% GST) each levied by NSE and BSE. The Board acknowledged that as a Public Sector Undertaking, only the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (MoPSW) has the authority to appoint or remove Directors. The company had previously sent waiver request letters to NSE and BSE on March 5, 2026, and has consistently requested the Ministry to appoint the requisite number of Independent Directors, including a Women Independent Director. The company has also submitted these comments to the Exchange for their records.

announcements.detail: SBC Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about Launching of F-route Clothing brand Website
announcements.ai_summary: SBC Exports Limited announced on June 2, 2026, the official launch of its digital platform and website for its new clothing brand, "F-Route Clothing" (https://frouteclothing.com/). This initiative marks a significant milestone in the company's long-term growth strategy, expanding its operations from large-scale textile manufacturing and corporate supply into the direct-to-consumer (D2C) segment. The transition from traditional B2B trading to D2C sales is expected to boost revenue streams by enabling higher gross margins and direct inventory monetization from its Mirzapur and Sahibabad manufacturing units. F-Route Clothing aims to amplify market presence by entering India's fast-growing consumer retail segment, targeting Gen-Z and millennial consumers with affordable, expressive casual wear. This online platform will facilitate pan-India expansion across Tier-1, Tier-2, and Tier-3 cities, strengthening the company's brand equity and opening new revenue opportunities.

announcements.detail: Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 02, 2026, titled "GMDC Partners with University of Cambridge to Establish India s First AI-Powered Rare Earth Supply Chain Observatory".
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Limited (GMDC) has entered into a strategic collaboration with the University of Cambridge to establish India's first AI-powered Rare Earth Supply Chain Observatory. This observatory, to be located at GMDC's International Centre of Excellence in Mining, will utilize Artificial Intelligence to track the complete Rare Earth Elements (REE) value chain in real-time, from mine to magnet. The initiative, structured as a two-year program with an investment of £600,000, aims to provide actionable intelligence for policy calibration, industrial procurement, and strategic stockpiling decisions, positioning Gujarat and India at the forefront of rare earth supply chain resilience.

announcements.detail: Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 02, 2026, titled "Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Ltd Navigates One-Time Challenges; Management Confident of Recoveries and Long-Term Growth".
announcements.ai_summary: Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Limited issued a press release on June 02, 2026, titled "Vishnu Prakash R Punglia Ltd Navigates One-Time Challenges; Management Confident of Recoveries and Long-Term Growth." The company reported a loss before tax of approximately ₹151.77 crore during the quarter, which management attributes to exceptional, non-recurring, and timing-related factors. A primary contributor was the termination of the Jaipur–Sawai Madhopur project by the employer, resulting in a total impact of ₹22.42 crore. This impact includes a one-time charge of approximately ₹12.46 crore to the Statement of Profit and Loss and an exceptional item of ₹9.96 crore recognized in the previous quarter. The matter concerning the project termination and associated contractual claims is currently sub-judice before appropriate judicial authorities. Based on legal advice and the merits of the case, management remains confident of a favorable outcome and expects substantial recovery of the claimed amounts.

The proceeds will be used to de-leverage the company's balance sheet, enhancing its financial strength and supporting future growth initiatives. Following the allotment, STL's paid-up equity share capital has increased to INR 102.78 crore, comprising 51.39 crore equity shares.

The subsidiary will be involved in the manufacturing and marketing of pharmaceuticals and related products, aligning with the company's strategic objective for business expansion.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Seamec Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of Deployment Status of Vessel SEAMEC PALADIN - arrival of vessel into India'.

The vessel had been held up in Dubai after dry docking due to geopolitical situations. Following the completion of necessary formalities, the vessel is scheduled to be redeployed with ONGC to continue its long-term charter in approximately 15 days. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: BLS E-Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 02, 2026, titled "BLS E-Services Successfully Consummates Acquisition of 100% stake in Atyati Technologies, Acquisition to strengthen BLSe's AI driven banking solutions and technology capabilities for banks and financial institutions.".
announcements.ai_summary: BLS E-Services Limited has successfully completed the acquisition of a 100% stake in Atyati Technologies Private Limited for approximately ₹157 Crores in an all-cash transaction on July 2, 2026. Atyati Technologies is an AI-powered banking technology company based in Bengaluru, providing digital solutions to banks and financial institutions. This acquisition is expected to strengthen BLS E-Services' AI-driven banking solutions and technology capabilities for banks and financial institutions. Atyati serves over 35 banks and financial institutions through a network of more than 25,900 Customer Service Points (CSPs) across India. Lagrange Point Advisors LLP acted as the transaction advisor, Dentons Link Legal as the legal advisor, and Deloitte as the financial and tax due diligence advisor for BLS E-Services.

announcements.subject: General Updates

announcements.ai_summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited has provided business updates for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. This growth was driven by robust disbursements of approximately ₹6,804 Crore, representing a 93.77% YoY increase and a 7.39% QoQ decline. Total Deposits increased by 10.44% YoY to ₹48,976 Crore and by 5.25% QoQ to ₹48,976 Crore. The CASA ratio stood at 25% as of June 30, 2026, with CASA deposits at ₹12,307 Crore. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 02, 2026, titled "Titagarh Rail Systems Limited and TuTr Hyperloop, an IIT Madras-incubated deep-tech startup pioneering indigenous Hyperloop technologies enter into a strategic collaboration agreement to advance indigenous Hyperloop Technology for India's First Hyperloop-Enabled Freight Mobility Solutions".
announcements.ai_summary: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited (TRSL) has entered into a Strategic Collaboration Agreement with TuTr Hyperloop Private Limited, an IIT Madras-incubated startup specializing in Hyperloop technologies. This collaboration aims to develop India's first Hyperloop-enabled freight transportation solutions. TRSL will leverage its expertise in rolling stock design, engineering, and manufacturing, while TuTr Hyperloop will contribute its capabilities in Hyperloop propulsion, control systems, and advanced mobility technologies. The agreement establishes a framework to evaluate, design, develop, integrate, and explore the commercialization of high-speed, energy-efficient freight transportation systems. This initiative is intended to build indigenous, automated, and advanced freight mobility solutions, aligning with India's 'Make in India' and 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' objectives. The press release was issued on July 02, 2026.

Premier Energies Limited will subscribe to 50,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each, aggregating to Rs.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bikewo Green Tech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 02, 2026, titled "BikeWo Signs Strategic MoU with PositiEV Mobility and Proposes Hiten Pal Saklani as CEO".
announcements.ai_summary: Bikewo Green Tech Limited announced on July 2, 2026, that it has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with PositiEV Mobility Private Limited to pursue a strategic partnership. Under this proposed transaction, BikeWo intends to acquire a majority stake of 51% in PositiEV Mobility. This acquisition is contingent upon satisfactory due diligence, mutually agreed valuation, execution of definitive agreements, and all necessary corporate, statutory, and regulatory approvals. Furthermore, the MoU outlines the intention that Mr. Hiten Pal Saklani, Founder of PositiEV Mobility, will assume the role of Chief Executive Officer of BikeWo Green Tech Limited upon successful completion of the transaction, subject to Board approval and definitive agreements. This move aims to create an integrated platform for EV retail, leasing, financing, charging infrastructure, battery swapping, fleet solutions, and after-sales services.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Net Avenue Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Net Avenue Technologies Limited has received an Order from the Court of Principal Commercial Court, Egmore, Chennai, in C.O.S. No. 1167 of 2022. The order directs the company to pay Rs. 13,92,749/- to Fasttrack Logistics. Additionally, the company is required to pay interest at 18% per annum on Rs. 9,16,160/- from April 2018, along with the cost of the suit.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: GSP Crop Science Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 02, 2026 regarding approval of Scheme of Arrangement.
announcements.ai_summary: GSP Crop Science Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 02, 2026, approved a Scheme of Arrangement. This scheme involves the amalgamation of Rajdhani Petrochemicals Private Limited (Transferor Company or RPPL) and GSP Intermediates Private Limited (Demerged Company or GIPL) with GSP Crop Science Limited (The Company or Transferee Company or Resulting Company or GSP). The Appointed Date for the scheme is April 1, 2026. All assets and liabilities of RPPL and the demerged undertaking of GIPL will be transferred to GSP Crop Science Limited at their carrying values. Since GSP Crop Science Limited holds the entire share capital of RPPL and GIPL, no new equity shares will be allotted upon the scheme becoming effective, and the equity shares held by GSP Crop Science Limited in RPPL will stand cancelled. The Board Meeting commenced at 4:00 P.M. and concluded at 5:30 P.M. (IST).

The requests will be placed before the Board of Directors for their consideration. Subject to Board approval, the company will proceed with the necessary steps, including submitting an application to the stock exchanges.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: TVS Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: TVS Holdings Limited announced on July 02, 2026, that it has acquired an additional 6,58,64,009 equity shares of face value Rs. 10/- each in its subsidiary, Home Credit India Finance Private Limited (HCIFPL). These shares were allotted to TVS Holdings pursuant to a rights issue offer made to the company. The aggregate cost of this additional investment exceeded the materiality threshold for disclosure. Despite this acquisition, TVS Holdings Limited's aggregate holding in HCIFPL remains unchanged at 80.17%. HCIFPL is a non-deposit-taking non-banking financial company, registered with the Reserve Bank of India as a middle layer NBFC, engaged in providing consumer durable loans, cash loans, and non-credit value-added services.

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: The Jammu & Kashmir Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
announcements.ai_summary: The Jammu & Kashmir Bank Limited announced on July 02, 2026, that it has signed Corporate Agency Agreements with SBI Life Insurance Company Limited and HDFC Life Insurance Company Limited. These agreements, effective from July 02, 2026, enable the Bank to service and solicit insurance products from both companies through its extensive branch network. The purpose of these agreements is to expand the Bank's product offerings to its customers. The Bank confirmed it holds no shareholding in either SBI Life Insurance or HDFC Life Insurance. Furthermore, the agreements do not grant any special rights such as appointing directors, share subscription rights, or the ability to restrict changes in capital structure.

This intimation was made under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company has also made this update available on its official website for investor reference.

announcements.subject: Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up
announcements.detail: LENSKART: Lenskart Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about the incorporation of a Joint Venture Company in India with Mingfeng Glassesworld Limited, pursuant to a strategic partnership between the parties.
announcements.ai_summary: Lenskart Solutions Limited's Board of Directors, during its meeting held on July 2, 2026, approved the establishment of a Joint Venture Company in India. This strategic partnership is formed with Mingfeng Glassesworld Limited (MGL), a company based in China. The primary business objective of the newly formed Joint Venture will be the manufacturing of metal spectacle frames within India. The company aims to achieve several strategic goals through this JV, including strengthening its manufacturing capabilities, enhancing overall supply chain efficiencies, and promoting the localization of manufacturing processes. This initiative is expected to contribute to Lenskart's operational resilience and reduce its dependence on imported components.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: YES Bank Limited announced on July 2, 2026, that its subsidiary, YES Securities (India) Limited, has fully complied with the directions issued by the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE). This compliance pertains to an NSE order dated May 26, 2026, which had imposed a prohibition on YES Securities (India) Limited from onboarding any new clients for a period of 3 months and levied a monetary penalty of ₹2 lakhs. YES Securities (India) Limited undertook the necessary corrective actions and engaged proactively with NSE in the verification process. As a result, the NSE, through its order dated July 1, 2026, decided to lift the prohibition on onboarding new clients for YES Securities (India) Limited, effective from the date of the order.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'restoration of supply of raw materials to normal levels'.
announcements.ai_summary: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited announced on July 2, 2026, that the temporary constraints in the availability of raw materials have eased, with supply restored to normal levels. This update follows an earlier intimation dated March 11, 2026, which reported supply issues stemming from the geopolitical situation in the Middle East, leading to diversion of LPG and suspension of feedstock supplies. The company confirmed that, pursuant to Government directions relaxing supply restrictions, the raw material supply position has normalized. Consequently, the Company's operations are now expected to continue without disruption. During the period of constrained availability, the Company managed its operations prudently, and the constraints did not have any material adverse financial impact, apart from certain variations in raw material prices.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: CSB Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Business Updates for the quarter ended June 30, 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: CSB Bank Limited released its provisional business updates for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Total Deposits increased by 26% year-on-year (YoY) to ₹45,415 Crore as of June 30, 2026, compared to ₹35,935 Crore on June 30, 2025. Within deposits, Term Deposits grew by 33% YoY to ₹36,600 Crore, while CASA deposits saw a 4% YoY increase to ₹8,815 Crore. Gross Advances rose by 24% YoY, reaching ₹40,866 Crore as of June 30, 2026, up from ₹32,944 Crore in the prior year. Advances against Gold & Gold Jewellery (excluding receivables secured against gold) demonstrated robust growth of 47% YoY, amounting to ₹21,906 Crore. These figures are provisional and are subject to a limited review by the Joint Statutory Auditors of the Bank.

This amalgamation is being pursued under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013, and is contingent upon receiving all necessary statutory and regulatory approvals. The company confirmed that, in accordance with Regulation 37 of the SEBI LODR Regulations and SEBI Master Circular dated June 20, 2023, the scheme is exempt from requiring a No-Objection Letter from the Stock Exchanges. The Scheme of Amalgamation and the Board Resolution approving it have been submitted to the Stock Exchanges for disclosure purposes.

announcements.ai_summary: Dreamfolks Services Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on July 2, 2026, approved a proposal to provide a Corporate Guarantee and Security in favor of AU Small Finance Bank Ltd. This guarantee will secure a Dropline Overdraft facility of INR 2.50 crore for Ten 11 Hospitality Private Limited (Ten 11). The facility will be secured by a Letter of Guarantee and a Fixed Deposit of INR 1 crore as collateral. The initial period for the guarantee is one year, with an auto-renewal provision until the loan tenure. The inspection took place from June 22, 2026, to June 30, 2026. The inspection concluded with one observation, to which the company will provide a comprehensive response to the FDA within the stipulated timeframe. The company will continue to keep the stock exchanges informed of any further developments.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Hindustan Zinc Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Production Release for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Zinc Limited has announced its production figures for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting its highest-ever first-quarter mined metal production for the fifth consecutive year. The company produced 268 thousand tonnes of mined metal, a 1% increase compared to 265 thousand tonnes in the preceding quarter (4Q FY26) and a 15% decrease from 315 thousand tonnes in the same quarter of the previous fiscal year (1Q FY26). Saleable metal production stood at 260 thousand tonnes, up 4% from 250 thousand tonnes in 4Q FY26 but down 8% from 282 thousand tonnes in 1Q FY26. Refined zinc production was 213 thousand tonnes, and refined lead production was 47 thousand tonnes. Silver production was 149 metric tonnes, and wind power generation was 133 million units. This update was released on July 2, 2026.

This transfer was executed to Auropharm Limited (formerly Auro Pharma Limited), a wholly owned subsidiary of Aurobindo Pharma, as a going concern on a slump sale basis. The company had previously intimated this transaction via a letter dated April 6, 2026, detailing the Business Transfer Agreement (BTA). announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Abans Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'General Update'.
announcements.ai_summary: Abans Financial Services Limited (formerly Abans Holdings Limited) informed the exchanges on July 02, 2026, about a general update regarding a probable ransomware attack. The company received an email from the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) on June 30, 2026, alerting them to the potential cyber incident. Following a preliminary investigation, Abans Financial Services ascertained that the attack did not affect its own IT systems but was directed at the IT infrastructure of its overseas subsidiaries. Crucially, the company confirmed that the incident has not impacted the business continuity of either the company or its subsidiaries, nor has it had any material financial impact. Abans Financial Services is actively monitoring the situation and implementing adequate remedial steps as a measure of good governance.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 02, 2026, titled "Glenmark Advances Multi-Country Phase 3 Clinical Trial of Trastuzumab rezetecan in Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer".
announcements.ai_summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary Glenmark Specialty S.A., has announced the advancement of its multi-country Phase 3 clinical trial for Trastuzumab rezetecan (SHR-A1811), a HER2-targeted antibody drug conjugate (ADC), for patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (PROC). announcements.ai_summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited (APSEZ) has provided its operational performance update for June 2026 and the first quarter of FY27. In June 2026, APSEZ handled a cargo volume of 46.8 Million Metric Tons (MMT), marking a 13% year-on-year increase, primarily driven by containers (+18% YoY) and liquids (+11% YoY). announcements.ai_summary: ESAF Small Finance Bank Limited has reported key business updates for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Total deposits grew by 18.62% year-on-year to ₹26,925 Crore, with Term Deposits reaching ₹20,627 Crore and CASA deposits at ₹6,298 Crore. The CASA ratio stood at 23.39%. Gross advances increased by 27.39% year-on-year to ₹23,216 Crore, with Micro Loans at ₹8,733 Crore and Retail and Other Loans at ₹14,483 Crore. announcements.ai_summary: Pranik Logistics Limited has executed a Master Service Agreement (MSA) with InstaKart Services Private Limited, the logistics arm of the Flipkart group. This agreement, finalized on June 30, 2026, establishes the framework for managing fulfillment centers, warehouses, and delivery hubs located in Bhagalpur, Bihar. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Devyani International Limited has informed the Exchange about update on acquisition.
announcements.ai_summary: Devyani International Limited has provided an update on its investment in Restaurants Development Co., Ltd. (“RD”), a subsidiary in Thailand operating KFC stores. The company, through its subsidiaries Devyani International DMCC (“DID”) and Yellow Palm Co., Ltd., has completed additional investments in RD, maintaining a 49% and 51% shareholding respectively. Previously, Devyani International Limited had approved an investment of approximately THB 1,210 Mn (INR 3,473 Mn) in RD and a convertible loan of approximately THB 400 Mn (INR 1,148 Mn) to DID. Following the conversion of this loan, Devyani International Limited's shareholding in DID is expected to increase from approximately 51% to approximately 56.7%, subject to approval from the Dubai Multi Commodities Centre Authority. The company also previously provided a corporate guarantee for a short-term credit facility of approximately THB 810 Mn (INR 2,325 Mn) to DID, which has now been fully repaid by DID, and the corporate guarantee has been released. The net investment in RD amounts to approximately THB 400 Mn (INR 1,148 Mn).

announcements.ai_summary: The South Indian Bank Limited has provided its provisional business updates for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, as intimated on July 01, 2026. Gross Advances increased by 17.01% year-on-year to Rs. 104,366 Crore as of June 30, 2026, from Rs. 89,198 Crore on June 30, 2025. Total Deposits grew by 11.39% year-on-year to Rs. 125,786 Crore, while CASA deposits rose by 14.61% to Rs. 41,493 Crore, resulting in a CASA Ratio of 32.99%. announcements.detail: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Maruti Suzuki Production volume: June 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has released its production figures for June 2026. The company produced a total of 178,024 vehicles, comprising 174,839 passenger vehicles and 3,185 light commercial vehicles. Within passenger vehicles, the "Compact" segment, which includes models like Baleno, Celerio, Dzire, Ignis, Swift, and WagonR, saw the highest production at 76,835 units. The "Utility Vehicles" segment, including models such as Brezza, Ertiga, and XL6, produced 76,626 units. The "Mini" segment (Alto, S-Presso) produced 10,718 units, and "Vans" (Eeco) produced 10,660 units. These figures are a comparison to the production in June 2025, which stood at 127,545 total vehicles.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Srivasavi Adhesive Tapes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 01, 2026, titled "Srivasavi Adhesive Tapes Limited's Polymer Division Enters into a Five-Year Supply Purchase Agreement with a Global MNC".
announcements.ai_summary: Srivasavi Adhesive Tapes Limited has issued a press release announcing a five-year supply purchase agreement between its Polymer Division and a Global MNC, effective July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2031, with renewal options. Under this agreement, Srivasavi's Polymer Division will manufacture woven fabric in various grades, including non-VCI, VCI, laminated, and printed variants, adhering to the company's technical specifications. The company has provided non-binding annual volume projections for planning, anticipating an offtake of approximately 2,500 MT in the first year, increasing to about 3,200 MT in the second year, and approximately 3,900 MT in the third year, across basic, laminated, and printed fabric categories, with actual volumes subject to specific purchase orders. The agreement also details quality assurance, packing, storage, logistics protocols, and standard payment terms aligned with MSME facilitation norms.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Syngene International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 01, 2026, titled "Siddharth Mittal Appointed as Managing Director & CEO of Syngene International".
announcements.ai_summary: Syngene International Limited announced that Siddharth Mittal has assumed the role of Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, effective July 1, 2026. Mr. Mittal succeeds Peter Bains, whose tenure as Managing Director & CEO concluded on June 30, 2026. Siddharth Mittal brings nearly three decades of business leadership experience, having previously served as the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Biocon Limited. During his thirteen years at Biocon, he also held the position of Chief Financial Officer. His contributions at Biocon included shaping strategic direction, strengthening commercial operations, expanding global presence, securing key regulatory approvals, and successfully commercializing Biocon's GLP-1 portfolio. Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, Executive Chairperson of Syngene International, expressed delight in welcoming Mr. Mittal, highlighting their long-standing collaboration.

announcements.subject: Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.detail: Canarys Automations Limited has informed the Exchange about Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
announcements.ai_summary: Canarys Automations Limited has secured a significant contract from the Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority (GNIDA) for its Storm Water Management Programme (Phase A). The contract, awarded on July 01, 2026, involves providing consulting and digital twin-based components, including a detailed Storm Water Design & Resolution Plan. The engagement is for a duration of 12 months for this phase. The commercial consideration for Phase A of this order is INR 9,84,88,645 (Nine Crore Eighty-Four Lakh Eighty-Eight Thousand Six Hundred and Forty-Five Only). Canarys Automations will utilize LiDAR-based surveys, hydrological and hydraulic modelling, and IoT and AI-based design studies. announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: WABAG wins Large Order towards expansion of the Donauinsel Water Works in Vienna, Austria
announcements.ai_summary: VA Tech Wabag Limited has secured a 'Large' Order for the expansion of the Donauinsel Water Works in Vienna, Austria. The order has been awarded by the City of Vienna, Municipal Department MA 31 – Wiener Wasser. This project will see Wabag responsible for the complete technology package of the new water works, encompassing process engineering, electrical engineering, instrumentation, and control systems, as well as building construction. The overall facility is slated for completion and commissioning in 2030, with subsequent acceptance milestones. This contract reinforces Wabag's position as a leading full-service provider in drinking water and wastewater treatment and highlights its focus on Europe.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Acme Solar Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on commissioning of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project
announcements.ai_summary: Acme Solar Holdings Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary ACME Suryodaya Private Limited, has commissioned a 240.720 MWh capacity Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project. This project is located in Village Sanwara and Mehar Nagar, Tehsil Pokhran, District Jaisalmer, Rajasthan. The commercial operation date (COD) for this BESS project is scheduled for July 02, 2026. Following this commissioning, ACME Suryodaya Private Limited has now achieved a total commissioned capacity of 285 MW / 842.624 MWh. This development follows a previous intimation dated April 13, 2026, and signifies an expansion of the company's energy storage capabilities.

announcements.subject: Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates-Sales Fig for the month of June 2026
announcements.ai_summary: SML Mahindra Limited has reported its sales figures for the month of June 2026. In June 2026, the company sold 355 Cargo Vehicles, a decrease of 26% compared to 480 units in June 2025. Passenger Vehicle sales for June 2026 were 1575 units, an increase of 13% from 1391 units in June 2025. Cumulatively for the April-June period of FY2026-27, Cargo Vehicle sales stood at 1109 units, down 13% from 1282 units in the same period of FY2025-26. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Wealth First Portfolio Managers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 01, 2026, titled "WEALTH FIRST ANNOUNCES ACQUISITION OF CONTROLLING INTEREST IN WFAPL, EXPANDING NATIONAL FOOTPRINT".
announcements.ai_summary: Wealth First Portfolio Managers Limited has announced the acquisition of a controlling interest in Wealth First Advisors Private Limited (WFAPL), a Mumbai-based wealth management and distribution firm. The acquisition is valued at ₹102.15 crore and will initially involve Wealth First acquiring a 51% stake through a combination of internal accruals and a share swap. This move significantly strengthens Wealth First's presence in the Mumbai market and increases the combined assets under management to nearly ₹9,000 crore. The remaining 49% of WFAPL will be acquired at a future date, specifically on March 31, 2029, and will be settled entirely through a share swap based on WFAPL's valuation at that time. This acquisition marks a significant step in Wealth First's evolution into a national financial services institution.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Godrej Properties Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 01, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Godrej Properties Limited announced on July 01, 2026, that it has emerged as the highest bidder for a 4.95-acre residential land parcel in Sector 151, Noida, acquired for INR 331.75 crore. This development is expected to offer an estimated revenue potential of over INR 2,000 crore. The company plans to develop a premium residential group housing project on this strategically located plot, which offers good connectivity to the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway and the upcoming Noida International Airport. This acquisition follows Godrej Properties' recent purchase of a 23.2-acre land parcel in Greater Noida earlier in July, which has an estimated revenue potential exceeding INR 7,000 crore. The company views this new project as a significant addition to its portfolio in the National Capital Region, aligning with its strategy to deepen its presence in key Indian cities. NOIDA will issue the allotment letter following the due process.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Ghcl Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of Fire incident at warehouse'.
announcements.ai_summary: GHCL Textiles Limited has reported a fire incident at its warehouse located at No: 1S/1-A, Madurai Bye Pass Road, Tuticorin, near the Tuticorin Port, which occurred on August 1, 2026, around 6:30 PM. The fire broke out in a warehouse used for storing imported raw cotton bales, which are raw materials for the manufacturing process. The cause of the fire is yet to be ascertained. The fire was controlled by the local Fire Department and the company's internal team, with no human casualties or injuries reported. There is no impact on the company's production or operations. The financial impact is currently being ascertained and will be communicated to stock exchanges and investors. The warehouse and stock at the affected location are adequately insured, and the insurance company has been intimated, with an insurance survey expected in due course.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Indian Bank has informed the Exchange about Revision in Benchmark Rates
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Bank's Asset Liability Management Committee (ALCO) has reviewed and decided to revise its Treasury Bills Linked Lending Rate (TBLR). Effective from August 3, 2026, the TBLR for tenors greater than 3 months and up to 6 months will be revised to 5.50% from 5.55%, and for tenors greater than 6 months and up to 1 year, and greater than 1 year and up to 3 years, it will be revised to 5.65% from 5.85%. The TBLR for tenors less than or equal to 3 months remains unchanged at 5.30%. The bank has also confirmed that its Marginal Cost of funds based Lending Rate (MCLR), Base Rate, Benchmark Prime Lending Rate (BPLR), Policy Repo Rate, and Repo Linked Benchmark Lending Rates (RBLR) remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: K.P. Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Execution of Power Purchase Agreement with GUVNL for 100 MW Grid Connected Wind Power Project'.
announcements.ai_summary: K.P. Energy Limited has executed a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited (GUVNL) for a 100 MW Grid Connected Wind Power Project. This agreement was secured under GUVNL's Wind Tender Phase X, following a Letter of Intent issued on March 30, 2026, and subsequent approval from the Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission (GERC). The PPA has a contracted capacity of 100 MW and is for the development of a wind power project under the company's Independent Power Producer (IPP) segment. The scheduled commencement of supply is July 30, 2028, which is 24 months from the PPA execution date. The PPA is for a period of 25 years with an approved tariff of ₹3.435 per unit. This development increases K.P. Energy Limited's cumulative IPP portfolio to over 250 MW.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 01, 2026, titled "TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 02, 2026, titled -Titagarh Naval Systems Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of Titagarh Rail Systems Limited) Launches Fifth & Final Diving Support Craft A24 (YARD 329) for Indian Navy".
announcements.ai_summary: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited has informed the stock exchanges about a press release issued by its wholly-owned subsidiary, Titagarh Naval Systems Limited (TNSL). On August 1, 2026, TNSL launched the fifth and final Diving Support Craft A24 (YARD 329) for the Indian Navy. This launch marks the completion of a series of five Diving Support Crafts being built under the Government of India's Make in India initiative. The vessel was successfully side-launched into the Hooghly River at 1505 Hrs. These catamaran-type vessels are equipped with advanced, indigenously sourced systems to support the Indian Navy’s Command Clearance Diving Teams (CCDTs) for underwater operations.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Sarda Energy & Minerals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 01, 2026, titled "Press Release".
announcements.ai_summary: Sarda Energy & Minerals Limited has released its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1 FY27) on August 01, 2026. The PAT includes a one-time net benefit of ₹110 crore related to the regulatory approval of the final project cost for its 113 MW Sikkim Hydropower Plant. Sarda Energy & Minerals Limited is confident in its medium-term growth strategy, aiming to quadruple mining capacity and double energy generation capacity, supported by a net debt-free balance sheet and healthy cash generation.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Muthoot Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 01, 2026, titled "Press release on Board level changes".
announcements.ai_summary: Muthoot Finance Limited has announced a leadership succession plan, recommending the appointment of Mr. Alexander George as the Managing Director, effective October 1, 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming AGM. announcements.subject: Press Release

announcements.detail: Eicher Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates for the month of July 2026 of VE Commercial Vehicles Limited, an unlisted material subsidiary of Eicher MOtors Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Eicher Motors Limited has provided an update on the monthly business performance of its unlisted material subsidiary, VE Commercial Vehicles Limited (VECV), for the month of July 2026. VECV reported total sales of 8,241 vehicles in July 2026, an increase of 15.8% compared to 7,115 vehicles sold in July 2025. For the year-to-date period in FY 2026-27, VECV sold a total of 33,056 vehicles, up 15.1% from 28,725 vehicles in the corresponding period of FY 2025-26. The domestic sales for VECV in July 2026 were 7,575 units, a 18.2% increase year-on-year, while exports stood at 470 units, a decrease of 11.3%.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Max Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under the extant provisions of Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI LODR ) regarding Axis Max Life Insurance Limited ( Axis Max Life ), the material subsidiary of the Company '.
announcements.ai_summary: Max Financial Services Limited has disclosed that its material subsidiary, Axis Max Life Insurance Limited, has made a payment of interest and redemption amount to its debenture holders. This payment was made on July 31, 2026, which was the immediately preceding business day before the due date of August 2, 2026, as the due date fell on a non-business day. The payment pertains to 4,960 unsecured, subordinated, listed, rated, redeemable, non-cumulative, taxable, non-convertible debentures. The record date for this payment was July 16, 2026. Axis Max Life Insurance Limited has duly informed the debenture holders about this remittance.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Update - HCLTech completes acquisition of Telco Solutions Business from Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE)
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Limited announced the completion of its acquisition of the Telco Solutions Business from Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE). The acquisition was finalized at 9:31 a.m. IST on August 1, 2026. This follows the company's earlier intimation of the acquisition on December 18, 2025. The announcement was made on August 1, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we are pleased to announce that the Company has entered into a strategic long-term supply arrangement with Kemin Industries for the supply of key ingredients to support its food and feed industry. Under this partnership, the Company will serve as a substantial primary supplier for an initial term of five years.
announcements.ai_summary: Clean Science and Technology Limited has entered into a strategic long-term supply arrangement with Kemin Industries, effective August 1st, 2026. Under this partnership, Clean Science and Technology Limited will serve as a substantial primary supplier of key ingredients for Kemin Industries' food and feed industry for an initial term of five years. This collaboration aligns with the company's business strategy and is expected to foster strategic partnerships. The announcement was made on August 1st, 2026.

announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger
announcements.detail: MPS Limited has informed the Exchange about the Completion of the Merger of American Journal Experts, LLC, North Carolina, with and into American Journal Experts, LLC, Delaware.
announcements.ai_summary: MPS Limited has completed the first step of its internal restructuring involving its subsidiaries, with the merger of American Journal Experts, LLC, North Carolina (AJE-NC) with and into American Journal Experts, LLC, Delaware (AJE-DE), effective August 01, 2026. Following this, AJE-DE will continue as the surviving entity, assuming all rights, assets, debts, liabilities, and obligations of AJE-NC. The second step of the merger, involving the amalgamation of AJE-DE with and into MPS North America LLC, is pending and will become effective on a date to be determined. This information was disclosed on August 01, 2026, referencing an earlier intimation on May 15, 2025.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Hyundai Motor India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 01, 2026, titled "Press Release for sales number for the month of July 2026".
announcements.ai_summary: Hyundai Motor India Limited announced its highest-ever total monthly sales of 75,360 units in July 2026, representing a 25.4% year-on-year growth. This includes domestic sales of 54,210 units, up 23.3% year-on-year, and export sales of 21,150 units, an increase of 31.4% year-on-year. The company also achieved its highest monthly export sales in over 100 months during July 2026. The Hyundai CRETA recorded its highest monthly sales for calendar year 2026 with 18,088 units, and the Hyundai i20 also achieved its highest monthly sales for calendar year 2026 with 6,738 units. These results were announced on August 01, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: CDSL has informed the Exchange regarding the Allotment of equity shares in India International Bullion Holding IFSC Limited (IIBHL)
announcements.ai_summary: Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL) has informed the exchange about the allotment of equity shares in India International Bullion Holding IFSC Limited (IIBHL). On July 31, 2026, CDSL was allotted 10,00,00,000 (Ten Crores) equity shares of ₹1 (Rupee One) each, amounting to ₹10,00,00,000 (Rupees Ten Crores). This allotment represents a 20% equity stake in IIBHL. This investment is a part of the first tranche of the rights issue of IIBHL, following SEBI's approval received on July 9, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Update - HCLTech completes acquisition of Guardian India Operations Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Limited has successfully completed the acquisition of Guardian India Operations Private Limited. The company had previously announced its intention to acquire 100% stake in the Indian-incorporated entity on July 16, 2026. The acquisition was officially completed at 11:59 p.m. IST on July 31, 2026. This strategic move is expected to further enhance HCLTech's capabilities and market presence.

announcements.subject: Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates for the month of July 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has released its monthly business update for July 2026, highlighting strong sales performance across its automotive segments. The company reported total vehicle sales of 1,03,860 vehicles, a 26% year-on-year growth, including exports. In the Utility Vehicles segment, domestic sales reached 60,048 vehicles, a 20% increase, with overall UV sales (including exports) at 60,887 vehicles. Commercial Vehicle sales in the domestic market stood at 25,204 units, a 23% growth. For the Passenger Vehicles segment, domestic sales for Utility Vehicles in July 2026 were 60,048 units, a 20% growth compared to 49,871 units in July 2025. The company's exports also saw substantial growth, with total exports at 4,070 units, a 47% increase.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 01, 2026, titled "Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015".
announcements.ai_summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited has announced a significant development in its biosimilars portfolio with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval for its rituximab biosimilar. This approval, received on August 1, 2026, is for the U.S. market and marks a key milestone for the company's expansion in the United States. The biosimilar was developed and manufactured by Dr. Reddy's and its approval follows a successful Pre-License Inspection of the company's biologics manufacturing facility in Bachupally, Hyderabad. Fresenius Kabi will exclusively commercialize the product in the United States under a commercialization agreement. The rituximab biosimilar is already available in India, the European Union, the United Kingdom, and over 25 emerging markets, and has also received marketing approval in Switzerland and Canada.

announcements.subject: Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: Escorts Kubota Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates for the month of July 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Escorts Kubota Limited reported its business update for July 2026, showing a significant increase in tractor sales. The Agri Machinery Business sold 8,731 tractors, a 22.0% growth compared to 7,154 tractors sold in July 2025. Domestic tractor sales reached 8,194 units, up 23.7% from 6,624 units in July 2025, driven by improved rainfall and increased Kharif sowing activity. Export tractor sales saw a modest growth of 1.3%, with 537 units sold compared to 530 units in July 2025. For the fiscal year 2027 (April-July), total tractor sales were 45,593 units, a 20.8% increase from 37,735 units in the same period of fiscal year 2026. The company will continue to monitor factors such as Kharif crop progress, monsoon, festive season impact, input costs, and the high base effect in the coming months.

announcements.subject: Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates - Sales Fig for the month of July 2026
announcements.ai_summary: SML Mahindra Limited has released its monthly business update for July 2026, detailing sales figures for its vehicle categories. In July 2026, the company sold 417 Cargo Vehicles, a decrease of 7% compared to 449 units sold in July 2025. For the April-July 2026-27 period, Cargo Vehicle sales stood at 1526 units, down 12% from 1731 units in the same period of the previous year. Conversely, Passenger Vehicle sales saw a significant increase, with 1186 units sold in July 2026, a 21% rise from 978 units in July 2025. For the April-July 2026-27 period, Passenger Vehicle sales reached 5515 units, an 19% increase from 4622 units in the prior year. Overall, total sales for July 2026 were 1603 units, up 12% from 1427 units in July 2025, and total sales for the April-July 2026-27 period were 7041 units, an 11% increase from 6353 units in the previous year.

announcements.company: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited
announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 01, 2026, titled  Gaudium IVF Introduces AI-Led Infertility Treatment, Marking an Industry First in India .
announcements.ai_summary: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited has issued a press release dated April 01, 2026, announcing a significant industry first in India: the introduction of AI-led infertility treatment. This innovative approach integrates advanced AI-driven embryology systems, such as SiD (Sperm Identification Device) and ERICA (Embryo Ranking Intelligent Classification Assistant), into their clinical practice. The initiative was inaugurated by Hon’ble Union Minister Shri Nitin Jairam Gadkari and is a collaboration with UK-headquartered embryology innovation organization, IVF 2.0. This development marks Gaudium IVF's commitment to leveraging technology in fertility healthcare, following its recent status as India's first publicly listed IVF chain. The press release is available on the company's website, www.gaudiumivfcentre.com.

announcements.subject: Agreements
announcements.detail: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation Limited has entered into an agreement with M/s Fortuna Public Relations Private Limited, New Delhi (FPRPL), effective April 1, 2026. FPRPL will serve as the Company's Public Relations Consultants, focusing on media relations, mass communications advice, and corporate image building. This agreement is valid for a period of two years, concluding on March 31, 2028. The company has confirmed that there is no shareholding in FPRPL, and the parties are not related. The agreement does not involve any special rights for FPRPL, such as appointing directors or pre-emptive rights on share subscriptions.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 01, 2026, titled "100% subsidiary, Popular Autoworks Pvt Ltd commence operations of state-of-the-art JLR 3S Facility in Nagpur, Maharashtra".
announcements.ai_summary: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited announced on April 01, 2026, that its wholly owned subsidiary, Popular Autoworks Private Limited, has commenced operations of a new state-of-the-art Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) 3S facility in Nagpur, Maharashtra. The facility, located at MIDC, Hingna Road, Nagpur, includes a showroom, workshop with 8 service bays capable of servicing approximately 50 vehicles per month, and a pre-owned car section. The total investment in this facility is approximately ₹15 crore. This expansion strengthens PVSL's presence in Maharashtra and its partnership with JLR, aiming to provide a premium ownership experience to customers in the Vidarbha region.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Business Updates for the financial year ended March 31, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: The South Indian Bank Limited has provided business updates for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. As of March 31, 2026, the bank's Gross Advances stood at Rs. 1,01,295 Crore, showing a Year-on-Year growth of 15.66%. Total Deposits reached Rs. 1,23,346 Crore, an increase of 14.71% year-on-year. CASA (Current Account Savings Account) deposits were Rs. 39,621 Crore, up by 17.47% year-on-year, resulting in a CASA Ratio of 32.12%, an improvement of 75 basis points. These figures are provisional and subject to audit by the bank's statutory auditors. The information was disclosed on April 01, 2026.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial production of its enhanced capacity  at its Unit at Banda, Distt. Sagar, Madhya Pradesh
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Ltd. has announced the commencement of commercial production for its enhanced capacity at its Banda unit in the Sagar district of Madhya Pradesh. Effective March 31, 2026, the Diammonium Phosphate & Nitrogen and phosphorus (DAP/NPK) plant's capacity has been increased from 2,40,000 MTPA to 3,30,000 MTPA, representing a capacity addition of 90,000 MTPA. This expansion required an investment of approximately Rs. 107 Crore, financed through a mix of debt and internal accruals. The rationale behind this expansion is to meet the growing demand and supply gap for DAP/NPK fertilizers in India. The company's existing capacity utilization was 100% up to January 31, 2026.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: SONAM LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on April 01, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Sonam Limited held a Board Meeting on April 01, 2026, at its registered office in Morbi, Gujarat. The meeting, which commenced at 05:00 p.m. and concluded at 05:30 p.m., resulted in the approval of appointing HI-CARE CAPITAL ADVISORS LLP as its Investor Relations (IR) Agency. This appointment is effective from April 01, 2026. The company has also designated a specific email address, cs@sonamquartz.com, for all investor-related queries. The IR agency's contact details are: Address: 409, Anant Building, Kalawad Road, Rajkot, Gujarat - 360005, and Email: info@hicareadvisors.com. The information will be available on the company's website at https://www.sonamquartz.com.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: ABB India Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: ABB India Limited has received an order from the Commissioner of Customs, APACC, Bengaluru, imposing a penalty of Rs. 3,55,73,125 and a redemption fine of Rs. 11,00,00,000 under Sections 114A and 125 of the Customs Act, 1962, respectively. This order, dated March 26, 2026, was received by the company on April 01, 2026, and relates to the alleged misclassification of goods. ABB India Limited plans to file an appeal against this order, expressing confidence in a favorable outcome and does not anticipate any material impact on the company's operations. The company will keep the stock exchanges informed of any further developments.

announcements.subject: Closure of operations
announcements.detail: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange about update on Closure of operations
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange that it has resumed operations at its Mundra Plant. The plant has an installed capacity of 4150 MW. This update follows a temporary suspension of operations at the Mundra units. The company has made this disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.company: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited
announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'transfer of investment management rights of certain AIF funds '.
announcements.ai_summary: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited has completed the transfer of investment management rights for certain Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) from ICICI Venture Funds Management Company Limited. This transfer, effective April 1, 2026, follows regulatory approval from SEBI received on March 2, 2026. The company will now manage five specific AIFs: India Advantage Fund S4 I, India Advantage Fund S5 I, India Advantage Fund S5 II, India Real Estate Investment Fund Series 2, and Iven Amplifi Fund. The requisite agreements between ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited and ICICI Venture have been executed.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: The Karnataka Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Provisional Key Business Parameters as on 31.03.2026
announcements.ai_summary: The Karnataka Bank Limited has released its provisional key business parameters as of March 31, 2026. Deposits increased by 3.8% year-on-year to ₹108,840.95 crore, and by 4.5% quarter-on-quarter to ₹104,111.52 crore as of December 31, 2025. The share of CASA to total deposits rose to 33.65% as of March 31, 2026, a 190 basis points increase year-on-year and a 212 basis points increase quarter-on-quarter. Gross advances grew by 6.9% year-on-year to ₹83,336.92 crore and by 7.8% quarter-on-quarter to ₹77,282.85 crore as of December 31, 2025. These figures are provisional and subject to audit by the statutory auditors.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Bharat Coking Coal Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Provisional Monthly Production Performance for the month of March, 2026'.
announcements.ai_summary: SJVN Limited, a Joint Venture of the Government of India and the Government of Himachal Pradesh, has announced significant milestones in energy generation for the financial year 2025-26. The company's operational power stations generated a total of 13302 million units of energy. Specifically, the 1500 MW Nathpa Jhakri Hydro Power Station achieved its second-highest annual generation at 7506.617 million units and crossed the 150 billion units cumulative generation milestone in March 2026. The 412 MW Rampur Hydro Power Station recorded its highest-ever annual generation of 2108.034 million units, surpassing the 2100 million units mark for the first time in its eleven-year operational history. Additionally, the 60 MW Naitwar Mori Hydro Power Station generated 310.37 million units, which is 17% higher than its design energy. The 1000 MW Bikaner Solar Power Station also set a record by generating one billion units of energy on March 19, 2026.

announcements.subject: Retirement
announcements.detail: Bharat Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Retirement
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Bharat Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about a change in its directorship. Shri Vikraman N, who held the position of Director (Human Resources), retired from his services on March 31, 2026, upon attaining the age of superannuation. Consequently, Shri Vikraman N ceased to be the Director (Human Resources) of the company effective April 1, 2026. The company has provided the necessary disclosures as per Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, in an enclosed annexure.

announcements.subject: Change in Auditors
announcements.detail: Menon Bearings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
announcements.ai_summary: Mr. Abhay Golwalkar, Chartered Accountant, has been re-appointed as the Internal Auditor for Menon Bearings Limited for the financial year 2026-27, effective from April 1, 2026. Mr. Golwalkar brings over 32 years of experience in auditing, taxation, and corporate advisory, with expertise in internal control systems and management information systems. He also has experience with mergers, acquisitions, and takeovers, and serves as an internal auditor for other listed companies. The re-appointment is in accordance with Section 138 of the Companies Act, 2013, and Rule 13 of the Companies (Accounts) Rules, 2014. This information is disclosed as per Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
announcements.detail: The Magnum Ice Cream Company HoldCo 1 Netherlands B.V. has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 18(6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.ai_summary: The Magnum Ice Cream Company HoldCo 1 Netherlands B.V. has acquired an aggregate of 145,44,12,858 equity shares of Kwality Wall’s (India) Limited from various sellers, including The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V., Unilever PLC, Unilever Group Limited, Unilever Overseas Holdings AG, Unilever UK&CN Holdings Limited, Unilever South India Estates Limited, Unilever Assam Estates Limited, and Unilever Overseas Holdings B.V. This acquisition took place on March 30, 2026, pursuant to a share purchase agreement dated June 25, 2025. The Acquirer has been disclosed as such in the detailed public statement published on February 20, 2026. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 18(6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
